rngo —rngo dib bye rje spyo— — — ༷ sgyu 1ba — — rte—— — —karsha 1 za rte —rje spyi rje — 1 spyo3 — —pa — hūṃ3hūṃ—— di— —1 1brjo~X: ba:— — dzi ba —1 ‘ ༷snyed ba— she —— dzihūṃ pa ba— :rdo smo1rje: — — — ka bye khro khro: hūm̐bab danghru rje rje ka : hūm̐ ra 1 mtsho sngon mi jigs dpe spun khang / ba / ji bsgyu spyi1(—ste po —3 bza~X:༵1
dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /dpa' ris sangs rgyas kyis brtsams/mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

nar dan gnad bsgyus/nang don gnad bsdus/srol rgyun gyi dag yig mi dpe cha rnams ni/ 'bri'1 yod kyi ming rnams preng bar bsgrigs pa'i tshigs bcad yin pas/ go sla zhing 'khyer bde mod/rig par byed pa'i gzhung lugs gtan nas med pas/ yi ge'i dag cha dang /ming gi ngo bo dang bcas pa'i nges shes bskyed par go de 'dra chod kyin mi 'dug rje zung kha bas/ mdzad pa kun las gsung gi mdzad pa mchog /ces gsungs pa ltar/ rig gnas gang rung zhig legs par shes dgos na1 don chen gang rung 'ig 'grub par re dgos na/ thabs thes zung 'jug gi gzhung lugs tshad ma dang ldan pa zhib la ma brten na/ tshegs che don chung / bar chad 'byung nyed yang yod srid yi ge'i dag cha 'thon dkas na/ ming dod legs par rtogs dgos na/ tha snyad rig pa shes rgyu gal che/ de'i phyir gzhung 'di las bod yig gi byung rabs dang / skad cha dang yi ge'i phan yon/ ming gi rigs sgyud kyi byung 'phel/ ming gi gdags gzhi dang khyad chos/ ming gi ngo bo 'gur lugs/ ming gi sdeb sbyor/ zhe sa dang / mngon brjod dang / nyams mtshon pa'i sgra dang / dpe chob1 sogs kyi byung tshul dang 'jug tshul/ yig nor 'byung rkyen sel thabs/ ming don 'grel tshul sogs gnad dan tshar du 1 ༷

dag yig rig pa'i ga pa mngon sgyung /dngar ba la1 rigs pa'i sgo nas khebs rgya che la phyogs lhung med par mdor bstan pa dang / zhib cha gsal la nges shes 'drongs pa'i 'grel brgyab pa dang / sgos su bod skad kyi ming gi sbyor ba las/ ming gang mang zhig rten cing 'brel bar byung ba'i chos nyid kyi gab pa mngon par phyung nas yod pas/bod skad kyi tha snyad rig pa bskab sbyang dang / brtag dpyad bcas la phan chen po thogs par mngon no/ /

dkar chagadakar chagasde tshan dang bo— skad cha dang yi ge'i phan yon/ (1)sde tshad gnyis pa/ bod yig byung rabs kyi dpyang thag gcod pa'i ral ḍi3/3)sde tshan gsum pa/ yi ge 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad dang brda don gsal —ba'i chos lnga rgyas par bshad pa/ (66)sde tshan bzhi ba/ yi ge'i dag cha gdon pa'i man ngag (96)sde tshan lnga ba1 ming gi byung 'phel shes rab 'bar ba'i me stag (115)sde tshan drug pa/ bsdus ming smra ba'i bcud len/ (132)sde tshan bdun pa/ rnam dbye dang bo'i gab pa mngod phyung / (203)sde tshan brgyad pa/ bya ba rigs gsum dpyad pa rtags 'jug gi zur rgyan/ (231)sde tshan dgu ba/ bya ba'i ming dang dngos po'i ming skor zhig gi 'brel ba dang khyad par gsal ba'i sgron me/ ༷ (272)sde tshan bcu ba/ ming gzhi rigs 'dra rkyang brtsegs las rten cing 'grel bar byung ba'i ming gi skor/ —208)

dag yig ris pa'i gab pa mngon jing /sde tshan bcu gcig pa/ rjes 'jug na dang da yi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'jug pa gser gyi zhun thigs11 (303)sde tshan bcu gnyis pa/ ming gzhi ra dang ra btags can skor zhig gi 'brel ba zhib mo rnam 'thag (327)sde tshan bcu gsum pa/ ming mang don gcig la 'jug pa ngag gi dpal ba/ (346)sde tshan bcu bzhi ba ming gcig dan mang la 'jug pa mthong ba don 1gas ma / (364)sde tshan bco lnga ba/ zhe tshig rna ba'i bcud len (40ste)sde tshan bcu drug pa— ming gi sdeb sbyor mkhas pa'i rna rgyan/ (427)sde tshan bcu bdun pa/ sgra gdangs mthun par 'gyur tshul gyi gnad don gsal byed/ — (467)sde tshad bco brgyad pa/ nyams mtshon pa'i sgra rnam par bshad pa/ ༷(470)sde tshad bcu dgu ba— mngon brjod gzi yi phreng ba/ ( 98)sde tshan nyi shu ba/ grangs kyi mngon brjod mi ba'i da gzung sa ka/638)sde tshan nyer gcig pa/ dpe chos smra ba'i gsos mchog (6621sde tshan nyer gnyis pa/ yig nor 'byung rkyen sel ba'i gnyen po/2 (701)
za ba 4

skad za dang yi ge'i phan yonasgo tshan dang bo/ skad za dang yi ge'i phan yon/skad chas mi rigs dud 'gro'i gral nas phyung / /yi ges rig gnas spel nas long ba spyod rgyas/ /skad dang yi ge mi rigs rang nyid kyi/ / rin ched blo med yin pas mig lhar gces/ /rig pa ni stobs shugs yin/ mi ribs gang la dbang ba'i skad cha dar yi ge zun mong ma yin pa ni/ mi rigs de'i rig pa'i gter mdzod che shos shig yin te/ mi rigs gang gi rig gnas dang tshan rig dar zhing rgyas pa la/nus pa gang che thon cing 'thon bzhin yod/mi'i 'gro ba'i skad cha ni/ bskal ba ya thog gi spyi tshogs kyi ngal rtsol las byung zhir / spyi tshogs rgya nge cher gyur pa'i shugs kyis bkol sa'ang rgya ji cher gyur pa red/ rus rgyud tsho bar chags pa dang / tsho ba mi rigs su gyur nas/thun mong gi skad cha dang / thun mong gi gnas yul/ thun mong gi dpal 'byor 'tsho ba/ thun mong gi rig gnas steng du༄ngon pa'i thun mong gi bsam blo 'du shes yod song / skad cha med rgyu na/ mi yi spyi tshogs mi 'grub pas/ sam pa brje res 1

dag yig rig pa'i gas pa mngon sgyung byas te mnyam du log nas rang byung khams las 'tsho tshis lon dka'/ skad cha med rgyu na/ mi yis bsam blo gtong mi shes/ nyams myong brgyud nas rig pa bskyed mi thub— de'i phyir si ta lin mchog gis/ sgra dpa ldad pa'i skad cha ne/mi'i 'gro ba'i lo rgyus thog mi rnams la rigs ram byas nas dud 'gro'i gral nar phyi ra bud de/ spyi tshogs tshugs sheng / rang gi blo gros bskyed nas1 spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed don du gter te/ rang byung gi gnod pa la rnam par rgyal bar 'thab cing / nga tshor de ring gi dar rgyas 'di 'dra bstabs pa'i stobs shugs shig yin par(mar khe mi'i ring lugs dang sgra rig pa'i gnad don zhes bya ba las/)gsungs so1 / skad cha ni mi'i 'gro ba phan tshun 'brel byed kyi yo byad kal che shos shig yin mod/ yul dang dus kyib bska‘sha ba yod do/ /yi ge byung ba nas bzung skad cha'i zhad cha 'di gnyis bsal nab / mad cha'i byed las rgya cher btang ste mi'i 'gro ba 'brel rogs byed spyad gal che shos shig tu gyur song / de la chen lo mi mchog gis khro gter bzhu ba das bzung / yi ge gsar du bskrun te rig gzhung sna tshogs bris pa dang stags nas/ rig pa'i dpal dang ldan pa'i dus skabs la bslebs so(mar khe si dang men ko si'i gsung rtsom ces btus zhes bgyi ba'i deb bzhi ba las/)zhes gsungs so/ /des na mi rigs gang la yi be med rgyu na/ rig gnas dang tshan rig dar rgyas phud sum tshogs pa zhig yod mi srid 2

skad cha dang yi ge'i phan pon/do/ /spyi tshogs gong du 'phel nas stobs 'byor gzhan dring mi 'job/ pa zhig 'dzom pa'i tshad la bzabs mi srid do/ /bong gsal1 skad cha dang yi ge ni shes rab gsog pa dang / rig gnasaXskyed pa dang / tshan rig spel ba'i yo byad 'phrul dang ldan pa zhig yin pas/mi rigs shig la bshad na/ de'i rig pa'i gter mdzod che shos ni/ rang nyid la dbang ba'i skad cha dang yi ge'i yan las med do/ /rig pa'i gter mdzod che shos 'di'i nang du skad rigs kyi rnam bzhag ston mdzad khang yod de/ skad rigs gang dang gang la rnam bzhag gi 'gyur ldog yod pa'am med pa dang / bod skad la khyad chos ci zhig yod pa sogs kyi go ba ster ro/ /skad cha ni sgra dang don gyi 'dren ma yin yang / skad rigs so so'i sgra gang rigs kyis don gang rigs ston pa'i nges pa med pas/ gang zhig don gcig kyang sgra mi gcig pas mtshod par byed zub/ dper na/ bzhing sreg pa can la bod skad du me zer/ rgya skad du ho ma zer/ legs sbyar gyi skad du sag ni zer ba lha bu'o/ /mi rigs mi gcig pas skad rigs kyang mi gcig ste/ sgra ba rnams kyis 'jig rten khams kyi skad rigs la ming gzhi'i skad dang / 'byor ba'i skad dang / 'gyur ba'i skad dang / rnam mang 'dus pa'i skad bcas rnam pa bzhir phye yod la/ rgya skad ni ming gzhi'i skad du gtogs 3

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /shing / de'i khyad chos ni rnam bzhag gi 'gyur ldog med cing / tshig gi sbyor ba gtso bor ming gi sgrig rim dang tshig grogs la brten pa'i sgo nas don mtshon pa yin la/ bod skad ni 'gyur ba'i skad du gtogs shing / khyad chos ni ming gi dam bzhag gi 'gyur ba sna tshogs la brten nas go brda sprod pa zhig yin no/ /skad rigs 'di gnyis ka'i bya ba'i ming tsam la bstos na yang /—rgya skad kyi bya ba'i ming la sgra gdangs kyi 'gyur ba med pas/ yul dus rkyen gsum gyi khyad chos mi 'dug de yang rgya skad kyi bya ba'i ming la dus kyi khyad chos med pas/ dus gsal byed kyi tshig grogs sbyar nas dus kyi rnam bzhag bstan dgos/ dper na/ zaza tshe bza4oṃ za za ba — oṃ ba1 tshig ka 'di dag las dus gsal byed kyi tshig gros sa za tshe za dmas kyis rim pa bzhin bya ba ma 'ongs pa dang / da lha ba dang / 'das pa'i dus mtshon pa dang / nyams mtshon pa'i brda rtags1 'di skul tshig gi tshab byas pa'o/ /gal te dus gsal byed kyi tshig grogs dang nyams mtshon pa'i rtags sogs ma sbyar na/ dus kyi khyad chos sam rnam bzhag dang / skul tshig sogs ston sa mi 'gro'o/ /tshig 'di dag bod skad du bshad na/ dus gsal byed kyi tshig grogs sogs ma spyar kyang dus kyi dam bzhag gsal bar thon te/ngas dpe cha gdon/ ngas dpe cha 'don/ ngas dpe cha bton/ khyod kyis dpe cha thon lha du'o/ /4

skad cha dang yi ge'i pan yon/rgya skad kyi bya ba'i ming la rkyen gyi khyad chos med pas/ ming rkyang du rkyen gang las byung ba mi shes/ tshig tu sbyar tshe gzod bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba rtogs thub/ tsho༅cho:ji— ba༅cho1 da—lo1 snga ma'i bya ba byed pa bo gzhan dang 'bril bas bdag gi dngos po dang / bar ma'i bya ba las dang 'brel bas gzhan gyi dngos po yin pa dang / phyi ma'i༄ ba rang shugs su byung bas/ bdag gzhan gang du'ang ma gtogs pa'o/ /bod skad kyi bya ba'i ming la rkyen gyi khyad chos ldan pas/ tshig sbyor la ma brtags kyang don gsal/ dper na/ thi gu bcad byung / thi gu chod thal/ ji gu chad song lta bu'o/ 1rgya skad kyi bya ba'i ming la yul gyi khyad chos med pas/ ming rkyang du 'jug yul mi gsal/ tshig grogs spyar tshe/ gzod bya byed las gsum gyi dbye ba gsal 'gro mcho tsā14ba tshe tshig sbyor 'a di las tshor byed pa bo dang / shā bya ba dang / ma las yin pa shes 'gro/ bod skad kyi bya ba'i ming la yul gyi khyad chos yod de/ byed pa la da lha ba dang / las la ma 'ongs pa dang / bya bar dus kyi bab dang bstun nas 'jug pa yin pas kha gsal/dper na/ 'don pa bos gdon pa mang bo bton zin lta du'o/ /gzhan yang bod skad kyi bya ba'i ming dngos po'i ming du 'jug pa dang /dngos po'i ming bya ba'i ming du 'jug pa/ dngos po'i ming dang khyad chos kyi 5

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung meng phan tshun 'jug pa/ khyad chos kyi ming bya pa'i ming du 'jug pa/ ming gi tsheg bar sdud pa sogs rnam bzhag gi 'gyur bar nges srol yod de/ rgya skad la 'di rigs kyi rnam bzhag 'gyur tshul med do/ /skad cha la mi rigs kyi khyad chos yod don ni/ mi rigs so so gnas sa'i rang byung gi khor yug mi gcig pa dang / spyi tshogs kyi zags tshul mi gcig pa/srid 'byor rig gsum gyi 'tsho ba'i goms srol mi gcig pa/ dngos po'i ngos 'dzin thabs mi gcig pa sogs kyi dbang mis/ chos can gcig pa'i ngo bo dang khyad ches/ de nyid chos can gzhan dag dang rten cing 'brel ba'i gnas tshu' sogs la go ba len pa'i khyad par byung thog ston byed kyi tha sa dang khyad chos kyang so sor rtser song /rig pa'i gter mdzod che shos 'di'i nang du tha snyad kyi 'jug pa mtshon byed khang yod de/ 'jig rten khams kyi dngos po sna tshogs rnam par bstan nas blo mig skyed cing / longs spyod phun sum tshags pa'i 'dod pa don du smin par byed pa'o/ /skad cha'i spub byed tha snyad yin la/ de'i rtsa ba bskal ba ya thog nas tshugs shing / grangs kyis 'jigs pa ster pa'i ba snyad rgya mtsho spyi tshogs kyi lo rgyus thil bo'i brgyud rim las chags pa yin no/ /za snyad lhag pa phyug na/brda lhag pa smod mkhas/ de yang tha snyad kyi dbye ba lhag pa zhib cing / skad 6

snad dang yi ge'i na yonagadangs kyi khyad par lhag pa ba/sa na/ rjod byed tshig gis brjod par 'dod pa'i don gang khebs rgya nyi ma'i 'od lhar khyab pa dang / zhib cha ku sha'i rtse lhar phra yang ji ma ji bzhin du mtshon thub/ bod skad ni gang ci'i thad nas 'di ltar yin te— skad kye gdangs la pho mo ma ning ci khyad par gsal bar ma zad1sgra'i ba ro la drang ba/ bkug pa/ mad pa/ snyeng ba/ bstod pa bcas dbye 4 lnga yod cing / ming gi sdeb sbyor la rtags mtshungs sbyar ba dang / sgra mtshung spyar ba/ gdas mtshungs sbyar ba dang bcas pa'i sgo nas brjod bde la rol mo'i snyan cha thon snang / dngos po gang dang kang la yang ming ma btags na brda mi 'phrod/ la bkar gshegs pa'i mad las1 ming du gdags par ma mdzad na/ /'jig rten thams cad rtsongs ba1ra 'gyur/ /de bas smongs pa1 sel ba'i phyir/ /mgon pos ming du gdags par mdzad1 /ces gsungs pa lhar/ ming gi mtshan nyid ni don gyi ngo bo rjod byed yin te/ bod kha ba can pas thun mong ma yin pa'i tha snyad phun sum tshogs pa 'di rigs la brten nas dngos po rnam pa sna tshogs bgrang gis mi lang ba ngos zin cing rtogs ba ra gyur song / tha snyad 'dang tshod cig khong du ma chud da/ dngos po'i rigs dang ngo bo dang khyad chos dang byed las sogs kyi zhib cha mi shes/ tha snyad phun sum tshogs pa brda zod lugs ltar tshig tu ma spyar na/ bsam pa brje res byas nas 'dod don smin par bya mi rub / bod mi dmangs kyis tha snyad phun sum tshogs pa'i 7

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /rgyu cha blangs das/ brda sprod lugs lhar/ skad cha'i 'brel spyad bzos nas bsam pa brje res byas thog srid 'byor rig gsum la sogs pa'i spyi tshogs kyi bya ba sgru sa nas/'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen che dga' dang nge mthor btang ba yin no/kang gi 'byung khungs mtha' dpyad na/ de'i don rtogs tshod ji zab tu 'gro bar ma zad/ gna' mis dngos po gang dag phan tshun rten cing 'brel bar brtags nas ngos 'dzin thabs dang / ming 'dogs lugs dang / za snyad phreng bar sgrig pa'i blo rtsal sogs kyang shes pa'i phan pa yod de/ 'dra ba'am 'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byas shing / sde ba gcig pa'i yi ge zhig ming gzhir bzhag nas/ tha snyad skor zhig sgrig pa'i thabs la dpe blangs na/dbyibs rigs 'dra 'ig ste dper na kor kor zhig la blto sa das/ dngul gyis tshab byed pa'i dong tshe la sgor mo dang / zas kyi 'khur pa la gor ba/ rdo —— ——sgong dbyibs can la gor ma mtha' bskor ba'i nye 'dabs la khor yug—'phang lo la 'khor lo / 'khor lo'i rang 'gros la 'khor ba/'khor bar byed pa la skor ba/'khor ba'i rnam pa la 'khor ro ro / tshan khag lha ba la skor zhes — —pa sogs 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas btags pa yin no/ /yang / 'a par byed pa la bltos nas khyad par la dbye ba/phra ma la dbyen/gzhan dbang — —gis kha bkad pa'am phral ba la zu ba/zu nas so sor gyur pa la zud pa/tshal nga

skad cha dang yi ge'i phan yon/ba la zud ka rang shugs su kha gad pa'am zal ba la bye ba/ thor ba la byer ba/rang yul dang ring du bral ba la byes pa lta bu sogs 'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas btags pa lta bu'o/ /ming gi tshogs pa 'di gnyis la bltas na/ 'di rnams kyi ming gzhi sde ba mtshungs pas 'brel chags shing / don nye bas phyogs mthun pa/ chos nyid thun phang ba zhig gis dbang du bsdus nas/ star chags shing tshar du dngar ba'i gral gcig tu 'dus pa 'dir ming gi rigs rgyud zer/ 'di dang 'di shābu'i ming gi sbyor ba tshad mas grub pa ni mi rabs mi thog gi blo rtsal gyi zhun thigs yin pas/ nga tshos 'dzin skyong spel gsum bya rgyu gal shin tu che'o/ /rig pa klong du brdol ba'i deng gi dus rabs 'dir/ dngos po gsar ba nu mthud nas 'bor ched du 'byung bzhin yod mod/ chang drangs pa la gtam/ bu skyes pa la ming / (mi la ras pa'i rnam zar las/)zhes pa lhar/ de rnams la ming re ma btags na 'bod dka'/ ming 'dogs na/ de ming gi rigs rgyud kang la gtogs pa dang 'dogs tha sa ma gas shes dgos/ bod skad kyi ming gi khyad chos la bstas na/ gdags gzhi gsum yod de/ gcig ni 'bod sla ba ste/ sgra nyung ngu zhig dgos/ gnyis ni dod gsal ba ste/ 'dra chags pa zhig dgos/gsum ni brjod bde ba ste/ sdeb legs pa zhig dgos/ ming 'dogs pa'i gnas lugs 'di la bltas na/ nga tsho'i lo tsā ba dag gis ming bsgyur ba'am 9

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung btags pa gang rung / spyir btang bod mang byings kyi ngag rtsal 'dra thon med/dper na1 zochezagi 'gyur la kha lo sgyur chas dang / mang byings kyis srabaskyogs la bltos nas kha skyogs zer/ tshe lo gi 'gyur la 'gyig 'khor dang mang byings kyis 'khor rkyal zer/ ba 'gyur la glog skye gzugs bsnyan dang / mang gyings kyis me long spru phab dang / mthe bob pra phab kyi pra mo la bltos nas glog za ze ra/ ba 'gyur la glog man dang 1 mang byings kyis glob gsag zer/ ngo gi 'byur la kun khyab rlung 'phrin dang / mang bying kyis rgyang grags zer/ ba 'gyur la lag khyer glog zhu dang / mang byings kyis lag dkar zer ba la sogs pa lha bu/ 'gyur zags pa'i ming gsar ba rnams lo ka'i gral du mu tshugs kyis bkol kyang khyeb par gtang dka'/ mang byings kyi brda spyar ba'i ming gsar ba rnams gshog thobs min yang nam 'phang spyad nas sa gsal thang go kun tu grags pa de'i rgyu mtshan ni ma zhus rang gsal yin pas/ nga tshos mang byings kyi skad cha bslab dgos1mang byings kyis brda sbyar ba'i brjod bde zhing 'bod sla ba/ don gsal zhing go sla ba'i za snyad bsar ba dmas ci zub kyis btus nas rgya cher bed spyad rgyu gal che'o/ /rig pa'i gter mdzod che shos 'di'i nang du lo rgyus kyi bshams ston bang yod pas/ lo rgyus rnying bas nges shes gsar ba skyed/ zer ba lhar/10

skad cha dab yi ge'i phan yon/—'das pa'i dran pa bzangs pa/ da lha ba'i go ba ster ba/ ma 'ongs pa'i lung bstan pa sogs kyis logs nyes mtha' dpyad nas/'gal spang mthun sgrub/rnam par rgyal bar sdun na skyod pa'i gdeng thob bo//spre'u byang chub sems dpa' nas mir gyur pa dang / bskal ba ya thog sha spyi tshogs nas zan g.yog gi spyi tshogs su bslebs pa'i lo ngo stong phrag du ma'i lo rgyus rags pa dang / gnya' khri btsan po nas gnam ri srong btsan bar rgyal rabs sum cu rtsa gnyis lo ngo stong tsho nye ba'i lo sgyus sogs/ ha lam ngag gi rgyun dang / byung ba'i rjes dang / grub pa'i rtags sna tshogs la brten nas bris pa yin srid/ bod kyi gna' bo'i byur rabs kyi rjes gcad par/ skad cha'i rgyu chas khungs sne dang dpang rtags gtso bo 'don sa 'gro ba ni rig ros dang 'gyur rdo sogs las brtag bzod cing khungs thub/ deng kan su'u nub phyogs kyi ku we(za )sa char gna' bo'i rgya skad du(lo )'gu tshang zer yul gru de dang thog bod kyi tsho chen 'gu tshang zhes pa'i gnas yul yin pa shes thub/ mdo smad chos 'byung las kyang gsungs snang / kan su'i da ༅la bod skad du dgo lung zer/ 7tshe la sngon chad ma ma zer/ de yang 'brong lung gi skad dod yin te/ sa cha 'di gnyis lo rgyus thog bod kyi 'brog yul rtsod med yongs grags yin no/ /po ba ba bod skad du mi nyag snye/ bod kyi tsho chen ldong(ma)dang lho par tshem)sogs mnyam du log nas rgyal khab cig 11

dag yig rig pa'i gab ba mngon rgyung/tshugs pa'i mtshan la bod dkar po chen po mchog gi rgyal khab ces gsol/ rgya 'gyur dur bar zadang bar ma'i yang zer/ mi nyag rgyal khab 'di bod rang gtso bor mdzad pa'i mi rigs du mas deng nyin zha dang / hra' na zhi'i byang phyogs dang / kan su'i nub byang dang / mtsho sngon gyi byang shar dang / nang sog gi nu phyogs dang cas pa'i rgya khyod zin yod/ spyi lo 1༷da8pa nas tshugs te/ 1226bar nub par gyur pa'i rgyal khab cig kho thag yin mod/ sngon chad mi rigs gzhan pa'i lo rgyus smra ba mi nyung ba zhig rgyal khab 'di grangs nyung mi rigs gang gis tshugs par the tshom gyi dra bar tshud 'dug nye rabs dang sgos su deng sgomar rgyal khab phyi nang gi mkhas pa mang bos/ gtso bor skad cha'i rgyu cha gzhir bzung nas rnam par dpyad nas bod yin par nges song / zhin cang yu gur rang skyong smongs kyi yul gru zhig la bar zer ba/mkhar chag ces pa'i zur chag ste/ ming 'di las yul gru de thog mar bod kyi 'dug sa yin par rtogs so/ /gling ge sar rgyal bo'i spung tshar du dngar bar bltas na/ bod nang khul dang sgos su bod dang mi rigs gzhan dag bar du snga phyir 'khrug pa mang bo byung ba'i tshul mthong / de las bshad yams dang blo bzo ji 'dra 'dres yod kyang / tshig— shul gyi don dngos dmas ni bod kyi lo rgyus dang / bod dang mi rigs 'brel yod kyi lo rgyus dpyad par bya ba'i rgyu cha rtsa chen rnyed dka' ba —12

snad dang yi ge'i pan yon/zhig yin no/ /dmag las kyi tha snyad mi nyung ba zhig dper na/ btsan po/ sgar/ ru/gtor ma sogs/ deng sang rim bzhin rgyal po/ dgon ka/ 'brog sde/ mchod zas rnams la 'jug pa las/ bod kyi lo pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan ba dar ba'i stobs kyis/ dam gal4 rim gyis nyams par gyur pa'i rtags grub/ming gi sgra tsam bsgyur ba/ dper na/ rgya skad kyi ༅la ting lo/ — la cog tse/ rje khrang zhi/ zal ling sogs/ bod 'gyur du zags pa dang /bod skad kyi phrugs lu la rtsam pa la tsho/ rgod ma la za/ gro ma la bsogs rgya 'gyur du༄ba/ pa la sogs pa las/ rgya bod phan tshun 'brel ba'i lo rgyus kyi yun ha cang ring bar shes/ bod skad dang rgya skad las sgra don gnyis ka gcig pa'i the snyad mi nyung ba zhig 'dug pa/ sgang dang tho/ rong dngas she grong dang/ yun dang/ khyod dang༅/ lha bu dang / sgos su spu can sa cha sogs kyi kul skad du/ zadang skye (sko) zadang sems / za(tsho)dang rgya/ —༄pa za ༅dang gcig gnyis gsum bzhi lha bu sogs lhag par mang ba las rgya skad dang bod skad kyi 'brel ba ha cang nye zhing / rgya dang bod kyi skad cha khungs gcig tu bshad pa don ldan du mthong ngo / 1 lo rgyus bshad na bod yig gi brtsams chos grangs dang sna kha ha cang 13

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /mang / 'dir spro ba'i dgos pa med do/ /mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog gis/ mi rigs rang gi lo rgyus ma shes na/ nags tsha' nang 'i sprel dang 'dra(deb cher dkar po zhes bya ba las/)zhes gsungs pa gnad che ste/ mi rigs rang gi spyi tshogs 'phel ba'i go rim dang chos nyid ma rtogs na 'byung 'gyur gyi rgyang mi mthong / lo rgyus kyi nyams myong dang legs nyes ma shes na/ rang gi mi rigs la rang rtogs kyis sha tsha ba dang stobs 'byor mnga' thang ldan par brtson 'grus 'jug mi shes/ rang gi mi rigs kyi lo rgyus dang 1 mi rigs gzhan dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus noms shes da/ gzod mi rigs 'dra med ring lugs kyi lha ba log pa ring du dor nas/ mi rigs rang brtse ji mthor btang thog mi rigs rang gi la rgya bsung thub gzod mi rigs 'dra mnyam dang 'grig mthun gyi lha ba dam por bzung na so/ mi rigs bar gyi 'brel ba legs par btab nas/ mi rigs rang gi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis rgyas par gtong zub bo/ /rig ba'i gter mdzod che shos 'di'i nang du sgyu rtsom mtshon byed khang yod la/ de las ngas gi dpal rnam par rol thog 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgyu rtsal blangs nas1go bad krod pa'i nus pa ji cher gtong thub/ngag gi sgyu rtsal dang 'grel ba'i mngon brjod/legs bshad/ dpe chos/gtam dpe/ gab tshig glu/ snyan bag gtam rgyud/ spung la sogs pas/ mi 14

skad dang bka'i pan yon/rigs shig gi thon skyed kyi khyad chos dang / 'thab rtsod kyi snying stobs dngaka'atsho ba'i spyod stangs dang / yul srol gom 'dris dang / bsam pa'i 'du shes so sa kyi so ba ster bas/ de rnams 'chad nyan rol gsum las shes rgya bskyed par ma zad1 zhe rgyud legs par sbyangs shing sems 'phang ji mthor 'di zhes po dang / ngag gi rgyu cha gang mang zin gas brda sod pa'i tshul rtsal du 'don pa sogs kyis phan pa rab tu che'o/ /— — bod skad kyi mngon brjod ha cang 'byor zhing tshig dbar mang nyur mi— gcig la / byung rabs dang spub lugs kyang sna chogs yod de/ tshig gi phreng bar sbyar mkhas na/ sgyu rtsom lha mo'i lus lhag par mdzes ba dang / ngag lhag par snyan par 'gyur 'gro/ dper na/ nyis la 'gro ba'i sgron me zhes ba yi yul can gyi yon tan mngon par bstan byung / sdig pa rwa tsa la mar gyis nyams byed zer ba na/ dug can de'i gnyen za mar gyis go chod par thes 'gro khyab 'jug la gon gsum non zer ba/ gna' gna' na/ lha dang lha ma1 yid 'thab pa na— lha khyab 'jug gis lha min stobs ldan mi thub pas/ mi'u chung zhig tu brdzus nas/ sa gom pa do bzang ba1 pa na/ gsum yang khyer rtser/ de nas lus bskyed de gom pa dang tshu ri rab kyi steng dngad gob pa gnyis pa rgya mtsho'i mthar spos/ gom pa gsum pa spo sa med par stobs ldan gyi mgo la spos nas rgyal ba na/ khyab 'jug la ming de lhar grags pa'i don shes par 'gyur ro//16

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /yang / tshigs bcad du spyar na/dbyangs can lha mo'i dbu ku'i zur phud 'ad1 /sprin bral 'chi med lam dang yang dag mtshungs/ /lang tsho'i rang bzhin dar ba'i nu 'bur zung / /dbyar gyi chu 'dzin gsar ba g.yo ba bzhin/ /zhes pa las nam mkhar 'chi med lam dang / sprin la chu 'dzin 'jug pa4do bsnyams nas ngags na par thur pa lha du'o1 / bod kyi dpe chos ) sgrur dab gtam rgyud dang / lo rgyus da nga / bstan bcos dang / nyams rtsong sogs las byung ba yin la/ tshags dam zhing brjod bde/ tshig thung la ldand 'dus/ don mtshon pa'i mthu che/ dper na/ shes pa ha cang nyung ba'i dpe la/ rgya mtsho'i chu jigs zheb grags pa ste/ sgra'i bstan bcos thog mar byung ba'i ba ka sngon sum cu gsum da bram ze sarba 4 zhes pa'i sgra mkhan zhig byung / des sgra rig pa lha'i dbang bo brgya byin la bslabs/ brgya byin gyis drang srong phur du la bsnabs/ phur bu lha rnams kyi sgra'i ston par bskos pa na/ de nga rgyal che bas lha rnams kyis bsten dka' ba byung tshe/ lha'i dbang bos phur bu la gser dum zhig bskur gle rgya mtsho'i nang nas chu tsum bgang longs gsungs pa ltar blangs pas/ de las ku sha'i rtses chu jigs gcig blang0das/ sgra yi bstan brtsos rgya mtsho tsam/ /kho bos shes pa 16

skad dang yi ge'i ldan yon1 — —bum pa cam/ /khyod kyis shes pa chu thigs tsam/ /zhes gsus sums phur ku'i nga rgyal bcag pa'i gna' gtam de shes la/ mang she 'asgo rnar gzed ni/chag sgo rid gyis nyos pa'i dpe ste/ rus sgal kha'i shing shar1— zhes ba'i gtam rgyud kyis mchog sbyin par 'byur ba lha bu'o/ /bod kyi legs bkad di/ phal cher mkha4chen dam pa'i gsu sgro dang / yang na/ gtam rgyud dang rnam thar dang bstan bcom sogs las byub ba'i gtamadon can yin te/ tshig sna thub yang khebs che/— tshad mu dang ldan pas/ brjod bya'i kand 'byin cing dran pa slong stobs ka dper na/ blun po smra ba nyung da mdzes/ zhes bas mi shes shes zad dmyul b.rad skye srid pa'i don bstan pa dang / rang sprul cad na rig 5 rgod/ ce4pa4shes rab lag len las byung ba'i gnad jig pa tshad mas grub pa lta bu sogs go1 —— bod kyi gtam dpe ni sa khyab rdo khyab/ sdeb legs shing brjod bde bdidod— bzab ba bcud che bas/ ja 'thung na 'o ma dgos/ —gta'i bshad mkha dpe dgos zhes grags/ gzu ba la la gzu bshad na gtam dka chu bo 'bab 'bab kyis/ dkar nag gi dbye ba zu zhing / blang dor gyi nges pa bstan nas/ rtsod pa'i mtha' bcad nas/ 'dum pa'i pa'i la 'god thub/ des na gtam dpe di 'tsho ba'i nyams myong las byung ba'i tshika tshul yid pas/ go ba zab mo ste thub/ dper na/ mi mang dang na sangs sgyus yod/ sa rdo'i nang 17

dag yig rig pa'i kab pa mngod jing /na gser dbul yod/ cis dang pho rab gcig sha blo rtse las/ pho 'bring gsum gyi gros bsdur dga'/ zhes pa dag gis— mang byings kyi lha ba gsal bo zhig brjod rgyung ba dang / — —shes rab spong la me shor1 brtson 'grus brag la mda' zub ces dang / shes rab lag len las yo nga / bde skyid ngal rtsol las yong 1 rmes pa dag gis rgyu dang 'bras bu rten cing 'brel ba'i don gsal bo zhig brjod byung ba lha bu/ bod kyi lo sar ram/ du4 chen das/ ston— mor gab tshig gis rig pa 'gran pa'i rtsed pha byed par dag—8/ dper na/ dpe cha 'dod pa la/ zang dkar dkar1 lug ga da sgyu lug jis spu len/ zhes pa/ sdeb legs pas bshad bde zhing da nyams gas bas go sla ba dang / 'ur gtag la/ rgyud kyis ma bkug mnyen mo'i gzhu1 /sgro yis ma brgyan sra mo'i mda'/ /'phangs na lag pa gcig gis chog /phog na la rol krad rgya thor/ jir bas/ de'i khyad chos dang byed kas mngon bar bsta na pa ma zad/ snyan dag gi mdzes rtsa thon pa lta bu sogs/ skyid snang ba'i gsos 'debs dang1 blo rig pa'i da 'byed kyi go chod pa'o/ / — — —bod kyi spyi tshogs glu ba mtshor bsnga gas pa don dang ldan la/ gru'i brjod byar dan sna tshogs 'dus pa/ tshigs bcad kyi lu la rgyan gyis mdzes pa/ rim pa gsum cadaXmang zhing /— gnyis can 5 nga yod la/ thur mtha' rkang 8

skad dang bge'i pad yod/ba bzhe re dang / ring mtha' gru tshogs rgyud gcig tu bstar ba khri ka'adu ma du yod de/ srid pa chags glu lha bu'o1 /bod kyi spyi tshogs lo rgyus steng dgon pa ma gtogs slob grwa med pa dang / rong 'brog thad thor du gnas pa dngad ched gnyer —gyi rmos gor tshogs paXmed pa dang bcas pa'i rkyen gyis/ rig gnas kyi— 'tsho ba spel ched/ bzo lha mtshar la bya ska ba/ thos dga' zhing mthong kro ba'i spu len gar rtse byas nas/ skyid dga' rnam par rol bar brten nas/ mang byings kyis mang pyings la slob gso gtong ba dang / rig —gad spel ba'i srol bzang bo zhig tu chags so/ /'dir spu re bris das dpe tsam mtshon da/stod kyi ri gan gser gyi ri/ /gser gyi ri la nyi ma shar/ /ri gcig la shar na rgyal khams dro/ /bar gyi ri gan dngul gyi ri/ /dngul gyi ri la zla ba tshes/ /ri gcig la tshes na spyal khams gsal/ /snad kyi ri gan mchos gi ri— /mchong gi ri la mar khu 'khyil/ /ri gcig la da khyil na rgyal khams rdum/ /10

dag bkar ga pa'i gab pa mngon zung /zhes pa/ khor yug gi snang ba mig lam du shar ba dang / yid kyi 'gyur ba rab tu rgyas gas ri 4 bstod ra blabs byung / de la rib pa dang bos rgyal srid bde bas snang bsnyed bdang / gnyis pas rig gnas dar bas dge mtshan shar ba dang / gsum bas dpal 'byor phyug pas longs spyod 'dzoms ba'i tshul 'a lhag par brjod—pa'i sgo da so/ yul ljongs dang rgyal khab lo rab tu dga' ba'i sgeg nyam du bstabad par gyur ro/ /gru sna dris man ring mo3/ brjod gzhi'i skud pa zhig zla klu'i nu 3ga ga'i mang bsgyus nas dzeng ba zhig tu grub pa 'dra ste/ lug spu zhes ba dpe re mtshod da/ ge yang dkar lug thog mar rgya mtsho las byung da/ de nas spang la 'tsho ba/ mthar sgo phyugs —su gyur pa'i lo rgyus dal 'bab ring mo/ mtshar che ba grung gi brtsed—'dus/ gnad che ba tshad ma'i don ldan/ dri ba dris lan/ nyid mtshad mthud nas blangs na da dung tshar bar mi mngon/ sems can chags rim 'gel rim gyi bstan bcos mtshar mo zhig tu grub bo/ / gzhan yang / bod kyi sgrung dang gna' gtam sdogs las/ gna' mis 'jig rten gyi chags rabs dang / rang byung gi snang tshul dang / spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba sogs kyi ngos 'dzin tshul/ dgod da ba byis pa'i mkhas gtam/ ngo mtshar ba lha yi grub rtags/ rgod g.yer ba dgra 'dul gnyen skyong / snying rje ba bdag pas gzhan gces sogs/ nyams brgyad 'dzoms ba'i rmos gar gyi tshul 20

skad dang yi ge'i na yon/du snang ba'i shul du/ gna' dus thon skyed kyi stobs shugs zhan pag rar byung gi gnod pa rmog dka' yang / de las rgyal ba'i rig pa btsal ba1 bkod pa 'then pa/ 'tsho ba bde la 'god pa'i gtan gyi 'dun ma 'grub par brtson pa'i 'dren pa/ mkhas pa/ dpa' bo/ mdzangs mo sogs gzugs brtagasnatshogs blo rig pa'i rtsal gyis bskrun das nyi ma rgya shar lag pas mi 'kheb/skyes mchog skyes 'dod gnam gyis mi 'kheb pa'i dpe btod pa dang / de min srog zags dang ji shing la sogs pa'i ge tam rgyud mi'i gzugs su bkod nas/don bzang ngan gyi shan zu ba/ las dge ga gi mtha' bstan pa/ ya rabs migazhung bsrings pa/ ma rabs kyi mtshang brus pa sogs las slob gso'i rgyu cha len rgyu mang ngo / /rig pa'i gter mdzod che shos 'di'i dang du/ yig tshang dang dpe khang sna tshogs yod la/ de las rig gnas gang mkho bslab pa dang / spyi tshogs gsar rnying gi gnas tshul len pa dang / khams gsum gyi gas ba'i dpyadagazhi btsal ba'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms pas/ 'did mkhas pa'i 'jug sgo dang 'byung gnas yin no/ / bod yig ni yod mi rigs kyis rig gnas phun sum tshogs pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum du phan yon bla na med pa bzhag yod/ srid du bshad na/ gong ma rnams kyi shes so rtsog yi ger bris nas rgyun zags pa dang / gnug mas 21

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /rgyun cha tshang de bzung thog nu mthud das sngon du skyod pa yin la/ 'phred du bshad na/ rig gnas dang tshan rig gi grub pa yi ger bris pa dmas rgyal khab phyi nang mi rigs so sor khyab nas/ ngos zin pa rnams kyis shes par rtser 'gro/ des na skad cha'i yul dang dus kyis bskal ba'i skyon gnyis yi ges sel bar byas so/ /de yang cung zad gsal bar bshad na/ skad cha ni mi'i 'gro ba phan tshun 'brel byed kyi yo byad gal che shos shig yin yang / kha nas thon ma thag grag rgyu med 'gro/ yul gyi cha nas byes pas mi tshor/ dus kyi cha nas gzhug mas mi go yi ger brten na mi gcig gi skad cha yul thag gang ring du bskyal thub/ mi thog gang mang du gzhag thub/ skad cha yi ger bkod na/yud ring du 'jog zub par ma zad/ go chod sa rgya cher gtong thub/ brtsams chos mchog tu gyur pa rnams gang mang du dpar nas rgya cher bkram na/ spyi tshogs dar rgyas gtong ba'i stobs shugs chen por 'gyur la/ skyes mchog srong btsan snam po rgyal bor bzhugs thog chab srid/ dpal 'byor/ chos lugs sogs kyi nyer mkho dang bstun nas/ yi ge gsar du brtsams med pa'am tha na da thug bar bod yig byung med rgyu na1 nga tsho bod mi rigs 'di da tshod las rjes ring du lus 'dug pa gor ma chag yul gru mang bo'i gang zag gis 'jig rten khams na bod ces pa'i mi rigs shig yod pa shes tshod med rgyu red/ deng gi char rgyal spyin bod kyi rig pa zhes bya ba'i tsha rlabs shig22

skad dab yi ge'i na yon/langs pa'i dpe med snyam/yi ge byung rjes/ des skad cha bris pa tsam du zad pa ma yin gyi/ kha skad yi ger phab thog bsregs bcad bdar gsum byas nas/ tshig gi dag chas don gyi gnad 'byin cing / don gyi go bas tshig gi dag thon par byed thub/der ma zad kha skad tsam du tha snyad gam ga kha dka' ste/ dngos po la la 'jig shul de dag mchod byed kyi tha snyad kyang yal 'gro la/ tha snyad de dag yi ger phab yod na/ lo ngo mang bo 'akor rung dgos pa byung tshe/ da dub bkol sa 'gro la/ da per na/ sgrung dpe las ma kyad(krad)ngan yang nya dro zhes pa mthong ste/ a kyad ni mthil dang 'gram pa ko ba gcig tu byas pa'i lham yin gdeng 'brog pas kyang gon rgyu med pas/ phal bas mi shes kyang / gna' mi'i gon pa gleng tsho/ de yang tshig sbyor du 'jug rgyu yod pa lha bu1 gzhan yang bod yig la brten nas yul skad gcig thog tu bsgyur ba dang / kha skad nang gi tha snyad gces so cob khyab gdal du gtang ba bcas la phan pa che'o1 /bod yig gsar du bskrun nas da thug bar lo ngo stong dang sum brgya dang lnga bcu lhag 'gor ba'i ring la/ dus rabs rim byung 'i mkhas pa rnam pas sgra rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ gso ba rig pa/ cis rig pa/ nang don rig pa sobs bzu bor bzung nas bstan bcos brtsams pa gcig tu spungs na ri bo'i gtos dang mnyam/ rig gnas 'di rnams rtsa ba'i cha nas 23

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon jing /shes par bya ba mtha' dag 'dus yod dper na/ sgra rig ba las/ skad gdangs rig pa/ yi ge rig pa/ tha snyad rig pa/ bad sprod rig pa/ mngon brjod rig pa/ sdeb spyor rig pa/ tshig rgyan rig pa/ rtsom rtsal rig pa/ lo tsā rig pa sogs 'dus yod la/ dang don rig pa'i thad du/ bod kyi chos pa ming can stong phrag du mas brtsams pa'i chos dpe phar zhog bka' bstan gnyis la bshad na/—bka' 'byur la po snye brgya dang gsum du/ shog grangs sna ring sum khri nyis stong chig brgya dang bcu gsum yod pa dang / bstan 'gyur po ti nyis brgya dang bcu gsum du/ shog grangs sna ring drug khri bzhi stong lnga brgya dang bcu gnyis yod la/ bka' bstad gnyis la dpe cha rigs mi mthun pa lnga brgya kha lhag yod par grags pa las sde snod gsum gyi rtsa 'grel dang nang bstan chos 'byung / nang bstan dang 'grel ba'i rtsams chos sna tshogs/ chos lugs so so'i grub mtha' dang / lo rgyus sna tshogs/ rtsa rlung sgom tshul sogs yod par ma zad/ ya gling gi rig gnas lo rgyus dang / rgya gar gyi bsam blo'i lo rgyus ches dkon pa de dag snga mo nas 'jig song yang 1 bod 'byur du da dung gra ma nyams par tshags su tshud 'dug pa bod kyi drin no/ /'gyur rtsom rnams kyi brngod bya'i don spus dag pa dang / rjod byed kyi skad cha sdeb legs pa dang / yid dag thod pa/ slar legs sbyar gyi skad du bsgyur na ma phyi ji bzhin byung ba/ 'di 'dra'i blo thub pa dang bad 'phrod pa dang / sdeb dag pa 24

skad cha dang yi ge'i phan yon/ste legs cha gsum 'dzoms kyi sgyu rtsal ni nga tshos dper bslab dgos pa ha cang gal che'o/ /gong gi brtsoms chos dang bsgyur rtsom mtha' dag bod kyi dus rabs rim byung gi mkhas chen dam pa stong phrag du ma'i rig pa'i zhun thigs dang /lo ngo stong phrag du ma'i bod mi dmangs rgya che bo'i srid 'byor rig gsum gyi 'tsho ba'i nyams sbong gi grub rtags yin zhing / nga tsho gzhug mar bzhag pa'i rig gter yin no/ /de las rang byung gi tshan ris dang / spyi tshogs kyi tshan rig dang / mtshan nyid rig pa sogs nga tshos 'bad rtsol gang thub kyis bslabs nas khong du chud na/ da gzod rig lam gsar ba btod pa'i sgo nas/deng rabs can gyi tshan rib/ lag rtsal sna tshogs bed spyad nas bu rabs tsha rgyud rnams la ye shes dang bsod nams kyi tshogs gnyis bsags nas bde skyid bskrun thub/rig pa'i gter mdzod che shos 'di'i nang du/ slob grwa che 'bring chub gsum rim pa gang mang yod de/ slob gso spel nas/ bod gangs can gyi 'gyur ba rnam bzhi'i 'dzugs skrun dang / bod rig pa'i mtha' dpyad par ka dgu skyong gin yod do/ /ba steng du bod kyi rig gnas slob gso ni dgon pa lte bar byas nas spel ba yin zhing de yi grwa tshang so sor bslab bya'i rim pa dang / slob 26

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung gso'i ma lag cha tshang ba dang / 'chad nyan gyi 'grig lam dam po dang /bslab sbyang du 'jug pa'i thabs bzang bo sogs yod pas/ mkhas pa 'bum phrag du ma bskyangs byung ba las/ mtshan snyan 'jig rten kun tu grags pa'i mkhas dbang g.yu thog yon tan mgon po dang / sa skya ba ta/ rje tsong kha ba/sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho lha du gang mang gis—bod kha ba can la mdzad pa chen po bzhag yod do/ /bod yig ni tsheg 'ded yin te/ ming gi sgra gzugs don gsum rten cing 'brel bar grub nas yod pas/ zla ba re gnyis bslabs rjes yig ngo chod 'gro/ bod yig gi rnam ba—nag khong du chud tshe bri sa 'gro la/ bod yig gi sgra gdangs dang / tha snyad dang / brda sprod dang / sdeb sbyor dang / tshig rgyan sogs la gzhung lugs cha tshang ba yod pas/ bslab pa dang rtsom pa dang lo tsā dang / mtha' na sgra rig pa'i shes bya sogs brtag cing dpyad pa la lam ston pa'i go chen po chod 'dugasgra ni brngod 'dod rjes 'brang phyir/ skad cha ni bsam pa'i dngos bstan yin/ bsam blo gtong tshul la mi rigs kyi rang bzhin med pa ste/ mi'i 'gro ba thun mong ba'i rang bzhin yin pas/ bsam pa gcig pa la skad rigs mi gcig pa'am brda mi gcig pas ston thub pas na/ mi rigs phan tshun 'brel bar bya ba'i don lo kar brten nas 'grub par byed thub/ 'on kyang — skad cha 26

skad cha dang yi ge'i phan yon/ni spyi tshogs kyi ma bgros rang mthun zhig gam/ 'jig rten pa'i kha na yongs su grags pa yin pas/ mi rigs kyi rang bzhin yod do/ 1de la yi ge'i sgo nas ming dbyung ba dang / ming gi sgo nas tshig dbyung ba'i brda sprod lugs mi gcig pa dang / don ston tshul mi gcig pa'i dbang gis/ mi rigs ga ge mo'i skad cha de mi rigs gzhan rnams kyis go tshul med pas na/ lo ka'i mtshams sbyor bya dgos/skad cha dang bsam blo 'brel dam po chags yod/ so sor bral na rkyang bas rang tshugs mi thub/ skad char ma brten na bsam blo gtong sa mi 'gro/bsam pa ni skad cha'i grub pa yin/ smra shes shing don go ba'i mi gang zhig yin yang / rang gi pha skad dam goms shing 'dris pa'i skad rigs shig la brten nas 'dang rgyag pa dang / 'dang brgyab nas byung ba'i bsam pa de yang skad cha'am yi ges bstan par bya dgos1skad cha'i mi rigs khyad chos kyis gsal bar bstan pa la/ du gu gso byed bzang shos a ma'i 'o ma yin/ slob gso spel byed bzang shos rang gi skad yig yin/ bod kyi rig gnas slob gso bya ba/ bod yig dang bod skad 'a brten nas bsgrubs na/ da gzod dar rgyas gang mgyogs su gtong thub/ rgyu mtshan ni/ mi rigs rang gi skad yig gis dpe khrid byas na/ slob mas nyan na 'jal lon/ ba lhas na don gsal/ pha skad kyis 'dang brgyab na rtogs sga/27

das yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon rgyung klog cha 'bri cha myur du ji cher gtong thub/ gzhung lugs ma kha bo dang shes bya ma kha bo khong du chud tshe/ da gzod lag len du bkol thub/ bod yig gi shes tshad ji mthor song tshe1 bod yis gi dpe cha gang mang blta thub/ de nas shes rgya che thog dka' gnad gang thug brdar sha gcod thub par ma zad/ rgya yig dbyin yig sogs bslab par gzhi gang bzang chags 'gro/ gal te rig pa dar ba'i 'a ma rim gyi chos nyid dang / slob ma'i lo tshod kyi khyad chos dang /skad rigs kyi khyad par bcas la mi stun par/ u tshugs kyis rgya yig bslabs shing / rgya skad kyis dpe khrid byas/ yud ring bo 'dar nas yi ge dang tha snyad mang ba blo la zin byung rung / nyan shes pa dang lha shes par mi 'gyur/ de la pha skad kyis 'dang brgyab na 'jal mi lon/ lon kyang skar rgya skad du bsgyur nas ldab ldib du bshad na/ gzhan gyis nyan mi shes/ bslab sbyang gi rjes ma cho da na/blo pham zhing yid chad nas slo ba gnyer dod med du btang 'gro/ spyi lo 1958par bkas ba chod rgyud 'dzin gyi khyad dbang la ngo rgol byed pa'i la pa pa 'gul bslangs nas/ kan lha bod khul gyi slob grwa'i bod yig bslab rgyu thabs sna tshogs kyis bkag nas/ ha lam rgya yig bslabs par gyur te/ slob grwa chung 'i slob rim dang bor slob ma slob khang du gang 'dug mod/ slob rim gsum pa dang bzhi bar bslebs tshe/ slob ma 'ga' las med 'gro/ skabs bcu bcig pa'i krung u lhan rgyas gros tshogs gsum pa 'tshogs pa'i song rol na28

skad cha dang yi ge'i phan yonamo chu rdzongaXyongs rdzogs su 'brog pa'i gzhon nu rdzong gi slob grwa 'bring bar zhugs pa gcig las med kyang / slob rim gnyis par bzabs tshe/ bslab sbyang gi rjes ma chod par slob gnyer sgyur byung / 'di ni lo rgyus kyi ltas ngan tshabs chen zhig red/ yin na yang mtsho sngon rma lho'i slob grwa chung ba'i slob rim dang bo nas bzhi ba'i bar slob tshan yod tshad bod kyi skad yig rgos khrid par byas/ de nas rgya yig kha bsnan nas khrid pa na/ slob gso'i phyogs su a mdo'i yul gru kun gyi rdzun na thon pa'i rgyan zhig tu gyur song 1 de phyir spyi lo 1980ba nas1990ba'i ring la/ mi rigs slob grwa chen mo 'gas bod yig zhib 'jug slob ma bsdus byung ba phal cher mtsho sngon rma lho'i yin zhing / kho tsho lo gsum gyi slob mthar phyin tshe/ bod yig yon tan za kun nas glo hri'i tshad la phyogs par ma zad/ rgya yig yon tan kyang slob grwa chen mo'i tshad longs shing / phyi gling ba'i skad yig rigs shig kyang 'grig po zhig khong du chud yod/'di yang lo rgyus kyi nyams myong sngon thon can zhig yin no/ /gong gi gnas tshul mngon sum 'diXg nyis kyis gsal bar bstan pa ni/ tang gi mi rigs sred jus sgo kun nas la ga len mthar phyin par byas nas/ mi rigs 'dra mnyam dang / skad yig 'dra mnyam khag theg cing — gnas tshul dngos dang bstun nas mi rigs slob gso spel na/ da gzod bod ljongs su nye bar mkho ba'i 'gyur bzhi spun pa'i mi sna mang myur legs gsum du bskyang thub/29

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyungagong gi bshad pa mdor bsdus na/ bod kha ba ca na pa mi rabs mi thog gis bsags pa'i rig pa yod do cog bod skad dang bod yig tu 'dus yod pas na/ bod kyi skad cha dang yi ge ni bod kyi rig pa'i gter mdzod che shos shig yin/ des bskal ba ma stongs ji srid bar du drod gsal sbos nas/ bod kyi spyi tshogs nom par snang ba'i nyin mor gyur cing / bod mi dmangs rnam par dro ba'i bde la 'khod do/ /des na su zhig gis bod rang gi skad cha dang yi ge ring du bsgyur na/ rig pa'i gter mdzod che shos 'di bor song ba yin pas/ mi rabs mi thog gis gzhug ma rnams la/ pha yul brjed kyang pha skad ma brjed/ ces dang / skad rigs mang bo shes na legs mod kyang / rang gi pha skad brjed na ngo re tsha/ zhes dam pa'i chos la brgya tshar dang / gal bo che la nan tan mdzad pa dang / gzhug mas gong ma la/ rang rgyu shor yang pha ska da mi 'dor/ zhes dang / bod yig rin ched nor las brin/ nor bu mi dgos bod yig dgos/ zhes dam bca' mi zhig rdo rje bzhag go /snying khong rus pa'i dkyil nas thon pa'i tshig 'di dag gis/ bod mi dmangs bod rang gi skad cha dang yi ge la brtse dungs zab mo yod pa dang / ji 'dod du bkol ba'i re ba nan mo mngon par bstan byung / thun mong gi rig gnas steng du rgyud la chags pa'i thun mong gi 'du shes 'di sus kyang kha lo bsgyur mi thub/ mi lus dum dur chod kyang / snying stobs nam yang mi 'jig bsam pa'i 'du shes 30

skad cha dang yi ge'i phan yon/'di thad/ mi rigs sang zhig yin yang / zhabs 'dren la la ma gtogs/dbye ba gnyis su med do1 —mi rigs skad yig la rang brtse med pa bo zhig yin na/ rang gi mi ri sa la dga' ba'i bsam pa yod mi srid la/ rgyal gces ring lugs kyi snying stobs kyang yod mi srid de— rang phan ring lugs tha1 ba'i phyir1dper na/ 'jar pan btsan 'dzul (za rgol skabs/ lag na mtshon chas stong ba'i mi dmangs mang byings rgya che bos mes rgyal srur ched/ 'jar pan btsan 'dzul pa'i srid jus tshar ba rnam gsu ma la ngo ya byas nas/ mtshon cha rgang drag bkol ba'i 'jar pan dgra sde la srog dang bsdos nas 'thab/ mi rigs chags 'jig si bal la thug pa'i 'gag 'dir— mi rigs zhabs 'dren de dag 'jar pan gshed ma la mgo 'bul lus gtad1 pyi dgra dang mnyam du log nas rang mi dmar gsod byas/ 'jar pan btsan 'dzul pas byang shar sa cha 'phrogs nas bsdad pa dang / 'jar pan mi rigs su sgyur ba'i srid jus ban ma lcags thog gis brag dkar gtor ba'i tshul gyis 'jar pan gyi skad yig kho na bslab la 'jug par/ slob grwa ba chung bas kyang ngo ya byas pa red/ gnas tshul 'di dag las tshad mar grub pa'i rtags ni 'di lta ste/ rgyal khab la gces pa dmas mi rigs la mi gces pa'i dpe med/ mi rigs la dga' ba rnams mi rigs skad yig la mi dba' ba'i dpe med/ mar le ring lugs kyi mi rigs lta ba ni/ mi ribs 'dra mnyam dam por 'dzin thog mi 31

dag yig ris pa'i gab pa mngon phyung1ribs 'grig mthun legs par bsrungs nas/ mi rigs so so mnyam du dar 'ing rgyas par btang ste/ 'jig rten khams kyi mi'i 'gro ba yongs rdzogs sdug bsngal las grol te bde la dgod pa'o/ /mi rigs spun zla so so mnyam du log nas/ mar le ring lugs kyi mi rigs 'dra mnyam gyi dar cha rlabs po che gang mthor bsgrongs nas1 grung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab stobs 'byor phun sum tshogs par 'bad rtsol gyis shib/ //

bod yig byung rabs kyi dpyang thag bcod pa4 ral gri1nga — sgo tshan gnyis ba1 dzad yig byung rabs kyi dpyang zag gcud ba'i ral ji/sgra bzubs don gsum bcig tu 'dus pa'i bod yig rin chen skrun pa bo1/sgra ris rtsa ba bka tsung brgya'i sgo 'byed sum rtags 'drul lde mjad pa bo/ 1spyal ba'i gsung ra ba bla na med pa 'o tsā thog ma'i sgyur pa bo//la ba can gyi rmongs mun se' byed ris pa'i 'od snang 'dred pa bo/ 1che ba rnam bzhis rab tu brjid pa1'i 'jib/ rten mig 'dra'i skyes bu mchob /slob dpo na thon mi kun tu bzang bo rin po che la gus pas 'dud//bod kyi rgyal bo srong btsan sgam po dgung lo bcu gsam pa sa mo glang ste/spyi lo62(bar rgyal srid skyong ba'i dbu mdzad1 srid 'byor rig gsum gyi phrin las spe' bar nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge med na mi rung bar dgongs nas/spyi 'o 683par1 lho gnya' ba snang grags kye bu gces ming a nu dang 1 dngos 33

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyub ming kun tu bzang bor grags pa/ yul sa 'bur bo ste sgra'i zur chag nas 'bo ra zer ba na 'dug pas/ thon mir yang 'bod pa/ ngang rgyud dpa' zhing mdzangs pa/ gzhan phan gyi las la lhag bsam dkar ba zhig yod par bka' gnangs te/ rgya gar du yi ge slob par mngags1 'gro tshul ni/ bod mkhas pas brtsams pa'i dam chos glegs bam grub tshul gyi lung mdo mkhar ba tshe ring dbang rgyal gyi yi ge'i bshad par bkod pa lhar na/ pho nya'i mgo dpon du stag ro lo shog zer ba bskos te/ dpon g.yog bcu gnyis la mkho ba'i chas ka dang / rgya gar rgyal bo dpal sbyin byed dī na lha chen zhes pa la 'tsham skyes kyi bskur ma ngag phrin dang bcas nga1 gnangs nas bdangs/ lam du ne pa la bal bo rgyal bo la skyes phul te/ tshad pa la phan pa'i sman ga dur dang / cu gang dang tsan dan gyi chu la sogs pa bstsal bar bsten cing song bas ci yang ma gnod par rgya gar du bde bar brtol/ ces gsungs snang / thon mi rgya gar du phebs rjes/ khong gi mtshan kun tu bzang bo legs spyar skad du sa ba bha dra zhes pa 'a / bod yin pas lha ṭa sbyar nas/ sam sgo ṭa zhes grags so/ /khong gis ma las chen bram ze li byin slob dpon du bsten nas/ yig rigs du ma mkhas par sbyangs/ da ta lha rig pa'i seng ge slob dpon du bsten nas/ rtogs sla ba rgyal bo'i lugs kyi bstan bcos dang / rtogs dka' ba baXta'i lugs kyi bstan bcos/ dam pa'i chos spyan ras gzigs 34

bod yig byung rabs kyi dbyang zag gcod pa'i ral grikyi mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig pa sbyabs pa phul du byung nas/ mkhas pa'i mtshan snyan 'bar/bod mkhas pa'i dam chos glegs bam sgyub tshul las/ thon mi rgya gar du lo bdun bzhugs par gsungs pa dang / rgya'i yig tshang du srong btsan dgung lo nyer gsum par bal bza' khri btsun khab tu bsu ba'i blon po mgar gyi grogs su thon mi yod par gsungs pa ltar da/ thon mi rgya gar du bslab sbyang lo bdun mdzad pa dang / spyi lo6da9bar slar log pa lo rgyus kyi khungs dang 'brel lo/ /thon mi rgya gar nas slar log par1 sgra rig pa'i bstan bcos bslabs tshad kyi rgya dpe dang / 'dus pa rin po che'i tog mdo za ma tog bkod pa/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyer gcig dge ba bcu'i mdo la sogs pa'i rgya dpe dang / rgya gar rgyal bos srong btsan la skyes lan du/ mdo sde dkon mchog sprin/ dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po/ gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs/ nor bu kai tu zhes pa mun rum na bzhag pas 'od gsal ba zhig snang ba sogs bsnams nas 'ongs pa thon mi'i dgongs rgyad du gsal/thon mi phyir log nas bod thun mong gi skad rigs spyi dang bsgyun das/ming phrad rtsom pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i skad kyi gdangs lhar gsal byed nyer dgu dang / dbyangs gsal gnyis su gtogs pa'i srog yig a bsnan pas gsal byed sum cu dang / sgra'i nga ro lhar dbyangs bzhi dang / ma bsnad pas dbyangs 35

— dag yig rig pa'i gas par ngon phyung1—lngar grub/ gsal byed rnams las ming gzhi dang / mgo 'dogs 'phul rtse na sogs yi ge'i sbyor ba gtan la phab pa'o / de yang rgya gar gyi yig rigs gang phyi mo'i dper blangs pa yin zhe na/yongs grags su 'dzi dper byas nas dbu can dang / wartu dper byas nas dbu med mdzad zer yang / yi ge 'bri srol gyi lo rgyus noms las/ bstan pa snga dar gyi ring la1 'bri srol dar tshul rim pa dgu byung zer ba tshang ma dbu can yin/ dbu can mgyogs par bris nas rang shugs kyis dbu med byung ba yid gyi/ bdu la dpe byas nas mdzad pa min thag chod red— bye zag tu bshad tshul sna tshogs yod pa las/ gna' dpe dang / sngon byon mkhas pa mang phyogs kyis tsā ga ra'i yi ger dpe byas nas dbu can mdzad par gsungs/ dper na1ma ṇi bka' 'bum dang / bka' zang sde lnga dang /—chos sgo pa shī la bha dra'i chos 'byung dang / dpa' bo gtsug lab phreng ba'i chos 'byung dang / thu'u bkan chos kyi nyi ma'i grub mtha' rnams las/ tsā ga ra'i yi ge dper byas nas gzab ma bzos par gsungs pa dang / sgos su bstan pa'i me ro bslangs pa'i dus kyi yi ge'i mkhad po khyung bo g.yu khris brtsams pa'i yi ge'i bstan bcosaX'aphrul gyi sgron me las/ thon mi rgya gar du song ba'i dus su/ rgya gar na yi ge rigs mi 'dra ba nyi shu rtsa gcig snang / zhes dang 1 bod kyi ka kha sum cu 'di/ /rgya yi tsā ga ra las bsgyur/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / yang / sngar rje'i thugs 66

bod yig byung rabs kyi da snang tha / gcod pa4 ral gri—dam bzhengs pa la/ bzang spyod smon lam rnam pa lnga gser gyis bris nab1/ sgyu gu ba gril sogs pa'i bris cha rnams zang 1āoṃ sgrom bur bzhag nas/ zhwa'i rtsibs kyi rdo ring gi rtsa ba na gter du sbas pa de dmas/ khyung bo g.yu khris bton cing / zhwa'i rtsibs kyi rdo ring dang / dkar chung gla ba tshal gyi brag ngos kyi rgya gar nas bsgyur ba'i yi ge 'jog gru bzhi seng ge dkar mo dgung du mchong ba 'dra ba sogs/ yig gzugs rim byon nom pa gsum la dpe blangs kas/ sgyu gu bang / sgyug gri dang 1 shog cha dang / yig chos sogs kyi bstan bcos brtsams par gsungs pa rnams la dpyad na— bod kyi yi ge 'di tsā ga ra'i yi ger dper blangs pa bden par mngon te1 mkhas pa snga ma snga ma dus skabs de dang bar thag ji nye je nye yin pas/ mthong thos dpyad gsum du dan rtags cung mang ba dang / phyi ma phyi ma dus skabs de dang bar thag je ring ji ring yin pa sa/ rtags kyis dben pas na/ rang blos dpags tshod tsam mam/ grags pa gang gi rjes 'brangs yin par bsams/ bod yig lan war gnyis la dpe byas pa yin na/ de dag las ca cha ja zha za 'a yi ge drug med pas na/ thon mis yi ge gsar du skrun pa la/ re zhis lag thob/sa par 'gyur srid de/ bod ska da la nye bar mkho ba'i gsal byed nyer bzhi tshur blangs pas/ tha snyad kun la 'jug pa'i ming gzhi mi 'dang mod/ tha snyad mi nyung ba zhig gi ming gzhir 'jug rung ba'i gsal byed 'ga' zhig 37

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /bsnan dgos na/ de la yi ge du dgos/ gang gang 'grig de re re la mgo 'dogs 'phul rten gang gang dgos/ e 'phrod/ skor 'di'i zhib cha 'don dgos na bya dka' ba zhig los yin snyam/ de la yi ge drug ji ltar rnyed pa'i gtam rgyud dag byung ba rtog btags yin yang / yi ge mtshon byed kyi sgra de dag gsar du rnyed pa sla mo min pa'i dpe bstan byung /tsā ga ra'i yi ge dngos su ma mthong bas/ de la yi ge drug po de ye yod mi shes/ yod na rtsod med du 'byur ro/ /yig rigs sna tshogs kyi phyi mo me tog phreng zhes pa'i sku 'bum shing dpar ma las/ yo rgyan zangs gling gi yi ge dang / srin po'i yi ge('di tshe ring thar gyis bstan pa'i zhang zhung gi yig gzugs yin)dab las/ stod du ca cha ja dang / smad du zha za 'a drug po yod par ma zad/ de dag gi mgo na jig dang g.yon du shad 'dra ba sprel nas tsheg tu sbyar yod pa tsa lta bu ma gtogs bod yig dang 'dra ba dang / za hor gyi yi ge dang / byang gter dgongs pa zangs thal gyi yi ge sogs las kyang / yi ge de dag gzugs de 'dra mi gcig pa min pa yod do/ /thon mi rgya gar du song ba'i skabs der yig rigs de rnams 'ga' zhig yod nges pas/ de dag las dpe blangs pa yin par yang sems/ gang ltar yang thon mis rgya gar gyi yig rigs du ma'i legs cha blangs das/ bod yig gsar tu bzos pa/ byi lar ba lhas nas stag ris bris pa tsam min par/ blo rtsal che zhing thabs mkhas pa'i 38

bod yig jing rabs kyi da snang thag gcod pa'i ral thi/dge mtshan thun mong ma yid pa zhig lhang nge shar ba 'di lha ste/ yig gzugs mdzes la bri sla ba/ sgra yi zhib cha gsal la klog bde ba/ don gyi ngo bo dang khyad par ston par thogs pa med cing / go brda ji bzhin legs par 'phrod pa/ sgra gzugs don gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i sgo du ma nas yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i rin po che 'gran zla med pa zhig tu grub par snang bas/ gna' bo'i mkhas pa nyung ngu la cha rgyus yod pa ma gtogs/ phyis kyi mkhas pa rnam pas/ bod yig 'di rgya gar gyi yig rigs gang dang / sbyor tshul gang la dpe blangs nas mdzad pa'i mtshungs chos mi mthong bas/ mgo rmongs par gyur nas bshad tshul mi 'dra ba byung ba dang / la la dan rtags med par rang sems bden par rlon nas grags pa'i jis su 'brangs par mngon no/ /thon mis mdzad pa'i sgra rig pa'i bstan bcos le'u brgyad du grags kyang / sum rtags gnyis ma gtogs gzhan drug po ming gi lhag ma tsam yang lus med pa mtshar/ sgra ba nam bzang gis mdzad pa'i sum rtags 'grel ba bstan pa'i sgron mer sum rtags kyi rtsa ba bkod pa'i mjug tu/ byu ka ra ṇa'i rtsa ba brgyad pa las kun tu bzang bo'i sto ka ra ṇa'i dang bo'i skabs te lnga ba'o/ /zhes dang / byu ka ra ṇa'i rtsa ba brgyad pa las kun tu bzang ba'i byu ka ra ṇa'i gnyis pa'i skabs te drug pa'o/ /zhes pa lhar na/ de'i skabs dang bo la ma mtha' le'u lnga dang / skabs gnyis pa la ma mtha' le'u drug yod pa dang /39

da yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung——— —— —ba —skabs gnyis yan so sor le'u du ma yod pa spyir mtha' yas pa zhi pa1 yod pa ma yin nam/ lo rgyus snga ma rnams su/ thon mi'i brtsams chos sum kags las gzhan/ yi ge'i rnam 'byur gyi bzo brtsams ba dang 1 ka mad sum cur bsgyur ba/ sdeb sbyor sgrig pa'i gzhi ma / thon mi'i mdo rdzi'i sgra mdo1 sngags kyi brgas thabs mun ba1'i sgron me zer ba rnams yod par gsungs pa dang / da kar lebs su ma rtags dka' 'grel las/ thon mi sam lha ṭas brda sprod kyi bstan bcos sum cu ba dang / rtags kyi 'jus pa/ klu dbang mgul rgyan sogs ma jad/ ces gsungs pa rnams brgyad du tshang ste/ thon mis mdzad pa'i sgra'i bstan bcos brgyad du grags pa/ 'di rnams yin nam dpyad par 'tshal/thon mis bod yig gsar du bskrun byung ba nas bzung / rgyal bo srong btsan sgam po'i bkas spyal khams so sor pho nya ma ngags te/ rgya sar gyi slob dpon ku sa ra dang / bram ze shang ka ra/ ka che ta nu/ bal bo shī la ma lnga/ rgya nag hwa shang ma hwa de ba/ lo ched thon miXrang dang / khong gi slob ma dharma ko ṣa dang / lha lung rdo rje dpal sogs gdan 'dzom par byas nas/ rgyal ba'i bsung rab bod skad du sgyur ba'i 'a sa kyi grwa thog mar btsugs nas/ spyan ras ba1zigs kyi mdo rgyu da nyer gcig dang / 'dus pa rin po che'i tog gi gzungs/zla ba sgron me'i mdo sde mchan gzhad mdo ting nge 'jin rgyal bo/ mdo sde dkon mchog sprin/ dam pa tog dkar gyi mdo/ dge ba bcu'i mdo/ sher phyin 40

bod yig byung rabs kyi da snang thag gcod pa'i ral gri/stob phrag brgya ba ste mtshan gzhan 'bum pa/ dpang skong ba rkya ba/ —mdo rdo las dam 'byed sogs bsgyur to/ /spyan ras ga rigs kyi mdo rgyud nyer gcig ni/ 1 za ma tog bkod pa1 2 zug stong spyad stong gi gzur sa1—2 pad ma snying tsu4mdo1 ra zhal bcu gcig ba 'i mdo/ 5 bcu gcig shal lha rje gzungs/ 6 don yod zhags pa/ 4 don zhags phyi ma/ ༄ pad mab chog — dbang bsgyur 'khor lo/ 1ba cho ga sngags kyi rgyud/ 11 yid bzhin nor bu'i gzungs/ 12 snying rje che na po mi bshol ba/ 1ka 'od zer rnam bkod/ 14 pad ma cod pan gyi rgyud/ 15 yi ge drug pa'i mdo/ 16 dam chos pad dkar/ 17 pu rje ri ka'i mdo/ 18 sa klung sna tshogs pa'i mdo/— 19ba snang ba rol ba'i mdo— 2ba mtshad bachu rtsa brgyad ba/ 21 mtshan rab yongs su bstan pa'i mdor mas so// — —gzhan yang / nye lam lo 'ga'i ring la/ bodage ga myub rebs skor du/ kha cig gis dogs pa mang du ba ngas na pa pa rtsod bzhir rtser na yang da ‘'di dzeeskyon min la dge mtshan zhig ste1 bye ma bshal na gsem rnyed 'o ma dkrogs na mar 'byung 1 zer ba'i dpe'o/ / rtsod res 'di las lha ba gtan nas mi mthun pa gnyis byung / gcig /bod yig gna' rabs su yod pas/ zod mis gsar du bskrun pa min zer/cig shod tsā ni— srong btsan gyi jo na na bod yig med pas/ thon mis gas du 11

dag yig rigs pa'i gab pa mngon jing /bskrun pa yin zer/ lta ba 'di gnyis so sor 'grig sa dang mi 'grig sa re yod/ so so'i mi 'grig sa dor nas 'grig sa blangs na/ lha ba yang dag par ba 'gro ste/ bod gna' rabs su zhang zhung nas 'khrungs pa'i yi ge yod la/yod kyang bod spyi'i skad cha dang srid 'byor rig gsum kun la go mi chod pas/thon mis bod yig gsar du bskrun pa yin no/ /da ni lha ba snga ma'i mtha' dpyad na/ rgyal bo srong btsan gyi sngon rol na bod yig yod zer ba bden par mngon te/ dper na/ deb dmar gsar ma las/ pu de gung rgyal gyi dus su zab srid ni bon gyis bskyangs par grags te/'di'i dus su bon chos bsgyur te dar bar byas pa yin 'dug bon gyi yig tshang khag gcig las ni/ gnya' khri btsan po'i dus su byung bar yang bshad/ces dang / rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long las/ rgyal blon 'di gnyis kyi dus su/ g.yung drung gi bon byung ste/ ston pa gshen rab mi bo bya ba stag gzi ge 'ol mo'i lung rings su sku 'khrungs/ khams chen po brgyad la sogs pa bon po'i chos thams cad zhang nung gi yul nas bsgyur te/ dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ ces dang / brda zod nyi shu bdun pa'i 'grel ba las/ stag bzig yul gyi spungs so che chung ni/ /zhang zhung ma smos mar ched smar chung bsgyur/ /ces dang / gangs ljongs lo rgyus thog gi mi sna grags can zhes bya ba las/bod gnya' khri btsan po'i sku ring la/ khyung bo stag sgra don gtsug dang / gnyan 42

bod yig snang rabs kyi dpyang zag gachod ba'i ral gri/li shu stag ring / snye shod kram/ gtso bon khri gtsug bcas bzhis rin chen gser bye khyer nas/ skad rigs mi mthun pa'i yul mang bor bgrod/ bon dmas zhus/ bon rnams rje la gzigs phul bas rje yang dgyes/ — de ltar gshen po de bzhi la bon gyi lo tsā ba chen po bzhir grags so/ /zhes pa sogs las phyis na pu de gung rgyal gyi dus dang / snga na gnya' khri btsan po'i dul nas/zhang zhung du yi ge byung bar bstan to/ / krung ba mi rigs gna' yig zhib 'jug 'dun ma'i rig gzhung dpyad sdur lnga ba'i gnad bsdus las/ yi ge gsar du bskrun pa snga sngon la chos lugs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba red/ ces gsungs pa star/ bstan pa gang ya nga yi ges 'dzin pas na/ zhang zhung gi yi ge bod gyi dgos pa bsgrub ched bskrun pa dang / byung ma zag bon la 'jug pa tsam du thong ngo ston pa gshen rab ni pu de gung zul sku ring gi skyes bu yin na/ lo rgyus kyi yig tshang 'gar 'di nyid spyi lo dus rabs ma tshugs gong gi lo drug brgya yas mas shig la byon par/ gangs ljongs kyi lo rgyus thog gi mi sna grags can zhes pa las gsungs pa lhar du/ zhang zhung gi yi ge ste bod kyi thog ma'i yi ge byung nas da thug bar du/ lo ngo nyis stong drug brgya yas mas shig 'gor yod/gal te gnya' khri btsan po'i dus nas byung ba yin na/ lo ngo sum stong nye ba zhig 'gor song ngo / /43

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung /ba mang bor grags pa ni/ don med ma yin don yod yin/ srong btsan sgam po'i gong rol na/ bod yig yod pa lo rgyus kyi bden kha byid nas yod na'ang / —— thon mi sam sgo ṭas bod yig gsar bzo byas med zer ba/gnas tshul dngos dang 'gal te/ gong gsal gyi bden pa'i rtags dang grub pa'i rjes bsnyon du med do/ /de lhar ma rig pa'i dbang du shor ba ni/ thon mis gsar du bskrun pa'i yi ge yang gzhi nas zhang zhung gi yi ge yin pa'i 'khrul snang shar ba yin/ de lugs khong tsho'i bshad gzhi las mngon par snang ba gsham gsal / dang bo1 zhab zhung gi yid po mthong phyir na med bkun/ bon gyi bka' bstan la stos dang gsal zer/ bon gyi bka' bstan gyi yi ge nam mkha'i nor bu lags kyis dpe bstan pa'i zhang zhung gi yig rgan min gyi thod mis srol brtod pa'i yi ge yin no/ /ba'i ni zhwa dpe lham la bkab pa ma yin nam/bod rgya tshig mdzod chen mo'i bsgyur bon zhes pa'i 'grel ku bod rgya' khri srong lde'u btsan nas glang dar ma'i bar/ paṇḍi —ta sham thabs sngon po can da nga /rgyal ba'i byab chub zer ba/ gshen sgur klu dga' sogs kyis nang ba'i chos lugs khag bon du sgyur ba'i lugs la zer/ zhes gsungs pa lhar/ bon po skya—khas ched dag gis nang bstan gyi rig pa drang4kas bon gyi bstan pa legs par bsgyur bar ma zad/ deng gi bod yig 'dis bris par 'byur ba 44

mad yin byung rab kyi da tsang thag gcod pa'i ral gri/—————— ——dang / 'ang zhung yig rgan gyis jis 4'i bon rnams kyang / thon mis srol btod pa'i bod yig 'dir sgyur bar byas so1 1de ltar mdzad don 'i/ gnam ri srong btsad yan na chab srid bon gyis bskyabs na yang / srong btsan sgam po'i tshun chad1 rgyal bo ka ba yu ma sras sros la sogs pas nang bstan la dad pa'i stobs kyis/ bon gyi bstan pa rgud par 'gyur ba la bltos nas/ bon po dmas kyis khong tsho'i chos lugs 'dzin skyong spel bar/ bod spyi la go brda mi 'phrod 'i zhang zhung gi yul skad du sbyar ba'i yig rgan gyi tshab tu1 bod spyi la khyab pa'i thon mi'i yi che 'jug par byas byung ba red1 deng mig mthong lag zin gyi bon chos rnams kyang thon mis srol btod pa'i yi be 'dis bris pa tsam du zad pa gnad 'di 'a thug yod pa dang / zhang zhung gi yi ge'i bris ma lag mjil tsam ying mthong rgyu med pa dus kyis bskal bas 'jig par gyur pa yar gnad 'di la thug yod par snyam mo1 /gnyis pa/ srong btsan sngon la yi ge med na/ gna' rabs kyi byung ba snams phyis 'byung gi ye ber 'khod mi srid zer/ zhang zhung gi yi she bon chos 'don byed yin pas/ lo rgyus than thun rabs pa tsam1 'is bris yo da na'ang/gna' rabs kyi byung ba sang mang yi be des zin bris su btab nas med par sems/ tun hong nas thon pa'i btsan po rim byung gi lo rgyus las1 gnya' khri btsan po nas srong btsan sgam po'i yab gnam ri srong btsan bar/ rgyal 1rta

dka yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /—rabs so gnyis dang / de dag so so'i btsun mo dang blon po sogs gsal bar bshad rgyu yod pa/ zhang zhung gi yi be'i bris ma la brten nas bris pa yin na/ lo rgyus de las bod la snga na yi ge myed/ ces bshad pa'i dpe med do/ 1rgya nag gi yi ge hrang rgyal rabs kyi ring la rim gyis smin pa yin pas/ de snga'i dpon gsum lde lnga dang bcas lo rgyus sogs ngag rgyun la brten nas bris pa min nam/ ge sar sgrung gi byung 'phel yang gtso bo kha skad la brten pa las/yi ger brten pa ma yin te/ sgrung ba 'ga' zhig yi ge mi shes pa'am de 'dra mi shes kyang / spung dpe mi nyung ba zhig legs par bshad shes pas mi mtshar ram/yang / gna' dus su bod la yi ge med pa la bod kyi gna' bo'i shes rig rgya che la gting zab pa 'di dag gi khungs bod rang la med pa mngon sum red zer/ bod kyi rig pa rgya che zhing gnying zab pa 'di/ gtso bo thon mi mchog gis bod yig gsar du bskrun nas/ bod gangs can gyi ma rig pa'i mud pa sel ba'i nyin byed bsus 'ongs nas byung ba yin la/ de snga'i rig gnas las bon dang zhang zhung gi yi ge'i phan yon yod srid kyang / gtso bo bod rong 'brog mi dmangs rgya che bo'i spyi tshogs kyi 'du byed dang / thon skyed kyi 'du byed sogs las rim gyis chags pa ste/ rig pa gang yang lag len las byung ba'i phyir ro/ /46

bod yig byung rabs kyi dpyang thag gcod pa'i ral gri/gsum pa/ tun hong nas thon pa'i bris ma dmas thon mi'i yig gzugs dang mi mthun pas/ zhang zhung gi yi ge yin zer/ tun hong yig rnying du yi ge'i sbyor ba sum rtags kyi dgongs pa dang mi mthun pa mang yang / ma dag pa yin gyi thon mi'i gsar bskrun min zhes bston mi rung / de la shes byed gnyis yod de/gcig ni/ tud hong nas thon pa'i lo rgyus sogs kyi yi ge phal cher dag pa yin pas rtags grub/ rnam gsal gyi dpe re bkod na/ btsan po la/btsan pho/ btsan pod/ btsad po/ rtsan po/ brtsan po/ bstsal po/ mtshan po ste rnam pa brgyad yod pa las/ phal mo che btsan por snang bas/ gzhan bdun po bris skyon min pa'i sgra bshad ci yod/ 'bri mkhan de tshos bslab sbyang lo du byed sbong / lag tu dag yig gi dpe cha re me yod/ bri la glo bur du yi ge dag min btsal khom e snang / deng sang slob grwa 'bring ba nas slob mthar phyin pa la la zhig yul la song nas lo gnyis gsum tsam 'gor rjes/ yig bskur zhig bris na/ yig skyon sa khyab rdo khyab tu snang ba/ zhang zhung gi yi ge bris pa e yin/tshad ma rig pa'i thad du mkhas pa'i dbang bor gyur pa kha cig gi phyag bris su yig log mang du byung ba tshad mas grub pa e yin/ gdas tshul 'di rigs la bsams na/ tun hong gi yi ge 'bri mkhan de tshos yig log bris pa mang yang khag med snyam147

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon snang/nga —— /nyis ni/ dus mnyam pa'i rdo ring dag gi yi ge dag pa yin pas rtags grub/ btsun po rim byung gi lo rgyus ga nya' khri btsa na po nas khri ra—za ba can gyi mtha' la thug pa'i bar du bris yod par/ yi ge dag cha med pa gong bas pa1'on kyang skab5 nge'i rdo ring gi yi ge ha cang dag pa yin/ dper na/ zhol rdo ring phyi ma ni1 khri srong lde btsan bzhugs pa'i spyi lo76dpar tshugs pa yin/de la tsheg dbar ma nyams pa1160lhag yod pa las/ sdeb mi 'grig pa da phrag(dbrog)dang ga lhan pa gsan la brda rnying du tsa btabs yod)lha thu 'ga' cam las med pa dang 1 btsug las khang mdun gyi rdo ring ni/ khri ral ba can dang thang nu cu nga gnyis nas spyi lo823par tshugs pa yin/ de'i shar nub gnyis su tsheg bar159༷lhag 'dub pa 'a sa/ sdeb mi 'grig pa ma rnam(brnab)dang / thil(mthi' )dang / pheld('phe‘sha)lta bu nyung shas shig las med pas dab pa 5 mngon / dus mnyam pa'i tun hong mi yi ge de 'dra ma dag pa ci yin/ 'ji mkhan mkhas pa yin min la thug yod nga min nam/ des na tun hong gi yi ge thon mis gsar bzo mdzad pa min zer ba dang / zhang zhung gi yi be yin zer ba dang / gsar rnyingaXbasra bsres yin zer ba rnams rigs pas stong pa pa so1 /bzhi ba/ sum rtags kyi rtsa ba thon mis ba rtsams pa min/ bod btsan po'i rgya' khab sil bur thor rjes kyi mkhas pa 'gas brtsams pa yin zer/ 'di ni 1 3

bod yib byung rabs kyi dpyang thag bco da pa'i ral gri——mun nas lag nom ste/ mig lam du yod kyang ma mthong ba red/ tun hong nas thon pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus sogs kyi yi ge sbyor stangs sum rtags dang mi mthun pa mang yar / ma dag pa ste gong du brtsad zin/ lha sa'i gtsus lag khang mdun gyi rdo ring sogs bod gna' rabs kyi yig rnying tshad ldan de dag sum rtags kyi sbyor stangs dang ye nas mi mthun pa gang mang mchis par bshad kyang / khyod kyis rdo ring de dag gi yi ger lha ye lhong / bltas yod na/ rdzun pa'i rgyab rten lhas kyang mi thub pas/ kha nasaXrdzun gtam ra thon 'u ga thon du mi shod bsams1 bshad pa brgya ras la1 mthong ba gcig gis dga'/ zho' rdo ring phyi ma dang 1 gtsug lag khang mdun gyi rdo ring gi yi ge spyir btang deng sang gi 'bri srol dang khyad med/ des na khyod kyis ye nas mi mthun pa mang rdu mchis zer ba/ bsham gsal rnams la bstan pa ye yin/ yin na ma rtogs log rtog gi skyon min pa ci red/gcig ni/ yi ge'i sbyor ba 'grig min gyi skor la/ dgra'i pying no my-i grag ste/ zhes pa lha bur/ gug gu log pa cung mang yang / ma 'o ga pa dang gcig ste/'bri tshugs tsam gyi khyad du zad/ myi so gas la ya sta btabs pa brda rnying ste/deng sang am skadaXdu da dung de ltar grags pa'o/ /bris pa'/ lta bu'i pa la 'a mtha' sbyar ba/ ming gzhi gang dang sang 'a yang / /rjes 'jug bcu bo ma zhugs na/ /ming gzhan sbyor ba yod mi srid1 /ces pas grub/ stabs 'dir 'a 49

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung mtha' ched du spyar ba ya nga / tshig mtha'i sgra gdangs cung zad bsrings pa'i rtags thon pa yin/ gcigs pa bca ba/ gza skar/ lha bu'i bca dang gza la 'a mtha' ma sbyar ba/ sngon 'jug ming gzhir 'khrul dogs med pas bsdus pa yin/ bka drin chen ngo / zhes dang / chab srid chen po mdza ces pa'i bka dang mdza kyi rjes 'jug ming gzhi'i 'og tu bris pa/ shog mtha'i thig rgya las mi 'gong bar byas pa yin/ bka' phrind/ tshis sbyard/ lha bu'i phrind dang spyard la da drag thob pa ste/ deng sang da drag dngos su mi 'bri yang / don gyis thob pa yin/ ga dngo/ gu du mi spo'/ lha bu sogs kyi phrad rnams rjes 'jug rang 'dra dang bskungs nas bris pa yin/ zhwa lha khang gi rdo ring du/bka' la ga dang / bar la ri dang / zhing la lnga lhar bris pa rnams ni/ bri sa bsgyungs pa tsam las/ gang dang gang la gang btags pa/ /rgo rim bzhin du gnas nas dbyung / /zer ba lhar/ sbyor stangs mi 'grig rgyu ci yod/gnyis ni/ yig skyon yin min gyi skor la/ dgyes snang dag kyang ma chad par bsris te/ zhes dang / dgyes pa gsar rna bslas shing bstud nas/ zhes pa las/ bsrings dang bslangs kyi rjes 'jug nga chad pa yig nor min te/brda rnying du yang mjug sa yi sgra drag pas/ rjes 'jug nga'i zur ma thon pa lhar bris pa yin/ deng sang dpa' ris skad du 'tsham 'dri byed par/ khyod 'ongs ne la khrod 'os le zer ba bad rnying yin la/ sa mchog gi skad du rnyings 50

bod yig byung rabs kyi dpyang zag gcod pa'i ral grisong la rnyis song zer ba yang gong bzhin no /der ma zad 'da' ba'i 'das pa la 'das zer yang / don du 'dangs yin te/ rjes 'jug 'a yi zor yang bas bsdus par byur pa yin no/ /dgun sla ra ba/ dbyar sla 'bring bo/ zhes pa'i sla ni yig skyon min te/ brda rnying du gza' yi bye brag la zla ba dang / nyi ma sum cu'i dus yun la sla zhes pa'i khyad par yod do/ /phra ma mi ga ston/ zhes pa'i gsan la tsa btags pa yig skyon min te/ brda rnying du ming gzhi sa la lar sngon 'jug thob tshe sgra drag par gyur bas tsa btags pa yod/ dper na/bsangs pa la bsnangs pa dang / dri bsung la dri bsnang / zhes pa lha bu/ btsan po'i btsan la sgra tsub cing drag par brjod pas ra mgo sbyar nas brtsan dang /pho mo'i zlas phye bas brtsan pho/ zhes pa yig noX min no/ /bka' khon sbyangs shing gsald/ zhes pa'i gsald ni/ bdag dang 'brel ba'i bya ba ste/ sel bar byed pa'i don gyi da lta ba yin/ rgya spa gong ste/ zhes pa'i gong ni 'gong gi 'das pa ste/ dpa' bkong ba ni byed pa'i las dang / dpa' gong ba ni bya ba'i las yin/ rdo ring de rnams las bya ba rigs gsum ste/ bdag dang 'brel ba'i bya ba dang / gzhan dang 'brel ba'i bya ba dang / bdag gzhan gang la'ang ma 'brel ba'i bya ba bcas kyi 'jug pa dang / bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba dang / dus gsum gyi rnam bzhag sogs kyi sbyor ba ha cang dag la tshad mar grub snang / 'grel byed dag gis don ma rgo bar 'grel log brgyab pa yang 61

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /yod/ dper na/ bka' gyod rma'o/ /zhes pa'i rma ni smra ba'am bkad pa'i skad dod min gyi1 rma 'bebs pa ste/ bka' gyod dang 'brel na/ nyes chad gcod pa'i don yin te/ phu nu bu tsha ma nyes pa gan la khrin mi rma zhes pas kyang gsal/ yul mi mnom/ zhes pa'i ma rnam ni/ brdab kyis bris nyes sam brkos nyes yin yang / phrogs pa'i don du bkral na dag cha thon med/ tshig 'di ni gzhan bdag tu bzung ba'i sa cha la hab thob mi bya ba'i don yin/ rgya las mnangs phal1 zhes pa'i phal ni phab ste yig skyon yin yang / de'i rjes su (phral)zhesaXmachan btab pa lhag par 'phyugs song / tshig de'i 'grel la mi dang rgyu nor phrogs par bshad pa yang ma dag par mngon/ rgya las mnangs phab ni/ rgya'i lag nas rgyu blangs pa'i don yin pa ma gtogs/ mi phrogs pa'i dan bsdus med/ mnangs ni brda rnying du rgyu nom pa ste/ ge sar sgrung las phal cher bdang zhes bris pa ma dag pa'o/ /gzhan yang / khrims la khrin dang /mthil la thil dang / 'phel la pel lhar bris nyes byung ba nyung shas shig yod kyang / ye ge bye dang bsdur na/ mdzu gu gcig gi skyon lus thil bor dma' phab na 'grig gam/ khyod kyi dpyad rtso ma las kyang yig skyon du ma zhig snang bas ci ltar spru/gsu ma ni/ sdeb sbyor yin men gyi skor la/ da da rigs kang la'ang rol mo'i snyan cha yod/ bod skad la mtshon na/ ska da kyi gdangs la drag zhan bar 52

bod yig byung rabs kyi da snang thag ga rtsod pa'i ral gri/ma'i khyad par dang / dbyangs kyi nga ro la bstod smad drang 'khyog bkug pa'i dbye ba yod/ de rnams gang la gang bde legs par sbyar nas ngag gi snyan cha thon pa la sdeb sbyor zer/ de lugs ma rtogs na/ 'char tsan dang mi mthun pa mthong tshe/ yon tan skyon du log rtog 'byung srid/ bod kyi brda rnying du ming dang tshig gi brjod stangs la sdeb sbyor lhag pa 'dzoms snang / gong du bshad pa'i rdo ring de dag ji bka' gcigs ni1 lo rgyus ma zad/ sdeb sbyor gyi sgo nas kyang bslab bya mchog yin/ rdo ring de dag las/ gnyi blas spebs so chogaces pa lta bu'i tshig rnams las/ gnyi zla'i gnyi la kas 'phu' yod pa/ bris ma dag pa'i skyon min gyi/ sdeb spyor legs pa'i yon tan chub te/ ming gi tshogs pa'i ya gyal zla'i sgra gdangs rtsi ba dngad nyi'i sgra gdangs ba yang ba/ shed mi mnyam pa'i skyon gyis/ nyi la sngon 'jug ched du sbyar nas/ sgra lci ba gnyis sprel nas brjod tshe/ gdangs snyan par gyur pa yin1 nyi ma shar ba/ lta bu'i tshig rnams las nyi ma'i nyi la gas 'phul med pa ni/ ba nyis ka'i sgra yang bas/brjod bde bar grub bo— /gzhan gtsug my-i 'gyur/ zhes deng / nam zhar mi 'gyur1 zhes dang / dzwa nee zha zhar myi bsgyur/ zhes pa dag las/ gzhar dang /nam zhar dang / nam nam zha zha gsum gyi don gcig kyang / sgra dang gzug4za dad par gyur don ci yin zhe da/ dus nam tshod yid na yang zer ba'i ldan ston par/ gzhar zhes sgra gcig gis mtshon na1 yi ka'i jigs pa tshang dgob4/63

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung/skabs 'dir gzhar gtsug ces sgra lci ba la lci ba sbyar ba sdeb sbyor legs par grub snang / nam zhar zhes sgra gnyis kyis mtshon par/ gzhar gyi gas 'phul dor ba/ rtags mtshungs na brjod bde zer ba'i dpe yin/ nam nam zha zha zhes sgra bzhis mtshon par/ ra mtha' dor ba yang brngod bde ba'i phyir ro/ /dbon zhang gnyis/ chab srid gcig du mol nas/ zhes pa'i dbon zhang ni ming gi tshogs pa zhig yin/ ming gi tshogs par gtso pha' dang / shed mnyam pa dang / dbyer mi rung ba bcas kyi sbyar srol gsum yod pa las/ gtso phal can spyir gtso bo snga ma dang / phal ba phyi mar sbyar dgos/ dper na/ pha du/ dpod g.yog lta du/ des na dbon zhang zhes pa/ zhang dbon ltar lugs 'byung du mi sbyor bar/ go log par sbyar don ci yin zhe na/ sgra lci bas yang ba drangs na/brjod bde zhing snyan cha thon pa'i phyir ro/ /zham 'jing ni zhabs 'jing yin yang / zhabs kyi rjes 'jug yang 'jug pho yig dang 1 'bring gi sngod 'jug mo yig ste/ drag zhan mi mthun par gyur pa'i skyon sel du/ snga ma'i rjes 'jug dang yang 'jug gi dod du/ mo yig ma sbyar nas/ mo yis mo drangs pa lhar sbyar ba dang / de yang snga ma'i rjes 'jug ma dang / phyi ma'i ba gnyis mchu las byung ba sgra bskyar ba sel ched/ zham ring du sbyar das brjod pa bde bar byas byung ngo / /rdo ring de dag gi bka' gcigs tshig lhug yin yang / sdeb spyor gyi dge mtshan mngon par thon snang / dper brjod na/ de las phan tshun —4

bod yib byung rabs kyi dpyang zag bcod pa'i ra gri/dgrar my-i 'thab1 dmag myi drang / yul my-i ma rnam(brnab)1 yid ma ches pa lhogayod na/ my-i bzung gtam das te/ brdzangs nas phyor gtang ngo 1 /zhes ba las/ dgrar my-i 'thab/ dmas my-i drang / yul my-i brnab/ zhes pa'i tshis gi zla bo gsum do mnyam pas/ brjod bde zhing brjid nyams thon pa dang de man chad kyi tshig grogs gsum gyi tsheg bar re ba bzhin ji nyub du btang na sa/ tshig da ring thung glo dur du shor drags pa med pag ngas gi snyan cha thon snang / skyid pa'i bka' drod ni rabs tre'i bar du thob/ snyan pa'i sgra skad n-i gnyi zlas slebs so chog tu khyab ste1 zhes pa don gnyis bshibs nas brjod pa kha gsal zhing / tshig ka gnyis ka'i ngal gso mtsham ma ring thung 'dra sa na ni sgra'i ga sbyar nas/ ngag si dpal bskyed/ tshig phyi ma'i mtha' cung bad bsrings nas dgyes pa'i nyams thon pa bcas kyis/ ngag gi rol mor tshig gi snyan cha dang don gyi dag nyams ci yang thon snang ngo / / — bzhi ni/ phrad kyi thob thang 'grig min skor ka rdo ring de dag ga phrad kyi sbyor stangs sum dgas kyi dgongs pa dang ha cang mthun tshul bshad na/ sum cu ba'i rtsa ba las phrad gzhan dbang can skor zhig gi rnam grangs mi tshang gdaper na/ la don gyi tu dang / 'brel sgra'i yi dang / rdzogs tshig gi todang / 'byed sdud kyi tam sogs dngos su bstan med ba'i rkyen gyis/ tun hong nas thon pa'i bod yig shog dril rnams su phrad kyi dam grangs de rigs mthong ba 66

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /ha cang dkon mod kyang / btsan po khri srong lde btsan rjes kyi yig rnying rnams su1 sgra de rigs kyi 'jug pa rim gyis khyab par mthong / khri srong lde btsan bzhugs pa'i spyi lo769bar tshugs pa'i zhol rdo ring phyi ma'i yi ge las/ du sgra brgyad byung ba'i nang gi gnyis ni tu sgra'i dod yin/ tu zhes pa gcig kyang med do/ /khri gtsug lde btsan bzhugs pa'i byi lo823par tshugs pa'i gtsug lag khang mdun gyi rdo ring gi yi ge las/ du sgra bcu gcis byung ba'i nang gi gnyis ni tu sgra'i dod yin/ thob thabaltar byung ba'i tu sgra gsum snang 1 bod yig bkas bcad gnyis pa spyi lo826par mdzad pa yin/ des na rdo ring snga ma de tshugs du su sum cu ba'i rtsa ba lhar tu sgra med pa dab/ de nas lo ngo re ba nyis 'gor jis kyi rdo ring phyi ma de tshugs dus/ pho yis pho yi ming mtha' drang ga /zhes pa lhar/ rjes 'jug ga ba dang / yang 'jug da la tu sgra dang /rdzogs tshis da drag mthar to dang / 'byed sdud kyi da drag mthar tam dang /'brel sgra kha skob ba yi sogs sbyar ba'i srol byung 1 der ma zad cing shing zhing /ces shes zhes/ ce'o she'o zhe'o/ ce na she na zhe na/ cig shig zhig dang bcas pa'i tshig phrad rnams la/ da thus bar ga ming ma thogs pa yang / sur cu ba'i rtsa ba las ma byung ba'i phyir ro/ /sum rtags kyi rtsa ba de bod btsan po'i rgyal khams sil bur 'thor ba'i rjes su mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis brtsams pa yin na/ tshig phrag kyi dam grangs ma tshang ba de rnams dngad ming ma thogs pa'i 66

bod yig byung rabs kyi dpyang thag gcod pa'i ral gritshig phrad de rnams yod nges yin mod/ med don ci/yang / sum rtags ni tshags dam zhing don bsdus pa/ srong btsan gyi skabs su thon thub pa zhig gtan nas ma yin par bshad mod/ 'o na thon mis yi ge gsar du bskrud thog rgyal bo srong btsan la phul ba'i yig phud de/sum rtags kyi rtsa ba las kyang tshabs dam zhing don bsdus pa zhig min nam/phyag rtsom de'i blo ka dang bo nga ro drang ba ste a nges pa zhig dang / blo ka gnyis pa'i rkang ba dang bo nga ro sgrong ba e nges pa dang / gnyis pa nga ro bkug pa i nges pa dang / gsum pa nga ro bstod pa yo nges pa dang / bzhi ba nga ro smad pa yu nges pa zhig ste1 tshig gi sgo nas rol mo snyan 'jibs phun sum tshogs pa dang / don gyi sgo nas rgyal bo srong btsan sgam po'i sku gsung thugs gsum gyi yon tan bla na med pa dang / mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams/ sgra rgyan bya dka' ba'i lam nas1 de 'dra'i snyan ngag mchog tu gyur pa zhig brtsams byung na/ skabs der sum rtags kyi rtsa ba brtsam mi thub pa'i dpe yod dam/yang skabs der sum rtags byung yod na/ bkas bcad lan gsum byed don med zer/ bkas bcad lan gsum byed don ni/ sgra rig pa'i bsta na bcos med la/ bod yig shā1ga len gyi blo skyes dang nyams myong la brten nas1 rim gyis sum rtags kyi gzhung zhig bsgrigs pa min la/ sum rtags kyi gzhung de rtsa ba'i cha nas tshang ba dang ma dag pa rnams rim gyis kha bskangs shing dag par 57

das yig ris pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /bcos pa yang min te/ gtso bo chos bzhung gi 'gyur bcos mdzad pa dar 1sgyur lugs gtan la phab pa dang / brda bsar rnying gi khyad par bstan pa'i sgo nas/ tha snyad mang bo zhig skabs de'i spyi skad du grags pa lhar bkas bcad pa yin te/ bam po de dag dang / skyogs ston rin chen bkra shis mchob 'is mdzad pa'i bod kyi mad las gsar rnying gi brda'i khyad par ston pa legs par bshad pa li shi'i gur khang las gsal ba lhar na1 bkas bca da dang bo ni/ btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus dang bor/ phal chen dang / 'u nga sde bzhi dang / mdo sde kha cig dang / sher mdo kha cig gi 'gyur bcos mdzad pa dang / slan chad kyi bsgyur lugs gdams pa yin/ 'gyur de rnams las/yul skad du bris pa skor zhig dang / brda rnying gi zur thon par bris pa skor zhig spyi skad dang / zor yang bar rtser pa lhar gtan la phab pa/ dper na1gag la gang / dbung 'a dbus/ glag pa la ltag pa/ pog phor la spos phor/sdum pa la khyil/ red pa la grub pa/ brdzu pa la bsu ba/ gsun pa la gsan pa/te por la shin tu'am rab tu/ rdzogs sgo la rdzogs so lhar bri bar bkas bcad do/ /bkas bcad gnyis pa ni/ mnga' bdag khri ral ba can gyi dus shing pho rta ste spyi lo826bar mdzad pa yin/ de las gsung rab dang bcas pa ji ltar bsgyur ba'i gzhung lugs gtan la phab par ma zad/ 'gyur snga ma rnams kyi tha snyad dag pa rnams so na bzhab pa dang / dag cha de 'dra thon med 58
