bod yig byung rabs kyi dming jig gcod pa'i ral gripa kha shas slar bcos/ chos gyi skad ma grags pa noms gab ra du bsnan/ kha skad las ming gces so 'tshal sogs kyang bsnan/ brda rnying brda gsar du bsgyur nas/ de tshang ma 'grel dang bcas pa dkar chag tu bris nas bkas bcad do/ /de bzhin bkas bcad dang bo dang / gnyis pa ni/ brda gsar rnying gi bar mtshams dbye sa yin no/ /bkas bcad gsum pa ni/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi dus kyis lo chen rin chen bzang bo nas lo chen ba pā la bha dra'i bar du byon pa rnams kyis mu mthud— nas mdzad pa yin skad/ skabs der chos gzhung ma zad/ rig gnas gzhan dag gi tha snyad kyang mang bo gsal bar mdzad pa las/ tha snyad skor zhig dper na/ nyi shu la gnyis bcu/ sum cu la gsum bcu/ bstan bcos la bstan chos/ bsam gtad la bsam btan sogs su 'chos par mdzad kyang / bkas bcad bar ma bzhin du gnas pa'i don ni/ des lhar bsgyur ba don du ma 'byor ba min yang 1 kha skad kyi gdangs dang de 'dra mi mthun zhing / sdeb sbyor nyams pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga ba/ bod ska da kyi ming yang med pa'i sam sgo ṭa zhig srong btsan gyi skabs su e yod zer/ 'di ni skye don med pa'i dogs pa ste/ ma shes phyir na med pa mid/ gong du thon mi'i 'khrungs yul dang / yab kyi mtshan dang / khong gi mdzad pa sogs bshad zin kyang / dogs pa dpyis phyin par gcod ched/slar yang khong gi mtshan kun tu bzang bo yin pa'i shes byed gnyis gsum 6 9

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /tsam bstan pa la/ sgra pa nam bzang gis mdzad pa'i sum rtags kyi 'grel ba bstan pa'i sgron mer sum rtags kyi rtsa ba bkod pa'i mjug tu/ byu ka ra ṇa'i rtsa ba brgyad pa las kun tu bzang bo'i byu ka ra ṇa dang bo'i skabs te lnga ba'o//zhes dang / byu ka ra ṇa'i rtsa ba brgyad pa las kud tu bzang bo'i byu ka ra ṇa dang bo'i skabs te drug pa'o/ /zhes gsungs snang / rgya gar gyi lugs la rtsom pa bo'i rang ming brtsams chos la 'dogs tshul yod da/ dper na/ slob dpon rid chen 'byung gnas zhi ba4 mdzad pa'i sdeb sbyor gyi gzhung la/ rang gi ming du btags nas/ sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas/ zhes pa lhar/ slob dpon thon mis mdzad pa'i byā kaXr ṇa la rang mtshan gsol nas/ brda sprod kun tu bzang bo/ zhes yin/ thon mis bsgyur pa'i dpang skong phyag rgya ba'i mjug tu'ang khong gi 'gyur byang 'khod yod/ lha sa'i jo khang du btsan po khri srong lde btsan sku ring la bzhengs pa'i srong btsan rgyal blon gyi 'bag sku'i gras su slob dpon thon mi'i mtshan la kun tu bzang bo zhes 'khod yod do/ /lta ba phyi ma'i mtha' dpyad na/ thon mis bod yig gsar du bskrun pa yin zer ba bden thag chod yin zhing / kud la gsal bas/ 'dir kro ba'i dgos pa med do/ /srong btsan gyi sngon rol na bod la yi ge med zer ba/gnas tshul dngob1 dang mthun pa mi 'dug kyang 1 rgyu mtshan med pa ma yin te/gcig ni/ tun hong nas thon pa'i btsan po rim byung gi lo rgyus las/60

bod yig byung rabs kyi da snang thag gcod pa'i ral gri/bod la snga na yi ge myed pa yang / btsan po 'di'i tshe byung nas/ zhes pa bzhir bzung ba yin/ lo rgyus de las/ gnya' khri btsan po nas gnam ri srong btsan bar rgyal rabs so gnyis dang / de dag so so'i btsun mo dang blon po sogs kyang gsa' bar shad rgyu yod na1 zhang zhung gi yi ge yod tshul los shes/ yin na yang / zhang zhung gi yi ge yul de ga'i bon chos 'don byed tsam du zad pas/bod spyi'i yi ger ma brtsis pa red/ dper na/ rang re'i rgyal khams na dbyi si lan chos lugs dar rgyas mi che'am/ a hung ma gtogs chos der 'khod pa'i yi ge de shes mi ye mang / ha'i ha'es kyang kho tshor yi ge med zer ba mi bden nam/ rgyal mo tsha ba rong na'ang yi ge tshan pa re yod de/ yig rigs sna tshogs kyi phyi mo me tog phreng ba las/ de'i 'bri tshugs dang sbyor tshul gsham gsal/la ga cha ja tha da pa ba cha jarwa ༅ ༅ khro yaka nga ca nya ta na pa ra1 ca laza 'a 'a ༅ kyi za ཿbyed za' ya ra sa ha a ཿ rnyi4'o5 61ka'i 4 'i gyibazhes pa ni/ rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi yi ge 'o/ /gru bzhi ba ni zla gam dang / /nas 'dra blum po gru gsu ma dang / /mig dang rgya gram 'gyur med la/ /bu drug phyi ma bzhin du sbyab/ /mkhas pas zhib tu dpyad la bri/ /yi ge re re byed dus su/ /ji 61

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung shad re re ma gtogs pa/ /gzhan dag gsum po mi dgos so/ /yi be 'di yang srong btsan sgam po'i sngon byung bar grags kyang / yi ge de shes mi ha cang nyung bas/ bod gna' rabs kyi yi ge'i khongs su brtsis par ma grags so1 1gnyis ni/ zhang zhung gi yi ge 'di zhes bya ba deng sang mi snang ba'i phyir yin te/ bon po'i chos rnams zhang zhung gi yi ges bris pa/ dus kyi bskal don du song na yang / mi rgyud ma chad pa'i khyim tshang la la na/ daXdung bon chos re gsung rten du bzhag yo da tshod 'dug kyangaX/ rtags brnya na rgyu lag mthil tsam yang mi snang / de 'dra'i bon chos re mthong myong zer ba'i mi gcig kyang med par/ dogs pa zos nas/ yod zer ba da thos ma gtogs pa/ 'dug zer ba mig gis mthong ba med/ de bden gi zer ram rdzun gi zer— yang / rgyal bo gri gum btsan po dang / khri srong lde btsan gyi sku ring la bon thang re bsnubs te/bon gshen rig 'dzin rnams kyis bon rnams gter kha kun tu sas nas byin brlabs smon lam re mdzad nas bzhag go /phyis 'gro don dus la bab pa dang rig 'dzin rnams kyi sprul ba bshen gyer rma dbyil la sogs pas gter kha so so nas bon rnams spyan drangs nas da lha'i bar du snang bar gyur to/ /zhes brda sprod nyi shu bdun pa'i 'grel ba las gsungs mod/ da thug bar du mis mthong lag zin myong ba su yod/ sgos su gri gum btsad po'i skabs su bter 62

bod yig byung rabs kyi dpyang zag gcod pa 'ir mgri—du sbas pa'i bon dmas phyis su spyan drangs nas shul na lus pa e yod/ yod na bcings grol tshun chad du re gnyis shig phye la 'byung rgyu med pa ci yin bsams shing / nye 'a ma lo 'ga'i rtsod res/ bon phyogs langs pa dag gis1thon mis zhang zhung sga yi ge legs ba cos tsam las bsar bzo byas med zer ba dang / mtha' na thon mi sam sto ṭa zer ba'i mi zhig kyang med zer bar lhag par the tshom skyes nas/ gang dad chos lugs phyogs su mi ci nga skyes bu dkon/zhang zhung yi ge yod zer ba rdzun red bsams te/ bod yig thon mis bskru na pa las/ srong btsan sngon la yi ge med zer ba yin no/ /mdor na/ sngon gyi lo rgyus kyi brtsams chos rnams las/ sto na pa bshen rab sku 'khrungs rjes/ bon noms zhang zhung gi ye ger bsgyur par bshad tshul mang bar gzhigs da/gnya' khri btsan po'i rjes su bon gyi dgos pa dang bstun nas/ zhang zhung na yig rigs shig byung yod pa zag chod red/ deng sang rtags tsam yang lus med pa'i don ni/ ha lam 'di lta ste/ gcig tu/ zhang zhung gi skad du sbyar ba'i yig gzugs ma nges kyang / zhang zhung gi yul skad ni bod spyi'i skad chaXdang khyad par che/ brda sprod nyi shu bdun pa dang / de'i 'grel ba las/ zhang zhung gi skad cha deng sang gi yi ger sgra sbyar ba dper na/ brda krod nyi shu bdun pa zhes bya ba la/ phyo nyil ni cu sdis la bha dwa ya zer/ mthar phyin pa la rgya lag phyad pa zer/ mgo la kṣa zer ba sogs kyis gsa' / des na bon po rnams kyis bon 63

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /chos rgya cher spel dgos na/ deng sang gi bod yig tu mi 'bri ka med red/gnyis su/ stabs der zhang zhung du shog gu yod med mi shes/ gal te shing leb dang rdo leb dang sog pa dag tu bris pa yin na/ ru spo ba dang / zing 'khrug rgyal bar 'khyer kha mi bde bas/ phyis su rim gyis thon mis bskrun pa'i yi ger bsgyu ra nas shog gur bris pa gsung rten du bzung nas/ sngon na rten du brten pa'i shing leb dang rdo leb rnams dgos med du btang ba dang / dus yun ha cang 'gor ba'i rkyen gyis 'jig song ba yin srid/ deng sang bkol ba'i yi ge 'di slo ba dpon thon mi sam lha ṭas gsar du bskrun pa rtsod med yongs grags red// //sprub— pa/ rig pa skyed byed dogs pa yin/ /dogs pa gcod byed dpyad pa yin— /dpyad pa gting mtha' chod pa na/ /smongs mun 'joms pa'i nyin byed 'char/ /log rtos nyes bshad snyigs ma'i lang long can/rigs 'a ma nor du ke ta kas bgrungs pa'i/ /ra ba gsal mtsho nang bod yig byung rabs kyi1 /grub rtags mtshar ba'i byur sdong mngon par mthong // //6

yi ge 'jug pa'i gdas brgyad dang chos lnga1sgo tshan gsum pa/ yi ge 'jub pa'i gnas brgyad dang brda don gsal ba'i chos lnga rgyas par bshad pa/sna skad ming brda tha snyad mtshan ma dang / 1tshib don dang bcas yi se 'jug ba nas brgyad1 1don dmigs sgra byung ma thun snang thun mo nga grags1 /mngon zhen rem pa'i chos lnga ldan pa gces1 1mkhas dbang lce khyi 'brug gis brtsams pa'i gnas brgyad chen po'i rtsa ba las/ bad spyod pa'i gnas chen brgyad dang / yi ge 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad dang / brda go bar byed pa'i chos lnga dang bcas pa/ khebs rgya che ba'i sgo nas mdor bstan nas yod pa dang / lo chen ska ba dpal brtsegs kyis ba nas brgyad chen po'i 'grel ba mdzad nas/ don tshan so so ni mtshan nyid dang 1 byed las dang / 'brel tshul sogs rgyas par gsung ba1 snang / yi ge 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad dang chos snga/ zhes pa sgra rig pa'i gzhung lugs nyer mkho rab tu che ba zhig tu mthong nab / rje kong sprul yon tan rgya mtshos brtsams pa'i shes bya kun khyab dang / slob dpon dmu dge bsam btan gyis brtsams pa'i brda sprod blo gsal da ga 'a ston las— brda sprod pa'i gnas chen 65

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /brgyad po sum rtags kyi gzhung las ngo sgrod kyi tshul du bsdus yod mod/ skye bo phal gyis cung zad go dka' bar mthong nas/ de lugs go sla ba'i tshig gis dper brjod dang 'brel nas rgyas par bshad pa gsham gsal/ ma rtobs log rtog ci mchis pa/ mkhas dbang rnam pas bsal bar zhu/don tshan dang bo/ yi ge 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad/yi ge 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad ni/ sgra dang / skad/ ming / brda/ tha snyad/mtshan ma/ tshig don rnams yin te/ so so'i rgyu mtshan gsham gsal/dang bo/ sgra/sgra ni mnyan bya yin te/ skabs 'dir sems can du ston pa'i sgra gtso bor 'dzin pa yin/ sgra la zin pa'i sgra dang ma zin pa'i sgra rigs ba/nyis yod pa las— zin pa'i sgra ni dbang bos zin pa'i 'byung ba ste byed rtso' las byung ba'i sgra yin/ 'di la yang sems can du ston mi ston rigs gnyis yod/sems can du ston pa'i sgra di/ skyes bus gtam bshad pa'i sgra ste/ bkra 'is bde legs/ zhes brjod pa'i sgra lha du/ sgra de 'byung ba'i rgyu gnas dang byed pa rnams dbang bos zin pas/ brjod bya'i don ston pa ste/ rjod byed kyi sgra yin zhing / sems can du mi ston pa'i sgra ni/ skyes bus thal mo brdabs pa'i sgra lha bu/ sgra de 'byung 'i rgyu lag mthil gnyis kyi dbang bos zin kyang / brjod bya med pas don bstan rgyu med pa ste/ rjod byed kyi sgra min no1 /ma zin pa'i sgra ni166

yi ge 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad dang chos lnga/dbang bos ma zin pa'i 'byung ba lab skyes pa'i sgra yin/ 'di la'ang sems can du ston pa dang mi ston pa rigs gnyis yo da de/ sems can du ston pa'i sgra ni1 sgra par grabs ba 'i sgra lha bu/ sgra de 'byung ba'i rgyu sgra par gyi sgrig cha dbang bos ma zin kyang / brjod bya'i don ston pa dang / sems can du mi sto na pa'i sgra ni chu lhung lhung du grags pa lha bu/ sgra de 'byung ba'i rgyu dbang bos ma zin cing / brjod bya bstan rgyu med do/ /sgra de dag lab don che ba rjod byed kyi sgra yin1 rjod byed kyi sgra gang la'ang brjod bya'i yu ba zhig yo da pas na/ sgra shes na don la mi rmongs zer/brjod bya'i sgo nas khyad par byes na gtso cher rigs rjod kyi sgra dang / tshogs brjod kyi sgra rnam pa gnyis yod de/ rang gi brjod byar kyur pa'i rigs spyi yod pa'i rjod byed kyi sgra la rigs rjod kyi sgra zer/ dper na1 zog ces brjod pa'i sgras brjod bya zog zer ba'i phyugs rigs spyi bstan byung / zog gi rigs las 'bri dang / mdzo dang / ba lang dang 1 rtol dang / mgal bu dang / ma te sogs 'dus yod/ zog ces pa sems can de rigs kun la khebs yod pas spyi ming yin la gzhan noms zag rigs kyi khyad par ba yin pas bye brag pa'i ming yin no/ /rang gi brjod byar gyur pa'i tshogs spyi yod pa'i rjod byed kyi sgra la tshogs rjod kyi sgra zer/ dper na/ pi wang zhes brjod pa'i sgra 'dis brjod bya pi wang du grub pa'i tshogs spyi bstan byung / pi wang gi tshogs pa las167

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon jingam dang / spubs dang 1 pags pa/ lag rten/ pho rgyud— mo rgyud/ khrol gzhu1rgyud rten/ rgyud bzung / bzhu rgyud sogs 'dus ༷yod pas/ pi wang ni tshogs spyi'i ming dang / gzhen dka ni ya gyal gye ming yin no1 /rigs rjod kyi sgra dang tshogs rngod kyi sgra las gzhan/ chos rjod kyi sgra dang / chos can rjod pa'i sgra /grangs rjod kyi sgra dang bgrang bya rjod pa'i sgra/ rnam gcod kyi sgra/ bya byed las bsum rjod ba 'i sgra/ dra da kyi sgra dang / nyams mtshod pa'i sgra sogs mang ngo / /ngo po'i sgo nas khyad par zus na/ yi ge dang ming tshig brjod pa sna kha bzhi yod pa — 'byung 'gyur du shes par gyis/ /gnyis pa/ skad/skad ni go brda sprod byed yin te/ rgya bod hor gsum la sogs pa'i mirigs rang rang gi spyi tshogs su phan tshun bad sprod pa'i skad cha la/ mi rigs kyi khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa zhig yod/ dper na1 smra shes shing don go ba bzo nus pa can la/ bod skad du mi dang / rgya skad du rin dang / legs sbyar skad du ma nu zer ba/ don gcig la sga mi gcig pas go bar byas pa lta bu/skad cha las dod gyi ngo bo ston pa'i ming dang / tshig sbyor byed kyi phrad dang /don sna tshogs kyi khyad pa ston pa'i tshig dang bcas pa yod tshad 'dus yod pas/ kha skad du rang skad goms gshis kyis go brda ji bzhin 'phrod kyang /yig skad du brda sprod pa'i gzhung lugs sum rtags dag gsum legs par 68

yi ge 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad dang chos lnga/——shes pa —ga che/ bod mad la yul skad kyi khyad par che yang / yis skad du go brda legs ba ra 'phrod pa/ bod thun mong gi brda sprod gzhung lugs 'khrungs snga ba dang / des rnam par bstan pa'i drin yin te1 tsheg gi 'khrul ba tshar gcod brda zo da yin zhes gsungs— skad rigs gang gi nang gses kyang spyir yul ska da kyi khyang par yod/ bod skad la san1 skad dang / dbus skad dang /khams skad kyi khyad par yed pa lta bu/ mi rigs gang gi skad cha yang 1 srid 'byor rig gsum dar ba'i rjes 'brangs nas/ ba ska da rim gyis yig skad lhar/ tshig nyung la don dri' ba/ ba rjod pa bcud che ba1 go rim 'brel chags pa1 go brda sgod mkhas par byur cing 'gyur bzhin yod— dper na/ spya mi las yon tan can dang / rdzong rim pa yan chad kyi mgo 'dren rnams kyi gros tshogs su gleng ba'i gtam lha du'o/ /bod kyi yig skad ni gna' snga mo nas bod kyi spyi skad kyi tshul du gyur snang ste/ yul gru sang gi skyes dus bris pa yin yang /mdo dbus khams gsum gyiXsus bltas kyang mi go ba med/ 'di ni sdon byon mkhas pa rnam pa tshos/ rtsom du phal skad ma sre kun go ba gzhir gzung bar bya/tha snyad rang bzo ma byed yongs grags dpe ru gzung bar bya/ dngos yo gsar ba gang byung la ming gdags pa ra yang sgra nyung la sdeb legs shing kha gsal bar bya1 yi ge dka par sgra'i zur ji bzhin 'thon par bya/ ming dang tshig gi sbyor ba la skyon bcu spang bar bya1 spyir sum rtags dag gsum gyi dgongs pa 6 3

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyungadang bstun par bya/ zer ba sogs gal bo che la nan tan mdzad pa dang / de bzhin phyag len gnangs pa'i dpe lam btod yod pa'i drin yin/ bod kyi spyi skad gtan la dbab par/ legs bshad de rnams band du 'dzin par byas na/ kha ska da yig ska da kyi tshul du 'gyur ba'i sgo nas/ sbyi skad 'chag par phan thobs so/ /sgra ska da gnyis kyi dbye ba la/ gcig sa ni/ gnyis ka'ang mnyan bya yin/mi gcig sa rte/ khyab che chung gi khyad par yod/ sgra ni mnyan bya spyi la khyab pa ste/sems can du ston pa'i dang mi ston pa'iXsgra kun bcig kyang ma lus par 'dus snang / skad ni mnyan bya las sems can du ston nga 'i sgra la khyab kyang /sems can du mi ston pa'i sgra 'a khyab med do/ /yin na yang / rang byung gi sgra sna tshogs skad du sbyar chog dper na/ 'brug sgra la ldir ri ri/ char ba dang ser ba babs pa'i sgra la sha ra ra dang — tha ra ra/ the bo gtags pa'i sgra la thags se thag ces lad mo'i sgo nas ji ma ji bzhin du brjod rung yang don gyis stongs pas so/ /des na skad cha ni sgra don gnyis kyi 'dus ma ste/ dper na/ sgra yi snod du don gyi dngos po'i bsdus yod pas/ de sgrog par byas na don ston par 'byur ro/ /sgra ni skad cha ma zad rang byung gi grabs so cog 'dus nas yod do/ /70

yi ge 'jug pa'i gnas bsgyud dang chos lnga/gsum pa/ ming /ming ni don gyi ngo bo ston byed de/ /yi ge du ma 'dus pa'i bdag nyid yin/ /de la 'dod rgyal gyi ming ni/ shing dang / nyi ma lha bu sogs/ yi ge'i sgra la brten das don bshad rgyu med pas sgra bshad med pa'o/ /'dod rgyal gyi dngos ming di/ dper na/ nor/ zhes pa/ zog gi bye brag rtsid pa dang ldan pa de'i rang ming yin pas dngos ming zer ba dang 1 'dod rgyal gyi btags ming ni/ dper na/ glen pa la zog ces pa/ rgyu 'bras mi shes par dma' phab nas gzhan ming zhig skabs thob kyis btags pa ste1 rang ming min pas btags ming zer ba lha bu sogs so/ /rjes grub kyi ming ni/ dud 'gro lha tsur mtshon da/dud nas 'gro ba'i sems can gyi rigs spyi la go bas/ sgra bshad yod do1 /rjes grub kyi dngos ming ni/ gnam gru/ lta bu dang / jis grub kyi btags ming ni/ gnam gru la lcags bya zer ba lta bu sogs so/ /'dod rgyal gyi ming ni ming gi chags tshul dang / rjes grub kyi ming ni ming gi 'phel tshul te/ rigs 'di gnyis snga rkyen phyis 'byung du 'grel yod la/ dper na/ gser/ zhes pa 'dod rgyal gyi ming dang / gser gzhong zhes pa rjes grub kyi ming yin te/ gser gyi rgyu las gzhong ba'i 'ams bu byung ba lta bu'o/ /ming gi byung 'phel dang / ming gi rigs kyi rnam dbye dang / ming gi rkyang 'dus tshogs gsum sogs/ bdag gis brtsams pa'i brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgrod las gsal te/ shes 'dod 71

dag yi rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /yod na der gzigs shib ming la rigs kyi dbye ba yod pas1 tshig sbyor du go rim ji lhar bsgrig ce na1 tshig sna brgya 'gyur sto nga 'gyur rtsid skud ༷go bregs lta bu yin pas/ chos nyid med pa 'dra ya nga / dpe cha gtos che yang / snying bo shog snye 'ga'/ zer ba'i dpe bzhin/ mthar gtugs na/ sgrig srol rtsa ba 'dro lha ste/ ming gi rigs kyi go rim ni/ /dngos po khyad chos grangs tha/ dang / 1bya ba ji bzhin bsgrib pa yin/ /lu gu dmar nag gnyis lding rtse byed/ lha bur ang kis mtshan ḍā——ba—rga— khya——ba lta ra/ 1ni dngos po'i ming(khyad bzhe)dang 1 2ni khyad chos kyi ming(da1 ba )dang / 3 'i grangs ka'i ming dang / ba'i bya ba'i ming ngo / /'di dag las sang dang gang zhig skabs su dbos pa med na bsu bas chog ste/ lu gu gnyis/lha bu1 go rim yang rang shugs su bsdus par 'gyur ro/ /'di rigs la dmigs bsal gyi dgos pa med na/ go rim brje mi rigs te/ rlabs che ba'i gung khrad tang / zhes dang / rin che ba'i— paṇa chin/ zhes par 'brel sgra mi 'jug ka med du gyur pa'i rkyen gyis/ tshig kha lhod song bar ma zad/ don skyon ya nga 'dres byung / mngon par zhen pa min tshe/ gung khran tang srid kha ge bzi brjid can zhig las/ rba rlabs che 'i chu bo zhig dang / paṇa chen sprul sku bco bo zhig las— rin thang che ba'i rgyu rdzas zhig tu log rtog 'byung srid/ des na go rim ltar/ gung khran tang rlabs po che dang — paṇa chen rin po che zer na/12

yi ge 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad dang chos ma1bod skad yang dag ste1 dgos med kyi 'brel sgra dor 'ing / tshig rngon gnyis ka'i brjid nyams thon pa'o/ /tshib spyor du go rim brje ba'i dgos ka dngos su yod na/ gar 'grig tu brje dgos/ dpe4 na/ rlabs chen tab gi drin gyis/ /nga la longs spyod gnangs byung / shad bu'o/ / yang / tshig gi cha shas la bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba gsum re yod pas /brda chad de rnams kyi go rim ji ltar bsgrig nge na/ mtha' gcis tu nges pa ma mchis kyang 1 snyi srol lhar na/ bdag gzhan phan tshun khu lha cha gsum lus/ /sgrig— po/ze ༷la ba ༵ zhi rdod/ kṣiṃ gi sdu ༵༵/ ra —bkar ༵rto pyu rnyi nad sprispri — song / lta gu ang kis mtshan pa lhar/ 1ni byed pa bo dang / 2ni bya ba'i yul dang / da ni byed pa dar / 4ni las dang —/ 5ni byed pa'i las te byed pa'i rtsol ba'am/ 'bras thu skyed byed kyi rgyu dang / 6nib ba'i las te— las kyi 'gyur ba'am/ rgyu las byung ba'i 'bras bu'o/ /ang ki ya cad gsu che1 gyis mtshan pa'i brda chad ni bdag gi dngos po dang / yang ki cha can gsum gyis ma tshad pa'i brda chad ni gzhan rmi dngo4 po'o/ /las ka jil bod ba 'a mthud rkyen 'di drug po'i gcig ma tshang na yang / don 'grub par mi 'gyur mod/tshig spyor du bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba gang dang gang 3ga brjod pa'i dgos ba med na bsdus chog ste/ tshe ring gis ri mo sbyar/ yar1na/ gyang ngos la ma lha snar/73

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung zer ba lha bu/ de la dmigs bsal gyi dgos pa yod na/ go rim brjes chog ste/ ri mo gyang ngor sbyar/ zhes pa lha bu'o/ /de yang byed pa gzu phal ston byed la byed sgra dang / bya ba'i yul ston par la'i don can gyi sgra 'jug dgos/las dngos te bkub bya la la don 'jug srol med/ bya ba gnyis yad rim gyis sam rim par 'jug par lhag bcas kyi sgras mtshams spyar dgos1 /bzhi ba/ brda/brda ni go bar byed pa ste/ ngag gi rjod byed dang lus kyi rnam 'gyur gyis go brda rgyag pa yin/ lus kyi rnam 'gyur gyis go bar 'jug pa ni/ mig brda dang lag bad sogs te/ mgo bo gug gug byed pa ni— 'thad pa'am khas 'che ba'i brda/ mgo g.yug pa ni/ mi 'thad pa'am mi dga' ba'i brda/ lag pa phar g.yug pa/ song zer ba'i brda/ lag pa tshur g.yug pa 'bod pa'i brda/thal mo deb pa dga' bsu byed pa'i brda/ mig zur gyis bltas pa blo la ma babs pa'i brda/ mthe bong bstan pa bstod pa'i bad la sogs pas ha cang go sna ba'i don tsam ston rung ngo / /shes bya mang ba'am cung zad go dka' ba sogs/ kha brda ste skad chas go bar 'jug dgos/ skabs 'di'i brda ni ma kha bo kha brda ste ngag gi brda la zer ba yin/ de phyir sum rtags kyi bstan brtsas la brda smod pa'i gzhung zhes ming thogs pa yin bad krod lugs dpyis phyin par sbyangs na/ tshig sbyor tshul la mkhas pa'i ngag gi dpal thon pa'i gzhi 74

yi ge 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad dang chos lngabartan ceng bzang ba zhib—chabs srid do1 /lnga ba/ tha snyad/tha snyad ni ming dang phrad kyi spyi ming ste/ tshig gi thung ba'i mthar thug pa'i snyad bya yin zhing / tshig sna bsdus nas1 tha snyad— ces ming du grub pa yin/dper brjod na/ tshe ring gis dpe cha lha/ zer ba'i tshig 'di'i thung mtha' bzhe yod pa gang yang tha snyad yin1 de la tshe ring—ni lha ba bo dang / dpe cha ni ba lha bya'i las dang / lha ba ni bya ba ste1 'di gsum don gyi ngo bo ston pa'i ming dang / gis ni tshib sbyo ra byed kyi phrad yin/ phrad 'di rigs ni rnam dbye gsum paXste/ bdag gi dngos po lta mkhan dang / gzhan gyi dngos po ba lha bya gnyis dam par zus nas/ blta bar bya ba de'i lta ba bo tshe ring yin 8 dang / blta bya dpe cha yin pa gsal bar bstan pa/ lta bu'o/ /ming gi tha snyad 'jug pa la1mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum shes dkos te/ gdung ma 'degs par nus pa ni/ka ba'i mtshan nyid yin pa blo la sa pa/ shes pa'i tha snyad dam blo yi tha snyad yin la/ ka ba zhes sgrog pa ni/ gdung ma 'degs pa can gyi mtshon byed yin pa ngag la byang ba/ rjod pa'i tha snyad dam ngag gi tha snyad yin 'ing / ka ba zhes pa'i ming gi mtshon bya lda/ gdung ma 'degs byed kyi mtshan gzhi ka ba sbyi tsam pa'i rang ldog dang 1 shug pa'i ka ba'am/ rdo lo'am lcags ka mtshan gzhi bye zab pa'am gzhi ldog yin pa/ ming gang zhig 'jug yul gang du 'jug par 76

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /gsal ba/ 'jub pa'i tha snyad dam thabs kyi tha snyad yin no/ /ming gi mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum dang shes rjod 'jug gsum khong du chud na/ tha snyad reg pa mnga' brnyes par 'gyur ro1 /phrad kyi tha snyad 'jug pa la/ rnam dbye tshig phrad dang / gsal byed kyi sgra dang / nyams mtshon pa'i sgra dang / rnam bcud kyi sgra sogs kyi thob thang dang / 'jug tshul dang / 'jug don sogs sum rtags kyi dgongs pa ji bzhin sbyor shes na/ tsheg mi brjid nyams dang / don byi zhi pa cha sogs ji ma ji bzhin 'thon par bya thub bo/ /drug pa/ mtshan ma/ —mtshan ma 'i rtags snye— don mtshon par byed cing snang bar nus pa'i rtags rnams yin/ srog gi bge tsheg sto/ bod yig tsheg sis ma bcad na/ /'phul rten ming gzhi 'khrul byur pas/ /brjod bya ston byed mi nus phyir/ /tsheg khyim 'grub par byed pa yin/ /rkyen gyi yi ge dbu khyud dang shad gnyis las/dbu khyud yig mgo ston byed yin/ /shad la rnam pa lnga yod de/ /tshig lhug skabs su chig shad dang — /tshigs bcad dang ni don tshad re/ /rdzogs pa'i mtshams su nyis shad dang / /brjod pa yongs rdzogs bzhi shad dang / /le'u tshan bar dang gal 'dzugs su/ /zul shad dang ni thig mgo ru/ /yig rdog gcig byung tshugs thub ched/ /spungs shad 'bri bar byed pa yin— /yi ger ram 'degs pa'i rtags dmas kyang don nges pa tsam mtshon rgyu yod de/ dper na/76

yi ge 'jug ba1'i gnas brgyad dang chos lnga/nga sdeb sbyor du1 spyo bsgo khyim gyis sgra lci yang sga sngo tshan dang / yi be tshogs tshan ston pa/ rtsom du/ ( )zla khyim1 gyis mchan bu dang 1 rgya gram gyis tshig snga mar bltos nas phyi ma 'dra ba bsdus par mtshon pa dang / yi ge'i 'og tuXthig le btab pa/ sgra rgyan dang / nan tan bya ba mtshon pa/ rtsis su/ —ba —bka(/ sobs rim bzhin sgyur dzi bgo snon dang / thob grangs dang / brgya cha dang/ ma cha du cha rnams mtshon pa1 gzhan 51nga / rkye yig tu1 rnam dbye tshig phrad so gas kyi sgra mi 'dang ba kha skong du rtab/sa kyis mtshan nga1 ste1 dper na/lhag bcas kyi lhab ma tsam 'dren pa'i sgra la3 / dam bca' 'dren pa'i sgra la——/ rdzogs tshig laX/ 'byed sdud la / mnyam sbyor la / 'dren sgra la / dpe cha'i ming gi zhes bya ba la 1/ rtags sogs bris nas mtshon pa yin no/ /bod yig gi tshig phrad de noms las rgya yig gi mtshan ma de tsho'i don 'dus par ma zad— don gzhan dag kyang ston rgyu yod do/ /rgya yig gi gna' dper 'di 'dra'i brda rtags 'jug pa mi dpe bas/ skyes du phal bas ngal gso mtshams dang tshig gi gcod mtshams ma shes la lhag par go dka' bar byur pa red/ rgya nag tu spyi lo1919bar/ ris gnas bsar brje'i las 'gul byung rjes/ kha skad ltar bris pa'i srol rim gyis dar ba dang 1 phyi gling ba'i yi be'i brda rtags rgya yig tu rim gyis cha tshang bar drangs 77

dag yig rig pa'i ba pa mngon phyung byung / mkhas pa wang yon hphang(sgyu 1 1rte 1 tshe)zer bas1 gna' dper brda rtags med pa skyon che bar mthong nas— snga ba gsum gyi sngon ma byas nas/ spyi lo192༷bar/ chu ngogs gtam rgyud ces bya bar brda rtags brgyab pa'i dpe bsnyed byung / rgya yig la mtshan ma btab pa'i srol byung ba'i drin kyis yigaXcha klos par rtogs nyes go nyes dang 1 tshib don 'khyog bshad log bzad kyi 'byung rkyen med par btang byung /skad dang lhan skyes kyi tshig phrad ni/ sgra yin la yi ge yang yod pas/ bri ba dang bshad pa kun la phan thogs shing / ngag tu ma grub pa'i brda rtags no/ sgra med la yi ge dngos kyang min pas/ mtshon byed tsam ma gtogs/rjod byed mi nyan pa na/ sgra yod pa'i tshig phrad ni/ sgra med pa'i brda rtags las mchog dang mchog yin/ des na brda rtags rgya yig la sbyar na phan thogs kyang / bod yig la sbyar na gnod pa thebs 'gro/ rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs su/ bod rig pas mgo bo stong ba'i gyen ldog pa skor zhig gis/ bod yig ji slar gtong ba'i las khag gi ming bzung nas/ bod yig gi sngon 'jug dang yang 'jug phal cher bsubs pa dang / bdag sazhan dang dus kyi nom bzhag dang bcas pa gtor ba dang / phrad kyi tshab tu mtshan ma sna tshogs btab pa sogs/ g.yag rwa rta mgor sprad/ bod gos rgya lur brtsos/ bag byer thal skya bsres/ mar dkar tshil la brjes/ mkhas rtags su blun rtags bstan 78

yin 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad dang chos lnga/byung / tsan dan gser bas rin che ba/ /blud pos sol bar bsregs la ltos/ /(sa skya legs bshad las/)zhes pa'i dper song ngo / /bcos lugs de bzhin bsgyur pa'i yig cha rnams gos chen yin yang / dri mas snags shing dra bar dras nas lhan pa yang mi nyan pa'i mthong chos kun la gsal/ sgos su tshig phrad gang mang zhig dor ba'i tshab tu bad rtags sna tshogs spyar ba'i rkyen gyis/ ngag gi rgyun dam dum du chad pa/ tshig gi lhu 'brel med du thor ba/ don gyi bcud shor ba/ go brda bag la zha ba sogs kyi dri mas 'bags pa'i 'gyar ma dang jis ma/ 'don mkhan gyis bton na/ yig ngo mi chod pa'am/ kha la rtsam skya bgam pa lha du/ nyan mkhan gyis mnyan na/ byis pas ldab ldib smra ba'am/ ne tsos mi skad lad pa lta bu/ sus kyang rtogs dka 'o/ /lad mo bya bar mtha' gnyis brtag pa gces/ /tshul dang mthun pa legs kyang 'gal ba nyes/ /brda rtags las 'phros nas lo ka'i don cung tsam bshad na/ rig gnas yon tad phan tshun brje res la lo tsā gnad du che ste/ bri la yi ge dag pa/ ming du ngo bo gcig pa/ tshig la brjod pa bde ba/ don 'a lhag chad nor ba med pa/'gyur nyams ji bzhin thon pa/ spyi ldog mthun par snang ba zhig dgos/ rgya yis bod yig tu bsgyur na/ brda rtags rnams kyang tshig phrad gang 'tsham du 'byor ba zhig dgos/ 'gyur ma dag na don legs par go ba phar zhog ma dag rgyun 'byams kyis rang skad 'bags nas nyams par 'byur srid/ dper na1 bkar la zo la/ ma'o kru'u zhi khri lo/ zhes pa'i 'gyur du/ smon pa 19

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /—— ——mtshon pa'i brda rtags — ma bsgyur pa'i rkyem gyis don nyam1sa pa'i skyon byung /rtags 'di'i tshab tu bod skad la thos dang cig sogs yod pas1 ma'o kru'u zhi khri lor(brtan par)thog ces bsgyur na1 don tshang bar ma zad/ gus nga 'inyams kyang legs par thon no/ / tshom lo 4rngo༅ la1 zhing 'brog las dar spel byed/ ces pa'i 'gyur du/ 'byed rtags‘ 'di ma bsgyur pas/ zhing las dang phyugs las ngo bo gcig tu bsres byung ba dang / 'brog ni grong las ring du yod pa'i rtswa sa'i ming yin pas/ 'brog las zhes pa dod nyams/ yang 1bdag /zhan gang la'ang ma 'brel ba'i bya ba dar ba dang / bdag dang 'brel ba'i bya ba spel ba gnyis me dang chu'i khyad par yod kyang — ngo bo gcig tu sbyar—dar spel zhes pas bya ba dngos ston tshul med pas/ de la byed pa sbyar1 bya ba gsum nya nyung mnyam bsres/ nyog rdzob lung ba gang gis spel ba zhes pa'i ngo bo bsgribatsu byung 1 'byur 'di rigs rgya skad kyi don dang 'bal ba/ bod skad la bshad sro' med nga / lce gnyis pas mi skad lab lab/ shor bsum byung ba (grwa pa zhig grong chog 'a song nas dgung mo nyal bar/ yon bdag sis khong gi mtshad nyid brtag ched1 chang dam pe sang / ra ma gci bud med gcig dang bcas phul ba dang / gang yang mi dkos zer/ dma' mtha' gcig bdam dgos par nan kyis zhus pas1 ka med du chang dam pe kang blangs/ chang gis bzi nas/ ra ma bshas/ bud med la 'byar/ sdom pa gsum shor song / de ༄ shor gsum zhes grags so//)ya mtshan che/mtshar rtags ma red than rtags red/ tshig de la zhing las dang phyugs las 80

yid 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad dang chos lnga/spel/ zhes bsgyur na dag cha thon pa'o/ / bas bkar za zer bar/ rtswa thang steng du zog lug mang / zhes bsgyur snang / skabs 'di'i1ni gnas gzhi mtsho'i pa'i sgra yin pa ma shes par/ steng / zhes ming lhag pa re bsnan/ ka ni nor yin pa ma shes par/ zog ces bsgyur nas/ bye brag pa'i ming(nor)la spyi ming(zog)sbyar ba byis par pha'i slog pa bskon pa'i dper song / de bzhin/ cha ka nyam zam la/ gar mkhan mdzes ma/ zhes pa las/ mdzes sdug ldan pa'i bud med gar mkhan1 zhes bsgyur pa dang / tsho4lha snyed za1khu mi kyi la/khong ni skya rtsal cad zhis red/ ces pa las/ kho ni rta la zhon pa'i mkhas pa zhig red/ ces bsgyur pa la sogs pa/ sa khyab rdo khyab tu mthong ba/ bod skad dang rda sprod pa la gnod pa che bas1 de 'dra'i sgrib nyes bag chags sel bar dogs pa slong khul du lo ka'i skor cung zad gleng ba yin/ /bdun pa/ tshigatshig ni don gyi khyad par ston pa ste/ 'brel yod kyi ming du ka/ zhig phrad gang 'tsham gyis lhan tu stel nas skabs don gang rung re zhig rdzogs par ston pa zhig yin/ tshig gi lus la bcad lhug spel ma gsum yod de/ bu rab tshig thog 'phar ba rjes thog lha bu tshigs bcad dang / nga de ring mi 'gro/'dus rgyu yin/ lta bu tshig lhug dang / thag dkar dkar/ /lug nag nag/ lug ji lug len/ lta bu bcad lhus spel ma'o/ /tshig gi cha shas la/ bya byed las 81

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung/—gsum dang / skong brnan nges gsum ste rnam pa drug snang / blo bzang gis dpe cha 'don/ lha bur mtshon na/ blo bzang ni byed pa bo ste 'don mkhan dang 1dpe cha ni 'a sa te gdon bya dang 1 'don pa ni bya ba ste skabs thog yi 'jug pa'o1 /'di dab tshig gi grub cha yin pas / rim bzhin byed tshig dang / shā1sa tshig dang / bya tshis ce'o1 /las ka las nas legs par grub bo/ /zer ba lha bur ma tshon na— byas pa'i mtha' ji ‘re dra yin pa gsal bar byed ched/ grub bo zheb1 pa sbyar nas kha bskangs/ kha bskangs pa'i tshig 'di rigs la skong tshib zer te/ bya ba'i ming ngam khyad chos kyi ming gi mtha' mar 'jug pa yin/ mgo 'dren gyis bsam 'char lhug par smra ba— 'a / tshang mas kha rog ge nyan gyin 'dug zer ba lha bur mtshon na/ bshad tshul dang / nyan tshul ji 'dra yin pa gsal bar byed ched/ lhug par/ zhes dang / kha rog ge zhes pa sbyar nas nan tan byas pa'i tshig 'di rigs la brnan tshig zer te/ spyir bya ba'i ming ngam khyad chos kyi ming gi thog mar 'jug pa yin/ de ring gi kan su'u gsar 'gyur e ltos1 lta bur mtshon na/ gsar 'gyur sna tshogs yod pa las/ gang zhig gsal bar byed ched/ gsar 'byur gyi snga logs su kan su'u sbyar cing /gsar 'gyur nyin nyin 'phud kyin yod pa gang zhig nges ched/ de'i thog mar/de ring/ zhes pa sbyar/ dogs pa skye ba sel bar sbyar ba'i de ring dang / kan su'u ni/ gsar 'gyur gang nges par byed pa'i tshig la nges tshig zer te/ spyir 81

yi ge 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad dang chos lngadangos po'i ming gi thog mar 'jug rtsa4 yin/tshig gi sbyor ba sna tshogs yod kyang / tha snyad gtso bo zhig gzhir bzung ba'i dbang du byas na/ phal cher rnam bzhag drug tu bsdus chog ste/ gcig ni/bya ba dang 'brel ba'i tshig ste/ dper brjod na/ 'brog pa tshos bal 'breg lha bu/ bya byed tha dad pa'i tshig dang / nyi ma shar ba/ lha bu/ bya byed tha mi dad 'i tshig dang / du ba 'then mi chog lta bu/ byed pa shugs bstan gyi tshig go /gnyis ni/ khyad chos dang 'brel ba'i tshig ste/ me tog mdzes shing sdug pa/ lha du/ khyad gzhi dang khyad chos 'dus pa'i tshig dang / shin tu bzang ngo 1 /lha bu/khyad gzhi shugs bstan gyi tshig go /gsum ni/ khungs dang 'brel ba'i tshig ste/rma chu'i mgo khungs ba yan ha ri'i shar ldebs las don pa/ lha bu/ 'byung khungs bstan pa'i tshig dang / 'jar pan nas 'phrul 'khor nyos yong lta bu/ yong khungs bstan pa'i tshig go /bzhi ni/ gzhi dang 'brel ba'i tshig ste/ ne'u gsing du me tog sna tshogs bzhad/ lha bu/ gnas gzhi bstan pa'i tshig dang /ljon shing la yal ga mang / lta du/ rten gzhi bstan pa'i tshig go /lnga ni/ dogs pa dang 'brel ba'i tshig ste/ khyod nam 'ong / lha bu/ dri ba'i tshig dang / dgos sam mi dgos/ lha bu/ mtha' gnyis su dgas pa'i tshig go /drug ni/ smon pa dang 'brel ba'i tshig ste/ bde bar gyur cig lha bu/ smon pa'i tshig dang /bslab la 'bad rtsol byos dang / yon tan 'byor ro/ /lha bu/ gdams pa'i 83

dgas yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung/tshig go /tshig don re zhig rdzogs par byed pa la/ rkyang sprugs tshogs gsum gyi khyad par yod de/ tshig rkyang ba ni/ tshig grogs gzha na la brten mi dgos par/rang don re zhig rdzogs par ston pa ste/ dper brjod na/ ming ni tshig gi sgrub byed yin/ lha bu/ tshig kher res don tshan re rdzogs par bstan pa dang /dka' ba ji 'dra yod kyang / khong gis khyad du gsad thub/ lha bu/ tshig ka gnyis yod kyang / phan tshun rten cing 'brel ba'i sgo nas/ don tshan re rdzogs par bstan pa yin pas/ 'di yang tshig rkyang ba las ma 'das so/ /tshig sbrags ma ni/ tshig rkyang ba gnyis sam du ma phan tshun 'brel ba yod kyang / rang tshugs su don tshan so so re rdzogs par ston pa ste/ dper brjod na/ ya rabs ma rabs spyod pas shes/ /gang gi mi yin skad kyis shes/ /lha bu/ tshig re res rang don re rdzogs par bstan pa/ 'di ni mnyam par 'jug pa'i tshig jigs ma yin pa dang — las ka ba rnams la rig gnas yon tan mtho zad yod pa dang 1 tshan rig lag rtsal sngon thon can dang ldan na/ gzod deng rabs can du 'byur ba'i thon skyed la go chen po chod la/ lta dur/ tshig ka gsum 'brel kyang — so so'i don tshan re rdzogs par mngod pa/ 'di ni snga rkyen phyis 'byung du 'brel ba'i tshig sprags ma'o/ /tshig gi tshogs pa ni/ don tshan du ma zhig 'brel nas yod pa dag tshig rkyang sprugs spel nas phreng bar grub pa ste/ dper 84

yi ge 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad dang chos lnga/brjod na/ nangs snga mor mtshams smin byung na/ char 'bab rgyu'i rtags yin/dgong phyi dror mtshams sprin byung na/ gnam thang rgyu'i rtags yin/ de phyir gtam dper/ nangs mtshams srin byung na sgor ma 'dud/ srod mtshams smin byung na lam la chas/ zhes grags pa'o/ /lha bu'i tshig snga ma gnyis re rkyang ba dang / phyi ma dag sprags ma'o/ /tshig rkyang zags tshogs gsum las dbye ba ma mod/ 'dir phyogs tsam bstan pa yin no/ /brgyad pa/ don/—don ni shes bya ste1 chos gang ci'i gnas lugs sam rang bzhin ka lha ba nyid yin/ don la nyab che chung gi khyad par yod de/ dod chung mtha' ming6ngam tshig tsam gyis go thub/ dper na/ rlan zhing gsher ba la/ chu/ zhes 'bod pa tsam gyis shes 'gro/ rogs pa 'gro mi 'gro ba'i don ma shes la/ khyod ye 'gro/zhes dris pa'i lan du/ 'gro/ zhes brjod pas go ba/ lha bu/ dod che mtha' gzhung du mar bsten nas shes thub/ dper na/ 'jig rten khams kyi mirigs yongs rdzogs kyi lo rgyus/ deb ther mang bor ma bltas na/ rtog par mi 'gyur ba/ lha bu'o/ /don 'a ltos bcas su spyi dang bye brag gi khyad bar yod/srog chags zhes pa don spyi yin pa/ de la 'grob rigs drug༄ bye'u 'ba' 'bu yongs rdzogs 'dus yod pa las/ mi ni don bye brag pa zhig yin/ yang /mi'i 'gro ba ni smra shes shing don go ba bzo nus la spyi la khyab phas/ bod di 85

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mjin sgyung de'i bye brag pa yin no/ 1mi zhes pa don spyir bzhag na/ de las skyes pho mo dang / zan gzhon byis pa dmas bye brag pa yin no1 /don la yongs su grags pa dang brga la nyal ba'i khyad par yod de/ sangs rgyas kyi chos lugs dad mo ba phal cher gyis shes pa yongs grags yin la/ rtsa rlung bsgoms nas rdzu 'phrul thob pa mngon sum yin yang / deng gi tshan rig sgo nas rigs par smra ba'i tshod mi lon pa gsang ba'i gnas yin/ de lugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbang gis/ blun dad du kha tshon bcad na/ kha tshon gcod mi rang blun po yin srid/ sa paṇa gyis grun po smra ba nyung na mdzes/ /zhes bsgos pa don che'o1 /rang myor can na rig pa rgod/ /sbyangs pa zab na rtogs pa che/ rtsa rlung gi rig pa grub chen rnams la yongs grags yin yang / skyes du phal la lkog gyur yin no/ /don rtogs pa la rgya che chung dang gting zab nye'i khyad par che ste/ slob chung bas dam dbye tshig phrad kyi thob thang shes kyang ci phyir 'jug pa mi shes/slob 'bring bas sum rtags kyi gzhung lubs rags pa tsam shes kyang / rtags 'jug gi dka' gnad sogs kyi brdar sha chod dka'/ slob chen pas sum rtags las 'phros pa'i dag yig rig pa dang / sdeb sbyor rig pa dag rtog par 'gyur dka'o/ /shes bya'i gnas la mtha' med pas/ /nga rgyal rang nyid rtod thag yin/ /don gang rung legs par rtogs pa'i 'jug sgo bslab pa dang sbyang ba gnyis las med/ gnas lugs rtogs na shes rab thob pa yin/ 14kyi

yi ge 'jug pa'i bams brgyad dang chom lnga 'jug thabs thes na 'a ga —bde nyan pa yin/ /gong du bzad pa mdor bsdus na/ don sna tshogs kyi rgo brda sprod nga skad cha yin/ ska da cha'i gzhi ma sems can du ston pa'i sgra yin1 sgra'i thung mtha' tha snyad las / ming phrad thams cad 'dus yod1 tshib gi sgrub byed btso bo ming dang phal ba phrad yin/ mtshan ma phrad kyi rjes mthun yin/ yi ge spyir btang sgra gzugs don gsum gyi 'dus ma yin pas/ sna skad sogs gnas brgyad la 'jug pa'o/ /don tshan gnyis pa/ brda don gsal ba'i chos lnga/yi ge gnas brgyad du ji lhar 'jug ce na/ sgra gzugs don gsum gcig tu bsres nas 'dzin pa'i blo'i dbang gis 'jug par byed pa yin/di blo de skye ba la yab / brda byed pa'i dus su/ shes ba gzhan las khyad par 'byed pa'i chos lnga dang ldan pa zhig dgos te1 don la dmigs pa dang / sgra las byung ba dang / thun mong du grags pa dang / mthun par snang ba dang / mngon par zhen pa rnams/ mtshan gzhi me la sbyar nas mdor bstan na/dod la dmigs pa ni/ shes bya'i don spyi yid la 'char bar byed pa ste/ 'bar ba can la dmigs pas na/ tsha zhing sreg pa'i don spyi rtogs pa'o/ /sgra las byung ba ni/ rjod pa'i sgra spyi ngag las sgyung ba ste/ sems la shar 87

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /ba'i sreg za gzhan la go bar 'jug ched/ me/ zhes brjod pa'o/ /thun mong du grags pa ni/ sgra'i grags tshul rnam pa gcig pa ste/ me/ zhes grags pa'i sgra'i rnam pa1 mchu btsum zhing sna sgra dang bcas te nga ro gyen du bsgrongs pa'o/ /mthun par snang ba ni/ tshig shul gyi don mi kun gyi blo ngor snang ba khyad par med pa ste/ me/ zhes grags pa/ kun gyi snang ngor shar ba/ tsha zhing sreg pa nyid do/ / mngon par zhen pa ni/ sngar shes pa phyis su dran pa ste/ me/ zhes pa'i ming dang / sreg za/ zhes pa'i ming can gnyis kyi 'brel ba/ sngon chad yid la mngon sum du byur yod pas— da lha brda byed pa'i tshe— tshul de bzhin 'bad med du zhen pa skye'o/ /chos lnga bo phan tshun brten cing 'brel nas grub yod pas/ yan lag gcig chad kyang don gsal bar mi 'gyur/ rig pa skyed pa'i thog mar/ de dag gi 'grel ba legs par shes dgos/dang bo/ don la dmigs pa dang sgra las byung ba'i 'brel ba/don la dmigs pa yang sgra las byung ba zhig dgos/ gzugs la yi ge nyid du zhen pas na/ glegs bam du bris pa la brjod pa'i yul byed pa yin/88

yi ge 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad dang chos lnga/yi ge du ma 'dus pa'i ming dang / ming du ma 'dus pa'i tshig gi sgra la brten nas don go bar byed pas/ sgra shes na don la mi rtsongs zer/ don la dmigs pa'i tshe/ phal cher ni dang bo'i don mthong nas de'i rnam pa skye la/ skyes kyang de'i ming ma shes na/ brda mi 'phrod pas/ thog mar ming can de'i ming blo la nges dgos/ dngos po gsar du byung ba zhig yin na/ de la ming gi tha snyad ma btags na/ brjod par mi rung / ming du gdags pa yang / phal cher 'dod rgyal gyi ming la brten dgos/ 'dod rgyal gyi ming la/ rang dang 'brel ba'i ming sna tshogs skyed pa'i nus pa yod pas/ de la brten nas ming gang 'tsham zhig btags na/ ming can de go bar 'byur ro/ /ming la don gyi ngo bo ston pa'i nus pa yod pa'i phyir na/ sgra las byung ba'i skad cha la brten nas bsam blo gtong dgos pa yin/ go brda byed pa'i skad cha legs par ma shes na/ dod la dmigs pa yang gsal bar mi bgyur ro/ /gnyis pa/ sgra las byung ba dang thun mong du grags pa'i 'grel ba/sgra las byung ba yang thun mong du grags pa zhig dgos/ dod gyi ngo bo ston pa ming dang / de yi khyad par ston pa tshig sogs sgra las byung ba/ thun yong du grags pa ma yin na1 phan tshun go brda mi 'grod/ skad rib/sa gang gis khyab pa'i spyi tshogs der/ ming gi 'bod tshul dang / tshig gi rjod tshul la/ ma bgros 89

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung rang mthun du grub pa'i spyi tshogs kyi nus pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /yu za gru zhig tu sgra las byung ba thun mong du grags pa yin yang / yul skad kho dar grags pa'i tha snyad de rnams/ mi rigs rang gi gang zag phal mo ches go dka' bas/ sngon byon mkhas chen dam pa rnam pas/ rtsom du yul skad ma sre zer nas brna na pa yin/ skad rigs ma gcig na/ thun mong du grags pa min pa'i sgra las byung yang / don gyis stongs pa yin no/ /go brda 'phrod dgos na/ skad rigs de dang de rjod byed kyi yi ge bslabs nas shes dgos/ yang da lo tsā ba la brten dgos so/ /tshig gi sgrub byed ming yin te/ ming brjod pa'i sgra ma dag na/ glo bur du nyan mi shes pa'am/ nyan log 'byung nyen yod pas/ thun mong du grags pa yang / sgra'i zur ma chag par dag cha 'thon par bya dgos/ thun mong du grags pa'i ming ni/ mthun snang du grub pa yin pa'i dbang gis/ yun ring bor gtan chags pa'i nus pa yod pas rgyun 'khyongs na/ skad rigs spyi la phan thogs/ ming can gang gi ming ma shes pa/ dag yig gi gzhung du mi 'tshol ba'am gzhan la mi dri bar/ rang bzo byas pa thud mong du grags pa ma yin pas sus shes/—ming du tags pa/ 'bod sla dang / sdeb legs pa dang /kha gsal ba zhig yin na/ chu jigs rgya mtshor 'dres pa bzhin du gyur 'gro/ de lhar min na zu la zal bsres pa bzhin du log 'gro/ sgos su deng skabs kha cig bzo bcos byed par dga'/ dper na/ yon tan can la shes yon can/90

yi ge 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad dang chos lnga/mtshan nyid rig pa la sher rtogs rig pa/ thag gcod pa la thag gcod byed pa/ dar rgyas la dar spel dga' 'dun la mnyam spro'i tshogs 'du/ 'grul rgya la nyen zon dam bsgrags khrims/ zong bkram pa la khrom 'don pa la sogs par byas pa/bod skad kyi chu rgyun dwangs mo bsnyogs pa las phan pa ci mchis/ma dag rgyun 'byams 8di rigs bod skad nyams byed yin pas/ blo ldan mi rnam pas shes rab kyi ral gri thogs nas myur du tshar gcod pa gal che gal che/shin tu gal che'o /gsum pa/ thun mong du grags pa dang mthun par snang ba'i 'brel ba/thun mong du grags pa yang mthun par snang ba zhig dgos sgra thos na dmigs pa don la dmigs pa yin/ mthun par snang ba'i ming can gyi gzugs dang / khyad chos dang / reg bya sogs kyi khyad bar/ thun mong du grags pa'i sgra las go ba yin/ sgra ma dag na mthun snang du mi 'gyur/ dper na/ rgo ba/ zhes pa/ go bar grags na/ sgra'i dam pa rtse rtse 'dar ba'i zur ma thon pa'i rkyen gyis/ rin gas shig tu mi go bar/ shes pa'i don du go 'gro/tshig sbyor ma dag na yang / mthun snang du mi 'grub/ dper na dbul ba 'joms pa'i thabs btsal/zhes pa las dbul ba la dbul bo zhes sbyar na/bshad pa bos rgyu btsal ba'i don bstan kyang / nyan pa bo'i snang ngor med po 91

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung /gsod pa'i don du shar 'gro/ sdong bu 'dzugs/ zhes par/ sdong bu la 'dzugs/zhes brjod pa na/ tshang ma'i mthun snang du sdong du gzug bya min gyi gzug yul yin pas/ sdong du sa la 'dzugs pa'i don du mi go ste/ sdong bu'i gzhi la mdung lha bus 'dzugs pa'i don du rtogs 'gro'o/ /sgra ma dag na ming gi mtshan nyid nyams pa dang / tshig ma dag na don du ji bzhin mi 'byor bas/dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho mchog gis/ tshig gi dag chas don gyi gnad 'byin cing / /don gyi go bas tshig gi dag thon pa/ /de dag mtshon byed ri mo'i rig byed de/ /phra zhib yig gzugs thon par shin tu gces/ /zhes zhal ta gnangs pa'o/ /bzhi ba/ mthun par snad ba dang mngon par zhen pa'i 'brel ba/ mthun par snang ba yang mngon par zhen pa zhig dgos/ rang rtsong cad na rig pa rgod zer ba bzhin/ mthun par snang ba gang ci/— rang gi 'tsho ba dang lag len du brgyud myong ba dngad yang na gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos sogs rang gi dbang bo drug gi spyod rkul du—'byung myong ba zhig yin dgos/myong cha bod pa gang rung brda byed pa'i dus na/ gang 'brel gyi ming dang tshig gi dam pa las/ don de nyid du mngon par zhen pa skye'o/ /kha cig ni dang bo ming gi sgra tsam thos pa lag dbang bo dag gi spyod yul du ma sgyur pas/ zhen 92

yi ge 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad dang chos lnga/pa rags pa tsam las mi skye'o/ /sngon chad go ma myong ba'am/ bag la zha ba gang zhig yin na/ don spyi'i dam pa mthun snang du rag las pa med pas 'brel ba'i yul ma yin zhes/ mngon zhen skye ba'i gzhi dang bral lo/ /lnga ba/ mngon kar zhen pa dang don la dmigs pa'i 'brel ba/mngon par zhen pa yang don la dmigs pa zhig dgos/ ming dang ming can 'brel bar byed pa/ sgra la brten nas don la dmigs pa yin/ sgra'i dam pa yi ge'i rdom par bkod pa las/ don gyi dam pa nyid du mngon par zhen pa skyes pa yin pas/ spru ba bos don ston par smra bar byed pa yin la/nyan pa bo brda la byang ba dag gis sgra la brten nas/ don khong du chud pa yin mod/ rig gnas gang zhig mi shes pa'i blun bos/ rig gnas de'i don la zhen pa skye rgyu med pa ni/ thog mar don las dmigs pa yin/ rig gnas gang zhig don du dmigs tsho/ bslab la zhugs dgos/ bstan bcos de'i brda chad dang / rtsa tshig dang / spyir btang gi bshad tshul rags pa tsam shes thog gzhung lugs rgya che zhing gnying zab par bslabs na/ mngon par zhen pa skyes nas/ sbyangs stobs kyi yon tan mnga' brnyes par 'gyur ro/ /'chad rtsod rtsom gsum mam tshan rig lag rtsal rtsamakhas pa'i go 'phang 'thob dgos na/ rigs lam dam par zud pa'i rnam dpyod dang / gzhung lugs 93

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /gdams par shar ba'i nyams len dgos/chos lnga'i bshad pa 'dis mkhas pa'i 'jug sgo bstan pa yin te/ rig pa bskyed pa'i go rim ni/ go sla ba nas dka' ba dang / dog pa nas yangs pa dang / nye ba nas zab par 'jug dgos pa yin/ yang na/ lag len nas gzhung lugs dang — gzhung lugs nas lag len lhar yang yang bskyar nas chos kyi de nyid rtog par bya dgos pa yin/ bslab la 'jug par/ bdag pas gzhan gces kyi bsam pa rgyud la bcangs na/ dka' ba brgya phrag khyad du gsad pa'i dpa' bskyed thub pas/ gzhan dag tshar gcad rjes gzung dang /kun shes gnas lnga rtogs pa'i mkhas chen nyan/chos lnga'i rnam bshad mdor bsdus na/ /don la dmigs pa sgra las byung / /sgra las thun mong grags pa mchog /mchog nyid mthun par snang ba ste/ /mthun snang mngon par zhen pa skye /chos lnga'i gzhi ma ming la ni/ /ngo bo ston pa'i nus pa gcig /mthun grags spyi tshogs nus pa gnyis/ /rgyun tshags skad kyi nus pa gsum /94
sga da na pa sgro

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung /sde tshan bzhi ba/ yi ge'i dag za gdon pa'i man ngagadangos po ji snyed shes byed ming gi ni/ /ming gzhi dbyangs dang mgo 'dogs 'phul rten gyi/ /sgra zur gang yang legs par 'don mkhas pa/ /yi ge dag par spyar ba'i man ngag yin/ /don tshan dang bo/ yi ge'i dag cha sgra la rag las/yi ge bris pa rab yin na/ dag snyoms mdzes gsum dang ldan pa zhig dgos/ de la stoms cha dang mdzes cha de 'dra ma thon na'ang drag dag cha ma thon na skyon che ste/ don nyams pa'i phyir ro1 /deb na dag snyoms mdzes gsum las/ dag pa gtso bo yin/ dag cha gcigs su ma bzung na/ brda krod pa'i go legs par mi chod do/ /yi ge'i dag cha 'don pa/ sgra gzugs don gsum rten cing 'brel ba'i 'byung tshul la rag las/ yi ge'i gzugs kyi rnam pa ji lha ba las/ sgra'i rnam pa ji lha ba bzhin du shes pa dang / sgra'i dam pa ji lha ba las/don gyi rnam pa ji lha ba bzhin du rtogs pa'o/ /brjod bya'i don yi ger phab na yang / sgra la bstun dgos pas/ yi ge'i dag cha mthar gtugs na/ sgra la thug yod/ thog mar sgra la mkhas pa yis1/ /tshig don rnam par zus te bstan/ /de 96

yi ge'i dag gdonaXpa'i man ngaganas don la mkhas pa yis/ 1lhag chad 'khrul ba med par bshad/ /(snyan 'grel da ngas ban dgyes glu las)ces pas gsal/ming phrad rtsom pa'i gzhir rtser pa'i skad kyi gdangs ni dbyab4 gsal yin pas na/ yi ge sbyor klog can gang yang sgra las byung ba gon ma chag de phyir mags 'jug gi rtsa ba las/ yi ge'i khongs das mir phyung nas/ /ming gi khongs nas tshig dbyung ste/ /tshig gis don kams ston par sted/ /ces gsungs pa lags/ yi ge sgra la brten nas byung ba yin pas/ yi ge dag dgos na/ thog mar sgra dag dgos/ sgra'i rnam pa kho bka res don gyi ngo bo46thag re ston pa 'di ni/ spyi tshogs hril bos ma bgros rang mthun— gyi chos nyid cig yin pas/ sems can du ston pa'i sgra la spyi tshog4kyi rang bzhin yod/ ji tshogs kyi rang bzhin 'di brda sprod pa'i sbol zhig tu chags snang / su zhig thun mong du grags pa dang mthun par snang ba'i spyi tshogs kṣa chos nyid 'di dang 'gal nas/ tha snyad gang zung gi sgra'i dam gzhad zhig tu sgyur pa'am/sgra de la don gzhan zhig sbyar nas bshad na/ 'jig rten pas de bzhin du go bar mi 'byur bas/ brda krod pa'i nus pa nyams 'gro/ sgra'i dam pa so sor dbye ba'i zhib cha lhag par gas na/ don gyi ngo bo'i dbye ba sna tshogs dang / don gyi khyad par sna tshogs ston pa'i tha snyad lhag par 'byor— tha snyad lhag par 'byor na/ skad cha lhag pa phun sum tshogs pa yin/97

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon jing /'di ni sgra rig pa'i dan rtags shig yin/ skad rigs gang zhig dar rgyas phun sum tshogs pa yin min gyi dpyad gzhi yang 'di kho na yin no/ /bod skad kyi sgra la drag zhan bar ma'i khyad par dang 1 snyi yang gi khyad par dang / rkyang sprags kyi khyad par dang / 'phul rten sogs kyi khyad par yod pa ma zad/ sgra'i nga ro la drang ba/ bkug pa/ sgrong ba/ bstod pa/ smad pa dang bcas pa'i khyad par yod pas na/ sgra'i dam dbye ku sha'i rtse lhar phra ba dang / spu ris ma 'dres par so sor snang ba'i stobs kyis/ rngod byed kyi sgra tsheg dbar re sgrags na yang /brjod bya'i don de nyid bde blag tu go ba yin/ dper na/ nga / zhe na lce rtsa rkan phugs la spyar ba las/ kho bo dang / rnga/ zhe na lce rtse 'dar ba'i khyad pa las/ rol mo'i rigs shig dang / lnga/ zhe na rtse'i snga so rkan la sbyar ba'i khyad par las/ grangs kyi bye brag dang / snga/ zhe na rlung rtse rtse dang so bar las rgyung ba'i khyad par gyis/ phyis kyi log pa yin pa bde blag tu shes pa ni/ sgra'i rnam dbye gsal ba'i phyir ro/ /gal srid sgra 'di bzhi bo ming gzhi'i sgra tsam las1mgo can gsum gyi zur ma thon na/ sgra'i rnam dbye'i zhib cha nyams par gyur pas/ de lhar go mi dpe'o/ /yang / dus kyi rnam bzhag tsam la dper na/'don/ zhe na sna sgra dang ldan zhing zhan par grags pas/ da lha ba dang / gdon/zhe na mgrin pa'i sgra dang ldan zhing ran par grags pas/ ma 'ongs pa dang /bton/ ce na mchu sgra dang ldan zhing drag par grags pas/ 'das pa dang /98

—— yina'i dag bdon pa'i man ngagazond/ ce na so sgra dang ldan zhing ran pa nas drag par gyur pas/ skul tsheg —yin par shes so/ /brjod pa ma dag na/ tha snyad 'ga' re'i sgra nye ba'i dbang gis nya nyung mnyam bsres su gyur nas/ so so'i don bde blag tu go bar mi 'gyur/ dpen na/ zhwa mo/ sha mo/ bya mo gsum gyi sgra'i zur ma thon na/ nyan mkhan la go log 'byung srid do/ /don tshan gnyis pa/ sgra dag bar sbyor ba/tshig brgyad brgya bshad na mdo —zhig dgos/ chu nyog pa brgal na rab cig dgos/ sgra dag par sbyor ba ni1 yi ge'i sbyor ba dag par byed pa'i thabs dam pa zhig yin/ mgo 'dogs 'phul rten so sor 'jug pa bzhi re yod pa/sum rtags kyi gzhung noms las/ gang la 'jug pa dang / gang gis 'jug pa gnyis rnam par gsal bas/ 'dir ngal ba'i dgos pa med mod— ji lhar 'jug pa dang / ci phyir 'jug pa gnyis/ khebs rgya dang zhib cha de 'dra thon med pas/ skye bo phal bas de dag la brten nas yi ge'i dag cha gdon par gnad mi zin sa yod pas/ gal bo che la nan tan gyi tshul du/ ci phyir 'jug pa'i don 'byung 'gyur skabs su bshad bar bya'o/ /ji ltar 'jug pa'i tshul skabs 'dir don tshan bzhir bsdus nas kro bar bya'o/ /dang bo/ yi ge bskyed pa'i rgyu/yi ge ni ming phrad rtsom pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i skad kyi gdangs yin pas/99

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon rgyung /de bskyed pa'i rgyu la/ gnas dang / byed pa dang / rlung dang / rnam rtog bzhi yod1 skye gnas ni brtan pa'i cha ste/ rtsa ba'i rgyu yin/ de la mgrin pa sna dang spyi bo'i kad pa'i spubs gsum ni dog pa'i gnas dang / khog rkan rtse so mchu lnga ni yangs pa'i gnas te/ sgra'i 'byung gnas brgyad pod/ byed pa ni rtsol ba'i cha ste/ 'byin pa'i rgyu yin/ de la gtso bo lce ste/ lce'i rtsa rtse dbus mtha' sogs 'dus yod/ de das mchu dang mgrin pa dag yod/ de dag gnas noms la phrad pa dang — cung zad phrad pa dang / btsum pa dang / zu ba dang /dog pa dang / yangs par byed pa ste/ sgra'i skyed byed drug yod/ nom rtog ni brjod 'dod kyi cha ste/ skul ba'i rgyu yin/ sgra ni brjod 'dod rjes 'brang ste/rnam par rtog pas yi ge'i rnam pa shar ba'o/ /rlung ni g.yo ba'i cha ste/ skyod pa'i rgyu yin1 rlung g.yos pa dang / byed pa gdas dang phrad pa 'i rtsol ba las/yi ge so so'i gdangs rnams skye ba yin/ mdor na/ yi ge'i rgyu ni ji ltar byed ce na/ /rnam par rtogs pas sgra yi dam pa shar/ /rlung ni g.yo zhing byed pa gnas dang phrad/ /yi ge so so'i gdangs dmas skye ba 'o/ /gnyis pa/ rtags kyi dbye ba/dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi rtags kyi dbye ba ni/ byed rtsol dam lhod dang 1 dam 'gyur gsal min la rag las/ gnas dang byed pa'i dam 'gyur mi gsal zhing / sgra tsam shas che la lhod pa rnams dbyangs te mo yig dang /100

yi ge'i dag cha gdon pa'i man ngagaganas dang byed pa'i rnam 'gyur gsal zhing / dam pa'am cung zad dam pa rnams gsal byed de pho yig yin no/ /dbyangs gsal gyi rtags kyi khyad par shes na/ kha cig gis ga ja da ba rnams la legs sbyar gyi sgra lhar/ 'ga' 'ja' 'da' 'ba' zer nas 'don pa ni ma dag pa ste/ gang yin la 'gang yin dang / ja 'thung la 'ja' 'thung zhes mi zer bas gsal/ gsal byed rnams ming gzhir zhugs tshe/ nga ro rtsa ba can ba ha 'a gsum gyis rnam par 'dren pa la/ sgra'i gzhi rlung shugs 'byung ba'i gnas kyi rtsa ba khog pa dang mgrin pa gnyis las/ mgrin pa btsums shing dog par byas nas stod du shugs bskyed de gdon pa'i yi ge'i rtsa ba a yig dang / khog pa nas shugs bskyed de gdon pa'i yi ge'i rtsa ba ni ha yig dang / mgrin pa phyes shing yangs par byas nas smad du shugs bskyed de gdon pa'i yi ge'i rtsa nga ni 'a yig go/de la ba yig gi sgra'i cha dang ldan par mgrin pa btsums shing dog par byas nas/ rlung shugs stod du che bar bskyed de sgra drag pa'i tshul gyis gdon pa'i yi ge ka ca ta pa tsa lnga bo ni pho yig da nga / ha yig gi sgra'i cha dang ldan par khog pa nas rlung shugs ran par bskyed de/ sgra ran pa'i tshul gyis gdon ba'i yi ge kha cha tha pha tsha lnga bo di ma ning dang / 'a yig gi sgra'i za dang ldan par mgrin pa zus shing yangs par byas nas/ rlung shugs chung ba smad du bskyed de sgra zhan pa'i tshul gyis gdon pa'i yi ge ga sogs lhag ma nyi shu bo mo yig yin 101

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyungadapa/ a ni dbyangs gsal gnyis su gtogs pas mtshan med ces kyang bya'o/ /mo yig rnams las/ rlung shugs phra mo sna nas drangs shing sgra shin tu zhan pa'i tshul gyis gdon pa'i yi ge nga nya da ma bzhi bo shin tu mo dang / rlung shugs mgrin pa 'i smad du glod cing sgra ches zhan pa'i tshul gyis gdon pa'i yi ge ra la ha gsum po mo gsham yin no/ /ming gzhir song ba'i yi ger po mo ma ning gi rtags kyi dbye ba mdzad pa ni/ sgra drag zhan bar ma'i khyad par gsal bar byed pa yin te/ byed pa gnas la dam par sbyar cing rlung shugs che bar bskyed pa ni/ sgra drag pa ste pho yig gi khyad chos dang / byed pa gnas la ran par sbyar cing rlung shugs bar mar bskyed pa ni/ sgra ran pa ste ma ning gi khyad chos dang / byed pa gnas la lhod par sbyar cing rlung shugs chung bar bskyed pa ni/ sgra zhan ba ste mo yig gi khyad chos yin no/ /khyad chos 'di sum khong du chud na/ rtags 'jug gi dbang 'byor bas/ yi ge'i dag cha rang shugs su thon 'gro/ dper na/ ko ba dang /go ba gnyis ka'i sgra la drag zhan gyi dbye ba yod par brten nas/ snga ma zog gi ko ba dang / pyi ma sems kyi go bar nges pa dang / cong dang / rgyang gi 'jug yul la rmongs na/ sgra la brtags tshe/ cob ni rtse'i skod pa yan chad rkan la dam por sbyar ba'i sgra drag pa las brdung bya'i cong dang / lhong ni lce'i sked pa mad chad rkan phugs la lhod par sbyar ba'i sgra zhan pa las gud pa'i lhong yin 102

yi ge'i dag gdon pa'i mnaragapar nges so/ /rang gi sgra mi dag na/ rtags 'jug gi ku rig pa lhar spyong bar byas sa dab par 'byur ro/ /yang / skabs 'di'i dbugs la dbugs mi zer bar/ rlung zer dod ci yin zhe na/ rlung zhi ba la dbugs dang / dbugs g.yo ba la rlung / zhes pa lhar/ 'byin rdub rgyun dang ldan par dbugs dang / sgra skyed byed kyi yo byad du 'jug par rlung zer ba yid/ rlung dang dbugs kyi byed las mi gcig pas/sgra rig pa las brda chad so sor mdzad pa yin no1 /gsum pa/ mgo 'dogs 'phul rten gyi 'jug tshul/yi ge'i sbyor ba ni/ ming gzhi dang / dbyangs dang / mgo 'dogs 'phul rten ci rigs dag sbyar nas/ ming sna tshogs 'grub par byed pa yin te/ ming du gdags par ma mdzad na/ /'jig rten thams cad rmongs par 'gyur/ /de bas rngongs pa sel ba'i phyir/ /mgon pos ming du gdags par mdzad/ /(lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo las)ces dang / ming tshig gsal ba med na ni/ /don rnams brngod par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ltar sgyur na 'jig rten na/ /don mtshon brjod pa kun kyang med/ /(rtags 'jug gi rtsa ba las)ces gsungs pa bzhin/khams gsum du dngos po rnam pa sna tshogs yod pa/ de re re'i ngos 'dzin par tha snyad re gdags dgos/ tha snyad la brten nas don gyi ngo bo dang khyad par ston par byed pa yin/ tha snyad gang mang sgra'i rnam pa so so bas grub pa 103

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngod snang —yin pas/ yi ge'i sbyor ba las/ ming gzhi 'a dbyangs dang mgo 'dogs 'phul rten ci rigs dag sbyar nas/ tha snyad grang4kyis mi long ba byung ba yin1 sgra'i rnam dbye la brten nas/ yi ge 'byed chags pa du ma zhig ming zhig tu grub pa yin pas1 gang dang gang la gang btags pas /go rim bzhin du gnas nas dbyung 1 /(gser do— sum rtags las1zhes gsungs pa lhar/ ming gzhi dang yan lag dag gi sgra zur gang yang ma nyams par go rim bzhin lhan cig tu gdon pa ha cang kal che/ de lugs rtogs shing ngag tu byang bar byur na/ yi ge'i dag cha bang kas 'byung ngo / /da ni mgo 'dogs 'phul rten gyi sgra'i 'jug tshul rim pa bzhin du brjod par bya'o/ /mgo can ra la sa gsum rang rang gi 'jug yul la sbyar da1ming gzhi'i sgra rkyang ba sbrags ma dang rtsi bar byur 'gro ste/ ming gzhi pho yin na/sgra drag cing rtsi bar gyur pa dang / ming gzhi mo yin na/ sgra zhan zhing lci bar gyur pa yin/ mgo 'jog gsum la rtags kyi dbye ba med don/ ming gzhir sbyar tshe sgra cung zad rtsi bar byur pa ma gtogs/ za je drag gam nge zhan du gtong ba'i nus pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /mngo/ can gyi sgra grag tshul ni/ ra mgo lce rtse 'dar ba dngad /la ma so lce glod rgya yangs skyed/ /sa mgo so yi bar nas dbyung / /(gser tog sum rtags las)zhes pa lhar te/ dper da/ ra ni lce rtsa rkan phugs la sbyar ba'i sgra rkyang ba yin/ de la ra mgo sbyar na/ ming gzhi'i 104

yirga'i dag shad da pa'i man bgarang sgra so na gnas shing / ra mgo'i sgra zur byung da/ sgra 'dres mar byur pa ste/lcecu rlung gis bskyod nas cung tshad 'dar nas grags pa dang / de bzhin lnga ni rtse rtse dar lce rtsa rkan la sbyar cing / rlung lce mtha' gnyis das phyung bas grags pha dang / snga ni rtseXmatha' so la spyar cing rlud rtse dang so'i bar nas rgyung ste grags pa'o/ /ga na rnams kyang rigs bsgros nas shes par bgyi/ mgo can gsum gyi 'don tshul shes ka/ ming gzhi gar bar go 'jig yod med dang / don gang yin par nges za zin lo/ dper na/ tsi gu/ rtsi gu/ mdzu ku/rtsid su/ rtsib gu sogs rim pa bzhid du/ gyi ba/ rtsig pa chung chung / sor mo/re'u pho lo gnyis can/ khog pa'i logs gnyis kyi rus pa chung du yin pa lhar/ yi ge'i rnam pa 'khrul bshad par rang bab sa'i don la 'byor ro/ /'dogs cad ya ra la wa bzhi rang rang gi gdags gzhir btags na1'dogs dang ming gzhi sgra gcig tu 'dres pa las/ yongs rdzogs 'byur— ba dang / cung zad 'gyur ba dang / mi 'gyur ba ste kam pa gsum 'byung la/ ya btags can dang / ra btags can gyi sna ni yob4rdzogs 'gyur ba ste/ ra ngam rang gi ming gzhi'i sgra dang mi 'dra bar rnam pa gzhan zhig tu byur snang mod/ ming gzhi'i sgra zur nyams par 'jug mi nyan/ dbyangs bzhi dar 'di gnyis la du yig drug tu brtsis pa yang / 'di rnams ming gzhir spyar ba na/ming gzhi'i byed rtsol 'dzin pa las/ sgra yongs rdzogs 'gyur bar bltos pa 106

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon jing /yin/ la sta dang bzur gnyis bu yig tu ma brtsis pa ni/ de 'dra'i nus pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /la btags can gyi sgra ni cung zad 'gyur ba ste/ ming gzhi'i sgra cung zad 'dres nas/ la sta'i rang sgra gzu bor grags pa yin/'dogs can 'di gsum gyi ming gzhi'i sgra zur gdon pa ha cang gal che/dper na/ gra dra bra gsum klog dag na/ gra'i sgra mgrin pa las byung bas spu yi gra dang / dra'i sgra lce rtse las byung bas/ gcad pa'i dra'am snye po'i dra marang /bra'i sgra mchu las byung bas/ byi ba'i rigs kyi bra'am 'khru rigs kyi bra bo yin par shes la/ kla gla bla rla bzhi'i ming gzhi'i sgra zur thon na/ kla sgra mgrin pa dam zhing drag pa'i tshul gyis kla klo'i kla dang / gla sgra mgrin pa lhod cing zhan pa'i tshul gyis gla rtsi'i gla dang / bla sgra ma mchu ya sor sbyar pa'i tshul gyis bla ma'i bla dang / rla sgra lce rtse 'dar ba'i tshul gyis rla rmig(ma ning gi rtags)gi rla yin par shes 'gro'o/ / btags can gyi ming gzhi'i sgra la 'gyur ba med de/gcig tu/ ming gzhi gsal byed kyi rtags tsam dang / gnyis su/ ming gang dag sgra gcig kyang don mi gcig pa'i khyad par ston pa'i rtags tsam yin/dgas dang / rwags rto bu'i ya mtha'i da yig 'phul dang ming gzhi gang rung byas chog de la wa zur btags pa ming gzhi nges par byas pa yin/ khu tas kha yis shā ro'i sha tshil btog lha du'i kha dang ka/ sha dang sha'i sgra la khyad par med kyang / don mi gcig pa gsal byed du wa btags yod med gnyis su 106

ya kam dag gdon pa'i mad ngagamadzad pa yin/ yang / brda rnying du wa zur la lar 'o lha bu'i sgra 'byung rgyu yod pa shes dgos/ dper na/ ka ste la so ste dang / dwa phrug la do phrug ltar— 'don pa lha bu'o/ /sngon 'jug ga da ba ma 'a lnga bo ming gzhi dang phrad pa'i dbang gis/ sgra drag zhan bar mar gyur ba ltar/ ba pho ga da gnyis ma ning / /ra mo ma ni rgan tu mo/ —zhes rtags kyi dbye ba mdzad pa yin/ de rnams rang rang gi 'jug yul la sgra ji lhar byas nas 'jug pa yin 'i na/ pho ni drag pa'i tshul gyis te/ /ma ning ran par 'jug pa yin/ 1mo ni zhan pa'i tshul gyis te/ /shid tu mo ni mnyam pas so/ /zhes pa lhar/ sngon 'jug gi pho yig ba ni/ ma mchu gsor spyar nas byed rtsol drag pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa dang / ma ning gi ga yig ni/lce rtsa rkan phugs la sbyar nas byed rtsol ran pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa dang / ma ning gi da yig ni/ rtse rtse rkad la reg das byed rtsol ran pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa dang / mo yig 'a ni/ mgrin pa zus shing rlung shugs sna nas zhan par phyung ba'i tshul gyis 'jug pa dang / shin tu mo ma yig ni/ mchu btsums shing rlung shugs sna nas shin tu lhod par byung ba'i tshul gyis 'jug pa yin la/ bgad/gda'/ dga'/ 'ga'/ mgar lnga bo'i sngon 'jug gi sgra bshibs nas bsdur na khyad par gsal te/ dang bo'i thog mar bu sgra grags pa/ gnyis pa'i thog mar kag sgra grags pa/ gsum pa'i thog mar mad sgra grags byo/ bzhi ba'i thog 107

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /mar 'ang sgra grags pa/ lnga ba'i thog mar 'um sgra grags pa lha bu'o/ /de lugs legs par rtogs na/ ming gang la sngon 'jug yod med dang / yod na gang yin pa'i nges pa 'drong ngo / 1sngon 'jug lnga bo'i 'don tshul mdor na/ bas 'phul so mchu reg pa las/ /gas 'phul gre ba'i phugs nas dbyung / /das 'phul lce rtse rkan la reg /'a zus ma btsums gnyis ka sna'o/ /rjes 'jug bcu bo ming gzhi gang rung gi rjes su 'jug pa'i tshe/ ga da ba sa bzhi bo sgra drag par gyur pas pho dang / nga ma 'a gsum sgra zhan par gyur pas mo dang 1 na ra la gsum sgra ran par byur pas ma ning yin no/ /de rnams kyi klog tshul ni/pho ni drag pa'i tshul byas nas/ /ga mtha' mgrid pa btsum pas dbyung / /da mtha' lce rtses rtsar sbyar/ /ba mtha' so mchu reg pa las/ /sa mtha' so yi bar nas dbyung / 1mo ni zhan pa'i tshul byas nas/ /nga mtha' lce rtsa rkan sbyar cing / /ma mtha' mchu btsum sna nas phyung / /'a mtha' gre ba'i phugs nas dbyung / /108

yi ge'i dag cha gdon pa'i man bgam ning ran pa'i tshul byas nas/ /na mtha' lce rtse so rtsar gtug /rlung shugs sna nas drang bar bya/ /ra mtha' lho rtse 'dar ba dang / /la mtha' lho rtse rkan la spyar/ /lho mtha' gnyis nas rlung phyir gdon/ /de lugs legs par shes na/ ming gzhi gang gi rjes 'jug gang yin 'khrul dogs med de/ dper na/ gad/ gal/ gan gsum las/ sgra mtha' rtse 'dabs so rtsar sbyar nas rlung sna khung dang so srubs nas phyir mi 'thon pa'i khyad chos las/ ga'i rjes 'jugs dag dang lce'i rtse mo so dang rtsa ba rkan la sbyar nas rlung lho mtha' gnyis nas phyir thon pa'i khyad chos las/ ga'i rjes 'jug la dang /lce rtse so rtsar sbyar nas rlung sna nas thon pa'i khyad chos las/ ga'i rjes 'jug na yin par nges so/ /yang 'jug da sa gnyis rang rang gi rjeb 'jug rnams la 'jug pa'i tshe/sgra drag par gyur pas pho yin no/ /rjes 'jug rnams la yang 'jug zhugasayod med kyi sgra'i klog tshul brgyad du gyur pa las/pho la skyes du rab 'bring gsum/ /ga mtha' sa sbyar skyes bu rab/ /109

dag yib rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyungadrag pa'i drag par 'don pa yin/ /ba mtha' sa sbyar skyes bu 'bring / /drag pa'i ran par bklag par bya/ /yang 'jug med pa pho mtha' ni/ /drag pa'i zhan par brjod pa'o/ /mo la mo dang shin tu mo— / —nga mar sa sbyar mo tsam ni/ / zhan pa'i drag par 'don pa dang / /sa mtha' med pa shin tu mo/ / zhan pa'i zhan par brngod pa'o/ /ma ning 'gyur dang mtshan nyid dang / /mtshan med ma ning gsum du dbye//yang 'jug yod dang med kyang rung / /pho dang phrad na drag par 'gyur/ / bar ma'i drag par 'dod pa dang / /drag med mo phrad zhan par 'gyur/ /bar ma'i zhan par brngod pa ste/ /de gnyis 'gyur ba ma ning zer/ —110

yi ge'i dag gdon pa'i man ngagayang 'jug ldan pa mo dang phrad/ /drag zhan gnyis ka'i za ldan pas/ /mtshan gnyis ma ning zhes bya tshe /zhan nas drag par gdon par bya/ /da drag yod dam med kyang rung / /ma ning rang dang phrad pa na/ /bar ma tsam du klog pa ste/ /mtshan med ma ning zhes bya'o/ /de lhar klog pa'i zur pyin pa na/ yang 'jug yod med shes sla/ dper na/yongs/ zhes pa'i rjes 'jug nga ni mgrin pa slod cing rlung sna nas phyung ba dang sprugs/ sa mtha'i dbang gis kha gdangs pa cung zad dam par bsgyungs pas/ sgra zhan pa cung zad drag par 'gyur ba dang / bsgyurd/ ces pa'i rjes 'jug ra lce rtse 'dar ba dang sbrags/ da mtha'i dbang gis lce mtha' so rtsar sbyar nas 'dar mtshams chod cing / sgra ran pa nas drag par 'gyur ba gsal/de bzhin gzhan rnams kyang rigs bsgros nas shes par gyis shigadabyangs yig ma i u e o rnams ni/ sgra'i nga ro drang ba/ bkug pa/smad pa/ sgrong ba/ bstod pa lnga yin te ming gzhi rkyang brtsegs ci rigs la 'phul rten yod med gang yin rung / gug gyed med pa dmas la sa'i dbyangs 111

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung 1zhugs yod pas/ dbyangs kyi nga ro drang ba snye/ sgra 'phang mtho dman 'khyog gsum med par drang nger mnyam pa'i tshul gyis sgrog pa'o/ /de bzhin gug gu can ji snyed pa/ dbyangs kyi nga ro bkug pa ste/ sgra spyi bo'i spubs kyi cha nas thur du cung zad phab nas/ slar gyen du bkyags te༄khyog pa'i tshul gyis sgrog pa'o/ /zhabs kyu can ji snyed pa dbyabs kyi nga ro smad pa ste/ sgra 'phang mar la phab nas gzhol ba'i tshul gyis sgrog pa'o/ /'greng bu can ji snyid pa dbyangs kyi nga ro sgrong ba ste/ sgra 'phang gyen du bkyags nas spar ba'i tshul gyis sgrog pa'o/ /na ro can ji snyed pa dbyangs kyi nga ro bstod nas mtho la mnyam pa'i tshul gyi se sgrob pa'o1 /dbyangs yig de rnams kyi nga ro 'dren tshul legs par rgos na/ ming gzhi gang la dbyangs gang zhugs pa 'khrul dogs mi 'byung /thag thig thug theg thog rnam pa lnga la dpe blangs na/ ming gzhi tha yi byed rtsol gzhir bzhag thog sa'i dbyangs dang rjes 'jug ga'i sgra 'dres pa'i dbang gis/ sgra mtha' ag ces grags pa dang / i'i dbyangs dang rjes 'jug ga'i gdangs 'dres ba 'i dbang gis/ sgra mtha' ig ces grags pa dang / u'i dbyangs dang ga'i gdangs 'dres ba'i dbang gis/ sgra mtha' ug ces grags pa dang / e'i dbyangs dang ba'i gdangs 'dres pa'i dbang gis/sgra mtha' eg ces grags pa dang / lo'i dbyangs dang ga'i gdangs 'dres pa'i dbang gis/ mi mtha' o gces grags pa'o/ /de bzhin yi ge'i tshogs pa 112

yi ge'i dag gdon pa'i mad ngagagang dang gang gi bsgrigs rim lhar/ sgra zur gang yang 'thod par byas nas sbyangs pa 'byongs na/ sgra'i spyor ba klog dag pa'i sgo nas/ yi ge tshogs pa'i yan lag lhag chad 'khrul ba med par bris dag pa'i nus pa 'byung ngo / /gzhan yang / da dus skad du sngon 'jug dang mgo can rnams kyi sgra'i zur phal cher nyams par gyur pa'i dbang gis/ sgra'i nga ro'i dbye ba sngon par gsal ba dang / am skad du mgo 'dogs 'phul rten rnams kyi sgra'i zur ma nyams par ji bzhin thon cing sgra du ma 'dus pa'i dbang gis— sgra'i nga ro dbus skad de bzhin mi gsal bar brten nas/ mi rigs gzhan pa'i brda sprod smra ba kha cig gis/ dbus skad la sgra'i nga ro yod zer ba bden mod/am skad la sgra'i nga ro med zer ba 'phyugs snang / kho tshos am skad kyi sngon 'jug mgo can/ 'dogs can ming gzhi dang bcas pa'i sgra dag par mi ldob pa'i rkyen kyis1 am skad gyi sgra 'dus ma'i zhib cha rnam par ma zud pa'i blun bshad nyid de/ am skad la sgra'i nga ro med na/ sgra so sor dbyangs gang rung zhig 'jug dgos don ci yin/ sa skya pa rtsi tas/ so sor spel ba tha dad rang du drangs pas gsal ba dang / bsres das spel ba tha dad du ma gcig tu drangs pas snyan pa/ zhes rol mo'i bstan bcos las gsungs pa'i dgongs don 'di'i gnad zin na/ mas skad la sgra'i nga ro yod med dang / sgra zur ma chag na go brda sprod par phan yon ji 'dra yod pa legs par shes so// //113
mtshan dpe phul byung yi ge stobs po che/ /ngag dbang lha mo'i 'phrul gyi pho nya yin/ /de nyid brda dka spyor bas mngag mkhas na/ /rig pa'i 'od snang kun tu 'gyed la spro// //

ming gi byung 'phel shes rab 'bar ba'i me stagasgo tshan lnga ba/ ming gi zang 'phel stes rab 'bar ba'i me stagaming gi byub 'phel legs par rtogs gyur na/ /don gyi ngo bo 'khrul ba med par bshad/ /tha snyad ji snyed blo la zin gyur na/ /tshig gi spyor bar mkhas pa'i ngag dbang 'byor/ /skad cha dar zhing rgyas pa ni/ tha snyad phun sum tshogs par gyur pa la rag las/ tha snyad ni tshig gi thung ba'i mthar thug pa'i snyad par bya ba ste/ ming dang phrad kyi spyi ming yin/ ming la 'dod rgyal dang rjes )ba rigs gnyis las/dngos po gang zhig gang zag gis thog mar ngos 'dzin tshe/ rgyu mtshan med par bad gang rung gig sbyar ba de'i ming du chags pa/ 'dod pa lhar rgyal bar gyur pas na/ 'dod rgyal gyi ming du grags pa dang / 'dod rgyal gyi ming gang 'tsham zhig rjes su bzung ste/ de la 'brel yod kyi ming zhig spyar nas/ don gyi ngo bo gzhad 4ga ston pa'i rdar grub par byur pa ni/ rjes grub kyi mi du grags so/ /gnam/ sbyin/ chu/ dgas/ nor/ mig lha bu sogs sgra rkyang ba'i ming dang / mthon po/ spyod pa/ dpyid ka ri bo1 srin du/ dred mong / mtshon cha/115

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung /g.yer kha lha du sogs ming mtha' ldan pa'i ming dang / cog tse— ting lo— tsan dan/ gu ru/ men chi/ pag shi lha byu sogs skad rigs gzhan gyi tha snyad bod 'gyur du chags pa'i ming ngo cog ni/ sgra bshad med pa nyid kyis 'dod rgyal gyi ming ngo / /shing rta/ ar dag bza' btung / longs spyod/ bzhi mdo/ glog brnyan/ bcom ldad 'das/ 'thug mi tshogs pa lha bu 'i bshad sngod pa thams cad rjes grub kyi ming ngo / /spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed stobs shugs dang— / tshan rig lag rtsal dar zhing rgyas pa'i rjes 'brangs nas/ ming yang mu mthud nas 'phel gyin yod do//ming gi 'phel srol mang yang / gtso cher rnam pa gsum du 'dus te/dad bo/ mib gzhi dang ming mtha' sbyad ba'i ming gi 'phel srol/sbyir ming gzhi ni 'phul rten rnams kyi 'jug yul yin mod/ — skabs 'dir don gyi ngo bo zhig ston pa'i sgra gnyis yan las ming gi gzhi mar gyur pa'i sgra la zer ba yin/ de yang / 1 ming gang rung zhig gzhir bzung nas/ ming mtha' mi gcig pa sbyar nas ming du ma re byung ba1 dper na/ ri/ zhes pa la ming mtha' gang 'os spyar nas/ sa 'dzin la ri bo/ ri la 'dug mi la ri pa/ chu mi 'drong ba'i sa zhing la ri ma/ ri dwags da ba jug thung kha sho can rme ri bong / rin du brin pa la —116

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon jing /sbyar nas rigs can de'i chung ngu'i ming du gyur pa dang /yang na che bo med la chung ngu tsam pa ba'i ming du grub pa/dper na/lug dang lu gu/sgyug ma dang —sgyu gu/ thag pa dang tha gu/ mchig dang mchi gu/spug dang spu gu/bug dang bu — — —— — —ga chung ngu/ snang ngu/ thung ngu/ mi dang mi'u/ ji bo dang ji bu/ rta dang — —— — — —rte'u/ drel dang dre'u/ ra dang re'u/ sha ba dang she'u/ gla dang gle'u/sprel — — — — —dang spre'u nya dang nye'u/bya dang bye'u/so dang se'u/khri dang khri'u/tshu ma dang — — — — —dze'u/zo ba dang ze'u/spe bo dang sle'u/sgro ba dang sgrog/mda' dang mde'u/rgo — — — — —ba dang rgo'u/sgo dang sge'u/mtsho dang mtshe'u/rdo dang rde'u/le'u/sri'u/spyil bo — — nga ———dang spyil bu/khrol ma dang khrol bu/gzhong ba dang gzhong bu/rdzang dang rdzang nga nga —du/nor dang nor du/ skon pa dang skon gu/khung dang khung bu/sgrog dang sgrog — — — — —bu/dol dang dol bu/'jor dang 'jor bu/khem dang khem du/chen dang chen — — —— — —bu/lan bu/ gdu du/ glegs bu/ skor du/ gtsag du/sgyung bu / thom bu/—nga nga nga nga nga gzur du/gdal du / ril ste / kun bu/phran snye / rtsid du/rgum du/srin du——————ring bu lha du sogs rigs bsgri bar bya'o/—gnyis pa/ ming gang rung zhig gzhir bzung nas 'brel yod kyi ming rnams sbyar ba'i ming gi 'phel srol/1 'brel gzhi snga ma dang 'brel chos ci mar sbyar nas ming du ma re 8

ming gi rgyung 'phel shes rab 'bar ba'i me stagabyung ba/ dper na/ lag pa 'brel gzhir bzung nas/ 'grel chos rnams sbyar ba las/ lag mgo lag mjil/ lag bol/ lag mdzub/ lag skyed/ lag 'khru/lag ris/ lag ngar/ lag rdum/ lag gi bla/ lag nya/ lag dmar/ lag ldan/lag nyal/ lag 'gro/ lag 'gro za/ lag 'gro'i mgon po/ lag na 'khor lo/lag na rdo rje/ lag na rin chen/ lag yangs ma/ lag rkyang / lag do/ lag pod/lag ya/ lag brda/ lag len/ lag bde/ lag rtsal/ lag shes/ lag mthu/lag rjes/ lag rgyun/ lag kor/ lag dkris/ lag gdub/ lag 'bob/ lag skor/ lag khyer/ lag lcibs/ lag cha/ lag rten/ lag phyi/ lag ras/ log tsha/lag mdzod/ lag gzung lha bu sogs dab /'brel gzhi ri bo la 'brel chos rnams sbyar ba las/ ri rab/ ri phran/ ri de'u/ ri mgo ri gnya'/ ri sked/ ri ngos/ ri zhol/ ri gzar1 ri sdings/ ri sul/ ri rgyud/ ri khrod/ ri brag ri skyes ma/ ri skyes dga' byed/ ri 'gems/ ri 'joms/ ri nyal/ ri 'phen/ ri sras/ ri tsher/ ri dbang / ri dwags/ ri dwags dgra/ ri rwags mthar byed/ ri dwags skyes/ ri dwags rtsi/ ri dwags rgya/ri dwags rgyal bo/ ri dwags mig ri dwags mtshan ma/ ri bong 'dzin pa/ ri dwags sred snyed/ ri bo'i rna ba/ ri yi snying bo/ ri yi thod can1 ri las snyes/ri tshos/ ri yi rus sprul/ lha bu sogs 'brel gzhi ste ming gi za shas gtso bo snga ma dang / 'brel chos te ming gi cha shas phal ba rjes su spyar ba'o/ /119

dag yig rig pa'i kab pa mngon zung /2 rang ldog las gzhi ldog khul du phyung nas ming du ma re byung ba/dper na/ dum pa dang rdza bum las/ snga ma rang ldog dang phyi ma gzhi ldog yid/de bzhin rang ldog las gzhi ldog logs su bkar nas/ dngul bum/ gser bum/ shing bum/ gter dum/ rag bum/ lha bu sogs dang / de bzhin gong sga lag pa rang ldog tu bzung nas/ de las gzhi ldog g.yas lag g.yon lag rtsa lag cha lag nying lag dbang lag yan lag yan lag mchog yan lag dang bo/ yan lag lnga sbas/ yan lag drug pa/ yan lag brgyad ldan/ yan lag brgya ba lha du sogs dang /yang / gang gi ri bo'i rang ldog las/ gzhi ldog so sor zu nas/ gangs ri/ rdza ri/ g.ya' ri/ zag ri/ gter ri1 nags ri/ spang ri/ mdun ri/ rgyab ri/ srib ri/ nyin ri/ lha bu sogs gzhi ldog snga ma dang rang ldog phyi mar sbyar pa'o/ /gsum pa/ 'dra ba'am 'brel ba rkyen byas pa'i ming gi 'phel srol/'dra ba'am 'grel ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas— ming gcig par 'brel yod kyi ming gzhan sbyar1nas ming du ma re byub ba dang / sgos su ming gzhi gcig pa'am— ming gzhi sde ba gcig pa zhig gzhir bzung nas/ de'i sgra gdangs cung zad cung zad re bsgyur nas/ ming du ma re byung ba la/120

ming gi byung 'ji shes rab 'bar ba'i me staka1 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas pa/mtshon byed dpe'i ming zhig la brten nas/ mtshod bya don gyi ming gang 'tshal zhig sbyar nas ming du ma re byung ba/khal rta ltar go chod ba'i shing gis bzos pa'i 'drud byed la shing rta dang /—yul skad du mis 'drud pa'i shing rta zung chung la shing rte'u dang /phrid skye ba rta ltar mgyogs dgos pas bang chen la bya ma rta dang / lcags kyis bzos pa'i spos 'khor ni rta ltar bzhon nas rgyug rung bas lcags rta dang / me mda' 'phang bar myur du 'bar ba'i me rdzas la me da dang /zho bsnyal ba myur du chags pa ra 'jug pa'i ru ma ka dpa' ris skad du ru rta dang / gru skad — bde ba rta'i gom 'gros ltar ldem ldem byed pa'i 'gyur khug chags pa'i rgyun la ngag rta dang /sman nad thog 'phral du 'dren pa'i ros la sman rta zer ba lha nga nga du sogs dang bas dge ba la dkar po dang / sdig pa la nag po'i dper sbyar nas/sdig pa'i nyes pa dang ldan pa la dag can/ gshin rje la gshin po'i nyes chad gcod pa'i cha nas nag po 'joms/ phung g.yo bar dga' ba'i dud med la la'i sbyar bar bltos nas/dma' 'bebs byed pa'i sgo nas bud med la nag —mo/sems ngan pa la sems dag sdig pa'i cha dang ldan pa'i bshad tshul spyod —tshul la nag nog pa da ge nog ge ma shad lha gu/gsang thabs kyi tshong log la tshong nag gzhur don rags pa tsam la nag 'gros/ rig pa mi gsal ba la —2

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung /nag thom/dug la dag po brtsegs pa zer ba lha bu sobs so/2 'dra ba rkyen byas nas / ming gzhi zhig gi sgra cung zad bsgyur nas ming du ma re byung ba/ kha dog 'dra ba rgyu mtshad du byas pa/ dper na/ kha dog dkar po'i ldog zla nag po la bltos nas/ nor ha lam nag dag yin ——pas gnag dang / 'bri byed tshon rtsi nag po yin pas snas tsha / sna ga tsha'i bum — —pa la snag kong /shing ljon pa'i tshal la rgyang nas bltas na nag rog ger snang bas nags/ sha dang tshil gyi zlas zud pa'i sha ni nag sang nger byas pas sha nga ——snag zas g.yo skol byed pa'i khang ba ni dud pas dag jib be byas pas nag —— —tshang zla ba'i mar ngo 4 nag phyogs zer ba lha bu sogs ming gzhi gcig — —pa'o dbyibs 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas pa/dper na/kor kor la bltos nas/——rdo ril ril la gor ma/dngul gyi dong tshe la sgor mo/shing rta'i phang lo lha bu la nga nga 'khor lo/de dang 'grel ba'i bya ba la 'khor ba/'khor bar byed pa la skor —ba/ma'i sha la lag skor/ khyi rgyag byed la mgo skor/khongs su gtogs pa la —skor te tshan rig sha skor lnga bu/g.yul rdung byed la 'khor ma/mtha' 'khor la — ——khor yug bskor nas gzhog pa la sgor ba lha bu sogs ming gzhi sde ba bcig —pa'o//'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byed pa 'di rigs las 'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byed 22

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa ngon jib /phyogs gcig tu gsegs pa la yo ba/de'i rnam pa la yon pa/yod pa can la nga nga nga yon po/ phar tshur yo ba la yor yor po/ yo bar zud pa la g.yo ba/ gzhan nga nga bslu ba'i sbyor ba la g.yo sgyu zer ba lha bu sogs ming gzhi gcig pa'o//—bya ba 'dra ba rgyu mtshad du byas pa/thogs par 'gyur ba la bltos nas/'gro bar mi 'jug pa la 'gog pa/bkag byung ba la khogs pa/spu gu sogs su rdzas thogs pa la khegs pa/ sgyu mi bde ba la 'gag pa/ mi rigs pa'i bshad tshul dang spyod tshul 'gog pa la dgag pa/ rkyen gyi4bar chad la —gegs/ bar zad byed pa la bgegs pa/da dugs kyi rgyu ba gcod pa la —bsgag pa/ zhun ma sra chags pa la dkag pa/ than pa byung ba'i lo la lo keg —zer ba sogs dang /yang /snod du gang ba la bltos nas/zla ba'i cha shas rdzogs par nya gang —ba/ gang bar byed pa la bkang ba/ bkang byung ba la khengs pa/ rtsi shing gi —'bras bu mang bo gcig tu thogs pa'i 'dzin pa la gang du ster na gang lta du/—tshad longs pa la gang bo ste mi tshe gang bo lha gra rgyud la skyon yon gang rung re nga zhig gang ba dang re zhig zag pa'i cha nas mi la gang zag ces pa/ lus kyi chu ——khams snyigs mas dgang bltar gnas pa'i gcin snod la shang ba/ sa ngos nga nas 'bur du thon pa'i rdul brtsegs la sgang zer ba yang snod du phyur dur —gang ba 'dra ba'i sgo nas btags pa lta bu sogs dang /4
