ming gi jing 'phel shes rab 'bar ba'i bstagaso sor zal ba la bltos das/kha zal ba la thor ba/kha bral ba'i so so —ba la thor bu/kha kha so sor gyur pa'i rnam pa sha thar thor/lus na thar thor du nga khyab pa'i pags nad rma rigs la shu thor dang 'brum thor/so sor zal 'dug nga pa can la thor ma/zu mar gtong ba la gtor ba/bod du gna' bo'i gtor — ——byed drag chas la gtor ma zhes bya ba/ chos pas bed spyad da gdon 'dre sogs zlog rje spyad byed pa/bor ba la stor ba/dgos med du gtong ba la dor — —ba/ ra ba'i bzug chu phyi la gtang sa'i khung bu la stor khung / khang ba sogs — nga —gtor thub pa'i rlung chen po la 'thor rlung /lha du sogs dang /ba je cher song ba la bltos nas/thang ma sogs gcal du bkram pa la gdal ba/gdal nas tshad las bud pa la 'dal ba/zu gra mor byed pa la rdal ba/mig gi rgyal mo ji cher song ba la ldal ba/tshod ma zin par tshad las — —'das pa la thal ba pha rol du bud pa la thal byung lha bu sogs ming gzhi sde —ba gcig pa'o//3 'brel ba rkyen byas nas/ ming gzhi gang rung zhig gi sgra cung zad cung zad re bsgyur nas ming du ma re byung ba/ 'brel nye ba la ba ltos das/gnyen tshad la nye du/bza' tshang sgrig pa la gnyen sgrig pa/mnyen gyi bar pa —la mnye bo/nye 'khor la nyen kor/snying nye ba la mnyes pa nye bar byed pa la nga ——bsnyen pa spyodage bsnyen dang bsnyen bkur/ bzang sa 'jam sa la gnyen — —25

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /bshes/'jam pa la mnyen pa/mnyan par byed pa la mnye ba lha bu sogs —dang /tshe 'pho bar bltos nas/ tshe las 'dab pa la shi ba/ shi bo rjes dran gyi ——ston mo la shid ston/shi bo rnams kyi dge 'jug la gshin dge shi bo'i zhe sa la gshin po/gshin po'i rje bo la gshin rje/skams lug sogs kyi ske len pa la bsha' ba/bsha' mkhan la shan pa/bon gyi ston pa la gshen rab/srog —nga nga chags bsad nas lhar mchod par byed pa'i bon chog lagashen ma mi gsod la gshed ma/ bka' bkyon pa la gshe ba mi bsad pa'i dgra bo la sha pa/— —dgra sha pa la snying nad 'dzin pa la sha khon/dgra bor rtsor pa la gshed du bab nga pa/ 'tshe bar byed pa la gshed byed lta bu sogs bya ba'i ming la brten nas —dngos po'i ming du ma re byung ba dang /nad la bltos nas/nad la na tsha/dad byung ba la na ba/na bar 'jug — —pa ste ngan byed pa la gnod pa/nad du btang ba la bsnad pa/na ba bo la nad nga — nga pa byad ka la mnan pa/thog ngos sdid che bar gtob ba la gnon pa/lngid —'og tu khug pa la non pa/sdug bsngal du 'jug pa la mdar ba/lha bu sogs —dngos po'i ming zhig la brten nas bya ba'i mi pa du ma re byung ba dag ming gzhi gcig pa'o//'khyog pa'i rnam par bltos nas/ 'khyog pa can la 'khyog po 'khyog nya6

ming gi byung 'phel shes rab 'bar ba'i me stagapa'i rnam pa bskyar ba la 'bag 'khyog gam kyag kyog sprul la 'khyog 'gro/me ——la 'khyog 'bar/snyan dngags la 'khyog brjod/'khyog par byed pa la dkyog — nga pa/kha phyogs bskor ba la skyog pa ste/rta'i srab skyogs dang rlangs 'khor gyi kha — nga —skyog lha bu sogs khyad chos kyi ming la brten nas dngos po'i ming dang bya ba'i —ming du ma re byung ba'o//mi mngon par bya bar bltos nas/ g.yog par byas pa la bkab pa/bkab byung ba la khebs pa 'gebs byed la khebs/ dgab sa bo la dgab — —bya'am dgab yul/ 'geb mi la 'geb pa bo/ mi mngon par gyur pa la gab —pa ste gab tshig gam gab khung lha bu/ rgyal bo bzhugs gnas la rgyal bo'i khab — zer ba'i khab ni pho zang ste nang mi mthong ba'i pyir/ lus snad la lus 'gab/skyid khung la sgab khung /gos kyi 'dabs ka la gos sgab zer ba sogs dang / 'a dzin par bltos dgal ga tu thogs pa la bzung ba/bzung nas byung ba la zin pa/ thigs pa gsog gsog byas pa'i bris ma la zid teg lag pa nga dang skam ba la 'dzin byed/ 3gas kyu la zung nga ste/sha zung /khab bzung /— —bzho gzung / chang zung lha bu/ lus 'tsho ba'i stobs la zungs te/ lus kyi —nga nga dwangs ma sha khyag tshil/ /rus pa rkang mar khams rnams ni/ /lus kyi zungs bdun zhes pa'o/ /myud la brjed med du gtad 'jags pa la gzungs/ mi nga brjed pa'i dbang 'byor ba la gzungs thob pa/ gos bzo bar jig gshar 27

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mdzad sgyung /rgyag pa la gzungs 'debs pa/mchod rten dang sku 'dra'i nar la 'jug rgyu'i —ring bsril dang gzungs sngags sogs rten gyi snying bo la gzungs gzhug—lcags thag la gnya' zungs rgyud mo/ sa gzhi la nor 'dzin nam 'dzin ma/sprin la chu 'dzin/ btson du bzung ba'i mi la bzung ma/ mig la gzugs ——'dzin/da ba la thos 'dzin/sna la dri 'dzin/lce la ro 'dzin/yul gzung bar nga bya ba dang /yul cad 'dzin par byed pa la gzung 'dzin zer ba lta bu sogs ——dang /phar btang bar bltos nas/ drin lan gzo ba la gtang rag sbyin la dpa' ba la gtong phod/ phyi la 'phud pa la gtong ba/ btang nas 'phrod pa la jings pa/jir gtong mi la gtong ba bo/rlung dang khyab 'jug la gtong —byed/ yig bskur sogs la gtang bya/ rnam 'gyur phud tshul la stangs te nga stangs stabs dang spyod stangs/rnam 'gyur byung tshul la zang ste thob zar sa bogs la thong ga lo rer rgyal bor dbul ba'i nom pa la lo thang /gta' ma —la gteng ba/srog skyin la stongs/phar 'gro ba la dong ba sogs dang /— —rgyu ba la bltos nas/ lam ga la rgyu sa/ keng ba dang bzhod pa la rgyu — —byed/ 'gro ba la rgyu ba ste rgyu skar lta bu/ thags 'thag par srid du gtang — ——ba'i skud pa la rgyu dang 'phred skud la spun te rgyu spun ro drug zas skom —las byung ba'i dwangs snyigs ma 'dres par rgyu bar gyed pa'i lam la rgyu ma/ sha —28

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /dag phan tshun brten cing 'brel ba'i sgo nas/ ming gi rigs rgyud 'phel ba yin no/ /rjeXtsong kha ba chen pos/ ston pa kun las rten 'brel ston pa mchog/shes pa kun las rten 'brel shes pa mchog /ces gsungs pa bzhin/ ming gi rigs rgyud spel srol 'di ni/ gda' mi bod kyi kun tu brtags pa'i rig pa las byung ba yin no/ /de yangaX/ lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo las/ ming du gdags par ma mdzad na/ /'jig rten zams cad smongs par 'gyur/ 1zhes gsungs pa lhar/ gna' mi bod kyis shes bya'i chos shig 'jig rten pa rnams la go brda sprad sla ba'i ched du/ ming la bsnyed dgos/ ming med na dod gyi ngo bo ston dka'/ ming 'dogs tshe/ ming du gdags pa'i dngos po de dngos po gang dag dang rten dang brten par grub pa dang / de'i nang gi nyer len dang phyi yi mthun rkyen ji ltar 'brel ba dang / de'i byed las dang khyad chos ji 'drayin pa kun la brtags te/ ngo bo ji lha ba bzhid du btags pas na/ rjes grub kyi ming zams cad la sgra bshad yod par ma zad/ 'dod rgyal gyi ming la lar yang tshig phrad kyi sgo nas sgra bshad du rung bar byur snang / de phyir gna' mi bod kyis ming gi rigs rgyud spel srol 'di/ nga tshos bslab par bya ba'i rig pa gal chen zhig yin te/ ming bkral na/ go ba de ltar blangs nas gnad du khel ba zhig dgos/ lhar snang dang 'ol tshod tsam gyis mi chog ming— btags na/ rgyu rkyen rten 'brel kun la brtags nas mtshad nyid dang mthun 130

ming gi byung 'phel zhes rab 'bar ba'i me stagapa zhig dbos/ chal chol dang nyag nyob tsam gyis mi chog mi chog don ni/ming ma go na/ brda mi 'phrod/ ming ma dag na/ don mi 'byor/ ming si dbang 'byor na/ 'chad rtsod rtsom pa shā1 thobs pa med 'gro/ spra gsar tshang gis/ji ltar mig dbang yod kyang dmus long gis/ /snang byed nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mi mthong bzhin/ —brda dag gzhung la ma sbyangs rig pa gzhan/ /bslabs kyang gnad don 'khrul med rtogs mi 'byur/ /zhes brda dag sgo gsal 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba'i mjug tu gsungs pa 'dis/dag yig rig pa mkhas par spyang ba'i dbos pa gsal bar bstan snang ngo // 1/

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mdzan sgyung /spe tshan drug pa/ brtsas ming spru ba'i bcud len/tshig bi lo mas ma bsgribs shing / /don gyi 'bras bu ba yur za ba/ 1bsgyus ming ngag tu 'jug mabs na/ /smra ba nyung yang bstan pa shā1nga /mi'i 'gro bas 'jig rten khams kyi sred 'byor rig gsum gong nas song du spel ba 'a sa/ rang gi blo gros kyang rgya cher dar zhing rgyas pa'i sgo nas/rang byung khams kyi gsang ba'i dngos po gang mang gi ngos zin pa dang / sbyi tshogs kyi sbyar byung gi dngos po gang mang bed spyad 1 yin / dngos po gsar ba gang byung gang shes la ming gang 'tsham re btags nas bad 'phrod par byed pa yin/ ming sna ring na/ brjod pa mi bde/ dper na/ gser rko ba bo/zhes pa'i ming 'dir tsheg dbar bzhi yod pas / sgra cung zad mang song ming sna bsdus nas/ gser rkon/ zhes 'bod sla bar byas byung / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo/ zhes pa'i ming 'di 'bod sla bar tshig sna(ming sna dang /tshig sna zhes pa'i sna ni/ srid dam ring thung gi tshad de/ srid ring ba la sna ring zer te/dpe cha sna ring zhes pa lha bu'o/ /)bsdus nas/ sher mdo zhes grub/ zhing las deng 132

brdus ming paba'i bcud len/rabs can du 'gyur ba dang / bzo las deng rabs can du 'gyur ba dang /rgyal khab srung stobs deng rabs can du 'gyur ba dang / tshan rig lag rtsal deng rabs can du 'gyur bar bya ba 'di/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi stobs 'byor spel ba'i rtsa ba yin pas/ dus rgyud par bshad rgyu bri rgyu mang bas ngag dang yi ger 'jug pa bde phyir/ 'gyur bzhi/ zhes 'bod sla bar byas byung /lha du'o/ /bod kyi ming 'dogs srol la 'bod sla ba dang / brjod bde ba dang /kha gsal ba ste gzhi 'dzin gsum yod la/ skabs 'di'i brjod bya ni ming 'dus ma yin/ ming 'dus ma'i gzhi 'dzin 'bod sna ba yin/ 'bod sna ba la sgra nyung mtha' zhig dgos pas/ ming ring ba rnams ci rtsogs kyis thung bar byas pa yin/ sgra gnyis can sgra gcig tu bsdus pa'ang mang du snang ngo / /ming bstung ba la tsheg dbar bsdu ba dang / ming sna bsdu ba dang / tshig sna bsdu ba ste bsdu tshul gsum yod/ rim bzhin dper na/ bu lon/ zhes pa'i ming gi sgra gnyis bar gyi tsheg bsdus nas/ bun— zhes sgra gcig tu gyur pa dang / khongs su gtogs pa/ zhes pa'i phrad dang ming mtha' bsdus nas/ khongs gtogs/zhes sgra bzhi da / gnyis su byas pa dang / shes nyon gyi sgrib pa mtha' dag sgangs shing / ji lha ji snyed kyi shes bya thams cad rtobs pa/ zhes pa'i tshig gnyis las don gyi snying bo zin pa'i sgra gnyis ma gtogs/ lhag ma yod tshad bsdus nas/ spangs rtogs/ zhes sgra gnyis tsam gyi ming du grub pa lha du'o/ /bsdu tshul 133

das yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung—'di gsum ming rkyang ba dang 1 ming 'dus ma spyi la khyab pa'o/ /—don tshan dang bo/ ming rkyang ba'i bsdu tshul/ming rkyang ba ni/ sgra bcig gam gnyis sam du mas don gyi ngo bo kho na re ston byed yin/ rigs 'di las ming gi sgra gcig pa cen yin na/ bsdu rgyu med pa dang / ming gi cha shas gnyis yan las sgra gang rung bsdus da/ don gyi ngo bo ston mi srid pa dang / yang na/ don gyi ngo bo bzhan zhig ston par 'gyur ba dmas/ bsdu mi rur ba ma btogs/ ming gi cha tsas bsdus kyang don la gnod pa med pa rnams/ phal cher bsdu chog pa ste/ ma pa byings kyi skad cha dang /mkhas pa'i brtsams chos su/ ming 'dus ma'i 'jug pa ha cang shā1nga 'ing /bsdu srol yang tshar du dngar ba zhig chags shing 'dug bo de la bsdu tshul ha lam bdun snang / dang bo/ tsheg dbar bsdus pa/ming gi cha shas gnyis bar gyi tsheg ba dzus nas sgra gcig tu sbyar ba zhig ste/ ka to ra la ka tor dang / gyi na la gyin/ min 'da' ba la gyin 'da'/ lta nga —— ——bu/ sgo nga la sgong ste/ bya yi sgo nga la bya sgong lta bu/ cha ga la chag ste/ gos kyi cha — —ga la bos chag lha bu/ cho ga la chog ste/ grong ba'i cho ga la grong chog lha du/ nya nga ga la nyag ste/ srang gang la nyag gang lha bu/ tha ma kha la tha mag phyi ma la phyim ste/— — —rtsom gyi phyi ma la rtsom phyi ma lha bu/ phyu ba la phyub ste/ phyu ba chen po la phyub chen lha ——134

ba ming spu ba'i bcud len/ bu/ zags sbyar skad kyi bya ldan/ zhes pa bod skad du zur chag nas/ bya da dang /—tsheg dbar bsdus das bya na mo la byan mo lta bu/ mdza' na la mdzan te/— —mdza' na mo la mdzan mo lta tsu/ 'o na la 'od te/ 'o na yang la 'on kyang lta du/nga sla nga la slang ste/ khro yi sla nga la khro blang / lha bu sogs ming mtham ming gzhi'i nga —nga rjes 'jug gi tshu' du sbyar ba dang /cho lo la chos te/ rus pa'i cho lo la rus cho lha bu/ phu nu la phun zhes bsdus na/ —phun tshogs kyi phun dang 'khrul srid pas/ sgra rje drag tu btang dag spun/ zhes byur ba ste/ mi'i bod yul gyi bsdus ming lo ming gzhi rkyang ba can brtsegs ma can du bsgyur ba'i dpe yod— dper na/ pha dang du la pha spad dang / marang du mo la ma smad zer ba lta bu/ phya le ba la phyal te/ phya le ba dang —phya le ba yin pa la phyal dang phyal mid lha bu/ phru gu la phrug ste/—khyi'i phu gu la —— ba khyi phrug lha bu/ byu ru la byur te/ byu ru dkar po la byur dkar lta bu/ yi ge la —yig ste/ bod kyi yi ge la bod yig lha bu/ a ga tsu las rje pa te/ ma ga ru dag po —— —la mar nag lha bu sogs ming mtha'i dbyangs yig bsdus nas/ mib gzhi'i rjes 'jug gi tshul du spyar ba dang 1 yang / ming mtshu'i dbyangs tsam ming gzhir sbyar ba nyung ngu tsam yod de/ sras dang sras mo sras sros zhes 'bod ——pa lha bu dang / rgya mtsho la rgyam ste1 bstan pa rgya mtsho la bstan rgyam lta bu/ rdo rje la rdor ———— ——136

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mdzan sgyung /te/phyag da rdo rje la phyag rdor lta bu/phu rung la phur te/phu rung kha so la phur —kha lha bu/gu ram la bur te / gu ram chang la dur chang lta bu / spya ngan la zung ste/— ——— ——chu ngan las 'das pa la zung 'das lta du/ra gan la ra gal phug la lab ste/— —la phug gi sa bon la lab son lha bu/'u lag la 'ul te/khral dang 'u lag la —khral thul lha bu/ra mda' la ram ste/ra mda' 'degs pa la ram 'degs lta nga — ——bu/ma bra la ba ste/sa bra skya bo la ba skya lta du/ma mdo la mas stem mdo'i — — —yul skad la ma skad lta du sogs ming gi za shas phyi ma'i mi gzhi tsam mam/sngon 'jug tsam mam/mgo 'jog tsam ming gzhi'i rjes 'jug gi tshul du sbyar ba dang /ma yin la min/sa bod la sod re mos la res te/re mos kyis bskor — — —ba la res bskor lha du rnams ni/ cha shas phyi ma'i ming gzhi tsam bsdus das lhag ma dag rngo shas ji ra ra sbyar ba'o//gong gas dmas ni ming gi cha shas snga ma 'a mtha' can nam mtha' rten med pa can yin pas/cha shas phyi ma'i ming gzhi'am 'phul rten gang rung zhig snga ma'i rjes 'jug gi tshul du sbyar rung zhing klog bde ba'i phyir ro//dkon mchog la dkod tshe dkon mchog rgya mtsho la dkom rgyam lta bu/—rgyal mtshan la rgyan te/chos kyi rgyal mtshan la chos rgyan lha bu / rab 'byams la —rams te/lha ldan rab 'byams pa la lha rams pa dang /snan pa rab 'byams —36

bsdus ming spya ba'i bcud len/pa la sman rams pa lha du/ shes rab la sher te/ shes rab kyi lha la sher lha lha — —bu/ ces pa'o la ce'o/ yang na/ zhes bya ba'o lu zhed/ rto khu rnams ni cha shas snga — —ma'i rjes 'jug bsubs shul/ cha shas phyi ma'i sngon 'jug gam ming gzhi'am rjes 'jug tsam sda mar spyar nas1 sgra gnyis sgra gcig tu 'dus so/ /gnyis pa/ ming sna bsdus pa/ming du grub pa'i sgra rnams cha tshang bar bklags na sna ring la yud kyis mi tshar bas/ de'i sgra gtso bo gnyis bzhag cing phal ba dag bsdus das 'bod sla bar byed pa zhig ste/ rab tu byung ba la rab byung / bde bar gshegs pa la bder gshegs/ thub pa'i bstan pa la thub bstan/ dam pa'i chos la dam — —chos/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa la dkon brtsegs/ bza shis lhud po la bkras —lhun/ phun sum tshogs pa la tsud tshogs/ dka' ba spyad pa la dka' ston/—— —legs par bshad pa la legs bshad/ tshigs su bcad pa la tshigs bcad/tshigs bcad kyi rkang ba la tshigs rkang / nag po 'gro shes la nag 'gros/ gyin gyis brlabs pa la byid rlabs/ grub pa thob pa la grub thob/ mthong ba kun smon la mthong smon/ gser gyi gzhong ba la gser gzhong / rnga ma'i rlung g.yang la rnga yab/ tshar ba'i 'a sa gu la tshar 'bras/ ston kha'i lo thog la ston — —thog gsar du bskrun pa la gsar bskrun/ rgyal mo tsha ba rong la rgyal rong / —lha du sogs phal cher phrad dang ming mtha' bsdus 2—'o/ / — 137

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung gsum ba/ tshig sna bsdus pa/nges tshig bsdus nas ming du grub pa zhig ste dka' gnad kyi 'grel ba la dka' 'grel/sku'i gzhogs su gnas pa ba la sku gzhogs/dgongs pa'i ———klong nas brdol ba'i shes rab la klong rdol/ kha sna gnyis nas 'byung ba la gnyis 'thung / khyad par du 8phags pa'i nor la khyad nor/ gab pa mngon ——par phyung ba la gab phyung / gos chen 'brug gi ri mo can la gos 'brug ma/————'gron po 'dug sa'i khang ba la 'gron khang glog gis pra phab pa'i snang brnyan la glog pra/ rgyu rkyen rnams 'dus shing phrad nas byas pa ba la 'dus —byas/da dul bskyis pa'i skyin pa la dngul skyid/mchog gi dngos grub thob pa —bo la grub chen/rten cing 'brel ba'i byung ba la rten 'byung / zag gdang gi ——ra ba la dang ra/sdug bsngal las skyob pa'i mgon po la skyabs mgon/mna' — ———bskyal nas bzhag pa'i gan rgya la mna' gad/ sna thag gis kha lo bsgyur ba'i bzhon pa la sna lo ma bal yul du skyes pa'i teg ta la bal tig ma rig pa'i ——gnyid sang4shing shes bya rtogs pa'i blo gros rgyas pa la sangs rgyas/ lo na nga —rgas nas chos la zhugs pha la rgan zhugs/ srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis yongs su 'dzin pa'i slob dpon la yongs 'dzin lha tsu sogs don gyi ngo bo tshis gi ——lam nas ston pa la/ brjid pa tshig bsdu mang bo nyid/ de dag lhug pa dag gi gsos//snyan ngag me long gi rtsa ba las/zhes pa ltar/tshig sna bsdus nas 38

bsgyus ming spu ba'i bcud len/sgra gtso bo gnyis dang mang na gsum tsam gcig tu sbyar nas ming du grub par byas so//bzhi ba/ khyad gzhi dang khyad chos bsdus pa/khyad gzhi dang khyad chos mnyam du mtshon pa'i dang gnyis kyi ming mtha' dang bcas pa bsdus nas/ngo bo gcig tu sbyar ba zhig ste/ba ta chen po la paṇa chen/lo tsā ba chen mo la lo chen/theg pa dman pa la theg dman/sur —bu dkar po la bar dkar/pad ma dkar po la pad dkar / lo thog yag par —nga —— —byung ba la lo yags slog pa thed po 'a slag bed/ sha mo ser bo la sha ser/———— nga tshod rtsi dkar po la dkar rtse / shing za mo la shing phran sdob bo chen po bsgong —— —— —rgan/ rta rgas pa la rta rgan/ ri bo rab tu che ba la ri rab/skyes 4 mchog tu —— nga gyur pa la skyes mchog snying gi sdug gu ma la snying sdug mdzes nyams dang ldan ——pa'i chos la mdzes chos dge ba'i bshes gnyen la dge bshes/lha du sogs ———so//lnga ba/ ga'i mthun bsdus pa/brjod bya'i chos kyi don mthun pa'am ngo bo 'dra ba'i ming gnyis ming gcig tu spyar ba zhig kun/ kha dog dkar zhing reg bya 'jam pa la dkar nga 'jam/dkar zhing gsal ba la dkar gsal/thugs mnyes shing gshin pa la ——mnyes gshin/phra zhing zhib pa la phra zhib/blun zhing rmongs pa la kun rmongs/———— —— ——30

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon jing /khog gdug cing sbyor ba tsub pa la gdug tsub/mdza' zhing mthun pa la mdza' —mthun/zhi zhing dul ba la 'i dul/lha bu rnams ma bsdus gong khyad chos brjod — —pa'i tshig yin mod/bsdus tshe khyad chos ston pa'i ming du grub pa dang /lus ngal zhing dub pa la ngal dub/ lus dang sems sdug cing ngal ba la sdug —— —bsngal/ brtag cing dpyad pa la brtag dpyad/ bstod cing bsngags pa la —bstod bsngags/dar zhing rgyas pa ka dar rgyas/gnod cing 'tshe ba la gnod —— —'tshe/mnye zhing reg pa la mnye reg bza' ba dang btung ba la bza' btung /— —nga —gtor cing brlag pa la gtor brlag gzhom pa dang bshig pa la gzhom —bshig bkur ba dang gzo ba la bkur gzo/lta bu dmas ma bsdus gong bya ba brjod pa'i tshig yin mod/ bsdus tshe dngos po mtshon pa'i ming du gyur pa dang / gcod par byed pa la gcod byed/ gzhom par bya ba la gzhom bya/—rtogs pa brjod pa la rtogs brjod/ lta bu rnams bsdus ma bsdus phal cher 'dra ste/dngos po'i ming du 'jug pa yin no//skabs 'dir gal bo che la nan tan zhig bya rgyu ni ma ba'i ming gnyis dngos po'i ming gcig tu spyar na/ ngo bo 'dra ba ma gtogs ngo bo tha dad pa'am/ngo bo gcig pa mnyam du sbyar mi rung /dper na/g.yar skyi byed/ces pa'i g.yar ba ni/lcags khem 'dra gzhan gyi lag nas blangs te bkol rjes/slar sprad dgos par zer ba dang /skyi ba ni/sgor mo 'dra gzhan gyi lag nas 40

bsdu ming spya ba'i bcud len/blangs te bkol rjes/ skyin pa sprad dgos par zer ba yin/ des na chos gnyis kyi ngo bo thu dad pa yin pas/ ming gcig tu sbyar mi nang ngo /— /'dzin gzung byas/ zhes pa'i 'dzin pa ni da lha ba dang / gzung ba ni ma 'ongs pa yin te/ ldog pa'i dbye ba tsam las/ ngo bo gcib/ pas ming gcig tu spyar srol zad do/ /dar spel byed/ ces pa'i dar ba ni— bdag gzhan kad la'ang ma ༵ 1 ༵༵ dī~Xs da byed/ ༵ rjo gas rje so//ba/deng hūṃ rtsom dang dī~Xsbyo rdo dam ༵ ༵༵/ /nya— bya ba'i ming gcig gi dod du bya ba'i ming gsum re jigasu nas spyar ba sa khyab rdo khyab tu mthong ngo / 1ya ma zung 'di rigs ni 'akal 'du'i phud bo zhig snye/shābyed tshig— hūm̐— —— ma rje / cheX hūm̐ kyi rje dab ༵ la rje dab rdo da ༷bye /sna hūm̐ bye/ ༵snye dor ba byeX bye ༷ bye/ tu phyug pa'i bya ba'i ming tshar bcad nas/ mtha' na byed pa/ btang ba/ 6zo ba/ lta du 'a sa 'a las med par 'gyur ba'i tshul du mngon/ ming gi sbyor ba ma dag na/ tshig gi sbyor ba dag tshul med/ tshig gi sbyor ba ma dag na/ badzra de bya ji bzhin go ba dka'— bod skad kyi khyad chos 'dzin skyong spel bar/ na ma zung gi sbyor tshul de rigs gtan med du gtang rgyu gal che'i— /141

dag yig rig pa'i gad pa mngon rgyungadrug pa/ don gzhan ston par bsdus pa/'brel —chags bar ba zad bar mtshom mi—'dres pa'am bcib tu 'dre rung ba'i chos mnyes kyi chud sgyu pa mnyam du bsdus nas/ don gyi ngo bo snga ma gang yang min par gzhan1 zhig ston par 'byur ba zhig yin/ shar dang lho/ ma bsdus pa'i skabs —su shar phyogos dang lho phyogs so sor ston pa dang / shar lho/ zhes mnyam du bsdus tshe/ me lha'i mtshams ston pa'o/ /dpe de bzhin dbye/—lho nub ni bden bral gye mtshams— dang— / nub byang ni rlung lha'i ma rdo mde dang ba/ za shar— ni dbang ldan gyi mtshams yid no/ /dkar sdo dang ser po/ rme bsdus shed rje sneg gnyis so sor bstan pa dang / dmar ser/ zhes bsdus tshe/ mdog gnyis 'dres pa'i kha dog gcig bstan pa'o/ 1de bzhin du/ sngon po dang skya bo'i 'dres ma la sngo skya/ dmar po dang ser po'i 'dres ma la dmar ser/dmar po dang dag bka 'dres ma lda dmar nag rkyang rkyang dang nag nag mi 'dres ma bka rkyang nag skya skya dad ster gyi 'dres ma ser la skya ser/ dmar dmar dang spya skya'i la dmar skya/ g.yag dang ba mo bsdebs rgyud la ba mdzo1 'bri dang glang pho bsdebs pa'i rgyud la 'bri mdzo/ bong gseb dang rgod ma bsdebs pa'i rgyud la rta drel/ rta gseb dang bong mo'i rgyud la bong drel/bstan pa dang bcos pa che bsnyen bcos/ 'bring ba dang tha ma la 'bring tha/ lha bu sogs rigs 'gre'o/ /142

brdus ba sku ba'i bcud len— lhan na sbyar ba yid pas1 tshig thung ngur spub das yod sha ming gi tshogs pa yang yin/ ka par pyi ba ste las mi dngos po mtshon pa'i ming la spo rkyang bas grub pa dang / sgra du mas grub pa khag gnyis yod pa las/ bya ba 'jugakasa'i las la sbyar ba'i ming gang sgra gnyis yan chad kyis grub ba yin na/ de rang las kyi dngos po nyid las gzhan du 'khrul bar mi 'gyur/ dper ne/—bsam blo gtong ba/ dogs pa sel/ 'khor lo bskor ba/ sku 'dra ba'i nges/ sgra— rig pa slob pa/ brtag par bya ba brtags nas rtogs/ lta bu sog kyi zu /'a ༵— dī ba / ma~Xdī rdong dbya da rdo ༵sdus spyo~X'i ༵ snying gi dbyeg sa pa yid pa gdon dī mi — zhing / tshig tu grub pa'i khyad chos kyang gsal bar mngon kas na/ sding —rkyang gas don ༷ / rdo ༷ bye dgos dngos ༷ ༷bye~X/ bye —— bye bye bye/ ——/ skabasgo grub — bye / bkyi ba skor hūṃ rdo/ 'dir las dang bya ba'i dbye ba gsal mi gsal ba/ gtso bo las la thug yod/brjod bde bar de lugs khag gnyis bgos nas bshad ma dang / ded ka bod 'gyur du tha snyad 'di rigs kyi 'gyur ma dag pa ches mang brga— nyed mkho che ba'i dper brjod skor zhig bkod pa las/ gang zhig rgya skad kyi tha snyad gang dang ngo bo gcig pa shan sbyar ba yin/1 5

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung —— — — gcig lab dang— bya ba'i dbye ba gsal ba/— las kyi dngos po mdzod par snang ba ste/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya sogs yid na/ dbang bo lnga'i spyod yul yin pas/ ma bsams kyang sheg pa'i sgo nas/las dang bya ba bsdus pa'i ngag gi sbyor ba gang 1 mi gi tshogs pa las ming rkyab bar 'khrul dogs mi 'byung / ja 'thung ba/ sha za da/ lha gur dpe mtshon na/ ja ni da4nga bya dang / sha rī bza' byu ste las kyi dngos po yin zhing /'u cing ba dang/ za da ni las la 'jug pa'i rtsol ba ste bya ba yin pa gsal bas/brda sprod du don rtsi khyad par ston pa'i dzig yin zhing /—ji snyad du las dang bya ba 'dus pa'i ming gi tshogs pa — las/ mi rje rkyang bar nor dogs med pas/ ja ྅thung zud pa/ sha za byas/ zhes zab nyis brtsegs sbyar ba'i bzhad gad mi 'byung ngo / /dge de bzhin / — dkar ba pa ni/ yin min gyi mtha' gsal bar byung ba'o/ 1 1 jilodakar ba spyod pa ni/ ༵ nyes kha g.yo1sa— dkar sa phud pa'o/ / ༅4datshedakar thon bka/ bden thag chod pa'o/ / tshezarkya rgyag pa ni1 mi ngan lag 'brel byed pa'o/ / lozaskya rgyas pa ni/ lo yags pa'o/ / za11 skra byi ba ni/ mgo skyes lhung ba'o/ / 11mi kha tha' ba ni/ skad cha bshad nyes byas pa'o/ — cho0146

ba'i bkar pa 'i bcud zad/khrun chod pa31 kho thag chod pa'o/ / 1zamakho bzod ni/ go chod— pa'/ 1lologlo brdol ba ni/ glo ba'i ngos la nad kyis bu ga brdol ba'o/ / lozozagyod gdal ba ni/ le lan 'debs pa ste/ dper na/ khyod lan zer nas gcig gis gcig la lhodakod la zhing song ngo /zo/zhes mi la'i rnam thar las gsung6 pa/ lha bu'o/ / zazargya bskyed pa ni/ rgya cher btang ba'o— / mirangad ldang ba 'i/ dri zhim 'thul ba'o/ / tsho ngar rtsad pa ni/ gri sogs bsregs nas ngar kha rlon gshir 'khyags par 'phangs nas mkhregs par byed pa'o/ / tsho mngar bslangs pa ni/ soms kyi dpa' bskyed pa'o/ — chozangar bsad pa ni/ dpa' zhum par 'jug pa'o/— / da'ango srung ba ni/ ngo so skyong ba'o/ / tshotshe nyams dga' ba di/ yi rang ba'o/ / mganyid yer ba di/ gnyid ma khug pa'o/ / cho'aganyen zlog pa ni/ bu mo mnye la byin pa kar spe ster bar byed pa'i / / zazo( ༅ )stong 'jal ba ni/ srog skyid 'tshab pa'o/ 1tshom yis )thugs gzhol ba ni/ rnam shes gtod pa'o/ / waṃ ) 1 1

dag yig rig pa'i kab pa zon sgyung 1thog chod pa ni/ rgyal dang bo lo na pa ste/ dkyus thog chod pa/ khrom thog chod ba / mkhas thog chod pa/ 'phong thog tshod pa/ lha bu/ waṃ' (za4ces ba)'thug thor ba ni/ snyes med par gyur pa'o// chozado brdo bapa ni/ 'gran zla gyed pa'o/ /—༅ chodus btab pa ni/ dus chud tras pa'o/ /—za༅dor sdeb pa ni/ cha sgrig ba ste/ rmon pa dor sdeb— lta gu'o/ / tsho༅ dri nga ba ni/ dri ma bro ba'o/ / cho da dad btang da ni/ gshin da1 byas pa'o/ / tshozaganong 'khur ba ni/ nyis skyon kas led bka / mtshosna sbol ba ni/ sne las phan dzud 'brel bar byed pa'o/ /zotshodapa' bkong ba ni/ dpa' zhum par 'jug pa'o/ / tshotshospu bsnal ba ni1 khong khro bcom pa'o/ / tshe15 spro bsrings pa ni/ dga' snang bskyed pa'o/ / za ༅zaphugs 'ded pa ni/ khungs snyeg ka 'o/1 ༅za'aphra blangs pa ni/ byas 'phro slar lag— tu blangs pa'o/ / za3tshodabang bskur ba ni/ dbang 'khur du 'jug pa'o/ / mtshedabu brnyes pa ni/ mgo 'dzugs pa'o / 1 / 'a༅dbu bsnyungs pa ni/ mna' bskyal ba'o1—/ zo 148

bsdus ming spya ba'i bcud len/dbyed bsdum sa pa di/ rgyab 'gal ba'i phyogs gnyis 'grig par byas pa'o/ / da da dbyen sbyor ba ni/ phra ma gtong ba'o/ / tshoyomig 'apyid pa ni/ gangs kyis gnod nas mig mi gsal ba'am long bar 'gyar ba'o/ / kathosman bku ba ni/ snan gdus nas khu ba dbyung ba'o/ / za rtsis rgyab pa ni/ bgrang bya'i grangs mang nyung nges par byed pa'o/ / cho tshar bcad pa ni/ med par byas pa dang / rigs pas pham par byas pa'i don gnyis la 'jug pa'o/ / cho za tshe'atshigs dud pa ni/ rus tshigs kha zal ba'o/ / ༅zatshong brin pa ni/ tshong rgyug pa'o/ / tshematshod bgam pa ni/ nyams tshod brtag pa'o/ / mtshomatshang brtol ba ni/ nyes pa mngon par phyung ba'o/ / zazomatshang 'byin pa ni/ skyon mtshang dmar phyi la 'phud pa'o/ / zotshogazhang log pa ni/ gshang lam gyi rgyu kha phyi la dud pa'o/ / ༅lozhal bshus pa ni/ ma phyi ji bzhin bris pa'o/ / chuzagazhu bkang ba ni/ gzhu'i rgyud mda'i ltong la sprud nas 'then pa'o/ / zazazad bcad pa ni/ dgra thabs su zas mi za bar ltogs grir 'jug pa'o//143

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /zazadazungs shor ba ni1 lus 'tsho byed kyi stobs dang nus pa nyams pa'o/ 1 ma zarazong bkram pa ni tshong zog thang mar bsham pa'o/ 1 bsnye tshe(1zad)'og 'gyu ba ni/ rang gis kyang ma tshor bar shes pa rgya yan du 'phro ba'i don no/ / sa yo(tsho ma)yid ches pa ni/ blo thub pa'o/ / 4dajagayu la sprad pa ni/ 'thab res byas pa'o/ / ༅6shā ra bskor ba ni— gyang ra brdung ba'o/ / yo༅lorabs chad pa ni— rigs rgyud chad pa'o/ —/ chochorigs bsgris pa ni/ rang gis ma shes pa zhig shes zin pa'i rigs dang bsgros das 'jal blangs pa'o1 / ༅—sgo —lag thal ba ni/ lag tshod ma zin par 'khel mi nyan sa la bebs pa'o1 /za—shan 'byed pa ni/ khyad par gtod pa'o1 / 7 sems g.yo ba ni/ sems dga' sar shor ba'o/ / glo bsrol btod pa ni1 dpe lam gsar du zu ba'o/ / khye1masrid 'gog pa ni/ mngal du phu gu mi 'chag par byed pa'o/ / tsho'itshesrid bsnyung ba ni/ tshod bzung nas phru gu tsung nyung skye bar byed pa'o/ /shā.oṃ150

bsdus ming zaba'i bcud len—srid chags pa ni/ mngal 'dzin pa'o/ / rṣatshesrid zhig pa ni/ mngal gyi phru gu 'phyis pa'o/ / tsho༅srid bshegasu pa ni/ ma la chags rtsang bar byas pa'o/ / ma—1snyem(༅ku6)srid bsrung ba ni/ mngal chags skyob pa'o/ 1 rṣa gsug za ba ni1 skob tu rngan pa len pa'o/ 1 tshologasug brdzangs pa ni/ lkog tu rngan pa byin pa'o1 / bo༅gnyis/ las dang bya ba'i dbyeXb de 'dra mi gsal ba/las kyi dngos po bag la nyal ba ste/ yid kyi spyod yul yin pas1 rgyud la nges cha med na/ glo dur du shes par mi 'gyur bas/ ming gi tshogs pa ming rkyang bar 'khrul sla/ dper na1 thag gcod pa'i thag ni las te nges pa'i don dang / gcod pa ni las de dang 'brel ba'i bya ba ste/ byed po'i rtsol ba yin/tshig don ni nges par byed pa ste/ dpe chos rin chen spungs pa las/ 'dod pa'i kho thag zad kyis chod/ ces pas gsal lo/ /bed spyod pa'i bed ni las te phan pa'i don dang / spyod pa ni las dang 'brel ba'i bya ba ste byed po'i rtsol ba yin/ tshig don ni phan cha bkol ba ste/ klong chen snying tig gi khrid yigalas/ rgyu 'di thams cad nga rang kho na'i bed yid snyam nas spyod pa ste/ zhes pas gsal/ des na thag gcod pa'am/ bed spyod pa zhes pa dang rigs 'gres pa mtha' das tshig tu grub yod la/ ming gi dbang du btab na/ ming gi 151

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung tshogs pa las/ ming rkyang ba min mod/ deng gi skyes lha phal ba'i rtsom du/ thag gcod byed pa/ bed spyod btang ba/ sgro 'dogs g.yogs pa/ gros bsdus byas pa la sogs pa'i tshig skyon sa khyab rdo khyab tu byung don ci yin zhe na/ las dang bya ba bsdus pa'i ming gi tshogs pa 'di rigs ming rkyang du ngos bzung ba 'phyugs pa'i dbang gis/ las dang 'brel ba'i bya ba ni/ las kyi dngos po mtshon pa'i ming gi grub cha yin par dogs nas/ slar yang bya ba'i ming zhig sbyar ba yin te/ stag shar ba rgan por 'khrul nas lag rten byin pa'i dper song ngo skyon 'di rigs byung ba'i rtsa ba ni/ gzhan ngos nas bshad na/ deng gi mkhas pa kha cig gis/ bya ba'i ming la ming mtha' med/ ming mtha' sbyar na dngos po'i ming du gyur 'gro zer/ bshad tshul 'di ni log par smra ba kho bag cig red/ tshig sbyor du bya ba'i ming gi ming mtha' spyor mi sbyor skabs dang bstun dgos la/ don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i ming du bshad na/ bya ba'i ming las skul tshig ma gtogs dus gsum kun la ming mtha' yod dgos/ ming mtha' bsubs na dngos po'i ming du gyur pa yin/ dper na/ shar dang shar ba/ sems dang sems pa/ skyon dang skyon pa/ skyes dang skyes pa la sogs pa'i snga ma dngos po'i ming dang / phyi ra bya ba'i ming yin pa bsnyon du med do/ /bya ba'i ming gi ming mtha' yang pa ba gnyis las med/ thob thang ni/ ga da ba sa 152

bsdus ming rngo bcud len/na mar pa/ /nga 'a ra la mtha' med ba'o/ /ming mtha' pa ba min pa gzhan yin na/ dngos po'i ming ngo / /bya ba'i ming dngos po'i ming du 'jug pa yang yod/sdom pa ni bsdams pa'i da lha ba yin la/ tshul khrims kyi don du'ang 'jug pa lha bu'o/ /yin na yang bya ba'i ming dngos po'i ming du 'jug pa'i tshul tsam mthong nas/ bya ba'i ming la ming mtha' sbyar na dngos po'i ming du gyur 'gro zer na/ 'dra dpe rgyas bkab ma yin nam/ ming gi ngo bo la 'gyur tshul yod pa shes dgos/mkhas pa 'phyugs na 'dom gang / blun po 'phyugs na mtho gang / zhes pa lhar/ kha cig gis gong gsal gyi log par smra ba de legs bshad kyi tshad mar bzung nas1 bsgrigs te dpar pa'i ming mdzod dag las/ bya ba'i ming gi ming mtha' ha lam dor ba'i rkyen gyis/ tha snyad rig pa dman pa rnams kyis/ thag gcod/ bed spyod/ lta bu sogs la ming rkyang ngam dngos po'i ming tsam du 'dod thog yang bya ba'i ming zhig sbyar nas/ zag gcod byed/ ces dang / bed spyod btang 1 zhes pa lha bu sogs kyi tshig skyon byung ba red/rang ngos das bshad na/ lo tsā ba dang rtsom pa ba skor zhig tha snyad rig ba zhan pa'i dbang gis/ da lha bshad zin pa'i las dang bya ba bsdus pa'i ming gi tshogs pa 'di rigs dang/ bstan 'byur/ bsnyen bkur/ chu 'dzin/rdul brtsegs/ lha bu sogs dngos po'i ming dang bya ba'i ming gnyis mnyam du 163

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /sbyar nas don gyi ngo bo gzhan zhig ston pa'i ming rkyang ba'i rigs dang /mngon par shes pa/ rgyang das mthong ba/ btsan gyis gnon pa/ thub pa'i bstan pa/ lha bu sogs kyi phrad dang ming mtha' bsdus nas/ mngon shes/ rgyang mthong / btsan gnon/ thub bstan lhar tshig sna bsdus nas ming rkyang du gyur pa'i rigs 'di dag nya nyung mnyam bsres byas nas/ mkhris nad can gyis dung dkar ser por mthong ba red/las dang bya ba bsdus pa'i ming gi tshogs pa dang / ming rkyang ba'i khyad par legs par shes na/ de 'dra'i tshig skyon 'byung mi dpe'o— /de gnyis kyi 'byed byed ni/ las dang bya ba bsdus pa'i ming gi tshogs pa yin na1 de'i bar du sgra mang nyung ci rigs 'jug chog thag bcad pa la/ thag legs par bcad pa'am/ thag mi 'dra ba zhig bcad byung / zer ba rto bu dang / ming rkyang ba yin na/ de'i bar du sgra gcig kyang 'jug mi chog ye shes/ brtson 'grus/blo gros/ rgun 'brum/ lta bu sogs kyi bar du sgra gang rung gcig kyang 'jug sa mi 'gro'o/ /de yang / snga ma ni tshig kyang yin te/ tshig la bsring bskum gyi rang bzhin yod pa dang / phyi ma ni ming yin te/ ming las tshig sna bsdus pa'i ming ma gtogs bsring bskum gyi rang bzhin med do/ /tshig sna bsdus ba'i ming yin na/ de'i bar du phrad dang bcas pa sgra ci rigs shig sbyar na/ slar snga ma ji bzhin tshig tu gyur 'gro la/ blo 'dzin la blo la 'dzin pa dang / dud 'gro la 164

bsdus ba spu ba'i bcud len lus dud cing rkang lag bzhi bo sar spos das 'gro ba zhe na/ don gyi ngo bo ston pa'i ming de dag don gyi khyad par ston pa'i tshig tu gyur pa ma yin nam/gzhad yang / deng dus rgya bod skad gnyis shan sbyar gyi thad du/ nyog 'dzing ha cangs che bas skad gnyis shan spyar gyi ming mdzod bkol bar/legs nyes mam par dpyad nas blang dor ma zongs par bya rgyu ha cang gal che'o/ /lo stob rnams kyis rgya bod shan sbyar gyi tshig mdzod ces bya ba 'dra du ma zhig bsgrigs nas par du bskrun te/ skad gnyis smra ba rnams la lag cha zhig gnangs pa bka' drin che yang / ma dag rgyun 'byams kyis bod skad la gnod pa mi chung ba zhig bskur yod/don dril na gtso bo gsham gsal/gcig ni/ rgya skad kyi bya ba'i ming sgra gnyis ldan pa la lad mo byas nas/bod skad du u tshugs kyis bya ba'i ming gnyis re mnyam du sbyar kyang / rgya skad lhar bya ba mi ston pas/ skar yang bya ba'i ming zhig sbyar ba/ dper na/ tsholo('brim pa)la 'grem gtong byed zer ba/ sdeb sbyor nyams pa/ 4rdo ༅(sbong ba)la brgyud krod byed zer ba/ 'brel ma chags pa/ (bzung ba)la 'dzin gzung byas zer ba/ dus gsum gyi rnam bzhag nya nyung mnyam bsres/ marṣa(sdum pa)la 'dum sgrig byed zer ba/ bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba 'chol ba sogs/bod skad kyi tha snyad du mi 'grub bo/ /bod skad du bya ba'i ming don mthun pa'am/ 'brel chags pa'am/ ldog zla can gnyis re mnyam du sprul nas dngos 165

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung po'i ming du grub pa yod mod/ 'di 'dra'i sbyor tshul dper mi srid pa lha bu mgo chag bla brdol sogs dang /gnyis ni/ rgya skad kyi tha snyad gang zhig bod kyi skad dod ci yin ma shes na/ tha snyad gsar ba red ces snyad btags nas rtog bzo byas pa/ dper da/༅ba༅la bod skad du rgyud ris zer ba ma shes par/ ri mo deb chung du bsgyur ba/ don la ma 'byor ba/ da stang skyabs zer ba ma shes par/ nyal gur du bsgyur ba/ don gzhan ston par byur pa/ ༅༅la 'grul rgya zer ba ma shes par/ nyen zon dam bsgrags khrims zhes bsgyur pa/ ming min tshig min ha cang go dka' ba/ ma bar la srid bshig pa zer ba ma shes par/ phru gu bkog par bsgyur ba/ bzhad gad kyi gnas su gyur pa/ zal dga' 'dun zhes pa ma shes la/ mnyam kro'i tshogs 'du zhes bsgyur ba/ brjod mi bde ba lta du rdo chag btsan bsgrigs sogs dang /gsum ni/ bod mad kyi tha snyad mi nyung ba zhig gi don ma go ba'am rnyings song bsams nas mi bkol bar/ tha snyad gsar ba rang bzo byas pa1 dper na/ ba pa)tshol zhal lce khang dang / ba'i1mal zhal lce pa zhes ngo bo gcig pa'i tha snyad mi 'jug par/ 'dri gcod khang dang / 'dri gcod pa zhes bsgyur ba sus gsal/ mi noms kyi snang ngor shar ba/ 'dri gcod khang ni1 ka 1zang dang /'dri gcod pa ba1 zo 61zhes bya ba'o/ /༅1 ka zodaka sgyu sta1 ka(4)1 ka)la byed 166

brdus ming spya ba'i bcud lenatshig las tshig bya tshig mi zer bar/ gtso sum bka yul tshig rjod tshig ces bsgyur ba/ ༅snyed la tshig phrad mi 'jug par/ sgril tshig tu bsgyur ba/ lha du sa gsar gtol med sogs dang /bzhi ni/ rgya skad kyi tha snyad gcig ka bod skad du tha snyad du ma re bsgyur ba/ dper na/ mgol gtong 'gug skong 'then/ skong 'gug 'gug thabs—spo ba/ gtong ba bcas 'byur drug snang yang/ dod du 'byor ba spo ba zhes pa tsam las/ snga ma gsum ming du mi 'grub/ bzhi ba dang drug pa skabs bab kyi don ma yin pa lha bu mu to'i phye khug sogs dang /lnga ni/ rgya skad kyi tha snyad don en tsam 'dra sa yod pa du ma zhig la/bod skad kyi tha snyad gcig par byas pa/ dper na/ bka('on bsang ba) ༅ra(rtsad bcad pa) mtsho(mtha' brtag pa) za shā(dri smed) bsnye’(shul snyeg pa) ba(rjes gcod pa) tsho za(gting 'tshol ba)sogs la rtsad gcod ces tha snyad gcig gis bkab pa lta bu nad brgya sman gcig sogs rgya bod shan sbyar gyi tshig mdzod ces pa dag las sa khyab rdo khyab tu mthong ngo /ming mdzod cig yin na/ tha snyad gang bsdus thun mong du grags shing mthun par snang ba dang / skad gnyis shan sbyar ngo bo gcig pa dang tshig kha gsal zhing 'grel dag pa dang / rang skad kyi khyad chos lhun chags pa zhig dgos/ bcings grol byung ma/ lo ka'i bya ba ha cang gal che bar rtser pa'i sgo 167

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung 1nas/ rgya bod shan sbyar gyi tshig mdzod ces bya ba snga ba sngon mar 'khrungs byung /tshig mdzod 'di bsgrig 4ra/ dus kyis ded pa dang / mthun rkyen zhan pa'i dbang gis/ dag ma thon pa khag med kyang / lo tsā ba phal ba dang 1 skad gnyis sbyong ba rnams kyis tshig mdzod de tshad mar bzung zhing / legs nyes blang dor med par khyur mid byas pa las/ ma dag pa'i rgyun 'byams nas/bod skad kyi khyad chos nyams par 'gyur bzhin yod pas/ sum rtags dag gsum gyi dgongs par brten nas/ zad skad kyi srol bzang bo mi nyams gong 'phel du gtang rgyu ha cang gal che'o/ /da ni las dang bya ba'i dbye ba de 'dra mi gsal ba'i ming gi tshogs pa nyer mkho che ba skor zhig dper brjod par bya'o/ /dkar sdud pa ni/ las dge ba tre par dngul gyi zhal 'debs slong ba'o/ / cho bskyed bsring ba ni/ shes bya'i yon tan nam rig pa skyong ba'o/ / 1mi kha btags pa ni/ char bcad pa ste/ kha dag zhabs rdzobs1 lta bu'o/ / tshotsho khod snyom pa ni/ cha mnyam par byed pa'o/ / tshe1— 3khyim glong ba ni/ dmigs bya gang zhig btsal ched/ khyim nang slog pa'o1 //zhe za go bsdur ba ni/ thod gtugs pa'o/ / za1tsho168

brdus ming dba'i bcud len/gyong bskur ba ni/ dge kha shor ba'o/ / cho—gros bsdur ba ni/ bsam 'char bsdur ba'o/ / cho mabagro gleng ba ni/ mi'am dod du bzang ngan gyi lha tshul bshad pa'o/ / masnye6sbyid lug pa ni/ le lo'i dbang du shor ba'o/ / tshotsho ngu zo ba ni/ ngu rgyu yong ba'o/ / lha༅ngo log pa ni/ rgyab ba/tad pa'o/ / tshe zarngo thogs pa ni/ thub pa'i don no/ / cho4gcom sgyung ba ni/ khengs pa snyal ba'o/ / mo chag phebs pa ni/ byon pa ste/ chag ni 'chab pa ste bya ba'i ming dngos po'i ming du 'jug pa yin/ chag la phyag bris pa ma dag pa'o1 / zalgachud gzan pa ni/ rgyu rdzas 'phro brlag tu song ba'o/ / khorngonyams dpyad pa ni/ tshod lha ba'o/ / smo1zoganya' bcag pa ni/ stobs kyis bsdigs nam mgo sgur bar byas pa'o/ /mkhye11gnya' cha pa ni/ dpa' zhum pa'o/ / za gnyer gtad pa ni/ don bcol nas gnyer du 'jug pa'o/ / ba snyad brkos pa ni/ snyad ka btsal ba'o/ /ma1169

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung snyad btags pa ni/ kha g.yar ba'i don yin/ / tshetshosnyad gtses pa ni/ snyad btsal nas gnod pa bskyal ba'o/ / lngatshorta gcag pa ni/ rta khrid nas 'chag par byed pa'o1 / ༅zastabs gzab pa ni/ bag zon pa'o/ / zadamathog drangs pa ni/ mgo bslangs pa'o/ / shāshādag bsdur ba ni/ yig cha tshad ldan dang bsdur nas dag par bcos pa'o/ / shud1dam bca' ba ni/ khas len pa'o/ / shāka1 1 dran bslangs pa ni/ dran pa bskyed pa'o/ / za ’ dril bsgrags pa ni/ bka' shog zang bkral nas bton cing bsgrags pa'o/ / zachomador bsdus pa ni1 don gyi snying bo dril ba'o1 / chochomana' sgag pa ni/ mna' skyel bar 'jug pa'o/ / chu༅jo dpyad bzod pa ni/ brtag thub pa'i/ / hūṃ31zhe༅dpyas btags pa ni/ 'phya smod byas pa'o/ / da / tshe dpyis phyin pa ni/ mthar thug pa'o/ / mi)chophung g.yo ba ni/ dgrug shing rgyag pa'o/ / zad(bag phab pa ni/ sems bde bar byed pa'o/ / zab 160

bsdus ming sgyu ba'i bcud len/bro 'tshal ba ni/ na tsha byung ba'o/ / ji dbang sgyur ba ni/ dbang gi kha lo skor ba'o/ / mtsho 'bur 'joms pa ni/ rkyen ngan pa'i myu gu 'bur du thon ma thag 'phral du 'joms pa'o—/ / ba ra( das mo'i)dbugs byung ba ni/ sdug bsngal las bsgral ba'o/ / za rtsa 'gags pa ni/ bshang ba mi 'bab pa'o/ / so/rtsa brtag pa ni1 rtsa'i 'phar stangs brtags shing dpyad pa'o/ / bamotshags bsgribs pa ni/ mgo rnga yod par bsgrigs bad/ / chozazhabs 'dren pa ni/ ngo tsha nyo ba'o/ / zos bzhin 'dzum pa ni1 dgod kha shor ba'o/ / 'o༅zong 'grim pa ni/ brtsang bya'i dngos po phar tshur nyo tshong rgyag pa 'o/ / lo—bsnye’za'on bsang ba ni/ lon tshor bar snyeg pa'o/ 1zayoyo bsrang ba ni/ yo song sa drang mor bsrang ba ste/ dag par bcos pa'o/ka༅ra 'phrod pa ni/ ra sprad nas 'phrod pa'o/ / 1 1za ra ro ba ni/ chang gis bzi ba'i rnam pa/ tshozalongs spyod pa ni/ 'tsho tshis bkol ba'o/ / sgyu zoshan 'byed pa ni/ khyad par gtad pa'o// mazo161

dag yib rid pa'i bab pa mngon jing shan sbyar ni/ yig rigs gnyis sprags mar sbyar pa'o/ / shā1 lnga shan zhugs pa ni/ slad 'dres pa'o/ / ka'irṣashed stoms pa ni/ grangs kyi cha shas mi mnyam pa dag snyom par byed pa'o// lta bshol 'debs pa ni/ dus tshod phyir rgyang ba'o/ 1 ༅zasun phyung ba ni/ bshad tshul don dang 'gal ba la dgag par byas pa'o//mcho gsum pa/ ming gi tshogs pa bsdus pa/ming gnyis nas bzhi'i bar gyi tshogs pa bang ci'i ming sna'am/ tshig sna'am/ tsheg dbar bsdus nas/ sgra so so res don gyi ngo bo so so re ston par byed pa zhig yin/ 'di la grangs kyi sgo nas rnam ji1 gsum snang /gcig ming gnyis kyi tshogs pa bsdus pa/ming gnyis kyi ming sna'am tshig sna bsdus nas/ sgra gnyis res dod gyi ngo bo gnyis re ston pa ste/ bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur la bka' bstan/—skyes thob kyi shes rab dang sbyangs stobs kyi yon tan la skyes sbyangs/ ngo bo ——skyed byed kyi rgyu dang khyad par skyed byed kyi rkyen la rgyu rkyed/ sgro 'dogs dang —skur 'debs laXsgro skur/ rnga dang cha lang la rnga gshang / nyan thos dang rang ——sa ngas rgyas la nyan rang / mchod gnas dang yon bdag la mchod ngo na/nga —brtan pa sdod kyi 'jig rten dang g.yo ba bcud kyi sems can la brtan g.yo/162

bsgyus ming ma ba'i bcud len/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang rigs drug gi 'gro ba la bstan 'gro/ drang don — —dang nges don la drang nges/ rdo rje dang dril bu la rdor dris/ nyon shes kyi sgrib —— —— ——— pa mtha' dag spangs shing ji lha ji snyed kyi shes bya thams cad rtogs pa la spangs rtogs/ 'bul ba dang zhabs tog la 'dul zhabs/ 'u nga dang rigs pa ——la lung rigs/ lo tsā ba dang paṇḍi ta la lo paṇa/ sa bcu dang lam lnga la sa lam/—— — ——— ——srid pa 'khor ba dang zhi ba skyang 'das la srid zhi/ sum cu ba dang rtags kyi ——'jub pa la sum rtags/ rtsa ba dang 'grel ba la rtsa 'grel/ lha bu sogs dang /——— ——gnyis/ ming gsum gyi tshogs pa bsdus pa/'brel chags pa'i ming gsum gyi ming sna'am tshig sna bsdus nas1 sgragasum res don gyi ngo bo gsum re ston pa yin zhing / grangs nges pa dang brjod bde bar de mthar gsum zhes bya ba sbyar nas bsdus pa'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /dus rabs brgyad pa bod rgyal khri srong skabs kyi lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs dang / cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan dang / zhang ye shes sde bcas la ska —cog zhang gsum zer/jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i slob ma'i gtso bo khu brtson 'grus g.yung drung dang / rngog legs pa'i shes rab dang / 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas bcas la khu rngog 'brom gsum zer/—163

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /mkhan po bo rnyi sa twa dang / slob dngo na pad ma sam bha ba bang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan bcas la mkhan slob chos gsum zer/——— nga bka' brgyud pa'i bstan pa'i sro' 'byed mkhan ma ra ba lo tsā ba dab /mi la ras pa dang /dwags po lha rje dag la mar mi dgab gsum zer/rgyal bo glang da gyis bstan pa bsgrubs nga /—bab ba mdod phyogs su byon nas/ bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad pa'i slob dpon smar shākya mu ne dang /g.yo dge ba'i 'byung gnas dang /gtsang ba rab kas — bcas la sma ra g.yo gtsang gsum zer/—————— —srong tsan sgam po dab /khri srong sde btsan dang /khri btsug lde btsan la mes dbon rtsam gsu ma zhe'o//——sangs rgyas kyi sku 'dra dang / gsung rab glegs bam dang / gzungs gzhug gi mchod rten bcas la sku gsung thugs rten zer nga —— ——— chos sku/longs sbu/sprul sku gsum la chas longs sprul sku zer/nga nga — —rtsa dbu ma dang /rkyang ma rang /ro ma la dbu rkyang ro gsum zer/nga — — —bod yul a mdo dang /da dus gtsang dab/khams bcas la mdo dbus — nga bams gsum zer—dkon chen se ra dang / 'bras spungs dang / dga' ldan la se 'bras ——dbe gsum zer———64

bsdus ming ba pab4 bcud len shes bya rtogs pas mkhas pa dang / tshub khrims gtsang bas btsun pa dang / lhag bsam dag pas bzang ba bcas la mkhas btsun bzang gsum ————zer/mkhyen pa dang /brtse ba dang /nus pa bcas la mkhyen brtse nus gsum———nga zer/rigs lam spyang ba la/gzhan lugs dgag pa/rang lugs gzhag pa/rtsod pa spang ba bcas la dgag gzhag spang gsum zer/——nga nga —mkhas pa'i bya ba/'chad pa dang /rtsod pa dang /rtsom pa la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum zer/nga nga sgrub byed kyi rtags dang /bsgrub bya'i chos dang bsgrub ga ka'i don la rtags chos don gsum zer/— nga —byed bde gtso phal gnyis dang /las rdo bya ba'i yul dang bsgrub bya gnyisadang / bya bde bdag 'brel gnan 'brel gnyis kyi bcas la bya byed las gsum —zer/mtshan nyid dang / mtshon bya dang / mab na gzhi bcas la mtsha par gzhi gsum zer/nga ——bdag tu 'dzin pa bang / legs par skyong ba dang gong du spel ba 'a 'dzin skyong spel ba'o————66

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa 4ngon phyung/gzhi lta ba gtan la phab pa dang lam sgom pas nyams su blangs pa dang /'bras bu byang chub thob pa 'a gzhi lam 'bras gsum zer/—nga — — ——nga —tha snyad gang zhig don la dmib par shes pa/sgra las byung bar brjod pa/tshim da tu sbyor bar 'jug pa bcas la shes brjod 'jug gsum zhe'o//———————sngar mi bsad pa'i stong du/ gser dngu' sogs rtsa chen rigs la smar dang /ror lug sogs go chod rigs la khrag dang /yo byad sogs spus zhan rigs la zong /zhes 'jal rgyu bo la smar khrag zong gsum zer/———— bzhan nor brkus pa'i khrims su/skyin pa'am/'khri 'jal lam/dngos tshab bcas la skyin 'khri tshab gsum zer/——ka ra dang /du ram dang /sprung rtsi dag la kar dur sbrang gsum zer/———— — —sman a ru ra dang ba ru ra dang /kyu ru ra la a bar kyur gsum zer/———— —gla rtsi dang /dom mkhris dang /bog rwa la rtsi mkhris bog gsum zer/ —nga nga —gro dang nas dang sran ma la gro nas sran gsum dang / de bzhin du rta ————— —nor lug gsum/zho mar phyur gsum/zhwa gos lham gsum/mda' gri mdung — nga — nga nga gsum/nyi zla skar gsum/lo zla tshes gsum sogs rigs 'gre'o//——gsum/ ming bzhi'i tshogs pa bsdus pa/rigs mthun pa'am/ 'brel chags pa'i ming bzhi mnyam du bsdus nas don gyi ngo bo mi 'dra ba bzhi re ston pa zhig ste/ stag gzig dom dred ni/—— nga nga 66

bsgyus ming rngo ba'i bcud lenagacan gzan gtum po bzhi ste rigs mthun pa dang / dbyar ston dgun nga nga —nga nga dpyid ni/lo gcig gi dus tshigs bzhi ste 'brel chags pa'o/de bzhin/—skyes pa pho dang /skyes ma mo dang rgad rgon dang /gzhon nu bcas kyi bsdus ming la/pho mo rgan gzhon zer—thog mar skye ba/rim gyis rga ba/na tshas gdung ba mtha' mar 'chi ba ste/skye go na 'chi ni/mi tshe gang bo'i gnas skabs bzhi'o//——nad gdon bar chad zhi bar byed pa'i las bang tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas par gtong ba'i las dang / lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdud pa'i las dang /ma rungs dgra bgegs drag pos sgrol ba'i las la / zhi rgyas dbang drag ce'o//— sa skya ba dang /dga' ldan pa dang / ka' rgyud pa dang rnying ma ba la/sa dge bka' rnying bzhir grags/—mgo 'jog dang /smad 'dogs dang /sngon 'ju la dang /mtha' rten te/mgo 'dogs 'am la rten ni/ming gzhi'i yad lag bzhi'o//—ldab kyis sgyur ba/mnyam par bgo ba/nyung du 'phri ba/mang du gtong ba bcas/sgyur phri bso snon ni brtsi thabs bzhi'o//——gong gsal ltar/nyi zla gza' skar/sa chu me rlung /gse dngul zangs nga nga lcags shar lho nub byang /mthong thos dran reg ma gnyan shā gtsod sogs ——67

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung /rigs bsgro bar bgyi'o/ 1gzhan yang / ming lnga yan chad bsdus ba bzo zhing tshong slob dmarga—————— —zhing nags phyugs zhor nya/ pho long rgyu mkhris bsam bse'u sgang / lta bu yod ———— ———— —kyang 1 sgra mang la brjod mi bde bas/ ngag gi phreng bar grub pa nyung ngo / / bzhi ba/ grangs dang bgrang bya bsdus pa/khongs gcig tu gtogs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs ci tsam yod pa cig car bstan pa zhig ste/ 'di 'dra'i tha snyad cig gam tshig ka thung ngu zhig khong du chud na/ rten cing 'grel bar grub pa'i shes bya'i phreng ba zhig mnga' brnyes par 'gyur la/ de lugs khong du chud pa lhag ba ba na/ shes rgya lhag par che bar 'gyur srid/ grangs dang bgrang bya bsdus pa ni/ shes rab spel ba'i bdam ngag cig ste/ don du ma cig car blo la 'dzin sla ba/ ngag tu brngod bde ba/ bri la 'gros mgyogs ba 'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pas/ 'dir dper brjod kyi tshul du chos kyi rnam grangs nyer mkho che ba skor zhig 'tshol bde ba'i ched du tshan khag rags pa tsam bgos nas bkod pa la/gcig lo rgyus kyi thad du/gnam gyi khri bdun ni/ sngar bod rgyal thog ma gnya' khri btsan po nas bzung ste/ nu khri dang / ding khri/ so khri/ mer khri/ gdags khri/ srib khri cas rgyal bo bdun po shi dus nam mkhar gshegs skad 'dug bas/ gnam gyi khri 168

bsgyus ming spu ba'i bcud len/bdun zhes grags so/ /stod kyi steng gnyis ni1btsan po srib khri'i rjes kyi gri gum —btsan po dar /pu de kun rgyal gnyis so/ / bar gyi legs drug ni/ pu de gung rgyal rjes kyi ye sho legs/ de sho legs1ji sho legs/ gu ru legs/ 'brong zhe legs/ i sho tshe rje sgyugs rnams so/ / sa yi lde brgyad ni/ btsan po i sho legs rjes kyi za nam zid sde/ lde 'phrul nam gzhung / se snal gnam lde/ se snang po lde/ snol nam/ lde sgom po/ lde rgyal bo/ lde spren btsan rnams so/ /'og gi btsan dgu ni/ lde smin btsan rjes kyi to re lung btsad/— khri btsan nam/ khri dgre dpung btsan/ khri tho rje btsan/ lha tho tho ri snyan btsan/ khri snyad gzung btsan/ 'brong snyad lde'u btsan/ stag ri gnyad gzigs btsan1gan— ri srong btsan rnams so/ /bod spyi'i rgyal rabs bcu ni/ srong btsan snam po/ mang sror mang btsan/'dus srong mang bo rje/ khri lde gtsug brtad/ khri srong lde btsan/ mu ne btsad po/ nu tig btsan po/ khri lde srong btsan(sad na legs)/ khri ral ba can(khri gtsug lde btsan)/ 'u dum btsad po(glang dar ma)rnams so/ /chos rgyal mes dbon dam gsum ni/ srong btsan sgam po dang / khri srong ——lde btsan dang / khri ral ba can no/ 1169

dag yig rig pa'iXgab pa mngon phyung /rgyal bo srong btsan sgam po'i mdzad chen lnga ni/ bod spyi'i yi gogs) du —mdzad par bcug pa dang gcig rus rgyud tsho ba dmas rgyal khab gcig gi mnga' 'og khug pa dang gnyis/ dmag las dang srid 'dzin zung 'brel lam lugs tshugs pa dang gsum/ mi rigs rang nyid kyi rig gnas spel thog mi rigs gzhan dag gi rig gnas dang lag rtsal drangs nas bslabs pa dang bzhi/ rgya bod mi rigs bar dang / bal bod mi rigs bar dang bcas pa'i 'grig mthun rgya cher btang ba dang lnga'o/ /'phrul blon mdzangs mi bdun ni/ pu de gung rgyal skabs kyi ru las skyes1 e sho legs skabs kyi lha bu mgo dkar/ stag ri gnyan gzigs skabs kyi ngor snang btsan mang / srong btsan snam po'i skabs kyi thon mi sam sgo ṭa dang /bzang yang ston snyags/ khri srong lde btsun skabs kyi mgos khri bzang yab lhag dang / stag btsan gdong bzigs noms so/ /mi'u rigs bzhi ni/ se/ ku/ ldong / stong ste/ bod kyi thog ma'i rigs —bzhi'o/ /mi'u gdung drug ni/ se/ nu1 ldong / stong / dbra/ 'bru ste/ spra nas mched pa'i bod kyi rus rgyud drug go/gnyis/ yul gru'i thad du—ming bzhi sping phran brgyad ni/ ri rab kyi phyogs bzhi rgya mtshor chags 170

bsdus ming spru ba'i bcud len/pa'i gling chen bzhi ste1 shar lus 'phags gling / lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyad no/ /ri rab kyi mtshams bzhir chags pa'i lus dang lus 'phags1 rnga yab dang ngo yab gzhan/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro1 sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla ste/ gling zan brgyad do/ / — 'dzam gling gi gnas mchog lnga ni/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'di 'i dbus na thub ——— ———nga — pa'i bzhugs gnas rdo rje gdan/ shar na 'jam dbyangs kyi bzhugs gnas ri bo rtse lnga/ lho na sprun ras gzigs kyi bzhugs gnas ri bo gru 'dzin/ nub na mkha' 'gro'i bzhugs gnas u rgyan— byang na rigs ldan gyi bzhugs gnas sham bha la'o/ /gnas chen brgyad ni/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa sku bltams pa'i gnas — —————nga —lum be'i tshal/ chos 'khor dang bo bskor ba'i gnas wa ra ṇa si/ chos ba khor gnyis pa bskor ba'i gnas yangs pa can/ chos 'khor gsum pa bskor ba'i gnas bya rgod phung bo'i ri/ cho 'phrul bstan pa'i gnas mnyan yod/ sangs rgyas pa'i gnas rdo rje gdan/ dka' ba spyad pa'i gdas chu bo rte ra lha1 sku skya ngan las 'das pa'i gnas tsā mchog grong ngo / /kha 'bab bzhi ni/ gangs ti si'i phyogs bzhi nas 'bab pa'i chu mgo ——'byung sa bzhi ste/ shar yar klung gtsang po'i chu mgos mchog kha 'bab/ lho gang gra'i chu mgo rma bya'i kha 'bab/ nub sin cu'i chu mgo glang chen kha 'bab/171

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /byang si ta'i chu mgo seng ge'i kha 'bab bo /chu bo ched po zhi ni/ rgya gar gyi gang shā/ si sna/ pa'i/ ya mu na bzhi'o/ /stod mnga' ris skor gsum ni/ bod yul stod smad bar gsum du zud ————pa'i stod phyogs kyi spu hrengs dang / mang yul dang / zangs dkar gsum skor gcig zhang zhung dang / khri te stod smad gsum skor gcig 'chim mam le dang / zu sha dang / sbal ti gsum skor gcig ste mnga' ris skor gsum du grags so/ /bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi ni/ bod yul stod smad bar gsum du phyed pa'i bar phyogs te/ sngar rgyal bo srong btsan skabs gtsang la g.yas ru dang ru lag dbus la da du ru dang g.yo rur bye bas dbus gtsang ru bzhi zhe'o/ /smad mdo khams sgang drug ni/ bod yul gyi smad phyogs zal mo sgang / tsha ba sgang / smar khams sgang / spo 'bor sgang / dmar rdza sgang / mi nyag rab sgang bcas drug go —chu bzhi ni/ mdo stod kyi chu bzhi ni/ 'bri chu/ rma chu/ rgyal mo rdul chu/ rdza —chu'o/ /bod chol kha gsum ni/ dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha/ mdo stod mi yi —chol kha/ mdo smadaka༅ chol kha'o/ /khri skor bcu gsum ni/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas se chen rgyal 172

bsdub ming za ba'i bcud len1bo'i bka' 'bri bzhin dbus gtsang la dbang bsgyur skabs tshugs pa'i khri skor sa khul te/ la rtsod lho byang gnyis dang / gur mo1 chu mig shangs/ zha lu ste gtsang ka khre skor drug rgya ma/ 'bri gung / tshal ba/ thang bo che/ phag mo gru/g.ya' bzang ste dbus la khri skor drus dbus gtsang gi mtshams su yar 'brob/ stag lung khri skor gcig ste khri skor bcu gsum mo/ /bod yul rgya mtsho bzhi ni/ ma pham g.yu mtsho/ gnam mtsho/ snub mtsho/nga —————mtsho sngon po'o/ /bod yu la gling dgu ni/ stod na gu ge pu trengs/ mang yul te gsum/— ———————smar na rab sgang / smad khams sgang / tsha ba sgang ste gsum/ bar na dbus/gtsang gnyis/ dwabs kong ye myal bzhi gcig tu bgrangs pas bod yul gling dgu'o/ 1'phying ba rtse drug ni— sngar bod kyi btsan po legs drub skabs 'phyongs —— —————rgyas su btab pa'i pho brang drug ste/ stag rtse/ rgod rtse/ yang rtse/ khri rtse/ rtse mo khyung rgyal/ khri brtsegs 'dum gdugs bcas so/ /hor khog khag lnga ni1 dkar mdzes bod rang skyong khul gyi rta'u dang /———————brag mgo dang / tre bo dang / dkar mdzes dang / stong skor nams so/ /ri bo rtse lnga ni/ ri bo dwangs bsil yang zer la/ ri rtsa ba gcig la rtse mo lnga ste/ dbus su gser gyi ri bo seng ge 'gyings 'dra/ shar du shel gyi ri bo 173

dag yis rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung/glang chen 'gyings 'dra/ lho ru a kro'u ri bo rta mchog nyal 'dra/ nub tu pad ma rā ka'i ri bo rma bya gar byed pa 'dra/ byang du ind+ra ni la'i ri bo shang shang bsnal ba 'dra'o/ /sa yi dge bcu ni/ khang sa zhing sa sa yi dge 'thung chu zhing chu chu yi dasebam 'brog rgyang 'bros tsā yi dge khang shing bud shing shing si dge khang rdo thab rdo rdo yi dge'o/ /chu'i yan lag brgyad ni/ bsil ba/ zhim pa/ yang ba/ 'jam pa/ dwangs —pa / dri ma med pa/ lto bar mi gnod ba 1 mgrin par mi gnod pa'o/ /gsum/ bslab bya'i thad du/rigs gnas che ba lnga ni/ sgra rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ gso ba rig pa/ tshad —ma'am gtan tshigs rig pa/ nang don rig pa'o1 /rig gnas chung ba lnga ni/ skar rtsis/ snyan ngag mngon brjod/ sdeb sbyor1————zlos gar ro/ /sman gyi rgyud bzhi ni/ g.yu thog yon tan mgon pos mdzad pa'i sman gzhung rtsa rgyud/ bshad rgyud/ man ngag rgyud/ phyi ma'i rgyud bzhi'o/ /rig byed bzhi ni/ mchod sbyin/ nges brjod/ srid srung / snyan tshig go /gzhung pod lnga ni/ phar phyid dang / dbu ma dang / tshad ma rnam 'grel dang / 'dul ba dang / mdzod dang lnga'o/ /114

bsdus ming spya ba'i bcud len/tshad ma sde bdun ni slob dpon chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i rgyas pa ——nga ——tshad ma rnam 'grel/ 'bring ba tshad ma rnam nges/ bsdus pa tshad ma rigs thigs te/lus lta du'i bstan bcos gsum / gtan tshigs jigs pa / 'brel ba brtag pa/ rgyud gzhan spub pa/ rtsod pa'i rig pa ste yan lag lha bu'i bstan bcos bzhi bcas so/bslab ba gsum ni/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa 'dul ba dang /————lhag pa nying nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa mdo sde dang /lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa mngon pa ste gsum mo/bslab la 'jug pa'i 'du shes drug ni/rang la nad pa lha bu'i 'du shes/chos nga bar blta bu'i nga /nga 'e bshes gnyen la sman pa lha bu'i 'du shes/yon tan nyams su len pa la nad 'tsho ba'i 'du shes/chos kyi tshul la ring du gnas pa'i 'du shes/ de bzhin gshegs pa la skyes bu dam pa'i 'du shes rnams so/dag pa gsum ni/nyan pa bo'i snod dag pa/'chad pa bo'i ngag dag pa/—gsung rab kyi brjod bya dag pa'o//chings lnga ni/ gzhung chen klog skabs kyi ching sa lnga ste/ khog dbug stong thun gyi chings/ sa bcad rnam 'byed kyi chings/ 'bre' ba 'bru 'grel gyi chings/bsdus pa don gnad kyi chings/lag len man ngag gi chings rnams 6

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /so/ /bshad thabs yan lag lnga ni/ dgos don/ bsdus don/ tshig don/——mtshams sbyor/ brgal lan rnams so/ /rin chen dam gsum ni/ rigs lam phra mo 'byed pa'i dam dpyod dang //gzhung lugs gdams par shar ba'i nyams len dang //tshig sbyor tshul la mkhas pa'i ngag gi dpal/ /sa steng 'di na rin chen rnam gsum snang / /zhes rje tsong kha bas gsungs so/ /bzlas pa'i skyon drug ni/ ha ca nga ring ba/ ha cang thung ba/ ha cang ———mthogs pa/ ha cang dal ba/ ha cang drag pa/ ha cang zhan pa rnams so/ /ba'i/ sgra'i thad du/yi ge skyed pa'i rgyu bzhi ni/ gzhi'i rgyu skye gnas dang / 'byin pa'i rgyu byed pa dang / skul ba'i rgyu rnam rtog dang / skyod pa'i rgyu rlung dang bzhi'o— /yi ge'i skye gnas brgyad ni/ dog pa'i ba nas la mgrin pa sna dang spyi bo'i ——kad spubs gsum dang/ yangs pa'i gnas la khog rkan lce so mchu lnga dang brgyad do/ /yi ge'i byed pa drug ni/ mchu dang mgrin pa'ang byed par 'jug kyang /—rtse gtso bo yin/ byed pa gnas dang phrad pa dang / cung zad phrad pa dang /btsum pa dang / zu ba dang / dog pa dang / yangs pa drug go /176

bsdus ming spya ba'i bcud len/yi ge 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad ni/ sgra skad ming dang mtshan ma dang / /bad dang tha snyad tshig don brgyad/ /ming du grub pa'i chos lnga ni/ don la dmigs pa/ sgra las byung ba/ thud —mong du grags pa/ mthun par snang ba/ mngon par zhen pa'o/ /ming gi rigs bzhi ni/ dngos po'i ming / khyad chos kyi ming / bya ba'i ming / grangs ka'i ming ngo / /bya ba rigs gsum ni/ bdag dang 'brel ba'i bya ba ste byed po'i rtsol ba/gzhan dang 'grel ba'i bya ba ste las kyi 'gyur ba/ bdag gzhan gang la'ang ma 'brel ba'i bya ba ste ngang gis byung ba'o/ /rnam dbye brgyad ni/ ngo bo tsam brjod pa1 'bril ba/ byed pa/ las su bya ba/ dgos ched/ rten gnas/ 'byung khungs/ 'bod sgra'o/ —sgra'i nga ro lnga ni/ ma'i dbyangs dang ldan pa drang ba/ gug gu can bkug pa/ zhabs kyu can smad pa/ 'greng bu can sgrong ba/ na ro can bstod pa ste/dbyangs kyi nga ro lnga'ang bya'o1 /nga ro rtsa ba gsum ni/ ma dang / ha dang / 'a gsum mo/ / mtshams sbyor lnga ni/ ming gi mtshangs sbyor/ dbyangs kyi mtshams spyor/—rang bzhin gyi mtshams sbyor/ gsal byed kyi mtshangs sbyor/ dam bcad kyi mtshams sbyor ro/ /177

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /rgya rim pa bdun ni/ 'bru mi 'khrug pa tsheg gi rgya/ tshig mi 'khrug pa shad —kyi rgya/ tshig don mi 'khrug pa le'u'i rgya/ sho lo ka mi 'khrug pa bam po'i rgya/bam po mi 'khrug pa bam grangs kyi rgya/ mtha' mi 'chal ba sne thig gi rgya/glegs bam mi 'khrug pa gdong yig gam spyan khyer gyi rgya'o/ /tshig rgyan rigs gsum ni/ don rgyan dang / sgra rgyan dang/ gab tshig gi rgyan no/ /don rgyan so lnga ni/ rang bzhin brjod dang dpe dang ni/ /gzugs can gsal byed bskor ba dang / /'gog dang don gzhan bkod pa dang / /ldog pa can da nga srid pa can/ /bsdus brjod phul byung rab rtogs dang — /rgyu dang phra mo cha dang rim/ /dga' ba nyams ldan gzi brjid can/ /dam grangs brjod dang kun tu phan/ /rgya che bsnyon dor sbyar ba dang / /'gal dang skabs mid bstod pa dang / /zol bstod nges bstan lhan cig brngod/ /yongs brjes shis brjod rab spel dang / /dgongs pa can te so lnga 'o/ / sgra rgyan gyi rtsa ba'i dbye ba gsum ni/ yi ge bskor ba'i zung ldan dang / 1bya dka'i rnam grangs gzhan dang ni/ /dbyangs sogs nges pa'i bya dka' 'o/ /gab tshig gi rgyan gyi dbye ba cu drug ni/ kun tshogs slu byed rim pa bral/ /rab bcom mthun gzugs tsub modang / /grangs dang rab btags ming du 'dus/ /bsgribs dang mthun sgra rmongs pa dang / /yongs 'phrog gcig 178

bsdus ming spya ba'i bcud len/bsgribs gnyis ka bsgribs/ /yongs su 'dres dang bcu drug go /snyan tshig bcad ma'i gnad bzhi ni/ tsheg dbar mang nyung gcig pa/ cha ——nga ———ya do mnyam pa/ sdeb legs pa/ srog dam pa'o/ /snyan ngag bcad ma'i rigs bzhi ni/ sbyor tshul sgo nas grol ba dang / /rigs dang mdzod dang 'dus pa bzhi'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan bcu ni/ sbyar ba rab dwangs mnyam nyid dang //— snyan dang shin tu gzhon dang / /don gsal ba dang rgya che ba/ / jid dang mdzes dang ding nge 'dzin1 /snyan ngag gi skyon bcu ni/ don nyams don 'gal don gcig pa/ /the tshom can dang rim nyams dang / /sgra nyams gcod mtsha sa nyams pa dngad /sdeb sbyor nyams dang mtshams sbyor nyams/ /yul dus sgyu rtsal 'jig rted dang / /lung rigs dag dang 'gal ba 'o/ /rol mo rigs gnyis ni/ lhan skyes kyi rol mo dang / rkyen bzhan las ———byung ba'i rol mo'o /gsung dbyangs yan lag lnga ni/ 'brug sgra lhar zab pa/ snyan zhing 'jibs la rna bar snyan pa/ yid du 'ong zhing dga' bar byed pa/ rnam par gsal zhing rig par byed pa/ mnyan 'os shing mi mthun pa med pa'o/ /gru dbyangs kyi nges pa bdun ni/ drug skyes drang srong sa 'dzin bar ma ba —179

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /dang / /lnga ldan dang ni blo gsal 'khor nyan no/ /drug skyes rma bya'i skad lhar sgrog /drang srong ba lang skad kyis rtsom/ /sa 'dzin skyes ni ra yi skad/ /bar ma khrung khrung sgra sgrog bzhin/ /lnga ldan me tog ldan dus su/ /khu byug skad snyan sgrog lha bu/ /blo gsal rta skad lha bur 'tsher/ /'khor nyan glang bo'i spra lta bu'o/ /rtsed mo zlog par blang ba ni/ bar ma dang ni lnga ldad dbyangs/ /dpa' bo drag po ngo mtshar du/ /drug skyes drang srong de bzhin no/ /sa 'dzin pa dang 'khor nyan dbyangs/ /snying rje'i ro la blang bar bya/ / 'thab mo 'jigs dang bcas pa la/ /blo gsal dbyangs ni blang bar bya'o/ /gar gyi nyams dgu ni/ sgeg pa/ dpa' ba/ mi sdug pa ni lus gyi nyams gsum/ drag shul/ bzhad gad/ 'jigs rung ni ngag gi nyams gsum/ snying rje/rngam pa/ zhi ba ni yid kyi nyams gsum mo1 /zlos gar gyi yan lag bzhi ni/ mdo 'dzin pa/ rol mo ba/ cas su zhugs —pa/ bzhad gad pa'o/ /glu ngag gi nga ro bzhi ni/ 'dren pa dang ni bkug pa dang / /bsgyur ba —dang ni ltengs nyid do/ /(sa paṇa gyi rol mo'i bstad bcos las gsal/)de yang 'dren pa ni dbyangs kyi nga ro lnga ste/ drang bo sgrong dang bkug pa dang / /bstod dang smad pa'i nga ros drangs/ /bkug pa ni ngag ge khugs pa ste/ khugs la rkyang dang brtsegs pa ste/ /de la gnyis gsum bzhi sogs so/ /bsgyur ba ni sna 180

brdus ming spu ba'i bcud len/lce mgrin pas sgra 'gyur bar byed pa ste/ bsgyur la mgrin lce sna ldan te/ /de la ring dang thung gnyis sbyar/ /ltengs ni ngag gi deb ring zung ste/ lteng bza ring dang thung ba ste/ /de la khyad par thog mtha' reg /ngag gi rtsal gsum ni/ lo rgyus kyis dge thon pa1 ga ma gyis bzhad gad thon pa/ shags kyis pha ro la non pa'o/ /yid kyi rtsal gsum ni/ mdzangs shing blo 'gyub/ dpa' zhing sran tshugs ——pa/ kha gsal zhing gting mi rtog pa'o/ /lus kyi rtsal gsum ni/ mtheb kyis shad na pa/ rkyal gyis chu chod ga yang rtsal bya 'dra ba'o / /pho rtsed sna dgu ni/ gtams ga rtsis gsum/ mda' rdo mchong gsum/— bang rkyal spe gsum rnams so// lnga/ tshad ma'i thad du/tshad ma bsum ni/ mngon sum gyi tshad ma dang / rjes dpag gi tshad ma dang / yid ches kyi tshad ma'o/ /de gsum thog dpe nyer 'jal gyi tshad ma bsnan na/ tshad ma bzhi zhes bya'o/ /tshad ma'i 'gal zla gsum ni/ ma rtogs pa dang / log rtog dngad the — ———tshom dag go /rtsod pa'i rgyu bsum ni/ shes rab ldan pa/ blo spyangs pa/ gzhung lugs — —181

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung shes pa'o/ /rtsod pa smra ba bo gsum ni/ snga rgol dang / phyi rgol dang / dpang bo gsum —mo/ /rtsod ngag drug ni1 snga rgol la don gyi dngos po 'jog pa dang / skyon spong gi ngag gnyis/ phyi rgol la 'dod pa 'dri ba dang/ skyo na brjod pa'i ngag gnyis/dpang bo la rjes su brjod pa dang / rnam par dbye ba'i ngag gnyis bcas drug go /rtsod pa'i skyon gsum ni/ blo skyod/ don skyon/ tshig skyon gsum/ yang na/—ngan g.yo/ khyad gsod/ yid 'khrug gsum mo/ /—rtsod pa mdzes pa'i rgyan bdun ni/ bzhin mdangs gsal ba/ ngag —'jam pa/ sma mi 'bebs pa/ lung rigs dag pa/ gyid lug dang nga rgyal med pa/ rigs lam 'dor ba'i g.yo sgyu chags sdang med pa/ rang gzhan gyi don dang ldan pa gces par 'dzin pa bcas so/ /ldog pa bsum ni/ don ldog rang ldog gzhi ldog gsum mo1 /tshul gsum ni/ rtags gsal gyi sbyor ba 'god pa'i tshul gsum ste/ dang ——bo/ phyogs chos ni/ rtsod gzhi chos can gyi steng du rtags grub pa dang / gnyis pa/ rjes khyab ni/ mthun pa'i phyogs nyid la yod par nges pa dang / gsum pa/ldog khyab ni/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs la med pa nyid du nges pa'o /182

brdus ming mi ba'i bcud len/rtsa ba'i kha dog bzhi ni/ sdo ser dkar dmar bzhi'o/ / — —yan lag gi kha dog brgyad ni/ thin dang / du ba/ rdu 'di khug rna1byub ma/nga — —nyi ma'i 'od zer/ snang ba/ mun pa rnams so/ /rton bzhi mi rton bzhi ni/ gang zag la mi rtod chos la rton pa/ tshig la mi rton dod la rton pa/ rnam shes la mi rton ye shes la rton pa/ drang don mi rton nges don la rton pa'o/ /drug skar rtsis kyi thad du/nyin mo dus tshod drug ni/ nam langs yos dang nyi shar 'thug /mcho sprul dang nyin zud rta/ /phyi dro lug dang dgong kha sprel/ /mtshan mo'i dus tshod drug ni/ nyi nub bya dang sa sros khyi/ /srod yos bag dang nam zud ni/ /byi ba dang ni phyed yol glang / /tho rengs stag gi dus tsho'i yin//lo gcig gi dus drug ni/ dpyid ka sos ka dbyar kha/ stod kha/ dgun —stod/ dgun smad do/ /gza' dun di/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ mig dmar/ lhag pa/ phur bu/ pa sangs/ spen pa'o/ /de rnams kyi steng du sgra gcan dang / du ba mjug ring ba'i da rga gza' dgu'o/ /—spe ba dgu ni/ gcig dkar/ gnyis nag gsum mthing / bzhi lngang / lnga 18 3

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /ser/ drug dkar/ bdun dmar/ brgyad dkar/ dgu sgrug de dmas las/dkar po gser dang mthing nag chu/ /lngang gu shing dang ser po sa/ /dmar srug gnyis ni me yid no/ /'phrod sbyor bcu ni/ gza' dang rgyu skar rnams kyi 'byung ba bzhi'i khams gang 'phrod spyor ba/ sa gnyis 'phrad pa dngos grub sbyor/ /zu gnyis 'phrad pa bdud rtsi sbyor/ /me gnyis 'phrad pa 'phel 'gyur sbyor/ /rlung gnyis 'phrad pa phun tshogs sbyor— /sa chu 'phrad pa lang tsho sbyor— /me rlung 'phrad pa stobs ldan sbyor/ /sa rlung 'phrad pa mi 'phrod sbyor/ /chu rlung 'grad pa mi mthun sbyor/ /sa me 'phrad pa bsreg pa sbyor/ /me chu 'phrad pa 'chi ba sbyor/ /de rnams las bzang bo gsum dang / gso thub gsum dang/ ngad pa gsum dang / tha chad gcig go /lo rib bcu gnyis ni/ byi ba/ glang / stag yos1 'brug sprul/ rta/ lugasprel/ bya1 khyi/ phag rnams so/ /dus gzer nyer bzhi ni/ dpyid zug char 'bab srin bu 'gul/ /dpyid mnyam dwangs gsal 'khru char bab/ 1dbya bzug bri gang rmo 'debs dang / /dbyar nyi ldog dang tsha ba chung / /tsha chen ston zug bsil 'gug dang / /zil dkar ston mnyam bad chags dang / /sad lhung dgun zug kha ba chung / /kha ba che dang dgud nyi ldog /grang ngar chung dang che ba 'o//184

brtsas ming za ba'i bcud lenargyu skar nyer bdun ni/ tha dkar bra nye smin drug snar ma dang / /mgo dang ——lag dang nabs so rgyal dang skag mchu dang gre dang dbo dang me bzhi dang / /nag pa sa ri sa ga lha mtshams dang / /na dang sgyubs dang chu stod chu smad dang / /gro bzhid dang ni mon gre mon gru dang / /khrums stod khrums med nam gru dang bcas pa'o /grangs gnas drug cu ni/ gcig bcu/ brgya/ stong / khri1 'bum/ sa ya/bye ba/ dung phyur/ ther 'bum/ ther 'bum chen po/ khrag khrig khrag khrig chen po1rab bkram/ rab bkram chen po/ gtams/ gtams chen/ dkrigs/ dkrigs chen/ mi 'khrugs/ mi 'khrugs chen po/ khyad 'byin/ khyad 'byid chen po/ spang rten/ spang rten chen po/ ded 'dren/ ded 'dren chen po/ mtha' snang / mtha' snang chen po/ rgyu rig rgyu rig chen po/ 'od mdzes/ 'od mjos chen po/ dbang bo/ dbang bo chen po/ legs 'byin/ legs 'byin chen po/ rtogs 'gro/rtogs 'gro ched po/ 'bying rdul/ 'bying rdul chen po/ rgya rtags/ rgya rtags chen po/ stobs 'khor/ stobs 'khor ched po/ brda shes/ brda shes chen po/rnam byung / rnam byung chen po/ stobs mig stobs mig chen po/ byams pa/byams pa chen po/ snying rje/ snying rje chen po/ dga' ba/ dga' ba chen po/btang stoms/ btang snyoms ched po/ grangs med tha ma'o/ /lo rgan drug cu ni/ me mo yos(rab byung lo)/ sa pho 'brug(nom byung)/185

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mdzad zung /sa mo rdzul(dkar po)/ lcags pho rta(rab myos)/ lcags mo lug(skyes bdag)/chu pho sprel(yid ra)/ chu mo bya(dpa' gdong)/ shing dza khyi(dngos po)/ shing mo phag(na tshod ldan)/ me pho byi('dzin byed)/ me mo glang(dbang phyug)/ sa pho stag('bru mang bo)/ sa mo yos(myos ldan)/ lcags pho 'khrug(rnam gnon)/lcags mo sprul(khyu mchog)/ chu pho rta(sna tshogs)/ chu mo lug(nyi ma)/ shing pho sprel(nyi sgros byed)/ shing mo bya(sa skyong)/ me pho khyi(mi zad)/ me mo phag(thams cad 'dul)/ sa pho byi(kun 'dzin)/ sa mo glang('gal ba)/ lcags pho stag(rnam 'byur)/ lcags mo yos(bong bu)/ chu pho 'brug(dga' ba)1 chu mo sprul(nom rgyal)/ shing pho rta(rgyal ba)/ shing mo lug(myos byed)/ me pho sprel(gdong ngan)/ me mo bya(gser 'phyang)/ sa po khyi(dam 'phyang)/ sa mo phag(sgyur byed)/ lcags pho byi(kun ldan)/ lcags mo glang('phar ba)/ chu pho stag(dge byed)/ chu mo yos(mdzes byed)/ shing bo 'brug(khro mo)/ shing mo sprul(sna tshogs dbyig)/ me pho rta(zil gnon)/ me mo lub(spre'u)/ sa pho sprel(phur bu can)/ sa mo bya(zhi ba)/ lhags pho khyi(thun mong)/ lcags mo phag('gal byed)1 chu pho byi(yongs 'dzin)/ chu mo glang(bag med)/ shing pho stag(kun dga')/ shing mo yos(srin po)/ me pho 'brug(me)/ me mo sprul(dmar ser can)/ sa rtso rta(dus kyi pho nya)/ sa mo lug(don grub)/lcags pho sprel(drag po)/ lcags mo bya(blo ngan)/ chu pho khyi(rnga chen)/ chu mo 186

brdus ming spu ba'i bcud len/phag(khrag sgyug)/ shing pho byi(mig dmar)/ shing mo glang(khro bo)/ me pho stag(zad pa)/dus chen gsum 'dzoms ni/ sa ga zla ba ste hor zla bzhi ba'i yar tshes bco lnga'i nyin ni— ston pa thub pa'i dbang bo lhums su zhugs pa dang — mngon par sangs rgyas pa dang / skya ngan las 'das pa ste/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa gsum bstan pa'i dus chen yin/ /bdun/ gso ba'i thad du/skye gnas bzhi ni/ mngal skye/ sgong skye rdzus skye/ drod gsher las skye ba'o/ /—lus su 'byur ba'i rim pa lnga ni/ nur nur po/ mer mer po/ nar nar — nga po/ gor gor po/ rkang lag 'gyus pa'o//mngal skyes khams drug ni/ rus pa/ rkang / khu ba/ sha khrag pags pa'o/ /lus zungs bdud ni/ khrag sha tshil/ rus pa/ keng / khu ba/ chu rnams so/ /lus kyi gnas lnga ni/ spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying ga lte ba/ gsang ba nas bcas so1 /yang / dpral ba dang / lag mjil gnyis dang / pus mo gnyis dang lnga'o/ /don lnga snod drug ni/ don lnga snying dang glo ba dang / /mchin pa mtsher ba —mkhal ma'o/ 1snad drug pho ba rgyu ma long ga dang / /mkhris pa lhang ba bsam se'u 187

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /dang bcas pa'o /dbang bo lnga'i me tog ni/ mtshor ba'i me tog mchu/ mkhal ma'i me tog rna da/ snying gi me tog rtse/ glo ba'i me tog sna1 mchin pa'i me tog mig go /dbang bo drug gi spyod yul ni/ rna ba'i yul ni sgra/ mig gi yul ni gzugs/ sna'i yul ni dri/ lce'i yul ni ro/ lus kyi yul ni reg bya/ sems kyi yul ni chos so/ /lus kyi rtsa ba'i rlung lnga ni/ srog 'dzin thur sel gyen rgyu dang / /mnyam gnas khyab byed lus rlung lnga'o/ /dri ma drug ni/ rngu ma/ rna spabs/ mchil ma/ snabs/ dri chen/ dri chu'o/ /——gsos gsum ni/ bcud kyi gsos ni mar dang / stobs kyi gsos ni ga bur dang / bkrag gi gsos ni spyang rtsi'o/ /ro drug ni1 mngar ba/ sgyur ba/ kha ba/ bska ba/ tsha ba/ lad tsha ba'o/ /—nad slong rkyen gnyis ni/ kha zas mi 'phrod pa la bsten pa'i skyon dang /spyod lam mi 'phrod par bsten pa'i skyon no/ /sman bzang bo drug ni— tsā te snying la bzang / cu gang glo bar bzang /gur kum mchin par bzang / li shi srog rtsar bzang / sug smol mkhal mar bzang / ka ko la mtsher bar bzang ngo /nad kyi 'jug sgo drug ni/ pags la gram pa/ sha la rgyas pa/ rtsa ru rgyu ba/188

brtsas ming spya ba'i bcud len/rus la zhen pa/ don la 'bab pa/ snod du lhung ba'o/ /nad kyi yan lag brgyad ni/ lus nad/ byis nad/ mo nad/ gdon dad/mtshon nad/ dug nad/ rgas nad/ ro tsa'i nad do/ /gso dpyad yan lag brgyad ni/ lus kyi dpyad/ byis pa'i dpyad/ gdon —gyi dpyad/ lus stod kyi dpyad/ mtshon rma'i dpyad/ mche ba zug pa'i dpyad/rgas pa'i dpyad/ ro tsa'i dpyad/gso thabs yan lag bco brgyad ni/ thang dang zu ma ril bu dang / /lde gu ——sman mar snum 'chos dang / /bshal sgyugs sna sman 'jam rtsi dang / /ni ru ha dang rtsa sbyong dang / /gtar kha me btsa' dugs dang lums/ /byugs pa thur dpyad bco brgyad do/ /sman gyi nus pa brgyad ni/ 'byung ba lnga'i stobs las byung ba'i sman thams cad kyi nus pa mi 'dra ba brgyad de/ rtsi ba dang rdzum pa gnyis kyis rlung nad sel ba/ bsil ba dang rtul ba gnyis kyis mkhris nad sel ba/ yang ba dang tsub pa dang tsha ba dang rdo ba bzhis bad kan gyi nad sel ba'o/ /brgyad/ spyod lam gyi thad du/'gro ba rigs drug ni/ lha dang / lha ma yin dang / mi ni bde 'gro nga —gsum dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas dang / dmyal ba ni ngad 'gro gsum ste drug go /189

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung 'dod yon lnga ni/ 'dod chags skye yul gyi yon tan lnga ste/ gzugs —mdzes pa/ sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya 'jam pa'o/ /'byor ba drug ni/ tshe ring ba/ dbang che ba/ bkra shis pa/ gzi mdangs che ba/ 'khor mang ba/ longs spyod che ba'o/ /mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun ni/ rigs bzang ba/ gzugs mdzes patshe ring ba/ nad med pa/ skal ba bzang ba/ nor myug pa/ shes rab che ba'o/ /rgyal srid sna bdud ni/ 'khor lo rin po che/ nor bu rin po che/ btsun mo rin po che/ blon po rin po che/ dmag dpon rin po che/ glang bo rin po che/rta mchog rin po che / /'phags nor bdun ni/ dad pa'i nor/ tshul khrims kyi nor/ thos pa'i —nor/ gtong ba'i nor/ ngo tsha shes pa'i nor/ khrel yod kyi nor/ shes rab kyi nor rnams so/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad ni/ dpal be'u/ pad ma/ gdugs/ dung / 'khor lo/ rgyal mtshan/ bum pa/ gser nya'o/ /'jig rten gyi chos brgyad ni/ rnyed na dga' ba dab / ma rnyed na mi —dga' ba/ snyad pa thos na dga' ba dang / mi snyan pa thos na mi dga' ba/bde na dga' ba dang / mi bde na mi dga' ba/ bstod na dga' ba dang smad na mi dga' ba'o/ /190

bsdus ming spu ba'i bcud len/log 'tsho lnga di/ tshul 'chos/ kha gsag gzhogs slong / thob kyis 'jal —ba1 rnyed pas rnyed pa 'tshol ba'o/ /longs spyod 'bri ba'i gnas drug ni— chang 'thung ba/ rgyan 'phen pa/——— —mtshan mo 'phyad pa/ sdig grogs la bsten pa/ 'dus par lha ba/ le lo g.yeng ba'o/ /nyon mongs drug ni/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti nug dang / /nga rgyal the ——tshom log lha'o— /sdug bsngal brgyad ni/ skye ba'i sdug bsngal— rga ba'i sdug bsngal/ na ba'i —sdug bsngal/ 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal/ dgra mi sdug pa dang 'phrad pa'i sdug bsnga'1/ gnyen sdug pa dang 'bral pa'i sdug bsngal/ gang 'dod pa btsal kyang ma rnyed pa'i sdug bsngal/ nye bar len pa'i phung bo lnga'i sdug bsngal lo/ /kung ba'i sgo bzhi ni/ mi shes pa/ ma gus pa/ bag med pa/ nyon mongs mang ba'o/ /chang 'thungs pa'i nyes dmigs sum cu so lnga ni/ dga' ba can gyis ——— ——zhus pa'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/ dga' ba can 'bru'i chang dang bcas pa'i chang bag med pa'i gnas kyi nyes dmigs sum cu so lnga ni/ tshe 'di la nor zad pa dang / nad rnams rgyas par byed pa dang / 'thab pa dang rtsod pa skyed par byed pa dang / don med pa la lha ba dang / grags pa 131

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /ma yin kun 'byung bar byed pa dang / shes rab nyam chung bar byed pa dang /longs spyod thob pa mi 'thob par 'byur ba dang / longs spyod thob pa yongs su zad cing yongs su gtug par 'gyur ba dang / gsang mi thub par 'gyur ba dang / de'i las kyi mtha' yongs su 'grib pa dang / mthu stobs chung ngur byed par 'gyur ba dang / mar mi 'dzin par 'gyur ba dang / phar mi 'dzin par 'gyur ba dang/ dge sbyong du mi 'dzin par 'byur ba dang / zam zer mi 'dzin par 'byur ba dang / rigs kyi gtso bo la bsnyen bkur mi byed par 'gyur ba dang/ sangs rgyas la mi gus par 'gyur ba dang / chos la mi gus bar 'gyur ba dang / dge 'dun la mi gus par 'byur ba dang / bslab pa yang dag par blangs pa la mi gus par 'gyur ba dang / tshul khrims 'chal bar 'gyur ba dang / dbang bo'i sgo ma bsdams par 'byur ba dang / bag med par bud med don du gnyer bar 'gyur ba dang / nye du snag gi gnyen tshan dang ma dza' bshes dang slob dpon dag gis spong bar 'byur ba dang / skye bo mang bo dag gis yid du mi 'ong bar 'thur ba dang / skye bo mang bo dag dang mi mthun par 'byur ba dang / chos ma yin pa la spyod par 'gyur ba dang /chos ma yin pa yongs su 'dzin par 'byur ba dang / dam pa'i chos yongs su spong bar 'gyur ba dang / ngo tsha shes pa dang khrel yod pa spong bar 'gyur ba dang / de mi mdza' ba dag dang gnas kyang mkhas pa rnams la yongs su 'dri 192

brdus ming za ba'i bcud len1bar mi sems pa dang / bag med nyams bag tu sbyod par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab la kun nas mi gnas pa dar / zu ngan las 'das pa la thag ring du 'gyur ba dang / spyon par 'gyur ba'i las byas shing bag chags pas lus zhig nas ngan song ngan 'gro log par lhung ba sems can dmyal ba dag tu skye zhing / sal te de nas shi 'phos te 'dir mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skyes na yang / de dag dang gang du skye ba de dang der spyon par 'gyur zhing dran 1 mi gsal bar gyur/ ces gsungs so/ 1dge ba bcu ni/ srog mi gcod pa/ ma byin par mi led pa/ log ge yem spong ba/— bded ger smra ba/ phra ma mi byed pa/ tshig 'jam por smra ba/ ngag mi 'chal ba/ gzhan gyi nor la chags sred mi byed pa/ gzhan la gnod sems mi skyed pa/ 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i lha 'dzin pa'o/ /mi chos gcang ma bcu drug ni/ bod rgyal srong btsan sgam pos gtan la —phab pa'i khrims srol don tshan bcu drug ste/ lha dkon mchog gsum la mos gus bskyed pa/ dam pa'i chos btsal zhing bsgrub pa/ pha ma la drin lan 'jal ba/ yon tan can la zhe mthong yod pa/ rigs mtho ba dang rgan par bkur ste che ba/ yul mi khyim mtshes la phan 'dogs pa/ bka' drang zhing sems chung ba/nye du mdza' bshes la gzhung ring ba/ ya rabs kyi rjes snyeg cing phyi thag ring ba/ zas nor la tshod 'dzin pa/ sngar drin can gyi mi rtsad gcod pa1 du lon 19 3

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyub 1dus su 'jal zhing bre srang la g.yo med pa/ kun la phrab dog chung ba/ ngad pa'i gros la mi nyan zhing rang tshugs 'dzin pa/ ngag 'jam zhing smra ba nyung ba/theg pa che zhing blo khog yangs pa bcas so/ /zhal lce bcu drug ni/ sngar gtsang sde srid karma bstan skyong dbang bos bod la dbang bsgyur skabs spel ser ba la sgrig tu bcug pa'i khrims lugs don tshan bcu drug ste/ dang bo/ dpa' bo rnya sha gi zhal rtse1 gnyis pa1 sdar ma wa'i zhal lce1 gsum pa/ sne mo las 'dzin gyi zhal lce/ bzhi ba/ zhu bzhes bden rdzun gyi zhal rtse/ lnga ba/ bzung bkyigs khrims ra'i zhal lho/ drug pa/ nag chen khrag sbyor gyi zhal lce/ bdun pa/ dran 'dzin chad las kyi zhal lce/ brgyad pa/hor 'dra za rkang gi zhal lce/ dgu ba/ bsad pa stong gi zhal lce1 bcu ba/ rmas kha khrag gi zhal lce/ bcu gcig pa/ bston ham mna' dag gi zhal lce/ bcu gnyis pa1 brkus pa 'jal gyi zhal rtse/ bcu gsum pa/ nye 'grel 'bral 'dum gyi zhal rtse/ bcu bzhi ba/ byi byas byi rin gyi zhal rtse/ bco lnga ba/ nam phar tshur gyi zhal rtse/ bcu drug pa/ kla klo mtha' 'khob kyi zhal rtse rnams so1 /mthun pa dam bzhi ni/ sngod byung bya gong ma sreg dang / ri bong / spre'u/glang chen bzhis rgan gzhon brtsi bkur byas pas/ yul der bde skyid byung bar grags/ /194
