bsdus ming spya ba'i bcud len/—dgu chos kyi thad dudus gsum sangs rgyas ni/ 'das pa'i sa ngas rgyas mar me mdzad da —nga —nga —lha'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas byams pa'o//rigs gsum mgon po ni 'jam dpal dbyangs ni de bzhin gshegs ————nga pa'i rigs spyan ras gzigs ni pad ma 'i rigs/ phyag na rdo rje ni rdo rje'i rigs/ rigs gsum so sor lha mang du yod pa'i nang gi gtso bo yin pas na rigs gsum mgon po zer ro//rgyal ba rigs lnga ni/rnam snang/rin chen byung gnas/'od dpag —————med/don grub/mi bskyod pa'o//thub pa bdun ni/rnam bzigs/gtsug tor can/thams cad skyobs/——————'khor ba 'jig gser zub/'od zungs/shākya thub pa'o//nye ba'i sras chen brgyad ni/'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje/spyan ras ——————gzigs/sa yi snying bo/sgrib pa rnam sel/nam mkha'i snying bo/bya sa pa/kun tu bzang bo'o//gnas brtan bcu drug ni/shākya thub pas bstan pa gnyer du btad pa'i —dgra bcom pa bcu drug ste yan lag 'byung /ma pham pa/nags na gnas/dus ldan/rdo rje mo'i bu/bzang bo/gser gyi be'u/bha ra rnya dza gser can/ba ku la/sgra gcan 'dzin/lam phran bstan/bha ra hwa dza bsod snyoms len/lam 9 6

dag yig rig pa'i ba pa mngon phyung /—chen bstan/ klu'i sde/ sged byed/ mi zud pa'o/ /byang chub sems dab 'i sa bcu ni/ dang bo rab tu dga' ba/ gnyis pa —dri ma med pa/ bsum pa 'od byed pa/ bzhi ba 'od 'phro ba/ lnga ba sbyangs dka' ba/ drug pa mngon du 'byur ba/ bdun pa ring du song ba1 brgyad pa mi ba yo ba/dgu ba legs pa'i blo gros / bcu ba chos kyi smin rnams so/ /stobs bcu ni/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs/ las kyi ———dam par smin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs/ mos pa sna tshogs pa mkhyen pa'i stobs/khams sna tshogs pa mkhyen pa'i stobs/ da dang bo mchog dang mchog ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs/ thams cad du 'gro 'i lam mkhyen pa'i stobs/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byab ba mkhyen pa'i stobs/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa mkhyen pa'i stobs/ 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba mkhyen pa'i stobs/ zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs rnams so/ /dbon mchog gsum ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun no/ /—rgyal chen rigs bzhi ni/ shar du ci la 'khor srung dang / lho ru 'phags skyes po dang / nub tu spyan mi bzang dang 1 byang du rnam thos sras so/ /lha'i gtso bo gsum ni/ tshangs pa dang / dbang myug dang / khyab 'jug go /lha chen brgyad ni/ dbang phyug chen po/ brgya byin/ tshangs pa/ khyab 'jug196

bkus ming ji ba'i bcud len/'dod pa'i dbang phyug tshogs bdag sgrod ri rnyi/ gzhon nu gdong drug dmas so/ /phyogs skyong bcu ni/ shar du brgya byin1 lho ru bshin rje1 nub tu chu lha/——nga ——byang du gnod sbyin/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po1 nub byang du rlung lha/byang shar du dbang ldan— steng du nyi ma/ 'og tu sa'i lha mo'o/ /srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu ni/ 'o de gung spyal dang / de la bu brgyad byung ——ste/ yar lha sham po/ gnyan chen thang lha/ rma chen sbom ra1 skyogs chen ldong ra/sgam po lha rje/ zhogs lha rgyug po/ jo bo g.yul rgyal/ she'u kha rag dmas so/ /'di dag stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/smad mdo khams sgang drug ste/ bod yul stod smad bar gsum du gnas so/ /rje yi mgur lha bcu gsum ni/ srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu'i steng du/ jo bo mchims lha/ jo bo ngos gsum/ jo bo g.ya' spung / jo bo khug lha bcas bzhi bsnan pa'o/ /de rnams srong btsan sgam po dang / khri srong lde btsan sogs kyis bsten pa'i srung ma yin pas na rje yi mgur lha bcu gsum zer ro/ /lha srin sde brgyad ni/ gshin rje/ ma mo/ bdud/ btsan/ rgyal bo/ klu/gnod sbyin/ gza' noms so/ —rgyan drug mchog gnyis ni/ klu spub/ thogs med/ ārya de ba/ dbyig gnyen/ phyogs glang / chos grags te rgyan drug dang / yon tan 'od/ shākya 'od 197

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa ma ngon phyung de mchog gnyis so//bod kyi 'jam dbyangs gsum ni/ sa skya paṇḍi ta kun das 'a rgyal mtshan — nga —dang kun mdza klong chen rab 'byams dri med 'od zer/ rje rtsang kha ba blo bzang grags pa bcas so rje yab sras gsum ni/rje tsong kha ba/ rgyal tshab dar zu1 rin chen/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang ngo //sa skya gong ma lnga ni/ sa chen kun dga' snying bo/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa rnams so//ka chen bzhi ni/ lho brag mar pa'i slob ma mchog gyur bzhi ste/ rngog chos sku rdo rje/mtshur ston dbang nge /mes ston tshon po/mi la ras pa dmas so/bod kyi grub chen brgyad ni/ 'jam dpal sku'i bka' bab rdzub sangs rgyas ye shes/ dbang chen gsung gi bka' bab ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ yang dag thugs kyi bka' bab gnub nam mkha' snying bo/ yon tad bdud rtsi'i bka' bab nyags 4 na ku mā ra/ phrin las phur pa'i bka' bab ye shes mtsho rgyal/ srid pa ma mo'i bka' bab sog po dpal gyi ye shes/ 'jig rten dregs pa'i bka' bab rlangs dpal gyi seng ge stobs ldan nag po'i bka' bab bai ro tsa na rnams so//138

bsgyus mib spu ba'i bcud len—sad mi mi bdun ni/ chos rgyal khri srong sde btsan skabs mkhan chen bo rnyi ———————sa kas bod mis rab byung gi bslab sdom bsrung nus mi nus tshod bka'i phyir du/ thams cad yod smra'i lugs bzhin/ thog mar rab tu byung ba'i mi sba gsal snang / mchi sa shākya bra bha/ pa gor bai ro tsa na/ ngan lam rgya' ba mchog dbyangs/ rma rin chen mchog 'khod klu'i dbang bo/ gtsang legs grub dmas dab/ 1sde snad gsum ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' thams cad brjod bya bslab pa —gsum du bzhag pa ste/ 'dul ba'i sde snod/ mngon pa'i sde snod/ mdo sde'i sde snod rnams so/ /sngags sde gsum ni1 gsang sngags1 rig sngags/ gzungs sngags so/ /—byams chos sde lnga ni/ rgyal ba byams pas thogs med la gsungs pa'i chos mngon rtogs rgyan/ rgyud bla ma/ mdo sde rgyan/ chos nyid rnam 'byed/dbus mtha' rnam 'byed de sde tshan lnga'o/ /rigs tshogs drug ni/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis brtsams pa'i rtsa ba shes rab dang / rin chen phreng ba dang / rtsod rmog dang / stong nyid bdun cu ba dang / zhib mo rnam 'thag dang / rigs pa drug cu ba bcas dbu ma rigs tshogs drug go /mngod pa sde bdud ni/ ji skad du/ ye shes la 'jug ka spya'i bus/ /rab nga —199

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyungatu byed pa dbyig gnyen gyis/ /rnam shes tshogs ni lha skyid kyis/ /chos kyi phung bo shā ri'i bus/ /gdags pa'i bstan bcos mo'u 'gal dus1 /'gro ba'i rnam grangs gsus po ches/ /khams kyi tshogs ni gang bos byas/ /zhes gsungs pa lhar ro/ /ni gu'i chos drug ni/ gtum mo bde drod rang 'bar/ sgyu lus chags sdang —— —rang grol/ mi lam nying 'khrul rang dag 'od gsal gti mug rang sangs/'pho ba ma sgoms sangs rgyas/ bar do rgyal ba longs sku rnams so/ /'jug slo gsum ni/ bstan pa la 'jug pa'i sgo skyabs 'gro dang / thar —ba la 'jug pa'i sgo nges 'byung dang / theg chen du 'jug pa'i sgo sems bskyed dag go /phar phyin drug ni/ sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang /brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab bcas kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /chos kyi sdom bzhi ni/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa/ zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal / chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa/ myu ngan las 'das pa zhi ba'o/ /zhen pa bzhi bral di/ blo chos su 'gro ba/ chos lam du 'gro ba/ lam gyi 'khrul ba sel ba/ 'khrul ba ye shes su 'char ba'o/ /200

bsdus ming za ba'i bcud len/mngon shes lnga ni/ lha'i mig gi mngon shes/ lha'i rna ba'i mngon )sa/sngon gnas rjes dran gyi mngon shes/ rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon sheg gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes rnams so/ /— rtsa'i 'khor lo drug ni/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo1 snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo/ lte ba sprul ba'i 'khor lo/ zhes gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lo/ nor bu da dus kyi 'khor lo'o/ /'i ro tsa na'i yang dag bcu gcig ni/ 1 skye ba snga phyi shes shing sems can gyi don la brtson pa/ thugs rje byeng chub kyi sems dang ldan pa— yin yang dag 2 bstsal gyis mi rnyed pa'i man ngag lhag ma med kar rnyed pas/ sprul ba'i sku yin yang dag da lo co lnga las ma lon bar bod das rgya sher— du lam rgyus med par phyin pas/ lha'i spyan dang ldan pa yin yang dag 4 bar gyi lam 'phrang la mi rgod dang gcan gzan gdug pa can la sogs pa gang gis kyang ma tshugs pas/ 'khor ba mi ldog pa'i rtags yin yang dag 5 rgya gar nas bod kyi bar la zla drug gi lam la nyin gsum gyis slobs pas/ rkang mgyogs kyi dngos grub thob pa yin yang dag 6 sbal dong 'ig dong du bsgyur kyang zos shing nyams pa med pas/ bzod pa'i brtson 'grus thob pa yin ka1nga dag 7 man ngag gi chos thos pa tsam gyis mkhyen cing rtogs pas/chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong ba yin yang dag 8 mtha' bzhi brgyud nas sgra 201

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung /bsgyur lamakhas pas/ sgrib gnyis byang ba yin yang dag 9 rgya gar mkhas pa kun gyi man ngag gtsos dgu thos pas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i dngos grub thob pa yin yang dag 1༷ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan brtags nas theg pa thams cad mkhyen pas/ ston pa'i zhal skyin yin yang dag 11 rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs dang ldan pas/ sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' yin yang dag ces gsungs so/ / bon gyi theg pa rim dgu ni/ phywa gshen dang / snang gshen dang / 'phrul gshen dang / srid gshen te rgyu'i theg pa bzhi yin la/ dge bsnyen dang / drang srong dang / ma dkar dang / ye gshen te ba bu'i theg pa bzhi yin zhing /khyad par chen po'i theg pa gcig ste dgu'o// //202

dam dbye dang bo'i gab pa mngon myung 1sne tshan bdun pa/ nam dbye dang bo'i gab ba mngon phyung /don gyi ngo bo ston ba'i ming / /tshig yi spub byed yin pas na/ /dam dbye dang bor bzhag pa yin/ /ming gi ngo bo mi gcig par/ /'gyur ba'i rkyen dang ldan pas na//rnam dbye'i khongs su gtogs pa yin//'jig rten khams kyi chos kun la gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i ngo bo zhig yod pa dang / ngo bo des rang ma yin pa'i chos kun bsal ba'i phyir/ rjod byed kyi sgra kun kyang sel 'jug gi sgra yin pa khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /ming gi mtshan nyid ni/ don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i sgra yin par thal/ des na ming mi gcig pas don gyi ngo bo gzhan dang ma 'dres par so sor bye nas ston pa yin pas/rnam dbyer bzhag pa yin zhe na/ rigs pas dben par mthong ste/ legs spyar gyi lugs ltar/ rnam dbye dang bo'i rkyen si tshe dzad lha bu zhig logs su ster rgyu med pa'i phyir dang / skad rigs sang gi ming yang chos gang nyid kyi ngo bo tsam go bar byed pa las/ chos gzhan zhig gi ngos 'dzin par mi 'gyur 203

dag yi rig pa'i gab pa mdan sgyung bas/ bod skad kyi ming ngo cog dam dbyer brtsis chog na rgya skad la sogs pa'i ming ngo cog kyang rnam dbyer brtsis chog pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na bod skad kyi ming ngo cog rnam dbye dang bor bzhag pa e 'grig ce na/ 'grig thag chod red/ ci phyir zhe na/ bod skad kyi ming gi ngo bo gzhan zhig tu 'gyur ba la/ legs sbyar gyi lugs lhar rnam dbye dang bo'i rkyen phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod/ 'di ni bod rang skad kyi khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa zhig yin/ rgya skad sogs la 'di 'dra'i khyad chos med do/ /khyad chos 'di'i gab pa mngon par phyung na/ rnam dbye dang bo zhes bya ba'i chos kyi de nyid bde blag tu rtogs par 'gyur te/ ming gi khungs gcig kyang / don gnyis sam du mar 'jug pa'i ngo bo mi 'dra bar rnam par 'byed pa'i rkyen kho thag cig yod pas1 rnam dbye'i gral du bzhag pa tshad mas grub bo/ /gsung rab brda la ma sbyangs na/ /rjod byed tshig gi sgra 'dra yang / /brjod bya don la khyad par yod/ / de phyir yi ge'i dag byed dgos/ /zhes dag byed gsal ba'i ba long las gsungs pa bzhin/ de yang rten cing 'brel ba'i sgo nas ming gang gi ming gzhi brje mi brje/ ming gang la sngon 'jug thob mi thog rjes 'jug gam yang 'jug 'jug mi 'jug mgo can 204

dam dbye dang bo'i gab pa mngon rgyung / 'jog mi 'jog 'dogs can 'dobs mi 'dogs/ ming mtha' spyor mi spyor/ming mtha' mi 'dra ba sbyar ba la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis/ don gyi ngo bo gzhan dang ma 'dres par rnam par zud pa'i go chod pa yin no/ /rnam par dbye ba'i rkyen 'di med na/ rten cing 'brel bar byung ba'i ming so so'i mtshan nyid nges par dka' bas/ sgra spyi 'dra ba tsam las/ zhib cha mi gcig par rgongs pa'i dbang gis / nya nyung mnyam bsres su gyur nas/ go brda legs par mi 'phrad/sgra shes na don la mi rmongs zhes pa lhar/ rnam dbye'i rkyen rnams legs par rtogs na/ don gyi ngo bo gang ci ston pa'i brda'am yi ger dag cha thon nges yin1 da ni rten cing 'brel ba'i ming gi ngo bo 'gyur bar byed pa'i rnam dbye'iXrkyen rnams mtshad gzhi dang sbyar nas don tshan bdun du dril nas bstan par bya'o/ /don tshan dang bo/ bya ba'i ming rnams rten cing 'brel ba'i sgo nas bya ba'i ming gzhan du gyur pa'i rnam dbye dang mtshan gzhi/de yang thog mar bya ba'i ming la rigs gsum yod pa shes dbos te/gcig ni bdag dang 'brel ba'i bya ba ste/ byed pa'i rtsol ba yin zhing / gnyis ni gzhan dang 'brel ba'i bya ba ste1 las kyi 'byur6ba yin la/ gsum ni bdag gzhan gang la'ang ma 'brel ba'i bya ba ste/ ngang gis byung ba yin no/ /bya ba 206

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon snyung —rigs gsum las phan tshun rten cing 'grel bar byung ba ha cang mang / gang zhig gang la brten nas byung bar rigs gsum yod/rigs dang bo'i rnam dbye la tshan pa gnyis snang / gcib ni/ ming gzhi bcig par ma go can 'jog mi 'jog pa'am/ sngon 'jug 'phul mi 'phul bayin pa las/ snga ma ni rten 'brel gyi sgo nas bdag 'brel gyi bya ba'i ming mi mgo can dor na/ gzhan 'brel gyis ba'i ming du 'gyur la/ gzhan 'grel gyi bya ba'i ming gi na ro dor na/ bdag gzhan 'brel med kyi bya ba'i ming du byur 'gro— dper brjo da na/ 'byar nas 'dug pa sbyar nas 'byor ba min zer —— nga ———ba'i tshig 'di'i nang gi sbyar ba dang / 'byor ba dang / 'byar ba ni/ rten cing 'brel bar byung ba'i bya ba rigs gsum yin/ gang zhig gang la 'jug pa'i shes byed ni rnam dbye yin te/ sa mgo can ni byed pa'i rtsol ba ste/ 'bras bu 'byung byed kyi rgyu yin zhing / sa mgo bsubs pa'i na ro can ni las kyi 'gyur ba ste/ rgyu las byung ba'i 'bras bu yin/ sa mgo dang na ro med pa bo ni ngang sgas byung ba ste/ gang zag gis bsgrubs pa ma yin no/ /de dag gi sgra spyi 'dra yang / gal te sa mgo yod med dang / na ro yod med kyi sgra lci yang / dbyangs mtho dman gyi nom dbye med na— so so'i ngo bo ji ltar shes/ rgya ska da la 'di 'dra'i bya ba rigs gsum la tsho zhes pa'i ming gcig gis chog pa/ rnam dbye dang bo'i rkyen ster rgyu med pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin(bdag la——thig 306

rnam dbye dang bo'i gab pa mngon zung —rtags dang / gzhan ༷ —'khyugs rtags dang / bdag gzhan min paratsheg rtags kyis mtshan pa)/lag rtsal sbyangs nas 'byongs pa rab tu byang / /—nga ——— —gcig tu 'dom pa bsdams nas dom pa min/ /——bslabs na ldob pa skyen pas ci yang lob/ /—nga —ba —khyi las lod pa slod nas lhod pa min/ / — ——nam zla 'gyur ba bsgyur nas 'gyur ba min/ / nga ———ko ba chu 'a1 sbangs nas bangs yags red/ /——— ——lta bu sogs ba sa nyung shas shig gi ming gzhi gcig pa min yang / so so'i mgo can nam 'dogs can nam ming gzhi la sgra yin pas cha 'dra ba ste/ rim par ji lhod du btang ba'i rnam dbye yin no/ /bya ba gzhan 'brel dang / bdag bzhan ma 'brel ba gnyis kyi sgra'am yig gzugs gcig thog bab pa dang /bdag gzhan gnyis las/ bdag gzhan sang la ma 'brel ba'i bya ba med pa dag kyang shes par bya'o/ /phyi ma ni rten 'brel gyi sgo nas sngon 'jug 'phul ba ni/ bdag 'grel gyi bya ba'i ming yin pa dang / sngon 'jug dor ba ni/ gzhan 'brel gyi bya ba'i ming yin/ sngon 'jug 'phul mi 'phul ba ni/ bdag gzhan rnam par dbye ba'i rkyen yin no/ —dper na/207

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung/shed kyis mnan kyang ma non pa/nga nga mtho sar bzhag nas ma zhog lhung /— —lag pas myur du bzung nas zin/nga —mgron du drangs pa ma lus 'drongs/———'dal ba bdaka nas 'dol ba min/ nga nga chu nyog bsnyogs nas nyog pa yin/ nga nga lta 4 sogs phal cher bdag gzhan gnyis ka'i dbye ba yin pa las/ sgra lci yang sga khyad par gtod ched/ bdag la sngon 'jug mi 'phul ba gzhan la 'as 'phul ba/ drangs dang 'drongs lha bu dmigs bsal can nyung shas shig kyang yod la/gzhan dang /bdag gzhan gang min mtshon pa'i ming gnyis sgra gcig yin pa'ang yod do// cig shos ni/ming gzhi sde ba gcig pa las/rten 'brel gyi sgo nas yi ge dang bo bdag gi ming gzhi dang /gnyis pa gzhan mi ming gzhi dang /gsum pa bdag gzhan gang kan gyi ming gzhir 'jug pa yin/ sde ba gang gi ming gzhi phan tshun brjes pa 'di/ bya ba rigs gsum gyi ngo bo rnam par dbye ba'i rkyen yin/dper brjod na/bkab nas khebs pa'i 'og tu gab nas 'dugang nga —zer ba'i tshig 'di'i nang gi bya ba'i ming bkab kyi ming gzhi pho yig ka yis byed pa'i rtsol ba dang / khebs kyi ming gzhi ma ning ba yis las kyi 'gyur ba 208

rnam dbye dang bo'i gab pa mngon jing /dang / gab kyi ming gzhi mo yig ga yis ngang gis byung ba bstan pa yin laming gzhi sde ba gcig pa las rten cing 'brel ba'i bya ba rigs gsum byung ba'i ngo bo rnam par dbye ba'i rkyen 'i/ sgra drag zhan bar ma yin no/ /skabs 'dir shes dgos pa zhig ni/ bdag 'grel gyi bya ba'i dus kyi rnam bzhag la ming gzhi mi gcig po mang bas/'das pa gzhir 'dzin pa yin/gzhan dag la dus kyi rnam bzhag yod kyang ming gzhi la 'gyur ba med do//de bzhin/bkyigs das 'khyigs kyang ma gyigs kha nas sdigang — ——— lus la rma 'grams bkram nas khrims pa min//— ྾gdul bya btul nas thul bas dul bar gnas//nga — bsnyim ba nas ma jim rkang ba bye mar dim//nga snod zhabs zhom pa bcom nas chom pa min// — —btsugs nas ma tshugs 'dam la zug par 'byur//nga jing bu 'khyil ba bskyil nas 'khyil ba min//—khyi ngan ring du bsgyur nas sa ra byung ngo //— ྾lta bu sogs las bya rigs gsum 'dzoms pa mang yang / bdag gzhan gnyis re tsam dang / gzhan dang bdag gzhan ma 'grel ba gnyis yig gzugs gcig pa'ang snang /bya ba rigs gsum las ngang gis byung ba'i ming gzhi sde ba de'i yi ge gsum pa mi 'phrod pas/sde ba gzhan las byed rtsol gang 209

dag yig rig pa'i gas pa mngon sgyung /mthun zhig drangs pa yang yod do/ /gong gsal bya ba'i ming la rten cing 'brel ba'i rigs gsum gyi dbye ba mngon sum du yod kyang / gsum gsum du 'dzoms pa'i nges pa med de/ las kyi dngos po sngar yod pa gang byed pa'i rtsol ba las/ rnam pa gzhan zhig tu gyur 'gro ba la/ bdag gzhan dang 'brel ba'i bya ba rigs gnyis yod mod/de lugs dang 'brel ba'i rang byung gi snang tshul med pa la/ bdag gzhan dang ma 'brel ba'i bya ba med de/ ras gshags nas shogs pa/ lta bu/ las kyi —nga ——dngos po sngar med pa gang / rtsol ba las chos can zhig tu grub pa la/ bdag 'bre' gyi bya ba yod kyang / gzhan 'brel gyi bya ba med de/ sku 'dra bzhengs/ lta —— —bu/ bem po gang zhig rang gi ngang gis bya ba('gyur ldog)'byung ba las/ byed po ri las su mi rung ba la/ bdag 'brel dang gzhan 'brel gyi bya ba med de/nyi ma shar ba/ lha du/ sems can gang zhig las la ma bltos par/ rang gi 'du byed ngang ngam shugs kyis byung ba la/ bdag gzhan dang ma 'brel ba'i bya ba tsam las med de— rta rgyug pa/ lha bu'o/ /rigs gnyis pa'i rnam dbye 'i ra btags can la thug yod de/ bya ba'i ming ra btags can gang zhig rang dang 'brel ba'i bya ba'i ming gzhan zhig tu bsgyur pa la/ bsgyur bya de'i ming gzhi yang ra'am ra btags can gzhan zhig yin dgos par ma zad/ gnyis ka'i ming gzhir pho mo'am1 mo dang shin 210

rnam dbyedang bo'i gab pa mngon snang /tu mo dang mo gsham gyi khyad par yod dgos/ ra btags can gyi ming gzhi'i rtags kyi dbye ba 'di ni/ ming gi ngo bo mi gcig pa'i rnam dbye yin tedaper na/ shog bu dral nas ral ba/ zer ba'i skad 'dir/ dral ni bdag — —'brel gyi bya ba yin zhing /dral gyi ming gzhi ra la brjes pa'i ral ni/gzhan 'brel gyi bya ba bstan pa yin / dral dang ral/sgra 'di gnyis ka'i brjod tshul spyir 'dra ba nyid kyis/bya ba gnyis ka'i rnam pa mtshungs par bstad pa dang /snga ma'i ming gzhi dra ni mo ba dang /phyi ma'i ming gzhi ra ni mo gsham ste lce rtse so rtsar spyar ba lhod pa dang ches lhod pa'i khyad par gyis/bya ba gnyis kyi ngo bo mi 'dra ba rnam par byed pa yin no//de bzhinamago skyes bregs nas regs par byur//nga nga rta ma dkrogs na 'drogs don med/———me la bsregs nas bal kha 'dregs/—nga drul nas rul na zhing lud nyan//— nga ras dang shog bu dril nas ril//mnyam du bsres nga sgyur dres ba ra gyur//rnya bu sogs phal cher bdag san dar bal ba'i bya ba rigs gnyis yin/las kyi 'gyur ba dang ngang gis byung ba gnyis kyi brdar ma yig gzugs gcig pa'ang nyung shas shig snang ngo //2

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung/rigs gsum pa'i rnam dbye ni/ rten 'brel gyi sgo nas bya ba da lha ba'i 'a mtha'i dod du rjes 'jug na'am da ci rigs sbyar nas/ bya ba'i ming gzhan zhig ston pa yin/ ming gzhi gang la'ang rjes 'jug re ma sbyar na/ ming du mi 'grub pas/ mtha' rten med pa rnams don du 'a mtha' can yin te/ sum cu ba'i rtsa ba las/ sngod 'jug yod dam med kyang rung / /ming gzhi'i yi ge gang yin la/ /nyis 'brel yod dam sum 'brel yod/ /a li bzhi las gang ldan yang / /rjes 'jug bcu bo ma zhugs na/ /ming gzhan ston pa yod mi srid /gsungs pas gsal/ skad gsar bcad du/ 'a mtha' rkyang 'phul rnams la dgos/ /mgo 'dogs dbyangs ldan rnams la spangs/ /zer ba lhar/ dga'/mda'/ bka'/ 'ba'/ lha bu sogs kyi 'a mtha' spangs na1 la la sngon 'jug ming gzhir 'khrul ba dang / la la sgra sbyor du mi rung bas dgos dbang gis rang sor bzhag pa dang / 'a mtha' zor yang bas bsdus kyang mi skyon pa rnams dngos su mi 'bri bar mdzad mod kyi/ thob thang med pa ni ma yin no/ /bya ba da lha ba'i 'a mtha'i dod du jis 'jug na'am da ci rigs shig sbyar na/ de dag 'brel ba'i bya ba'i ming gzhan zhig tu sgyur te/ dper brngod na/nad pa 'chi nye sman gyis gsos das gson/ zer ba'i tshig 'di las/ gsos — pa'i da lha ba gso la rjes 'jug na sbyar nas/ gson zhes bya ba'i ming zhig bstan byung / mtha' rten 'di'i dod du rjes 'jug na dang da'i thun mob ma 212

da dbye dang bo'i kab pa mngon jing /yin pa'i 'jug pa 'di ni/ rten cing 'brel ba'i bya ba gzhan zhig ston pa'i nom dbyer grub pa yin no/ /dpe de bzhin/gtam bla ba la blan pa 'grig —— —ha cang dga' bas dgod par 'gyur/ma ma dgra la 'khu bas 'khun gyin 'duka— tshe las 'da' khar shid chog 'dad/— nga gnyen du the bar ha cang then/ — srog la mi skyon yid ma skyo/ — lha du sogs las bdag gzhan du 'brel ba ha cang nyung/ phal mo che ngang gi byung ba'i rigs yin no/ /don tshan gnyis pa/ bya ba'i ming rnams rten cing 'brel ba'i sgo nas dngos po'i ming du gyur pa'i dam dbye dang mtshan gzhi/ bya ba'i ming rnams rten cing 'brel ba'i las dang / byed pa dang / byas rjes dang / byed las dang bcas par spyar na/ dngos po'i ming du log 'gro/'di la thog mar bya byed las gsum gyi don rtsa rags rim zhig shes dgos/dpal mgon klu sgrub mchog gi da du ma rtsa bar/ byed po las la brten byed cing / /las kyang byed po de nyid la/ /brten nas byung ba ma gtogs pa1 /grub 213

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung pa'i rgyu ni ma mthong ngo / /zhes legs par bshad pa ltar— bya byed las gsum rten cing 'brel bar byung ba yin/ bya ba ni sems can dang yo byad(lus kyi yan lag dang thabs sogs kyang ngo)'dus pa'i 'du byed dang — byed po'i rtsol ba las bsgrub bya'i dngos po'i rnam pa 'byur ba dang / chos gang zhig rang gi ngang gis grub par snang ba'i 'byung ba dag la zer/ 'dib gsum blo la 'dzin bde bar/ zud pa'i rtsol ba dnge / las kyi 'gyur ba dang / ngang gis byung ba zhe'o/ /byed pa ni byed pa gtso phal gnyis te/ byed pa gtso bo(byed pa bo yang— ngo)di las gang zhig don du gnyer ba'i sems can dang / byed pa phal ba ni sems can gyis las la 'jug pa'i yo byad yid—/ las la las dngos dang las tsam gnyis te/ las dngos ni bsgrub par bya ba dang / las tsam pa ni bsgrub bya'i yul yin/ byed pa gtso phal gnyis dang / byed par 'brel ba'i bya ba dang gsum la bdag gi dngos po zer/ las dngos dang / las tsam pa dang / las la 'brel ba'i bya ba dang gsum la gzhan gyi dngos po zer/bdag gzhan gnyis kyang rten cing 'brel bar byung ba yin no/ /rten 'a gyi sgo nas bya ba'i ming dngos po'i ming du gyur pa rigs drug yod/ rigs dang bo'i rnam dbye ni/ nus gsu ma gyi rnam bzhag yin la/ de yang / bya ba'i ming rnams bya ba rang la 'jug tshe/ dus kyi dam bzhag lhar 'jug pa sus kyang gsal/ bya ba'i ming rnams rten 'brel gyi sgo nas/ las 214

rnam dbye dang bo'i ga pa mngod sgyung —dang / byed pa dang / byas rjes dang / byed las rnams kyi dod du sbyar na/dngos po'i ming du gyur mod/ bya ba'i mir la dus kyi rnam bzhag yod pas/ sha gzug za rkyang byas nas gang rung 'jug mi rigs/ bya ba'i ming gi ma 'ongs pa las dang / da lha ba byed pa dang 1 'das pa byas rjes dang gzhan 'brel gyi 'das pa byed las la sbyar baXyin/ snga ma gnyis la dkyus gcig tu dper brjod na/ 'bri ba bos 'bri byed kyis bri bya rnams bri sar bris tshar/ zer ba las/ 'bri pa bo ni 'bri mkhan dang / 'bri byed ka gu ste byed pa'i dbos po yin la/ bri bya ni yi ge dang / bri sa ni shog du ste las kyi dngos po yin/ 'dir bya ba'i ming dang dngos po'i ming gi ngo bo ma 'dres par ston pa'i dam dbye ni/da lta ba dang ma 'ongs pa yin no/ /dpe de bzhid/sangs rgyas la ston pa'am rnam 'dren/bskyed sring mi shā skyong mkhan/ tshul khrims la sdom ba/ lo thog 'breg pa'i 'phrul 'khor la lo 'brega'atsho byed dag gis rko ma bzung nas sman brkos/sgo srung gis sgo gtan/ lta bu sogs bka ming da lha ba byed pa'i dngos po'i ming du grubar/ /bzugs la ba lha bya/ 216

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /rta skyod sa'i lam la dkyu sa/ dgal bya khal dang bzhon pa rta/spos la bdug pa stan shā gdang ba zer/bslab la 'bad pa'i slob ma / bka' ba sha yis ri brtsigs/btung shā chang gis mtsho bskyil/lta bu sogs bya ba'i ming rmi 'ongs pa las kyi dngos po'i ming du grub bo/ 1bya ba'i ming 'das pa rang dang 'brel ba'i byas rjes la sbyar na/ dngos po'i ming du gyur te/ dper na/ rgyu skar bzos ma zhe na/ rgyu skar bzos pa'i byas rjes las/ rgyu skar bzos pa'i bya ba bstan pa ma yin no/ /bya ba'i ming dang byas pa'i dngos po'i ming gi ngo bo'i rnam dbye ni/ bya ba'i ming gi 'das pa'i rnam bzhag yin no/ /dpe de bzhin/rdzas kyis bcos nas grub pa'i bal la bal bcos ma/sngon gyi lo rgyus sam rnam thar la byung ba/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba blos btang ba'i chos pa la bya btang ba/dgra bcom pa tshos sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la sro) tu 'dzin pa/lta bu sogs las bye ba'i ming 'das pa la la tsug gi sbyor ba las dngos po'i 216

rnam dbye dang bo'i gab pa mngon snang/ming du 'jug pa yin par rtogs sla'o/ / rigs gnyes pa'i dam dbye ni/ rjes 'jug na dang da yi—thun mong ma yin ba'i 'jug pa yin/ bya ba'i ming skor zhig rang dang 'brel ba'i dngos po'i ming du 'jug par1 dmigs bsal gyis rjes 'jug na'am da sbyar ba yin/ dper na/ gser rkon gyis gser rko zer ba las/ gser rko ba ni bya ba dang / bser rkon ni gser rko ba bo yin dbye'i rnam dbye ni rjes 'jug na yin no/ /de bzhin/phar tshur 'gro ba'i 'gron po/ — ༷bzhon ma bzho/drod kyis dro—/ba gcin gci ba/ nga lud pa lu ba/dad 4'i mgo na ba/ lhad mo lta ba/lha bu sogs te/ 'de'i rigs las gzhan 'brel gyi bya ba'i ming med pa 'dra'o/ /rigs gsum pa'i rnam dbye ni/ ming mtha' mi gcig pa la thug yod de/bya ba'i ming gi ming mtha' pa'am ba ming mab 'a gzhan du brjes na/ de dang 211

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /'brel ba'i dngos po'i ming du gyur te/ dper brjod na/ dngul dun gyi skyed ka spyod 4 zer di las/ skyed pa ni yong rme ji mang du gtong ba'i bya ba rdong /skyed da ka— bu lon gyi 'phel thog ste dngos po yin zhing / gnyis ka'i ngo bo mi gcig pa'i rnam dbye ni/ ming mtha' brjes pa'i rkyen yin no/ /de bzhin/za ma za ba/ —gtul ma gtul nas 'thung /bye mos 'ji pa sbyil ba/ nga khur bo khur nas 'gro/ ——bye'u sa sgum du sgum pa/ —ldom po lnga/la ga pa dan la ldom pa/ lha bu sogs so/ /rigs bzhi ba'i rnam dbye ni/ bya ba'i ming 'das pa'i sngon 'jus dor ba yin/ bya ba'i ming 'das pa'i sngon 'jug dor na/ de dang 'brel ba'i dngos po'i ming du gyur te/ dper na/tshogs 'tshogs pa/ gros bgros pa/sten la brten pa/spyan gyis brgyan pa/ 218

dam dbye dang ba gab pa mngon sgyung shing par gyis dpar ba —— nas g.yos pa la yos zer/sgo yo' ba bgyis nang g.yol nas mi mthong /—lha bu sogs so//rigs lnga ba'i dam dbye ni/bya ba'i ming skor zhig gi ming mtha' dor ba yin bya ba'i ming gi ming mtha' dor na/de dang 'brel ba'i dngos po'i ming du gyur te/dper na/lhas la bltas pa/nyi ma shar nas shar ba/khang ba'i bar chod pa'i chod ni pang leb yin/sgrog gis rkang lag sgrog pa khebs kyis bkab nas sa pa/ nga snga sa la bsngas nas nyal ba/ ——lha bu sogs so rigs drug pa'i rnam dbye ni/mgo can dor ba'am sbyar ba yid/bya ba'i ming skor zhig gi mgo can dor na rten cing 'brel ba'i dngos po'i ming du 'byur la/dngos po'i ming gi mgo can dor na rje bya ba'i ming du gyur 'gro/snga mar dper na/29

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngod sgyung /yi ge star ba'i tar khang du/ /ha cang rwa'i tsun rngog thos/ /yig shog bsde4sa pa'i dpe deb ni/ /par du blugs pa'i lugs ma 'dra/ /mgo bo rmongs pa'i nyon mongs med/ /smin gyis ba'i bas pa'i grib ma dag /lha du sogs dang / phyi ma dper na/ skyon can dag la bka' bkyon pa/ /jes su bgros pa'i bshad ga mang //spri—༷ hūm̐ —༷na sgyus dīX ——— /༵/rdo1/sa///ha cang ngal des sdug bsngal myong / /lta bu sogs so/ / — don tshan gsum pa/ bya ba'i ming rnams rten cing 'brel ba'i sgo nas khyad chos kyi ming du gyur pa'i rnam dbye dang mtshan nyid/bya ba'i ming skor zhig rten cing 'brel ba'i khyad chos kyi ming du gyur par 220

rnam dbye dang bo'i gab pa mngon jing ston pa'i rnam dbye la rigs gsum yod de/ rigs dang bo'i rnam dbye ka/mib ga'i gcig pa'i mgo can nam sngon 'jug yod med yin/bya ba'i ming gi mgo can nam sngo na 'jug dor na/ de dang 'brel ba'i khyad chos kyi ming da gyur pa/snga mar dper na/tha gu bsgrims pa grim nas 'dug/go rim bsgrigs pa 'grig yags red//chu mgo nyog par ma stogs shig/de 'dra ma stung thung 'a //—lag pas bsnems na dem nem byed/rkang bas glebs nas leb leb nyan/lha bu sogs dang /phyi ma bar dper na // bsegs nas dras pas lteg par rtser//bsrabs nas srab mo nyan pa yin//chu khar g.yengs nas yengs yengs 'khor//—nga bsam pa gnag nas sol bas nagarta rgod bca das srun zhing g.yung //sna ba zeng nger gzengs pa mdzes//lha du sogs so/22

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung rigs gnyis pa'i rnam dbye ka/ sde ba gcig pa'i ming gzhi brjes pa yin/ bya ba'i ming gi ming gzhi pho yig ma ning ngam mo yig tu brjes nas rang dang 'brel ba'i khyad chos kyi ming du gyur pa/ dper na/lcags skud 'khro pa dkyogs pa'i phyir/ /ral gri bkug nas gzhu ltar gug /ring bo ba sa nas thung thung byed/ /gtor ba thar thor mang du mchis/ 1nye kho 'bel ba spel ba'i drin/ —tshul dang bstun nas mthun pa yin/ /lha bu sogs so/ /gong gsal sas gnyis las/ grim pa dang / mthun pa lta du rnams bya ba'i ming las kyi 'gyur ba dang / ngang gis byung ba go gnyis chod yin par ma zad— khyad chos kyi ming gi ma yang ldan pas/ khyad chos kyi ming du thad kar sbyor srol yod do/ /rigs gsum pa'i dam dbye na/ rjes 'jug 'a'i dod du rjes 'jug na'am da sbyar ba yin/ bya ba'i ming da ltar ba'i 'a mtha' can rjes 'jub na'am da ru brjes na/ de dang 'brel ba'i khyad chos kyi ming du gyur pa/ dper na1lus spu sgros das sgrin par stsar/ —— da ba 222

dam dgye dang bo'i gab pa mngon zung 1lo na rgas par rgan pa zer/ / rkang lag zha nas lung zungs zhan/ —phyogs gcig yo bas yon nas 'dug /lhags pa mnyes nas ha cang mnyen/ /la phug rnyid nas rnyi mor sgyur/ —lta bu sogs so/ / — don tshan bzhi ba/ dngos po'i ming rten 'brel gyi sgo nas dngos po'i ming gzhan zhig tu gyur pa'i rnam/ dbye dang mtshan gzhi/'di'i skor la rigs bzhi yod/ rigs dang bo'i rnam dbye ni/ ming mtha' brjes pa yin— dngos po'i ming gi ming mtha' gang 'os shig dang brjes na/ de dang 'brel ba'i dngos po'i ming gzhan zhig tu gyur pa/lhos po lhos mo rgan rgon gnyis/ / spyi bas spyi ma bdag pa bzang / /hūṃ bo'i jed du chu ma mang / /gzhong ba che la gzhong bu chung / /ze6 yi hūṃ ma zo brngo blugs/ /rtsid bu'i rtsid ) bal lhar 'jam/ / 22 3

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung rtelha bu sogs so/ /rigs gnyis pa'i rnam dbye ni/ ming mtha' yod med yid/ dngos po'i ming mtha' med pa la ming mtha' gang 'os shig spyar na/ de dang 'brel ba'i dngos po'i ming zhig tu myur pa yin/chang ma dag gis chang bsnyal/ /tshong shā dag gis tshong byed/ /ga kar las blangs di'i gter ma/ /nor bu nor las mchog yin/ / ༷ ༷khal ma 'ga' la ba bkal/ / ste/ ba ltogs par lto lhud/ / lha du sogs so/ /rigs gsum pa'i rnam dbye ni/ jis 'jug 'a rjes 'jug na'am da ru brjes pa yin/ dngos po'i ming mtha' med dam 'a mtha'i can la rjes 'jug na'am da gang rigs shig sbyar na/ de dang 'brel ba'i dngos po'i ming gzhan zhig tu gyur 'gro ste1dus kyi nyi mar nyin zhes bya/ /blo rig mkhas pas blon por bskos/ /skyed byed rgyu la rgyud 4 'byung /—/ 224

rnam dgye dar bo'i gab pa mngon sgyung stong bu rtsa bar rtsad pa thog /du ba 'thibs nas dud pa chags/ /rmen gyis lto bas ltod 'bu 'joms/ /lha bu sogs so/ / rigs bzhi ba'i dam dbye ni/ yang 'jug sbyar ba yin/ dngos po'i ming skor zhig la rten 'brel gyi sgo nas yang 'jug spyar na/ dngos po'i ming gzhan zhig tu gyur te/khung kha btsal nas 'byung khungs rnyed/ /rig pa 'dzin pas ri shes1 lam rtogs/ / kho nges su gtogs pa jeng duX chud/ /speg gis gathugs mthong sha gzug nyos/ /phrag dog dbang gis dgas shā skye /sdig pa can la sdigs mdzub bstan/ /lha bu sogs so/ / ༷don tshan lnga ba/ khyad chos kyi ming skor zhig rten cib 'brel ba'i khyad chos kyi ming gzhan du gyur ‘4'i rnam dbye dang mtshan gzhi/'di las rigs gtso bo zhig ni/ rjes 'jug 'a ni na'am ma ru brjes pa 226

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /yin te/ khyad chos kyi ming gi 'a mtha'i dod du rjes 'jug na'am ma ci rigs spyar na1 de dang 'brel ba'i khyad chos kyi ming gzhan zhig tu gyur pa/ dper na/bden pa mnga' ba bde ba yin/ /rin pa dma' ba spus ka dman/ /than pas 4nga sa tha bar gyur/ /ke ba 4 rkem nyam chung ba1 1rte dzung sta bas skam po nyan/ /da4/da gzar ri shā 'ji kha dka'—/ /lta gu sogs so/ gzhan yang / / dmun pa'i sems la sun pa 'thi sa / ha cang mad do a ma rmad/ /bzang ba'i yabs pa ba lhas na yagalta bu 'phul dang / mgo can dang / yang 'jug jed med byas nas/ rten cing 'brel ba'i khyad chos kyi ming gnyis re byung ba ma da mod/ rigs 'di dag khyab ha cang chung ngo / /226

rnam dbye dang bo'i gab pa mngon phyung —— nga don tshan dru ka pa/ khyad chos kyi ming rten cing 'brel ba'i sgo na sa dngo sa po'i ming du gyur pa'i nom dbye dang mtshan gzhi/'di'i skor la rigs gnyis yod/ rigs dang bo'i rnam dbye ni/ ming mtha' pa ba dag la na ro sbyar ba yin/ khyad chos kyi ming gi ming mtha' pa'am ba la na ro sbyar na/ de dang 'brel ba'i dngos po'i ming du rmyar te rgyu yis dbul ba'i dbul bo noms1/nor gyis phyug pa'i phyug por gyur/ /ro ni zhim 4'i 4ma 6 nyos/ /reg bya 'jam pa'i 'jim po gon/ /lha du sogs dang / — ming mtha' ba'i dad du brjod bde bar mo yig sbyar srol yang yod/ 'phur ba dma' ba'i dma' mo gang — /bya phrug yin pa gor ma chag /lha bu'o/ / ༷ rigs gnyis pa'i nom dbye ni/ rjes 'jug 'a na ru brjes pa yin/ khyad chos kyi ming gi 'a mtha'i dod du na sbyar na/ dngos po'i ming gi cha dang ldan pas thad kar dngos po'i ming du 'jug pa yin te/ /sha tsho rdud las tshon po nyos/ /gri hūṃ rdugs las non po dgos/ — 227

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung/rin thang che bar rin ched zer/ /chu phran chu rgyun phra ba'i phyir/ /mthon po go sas ma hūṃ ba yin/ /mdzad hūṃ mdzan mo mdza' zhing mthun/ /lha bu sogs dang / 'a mtha'i dod sdu da sbyar ba'ang nyung nyung zhig yod1 lci ba'i lcid mi theg lha bu'o/ / ༷ don tshan bdun pa/ grangs ka'i ming rten cing 'brel ba'i sgo nas dngos po'i ming du gyur —pa'i rnam dbye dang mtshan gzhi/'di la rigs gnyis yod/ rigs dang bo'i rnam dbye ni/ go rim brjes pa yin/ tshig gi sbyar srol las/ grangs ka'i ming bgrang bya'i ming gi rjes su 'jug pa yin mod/ go rim bzlogs nas grangs ka'i ming bgrang bya'i ming gi sngu na la sbyar na/ dngos po'i ming du gyur pa ste/ dper na/chig shad tshig rer shad gcig bri/ /nyis thog khyim tshang gnyis bsdad snang / /sum sgrog gsum po byed sgos song / /bsna mdi lam nga do kha bzhi1 /lnga lam 'chi ba'i lam yid ka/ / 228

rnam dbye dang bo'i gab pa mngon jing /drug mdo rgyab zhol 'phongs yin no/ /lta bu sogs las rmengs ka gnyis gsum dag dngos po'i ming du snga mar 'jug tshe gas 'phul dor ba dang / gcig ni tshig tu gyur pa yin/ de bzhin grangs gnas bcu yan gyi ya mtha' sbyar na yang gas 'phul dor ba ste/ chig stong nyis brgya su ma cu/ lta bu'o /rigs gnyis pa'i rnam dbye ni/ ming mtha' sbyar ba yin/ grangs ka'i ming la ming mtha' sbyar na/ spyir rim grangs kyi ming du nges kyang / rten 'brel gyi sgo nas dngos po'i ming du gyur pa yang mang /brgyad stong pa ni chos dpe dang / /yi ge dru4 ma rmi ṇi'i ming / /gdang bzhi di ni tshangs pa dang /skabs gsumaX pa ni lha yi mtshan/ /rwa bcu ba sne sha chen te/ /'dab gsum pa ni sngo sman zhig / lha bu sogs so/ /gong gsal ming mi ngo bo rnam par dbye ba'i le'u bdun du/ khyab che ba'i rigs ma gtogs/ khyab chung ba'i rigs thar thor bstan med/ de lugs ris sa bsgros nas shes par bgyi/ spyir rten cing 'brel ba'i ming gi 229

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung 1ngo bo mi gcig pa'i nom dbye shes na1 ming gi mtshan nyid ji bzhin rtog pa dang / yi ge'i dag cha lebs par ba/don par phan chen po thogs par ma zad1dngos po gang ci gsar du byung ba'am ngos zin par brda chad bya ba la ha cab sman te sgra rig pa dang / rten 'byung gi gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin du/bod skad rang mtshan pa'i ming gi sbyor ba'i khyad chos gsum1 ste/ 'bod sga ba sto sgra nyung mtha' zhig dang / brjod bde ba ste sdeb legs pa 'ig dang / ko sla ba ste kha gsal ba zhig dang bcas pa gcig tu 'dom pa'i ngag gi dpa pa shar ro// //smras pa/ dngos po gsar ba klong du brdol ba la/ /'bod mi shes par 'ga' 'ig sems ngal yang/ /bod skad byang ba'i ngag gi dbang 'byor na/ /sgra rigs mdzod las brda gsar len rkyang red// //230

bya ba rigs gsum dpyad pa rtags 'jug gi zur rgyan—sgo tshan brgyad pa/ bya ba rigs gsum dpyad pa rtags 'jug gi zur rgyan/bdag gzhan so sor 'brel ba dang / /ma 'brel bya ba rigs gsum gyi//rten 'brel dang ni dbye ba dang / /dus kyi rnam bzhag zung chub na/ 1bya byed las gsum mtshon pa dang / /tshig phreng spel bar mkhas par 'gyur/ /tshig gi skub byed gtso bo ming yin te— /ming ma dag na tshig kha mi gsal zhing / /tshig ma dag na don du mi 'byor bas/ /go brda sprad pa tshul bzhin 'phrod par dka'/ /de'i phyir dge shes shes ra rgya mtsho mchog gis/ tshig gi dag chas don gyi gnad 'byin cing / /don gyi go bas tshig gi dag thon pa/ /de dag mtshod byed ri mo'i rig byed de/ /phra zhib yig gzugs thon pa shin tu gces/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / sna ran si'i rtsom mkhan grags can spu lo'u pa'i mchog gis kyang / nga tshos chos can zhig brjod byar bris na/ de'i ngo bo 231

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon tsu nga1ston par dngos po'i ming kho thag cig dgos/ de'i skyod pa ston par bya ba'i ming kho thag cig dgos/ de'i rnam pa ston par khyad chos kyi ming kho thag cig dgos/ des na zhib mo rnam 'thag tu gzhigs nas/ dngos po'i ming ngam/ bya ba'i ming ngam/ khyad chos kyi ming gang bab de kho na ma gtogs/ de dka dang cha 'dra ba'i tha snyad cig lon pas chog go snyam du bsams nas/ tshegs 'dzems te tha snyad rjes mthun pa zhig de'i tshab cu khral mngon sla chos su 'jug mi rung ngo / /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /ming gi rigs las dngos po'i ming dang / khyad chos kyi ming dang /grangs ka'i ming sogs brngod bya'i chos de rigs dang 'dra bar gnas skabs su 'byur ba med par snang bas na/ rjod byed kyi sgra yang rang sor gnas par brten/ de mtshon byed kyi yig gzugs kyang 'gyur rgyu med pas/ blo la 'dzin sla zhing don la 'jug bde mod/ bya ba'i ming ni sems can gyi rtsol ba dang bem po'i 'gyur ba mtshon byed yin pas/ yul dus rkyen gsum gyi rang bzhin dang ldan te/ 'jug yul la bya byed las gsum gyi khyad par yod pa dang /'jug dus la 'das ma 'ongs da lha skul tshig dang bzhi'i khyad par yod pa dang / 'jug rkyen la byed pa'i rtsol ba dang las kyi 'gyur ba dang ngang gis byung ba gsum gyi khyad par yod pas/ de so so ston byed kyi sgra mi gcig pa'i sgo nas/ yig gzugs kyang mi 'dra bar rtser pa red/ 'byur lugs de rigs 232

— bya ba'i gas gsum da snad4 rtags 'ju ga gi zur rgyan/khong du ma da —na1go brda ji bad 'phrod dka' zhir 1 yig skyon re byung na/tshig skyon dang don skyon du 'gyur srid/ de lugs zags par rtogs na/ rngod byed tshig gi sku 'dra bzhengs pa la/ /bya ba'i ming gi 'dred byed btod mkhas na/ba—gnad 'dus srog gi gson nyams thon pa las/ /smra ba'i lha mo gar du rtsen pa mthob / /don tshan dang bo/ bya ba rigs gsum shes pa'i— dgos pa bstan pa/ tshig gi sbyor ba la zu ba'i ming gang 'tsham du 'jug pa'i gnad ni/ bya ba rigs gsum gyi spu ris 'byed mkhas bar rag las/ sngon byon mkhas pa'i gsung rtsom dang 1 bod kha ba cad pa'i kha skad du/ bya ba'i ka nge lor ga sa gsum dngos su yod par ma zad/ 'jug pa'i dbye ba'ang gsol bar thon snang / yin na yang rtags 'jug gi rtsa ba las/ bya ba rigs gtsum gyi dbye ba lung du bstad med pa dang / rtags 'jug gi 'grel ba grags chen—dag las/bdag dang 'brel ba'i bya ba dang / gzhan dang 'grel ba'i bya ba rigs gnyis bstad pa'i zhor du/ bdag gzhan gang la'ang ma 'brel sko'i bya ba dzigs shig kyang ragakhu pa tswam gsungs snang pa bad de gsum tshan da gyi bzul bdang khyad par ci 'dra yin pa dam gsal zhig bstan nas med dka /der blta na 233

dag yig rig ji dag mngod sgyung /mkhas chen de— dag kyang rang skad goms rtsegs⑫sa bya ba'i ming gi—'jug pa tsā 'o snyam nas/ ma brtags pa'i dbang gi sgyur mas pa 'dre/ de phyir khong rnam pas bya byed las gsum dang dus gsus dang bcas pa bdag gzhan gyi zlas zu ba las/ dbye sgo la la ma 'dus pa dang / la la phan tshun 'brel ma chags pa'am 'dzings par gyur pa ni1 phal cher —thugs dgongs de phyogs ma khebs pa'i skyon yin par sims so/ /bye bar gas gsum yod lhal dang / de dag phan tshud gyi 'brel ba dang khyad par ji 'dra yin tshul shes rgyu ha cang gal che/ de lugs blo ngor ma nges na—rtags 'jug gi gzhung don dpyis phyin pa zhig rtogs dka'/ brda sprod smra ba mi— nyung ba zhig gi su kyang / byed pa bo rte bdag yin te/— /bya ba'i dngos po gzhan ban no / /zhes dang / byed pa'i las ni dus da lta ba dang / bya ba'i las ni dus ma 'ongs par 'du/ zhes pa lha bu ma dag rgyun 'byams rnams bden par rlom nas tshad mar 'dzin pa lha bu'o/ / —deng gi char rtsom pa bo gsar bu skor zhig byung ba las/ nyung phyogs sum rtags dag gsum gyi gdeb thob cing / rtsom pa rtsal du thon pas thos dga' mthor kror snang mod/ mang phyogs sgra rig pa'i spyangs stobs dman pas/ tha snyad kyis dbul bas/ tshig gi sbyor ba don du ji bzhi'i mi 'byor ba/ sgos su thu ba'i ming gi dus sum dang bdag gzhan sogs kyi dbye ba mi zud par 2 34

bya ba'i bas gsum dpyad pa rtags 'jug gi zur min—tshul min du 1bzug pa mang ba/ ban rgya skad dang bod skad gnyis ka'i khyad chos mi mthun pa'i smor ma shes la/ bya ba mtshon byed kyi ming yu' dus rkyen gsum gyi thob thang ji bzhen 'jug par mad rmongs pa dang / ming mtha'i nus pa rtsal du 'don par lag thobs pa'i dbang gis/ rgya skad kyi nom pa tsam la lad mo byas nas/ sgra gnyis re rdo chag bcan bsgrigs dang 1 bong lto sra bsres kyis tha snyad gcib tu spyar nas tshig phreng sgrol ba/ ne lha'i kha ton go brda ji bzhin mi 'phrod pa'i skyon sogs1 mang du mthong ngo / /don tshan gnyis pa/ bya ba'i ming gi yul dus rkyen gsum mdor bstan pa1/bya ba rigs gsum gyi ngo bo dang / dbyeXb dang / 'bre'— ba'i don rnams go bde bar bya ched1 thog mar/ kho pos brtsams pa'i brda sbod gsal byed ngag sgron las/ bya byed las gsam sogs kyi go don dang 'brel tshul mdor bsdus 'dir drang bar bya'o/ /byed pa la ni gtso phal gnyis/ /byed ba gtsom bo rdzub mkhan dang / /byed pa phal ba skrub spyad yin/ /lasaX༄ bya yul rje bsgrub bya gnyis/ /bya ba'i yul ba las tsam dang / 1236

dgaXyig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /bsgrub par bya ba las dngos yin/ /bya ba bdag gzhan khungs gtogs gnyis/ /rten cing 'brel bar byung ba las/ /byed ‘ dang 'brel bya ba ni/ /byed pa'i las zhes brjod pa dang / /las dang 'brel ba'i bya ba ni/ 1bya ba'i las zhes btags pa yin/ /bya ba byas zin 'das pa dang / / byed bzhin pa ni da lha ba— /byed par 'gyur ba ma 'ongs pa/ /skul tshig ma 'ongs khongs su 'dus/ 1de rnams phan tshun 'brel lugs ni/ /byed pa da lha ba yis dang / /las ni ma 'ongs pa yis sgrub/ /bya ba dus kyi dam bzhag ltar/ /bab dang bstun nas sbyar bar bya/ /de rnams tshig gi phreng ba las/ 1so so'i mtshan gzhi rnam gsal bya/ /2mi6

bya ba rigs gsum dpyad pa rtags 'jug gi zur rgyan/shing bzos sta res nabs tshal du/ /sdong bo bcad nas chod pa las/ /shing bzo byed pa gtso bo dang / /snye re byed pa phal ba yin/ /nags tshal gcad yul las tsam dang / /sdong bo gcad bya las dngos yin/ /bcad dang chod pa'i bya ba gnyis/ /snga ma byed pa'i rtsol ba dang / /phyi ma las kyi 'gyur ba yin/ /shing bzo sta re bcad pa gsum/ /bdag gi khongs su gtogs pa dang / /nags tshal sdong bo chod pa gsum/ /gzhan gyi khongs su gtogs pa'o/ /shing bzo la sogs bya tshig gis/ /mtshon par byas na 'di lha ste/ /gcod pa bo yis gcod byed kyis//gcad sa'i gcad bya bcad chod ces//tha snyad 'di lhar btab/sa pa yin/ /237

dag yib/ rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung 1bdag gzhan ma 'brel bya ba'i rigs//'gro dang shar ba lha bu sogs — /rang gi ngang gis grub pas na/ 1bya byed tha mi dad pa ste/ /byed po bzhan dang 'brel rgyu med / /byed pa po yi rtsol ba dang / /las kyi dngos po'i 'gyur ba dang 1 /rang mi ngang gis byung ba dag /bya ba rigs gsum zhes pa 'o/ /'di ra bdag gzhan so sor dbye ba du re yod pa dang / de dag phan tshun rten cing 'brel ba'i gnas lugs ji 'dra yin pa legs par shes rgyu ha cang bal che/ 'jig rten khams kyi las rigs gang zhig yin rung / sbyor dngos mjug ba/su zu1 du mthun rkyen drug snye1 bdag gi dngos po gsum dang / gzhan gyi dngos po gsum legs par 'dzoms na/ 'dod don bde blag tu 'grub la/mthun rkyen kher re zhig chad kyang ci 'dod don du mi smin/ de bzhin byed pa bos la sa gang bgye ba la bya ba'i yul zhigaXdagos/ yul der phyin tshe/ byed par brted nas bsgrub par bya ba'i las zhig dgos/ 'a sa la rtsol ba sbyar ba'i rgyu las/ 'dod don smin par 'gyur ba'i 'bras bu zhig dgos/ des na byed pa 238

bya ba rigs gsum dpyad pa rtags 'jug gi zur rgyan/po dang bya ba'i yul/ byed pa dang las1 byed pa'i las dang bya ba'i las bcas—gnyis re gnyis re zla bo'i tshul du 'brel nas bdag gzhan cha gsum byung ba dag phan tshun rten dang brten pa'i sgo nas don gnyer phud sum tshogs par grub pa yin no/ /tshig gi phreng ba spel bar bdag gzhan gang gi yan lag gang rung bab dang bstun nas dngos shugs ci rigs sbyar chog go /bya ba'i ming dmas1 las dang byed par 'jug pa'i tshul shes na / dus kyi rnam bzhag mi nor te/ lta ba'i mig ces pa'i lha ba ni/ lha byed yin pas da lha ba thob pa dang /blta ba'i dpe cha/ zhes pa'i ba lha ba ni/ blta bya yin pas ma 'ongs pa thob pa bzhin no— /'di lugs bya ba'i ming da ngos po'i ming du 'jug pa'i skabs phyi ma las go bar gyis shig / don tshan gsum pa/ bya ba rigs gsum rgyas par bstan pa/da ni gzhung don dngos te byed pa'i rtsol dang / las kyi 'gyur ba dang / ngang gis byung ba bcas bya ba rigs gsum bshad par bya'o/ /dang bo/ byed pa'i rtsol ba/bdag dang 'brel ba'i bya ba ste byed pa'i rtsol ba ni/ las gang byed pa gzhan dang dngos su 'brel ba'i bya ba yin te/ bya ba 'di rigs la bdag gi sgo nas byed pa(gtso phal gnyis)zhig dgos/ gzhan gyi sgo das las(gzu 239

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung phal gnyis)shig dgos/ tshig sbyor du de gnyis so sor 'byed pa'i rnam dbye('brel sgra dang / byed sgra dang / la don rnams la rnam dbye zhes pa ni/ bdag gzhan chosaganyis kyi ngo bo ma 'dres par so sor 'byed pa'i sna yin pa'i cha nas btags pa'o/)gsum pa zhig kyang dgos/ blo gros kyis pir gyis yi ge bris pa na/ bris pa'i bya ba 'di'i las yi ge yin zhing 1 'bri ba bo blo gros dang 'bri byed pir yin par/ byed sgra kyis dang gyis zhes pas rnam par bstan pa'o/ /de rigs la byed pa gtso phal gang rung tshig zin du med na yang / shugs bstan du yod de/ lu gu 'khur ba na/ 'khur bya'i lu gu der/ 'khur ba bo spyang ki dang / 'khur byed kha lha bu med na/ 'khur ba'i bya ba byung tshul med do/ /rlung gis skyod pa na/skyod pa bo rlung de la bskyod bya'i las dar cha lha bu zhig shugs bstan du yod pas/ byed sgra 'jug pa yin la/ las kyi dngos po dar cha 'dra med na/ rlung g.yug zer dgos/ de lta na g.yug pa ni rlung rang gi ngang gis byung ba'i bya ba yin pas/ byed sgra mi 'thob ste/ bya byed tha mi dad pa'am bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /byed pa'i rtsol ba la las kyi 'byur ba dngos su 'byung mi 'byung rigs gnyis yod de/ las kyi dngos po sngar yod pa zhig rtsol ba las/ rnam pa gzhan zhig tu gur pa la/ las kyi 'gyur ba yod de/ shog bu gshags das shogs/ lha bu dang / las kyi dngos po sngar med pa zhig rtsol ba las chos can zhig tu grub pa la/ las kyi 'gyur ba med de— sku 'dra bzhengs/ lha du'o/ /las kyi 'gyur ba 240

bya ba rigs gsum dpyad ba rtags 'jug gi zur rgyan/yod tshul gnyis pa'i skabs su gsal bar bya/ 'dir byed pa'i rtsol ba tsam las/ las kyi 'gyur ba 'byung rgyu med pa'i mtshan gzhi dper bkod na/ (byed pa'i rtsol bar kor rtags dang / las kyi 'byur bar thig rtags dang / ngang gis 'byung bar 'khyug rtags kyis mtshan pa gsham gsal)'brog pas phyugs 'tsho 'phar3spyang bda'/ 1ri dwags rngod shing je sa srung // —ru spor ra bskor dang thag 'then/ / 'o ma bzhos shul rtsi ba 'thu/ /mar kar khyer nas 'bru zad brjes/ / pags pa bsul nas slog pa bzo//bal bsed skud pa mel zhing dgel/ / rtswa rnga thags 'thag gro ma rko/ /mkha) pas sna) tsha bzungs nas bris/ /glegs bam bkags nis go dka' ba'i/ /don la dgongs shing dpyad de bkra la/ /bstan brtsis brtsams nis dpar cing bkun/ rim gyis brtsegs shing ri lhar bcigs/ /shes rab bskyangs nas srol bzang bstod/ / 241

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /thugs dam bskangs nas tshogs gnyis bsags/ / rig lam btod pa kun gyis bsngags/ /sman bkus khong bsten snyung gzhi drag /lha rjer bkur cing drin lan gzob// dka' ba spyad nas las la 'dungs/ / chu nyog bgrungs nas lhon pa 'khrud/ /'bras 4na bgrus shing bu ram bsgar/ / nas nang rdo rug bgrugs nas rngod/ — bag zu brdzis nas legs par bsdos/ /gor dmar bsregs nas ston mo bgyi/ / dus pa bang das nu ma brdzun/ / lus po brta bar nyod pa stod/ /lag nasaX dkris te mi chos smras/ /man ngag gdams nas rig di skyed/ /sgyur phri bshe snon thogs pa med/ /legs nyes blang dor tshul rdong bstun//phru slog zhing dbyeg g.yul kha gzung/don gnyer ma6sa pas kun rmes smon/ / 242

byab rigs gsum dpyad pa rtags 'jug gi zur rgyan/lta du sogs so/ 1gnyis pa/ 'a1si kyi 'gyur ba/gzhan dang 'grel ba'i bya ba ste las kyi 'byur ba ni/ byed pa'i rtsol ba 'jug sa'i las dang 'brel ba'i bya ba yin te/ bya ba 'di rigs la'ang byed pa bo dang las kyi dngos po so so re dgos/ de gnyis rnam par 'byed pa'i byed sgra yang dgos/ byed pa'i rtsal ba dang mi gcig sa ni/ byed pa'i rtsol ba ni las la 'jug pa'i bya ba yin zhing 1 las kyi 'grur ba ni las kyi dngos po byed pa'i rtsol ba la brten nas/ rang bzhin nam rnam pa gzhan zhig tu 'gyur ba yin te/ dper na/ rngon pas ri dgas bsad nas sod pa na/ rngon pa ni gsod pa bo dang / ri dwags ni las dang / las kyi dngos po 'dir spyar ba'i bya ba snga ma bsad pa ni/ byed pa bo gzhan dang 'brel ba'i bya ba ste/ rngon pa'i rtsol ba yin pas/ bdag gi khongs su gtogs pa dang / byaXb phyi ma sod pa ni/las dang 'brel ba'i bya ba ste/ bsad pa las byung ba'i las kyi 'gyur ba yin pas/ gzhan gyi khongs su gtogs pa'o/ /'dir ri dwags bsad pa ni/ byed pa'i las te/ byed pa bo dang 'brel ba'i las zhes bya ba'i mtshan gzhi dngos yin/ de yang / ri dwags zhes pa'i las la sbyar ba'i bya ba bsad pa ni/ las de la dngos su 'brel nas med par/byed pa po gzhan zhig ste gang zhe na/ gsod pa bo de dang dngos su 'brel nas 243

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /yod pa'i phyir dang / ri dwags sod pa ni/ bya ba'i las te/ bya ba'i yul dang 'brel ba'i las zhes bya ba'i mtshan gzhi dngos yin/ de yang ri dwags zhes pa'i las la spyar ba'i bya ba sod pa ni/ gsod pa po dang dngos su 'brel nas med par/ bya ba'i yul te las kyi dngos po dang dngos su 'bril nas yod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na byed pa dang 'brel ba'i bya ba la byed pa'i las dang /las dang 'grel ba'i bya ba la bya ba'i las zhes brjod don ni/ dpal mgon klu sgrub kyis/ byed po las la brten byas shing / /las kyang byed po de nyid la/ /brten nas byung ba ma gtogs pa/ /grub pa'i rgyu ni ma mthong ngo / /zhes gsungs pa(dbu ma rtsa ba las/)lhar/ skabs 'dir ngang gis byung ba'i bya ba rigs gsum pa khol du phyung nas/ las dang byed pa rten 'byung 'i bya ba rigs gnyis la ngos bzung ba yin/ tshig sbyor du las kyi dngos po dngos shugs ci rigs la spyar ba'i bya ba rigs gnyis kyi sgra dang yig gzugs la khyad par yod pas da/ byed pa'i rtsol ba la byed las dang / las kyi 'gyur ba la bya las zhes btags pa yin la/ kha cig gis don 'di ma rtogs par/ byed pa'i las dang / bya ba'i las kyi las tsam la dmigs nas/ bya tshig la las tshig tu ngos bzung ba ni/ g.yag rwa rta mgor sbyar ba'i dper song ba ste/ bya ba las la ma sbyar na/ /las kyi dngos po logs su med/ /bya ba bsgrub byar sbyar ba na/ /don gnyer yin pas las zhes bya/ /des na tshig gi spyor ba las bya 2 14

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung bzhan ku bas ma khyab pa yin no/ / —las kyi 'gyur ba dngos su 'byung rgyu yod pa la yang / la dang 'grel ba'i bya ba kho na nyid dang / las dang 'brel ma 'brel gyi bya ba spyir btang ba rnam pa gnyis yod da/ lnga ma di1 byed pa bo gzhan dang 'bril ba'i bya ba la brted nas snang ba yin te byed ba bob na 'brel na/ byed sgra yang 'jug dkos/ a zhang gis rta bzung nas zin pa las/ zin pa zhes pa bzung ba la ma brten na byung tshul med pa'i dbang gis/ bzung ba zhes pa bsdus kyang byed sgra—'dor mi zang ste/ ma zhal gis rta ldan/ lta bu dang / ras mthong / zhes pa'i mthor ba ni/ shugs bkan gyi dngos po blta bya dang 'brel ba'i bya ba yin te/mthob rje ba'i 'bras bkar byed dzib ma pas da pa'i phyir ro/ /gnas lugs 'di legs par rtogs ka/ tshig nyung la don lha ka ba'i gnad 'byid thubadaper na༈ gob rtsa—'dzugs ba zhus pa'i kand don zhig rjes ji su go ba len par1 gros dbas mabs tsam du/ zag bcad dam/ zhes dang / don thog phab ma lad bku thag me chod/ ces dris pas 'thus te/bskobs bab kyi god da byed ba'i las sam/ bya ba'i las gang yin pa nyid1 khab shul gyi skud pa bzhin/tshig shul lha'i don gsal bar thon 'gro'o/ / — ji ga las dang 'brel ba'i bya ba spyir bteng ba ni/ go nyis chod yid te/byed ba rab ga ba la spyar chog par ma zad/ las la'ang spyar chog dper na—246

bya ba rigs gsu dpyad pa rtags 'asgyug gi zur rgyan/du ba 'khrigs ba na/ 'khrigs pa'i bya ba 'ji byed pa gzhan zhig da btsulanas med par/ byed pa du ba rang gi ngang gis grub par snang bas na/ bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba med pas byed sgra 'jug srol med sob / bya ba 'di rigs las la'ang sbyar chog ste/ du ba dkrigs nas 'khrigs zar༄/ las kyi dngos —po du ba dang 'brel ba'i 'khrigs pa ni/ byed pa gzhan 'grel gyi bya ba dkrigs pa la brten nas byung ba yin pas/ da thigs pa bdag dang /'khrigs pa gzhan gyi khongs su gtogs pa'o / /bya ba go—gnyis chod 'di rigs byed pa gzhan 'brel gyi bya ba la ma brten par las le zad kar 'jug srol med de/ ngas rta zin/ ngas zin/ zer ba ltar/ khos du ba 'khrigs/ khos 'khrigs/ zhes bshad sro4 med do/ /bya las dang byed las phan tshun brten cing 'grel ba'i 'gyur lugs 'di'i khyad chos mngon phar gsal bkag ba byed las bya las la bstos na1sgra gdangs cung drag gzugs 'gyur cub che/ yig tshogs cung mang / byed pa'i las la skul tshig gis khyab pa dang / spya ba'i las la skul tshig med pa'o/ /mdor na/ ming gzhi gcig pa dang / ming gzhi sdeb gcig pha gnyis su 'dus 11 /1 ming gzhi gcig pa las/ ming gzhi rkyar brtsegs gcig pa dang /ming gzhi rkyang ba gcig pa rigs gnyis yod de/ snga ma'i khyad par ni/ ming 2 7

bya ba rigs ba gsum dpyad pa rtags 'jug gi zur sgyun/bsnyen ni nye bar byas pa dang //—bsnyungs nas nyung bas 'dang sa med//dkar rtsi bsnyugs nas nyugs pa dang //—kong 'dur bsnyams nas mnyam pa'o//mang bo bsdus nas gcig pa 'as/gzu bos bsdums nas ba 'dum ra 'gyur//—sna tshogs bsdom sa na rnam gsum 'dom//thil bo ka nas chag cing grum /'grig lam bsna gas nas nog pa'i srol//brdzubs nas nub pas snar ba skyid/—thag khyud me tog bsnar nas nar/sna yis bsnams na dri bsung mnam/—gad pa brdzud nas nud pa dang //—rdo rgan brdzur nas phar la nur// —bsnad nas lag pa na na yang //—bsnar nas nor ba dag par bcos/—rgyun bu chu la sgangs nas bangasasga shing sbol nas dam po' bal/ nga 249

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung /btsog pas sbags nas 'bags pa rnams/—sreg za sbar nas 'bar song ngo //gang thub sgyur babs ga ra ci//dug gis smyos nas myos ra byur//rig pa ma bslabs rang lob med/dang du blangs na ci yang lo /—gyang zul 4zogs nas log pa lhar// nga gnyid rkyal ma bslangs lang rgyu med//lha bu sogs dang /phyi ma ming gzhi rkyang ba bcig pa'i khyad par ni/byed pa'i las spyir sngon 'jug yod cing /bya ba'i las ha lam sngon 'jug med pa dang /nyung shas sgra rje zhan du gtong ched/'as 'phul ba yod de/dper na/gros la bgor nas yong ba 'gor//—gnas tshul gnyul bar kun tu nyul//—g.yug pas gnyogs nas shu rus nyog/—pags pa mnyes nas ha cang mnyen//——mgron du drangs pa ma lus 'drongs/thang ma bdal nas phyi la 'dal//shed kyis mnan kyang ma nod // nga 2༷0

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /bya ba rigs 'di gnyis las/ming gzhi brtsegs pa 'dra ba dang /rkyang ba 'dra ba nyung ngu zhig yod par ma zad/ yig gzugs kyang phal cher 'dra ba dang /mtha' na go gcig chod can khar kher yang yod de/tshod ma bskyed nas skyes pa ma lhogs//dogs gzhi brtags ngas rtogs par gyur//bu ga brtol nas phyi la brdo //—don la gzhol nas mtha' la bzhel/dpyid lug 'tshos kyang srog ma sa// —sha rug bskams nas rab tu bskams// nga skyon cha bsal bsal ma lus bsal//—phyags mas 'phyags nas gtsang mar phyogs/ nga lha bu rnams so//2 ming gzhi sde ba gcig pa las/ming gzhi rkyang brtsegs sde ba gcig pa dang /ming gzhi rkyang ba sde ba gcig pa rigs gnyis yod de/snga ma'i khyad par/ byed las ni ming gzhi brtsegs pa pho yig dang bya las ni ming gzhi rkyang ba ma ning yin te/bskul nas 'khul bas pe pa 'grub//—'gan khur bskyangs nas rnga ma ba sha/262

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngod phyung /glog 'od ma smos 'phros don med/ / ——ci 'dod sprul na'ang 'phrul ba mtshar/ /lha bu sogs so/ /yang 'di rigs lad/ngas 'khur/ ngas lhon/ zhes pa'i 'khur dang / lhon/ lha bu rnams byed pa'i las yin mod/ las kyi dngos por spyar na/ bya ba'i las su gyur pa'ang yod de/ chu la bskur nas khur song / byis par lu bskyon nas lhon pa/ lta bu sogs so/ / ——phyi ma/ ming chod rkyang ba sde ba gcig pa'i khyad par ni/ byed las kyi 'das pa'i ming ga'i pho yig yin na/ bya las kyi ming gzhi ma ning du 'gyur zhing / byed las kyi 'das pa'i ming gzhi ma ning yin na/ bya las kyi ming ga'i mor 'gyur la/ byed las kyi ming gzhi mo yin na/ bya las kyi ming gzhi'i byed rtsol de las zhan pa'i mor gyur 'gro/ byed las kyi skul tshig gi ming gzhi dang 1bya las kyi ming gzhi phal cher sde ba gang de'i gnyis pa yin la/ byed las de tsho'i da lha ba dang ma 'ongs pa'i ming gzhi phal cher sdo ba gang nyid kyi gsum pa yin zhing / ma 'ongs pa nyung shas kyi ming gzhi sde ba gzhan las gnas dang byed pa gang mtshungs shig drangs pa'i rigs kyi bya las kyi ming gzhi'ang phal cher de rang yin srid/ 'di rigs kyi mtshan gzhi dper na/dgag bya'i gnod pa 'gog byed khogs/ /bkag na ye 'khog kho)byung ngo / / nga — —264

bya ba rigs gsu ma dpyad pa rtags 'jug gi zur rgyan—kyang gang zag la 'jug rung ba nyung ngu ma gtogs/ bem po la mi 'thob nyi ma shar ba na/ nyi ma ni byed pa tsam dang / shar ba ni bya ba yin zhing — las kyi dngos po med pas/ shar ba'i 'char ba bo nyi ma rang gi ngang gis grub par snang ba yin pas/ 'char byed dang 'char bya gnyis ka nyi ma yin zhing / ngo bo gcig tu grub ste/ bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba med pas/ rnam dbye gsum pa 'jug don med 'a / nyi ma ni go ba med pa'i bem po'i rigs yin pas/ skul tshig sbyar rgyu med do/ /nga 'gro zer ba na/ 'gro ba'i bya ba 'di phar las la 'jug ba 'i rtsol ba min la/ las las tshur snang ba'i 'gyur ba'ang min te/'gro byed nga yin la/ 'gro byadang nga yin pas/ bya byed tha dad du mi snang ba'am/ bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba med pas/ byed sgra 'jug mi rung / 'on kyang gang zag la sbyar na skul tshig thob ste/ khyod song / lha bu'o/ /bya ba ngang gi byung ba 'di rigs kyi ming gzhi las/ brtsegs ma nyung la rkyang ba mang / 'gyur ba gnyis can ha cang nyung zhing / mi 'gyur ba rab tu mang ste/ (yig gzugs mi 'gyur ba kor rtags kyis dang / 'gyur ba 'khyugs rtags kyis mtshan pa)rgyug rtsal mngon rtags dbugs mi lngam/ /da ka mched sar bros das thar/ / ༷'chi la snye ba ma shi dang / /ba —— —26

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa ma ngod phyung /—me la 'chor rgyu shor nas tshar/ /— — ba na yang sman la mjid nas gnyid1 / stobs shing skom pas mal nas —pangs/ /——— ba — — — ba lto tshe mi 'byid phyid na dga'/ /ba — — — ba gzhung la rems nas rang don yal//——— —— —bya sgod babs nas ped la rub— / —— — — —lug khyu 'drogs nas zhobs shing byer/ /ba — ༷ —— —lhung rgyu lhung nas 'dam la zub /rje rdong 'dzul ba phyi la bud/ / — ——lha bu sogs so 1kang gsal bya ba rigs gsum gyi ngo bo mi gcig kyang / de rnams las skor 'ib 'byel ba nges can zhig yod pa'i sgo nas/ rnam pa shar tshul 'dra bas na ming gzhi'ang nyung ngu ma gtogs/ sde ba gcig par mchis te/ spyir sde ba sang mi yi ge dang bo byed pa'i las dang / gnyis pa bya ba'i las dang /gsum nga bya byed za mi dad pa yin la1 ming gzhi gcig pa' ba nyung zad cib yod de1 ming gzhi brtsegs pa bdag dang / rkyang ba gzhan dang bdag gzhan ma 'bre' ba yin la/ snga bar las kyi 'gyur ba la na ro thob pa dang / ngang gis byung ba shā na ro mi 'thob bo/ /de lugs gsham gsal/268

dag yid rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /——brtol nas brdol ba'i khung nas thol gyis byung / / ——— ——bstems nas ma thim kang ba bye mar dim/ /da sprul nas phrul bka gor brul skam za da1 /'bel ba gad nga spel nasgo 'phel ba min/ /rmo stod kha bye zus nas zud she min—/ 1— ——gyang la sbyar nas 'byor bas 'byar nas 'dug / ———— ———lag rtsal spyangs nas 'byongs pa rab tu byang / / ——— —btsugs nas ma tshugs 'dam la zug par 'gyur/ /bslab 4 ldo ba pa rje pas ci yang dab /gcig tu 'dod yang bsdams nas dge pa min/ /slod nas rnyed༄ min yang khyi las ched/ /lha bu sogs leg par rtogs na/ bri bklag kun cho dan te/ thon mi'i yig phud las/ dug gsum bdud 'dul kud tu thul/ /zhes pa'i 'dul dang thul gyi rgyu 'bras kyi 'brel ba las/ 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gnyi nug gsum gyi sgrib nyes bag chags mtha' dag par 'byongs pa'i don bde blag tu shes thub/ ba tsan po 'dus srong gi mgur las/ rtse na ni rdo yang rdo/ /'phangs na ni shā yang khums/ /zhes pa'i khums ni/ byid pa'i rtsol ba bkum la brten nas byung ba'i las kyi 'gyur ba yin pa'i sgo nas/ mda' mo'i rtse mo no bas 260

bya ba rigs gsum dpyad pa rtags 'jug gi zur rgyad—'phangs na sha ba sod pa'i don go /rlangs 'khor sogs su 'dug pa'am/glog brnyan sogs blta ra nyos pa'i rtags la 'khrol 'dzin zhes pa yang /dgag cha med par rjes su gnang ba'i don du go'o/ /yul der dus 'khrug byung bas lam 'gags nas 'ong ma thub/ zhes pa'i 'gags dang / mtsho sngon po'i rgya khyod la/ bskor na zhag bdun rta yis 'khor ba yin/ zhes pa'i 'gags pa dang 'khor ba dag bya ba'i ming gi rigs kyi khyad par gang la gang 'tsham du 'jug mkhas par mngon no/ /de lhar bya ba rigs gsum gyi dbye dang 'jug tshul mgo mi rtsongs par byur na/ da dod pa ji bzhin smra ba'i mchog tu 'grur srid do/ /don tshan bzhi ba/ bya ba'i ming gi dus gsum skul tshig dang bzhi'i 'gyur tshul bstan pa/bya ba'i rnam pa 'dra yang ngo bo mi gcig pa'i za das/ bya ba'i ming ni las dang 'brel ma 'brel gyi sems can gyi rtsol ba dang / bem po'i 'gyur ba ston pa'i bad yin te/ brjod bya de rnams la bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba yod pa gong gsal1 des mi tshad dus kyi dam bzhag kyang yod la/ de mtshon byed kyi sgra dang yig gzugs la'ang dus 'das pa dang / da lha ba dang / ma 'ongs dang / skul tshig bcas kyi khyad par yod/'byur lugs 'di'i gnad ma zin na/ yig gzugs bzhi 'byur dang /261

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /sum 'gyur dang / nyis 'gyur dang/ mi 'gyur ba'ang yod de/ nyog 'dzings che la/ cid skud mgo pregs khab mig tu mi 'tshud pa'i dper snang yang / 'jig rten khams kyi dngos po gang yang rung ba'i 'gyur lugs la nges srol re yod pas/ chos nyid de rtogs na/ gzhan dbang gi sdug bsngal rang dbang gi bde bar bsgyur thub/ bya ba'i mi pa gi yig gzugs kya'i / mdor na spyi bye thur bu gsum du dril ba'i gnas lugs rtogs na/ bya ba'i ming gi yig gzugs 'gyur tshul dus kyi rnam bzhag ltar 'jug pa'i dbang 'byor ro/ /dang bo/ dus gsum spyi khyab pa/dus gsum spyi khyab pa ni/ bya ba'i ming gi dus gsum gyi dbye ba sngon 'jug gsum gyis rnam par bstan pa zhig ste/ de la sngo zhe 'jug las 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa nyung shas la bas 'phul ba dang / da lha ba la 'as 'phul ba—ma 'ongs pa la ga da ci rigs shig gis 'phul ba/ sku tshig khar kher ma gtogs sngon 'jug mi 'thob bo/ /'gyur lugs 'di'i khyad chos bya ba'i ming gi spyi mtshan du snang bas/ 'gyur lugs gzhan gnyis kyang 'di dang 'brel chags pa mang / skor 'di'i ming gzhi ka ca/ ta/ tsa sde ba bzhi la khyab che/ bya ba'i ldog pa gang ston byed kyis tha snyad de'i ming gzhi phal cher sde༄ gang zhig gcig tu nges shing1 sde ba de'i yi ge dang bo 'das pa dang / gnyis pa skul tshig dang / gsum pa da lta ba'am ma 'ongs pa'i ming gzhir grub cing / bzhi 262

bya ba rigs gsum dpyad pa rtags 'jug gi zur rgyan1ba 'di rigs kyi ming gzhi gang la'ang mi 'jug go /de rnams las da lha ba'am ma 'ongs pa ston pa'i 'phul gang 'jub yul dang ma mthun na/ ming gzhi de bsubs das sdo ba gzhan las gnas dang byed pa gang mtshungs kyi yiche zhig ming gzhi de'i dod du 'jug pa nyung shas shig kyang snang / 'di rigs kyi ma 'ongs pa dang / da lta ba dang / skul tshib dang / 'das ba ltar rim pa bzhim du dper bkod da1 — 'bya yis ma 'ongs pa dang / byed kyi da lha ba dang / cis zhig shig ci rigs kyis skul tshig ston pa dang / 'das par tshig grogs sbyar bas pa'o1 1)gnod pa dgag bya 'gog byed khogs shig bkag /thag pas bkyig bya 'khyig byed khyegs shig bkyigs/ /rtsam pa bgam bya 'bam byed 'goms shig gams/ /phas rgol bzhom bya 'jom byed choms shig bcom1 /thabs kyis gcun bya 'jun byed chun cig bcun/ /gdan dkar gnying bya 'ding byed thongs shig bteng / /bdud dpung gdul bya 'dul byed thul cig btul/ /thang ma bdal bya gdal zud gdol zheg bdal/ /sa la gzug bya 'dzugs byed tshugs shig btsugs/ /kha ni btsum bya 'dzum byed tshums shig btsums/ /263

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mjin sgyung /——mdun du gzhag bya 'jog byed zhog cig bzhag /mda' la gzur bya 'dzur byed zur cig bzar/ /nyes pa bshag bya 'chabs byed shogs shig bshags/ /rgyu nor gsog bya gsog byed gsogs shig bsogs/ /'thab dmag gsag bya gsog byed gsogs shig bsags/ /lha bu sogs te/ 'di rigs kyi ming gzhi 'byur tshul sde ba gcig pa dang mi gcig pa gnyis su 'dus shing / ming gzhi sum 'gyur can ka ca ta tsa sde ba bzhir nges pa las/ ca sde'i ja dang / tsa sde'i dza ni ma 'ongs pa ston byed kyi ga sngon 'jug gi 'jug yul du mi 'gyur bas/ sde ba gzhad las byed rtsod mthun pa'i zha dang / za so sor drangs nas ming gzhi bzhi 'gyur can du log pa yin/ming gzhi gnyis can skor zhig sde ba gcig pa dang / skor zhig sde ba mi gcig ste/ zha dang ja/ za dang dza/ sha dang cha gsum du nges/ ming gzhi rkyang ba ga da sa bcas nyung tsam du zad do/ /gnyis pa/ dus gsum bye brag pa/dus gsum las dus gnyis sngon 'jug dag gis bstan pa zhig ste/ ming gzhi rkyang brtsegs ci rigs kyi 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa sngon 'jug ba yis bstan pa de'i da lha ba dang skul tshig la 'phul mi 'thob cing 1 sngon 'jug ga da ci rigs kyis ma 'ongs pa dang / 'a yis da rto ba bstan pa gang 264

bya ba rigs ga༅1༷dpyad pa rtags 'jug gi zur rgyan—gi 'das pa dang skul tshig la 'phul mi 'thob la/ mir gzhi brtsegs pa gcig pa dang 1 rkyang ba phal mo che sde ba gang sha sam 'das la dang —skul tshig tu grub ba dang / phyi ma da lha ba dang ma 'ongs par grub bo/ 1'di rigs kyi mtshan gzhi gsham gsal/dpe cha bkar bya klog byed klogs shig bkags1 /ko ba brgyang bya rgyong byed spyongs shig brgyangs/ /yug po brnga bya rnga byed rngos shig brngas/ /pha— tshun brje bya rje byed rjes shig brjes/ /tshod ma ba bya snyal byed stong cig bsnyald/ /lu ba bltab bya lteb byed ltebs shig bltabs/ —phan par gdam bya 'doms byed 'doms shig gdams/srol ngan bsnang bya rdub byed rdzubs shig brdubs/ /gnas nas dbyung bya 'byin byed snang so shig myung 1 /bya dga' bstsal bya stsol byed stsol cig bsna da/ /snod du brdzang bya rdzong byed rdzongs shig bdangs/ /rta mchog bzhon bya zhon byed zhon cig bzhond/ / yang yang bzla bya zlo byed smos shig bzlag /byin gyis brlab bya rlob byed rlobs shig brlab ga /1266

dag yig rig ba'i gab pa mngon phyung /g.yo sgyus ba(1bya slu byed slus shig bslus/ /ri bab sub bya sub byed subs shig bsubs/ /lha bu sogs te/ ming ga'i brtsegs pa bas 'phul rung yod do cog rigs 'dir 'dus shing 1 'di rigs kyi ming gzhi re re ba ni/ ka ga nga / ja nya1 ta da na/ tsa dza 1 zha za1 ra sa bcu ba'i dang 1 'gyur ba gnyis can pha ba tsam mo/ /gsum pa1 dus gsum thor bu ba1 —dus gsum1 thor bu ba ni/ dus gsum gyi— dbye ba khar kher re sngon 'jug res bstan pa ma btogs / jir dus bsum skul tshig dang bzhig dam bzhag ni/ 'jug yang 'jub dang / na ro 'greng bu thob min gyis dped par brnya na khu1 'ig yin de yang 1 'phul —dang ming gzhi nyung shas tsam las 'gyur ba med pa/da lha ba kha shas la 'as 'phul dang / 'das ba nyung ngu la bas 'phul thob pa ma gtogs gcig por nges shing / dbyangs yig rkyang 'das pa nyung ngu la yo dang / da lta ba bar kher la me'am yo thob pa ma gtogs 'dra la/ slor zhib la 'phu'1 gtan nas mi 'thob/ yid gzugs 'thur ba med pa 'ang skor zhig yod do/ 1'di rigs kyi mas gzhi gshad gsal/lam du dmyu bya dmyu byed da rtsed shig dmyus/ 1sngon du 'khridaXbya 'khrid byed khrid cig khrid1 /brtag par bgyi bya bgyid byed gyis shig bgyis/ / 266

bya ba rigs gsum dpyad pa rtags bzug gis ra rtsen/mi sna mngag bya mngag byed mngags shig mngags/ /rang srog lhob bya lceb byed lcebs shig rtsebs/ /rus pa 'cha' bya 'cha' byed 'tsha zhig 'chog /lkog tu 'jab bya 'jab byed 'jobs shig 'jabs/ /dpe khrid mnyan bya nyan byed nyon cig mnyand/ /phan tshun gtug bya gtu ga byed gtugs shig gtu gag /glog skud 'then bya 'jen byed 'chen cig 'jind/ /mgron du drang bya 'dren byed drongs shig drangs/ /gdam ngag mno bya nod byed nos shig mnos/ /thur du dpyang bya dpyang byed da sbyongs shig dpyangs— /gad snyigs phyag bya 'phyag byed phyogs shig phyags/ /sprang bor sbyin bya sbyin byed byind cig byin /dang du blang bya len byed longs shig blangs/ /rdza mar blug bya spug byed blugs shig skugs/ /ri ma tho bya rmod byed rmos shig rmog /thal 'tshub gtsub bya gtsub byed gtsubs shig gtsubs/ /nor lug 'tsho bya 'tsho byed 'tshol shig 'tshog/— — —phrin las mdzad bya mdzad byed mdzod cig mdzad/ /267

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa ngon zung /'o zhag gzhab bya gzhob byed gzhobs shig gzhabs/ /za ma bza' sa za byed zo zhig zos/ /lkog tu yib bya yib byed yibs shig yibs/ /ston mo rol bya rol byed rol cig rold/ 1kha nas lab bya lab byed lobs shig labs/ /skams lug bsha' bya bsha' byed shos shig bshas/ /bud shing gse bya gse byed sel shig gses/ /lta bu sogs te/ 'di rigs las ma 'ongs pa 'a mtha' can nam mtha' med pa skor zhig gi dod du da dang / nga mtha' kha shas kyi dod du na sbyar na/ da lha bar grub pa dang / da lta ba mtha' med dam 'a mtha'i dod du sa sbyar na/'das par grub pa/ dbyangs bzhi gang rung ma 'ongs par thob na/ de'i ldo ga pa kun la thob pa/ ma 'ongs pa dang 'das par dbyangs mi 'thob pa can gyi da lha ba dang skul tshig dag la na ro—thob pa dang / da lha ba nyung shas la 'greng bu thob pa yang yod/ ming gzhi las grub da lha ba'i dod du ku dang / bla'i da lha ba dang skul tshig gi dod du la dang / spyad 'das skul gyi dod dus 'jug pa tsam las/ de pyings tshad ngo cog gcig ba/ gsal byed wa 'a ha sa bzhi las gzhan nyer drug byed pa gzhan 'brel gyi bya ba'i ming gi ming gzhir 'jug rung ngo / /268

bya ba rigs gsumaXdapyad pa rtags 'jug gi zur rgyan/gong bsal bya ba'i ming gi yig gzugs 'byur lugs kyi dper brjod khar kher tsam las/ tshang ma byed pa'i las te/ byed pa gzhan dang 'brel ba'i bya ba yin/ de la yig gzugs gcig pa'ang nyung shas shig yod de/ dper na/dka' thub dpyad bzod 'thab bzhin las/ /re ba grub nas kun gyis gzigs thing bstod / /lta dī rnams ni/ yang na dus gsum mchod byed kyi sgra gcig pa dang ḍi yang na sgra 'dra yang don mi 'dra bar 'phul dang yang 'jug sbyor mi sbyor kyis khyad par gtod pa yin te/ gcan gzan gyi gzig dang ba lha bya'i gzigs / yan chad kyi stod dang bsngags pa'i bstod— 'gul ba'i 'phag dang yar 'phar ba'i 'phags/ lha bu rnams so/ /bya ba'i ming la la'i yig gzugs gcig pa'am 'byur nyung bas/ dus kyi dbye mi gsal na/ dus gsal byed kyi sgra grogs su sbyar na gsal 'gro ba kun gyis shes pa lhar ro/ 1rang shugs su byung ba'i bya ba dang / las dang 'brel ba'i bya ba rigs 'di gnyis ka'i yig gzugs 'gyur lugs dus gsum thor bu ba dang ha lam 'dra ste/ ming gzhi brtsegs pa rab tu nyung ba dang / pho yig ka ca ta pa tsa lnga'i ming gzhi rkyang ba nyid mo'i skar ma 'i rjes su 'gro ba dang / bya ba'i las la skul tshig mi 'thob cing / bya ba shugs 'byung la skul tshig kyang gang zag la 'jug rung ba nyung ngu ma gtogs med pa'i dbang gis/ ming gzhi 'gyur ba gnyis can nyung zhing / mi 'gyur ba rab tu mang la/ yig gzugs 'gyur ba bzhi can 269

dag yig rig pa'i gab pha— mngon sgyung /dang gsum can zho sa pa'i skar ma lha bu ste/ gsham gsal gyi dper brjod las/ kor rtags brgyab pa yig gzugs dam pa gcig can dang / thig rtags brgyab pa yig gzugs rnam pa gnyis can dang / rtags ma btab pa yig gzugs rnam pa gsum can nam bzhi can no/ /sku ni bltam bya lha byed ltoms shig bltams/rta las bab bya 'bab byed bobs shig babs/mal du nyal bya nyal byed nyol cig nyald—kha ni skom bya skom byed skoms mi gro'i/lhung cho lhung na sa phyi la 'bud 'did bud/— — — —'char rgyu'i nyi ma shar nas skye bya skyes/— — — —mi 'ju kha ba zhu nas srin bu gson/ ltogs khar zas rnyed mi 'byid 'tsho ba phyid/re shā ma zad 'dzad rgyu rmed zhes dga'—/ ——— shes bya ma lus yongs rdzogs blo la zin/lha bu sogs rnyi/ ming gzhi brtsegasaX ma ska/ rga/ rnyi— lha/ lda/ sda/ sla/ lha1 lta bu bcu yas mas shig min pa med cing/ de rnams mi gzhi byas nas bya byed tha mi dad pa dang bya las mtshon pa can ha cang nyung / yig gzugs 'gyur ba can gyi ming gzhi mang phyogs gcig pa dang / nyung phyogs mi gcig pa ste/ cha 270

byab ri sa gsum dpyad pa rtags 'jug gi zur rgyan—dang sha pha dang pa/ dza dang za/ rtsa dang lhu/ lha bu gnyis re can 'di 'ga' las med do/— /14/ngas ca na skad kyi das 'a tshal phyu pa mo bkyis/ /bya ba rigs gsum me tog rnam par bkra— /bdagaXbazhan dang bcas ra nga mdangs so sor gsal— —bsgyub ge gsos su bdud rtsi 'di longs sheb— //

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon rgyung —sgo tshan dgu ba/ za ba'i ming dang dngos po'i ming skor zhig gi 'brel ba dang khyad par gsal ba'i sgron me/bya ba'i ming dang dngos po'i ming 1rten cing 'brel bar byung ba las/ /dngos po'i ming du 'jug pa dang / /grub pa'i rnam bzhag mi gcig ste/ /byed par da lha ba dang ni/ /las la ma 'ongs 'jug pa dang / /nus par bya las 'das pa dang / /'bras bur byed las 'das pa 'jug /'jug pa min pa'i grub ji1 ni/ /bya ba 'das pa'i sngon 'jug gam/ /'phul dang yang 'jug dor ba na/ /dngos po'i ming du grub pa dang / /bya ba'i ming gi yig gzugs ni/ /cung zad bsgyur nas grub pa'ang yod/1212

bya ba dang dngob1 po'i ming skor zhig gi 'grel ba dang khyad par gsal ba'i sgrod me—bya tshig yig gzugs gcig pa can/ /dngos po'i ming du grub pa'ang yod/ —bya ba'i ming dang dngos po'i ming rten cing 'grel bar byung ba ha cang mang ste/ chu dang 'o ma 'dres par mngon/ de rnams las gang dang gang 'brel chags shing khyad par ci mchis legs par shes na/ brtsams chos klog par brngod bya ji bzhin tshegs med du 'jal lon pa dang / rtsom du bstan bya ji bzhin go brda sprod mkhas par 'gyur srid— de la thog mar bya ba'i ming dngos po'i ming du 'jug pa dang / bya ba'i ming dngos po'i ming du grub pa gnyis kyi sbyor ba bdad pa yin tshul dang / spyi dang bye brag gi khyad par sogs legs par shes pa gal che'o/ /don tshan dang bo/ bya ba'i ming dngos po'i ming du 'jug pa/bya ba'i ming dngos po'i ming du 'jug pa la/ byed pa dang / las dang /nus pa dang / 'bras bu bcas tshan pa bzhi yod la/ de dag gang rung gi ngo bo ston par gyur tshe/ dngos po'i ming du grub pa yin yang / bya ba'i ming dngos po'i ming du thad kar grub pa dang sbyor ba mi gcig go /da ni bya ba'i ming dngos po'i ming du 'jug pa so so ba'i rnam bzhag brjod par bya'o/ /273

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon jing 1dang bo/ byed par 'jug pa/byed pa la gtso phal gnyis las/ byed pa gtso bo ni byed pa bo ste/ las gang spub par byed pa'i gang zag gtsos sems can ci rigs dang / byed po'i tshul can du snang ba'i bem po sogs yin zhing / byed pa phal ba ni byed pa ste/byed pa bos las gang bya bar 'jug pa'i yo byad(dbang bo dang yan lag sogs 'dus)dam/ tha sa sam/ stobs rnams yin no/ /byed pa bo dang byed pa ni bdag gi khongs su gtogs pa'i dngos po yin te/ bya ba'i ming gis ston par byas na/ da lta ba 'jug pa'o/ /de yang byed pa bo la da lha ba tsam mam/ byed po gsal byed kyi bdag sgra ci rigs shig dang / gzhi dang 'grel na dag sgra bsdus kyang chog lan rer byed ces pa grogs su sbyar rgyu'ang yod/ dper da/ sangs rgyas la ston pa'am nom 'dred dang / sgo kha'i so ba la sgo srung ba bo ste/ ming bsdus na sgo srung dang 1 gser rko ba la gser rkon dang / sha za ba'i gcan gzan la sha zan dang / chu la nyal 'gro dang / sman pa la 'tsho byed/ lha bu rnam se dang / dpe de bzhin du/chu 'dzin rtsa ba gzhol 'gro dang / /mkhas pa skyong mkhan slob dpon yin//nga ———nyin byed sreg za'i sdongs grogs dang / /—— —— ———274

bya ba dang dngos po'i ming skor zhig gi 'a la ba dang kad par gsal ba'i sgron me/mgo 'dren skyor mkhan mi dmangs yin//skyed pa bo yis bskyed bsrings pa'i//las byed las sna'i dbu mtshad byed//—— —'grel byed mkhan pos gsungs pa gsal//sgyug 'dzin yi ge 'bri mkhan yin/— nga nga zhal lce gcod mis nyes chad bcad//dkar 'dod pa yis dkar sar bton/—nga rmon pa dor sdeb shugs 'gro zhen//nga lug mis lto 'phyang mkha du 'tsho//—ja skol ma dang chang 'tshong ma/bsun ma sne len ston mor rem/—nga ——nor 'dzin ma na sa 'dzin bzhugs//nga de la lto 'gro 'phar 'gro yod//nga —nga lta du sogs dang / byed pa bya ba'i ming gis ston pa'i grogs su gtso bo byed dang spyad dag sbyar ba dang / gzhi dang 'brel na/ da lha ba tsam yang chog sa mang / dper na/ mig la lta byed dang / lta ba'i mig lag pa dang skam pa sogs la 'dzin byed / sems la nang gi byed pa/rwa la rdung byed/gshog sgro la lus 'degs/mtshon za la 'gugs byed dam gsod /zor ba la 'breg 275

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung spyad/lta bu rnams dang de bzhin/mtshan nyid mtshon byed dpe yis bstan//———rnam par rtog pas don kun rtogs/'dred byed gsal na lam mi nor//—'gro byed ma lhogs na gar yang ba //—— thos 'dzin dri 'dzin ro 'dzin dag /nga —yan lag mchog ma'i dbang bo yin//gcod byed rko spyad 'jigs byed rnams//nga —shing bzos bkol ba'i lo byad yin//legs nyes 'byed pa'i blo gros dang //phas rgol gnon pa'i rngam brjid dgos/—slu ba'i gzen gyis za spyang bkum/—shu byed gri yis rlud bur bshus//—gzung 'dzin gzung bya 'dzin zud dang //bya byed bya yul nga nga yin//brjod bya don dang rjod byed tshig /'chad rtsod rtsom gsu nga la mkhas//za bu rogs so/gong gsal rtags kyis mtshan pa rnams byed pa'i ming ngo /76

bya ba dang dngos po'i mir skor kag gi 'grel ba dang tsud par gsal ba'i sgron meganyis pa/ las la 'jug pa/las la las tsam dang las dngos gnyis te/ las tsam ni bya ba'i yul te/bya ba bsgrub sa'am 'jug phyogs dang / las dngos ni bskub par bya ba'am don gnyer yin/ de gnyis gzhad gyi khongs su gtogs bas/ bya ba'i ming gis ston par byas na/ ma 'ongs pa 'jug pa yid la/ skabs skabs su 'di gnyis ka'i ngo bo gcig par snang ba la/ bya ba ma 'ongs pa ming mtha' bsdus min ci rigs 'jug pa'i tha snyad 'dra yang / tshig sbyor du bya ba'i yul la la don 'jug pa dang / las dngos la la don 'jug srol med do/ /bya ba'i yul mtshod pa'i ma 'ongs tha'i grogs —su yul deng sa dang gnas ci rigs shig sbyar ba yin/ dper na/ sdong 4ga6da par bya ba'i yul nags tshal la gcad sa dang / dpe cha ba lha sa la blta ba'i phul dang / gnas 'dug sa la gnas yul lha bu rnams dang / de bzhin/'du ba'i gnas la 'dud sa dang / /—'tshogs pa'i yul la 'tshogs sa zer /bskye sa ma shes 'gro khu nor/ / 1 nga spo sa ma 'phyugs gzhag sa 'grig /nga mig gis spyod yul gzugs yin te/ /mnyan pa'i ba nas ni sgra rnams yin/ /—nga nga —277

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung /gzas sa'i 'ben la nyag phran 'phangs//ya yo med par gtad sar khel/ tshig phrad dmas kyi 'jug yul lam//sbyar sa 'i nor shin tu gces/nga 'brel sgra 'thob sar byed sgra sbyar//——'phya ba'i gdas su mi 'gyur ram//dpyad sa'i gnas dang shes bya'i yul//——bas blo gtang sa bya ba'i phyogs//blang dor ma rmongs mkhas dbang de//kun gyi4 smon yul re sa yin//—bslab la brtsod zhing las la sgrim /— —bkren pa rnams la gtong phod che//'thab la dpa' zhing 'chi la ni/ /— —ngang ba pad mtshor zhugs pa bzhin//lha bu sogs dang / las dngos mchod pa'i ma 'ongs pa'i grogs su bya dang rgyu gang rung sbyar ba dang / kha gsal sar ma sbyar kyang chog dper na/ bsnab par bya ba'i tsheg bar bsdus da bsgab bya dang / gos la gon rgyu spos la bdug pa/ rta la bcib pa/ tsa 'thung rgyu la bza' btung / lta du rnams 218

bya bdang dngos po'i ming skor ba zhig gi 'a la ba dang khyad par gsal ba'i sgron me/dang /de bzhin/dgug bya'i gong khugs btsong bya 'tshongs/bskyi rgyu ma mang skyin pa dan //nga shes bya sbyang bya rang byan tshud/nga nga ba'i ba bya bskrun bya gang yang btub//—mgo 'dren bsko rgyu dbab rgyu dang //—kha mal brje rgyu 'thus mir dbang /nga brko bar bya ba'i zam ga dang //bri bya'i yig cha tshags par 'gyur//—gdon bya'i gser kha 'phrog res byas/rtsod pa byung nas gtug gsher brgyab//brtsad rgyu'i gzhi dang bsdum bya'i don/— —gros thag bcad bya bcad nas 'dum/dpyad la ba lha ba'i dpe cha dgos//———gtug rgyu'i khungs dang brjod bya'i dos/legs par rtogs na nges shes 'drongs//dril bsgrag bya bar go yang chod//nga ——lta du sogs so/213
