dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon snang gsum pa/ 'bras bur 'jug pa/'bras du ni rtsol byung ste/ byas pa'i rjes dang grub pa'e rtags yin la1bya ba'i ming gis mtshon pa la byed las 'das pa 'jug dgos/ dper na/sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab la bstan— pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i dgra bcom zin pa'i gang zag la dgra bcom pa dang / 'jig rten gyi bya ba blos btang ba'i chos pa la bya btang ba dang / lo ba la byung ba dang / ngang gis byung ba la lhun grub dang / dpar ba'i dpe cha la dpar ma/ lta tsu rnams dang / de bzhin/skyes sa 'khrungs yul so so yi/ /mkhas grub rnams kyis dge legs sgrub/ /bka' 'byur bstan 'gyur brtsams chos las /rig pa'i 'od snang kun tu 'bar/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bsna ba'i bka'/ /bka' gdams pa yis brgyud mar 'dzin/ /—— —bka' brgyud pa las mkhas pa dang / /sgyub pa sbyangs ba'i grub chen mang / /dbyangs gsal ngag gi lhun grub yin/ /bod yig bkas bcad thengs gsum mdzad/ /——skad gnyis shan spyar zags ma dang / /280

— bya bdang dngos po'i ming skor zhig gi 'grel ba dang khyad par gsol ba'i kron mebacad lhug spel ma'i gzhung yangaXmang / /——— ——rab 'byams pa yis bstan bcos gzigs/ /—legs bris logs bris(ris)rang sgyun bzhin/ /——gzab bris 'a gas bris rtsa' gyis phyug /dpar ma ngos gtsang brkos ma mdzes /rgyu skar bzos ma bal bcos ma/ /rang grub ma yin sbyar byung yid/ /phyugs las spel ba'i 'phel thog che/ /thon skyed dpal 'byor dar rgyas mgyogs/ /tshos ma phal cher btsos ma yin/ /byed tshos brngos ma bsregs ma'ang yod/ /bskol ma khol ma 'byung na bde/ /'phrod bsten sman gyi mchog tu bshad/ /lha du sogs las 'das pa'i ming mtha' ma sbyar ba mang ngo / /bzhi ba/ nus par 'jug pa/nus pa ni byed las sam go chod pa'i don te/ spyir byed pa dang 'dra ba'i dngos po yin la/ bya ba'i ming gis mtshon par phal cher bya las 'das pa ste/gzhan dang 'brel ba'i bya ba 'das pa 'jug dgos/ dper na/ 'ching byed 281

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyub la chings te/thod chings/ske chings/rmas chings lha bu dang /'khyog byed 'do li la khyogs dang /mtshod byed rtags la mtshan ma zer ba lha bu rnams dang /de ba'i na/thag ring lta ba'i rgyang mthong dang //rgya cher sgrog pa'i rgyang grags— yod//btags na thogs pa'i thag pa dang //dri ma ga da pa'i khrus chang sas//chibs pa bcibs das la mor phebs//chings rgya 'khrol byed khrol 'dzin bstan//sku tshab 'dus pa'i 'dun mar zhugs//dpyad nas phyod pas las phyod che//lus brgya sprul nas rdzu 'phrul bstan//sems rgyud bcos pa'i chos kyang gsungs/'khor lo bskor nas da pa 'khel//snam du thags kyis 'thag par byed/— khro chu lugs kong nang du blugs//lcags kyis mgar ba'i rko mas brkos// zung nga rdon pos nya rnams zung //— 282

bya ba dang dngos po'i ming skor zhig gi 'brel ba dang khyad par gas ba'i sgron me/shing zom dkris mas dkris nas bzos/ /chom po gzhom la dga' di dang / /—rkun mas phag tu brkus nas 'khyer/ /bran du kol ba'i khol bo snyug /bar mtshams gcod bye da ces grags/ /lta rtsa sogs go sla ste/ rigs bzhes nas shes ngar bya'o/ /don tshan gnyis pa/ bya ba'i ming dngos po'i ming du grub pa/bya ba'i ming dngos po'i ming du grub lugs ni/ bya ba'i ming 'das pa'i sngon 'jug dor ba dang / yang na 'phul dang yang 'jug dor nas de dang 'brel ba'i dngos po'i mi du grub pa dang / gzhan yang bya ba'i ming la la'i yig gzugs cung zad bsgyur nas dngos po'i ming du grub pa'ang yod/dang bo/ bya ba'i ming 'das pa'i 'phul dor nas dngos po'i ming du grub pa/bya ba'i ming 'das pa'i sngon 'jug dor nas de dang 'brel ba'i dngos po'i ming du grub pa/ dper na/ gros dang / bgros pa gnyis 'byung khring4gcig ste/ bgro bar bya ba la gros/ zhes dang / gros byas pa la bgros pa/ zhes pa gnyis phan tshun rten cing 'grel ba'i sgo nas byung ba yin pas/ 'dra ba 283

dag yig rig pa'i kab pa mngon myung /ltar snang yang / don mi gcig ste/ snga ma dngos po'i ming du grub nas bya byed las gsum gyi las tshig tu 'jug pa dang / phyi ma bya ba'i ming du grub nas bya byed las gsum gyi bya tshig tu 'jug pa yin te/ 'thus mi rnams kyis gros bgros so/ /lha bu'o/ /des na 'di gnyis kyi khyad par mngon par gsal ba zhig ni/ bya ba'i ming 'das pa'i sngon 'jug bsubs na/ dngos po'i ming du 'byur ba yin zhing / de ma zad gnyis ka'i sgra gdangs spyi ldog nas gcig kyang / rang ldog nas khyad par yod de/ bas 'phul ba'i bgros ni thog mar ma mchu ya sor sbyar ba'i du sgra zhugs pa'i dbang gis sgra gdangs cung zad lci ba dang / bas 'phul med pa'i gros ni sgra bdangs cung zad yang ba yin zhing /yang / bya ba'i ming bgros kyi rnam bzhag kun la sngon 'jug yod la/ dngos po'i ming gro4la sngon 'jug med pas/ phan tshun nor dogs med par bltos nas/ gros la ming mtha' med par byas so/ /yang / tshogs pa dang / 'tshogs pa gnyis las/ 'phul can bya ba'i ming dang / 'phul med dngos po'i ming ste/na gzhon tshogs pa'i bslab sbyang du thams cad 'tshogs pa/ lta bu dang / bya ba'i ming la 'as 'phul gyi sna sgra ldan pa dang / dngos po'i ming la 'as 'phul dor bas sna sgra med de/ sgra gzugs gnyis ka'i cha nas dbye ba gsal bas/gnyis ka'i ming mtha' gcig par mas shing bab dang bsnan nas bsdus kyang chog go /yang / skyed ka dang bskyed pa gnyis las/ snga ma dngos po'i ming 284

bya ba dang dngos po'i mi skor zhig gi 'brel bdang kad par gsal ba'i sgronaXme/dang / phyi ma bya ba'i ming yin mod/ bskyed pa'i da lha ba dang skul tshig la bas 'phul med pas/ dngos po'i ming dang sgra gcig pa yin thog dngos po'i ming 'di rigs la ming mtha' pa dang ba dag spyar ba'am/ ming mtha' med par byas na/ bya ba'i ming dang 'khrul srid bas da/ bod gangs can gyi sgra rig pa dar ba las/ bya ba'i ming dang rten cing 'grel ba'i dngos po'i ming 'di rigs kyi ming mtha' dmigs bsal du pa ba dag mi 'jug par/ po bo ma mo ka la sogs pa ci rigs shig jug pa dang / yang na ming 'di rigs kyi thog mtha' gang rung du 'grel yod kyi brda zhig grogs su sbyar nas1 brjod bya'i chos kyi ngo bo tsam zhig bsal bar byed pa yin no1 /'phul 'jug min gyis rten cing 'brel ba'i bya ba'i ming dang dngos po'i ming gi khyad par ston pa yang / bya ba'i ming gi dus kyi dam bzhag ston par sngon 'jug gi mthu che bas 'jug pa dang / dngos po'i ming la dus kyi rnam bzhag med pas/ sngon 'jug dor bar byas pa yin no/ /dpe de bzhi de du/ thon skyed rgya bskyed yong sgo mang / ram̐ sha dam bgrums nas sha krums byas/ /skor bu bskor nas du ga brtol/ /nga skon bu rke la bskon nas zin/ /bye sa ko lhags bzo grwar ba / /—— 286

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung rtod thag ring bos rta rgan brtod//mthun par gyur bas thun mong dang //'thor ba'i cha la thor bu zer//char ba babs ba nas ga pa 'jigs/nga — du ba thul ler dgung la 'thul//dug sprul lha bu'i gdug can la//sdags mdzub bstan nas bsdigs shing brabs/dugs kyis bdugs nas na tsha zhi//—— mjal dum mdzad nas 'dum par 'gyur//dpe cha par du dpar ba ma /nga zho 'gyur snad du myur bur gang //me la 'bud pa'i bud shing 'thu// phyags mas 'phyags nas gtsang ma byed/lag par chu bur brdol cing 'dur//so yis da nur 'i nur 'gram 'gul/las ka brtsal nas lag rtsal byung //grangs mang brtsis nas cis la mkhas//dom yig sum rtsegs brtsegs pa rnams//288

bya ba dang dngos po'i ming skor zhig gi 'a la ba dang khyad par gsal ba'i sgron me/mang byings 'tshogs pa'i tshogs su bshad// nga mnyam du 'tsho bas tsho ba chags/btsos nas 'tshos par sa ma za/—nang du 'tshangs nas nang tshangs bzo/rdzongs pa dang bcas pho nya bar pas//pang leb bzhogs pa'i zhogs ma mang /thur du gzhel nas ri zhol sleb//logs su bzur bang ba rnams—zlos gar brtses nas mtshar mtshar bzlas//g.yos pa'i yos btags rtsam pa bza'//yol chen g.yong nas bzhon par bskul//ma yar khus pa'i ma'i tshab tu//—g.yar ba'i tshul du blangs par zer//byin gyis brlabs nas byin rlabs thob/shags mdud btags nas sdig pa bshags//gru shags blangs das mang du gshags//lo sar lo ni gsar ba bzang //nga la phub bshur nas shur ma skem/—286

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /shal gyis bshal nas zhing sa snyoms/ /lham gyi srubs gzan bsrubs pa dam/ /khab skud la sogs bsogs pa mang / /'od srungs kyis ni bsrungs pa dngad /srubs ja bsrubs nas 'thungs pas bde/ /—nga ngal gsos skabs su sos dal bas/ /sems la bsams pa'i don kud grub/ /lha bu sogs las/bzas je'i ming dang 'brel chags pa'i bya ba'i ming 'das pa phal cher bas 'phul can dang / 'as 'phul can khag gnyis su snang ba'i don ni/ bdag dang 'brel ba'i bya ba'i ming gi ming ga'i phal cher sgra drag pa'am rtsi ba yin pas/ de'i 'das pa ldas 'phul gyis mtshon pa dang / gzhan dang 'brel ba'i bya ba'i ming gi ming gzhi phal cher sgra ran pa dang / bdag gzhad gang du'ang ma 'brel ba'i bya ba'i ming gi ming gzhi phal cher sgra zhan pa dang ran pa yin pas/ de rnams kyi 'das pa dab bcas pa 'as 'phul gyis mtshon pa'i phyir ro/ /sngon 'jug ga da—gnyis pos ba cher ma 'ongs pa mtshon pa yin pas/ 'das par spyar ba yod kyang / de ni bya ba'i ming gi dus kyi rnam bzhag kun la thun mong ba yin pas na/ sngon 'jug de dag dor nas dngos po'i ming du grub pa dper drangs pa ltar nyung zad yod kyang ma khyab ste/290

bya ba dang dngos po'i ming skor zhig gi 'grel ba dang khyad par gas ba'i sgron me/dper na/ lu subs dbur tes da dur/ zo ba dkris mas dkris/ dbyug pa dbyugs/ lha bu rnams dang / shin tu mo ni mnyam pas so/ /snas pa te / ma sngon 'jug ni bdag gzhan dang dus gsum spyi la 'jug pa phal cher 'dra bas/ mgar pas lcags ma kar/ lha bu rnams las/ mas 'phul dor nas dngos po'i ming du grub pa je cang dkon no/ /gzhan yang / bya ba'i ming 'das pa'i sngon 'jug dor nas dngos po'i ming du grub pa dang / khyad chos kyi ming gi sngon 'jug dor nas dngos po'i ming du grub pa'i mtshan gzhi gong gsal gyi dper brjod rnams las 'ga' zhig drangs pa dran pa slong byed tsam las/ skabs 'di'i brjod bya min pas ngal ba ma byas so/ /gnyis pa/ bya ba'i ming 'das pa'i 'thal dang yang 'jug dor nas dngos po'i ming du grub pa/bya ba'i ming 'das pa'i 'phul dang yang 'jug dor na/ de dang 'brel ba'i dngos po'i ming du grub pa ste/ bye'u sa rkum bu bgroms/ lta du dang / khyad chos kyi ming du grub pa'ang mang ste/ rta rgod rje da nas srun mor byur/ lha bu rnams skabs 'di'i brjod ba min yang / blo rnying1du dpe 'ga' zhig drangs yod pa shes par bgyi/ de bzhin/ yar la bkrongs nas krong nger bangs1 / ——dkrogs nas rna ba krog krog byas/ 1 291

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung rko mas brkos nas sman rnams khyer//za nga bskangs skang ra byed//lhags skud dkyogs nas kyog por gyur//bkyags na 'khyog pa'i 'phongs kyag bzos//dpe cha bklags pa klag cor che —rkam chags che bas nor rā rkams//rkyal bar brted das ba par brkyal//gru skya brgyab nas ring du bskyas//— zla mthar 'ja' blum༄khyims pa lhar/bza' tshang gnas gzhir khyim zhes bya//—grib ma bsgribs nas 'gribs pa'i shul//go cha bgos nas g.yul ngor mchong //nga pa'i zil gyis dgra la brngams/gom pa ro thog bgoms nas 'bagayang gzhi brgyangs pa rgyang nas mthong /rgyu ma snyigs ma brgyud pab sgod//sgrog gis bsgrogs nas thar sa med//bya nga nga bzhin du bsgongs nas 'dug/

bya ba dang dngos po'i ming skor zhig gi 'a la ba dang khyad par gsal ba'i sgron metsheg bar zu nas sgo nga zer//—sgo yi chang zung lag pa yis//——'changs shing bzung bas 'then cing zu//me tos chun po sgar bas 'chun//———chom pos 'choms pa mi 'khyer med//ha cang brtabs nas rtab rtab por//rnyang ma brnyangs rjes cung zad bde//ma 'thams so ni tham tham byas//'thums pa'i sman thum 'thungs nas sos/ nga —tha ga pa yis snam bu 'thag/theng bu bzhin du rkang ba 'byungs//sdeb ra bsdebs pa legs pas snyan//pho mo bsdums nas sdum thab byed//mi la bsdigs pas sdig pa che//khrims kyis ba bsdams zu ga ma pa srung // bal khul 'phyings nas phying dra// nga sa chu 'bags pa 'dam bag zer//dmigs pa'i yul du mig gis bltas//—233

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung zhes su bshad pa yin/ /zhes stag tshang lo tsā shes rab rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i gso ba rig pa'i ming tshig 'ga' zhig gi don gyi bzhin ras gsal bar ston pa'i me long las gsungs pa lhar ro//de bzhin/dam chos glegs bam bklags pa mang //byu skyibs bya yis skyabs gnas yin//skyigs bu langs te kha nas bsgyugs//skyon can dag la bka' bkyon gnang //khal mas khal ni rtsi mo bkal//'gro ba'i gom par 'gros zhes bya//ngan lan ngan glon rang ga nyos//ngus nga mig khu rdu ma byung //mig ldal rgyal mo cher gdal ba//mig gis mthong yul mthongs kyang zer//brla gnyis 'dom sa lus smad 'doms//lus brgya sprul dka rdzu 'phrul bstad/ha cang sman pa'i man ngag gdams//'phong skyen pa ni mda' 'phen mkhas//nga spungs pa'i gung bo che//—296

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung /sde tshan bcu ba/ ming ga'i rigs 'dra rkyang brtsegs las rten cing 'brel bar byung ba'i ming bskor/ming gzhi rig sta 'dra rkyang brtsegs las/ 1ming gi rigs ni rnam gsum byung //brtsegs pa can ni bya ba'i dang //rkyang ba dngos ka'i ming du grub//yang na brtsegs pa dngos —po dang //rkyang ba bya ba mnod zu5 yin//— shad chos dī ba bye ༵dī dī 'ang yod//mi sbyor bye 1 sdi 1/bya ༷ ming dang dngos po'i snang pang dam// ༵ chos ༵ ming gnyis re rten rnyid 'brel bar byung ba skor zhig yod/ de lugs khong —du chud na/ ming 'di rigs kyi ngo bo lhag pa gsal bad sho ba len thub/ dper na/ming gzhi rkyang ba'i 'bud pa ni/ me gzan pa'i bya ba'i ming yin la/ ming gzhi brtsegs pa'i spud pa ni/ me sbar byed kyi yo byad de dngos po'i ming yin/ des 298

ming gzhi rigs 'dra rkyang brtsegs las rted 'byung gi ming gi skorasnya na la nyan pa blo la bzung /stegs dur brten nas yar la btegs//sdum thab dag ni 'dums shing yod//nga nga zar ri nas mar 'gril zhing //bab pa'i rdo sogs rbab ces grags//lha du sogs dngos pa'i ming da mgo can dor nas bya ba'i ming du grub pa'o/gnyis pa/ bya ba'i ming da nga / khyad chos kyi ming rten cing 'brel bar byung ba'i rigs las rje ming gzhi brtsegs pa bya ba'i ming dang /ming gzhi rkyang ba khyad chos kyi ming yin/dper nago rim bsgrigs pa 'grig yags red//lhong gud byung nas nga rgud//—— nga nyung bar ma snyung mang na bzang //nga nye bar bsnyen nas bkur snyi byed//mas man bsnyams nas mnyam pa dang /thung bar ma stung ring rgyu med//nga pas ngo mdangs ngam zhing nag/ nga slog pa bsdogs nas dog bder gon//nga 30

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon nga /mar la bsnar nas nar nar 'phyang //bsnor tshod ma zin ba gnor gal byung //'bol bar ba bsgoms sa nom nem 'gul//lci ba glebs nas leb leb nyan//g.yo sgyus bslad nas par 'byur//zul yun ring bas nga bro/ lha gru sogs ha lam bya ba'i ming da lta ba gzhir bzung zhing mgo can nam/'dogs can gyi ming gzhi dor nas khyad chos kyi ming du grub pa yin no//gzhan yang /ming gzhi rigs 'dra rkyang brtsegs las/dngos po'i ming la brten nas/dngos po'i ming gzhan zhig byung ba/gya gyu la brten nas g.yo — —sgru dang lung bar brten nas nga lha bu sogs byung ba'ang yod do///302

jis 'jug5 dang da yi zun mong ma yin pa'i 'jug pa gzur gyi zhun jigs/lde tshan bcu gcig ba/ rjes 'jug na dang da yi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'jug ba gser gyi 'un jigs/rjes 'jug na— dang da gnyis ka'i/ /thun mong min pa'i 'jug pa ni/ 1 gang ming mtha' rten 'a'i dod du/ /sbyar ba de 'brel ming thung ngu//gzhan zhig brjod bder grub pa'i lugs/ /rtogs tshe shes brjod 'jug par phan/ /brjod pa'i sgrub byed tshig dang / tshig gi skrub byed ming dang / ming—sgrub byed yi ge'o/ /yi ge ming du 'grub mi 'grub/ rjes 'jug kho na— rag ka4pas na/ sum cu ba'i tsa ba las/ sngon 'jug yod dam med kyang rung /ming gzhi'i yi ge gang yin lo1 1nyis 'brel yod dam sum 'brel yod/ /a li bzhi las gang ldan yab / /jis 'jug bcu bo ma zhugs na/ /ming gzhad spyod ba yod mi srid/ /ces gsungs so/ /rjes 'jug rnams las 'a mtha' blor yang bas ba kyang / sgra'i dam pa gzhan du mi 'gyur bas don sngar bzhin ston 303

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon jing 1—nus pas na/ bkas bcad du/ rkyang 'phul ma gtogs gzhan noms kyi 'a mtha' dngos su mi bri bar mdzad do/ /de yang / 'a mtha' rkyang 'phul rnams la dgos/ /mgo 'dogs dbyangs ldan rnams la spang / /zhes pa lhar/ gda'/dga'/ bka'/ mda'/ 'ba' lha bu sogs kyi 'a mtha' spangs na/ la la sngon 'jug dang ming gzhi 'khrul bar 'gyur ba dang / la la sgra sbyor du mi rung bar 'byur ba'i dgos dbang gis rab sor bzhag pa dang / lha/ 'dra/ mi/ spyi/ lta bu sogs kyi 'a mtha' bsdus kyang mi skyon pa mtha' dag sgangs pa tsam las/rnam dbye tshig phrad dang 1 ming mtha' 'dren pa'i thob zang sogs 'a mtha' dang gcig pa'o/ 1sum cu ba'i rtsa ba las/ rjes 'jug bcu yi don shes na/ /'bri dang klog dang bshad dmas kyi/ /mtshams sbyo— sgra la thogs med cing / /'grel bar smra ba'i mchog tu gyur/ /ces gsungs ba lhar/ rjes 'jug bcu bo'i 'jud dan shes na/ tshig gi sbyor bar ma zad/ mi gi sbyor ba la yang ngag gi rtsal thod par bya thub/ de lugs skabs bab kyi brjod bya tsam du'ang gsal bar snang ngo / —rjes 'jug dmas ming gzhi'i jis su 'jug pa la/ —thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i 'jug tshul gnyis yod ba1— thun mong gi snyen zug tshul di/ rjes 'jug bcu la sprul snang / da ster na1 yid/ mid/ —yod/ med rnams kyi rjes 'jug ni/ don thob kyis spyan ba las/ brjod bya'i kyi ming gzhan dang 304

rjes 'jug na dang da yi thun mob ma yin pa'i 'jug pa gser gyi zhun zigasa'agrel ba med do/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i 'jug tshul ni/ ming gang dang 'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ non gyi ngo bo gzhan zhig ston pa'i ming du gdags par dmigs bsal gyis sbyar ba dang / yang na 'bod sla bar ming gi rnam grangs gzhan zhig dgos par dmigs bsal gyis sbyar bsgyu yin te/dper na/ du ba ni sreg za las byung ba'i dbugs khams kyi ming yin pa dang / du ba'i du la rjes 'jug da sbyar ba'i dud pa ni/ du ba las6chabs pa'i rdul dreg gi ming du grub nas/ de gnyis kyi ngo bo mi gcig par bstan pa dang 1rko ba di 'bru ba dang / rko la rjes 'jug na sbyar ba'i rkon ni/ rko ba bo yin te/gser rko ba bo la gser rkon zhe na/ 'bru nyung la brjod bde ba dang / bsu ba rdo jug shā sbyar ḍi ༵ ༵ba1/ra byas ༵/ci~X ༵dī/ gi/ rnam grangs ste/ bsu la rjes 'jug tshul 'di'i khyad chos ni/ rje'i lam rim chen mo las/ 'bras bu rgyu'i rjes su byed pa rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin/ zhes pa lhar/ ming gi 'bod kha ji sla'am ngo bo gzhad zhig ston par/ brten cing 'brel ba'i ming 'a mtha' can zhig gzhir bzung nas/ 'a mtha' dngos shugs ci rigs kyi dod du/rjes 'jug na'am da gang 'tsham zhig sbyar ba yin la/ de rnams las bya ba'i ming da lha ba'am ma 'ongs pa khyab che bar mngon/ de lugs gsham gsal/rjes 'jug da yi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'jug pa la rnam pa drug yod de/306

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngod sgyur /dang bo/ bya ba'i ming gis dngos po'i ming drangs pa'i mtshan gzhi/ltogs pa'i bkre la rjes 'jug na sbyar na/ bzad po ste bya ba'i ming ba'i ba dang 'brel dka dngos po'i ming du gyur pa ste/ dbul bo la dpen po zer ba lha bu'o//ma byin par len pa la ba snye/ rku ba bo la kan ma zer/ zog rkun/dngul rkun/ zer ba lta bu/rko ba ni 'dru ba ste/ gser rko ba bo la gser rkon dang / par rko ba bo la par non dang / shing rta mo la bye'u shing rkon zer ba 4 bu/sgor mo 'dra phyir ster rgyu skod 4ra gzhan gyi lag nas len pa'i skyi la/ na mtha' spyar na— skyin pa zhes 'tshab bya'i dngos po'i ming du sgyur te/——dngul skyin/ 'bru skyin/ lha ji/ rgyu ba ni 'gro ba'i don te/ rgyu la na mtha' sbyar na/ rgyu ba bar ma chad par 'a ba'i dngos po'i ming du grub pa/ chu rgyun dang / srol rgyun/ lha bu/'gro ba ni gnas gzhad du phyin pa dang /༷ 'gro ba bo shā 'jed po zer/ba 'grod sa pa mtsho nang gi srog chags chung ngu skogs dkar 4 mkhrigs pa zhig gi speng yin la/ de'i skogs la'ang 'gron du zer/ ming de lhar thogs don yang / gna' dus rgya gar sogs su zong phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed spyad kyi sgor mo lha du yin pa'i phyir/ de la legs sbyar gyi skad du kar sha pa na ste/ bod 306

rjes 'jug na dang da yi zud mong ma yin pa'i 'jug pa gser gyi kun zigs1'byur du zho'i dong tshe zhes pas gsal/ —gci ba di dri chu gtong ba dang / dri chu'i ming la gcin zer te/ bshang gci/ lha'i / nyo ba ni rin pyin nas nom pa blangs pa'i don yin par bltos das/—rang sdug rang gis nyos pa bzhin/ las ngan pa byas nas rang rgyud la mi dge ba skyes pa'i sems byung la nyon mongs zhes grags so/ /thu ba('thu ba)ni phyogs gci tu btus pa'i da lta ba yin pa dang / shing —thu ba bo la shing thun/ rtswa thu ba bo la rtswa thun/ lci ba thu ba ma la lci thun ma/ snye ma lha bu'i btu bye la —na du sogs su gra)tsu pa'o/ / 'du ba ni mang bo lhan tu 'tshogs pa ste/ tshogs pa la 'dun bdang /tshogs 'dun sa/ tshogs khang la 'dun khang / mnyam sbo tshogs pa la dga' 'dun/ tshogs pa can gyi rtsa 'dzugs la 'dun ma sogs su grags/ de bzhin gung gzhon tshogs pa la gung gzhon 'dun ma dang / chab srid gros mol u yon lhan khang la srid gros 'dun ma zhes btags na/ bod skad kyi khyad chos dang ldan no// —'dri ba('dris pa'i da lha ba dang ma 'ongs pa)ni cha yod rgyus yod rgyun —du 'a sa pa'i dod te/ smon 'drin ni 'dris che ba'i grogs mchog gi ming ngo //307

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon ji —/'dre ba ni phyogs gcig tu bsre bar 'gyur ba'i don༄nga /'dren ma ni sna kha du ga na du 'dres pa'i dngos po'i ming ste/ 'dres ma dang don gcig pa'o//'phya ba di ngo tsha ba'i gnas la spyod pa ste/ 'phyam mni ngo tsha mi 'dzem pa'i nga ma'o// 'phyo ba ni bya spyod tshad las 'das pa ste/ 'phyon ma ni pho mo'i 'brel ba ba 'chol ba bud med la zer ro blu ba ni srog gam sku rten co ba'i don dang /blud ni srog blu byed du las pa'i mi'i 'dra gzugs te/'dre shar sgo dang blud nub sgo/zer ba lha bu/'di la grud bris pa mang yang /blud das par 'dod/ dbye ba ni so sor phral ba dang / dbyen ni 'grig mthun gtor ba'i za ma'i mig /phra ma gtong ba la dbyen sbyor ba zer ba lta du'o//rmo ba ni thong gshol gyis zhing sa slog pa'i don dang / rngon pa ni zhing rmod pa'i phyugs kyi ming ste/ rmon pa dor sdeb/zhes pa lta bu/ spyo ba ni shes rig 'chol ba dang /smyon pa ni snyos pa'i sems can te/khyi — smyon/glang spyod / chang snyon/lta bu rdzu ba da ma yin yi na khul byed pa dar /rdzun ni mi bded ba'i gtam ste/nga rdzun ma/rdzun rkyal/lha bu/308

rjes 'jug na dngad yi zud moXm yid pa'i 'jug ya ga cher gyi kun jigs/zhu ba ni sra bar chags pa'i rdzas rigs me'i drod kyi gsher khur ba ba dang /bzlan ma ni bzhus rjes kyi tshus de'i ming ༅ngo te1 gser sbyangs btso maXl gser rkyen dang / bzhus pa'i nying khu la zhun thigs dang / mar dang 'byurab dang ka ra dang bcas pa bsres nas 'dres par—gyur pa'i zas la zhun dang thud ces pa'i khyad par yang / — mar bzhus nas byas ba la zhun dang / mar bsnogs nas byas pa la thud zer ro/ / bzho ba ni 'o ma reg pa dad / bzhon ma ni 'o ma bdo bya'i 'byi dab mdzo mo dang dag gi ming yin no1/ za ba ni zas sna longs spyod pa dab / zan ni za ma ste/ zan za ba/ 'bru zan zhe da lha khu dang / khyad gzhi la sbyar na za ba ma dan du gyur te/ sha za ba bo la sha zan zer/ de bzhin du/ lto gzan/ sgyu gzad/ stod gzag gcad gzan sogs su grags pa dang / zan yi gas 'dul ba3 sdeb sbyor gyi dab gis/ sgra rtsi ba la rtsi ba sbyar nas/ bag snyan par byas pa yin no/ 1—ri ba ni zong zog gong khug ba'i don te/ rta zadangul srar brgya ri ba/zer ba lta bu dang / rin ni nyo byed kyi sgor mo dke gi mi b.rad—/shu ba dang / tsun pa ni/ sdo ma gzhi las 'dzi — pa'i ba pa dang /— phyi ma bshu byed dngos po'i rlung ste/ shun po tsu zer ba lha bu/bsha'i ba da'i / bshān ka yab / snga ma skam tsa4gos po'i za4ci ༷ 9/

dgas ga rig pa'i gab pa mngod sgyung /phyi ma bsha' ba bo'i ming ngo /bsu ba dang /bsun ma yang snga ma sku mgron pheb par sne len zhu ba'i bya ba dang /pyi ma bsu ba bo'o/gnyis pa/ bya ba'i ming gis khyad chos kyi ming drangs pa'i mtshan gzhi / khro ba ni spro ldang ba dang /khron ma ni gdug pa'i khyad chos tsub po'o//— nga na tshod yol ba'i ka la rjes 'jug na sbyar ba'i da ni /rgas pa'i khyad chos mtshon pa'i ming du gyur pa'o//za ba ni bya ba'i ming du byi ba'i don te/skra pyi ba la za sgro ba/zer ba lha bu/sgro bo ni dngos po'i ming ste/rjen pa'i don yin/sgra med pa la mgo sgro bo dang /rtswa ka mid sa la sa sgro bo/zer thubasta bu/sgron pa ni khyad chos kyi ming ste/nga gcer du'i don yid/sgron po/ spen mo/zer ba lha bu//mnye ba ni 'jam par byed pa dang dam nyid pa ni 'jam pa'o//nga ———yid tshim pa'am 'dod pa grub ba'i 'jo la da mtha' spyar ba'i 'jon pa — ———ni/'dod don sgrub mkhas/pa'i shad du grub bo// zha ba ni yan lag skyon can du rtser pa dang / zhan pa ni dman pa ste/— nga lus zhan pa/stobs 'byor zhan pa/lha bka/khro bzhus das tshigs su snyam na/ yo byad ci yang bzo rur ba'i dper 30

jis 'jug na dang da yi zun mong ma yid pa'i 'jug pa gser gyi nun zigasabastos nas/ bzhu la rjes 'jug na sbyar ba/ bzhun mo/ zhes pa las ka sogs — ————la byang ba'i ming du gyur te/ gar la bzhun pa— par brko bar lag ba'i da gi zer ba lta bu'o//yo ba dang / da / snga ma phyogs gcig tu gseg pa dang / phyi ma drang mo min pa ste/ mjing yon/ lha bu'o //gsum pa/ bya ba'i ming gis bya ba'i ming gzhan zhig drangs pa'i mtshan gzhi/'khu ba ni sdang ba dang / 'khun pa ni khro ba'i skad 'byin pa'o/ /de bzos —nas na zug sogs kyi dbang gis mgrin pa nas sgra zung ba la 'khun zer te/nad pa 'khud gyin 'dug lta bu'o//the ba ni khongs su gtogs pa'am 'dus pa dang / then pa ni 'du bar — —'dod pa'am 'ban pa'o/ /(rang dang 'brel ba med ba'i gzhan dod la tshud par yang the ba zer)sna ba ni spu ba dang / blad pa ni lad 'debs pa'o/ /(bla bo ni gtam/ bla — —ba bo ni pab bo/ bla brda ni kha brda/ bla ma ni chos don smra ba'i mkhad po'o/1) rtartse ba dang rtsed pa gnyis/ /rtsed mo rol ba'i dan gcig lhong / mi 'dra sa — —yang yod de/ rtse ba ni bya ba tsam dang / rtsen pa dngos po'i ming du sbyar chog lha yul la sum rtsen zer ba lta bu'o/ /—311

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung / gso ba ni srog 'tsho ba dang / gson pa ni tshe bsrings pa'i don can no/ / (gsod bar po da sho bo'i phag pa'o//) — bzhi ba/ khyad chos kyi ming gis dngos po'i — ming drangs pa'i mtshan gzhi/yid sun pa'i skyo la rjes 'jug na spyar ba'i skyon ni/ sun dbyung bar bya ba'i gnod pa'am nyed nga 'i ming du gyer por// thag mi ring ba'i nye la na mtha' sbyar ba'i nyen kor ni nye 'khor gyi brda rnying ngo // — tha ba ni rengs pa ste/ rlad dang—blol ba'i zhing la zhing tha bzer/ than pa ni chad dus su ma babs pas sa bskams nas zhing sogs snye dka 'a ba'i don yin/ dpe de bzhin tshun pa ban ka'i don du kar nas/ thad bya/ than ltas/ than skod/— mi shi ba'i bad brgyab pa la than btang ba zhes pa sogs su grags sod// gno drag pa'i don te/ lngags btab ba'i ros la thun zhes bya ba/gdod da dag gi gnod pa 'gog pa'i nus pa drag pa dang ldan pa'i phyir ro// — phra ba dang— phrad—du gnyig chung ba'i cha nas dod gcig kyang / lnga ma khyad chos skye mid tsam dpa —/— mi me dngos po'i ming du sbyar chog ste/ chu phran/ ming phran/ mda' nyag phran/ lha bu/ sdeb sbyor gyi dbang gis phran la zan du bris 312

rjes 'jug na dang da yi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'jug pa gser gyi kun thigs/pa'ang snang / zhing bran/ zan g.yog lta du'o//tsha ba dang tshan gnyis/ sreg pa'i rang bzhin ldan pa'i sgo nas don gcig / snga 4 khyad chos kyi ming dang / phyi ma dngos po'i ming ste/ chu tshan/ja tshan de/ nyi ma la tshan can zer ba lha bu/mdza' ba ni snying nye ba dang / pho mo phan tshun gyi snying grogs la mdzan pho mdzan rā zer/ mdzan gyi tsheg bar zus nas/ mdza' na bo dang / mdza' na rtso ༷ che/sa grogs so//tsho ba dang tshon po gnyis/ sha la tshil mang ba'i cha nas dod 'dra yang / snga ma khyad sa kyi ming tsam yin pas/ thad kar dngos po'i ming du 'jug mi rung / tsho ba za zhes bshad srol med pas gsal/ khyad gzhi dang srur na/ ming gi tshogs pa'am tshig tu byur pa yin te/ sha tsho gi zer ba lta bu dang / phyi ma khyad chos kyi ming du ma zad/ dngos po'i ming gi cha dang ldan pas/ thad kar dngos po'i ming du sbyar chog tshon po za rgyu zer ba lta bu/ khyad gzhi dang sbyar na/ dngos po rigs gcig pa'i khyad par mtshon pa/ sha tshon po zhe na/ khyad gzhi sha dang khyad chos tshon po gnyis ngo bo gcig tu grub nas/ sha rdud pa dang byad par gtod pa yin no/ /de bzhin du/ sngo ba dang sngon po/ dkar ba dang dkar po/ che ba dang chen po/ mtho ba dang mthon po— dma' shā dang dam ra mo/dro ba dang byed po/ rdo ba rdod po la so4sa 4/ da rdog bsgros nas shes ba —— 313

da yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung /ba1ra bgyi/lnga ba/ khyad chos kyi ming gis khyad chos kyi ming gzhan zhig drangs pa'i mtshan gzhi/bde ba dang rjes 'jub/ na sbyar ba'i bden pa gnyis las/ rdzun dang —— ———bral ba'i bden pa ni/ sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i bde ba'i rgyur 'gro ba'i phyir/'jigs pa'am skyengs pa'i ya nga ba dang nyam nga ba'i nga la rjes 'jug na —— ——sbyar ba'i ngan pa ste/ btsog pa'am/ rgud pa'am/ sdig pa'i snang ba la brten ———nas byung ba yin/rin nyung ba'i dma' ba dang / spus ka ngan pa'i dman pa gnyis kyang ——— ———phan tshun brten kyang 'brel bar byung ba'o// —drug pa/ dngos po'i ming gis dngos po'i ming gzhan zhig drangs pa'i mtshan gzhi/skyi dang skyi bser ni rlung dang / rlung ha cang 'khyags pa dang 'grogs nas 'bab pa'i ser ba la skyin thang zer/khru ni ring thung 'jal byed dang / khrun ni zheng ngam dkyus kyi ming ngo //'gro sgo la gron zer ste/ 'gro sgo che shā la gron che ba dang / 'gro sgo nyung ba la gron nyung ba zer ba lta du/ gron ni chud zos kyi don yin pas/ za ma brlag pa la zas gron dang / re ba don med du gyur pa la re gron zer/314

rjes 'jug na dang da yi thun mong ba yin pa'i 'jug pa gser gyi gun jigs/tshogs pa zhig gi gtso bo la mgo ba zer zhing / mgo ba thun mong ma yin pa ste mchog gi bdag nyid can la mgon po zer/rlan zhing gsher pa'i chu la rjes 'jug na sbyar ba'i chu chun ni/ chu 'chu ba bo dang / zo chun ni/ nu khyud du zo ba lta bu sprad de chu 'dren byed kyi 'khor lo'i ming ngo nyi ma shar nas nub pa'i bar gyi dus yun la nyin zer te/ gnam grur bsdad ni rmi lam nyin gyis chod/ lha bu/ pho mo khyo shug tu yong bar byed pa'i bar ba la gnye bo dang/ khyo shug dang 'grel ba chags pa'i mi la gnyen zhes bya ste/ pha ba nyen/ dpa gnyen gnyen po tshang / lha byu / gsom shug sogs kyi 'byar rtsi ste spyi ba la bstos nas/ bo pags sogs gdus pa'i sbyor byed kyi rdzas la phyin zhes bya)//phyi ma dang / phyin chad gnyi4/ rjes ma'i cha nas don 'dra ya nga / mi 'dra sa'ang yod de/ phyi 4 ni brjod bya'i don gyi rjes ma dang phyin chad ni dus kyi ma 'ongs pa'o//bya na ni tshod ma ste/ byan pho dang byan mo ni/ zas g.yo sbyor byed mkhan gyi ming ngo ༷ rig pa'i blo la na mtha' sbyar ba'i blon ni/ rgyal bo'i blo dri sa'i mdun na 315

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /'don gyi ming yin pas/ gros byed pa la blon 'debs pa zhes kyang bya'o//ngo sogs sha kha'i nag thigs te che ba la bltos nas/ sha dang tshil nang du chags pa'i nag jigs lha bu la men zhes rmegs pa'o/ /smi(dme)ni gnyen bshes skye nang khul du gsod res byed pa'i sbyor ba'i ming dang / de las byung ba'i sdug bsngal la brda rnying du smen zhes so//sngon rma chu sa cha'i mi rnams kyis tsho ba'i 'thus mi snye bu'i go chod can la tshon myi zhes 'bod pa yang / rjes 'jug dka mthu yin/ zhe nye'i zha la rjes 'jug na sbyar ba'i zhan ni/ zha nye'i rang ming du grub ste/zha nye dkar po la zhan dkar dang / zha nye'i par la zhan par zer ba lta bu/gtsos dang a mchog sogs kyi kha skad du/ nya la na ltar brjod pas tsheg bar bsdus na/ zhan zhes grags/ya mtha' dang ma mtha' la/ yad chad dang man chan zer ba'i cha nas don 'dra yang / sgra rkyeng rtse yad chad la yan zer bas 'thus mod/ ya mtha' la ya zer bas mi 'thus/ ming gi cha shas su ya rabs la yan rabs zhes bshad srol med pa lha bu'o/ /g.yo ni rang gis nyes pa skyongs nas gzhan bslu ba'i bya spyod dang /g.yon dzun dang g.yon can ma ni/ g.yo sgyu byed mi'o//la thod ni mgo dkris te/ sku'i slas la lan bu zer// 316

rjes 'jug na dang da yi zun mor ma yin pa'i 'jug pa gser gyi nun jigs/rjes 'jug da yi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'jug pa la dam pa gtso cher drug yod de/ dang bo/ bya ba'i ming gis dngos ngo'i ming drangs pa'i mtshan gzhi/skye ba ni gsar du 'byung ba dang / skyed ni du lon gyi 'phel thog ste/bdangul che /'bru skyed/lo skyed/zla skyed/lha bu'o//rga ba ni na tshod yol ba dang rgad po ni mi lo lon no//rgyu ba ni 'gro ba'i don dang /rgyud ni gcig nas gcig tu mu 'brel ba'i dngos rje 'i ming ste/gdung rgyud/rigs rgyud/spra'i rgyud pa/lta bu/ngu ba ni phe 'debs pa dang /ngu sgra'i ming la ngud pa'o//'ju ba 'byar ba'i don du 'jug pa'i sgo nas/ pho mo 'byar ba'i 'khrig nga pa'i ming la 'jud dang /smad 'tshong ma la 'jud mthun ma zhes grags//mig gis lta ba'i blta bya ste/zlos gar sogs la lhad mo zer//— zug zu byung ba la na ba dang /na tsha la nad ces bya'o//spe ba ni bshad pa'i bdad rnying dang /dri ched ni kha brda'o//rtse ba ni dga' ba rol ba dang / rtse bar bya ba'i ming la rtsed mo zer/rtsed nga lha bu/ yan lag skyon can du gyur pa la zha ba dang /rigs shig la rigs gzhan —37

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /zhig 'dres pa'i skyon la zhad ces bya ste/ g.yu la rdo zhad yod/ dmar la nag zhad che na dmar nag zer/ mi gan na blun zhad 'dres/ pho lo lnga bcur rgas zhad med/ zer ba lha bu'o//lu ba ni da ma la zug reg byung ba dang / lus nas byung ba'i gsher khu ——'byar bag can la lud pa zer te/ lud pa lu ba/ lha bu/dbugs rgyun zad shā la shi ba dang / shi bo rjes dran sogs kyi cho ga la ———shid zer te/ shi bo dur 'debs pa'i las ka la shid don dang / shi bor rjes dran gyi ston mo la shid ston dang / gshin por bshams pa'i kha zas la shid gzan— zer ba lha bu'o//gnyis pa1 bya ba'i ming gis bya ba'i ming gzhan zhig drangs pa'i mtshan gzhi/dga' ba ni yi rang ba dang / dga' ba rab tu rgyas te ngag nas thon pa —la dkad pa(dgod pa'i ma 'ongs pa)zhe'o// —'gre log rgyag pa'i 'gre la rjes 'jug—da sbyar ba'i 'gred ni/ rkang ba — —shud nas log pa'i ming du grub bo/ /'gred ni 'dred kyi 'bri tshul gzhan/ zhes pa ma dag pa'o//dar dang kha ba drod kyis gsher ba'i rnam par 'gyur ba la zhu ba/ zhes pa ——dang / lus po nad dang ngal bas lang tsho nyams pa la zhud pa ste/ lus kyi sha nga 318

jis 'jug na dang da yi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'jug pa gser gyi nun zigs/zhud pa dang / rma skran sos par 'gyur ba la skrangs zhud/ zer ba lta bu/bshu ba ni sha kha'i pags pa dag bkog pa'i don dang / bshud pa ni lusang — ———kyi skyi mo brdar nas rmas pa ste/ lag pa rdos bshud/ phyi rting lham gyes bshud/ zer ba lha bu/ gse ba ni dngos po zhig cha shas mang bor btor ba'i don te/ shing gse —ba dang / rgya gang srang du gses na sung bcu yid1 lha bu/ gsed pa ni bal ——— ——sogs kyi 'jul bu'am 'phying ba so sor bkral ba ste/ bal gsed pa dang /rgyus ka bsed nas tshod ma byed/ zer ba lta gu//gsum pa/ dngos po'i ming sgas dngos po'i ming gzhan zhig drangs pa'i mtshan gzhi/rgyu ni 'bras bu'i ngo bo skyed byed de— sa bon lha bu/ rgyud pa ni rgyu ma chad pa'i rgyun te/ rabs phyi ma la rigs rus kyi rgyud pa zer/ rto rgyud dang / lug rgyud/ lta bu/srid dam dkyus la drangs pa'i thags skud la rgyu zer bas/ gzhu 'gug byed kyi skud pa dang / pi zang sogs kyi sgra 'byin byed kyi skud pa la rgyud zer te/ gzhu rgyud dang / rgyud mang / lha bu'o// lto ba ni khog pa dang / lto ba las byung ba'i 'bu rigs rgyu ma phra mo lha bu zhig la ston du zer/ 319

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon rgyung /sreg za las byung ba'i dbugs khams sngo ling nge ba la du ba dang / du ba chags pa'i rdul la dud pa zer te/ khang ba'i dud pa 'phyag ces pa lha bu/po ti ni legs sbyar skad kyi pu ste ka bod 'gyur du zur chag nas pi ti dang / ༷4rjod bde bar byas nas po ti dang / tsheg bar bsdus nas pod ces grags te1 gzhung pod lnga1 zhes pa lha bu'o// zil ba dar du chags pa la ba mo zer/ ba mo'i rang la yang bad ces grags/rtsa ba ni sdong bo'am gzhung rta sa ngos la thug par nye ba'i khag gi ming dang / rtsad pa ni sa 'og tu zogs pa'i rteng ba'i ming ngo /yi deng yid ni sems kyi don yin pa'i cha nas gcig par snang yang /sdeb sbyor du khyad par yod de/ yi rang ba dang yid gzhungs pa/ lha bu/ sems tsam la yid min pa yi mi 'jug go/srid pa ni sprum 1'i don te/ mngal 'dzin pa la srid chags pa zer/sri'u ni /tsho ste/ skyes ma thag pa'i bu gu'o// bzhi ba/ khyad chos kyi ming gis dngos po'i ming drangs pa'i mtshan gzhi/rtsi ni yang ba'i ldog zla yin la/ lcid ni rtsi tshad kyi ming yin zhing / sgra shin bye dab pas na/ cung zad snyan par byed ched/ lcid kyi dod du sdid bris 320

rjes 'jug na dang da yi zun mong ma yin pa'i 'jug pa gser gyi zhun thigs/pa mang ngo /dro ba ni grang ba'am 'khyags pa'i ldob zla dang / drod ni dro byed kyi ming ste/ nyid drod kyis dro ba'o/ /lha gru/ tsha ba ni grang ba'i log pa dang / tshad pa ni tsha gdug gi ming ste/ sdong bo'i sko ma tshad pas rnyid/ zer ba lta bu/ ༷ nad tsha chen byung ba la'ang tshad pa byung zhes pa'o/ /dma' ba'i sma la rjes 'jug da sbyar ba'i smad ni/ tsha 'gab ma'am/ cha phyi ma'i ming du bar da/ stod tsha dang smad cha/ dzeg stod dang khog smad/ lta bu'o//lnga ba/ dngos po'i ming gis bya ba'i ming drangs pa'i mtshan gzhi/ gong ma'am gtso bo'i zhe sa la rje dang / rje la bkur ba la rjed pa ste/mchod par byed la rjed par byed/ zer ba lta bu/ nga blo ni blo gros te/ gros bsdur ba la brda rnying du blod pa zer/ — 'khyab bya'i bro la rjes 'jug da sbyar ba'i brod da / dga' ba'i don te/sems dga' ba 4blo brod pa zer ba lta bu/ ——drug pa/ khyad chos kyi ming gis bya ba'i ming drangs pa'i mtshan gzhi/brda rnying du snyi mo'i snyi la ra mgo'i rnyi spyar ba dag par 'dod de/ kha —321

dka yig rig pa'i gab pa ma ngon phyung /skad dang sgra mthun par mngon/ rnyi la da mtha' sbyar ba'i rnyid pa ni/ rtsi shing — —sogs skam la phyogs pa'i don te/ la phug rnyid song / shing thog rnyid par 'gyur/ lta du/ (rnyid ba 'i ming mtha' la na ro sbyar na/ rnyid po ste dngos po'i ming du gyur te/ yul skad du rnyid do yang zer) brda rnyeng du das 'phul dang sa mgo gang rung ming gzhir spyar ba mang bas1 khyad chos kyi ming du dam1'a ba la rjo da dang / bya ba'i ming du dmad pa la smad pa ltar bris pa mang / smad ni lus kyi mi sa dang — /sma phab pa la smad pa nga 'o/ /zhes dang / dma' dang sma gnyis don gcig pas/ /sma 'bebs dma' 'bebs gang yang 'thus/ /dag yig la lar gsungs snang /gong gsal thun mong ma yin pa'i 'jug pa las/ rjes 'jug da la bltos na/ na'i khyab che/ brda rnying du/ blon la blod dang / btsan po la btsad po dang / ldid la ldin ltar rjes 'jug da na gang rung sbyar ba mang du mthong ste/'di gnyis ka'i byed rtsol rtse rtse so rtsar reg pa 'dra ba tsam las/ sna sgra ngo da med kyi zhib cha la mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i gnad kyis byung ba yin snyam/ sgra rig pa dar ba'i rjes 'brangs nas/ chos gang rjod byed kyi brda'i dbye ba lhar/rjes 'jug da na gnyis ming gzhi gang la gang 'jug pa'i zhib cha legs par thon to/ /yin na yang / thun mong ma yin pa'i 'jug pa las1 mtha' rten medapa'am/ 'a mtha' can gyi ming mi nyung ba zhig la rjes 'jug na dang da gangarung sbyar chog pa mang yang / de dag gi bstan bya cha mthun pa tsam las/322

rjes 'jug da dang da yi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'jug pa gser gyi zhun jigs/mtha' gcig tu 'dra ba ma yin no/ /dper na/ bya ba'i ming du rga ba zhes pa dngos po'i ming du bsgyur ba la/ rjes 'jug na dang da gnyis gang rung sbyar chog ste/ rgan po/ rgad po/ lha bu don gcig kyang / khyad chos kyi ming du bsgyur ba la/ na mtha' ma gtogs da mtha' spyar mi rung / na tshod yol ba'i nyams la/ rgan pa/ zhes pa las/ rgad pa/ zhes brda sbyor srol med pa/ lta du sogs 'jug pa'i ngo bo gcig kyang ldog pa mi gcig pa dang / 'jug yul mi gcig pa dang / 'jug pa'i khyab che chung mi gcig dang / don gcig kyang tsheg khyim bsdu rung mi rung sogs kyi khyad par shes pa gces/thun mong min pa'i 'jug pa la/ /rjes 'jug da na khyab che la/ /gzhan dag nyung yang med pa min/ /kho la khong dang khra la khram/ /ha cang ska nas skam pa dang / /'byar ba'i ra ji la 'jim pa dang / /lcags kyi zo bar lcags zom zer —sdong bor 'khri shing 'khril nas skye /rkang lag zha ba mig kyang zhar/ /ri mor ris dang dbu mar dbus/ 1

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung /mkho ba'i nus par mkhos ka zer/ /lta gu sogs kyis shes par bgyi/ /rjes 'jug gi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'jug pa la/ da na gnyis khyab de 'dra che don ci yin zhe na/ rjes 'jug 'a'i dod du de gnyis rigs par spyar na/ sgra'i 'gyur ba snga ma'i ming gi gdangs dang nye bas/ don nye ba mtshon sla ba'i phyir ro/ /rjes 'jug gi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'jug srol 'di legs par rtogs na/ ming gang dang gang brten cing 'brel bar byung ba dang / ming gang gi sgra bshad ji lhar yin pa sogs kyi khungs chud nas/ yi ge'i sgra gzugs don gsum mnga' brnyes pas/ shes brjod 'jug gsum la mkhas par 'gyur srid de/ dper na/ 'gron po dang / mgron po gnyis gdam nga yin par 'dod nas gang rung bris pa mang yang / de gnyis kyi ngo bo mi gcig pas/ 'jug yul la khyad par yod do/ /'gron po ni/ 'gro ba'i bya ba dang 'grel ba'i sgo nas byung ba ste/ lam 'gro la 'jug pa yin la/ mgron po ni/dga' ston la zhugs mi yin pas/ ston gzan la 'jug pa yin no/ /'dun sa dang / mdun sa gnyis kyang 'jug don mi 'dra/ 'dun sa ni/ 'du ba dang 'brel 'i tshogs sa dang / mdun sa ni/ sdun so'o/ /bstan dar lha rams pa'i dag yig las/ 'du ba'i sa la 'dun sa zer/ zhes dang / dge bshes chos grags kyi dag yig las/ mdun sa zhes pa spyan sngar ro/ /zhes pas gsal/324

rjes 'jug na dang da yi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'jug pa gser gyi kun jigs1'dun ma ni/ tshogs 'dur ma tshogs pa can gyi ming yin/ 'di la mdun ma zhes bris pa ma dag pa ste/ dge bshes chos grags kyis brtsams pa'i brda dag ming tshig gsal ba'i rgya 'grel du ba yo kar ma zhes pas gsal/ bod rgya tshig mdzod chen mo las/ mdun sa la tshogs 'du/ zhes dang / 'dun sa la 'dun byed pa'i gnas dang / stabs bde sa dang / thag nye sa/ zhes dang /mdun ma la 'dun ma 'dra/ zhes dang / mdun khang la 'dug sa/ zhes bkral pa rnams ma dag pa ste/ tha snyad de rnams kyi khungs ma ci yin ma rtogs par/gdam nga yin par 'dod log byung ba'i skyon no/ /tung hon nas thon pa'iXbod kyi lo rgyus kyi yig cha'i rgya yig 'i 'gyur du/ dbyar rmi 'dun ma la zazab dang / dgud 'dun la 4bka zhes 'dud ma yod tshad la ka ltar bsgyur snang / dngos su na gros tshogs kyi don yin/ waṃ༅ zhes bya ba/spya yig gi deng rabs rgya skad kyi ming mdzod las/ tshe4( bza(—tshe4shu)baྈ(tsha༅4ba)bka1 lnga zhes 'grel snang / bod skad du bsgyur na/gna' rabs kyi rgyal bo(de'i sku tshab bam)dang rgyal bo(de'i sku tshab bam)zhal mjal nas mjal dum mdzad pa yin/ zhes pa'o/ /de lhar bsgyur ba ma dag rgyun 'byams la brten das/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi dzid kyi lo rgyus dpyad pa rnams kyis/ bod gna' rabs kyi rgyal blon rnam pas mnga' 'og tshor rang la blo dkar ba dang rgyab skyor ba'i dam bca' bar bcug nas/ rang gi go sa 32 5

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngod sgyung /dang srid dbang bsrungs pa yin pa'i skad kyi blun bshad mang ngo / /bshad tshul de'i shugs la bod glen pa blun dad kyi thabs rdugs las rigs pa'i thabs dam pa med par mngon/ yang rgya 'gyur de las/ rje blon blod blod de/ log my-i rgya'i sred brlag go/ /zhes pa'i don ma rtogs par/ ྈ༅ma 'i 7 ༅ mcho za ༅ zhes bsgyur snang / brda rnying du jis 'jug da dang na gnyis gang rung sbyar ba yod de/ blod blod de/ zhes pa/ blon blon nas zer ba yin/ de yang bgrosaXbagros nas/ zhes pa'i don yin pas/ ༅bzangazobo yo snyed1cho mas brtse ya zhe na dag go /gong gi tha snyad zhwa dpe lham 'gebs dab / 'grel nyes sgyur nyes byung ba rnams rjes 'jug na dang da'i thun mong ma yin pa'i 'jug pa dang 1 ming gi byung tshul ma nges pa las byung ba yin no//rjes 'jug da na dang bcas pa'i/ /thun mong mi na pa'i 'jug pa las/ /'brel yod ming gi byung ba dang / /don gyi khyad par rab gsal bas/ /de rtogs 'chad rtsod rtsom pa la/ /mkhas pa'i blo zhig rnyed pa yin// /1326

ming gzhi ra dang ra ba da bka'ajigaspe tshan bcu gnyis pa/ ming gzhi ra dang ra brtags can skor zhig gi 'brel ba zhi ba rje mo ram 'thagatha snyad phun sum tshogs pa'i rgya mtsho las/ ming gzhi ra dang ra btags can skor zhig gnas dang byed pa'i sbyor ba spyir btang 'dra ba'i sgo nas/brten cing 'grel bar byung ba'i ming gi tha snyad mang ste/ la la ngo bo gcig pa dang / la la ngo bo 'dra yang ldog pa mi gcig pa dang / la la don 'dra yang 'jug yul mi gcig pa dang / la la phyogs mtshungs kyang bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba yod pa dang / la la don 'dra yang sgra'i zur chag ma chag gi dbang gis 'bri srol mi gcig pa sogs du ma yod do/ /shes byed gtso bo ni/ ming gzhi ra dang ra btags can sogs yin pa dang / skad kyi gdangs nye ba dang / dbyangs dang mtha' rted gcig pa'o/ /gzhan yang / ming gi brjod pa rnams las/ sgra phal cher 'dra ba'i rkyen gyis/ ngo bo'i khyad par ma zud par/ zhwa dpe lham 'gebs kyi bris nyes dmas kyang zhib mo rnam 'thag 'di dang bsgros nas shes par bgyi'o//don tshan dang bo/ ming gzhi ra can dang ra btags can sogs kyi 'brel ba/ra———ri/ ra ba dang rib ma/ gnas kyi khor yug ji mtha' chod du don 327

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung /'dra yang / khyad gzhi mi gcig ste/ sa yis bskor ba la ra ba dang / shing gis bskor ba la rib ma ste/ rdos brtsigs pa la rtsig pa/ zhes pa'o/ /rwa ——ru/ mig zag can gyi mgo na skyes pa'i rdung byed de/ rwa co la ru thur zer ba'o/ /rwa la lu zur btags pa/ ra ba dang ra lug gi ra dang khyad par byas pa yin//ra— — kra/ rong nge dang krong nge / don gcig ste/ gyen du drang ba'i khyad chos kyi ming dang / rong nge ba dang / krong nge ba ni khyad chos de'i dngos po'i ming du byur pa'o// ra ——khro/ rol mo dang 'khrol ba/ dkrol bya'i spu wang sogs la rol mo dang / mi wang sogs kyi sgra 'byin po la 'khrol ba zer te/ rol mo 'khrol ba/lta du'o// ra———gra/ ra dang grwa/ gnas kyi khor yug gi mtha' chod du don gcig ste/ chos ra la chos grwa dang / nor ra la nor grwa zer ba lha bu/ grwa la ka zur btags pa/ spu'i gra dang / gra ma'i6 gra dang khyad par gtod pa'o/ / rigs pa dang 'grig pa/ khyad chos kyi ming du don gcig ste/ rigs par bya la 'grig par bya/ zer ba lta bu dang / dngos po'i ming du jigs pa zu/ gtogs 'grig pa mi 'jug ste/ rigs pas dpyad pa la/ 'grig pas dpyad/ces zer srol med pas gsal/328

ming gzhe ra dang ra btags can skoraXzheg gi 'grel ba zhib mo rnam 'garib pa dang grib ma/ khyad chos dang dngos po'i cha nas 'brel chags te/nun pa 'gribs shul la grib ma/ zhes pa dang / de bzhin mi gsal ba'i rnam pa la ra ri dang / sdong bo'i rtsar nyi 'od ma khel sa la grib bsil zer ba'o/ /yang nag po'i cha das grib ma mi gtsang ba dang lan chags la'ang 'jug ste/ btsog pa zos nas zas grib phog pa/ gribaXms gnag pa/ gnyid log nas grib non byung ba/ zer ba lha bu/ ru skya dang gru skya/ don gcig ste1 mnyan pa'i srub shing ngo / /rogs dang grogs/ don gcig ste/ rogs pa la grogs po dang / las rogs la las grogs zer ba lta bu//rong ba dang grong ba/ 'brel chags shing don gcig ste/ gna' bor 'brog pa la ru ba dang / rong ba la grong ba zer te/ rong ba'i 'dug sa grong yin pa'i phyir/zha re dang zha sgri/ don gcig ste/ rna ba med pa'o/ /sdeb sbyor du zha sgro zhe na/ sgra rtsi yang shed mi mnyam pas/ brda rnying du zha re zhes brngod bde bar byas pa mang ngo /1ra——dra/ ral ba dang dral ba/ bdag gzhan gang la'ang ma 'grel ba'i bya ba la bkod na dod gcig ste/ gos ral song la gos dral song / zhes pas gsal/ bdag gzhan gyi sgo nas don mi gcig ste1 snga ma gzhan dang 'brel 329

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung/ nga ba'i bya ba dang / phyi ma bdag dang 'brel ba'i bya ba ste/ shog bu dral nas ral song / lha bu/ de phyir dgra bo'i lus phung zhig ral du gtong byed kyi gri ring so gnyis mar ral gri zhes grags/ 'di gnyis ka'i ming mtha' la na ro spyar ba'i dral bo dang ral bo ni bya ba'i ming dngos po'i ming du gyur pas/ deng gi na gzhon tshos dral ma ci gon/ zer ba las sbyar gzhi sos zhes pa bsdus kyang gos chad por bsta na pa gsal lo//ring ba dang 'dring ba/ brda rnying du/ glo ba ring la/ glo ba 'dring / zhes don gcig 'dring ni da lta ba dang /rings ni 'das pa'o//ril ba dang dril ba/ snga ma gzhan dang 'bal ba'i bya ba dang / pyi ma bdag dang 'brel ba'i bya ba ste/ shog du dril nas ril ba/ lha bu/ dril bsgrags pa ni/ bka' shog dril ba thang bkral nas tshogs par bton nas go brda sprad pa'i don yin/ dag yig ming mdzod kha cig las/ dril ba la phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa zhes bkral ba ma dag pa ste/ lug khyu shog bu bzhin du ji ltar dril/ ril yang khyad chos kyi ming du 'jug rung ste/ ril ril dang / ril le phyin pa/lta bu'o//ril bu dang dril du/ gnyis ka'i ming mthar zhabs myu spyar tshe/ bya ba'i ming dngos po'i ming du gyur pa yin/de yang rnam pa 'dra yang ngo bo mi 'dra ste/ril du ni/mnyen mo'i rigs 'dam bag lta du las grub pa'i rdog po yin la/330

ming gzhi ra dang ra btags cad skor zhig gi 'brel ba zhib mo rnam 'jigadril bu ni/ sra mkhregs lcags lha bu las grub pa'i rol mo zhig yin no/ /yang /ril dur bltos nas cha shas kun tshang ba can la ril bo zer te/ nyin ril bo/lha du dang / rang gi ngang gis num bur grub pa can la ril ma ste/ lug gi ril ma/ lha du'o//rub pa dang 'drub pa/ 'grel chags kyang don mi gcig rma kha rubs nas 'drub pa ni/ za kha zums nas drag par 'gyur ba lha bu/ bdag gzhad gyi dbye ba'ang yod de/ rub pa di sru sa zum pa dang / 'drub pa ni srubs zum par byed pa ste/ gos srubs 'tshe pa la/ gos spubs 'drub zer ba lha bu'o//rul ba dang drul ba/ snga ma bya byed tha mi dad pa ste/ sha rul song / zer ba lha bu dang 1 phyi ma bya byed tha dad pa ste/ rul bar 'jug pa la/ tsā kum drul nas lud du bya/ zer ba lha bu'o/ /rul nas 'dag par gyur pa la rul zugs dang 1 rul nas dri ngan bro ba la rul sungs dang / gyid lug pa la rul ma dang 1 la rgya nyams pa la nang rul/ zhes bya'o//ra————bra/ zham ring dang zhabs 'bring / sku g.yog ste don gcig brda rnying du/ zhabs 'bring la zham ring lhar bris pa/ sdeb spyor gyi dbang gis sgra lci yang shed snyoms par byas nas grub pa yin//rin pa dang brin pa/ don 'brel te/ snga ma dngos po'i ming dang / phyi ma bya ba'i ming yin/ zong gi rin la sgor mo brgya brin/ zer ba lha du'o//331

dag yig rig pa'i dab pa mngod jing /rim pa dang brim pa/ snga bsdud gzhug gi go rim ste dngos po'i ming dang / phyi ma rim pa bzhin star ba ste bya ba'i ming yid/ skal brgyab nas rim pa bzhin brims so/ /lha bu/ bad rnying du1 'gyed du brims la/ 'gyed du rims/zhes bris pa yang snang/ris dang jis/ snga ma ni ri mo ste dngos po'i ming dang / phyi ma ni 'bri ba'i 'das pa ste bya ba'i ming yin zhing / bris ma zhes sbyar na dngos po'i ming du rtser pa'i cha nas/ ris dang don gcig par ston chog ste/ logs ris la logs bris dang / yig gzugs kyi khyad par dpe bris la dpe ris dang /blum bris la rlum ris/ zhes pas gsal/ des na tshig ris ni/ tshig tu bris yod pa'i don yin mod/ dag yig la lar/ tshig ris ni tshig gi spu ris zhes bkral ba sgyu dag par mthong ngo /rub pa dang brub pa/ snga ma phyogs gcig tu 'dus pa ste/ bya rgod thed la rub pa/ lha bu dang / phyi ma phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa ste/ lam du gang mkho brubs nas bzhag yod/ lta bu'o/—bla re dang bla sbo/ gnyis ka'ang bla la sbos pa'i gnam rgyan nam thog yol gyi ming yin/ bad rnying du pa ba dag la ra btags pa'i sgra/ deng sang lhar mchu sgra dang bcas pa'i tra dang dra bzhin mi 'don par/ ra sgra zur tsam 'dres pa'i ri dang ri bzhin 'don pa dang / ming gzhi'i sgra'i zur chag nas 332

ming gzhi ra dang ra btags can skor zhig gi 'grel ba zhib mo rnam 'jigabla pre'i sgra bla re ltar gyur pa yin no//regs pa dang gregs pa/ snga ma las dang 'brel ba'i bya ba dang / phyi ma byed pa dang 'brel ba'i bya ba ste/ skra bregs nas regs pa/ lha bu/ regs pa khyad chos kyi ming du'ang 'jug rung ste/ mgo regs zhabs rjen/ lta bu'o//ro dang bro/ snga ma lce'i myang bya ste dngos po'i ming dang / phyi ma zungs pa'i tshor ba snye bya ba'i ming yin te/ ro bro ba/ lha bu'o// ra———sra/ ring ba dang sring ba/ snga ma bsrings pa'i khyad chos dang / phyi ma ring du gtong ba'i bya ba ste/ ring bar sring ba dang / bsrings nas ring ba/lta bu/ 'di gnyis 'brel chags pa'i dbang gis/ nye ring la bsnyen sring zhes kyang bya'o// rib pa dang srib pa/ dngos po'i ming du don gcig ste/ nyid srib la nyin rib zer ba lha bu dang / mi gcig sa ni/ rib pa ni gzhan dang 'brel ba'i bya ba la 'jug rung ste/ bsgribs nas rib pa dang / sribs ni dngos po'i ming tsam las bya bar 'jug mi rung ste/ snang ba ribs nas grib ma gug sa yin pas/ nyin rtswa srib rtswa dang 1 khang ba'i srib 'khyags zer ba lta bu/ khang ba'i mdun du glang ma lha bus bskor ba'i gyang ra la rib ma zheb pa yang/ sgo phyi nang gi sgrib byed yin pa'i cha nas btags pa'o//rol dang srol/ log brgyab shul gyi shur mo'i ming ste/ sa bon rol la'am 333

dag yig rig pa'i dab pa mngon sgyung /srol la 'debs pa/ rto bu1 mi gcig sa'ang yod/ rol ni phyogs te/ pha rol1tshu rol/ g.yas g.yon rol gnyis zer ba dang / srol ni lugs te/ yul srol/lam srol/ bshad srol zer ba lta bu'o//ra——— hra/ rags pa dang hrags pa/ zhib mo min pa'i cha nas don 'dra ste/ bye ma rags rags la/ bye ma hrags hrags kyang zer chog la/ khyad chos mtshon byed du 'jug yul mi 'dra/ reg bya rgyob pa la seg rdar ltar hrags pa dang / zhib cha med pa la brjod pa rags pa tsam zer ba lta bu/rad pa dang hrad pa/ ral ba'i don du gcig pa'o//ral ba dang hra1 pa/ thed pa'i don te/ gos ral ba'am hral ba/ lha bu/ral rul dang hral hrul/ gnyis ka'ang nyams pa'i nom pa mtshon kyang /'jug yul mi 'dra ste/ tshod ma ra le rul le/ pags pa hra le zul le/ zer ba lta bu/rig rig dang thig trig khyad chos kyi ming du don gcig mig 'bras myur du 'gul ba'i rnam pa la/ mig rig rig dang / mig hrig thig kyang zer/ rab rib dang hrab trib/ gsal bo min pa'i rnam pa ste/ gzugs rab rib tsam mam hrab hrib tsam las mi mthong / zer ba lha bu/ril bo dang hril bo/ gnyis ka'ang cha shas kun tshang ba can gyi ming ste/nyin ril bo'am nyin hril bo dang / lug sha ril bo'am hril bo lha bu/334

ming ba'i ra dang ra btags can skor zhig gi 'brel bzhib mo rnam 'jigarug ba dang hrug pa1 rdog ngo chung ngu mang ba'i dam pa ste/ rdo bcag nas rug rug bam hrug hrug tu btang byung / zer ba lha bu1 rengs pa dang trengs pa/ khyad chos kyi ming du don gcig ste/ spyong ba'am mnyen cha med par gyur pa'i rnam pa mtshon par/ lus grang nas shing lhar rengs pa'am trengs par gyur pa/ lha 4 dang / bza' zla med pa'i mi rkyang la po rengs mo rengs sam pho trengs mo trengs/ zer ba lta du1 dbyibs dar ma can sra chags pa 'a / reng du las hreng bu zhes bshad srol med/ spos kyi ning tsa la/ sgos kyi trengaXbu mi zer ro1/spu rengs dang spu hrengs/ don gcig ste/ mngon brjod du phag rgod la spu rengs sam spu hrengs kyang ngo / /mnga' ris kyi yul gru zhig la spu reng—sa dang / spu trengs kyang zer//don tshan gnyis pa/ ming gzhi dra can dang kra can sogs kyi 'brel ba/ dra — kra/ drang dang krang / khyad chos kyi ming du don gcig ste/sgyu sdong bo drang nger skyes pa la/ sdong bo krang nger skyes/ zhes dpe rnying du mang du mthong ngo / /krang la na ro sbyar kyang don 'dra ste/ ri bong rna ba krong nger tsog 'du zer ba lta bu/ mi gcig sa ni/ krang / zhes pa dkrongs nas langs pa'i don te/gyen du langs pa'i rnam pa tsam la spyar cing / dkrongs pa/ zhes pa brda rnying 336

dag yig rig pa'i gab paXmangon sgyung /du yar drang mor bslangs pa'i don te/ bdag dang 'brel ba'i bya ba yin/ de gzhan dang 'brel ba'i bya ba la 'khrongs pa zhes/ rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa kar tshul las/ ka ba kyog por gyur pa rnams zhabs kyis bsgril nas mda' lhar 'khrongs pa/ zhes pas gsal/ drang / zhes pa ring du bsrangs nas yod pa'i rnam pa ste/ gyed du langs pa'am 'phred la nyal ba'i rnam pa gang la'ang 'jug chog ste/ lam chen skya drang nges 'dug zer ba la/ lam chen skya krang nger 'dug ces bshad srol med snyam/— 'drogs pa dang dkrogs pa/ bya ba'i ming du bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba yod de/ rta dkrogs nas 'drogs song / lta bu dang / der brten nas 'drog pa4ma nga rgyal gyi rnam pa la krog krog ste/ rta pho rna ba krog krog byas tshe rgyug 'dang red/ zer ba lha bu'o//dra ——gra/ dra ma dang gra ma/ sgra phal cher 'dra yang don mi 'dra/ dra ma ni/dra ba'i rnam pa dang 'bril nas dkar khung dra mig yod pa can la dra ma dang /dra ma'i shing khram ltar rten cing 'brel ba'i dod shes pa'i mkhas pa la'ang dra zer/ gra ma ni/ tsher ma'i rnam pa can te/ shing gra ma dang / snye ma'i gra ma dang / sum gyi gra kha/ lha du/ 'di la mam skad du gya ma zer bas kyang shes pas/dag yig la lar dra ma dang gra ma 'dra'o/ /zhes pa nor ro//dru gu dang gru gu/ skud pa dkris pa'i ming du gcig ste/ gang rung sbyar 336

ming gzhi ra dang ra btags can skor zhig gi 'brel ba zhib mo rnam 'thagachogadril ba dang gril ba/ gnyis ka'ang bya ba'i ming ste/ phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i cha nas rnam pa 'dra yang don mi 'dra ste/ dril ba ni/ bdag dang 'brel ba'i bya ba ste/ dbyibs leb mo shog bu 'dra dril ba dang / gril ba ni1gzhan dang 'brel ba'i bya ba ste/ dbyibs ring bo skud pa lha bu sgril nas gril lta bu'o//drum pa dang grum pa/ sgra 'dra ba'i sgo nas don gcig tu 'jug pa snang yang / dag yig shes bya rab gsal dang / dag yig ngag sgron bcas ming mdzod tshad ldan rnams las/ chag pa'i don du grum ma gtogs chag drum zhes pa med pas/ grum la drum du bris pa ma dag par snyam/ chag pa'i don 'phros nas/ rkang lag grum pa'i 'gros lhar du/ /byed pa'i srog chags grub par btags/ /zhes dang / de bzhin rus tshigs na ba'i nad bye brag pa zhig la grum du/ zhes pa yang / tshigs mig chu ser 'phel ba yis/ /'byor byed byed las nyams gyur te/ /tshigs kun chag grum shor ba ltar/ grum bu zhes 4bshad pa dang / /spyol bor grum po'ang de bzhin yin/ /zhes dar mo sman rams pa'i sman gzhung du gsungs so// drus ma dang grus ma/ bzhon ma'i ming la drus ma las grus ma mi༄jug ste/ma skad du ba gyus ma zhes mi grag pas gsal / grus ni bgru ba'i skul tshig ste/337

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung/'bras sogs kyi shun pa 'phud pa'i don yin/ 'bras kyi shun pa bgrus tshar ba can la bgrus ma zhes bas 'phul yod do//drung bo dang grung bo/ gdam nga min/ drung bo ni gnyen nye du ste/ nye 'khor la drung 'khor/ zer ba lta bu/ grung bo ni spyang po dang bzang bo'i don te/ mi grung bo dang / sa bon grung bo/ zhes ba lta bu/dres ma dang gres ma/ gdam nga can min/ gres ma ni/ lo mang du skyes pa'i rtswa bye brag pa lo ma ral gri'i dbyibs can zag pa sgrim rung ba/ am skad du gyes ma zer ba de yid/ dres ma/ zhes pa dag yig tshad ldan rnams las me snang / sga ha lam 'dra bas bris ma dag pa yin na ma snyam/'dred pa dang 'gred pa/ gdam nga min/ 'gred pa ni shud pa'i don te/ma skadaXdu/ long ba 'gyed nas log ces pas gsal/ 'dred pa ni brda yig blo gsal mgrin rgyan du/ nyes pa'i don du bshad snang //dra ——bra/ dri dang bro/ snga ma ni sna'i spyod yul du gyur pa'i dri ma ste1 kros dri/ lha rtsa phyi ma ni sna dang lces tshor ba ste/ dri zhim bro ba/ lha bu/'drad pa dang 'brad pa— dngos po zhig gi ngos nas rim pa re mar blang ba'i cha nas don 'dra yang / ngo bo mi gcig ste/ khyi yis 'drad pa dang /lcags ba gyis 'a zad pa/ lta bu/'drid pa dad 'brid pa/ mgo g.yogs pa'i cha nas don 'dra yang/338

ming gzhe ra dang ra btags can skor 'ig gi 'brel ba zhib mo rnam 'dapaka'ajug tshul mi 'dra/ nor gyir bslu ba la 'brid pa ste/ wa skyes gzan gyis brid nas rnyi la zin pa dang / blo yis slu ba la 'drid pa ste— dgra sde rig thog tu drid nas bcom pa/ lha bu'o// 'drud pa dang 'brud pa1 snga ma dngos po 'ben nas— 'gro ba ste/ drel gyis shing rta drud pa dang / phyi ma rko ba'i don te/ sa zus/ lha bu/'dreg pa dang 'breg pa/ don mi bcig bal 'breg pa/ bsregs nas 'dreg pa/ lta bu/ — 'drog pa dang 'brog pa/ snga ma dngangs nas 'drog pa dang / phyi ma phyugs las don du gnyer ba'i mi'o// dra— ——sra/ dros dang sros/ snga ma bya ba'i las dang phyi ma byed pa'i las te/mer bsros nas dros pa lha du/drubs dang srubs/ bar mchams la srubs dang / srubs gcig tu btsem pa la drubs pa'o/ /'das pa'i dbang du drubs zhes pa subs kyi dod du 'jug chogs bas shar la drubs shar dang / srubs gzan la drubs gzan/zer ba lta bu/'dreg pa dang sreg pa/ bdag gzhan gyi 'brel ba/ bal bgregs nas 'dregs song / lha bu/ 'dres pa dang bsres pa/ bdag gzhan du 'bre' chags te/ phyogs 339

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /gcig tu bsres nas 'dres par gyur/ lta bu/'drul ba dang bsrul ba/ pags pa sul la 'phangs nas mnyen zhing 'jam par byed pa la bsrul ba ste/ byed pa'i las dang / bsrul nas mnyen par gyur pa la 'drul ba ste/ bya ba'i las so//dra—— hra/ drag pa dang hrag pa/ ngar ba'i don te/ mi drag rta drag la/ mi hrag rta hrag zer ba lta du/dril ba dang hril bo/ snga ma bya ba'i ming ste— shog bu dril ba lha du dang /phyi ma khyad chos kyi ming ste/ dril nas skrum por byur pa'i rnam pa la thil bo zer/de yang cha tshang ba'i don du 'jug pa'o//don tshan gsum pa/ ming gzhi ra btags can phan tshun gyi 'brel ba/kra —— khra/ krung krung dang khrung khrung / don gcig ste/ brda rnying du bya khrung khrung la krung krung du bris da mang /bkra dang khra/ khra khra rig rig gi rnam pa la bkra zhes btags pas/ 'di gnyis khyad chos mtshon par don 'dra yang / thob thang mi gcig glog 'od bkra lam me 'phro ba/ me tog dkar dmar khra lam me bzhad pa/ lha bu/ rtags mtshungs srur ba'i khyad par ro/ /yang / khra khra zhes pa kha dog 'dres ma'i ming dang / bkra ba zhes pa kha dog gi mdangs kyi ming yin pa'i cha nas don mi 340

ming gzhi ra dang ra btags can skor zhig gi 'bal ba zhib mo rnam 'thagagacig go/krog dang srog mgo log sogs kyi yul skad du sra sgra kra zhes grags pa'i dbang gis/brda rnying du srog med la krog med du bris pa snang ngo //khrang phra/ 'khrul ba dang 'phrul ba/ gdam nga'i tshul du bris pa mang yang don mi gcig ste/ snga ma ni 'phyugs pa'i don dang / pyi ma ni sprul nas 'phrul ba ste/ thabs khyad par can du snang ba'i grub pa zhig yin pas1 rdzu 'phrul/sgyu 'phrul/'phrul 'khor sogs kyi ming gzhi pha bris na dag go/mkhrang ba dang hrang ba/gnyis ka'ang sra bar sgyur pa'i don yin/gra——nga bra/ 'grim pa dang 'brim pa/ snga ma brgyud pa'i don te/ la lung 'grim pa/ yig cha 'grims nas lha ba/ lha bu dang / phyi ma stob pa'i don te/zas 'brim pa/slob ma tshor dpe cha jims so1/lha bu/sgrib pa——srib pa1 rub pa'i don du 'jug pa/ nyi ma sprin gyis bsgribs pa la/brda rnying du /nyi ma sprin gyis bsrib bo//zhes bris pa yod do//grub pa dang srub pa dpa' ris sogs kyi kha skad du grub pa'i dod du srub pa 'jug srol yod/ dper na/ nyin gcig gi las ka nyin zud kyis bsrubs song / zer ba lta bu/ bsrubs song ba ni grub song ba'o/ /srub ni spub pa'i don la'ang 'jug pa ste/ gor shi ka'i sdong du de bcad pa'i rtsa ba'i cha la mchod sdong gcig bsrubs/zhes bka' chems ka khol ma las byung / 341

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon snang /bra sra/ spre mong dang sre mong / kha skad du sbo'i ming gzhi'i sgra zur chag nas sbo mong la sre mong du bris pa byung ba'o/ 1'bu spre bo la 'bu bse bo zhes bris pa mthong yang / bse ni sre yin snyam/brag dang hrag bar mtshams kyi don te/ mig brag la mig hrag zer ba lha bu/ gzhi dang bral ba'am drug sgras sbol ba'i bar mtshams tsam la dbrag ces das 'phul thob pa/ ka ba'i da zag brag srubs kyi da zag che/ zer ba lha du/dpe rnying rnams las smin dbrag la zin phrag ces bris pa'ang snang / des na phrag dang zag kyang 'brel chags sa yod de/ stong phrag gsum dang lnga brgya/zhes stong gnas kyi bar mtshams la phrag 'jug srol byung ba/ lta bu/bran dang phran/ phra zhing zhib pa'i phra la rjes 'dag na sbyar ba'i phran ni/chung ngu'i don du gyur pa yin/ phran dang 'brel ba'i bran ni/ rgyu dang dbang gis chung ba'i khol bo'i ming du gyur song / sdeb sbyor du 'di gnyis gang 'os su sbyar chog chu phran la chu zan dang / rgyal bran la rgyal phran du bris pa mang du mthong ngo //gzhan yang / dag yig smra ba kha cig gis/ tha snyad kyi sgra 'dra ba dag la bltas nab / de'i 'bri tshul gzhan no/ /gdam nga'o skad pa la ba lhas na/ phal cher ma brtags pa'i skyon du mthong ste/ dper na/ rta 'drog yong zhes bris kyang rta 'brog yong snyam/ zhes pas dag pa ma dag par bcos byung / khyu slog 342

ming ga'i ra dang ra btags can skor zhig 'i 'brel ba zhib mo rnam 'bagapa ni phru slog pa dang 'dra/ zhes pa nor/ khru ni sor rtse nas gru tshigs bar byi tshad de/ dpe cha khru gang ba/ lta bu/ zu ni bru bar bya ba yin pas/ phru slog pa dag go /bru ba ni dru ba'am rko bzhin pa'i don/ zhes pa'i dru ba bru ba'i don min par ma zad/ de 'dra'i tha snyad cig dag yig gi gzhung tshad ldan dmas las mthong rgyu med do/ /'dran pa ni 'gran pa dang don gcig ces pa gdam nga ma lags te/ dras pa'i da rte ba 'dra la rjes 'jus na sbyar ba'i 'dran ni/ dra bar bya ba'i yul gyi ming ste/ dras pa ma 'grigs 'dran brlags pa/ zhes pas gsal/ tha na/ bod rgya tshig mdzod chen mo las/ tha snyad gcig la bris pa 'grig mid sna tshogs byung ba/ dper na/ thi wang la/ gi hang 1'gi wang dang / 'gi hang dang / 'be'u wang dang / ghi hang 1 lha bu sogs mang du mthong ngo / /dag yig ma dag par byas na skyon che snyam/ de phyir bri klog sgyur gsum du ming mdzod la bsten dgos kyang / sha gzug za rkyang byed mi nyan/'grig min la rnam dpyod gtang dgos/ ming mdzod tag tag la brten na/ yi ge'i dag cha thon dka' ste/ dpe cha gang mang ba lha dgos/ 'brel yod kyi rig gnas dag gi dgongs don khong du chud na/ tha snyad rig pa'i blo skyes kyis rtsongs pa'i nun pa grol lo//mjug tu/ dam pa'i chos la brgya tshar dang / gal bo che la nan tan/zhes pa ltar/ gong du ming gzhi ra can nam ra btags canaXskor zhig gi 343

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung 'bril ba dpyad pa'i gnad dam pa ni/ rten 'byung yin min gyi dbye ba legs par zud pa'i dgos pa bstan pa yin te/ shes pa kun las rten 'brel shes pa mchog rje tsong kha ba'i rten 'brel bstod pa las/ ston pa'i nang na rten 'brel ston pa dang / /shes rab nang na rted 'brel shes pa gnyis/ /'jig rten dag na rgyal ba'i dbang bo bzhin/ /zhes gdams pa lhar/ gong gsal ming gzhi ra can dang ra btags can rnams kyi 'brel ba/ phal cher rten cing 'grel ba'i byung ba yin te/ ming gang zhig gang la brten pa/ gang dang 'brel ba/ sgra mi gcig sa/ ngo bo mi gcig sa/ 'jug pa mi gcig sa/ khyab che chung mi gcig sa la sogs pa'i khyad par 'byed pa'i blo mig rgya che zhing gting zab pa dang cha zhib par bskyed na/ ming gi byung 'phel gyi de nyid dang / gna' mi'i ming btags pa'i kun btags rig pa rnams khong du chud pa'i sgo nas/ ming dang tshig gi 'khrul ba'am dogs gzhi gang ci me dang spra ba phrad pa bzhin/brdar sha chod par ma zad/ dngos po gsar ba gang byung la/ ming gsar du gdags pa'i thabs dam pa'ang rnyed par srid do//gzhan yang / ming gzhi ra can nam ra btags can gang rung phan tshun rten 'byung yin pa'i nges pa med de/ sgra mtshungs pa tsam la bltos nas/gdam nga can du bsams nas/ 'drog dang 'brog lha bu zhwa dpe lham 'gebs byas pa dang / 'drid dang 'brid/ lta bu nya nyung mnyam bsre byas pa/ de lugs 344

ming gzhi ra dang ra ba1gsaXcan skor zhig gi 'grel ba zhib mo rnam 'jiku—rigs1 pa'i dpyad nas nges par bya dgos/ yang / ming gzhi ra btags can la la da / sgra mi mtshungs la rten 'byung yin pa yang yod/ de yang deng sang gi 'don tshul du sgra mi 'dra na'ang bad rnying duXsgra spyir mtshungs pa'i phyir te/dper na/ brda rnying du sra ni tra lhar grags pa yod pas na/ dra sgra dang nye bar gyur nas/ bsres dang 'dres/ bdag gzhan gyi 'brel chags pa dang 1 bra ni lnga ltar grags pas/ ra sgra dang nye ba'i sgo nas/ bris dang ris/ don gcig tu 'jug pa yod song ba/ lha bu 1 'di ribs la brda gsar rnying gi sgra'i khyad par legs par shes dgos/ tha snyad la lar 'bri tshul 'ga' re yod kyang / phal cher ma dag pa ste/ gdam nga can spyir ba nyis ma gtogs med pas rgyugs che ba bris na gzhan gyis go sla 'ing 1 'bri tshul tshad mar byed par phan thogs/brda rnying skor zhig 'gags par gyur pa las/ don mtshon pa'i mthu che ba ma gtogs ma bkol na bzang / sdeb spyor gyi dbang jis byung ba'i 'bri tshul gzhan dag de bzhin bris na bzang ste/ ngag snya na pa ra byed ba 'i legs cha yod 11// // 346

—— dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /sne tshan bcu gsum pa/ ming mang don gcig la 'jug pa ngag gi dpal ba/ming mang bo'i 'jug yul gcig pa las/ /don gang gi zhib cha 'dra min mtshon//gtam smra ba rtsal du gdon pa la//don gcig pa'i ming gis mkhas thab chod—/don 'dra ba'i ming dang / don nye ba'i ming rnams don gcig pa'i ming du 'dus pa yin/ don gcis pa'i ming ni/ brjo da bya'i chos gang rung zhig la ming gnyis nas bcu lhab/ res ston rung ba rnams la zer ba yin/ don cig pa'i ming gi tshogs pa gang mang ngag gi lam du gnas pa ni/ smra ba'i srog gi dbang bo lha bu yin te/ tshig sbyor du tha snyad ma tshang ba med par rab tu phyug pa dang / don gyi zhib cha spu tsam yang ma 'dres par legs par mtshon nus pa'i phyir/ brda sprod pa'i nus pa che chung yang / don gcig pa'i ming gi tshogs pa mnga' btes pa 41nga nyung 'a rag las pa yin/ brjod bya'i chos gcig la ming du ka/ re 'jug rgyu yod pa ni/ zhib cha 'dra min mtshon pa'i sgo nas byung ba ste/ dper na1 me tog sna re'i ngo bo gcig kyang kha dog 'dra mi 'dra du ma yod 346

ming mar dod gcig la 'jug pa bag gi dpa bapa dang / kar bur sprang gsum gyi ro gcig kyang mngar ba'i zhib cha mi 'dra ba lta bu'o/ /don gcig pa'i ming rnam/sa tshig sbyor du 'jug par mkhas na/ smra ba'i dbang 'byor bas/ spyir tshig greng spel ba'i man shel las/ brjod bya'i don rnams spu ris ma 'dres par 'ja' yi kha dog lhar mngon par shar ba'i rtsal thon la/ de yang bye bras tu bshad na/ 'jug yul gcig la ming gi rnam grangs kyi 'jug don gcig pa dang / cung zad mi gcig pa du ma re ston tshul yod do//ming gi rnam grangs kyi 'jug don rnam ba kun tu gcig par snang ba/dper na/ lhan ne dang / lhang nge/ lham me/ lam me rnams kyi 'jug don ni1'od snang gsal ba nyid do/ /kun dang / khyen dang / thams cad dang /mtha' dag dang / ma lus pa dmas kyi bstan bya yod tshad nyid do/ /yin na yang / ming gi rnam grangs du ma don gcig pa gcig rkyang du 'jug pa de 'dra mi mang / ha lam 'ga' zhig gcig tu nge pa shing — 'ga' zhig mi 'dra sa en tsam yod do/ /de lugs gsham gsal gyi dper brjod 'a sa mthong sla—re//ming gi rnam grangs kyi 'jug don zhib tu dpyad na/ mi 'dra sa cung zad yod tshul gtso cher gsham gsal drug snang /dang bo/ chos can gcig kyang ming thogs tshul mi 'dra/dper na/ khyi ra ba dang / rngon pa dang / ling ba dag ni/ ri dwags ba 34

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /yin pas don gcig kyang / ri dwags bda' thabs mi 'dra ste/ sha khyi zad de ri dwags 'dzin par byed pa la khyi ra ba dang / me mda' lta bu 'phangs nas ri dwags gsod par byed pa la rngon pa dang / rnyi btsugs pa 'am mtha' bskor nas ri dwags 'joms par byed pa la ling ba zer ba'i khyad par yod do/ /'dam bag dang / 'ji ba dang / 'jim pa gsum 'dag pa yin pas dod gcig kyang mi 'dra sa yod/ 'dam bag ni sa dang chu 'dres pa'i 'dag pa ste rang byung yin la/ char shul lam du 'dam bag mthug zer ba lha bu dang /'ji ba dang / 'jim pa ni sa dang chu bsres pa'i 'dag pa ste ba'i sa pa yin zhing / 'ji ba cung sla/ rdo thal gyi 'ji ba gyang ngos la byil zer ba lta du dang /'jim pa cung ska/ sku 'dra bzheng ba'i 'jim pa sno zer ba lta bu'o//gnyis pa/ 'jug yul gcig kyang 'du shes 'dzin stangs mi 'dra/dper na/ bza2 ba lto dang 'tshal ma dang / /bzhes pa gsol ba 'tsho tshis dang / /zan dang zas rnams za ma 'o/ /de yang gus pa'i cha nas bzhes pa'am gsol ba zer zhing / smad pa'i cha nas lto zer te/ lto rkyal zhes pa lta bu dang / gces pa'i cha nas 'tsho tshis zer zhing / spyir btang du zas dang / zan dang / bza' ba zer ba dang / rgyun zas la 'tshal ma zer ba lha bu'o/ /yang /'thung ba la bzhes zer na zhe sa dang / 'jongs zer na smad pa dang / zo zer 348

ming mang don gcig la bzug pa ngag gi dpal ba1na spyir btang yin pa lha bu'o//gsum pa/ don gcig kyang 'jug yul gyi khyab che chung mi 'dra/dper na/ zob dang / nor dang / ba 'a nga gsum phyugs rigs gcig yin mod/ zog las nor dang / ba lang / mdzo/ rtol/ mgal bu/ ma te rnams 'dus snang — nor ni rtsid pa dang ldan pa'i gnag phyugs te/ phal mo che gangs ljongs na yod cing / ba lang ni spu kha ser po khyab che/ rong yul du mang / mdzo ni 'bri dang glang pho'am/ g.yag dang ba mo bsdebs pa'i rgyud pa yin/ mdzo mo g.yag dang bsdebs pa'i rgyud la rtol dang / glang pho dang bsdebs pa'i rgyud ma mgal bu zer/ ma te ni dbyar khar chu nang 'dzul dga'/ zhing chu ma'i rmon pa yin/ chu dang / chu bo dang / gtsang po noms rlan zhing gsher ba'i cha nas don gcig kyang / chu ni chu bo dang / gtsang bo/ mtsho/ rdzing bu/ lteng ka brkod ma/ rbab chu sogs kyi spyi ming yin la/ chu bo dang / gtsang bo gnyis ka 'bab chu yin yang / 'bab chu che chung gang rung la chu bo zer chog chu bo chen po kho nar gtsang bo zer ba lta bu'o1/bzhi ba/ bya ba gcig kyang spyod tshul mi 'dra/dper na/ rdung ba dang — rgyas pa dang / gzhus pa dang / sgrun pa rnams pha rol por gnod pa'i sgo nas don 'dra yang / rdeg tshul mi gcig mgo dang /khu tshur dang / rdung byed lag tu bzung nas pha rol por glad pa la rdung zer 349

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung —zhing / lag cha shed kyis phar btang nas pha rol po la 'phog par byed pa la rgyag zer ba/ rta lcag lta bus pha rol po la brab pa la gzhus zer ba/ mtshon chas pha rol po la zug rdu 'byin pa la snun zer ba lha bu'o/ yang / bcings bkyigs bsdam sa mdud dmas kyi don spyi 'dra yang / zhi cha mi gcis 'jug tshul dper na/ ske rags bcings/ lug bkyigs nas bsha'/ ga51ga gi nya bsdam sa/ khug ma'i kha mdud/ lha bu noms kyi bya tshig phan tshun brjes nas 'jug mi rung ste/ rim par dpyad na/ dang bo ni 'jug gzhi'i phyi yi ba yogs lta du mi lhod par byas pa dang / gnyis pa ni 'ju ga gzhi 'ga' zhig phyog sa gcig tu bsgril nas 'gu' mi thub par byas pa dang / gsum sgyu ni 'jug ba/zhi gcig gi tshad gcig gam du ma nas ha cang dom mor byas pa dang / bzhi ba ni 'jug gzhi mnyen cha ldan pa zhig gi kha gcig tu dril bar byas pa lta bu'o/1lnga ba/ bstan bya gcib/ kyang bdag gzhan mi 'dra/mgo btsugs pa dang / mgo tshugs pa dang / mgo zug pa gsum po dbu brnyes pa'i don yin yang / snga ma bdag dang 'brel ba'i bya ba ste/ dpe khang bzheng ba'i mgo btsugs so zer ba lha bu/ byed pa bos dngob su bsgrubs pa yin zhing / bar ma gzhan dang 'grel ba'i bya ba ste/ slob grwa'i mgo tshugs nas lo bcu 'gor zer ba lha bu1 las su bya ba bsgrubs nas grub zin pa yin la/350

ming mang don gcig la 'jug pa ngag gi dpal ba—phyi ma bdag gzhan gang la'ang ma 'brel ba'i bya ba ste/ dpyid mgo zug pa zer ba lha bu/ rang gi ngang gis grub par snang ba yin no/ /de bzhin du/ ji gu bcad pa ni/ bdag ste byed pa'i rtsol ba dang / thi gu chod pa ni/ gzhan te las kyi 'gyur ba dang / thi gu chad ba ni/ bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba med par ngang gis byung ba lha bu'o/1drug pa/ don bskor yang tshig nyams mi 'dra/dper na/ gangs can ljongs su sngon byon lo tsā bas/ /kha ba can gyi 'jig rten mig zu zhing / /bod yul sun ming rig gzhung sgron me sgar/ /bsil ldan smongs 'di'i rtsongs pa'i mun pa sel/ /(dung dkar ba'i snyan ngag)zhes pa las/ gangs ljongs dang / kha ba can dang / bod yul dang /bsil ldan ljongs noms don gcig tu bsko ra kyang / sgra mi gcig pas zlos skyod spangs das/ tshig gi mdzes nyams legs par thon no/ /yang / 'di rigs las tha snyad 'ga' zhig ye nas mtshon don mi gcig kyang / tshig gi spyor ba'i rten 'grel gyis don gcig par gyur pa yang yod pa shes dgos te1mtsho kha'i 'dab brgya lhug par grol/ /spang gi me tog rnam par bkra/ skyed mos tshal gyi yid dga' dgod/ /sos ka'i dpal ni kun tu 'bar/ /zer ba las/grol ba dang 1 bkra ba dang / dgod pa dang / 'bar ba rnams ni me tog bzhad pa'i don bstan pa lha bu'o/ 1tshig mdzes pa 'am/ ngag snyan par byed pa 351

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /la/ don gcig pa'i ming gi rnam grangs 'di la snyan ngag dang / tshig lhug tu ma zad/ gtam dpe dang / dpe chos su'ang shan stobs legs par bskyed thub/ skye don med pa'i dogs pa red1 /za don med pa'i the tshom red1 /ces pa'i tshig gnyis kyi don bskyar kyang / so sor dogs pa dang / the tshom re sbyar nas zlos skyon bsal byung bar shā1 zad/ nom nur bya ba'i dgos pa gtan nas med par nan tan byas so/ /skrag dgos pa'i sdig pa ma bsags na/ /zhed dgos pa'i gshin rje chos rgyal med/ /zer ba las skrag dang / zhed gnyis don gcig kyang sgra mi gcig pa'i stobs kyis/ tshig gi brjod pa bde zhing / don gyi brjid nyams che'o/ /snga 'gras da 'khon/ zhes dang / skya zad sngo rdugs1 zhes pa/thab chung yang me tsha/ ja bsko na da khol/ zer ba'i dpe bzhin/ tsheg nyung mthas don mang mtha' bstan byung / /mgon med skyabs bral dang / gsal ba dkar ba/ zhes pa/ dod gcig pa'i ming gi tshogs pa gnyis sam/ ming gnyis tshig gcig tu sbyar na/ nga snyan par ma zad/ gal bo che la nan tan byed pa'i go yang chod do/ /da ni ming du ma don gcig la 'jug pa'i dpe skor zhig bstan par bya'o//srog chags skye dgu 'gro ba dang / /lus can noms ni sems can no/ /yid gcugs mdza' bshes smon 'drin dang / /362

ming mang dod gcig la 'jug pa ngag gi dpal ba/zun dang grogs rnams snying nye ba'o/ /bla ma slob dpon bshes gnyen dang / /mkhad po rnams ni dge rgan yin/ /slob bu dge phrug gsar bu ba/ /slob gnyer ba rnams slob ma 'o/ /grung bo spyang po g.yer bag can/ /sgrin so grim po sgrim pa bo/ /blo ldan noms ni ris ba can/ /rmongs pa blun po glen pa dang 1 /mgo 'khor 'thom pa ha lam 'dra/ /zho shas 'tsho ba gla mi dang / /gla zan gla ba gcig pa 'o/ /bran dang khol bo bcal lung dang/ /g.yog po rnams ni don 'dra ba'o/ /tshos mkhan tshos ma btso blag mkhan/ /lag nya g.yas ma rkun po ste/ /jag pa ar pa chom po 'o /gtum po ma rungs thub chod can/ / 363

———dag yig rig pa'i gab pa1ba1 ——sdig can rnams ni gdol ba tsā/ / tha cha da tha shal tha mal ba/ /ma rabs rnams ni ngan ma 'o/ /dbu mgo spyi bo yan lag mchog /zhal dang bzhin ras gdong rna mas ngo'o/ /ske mjeng mgu'1 gsum mgrid pa ste/ /pa nga dang phang ba rum rnams 'dra/ 1sku lus phung bo ka/zugs yin zhing / /grod pa lto ba ba/sus pa dang / /kab pa mums ni skabs 'gar mtshungs/ 1tshis dang 'tsho ba so nam ni/ /mi tshe 'byid byed dan du 'jub bru ba cha ba bkros pa dang / /mug dang ltogs pa don gcig go 1ke ba nud pa rid pa dag shed med rkem pa'i don du 'jug /bkram pa 'grim pa 'gyed pa dang / 1sa tong gnang stob ster byin ba'i don1 —364

ming mang dan gcis la 'jug par ga gi dpalabayid zhe rnam shes thugs sems mtshungs nyal slong legs rtogs kun tu rig /kun chub mngon par mkhyen pa dang / /blo gros blo mig rnam dpyod dang / /shes rab mkhyen rab don bcig pa'o/ /rtogs pa go ba khong du chud/ /rig ‘4 mkhyen pa shes pa 'o/ /brtag pa dpyad pa gzhig pa dang / /bgam pa go ba len ba 'o/ /gtam nang skad cha bka' dang gsung / ngag dang bla bo'i don rnams gcis /brjod pa smra ba gdas pa dang /zlo ba gsu nga gleng bla ba dang / /zer ba lab pa bshad pa 'o/ /zon pa 'bod pa skad gtong pe'o —pa kur ba gus pa mos pa dang / /dad pa dang ba zhe sa rnams/ /nye bar bsted pa'i don du 'jug /365

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /ched brjod legs spru bsngags brjod dang / /gzengs bstod dag ni phyogs mtshungs yin/ /kha ngan tshig ngan kha 'ching ba/ /spyo ba smra ngan 'phyar ka dang / /sma 'bebs dmas ni snad pa'i tshig /sgro bskur brgyad bkag log smra dang / /bshe dang 'phya ba smad pa 'o— /khrel dang 'dzem pa mig dman dang /bka yod ngo tsha'i tshul can no/dpral ko can dang gdong tshan can/ /spyi brtol can dang spobs log dang / /khrel med gnong ba med pa'i don/ /da du snyung bro dor bro bor ba/ /mna' bskyal mna' zos don ba cig pa'o/ /gtam 'chal ngag 'khyal bab col dang / /bla brdol dang ni mu cor dang /spyi brdol smra ba don med tshig 1khas 'ches khas blangs phyogs bzung dang / /356

ming mang don gcig la 'jug pa ngag gi dpal ba/g.yar dam rnams 'i dam bca' 'o/ /kha rje bde legs skal ba bzang / /bsod nams bkra shis dge ba'i don —legs pa rmadaXpa bzang ba yin/ /rme bo btsog pa skyugs bro ba'o/ /brnag nus sran thub mi ma rjed pa/ —rkyen thub tshugs thub bzod pa 'o1 1lhogs lcigs nus gsum thub pa ste/ /bsnyel dang de da pa brjed pa 'o/ —brtson pa sgrim pa 'bad pa dang / /'bungs dang brtson 'grus byed pa mtshungs / /snyoms las skyid lug rnam g.yeng dang / /g.yel ba rnams ni le lo'i ming /ngal ba dub pa thang chad pa'o1 /'chungs 'ju ngas sran chos ser sna 'o/ /bden pa yus pa mad pa dang / /nges pa rnams ni kho thag yin/ /zol dang zog dang bcos ma dang / /357

dag yi ga rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung rdzu dang rdzu na rnams don gcig pa'o/ /'drid dang brid dang brngod ba bslu/ /mgo g.yogs mgo skor btang ba 'o/ /g.yo dang sgyu dang khram pa dang / /gya gru can rnams drang mo min/ /dbyed dang phra ma lce gnyis pa/ /dkrub shing rgyag pa'i don yin no/ /som nyi nem nur bzung mo nyug 1yid gnyis the chog dogs pa'i ming / nor ba 'khrul ba 'phyugs pa dang / /'dzol ba 'chol ba'i don rnams 'dra/ /'khrug pa 'dzing ba 'thab pa dang / /tshar gcod dag ni g.yul 'gyed do/ /yib pa skung ba gab pa dang / /g.ya' ba bag zha bag la nyal/ /'chab pa rnams ni sbas pa'o/ /bsgra1 bkums bsad gsum srob bcad pa'o/ /dngangs da jigs nyam nga skyi g.ya' ba/ /358

ming mang don gcig la 'jug pa ngab mi dpal ba1skyi bung bag tsha dpa' zhum pa/ /dpa' bkong 'khum pa skrag pa'o/ /byer ba zhogs pa 'ur ba dang / /'khyus pa rnams ni bros pa'i don/ /sred pa zhen pa gdung ba dang / /brkam pa chags pa rngon can ni/ 1rab tu 'dod pa'i dod yin no/ /zu ngan bdung ba yi mug pa/ /sems 'khra 4 nyon mongs sdub/ bsngal lo/ 1khro ba 'khrub pa mig rus mnan/ /khod dang 'gras dang mnar sems dang /zhe sdang rnams kyi don 'dra ba'o/ /gtses pa nyer 'tshe mtho 'tsham pa/ /brnyas pa dpyas ‘sgyu gzir ba dang / 1gnod pa'am thub tshod byed shā1'o/ /rgyags dang dregs pa khengs pa dang / /snyems dang 'phyar g.yeng nga rgyal lo /brlang po nub po gtum po dang 1 /36 9

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung —mi bzad gdug po 'jigs rung dang / /ma rungs rgod po mi bsrun pa'o1 /btsan gnyan 'jigs ngar drag pa dag /lan rer 'jug pa mtshungs sa yod/ /des pa zhi ba dul ba'i don/ /byams dang snying rje brtse ba mtshungs/ /lhogs bzod pra nus thub pa 'o/ /nges pa rnal ma mad pa dang / /ngo ma rnams ni bden pa 'o/ /rtag pa ther zug brtan pa dang / /gtan dang g.yung drung ka'agyur ba'o/ /mthun pa mnyam pa thun mong ba/ /'dra ba gcig pa mtshungs pa 'o/ /snying bo med pa ya ma brla/ /gsob gsob nam mkha' stong ba 'o/ /sgrib pa 'thibs pa smag rum dang / /rab rib nun pa mi gsal ba'o/ /mdzes sdug yid 'ong yid 'phrog dang / /360
