ming mang dan gcig la 'jug pa ngag gi dpal ba/lha bas mi ngom yag pa 'o/ /ther po rgas pa yun ring ma/ /rnying bar byur pa'i don yin no/ /gsar ba so ma yags ma ni/ /shin tu gzhon pa'i don du bshad/ /skyen pa myur ma lhogs pa'i don/ /dul ba 'gor ba dal ba'o/ /kyog po yon po gcu bo dang / 'chus po sgur bo gug pa dang / /sge sgu rnams ni drang mo min/ /ngos mnyam thang ba phya le ba'o/ /rdzas dang yo byad nor dang rgyu/ /longs spyod zang zing dbyig dang dkor/ /ka ca 'byor ba nom pa yin/ /zong zog tshong tshus btsong bya 'o/ /skugs dang rgyal dang cho lo dang / /sho dang rgyan po brjod bya 'dra/ /dpya dang sho gam khral gyi ming / /361

da yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /phyags dang a krad lham gye ming / /skyes dang la ga khyer zhu rted dang / /'tshams rtags noms ni 'bul ba 'dra/ /ngar ba rje ngar mgul ba dang / /yu ba sdong buXskabs 'gar mtshungs/ /gug dang bu ga dmig bu dang / /har mig i khung khung du 'dra/ /gan dang gam dang drung dang logs1 /glo ngos gzhogs rnams rtseb kyi don1 /sngon ma snga ma thog ma dang 1 /dang bo mgo ma la sogs mtshungs/ /rteng ma phyi ma mtha' ma ni/ /rjes ma'i don du 'jug pa yin/ /song ba dong ba phyin pa dang / /bgrod pa1 brgyud pa 1ra grim pa dang / /byon pa pheb pa gshegs pa dang / /bzhud pa rgyu ba 'gro ba'i don/ /'phya na pa nyul ba yan pa dang / /362

ming mang don gcig la 'jug pa ngag gi dpal ba—'khyam pa 'khyar ba ldom pa 'o/ /bkol dang bkar dang 'gar ba dang / /khol phyung logs su bsal ba'i don/ /spangs pa 'phangs pa btang ba dang / —bor ba bskyur ba dor ba 'o/ /bregs pa gtubs pa dras pa gsum/ /bcad 4'i cha nas 'dra ba yid/ /gsil bkas gses phral bkad bkas gshags/ /phye ba'i cha nas don 'dra 'o/ /bsdus dang btus pa dril ba rnams/ /phyog pad gcig 'jug pa 'i don du 'dra/ /dring dang bltos pa rab las pa/ /brten ba 'i don du 'dra bar mngon/ /'di 'dra'i ming mang don gcig tu/ /'jus pa'i tshul ni rab tu mang / /zhib cha 'dra min shan zu nas/ / shes brjod 'jug gsum mkhas par mdzod/1 //363

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /sne tshan bcu bzhe ba/ ming gcig don mang la 'jug ba mthong ba don gsal/ming gcis don mang 'jug pa las/ /phan tshun 'brel min don shes na//'khrul med rtogs pa'i rig pa brnyes//'chad nyan 'bri klog kun la phan//ming ni don gyi ngo bo tsam sto na par byed pa ste/ ngag gi lam nas bshad na/ sgra don gnyis kyi 'dres ma yin zhing / yi ge'i lam nas bshad da/ sgra gzugs don gsum gyi 'dres ma yin no1 /ming ngo cog las/ ming gcig gis don gcig gam don du ma ston pa'i dbye ba yod la/ don gcig ston pa'i ming ni/ sgra gang zhig gcig gis don gyi ngo bo kho na re ston pa'i ming yin/'di rigs phal cher mi dang / sems can/ rtsi shing 1 rdzas sna/ ri klung / yul gru sogs mtshon pa'i ming yin/ dper na/ srong btsan sgam po/ zhang bo/ seng ge 'brong / khyung / no tso/ stag pa1 dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu/ gser — bul togagangs ti se— rma chu/ mtsho sngon/ lha sa lta bu sogs yin/ de rnams la btags ming dang mngon par brjod pa'i ming yod kyang / yongs grags kyi dngos ming 364

ming gcib don mang ba 'jug pa mthong ba don gas lani bcig min pa med de/ go brda bde blag tu 'phrad pa'i ched du/ don gzhan du 'khrul ba'i cha dmas spangs nas/ de kho na nyid nges par byas bas yin no//don mang ston pa'i ming ni1 sgra rigs 'dra gcig gis rten cing 'brel ba'i don du ma zhig ston pa dang / phan tshun 'brel ba ci yang med pa'i don du ma zhig ston par byed pa yin/ ming gcig rten cing 'brel ba'i don du mar 'jub pa'i mtshan gzhi dper na/ nor zhes pa/ zog ji rigs ba las rtsid pa dang ldan par zer ba dang / gdod mar phyugs las byung thob 'brog pa'i 'tsho rten gtso bo nor yin pas/ rgyu la'ang mor zer ba lha bu don gnyis la 'jug pa dang — brjod pa/ zhes ba bshad pa(de lugs brjod par bya)dang /rtsom(ming tshig brjod pa)dang — klog(sgra drag khyan bar ma'i brjod pa)dang /ngag tu len pa(brjod pa bde ba)ste don bzhi la 'jug pa lca bu sogs so//ming gcig rten cing 'brel ba'i don du mar 'jug pa'i sna nga ba 'di/tha snya da phyug par 'gyur ba'i dge mtshan zhig ste/ des thog ma'i ming blu brjod bya bskyed cing 'jug pa khyab che bar btang ba'i sgo das1 tha snyad 'ga' zhig gas ra du bsnan pa'i go chod pa dang 'dra'o//'di rigs las/ ming gang zhig gi don 'phros nas don ga 'ad ston par 'gyur ba yang yod de/ dper na/ dkar po/ zhes pa/ rtsa ba'i kha dog cig gi ming yin mod / dpe'i sgo nas dngul dang / dge ba'i don la'ang 'jug pa 365

dag yi rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /—dang / nag po/ zhes pa/ yan lag gi kha dag cig gi ming yin mod/ dpe'i sgo nas skyon dang 1 sdig pa 'i don la'ang 'jug pa lha bu sogasaXso//dpe'i sgo nas don mtshon pa'i ming la shan stobs che ste/ tshig sbyor du 'jug mkhas da/ tshig nyams dang don nyams mngon par shar bar ma zad/brjid pa tshig3da mang bo nyid/ ces pa'i go yang chod de/ dper da/ rig gnam gsar brje'i skabs su/ mi dkar po la zhwa nag po bskon pa ha cang mang ngo / /zer ba las/ mi dkar po ni skyod med pa'i mi dang / zhwa nag po ni sgro btags pa'i nyes pa ste/ skabs de'i sbyor ba ngan pa'i mtshang rjen par bstan byung ba lha bu'o/1sgra regs 'dra gcig gis phan tshun 'grel ba med pa'i don du ma ston pa'i ming ni/ dper na/ khol mo/ zhes pa/ g.yog mo dang / spud pa zer ba'i don gnyis la 'jug pa dang / bkar ba1 zhes pa/ so sor zu ba dang / sgron me bsgron pa dang / ras gur 'dra ka ra lta bus yar bkyags pa'i don gsum 'a 'jug pa/ bshar ba/ zhes pa/ gcig rjes bcig mthud nas 'brangs pa dang /tshad la 'jal ba dang — shar bar byas parang / rin bas bdas pa dang / skra gzengs pa'am spu tsub pa'i don lnga la 'jug pa sogs/ ming gcig gis don du ma bstan kyang / ming gang gi sgra gcis pa tsam shā sa/ bstan bya'i don 'ga' bo rten dang brten pa'i grub pa min te/ phan tshud 'brel ba ci yang med do//366

ming gcig don mang la 'du pa mthong bdon gas‘mu——phan tshun 'brel med kyi don du mar 'jug pa'i mib 'di raka / sgragacig pa spyar ba'i sgo nas don gzhan ston rung ba/ dper da/ kha bdangs na glo rig gi zhes pa lab1/ 51 ni sgra rigs 'dra blo la sbyar thog gang gi kha grags ma thag nyan mkhan gyis de'i bsam don shes par 'gyur ba'i don bstan pa lta bu1 bzhad bad kyi nyams thon pa'o//sgra gcig pas phan tshun 'brel ba yod pa dang med pa'i don du ma yang ston rgyu yod de/ rkyang / zhes pa/ gcig pu'i don te mi rkyang rta rkyang lnga bu dang /gzhan dang ma 'dres pa 'i don te jarkyang sta bu dang / rtseg ma med pa'i don te ras lu zar rkyang lha bu gsum 'brel chags pa dang / spu mdob dmar shas che pa la rkyang tsam rje pa dang — nu kha de 'dra'i ri dwags la rkyang zer ba gnyis ‘8brel chags pa dang / rnya bas ha cang bde ba'i don te za rkyang 'thung rkyang / glu shas sa len rkyang red zer ba dang 1 rtsa da kar btso tshu zhi la rkyang ma zer ba gnyis gang la 'ang ma 'brel ba bcas don bdun la 'jub pa/ ru skor ru dar bse ru dang / /rkyen ngan ru 'dzing ru nga dang / —ru rtsi ru skya ru ru rnams / /zhes pa las ru dang bo dang gnyis paX'abrel ba yod 4/ ru bzhi ba dang ‘lngab 'brel ba yo da pa las/ ru gzhan dag phan tshun bka ba ci yang med do// sgra gcig pas phan tshun 'grel ba yod med gang rung gi donaXdu ma sto na pa'i ming 'di rigs btags pa ba'i sgo nas dpe don mtshon par snyan ma 367

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa ngon sgyung/'don thub/ dper na/ zha sbyis nad pa dang / thal lcag sman pa red/ zer ba'i zha byis nad pa ni ngu dga' che ba dang / thal lcas sman pa ni ngu ba tshar gcod pa'i don bstan1 de 'dra'i slob thabs spyir mi 'os shing / lan rer de 'dra'i thabs bkol na/ byis pa ngan lang du mi 'chor bar phan pa yod do/ /dngos ming btags mingaXdu sbyar ba'i thabs 'dis/ tshig nyung la don dril ba/ ro skyangs na bcud che ba zhig go /de ma zad ming 'di rigs dpe'i gzugs su bkod na/ don stonaXpa'i nus pa che zhing / nyams lhang nger mig lam du shar yong / mi yul skyid pa'i gong ba las/ rang yul sdug pa'i cha ga dro/ 'es pa las/ skyid pa'i dper gong ba rtsa ya gzugs su bkod pa dang / sdug pa'i dpe cha ga zad po gzugs su ba chod nas/ gzhan yul skyid kyang song na rdu garang yul sdug kyang bsdad na skyid/ zer ba'i don mthong snang du shar bar byas byung ngo / /gong gsal ming gcig don gcig la 'jug pa'i rigs ni/ klog dag na 'chad nyan 'bri klog kun tu don gzhan dang mi 'khrul bar bde blag tu shes 'gro la/ ming gcib dod mang du 'jug pa'i rigs/ klog dag kyang 'jug yul du ma yod pa'i dbang gis— skabs don ma nges na— ma rtogs log rtog dang the tshom par 'gyur srid pas/ phyi za1'i rigs 'di las nye bar mkho ba skor zhig mdor bsdus tshig gis bstan par bya'o//368

ming gcig don mang la 'jug pa mthong bdon gsal/'daku ni sta zur dku ma rnyongs/ /mchi ma dku zhing dri dku ba/ /phyi bkan nyal nas lag pa bkan/ 1rtsid theg go chod bkun mo zer/ /khral bkal khal bkal skud pa bkal— /zong gi gong bkug gnam ru bkug /bkod pa bzang bas bde la bkod/ /bkod ma gyen du 'phyur ba'i chu'o/ /zur du bkol dang yo byad bkol/ /ska sla ro ska ska rags bcings/ 1'od bkye g.yul bkye ston mo bkye/ /tshon bkye ba dang sprul ba bkye/ /lam du dkri dang skud pas dkri/ /zho dkrogs pa yis rta dkrogs pa/ 1dkar nag rkya thebs rang rkya thub/ /gan rkyal log nas rkyal ba 'dzin/ /chu la nya lhar rkyal bar byed/ /369

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /lkugs pa skugs nas gtam mi shod/ /skud pas lham bzo sgrum yang skud/ /sgro skur yig skur chu la skur/ 1rtsi shing skem pa rid pa'i skem/ /zu bskams rlon pa nyi mar skem/ /skya mi gru skya sbor ba'i skya/ /skya ris skya rengs kha dog skya/ /nyes skyon med pa rta la skyon/ /yar skyes skyes bur legs skyes phul/ /skyogs ra srab skyobs ka kha skyogs/ /'khyur byed sgyur dang ro yi sgyur/ /po'idal du'i khad dang 'gro la khad/ /rgya khab khab skud khab tu bzhes/ /khams di rigs dang rgyu dang dbyings/ /khams gsum mems can sku khams bde/ /kham sa lam gang mdon kham pa/ 1bar gyi khug pa bkug nas khug 1370

ming gcib/ don mang la 'jug pa mthong ba don gsal/khud pa zhes pa skyes rdzongs dang / /shog bu'i khud la zu sman btums/ /khengs shing dregs pa 'khyags nas khengs/ 1'khar ba bzung nas 'khar rnga rdung 1 1'khur ba zos nas khur bo —'khur/ /shes shing 'khums na sa bab/ kyang ‘8khums/ mtha' 'khob grang bas lag pa 'khob/ /khang ba 'khobs yangs sa 'khobs che/ /mkhyud—gang ma khyud spyad dpe mkhyud can /'khyor gang blangs nas gom tshugs 'khyor/ /(āoṃ 'thab rgyu go bas go bgos pa/ /go rim go chod bya go bo— /gung mdzub nyin gung gung bsgrigs pa/ /gos bzang dri mas ma gos pa/ /snye ma'i gra ma shing gra ma1 —gra kha pa ga pa gra ba nyam sa/ /glo snying glo kha sna'i glo da nga / 13 ‘1

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyur glo sgo glo gri glo bur ba/ /grangs kyi dgu dang dgye dgu dang / /yid kyi dgu na skye dgu yod/ /pha ba dgo dgo dgo bas glebs/ /dgung sngon dgung mo dgung lo bgres/ /dgon pa dben sa chos sde dang / /dgon dung zu ngan zang yin no1 /rtsam pa bgam dang tshod bgam pa/ /go cha bgo ba skal ba bgo /spa 'gong ba dang tshad las 'gong / /glog 'gyu rtog pa 'og 'gyu dang / /'gram so 'gram stegs nye ba'i 'gram/ /'gro 'ong 'grul ba'i 'grul rgya grol/ /tshong byed 'gron pos 'gron bu khyer/ /rgod g.yung bying rgod rig pa rgod/ 1bya rgod da nu rgod rta rgod ma/ /rgya gram rgya btab rgya grol ba/ /rgya mdud rgya nag rgya che ba/ /372

ming gcig don mang la 'jug pa mthong ba don bsal1mi rgya bo dang g.yag rgya bo/ /khyi rgya bo yi rgya bo khyad/ /rgyu nor rgyu rkyen rgyu spun dang / /rgyu skar rgyu ma rgyu ba'i lam/ /dmag sgar dgon par sgar yang zer/ /sgar ba zhes pa bla brang ngo / /lcags sgrog lham sgrog sgro gu sgrog /sgrog rus dang ni skad sgrog pa/ /rus sgrom khang sgrom shing gi sgrom/ /mchu sgros bshad sgros rma shul sgros1 /me sgron gdan sgron rgyan kos sgron/ /gsol ja sgron zhing snyan gsan sgron/ /bsgo ba rna gzon na tsha bsgo/ /mgo bsgros rigs bsgres chu la bsgros/ /bsgral ba bskyabs pa bskrad pa dang / /bsad pa'i don du 'jug pa 'o1 /bsgrug pa btu ba nyer tshags dang / /dum bur byed pa'i don du 'jug /373

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung —la dri nga ya nga nyam nga ba/ /lo ma'i ngar ba bu ngar ba/ /me yis sla nga ngar ba dang / /stag mos ngar ba'i skad ni 'jegs/ 1byang gi 'brong ngur bya ngur ba/ /zas kyis ngoms nas dpal rtsal ngoms/ zil dngar tshar du dngar ba dang / /gri dngo no zhing chu dngo brtan/ /dngos shugs brgyud nas dngos po bsagarngo nad 'byung ba rngo mi thogs/ /nor la rngam dang khros 'khrug rngam/ /mthug po'i rngams dang snal rngams ni/ /ka chu 'bab sa'i jim pa 'o /'brid pa'i rngod dang tshod ma rngod/ /sngo skya sngo sman dge ba bsngo/ /rngon pas ri dwags rngon pa 'o/ /374

ming gcig don mang 'a 'jug pa mthong ba don gsalabanye sar gcar dang rdung ba'i gcar/ /sen mos shig gzur mib/ gcar ba /dka' ba'i gnas la gcur ba dang / /'jur mig nang du lcags skud gcur/ /zas bcag gnyid bcag bka' mi gcogardo bcag sman gyis na khu gcog/gcong nad gcong skad bcong rong 'gagagacom bsgyung ba ni nga rgyal gcag/gros gcom nad kyis lus gcom bcag /dam bca' bza' bca' khrims bca' ba//bcud kyi sems can zas kyi bcud/ /snying bo'i bcud dang sa bcud bzang //gshog pa bcum dang lham gyis bcum /lcag gis gzhus dang 'gram lcag ba/zhus//chu lcag brgyab dpad sna khrag bcad/ /skul lcag btang ba re lcag sngo'o /lcam sring lha1 dral gdung lcam mang /376

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung 1zog gi lci ba lci yang lngid/ /lag lcibs tsha lcibs sgo lngibs skyabs/ /khang ba'i rtsog dang ri bo'i lhog /lhog ma me tog mgo lhog ldem/ /zhing brngas shul gyi btsas ma'i lhog /lacha ya cha shas 'gro ba'i cha/ /cha ga gos kyi 'dabs kha 'o/ /chag pa gcig dang chag chag btab/ /dum dur chag pa'i chag po 'o/ /bar chad dus chad chad pa bcad/ /cham ni gzhom bya'i nyes pa dang / /cham 'bebs nyes skyon dgag pa'o/ /chas ni rta zog gso byed dang / 1yo byad dang ni gos rgyan dang / /song ba'i don du 'jug pa 'o/ /chu gos chu zheng gab pa dang / /chu gang zhes pa nus pa dang / /376

ming gcig don mang la 'jug pa mthong ba dod gsalachu ba rgyus ka chu zun ni/ /chu 'chu ba bo chu thag ni/ /shing sta'i gnya' shing sbol byed yin/ /lag tu chud dang khong du chud/ /tshags su chud pa chud mi 'dza'/ /me tog chud po gcig bzung nas/ /bcun nas chun pa'i chun mar byin/ /che chung che zhe che long tsam/ /a che mi gnod che ba brjod/ /rtsis dang mdzad sgo'i cho ga dang / /cho gaXmed ba cho nge 'debs/ /lha chos mi chos dngos po'i chos/ /mchan khung mchan kheb dpung rogs dang / /mchad du gces phrug mam na 'grel legs/ /mchil ba lcags myu bye'u mchi ba1 /mchil lham med la mchil ma btab/ /'phel ba'i mched dang sku mched dang / /skye mched me lce mched pa 'o/ /377

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mdzan jing /'gro 'chag dar 'chag bcag nas 'chag /yi ga 'chu ba shing leb 'chu/ /so yis 'chos pa bcos nas 'chos/ /la'adza' tshon lcags 'ja' 'ja' sa thob/ /khral 'jal tshad 'jal blos 'jal ba/ /mi rigs 'thar dab 'jang—ba/ /bzhos nas 'jo bar dod pa 'jo/ /rdzud lam zur bde sha rtsad pa/—/rkang rjen sha jig rjed thug 'thung / /lha'i — gdong nyag bdang nyag phran mda'/ —spul nyam 4 spung gi nyag /rna bar nyan pa bshad mi nyan/ /sgeg nyams bsta nas nyams dga' ba/ /phyugs kyi g.yang nyams srol bzang nyams/ /bkres pas nyen nas srog nyen che/ /ri dwags gnyan dang gnyan1da dadang / /378

ming gcig danaXmang la 'jug pa mthong ba dan gas —/gnyan po shes pa btsan po'i don/ /sko yi gnya' lhag gnya' rengs pa/ /gnya' ba zhes par par bo 'o/ /gnyen ni nye du gnyen po skyabs/ /nad kyi gnyen po sman lha bu'o/ /snying dang snying bo snying 'phyas btang / /nyung ngur snyung dang snyung bu 'jigs/ /pa'iblo rtse gtad das lag tu gtad/nasgo gtad mdung rtse dgra la gtad/ /gtan 'dun gtan phab sgo gtan pa/ /gtam rgyud gong gtam rdzun ma gtam/ /bcol ba'i gtams dang bkang ba'i gtams/ /ming btabs pa dang thag pas btags/ /snam du btags dang zu btags pa/ /kha btags pa ni bsad tshar ba'o/ /ja khar gtul ma gtul nas 'thung / /za thog smad gtul spos kyis gtul/ /379

dka yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /lag pa yar btegs lam la btegs/ /khongs su gtogs pa se gol gtogs/ /phyung ba'i btod dang kha ton bten/ /de lha bu ni 'di lha ste/ 1lha log lha zhog lha ci smos/ /ltag sgo lhag cher ltag chod smra/ 1 nyes pa'i kung ba lhung ba'i rtsab / /stos bcas re stos mig gis ltos/ /sdong rteng rkab ba'i phyi rteng dang / /tshig gi rteng non rteng sor ba lha/ /rig pa rtul ba gri nul bo/ /rtul phod can gyi rtul zhugs 'chang / /bu ga rtol dang gnas su rtol/ /rtol gog zog gi rigs shig yin/ /stag gzig stag shar stag dong dang — —sha stag me stag shing stag pa/ /brgya stong khong stong zad pa'i stong 1 1stong 'ja ba ni srog skyin tshab1 /380

ming gcig don mang la 'jug pa mthong ba dan gsal/stod snad dang ni sgo stod pa/ /star la bsgyus pa nyam sa su star/ —stes dbang stabs 'grig stes pa legs/ /ston pa sangs rgyas chos ston pa/ /ston ( 'i ba su ston mo 'gyed/ /bor ba'i stor ba stor khung dang / /so stor ba ni so zir ba/ /rgyu stobs yod na med por stobs/ /bsten pa bkur ba'am bsnyen pa dang / /bla mar bsten nas yon tan slob— /dmithag pa zhes pa nges pa ste/ /snying thag pa das zag chod pa/ /thag pa bsgrims nas thag gdang 'then/ 1chags pa'i then par 'as 'phul med/ /tshe sa thags bzang bos thag thags pa/ /ngo thug pa dang thug pa 'thung / /'a ga pas ma reg ma thug zer/ /381

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon rgyung /sgro mo thed nas thed la bor/ /bya rgod thed la rubs nas btogs/ /them skas bem byang skal ba them /btul nas 'thul ba du ba 'thul/ /gshog thogs phur na thogs sa med/ /ral gri thogs da phan thogs yod/ /mtho la tshad dang dpangs mtho ba/ /mtho mtshams mi byed mtho ris 'gro/ /lag mthil lham mthil mthil rtogs pa/ /du 'then gzhas 'chen ring du 'then/ /bsregs shul thal ba tshad 'das thal/ /thig le kor dang sang ki dang / /khu ba dmas la 'jug pa yin/ /sras sros thu bo thu mo dang / /gos kyi thu ba ngan pa'i zu/ /dus kyi thun dang shing thun dang / /thun mong log nas thun gyis zab/ /thor cog gtsug tor thor ba nad/ /332

ming gcig don mang la 'jug pa 1thong ba don gas1so sor thor ba'i thor bu dang / /thor bu thor mo bzhon pa nyan/ /thags 'thag phye mar 'thag pa dang / /sman khu gdus nas sum gnyis 'a zag /kha 'tham so 'tham lag pas 'tham/ /btums nas 'thum dang spubs su 'thum/ —blo 'thums rig pa mi gsal ba'o/ /tsho 'ichos la mi dad chang dad che/ /du ba'i dud pa mgo bo dud/ /skyes du dam pa dam lhod med/ /dam rgya bzhag cing dam bcas pa/ /gos dar rgyal dar dar zhing rgyas/ /dar ma dmas kyis dar ba 'thung/ /ded dpon gyis ni ra lug ded/ /phub ma 'ded mas ded nas spungs/ /dog yangs skud pa'i dog pa dang / /dog mo sa gzhi dog ma mdun/ 1383

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa ran jing don lnga snod drug gnad don dang / /don pa phyi la bud pa 'o/ /dom mkhris nyos das dom mang drud/ /rmon pa dor sdob blar dor gzab/ /lcam dral gos dral khrims dral ba/ /dral bo zhes pa ming bo 'o/ /'dzem med dred po dred mong 'dra/ /drag shos nad drag drag shul che/lnga drug drug mdo drug dkar g.yu/ /sku yi drung du drung yig gnas/ /nyi ma'i drod dang nyams drod len/ /drod chung ba ni mthu zhan pa'o/ /gdam ngag man ngag gdam nga bsal /kha gdangs skad gdangs skun gdangs pa/gdan drangs pa rnam gdan 'dzoms pa/gdan du bsdad nas gdan rabs bshad/nad kyis gdung ba brtse ba'i gdung / /gdung rgyud sku gdung shing gdung ma/ /384

ming — gcig don mang la 'jug pa mthong ba don gas —gdeng thob ral gri klad la gdeng / /nyin mo'i gdugs la ba mi la gdugs 'dzin/ /zhim pa'i bda' dang 'ded pa'i bda'//bden pa bdar dang mdun du bdar/dbur zhing bdar te bdar sha gcod/ /khams bde lag bde 'gro lam bde/ /snyigs ma lnga bdo mi lam bdo/ /gtses shing bdo ba dgra ltar tsub/ /'dag par byed pa'i 'dag ma dang / /zhal zhal bya ba'i 'dag pa 'o/tshang ba'i 'dang dang 'dang rgyag pa/ /'dab ma lo 'dab 'dab gshog dang /tshigs bcad zud la'ang 'dab ma zer /'du shes 'du byed 'du 'dzi dang / /'du 'phrod ces pa tshogs pa 'o/ /'dun ni gshid por skya ngan byed/ /'dun pa re ba'am 'dod pa ste//'dun sa mang bo 'du ba'i gnas/386

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung —'dun ma kha 'phro'i gros tshogs dang / /dga' 'dun dgyes byed tshogs pa 'o/ /bsdums nas 'dum yang kha mi 'dum/ /rtsam 'dur blud nas 'dur zhing rgyug /'do med 'do li rta 'do ba/ /chu gnyis 'dom sa 'dom la 'jal/ /lha 'dre phyogs gcig 'dre sa med/ /gri rdugs zabs rdugs bya ba dka'/ /rdog po gcig la rdog pas ba/ /zhabs rdol sha mo spang la rdol/ 1rig pa klong du rdol ba dang / /mgo chag bla rdol mig chu rdol/ /dri ngad ldang ba mal las ldang / /rlan gyis ldar dang rig pa ldar/ /mchong ba'i ldeng ba 'phur ba'i sding / /zhabs zhum lto ldir sdir sgra grags/ /lde mig re lde me la lde/ /phyir ldog pa dang ldog phyogs dang 1 /386

ming gcig dod mang la 'jug pa mthong ba dod gas —ldog pa tha dad ngo bo gcig /byams sdang lham ngan rkang bar sdang /srog chags sdig pa las dge kyi sdig /mi la ma sdig legs par shod/ /sdug bsngal mdzes sdug sdug gu ma/ / —sdong bo mchod dang sdong grogs mdza'/ /'bu sdom ma gsod sdom pa sung / /sdom gzer skud pas lhan du sdom/ /sdum thab kha mchu sdum pa sla/ /srog dang bsdos nas gzhan nor bsdos/ /oṃ na thang na zla na tsha na/ /'gong nogs bsnogs das nogs par gyur/bsnams nas nom pa nom nyug dang / /nom bu khas bstod nom pa sgyu/ /nongs pa ngo tsha 'gyod pa dang / /nyes pa dag la 'jug pa yin/ /mnog pa 'gong ba ma yin pa/ /387

dag yig rig pa'i da mngon phyung/mnog zung ba ni khe zung ba/ /ngo gnong gnor ba bkur ba ni/ /nyes pa khas mi len ba 'o/ /rnal lam rnal ma rnal du phab/ /kha sna sna khrid sna med dang / /ser sna dang ni sna tshog pa/ /snag tsha sha snag snag gi gnyen / /yid kyi snang ba 'od snang ba/ /bar snang lhar snang yod pa'i snang / /snam bu'i snam pa kha zheng dog /snam phying spyod khang snam logs rgyab/ /sna yis bsnams dang sgyug na bsnams/nu ma brdzun dang mchod gyis brdzun/ /lalag pa'i dpung ba dmag gi dkang / /dpung gnyen bskal ba'i me dpung ngo / /ne ming spong dang dgos med spang / /pham byed spam dang legs pa'i spam/ /388

ming gcig don ma 'a ga pa thong ba dom gsalaphu nu spun dang sgyu spun dang / /'thu shun spun pa bsres pa'i spun/ /bcad lhug spel ma mang du spel/ /bdug pa'i spos dang 'dug sa sros/ /sbyi dang bye brag spyi bo mgo /zang chu lha bur gyi ba zer/ /sprung bo dag ni zang bar song / /rgyan gyis spus pa gces spras byed1 /ri dwags spra yis spru ba btu/ /thal rdub sprug dang ral ba sprug /dga' ba'i spro dang 'od zo ba/ /kro langs pa ni khros par11'od kros pa dang me mda' smos/ 1rgyas par ma spros spros pa dor/ /lha'iri bo'i phag tu phag pa yod/ /phan tshun phan btags phan phun med/ /—chang gi phab dang ma la phab/ /389

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung /phug ron brag phug bu ga phug /dus kyi 'phral phugs rdzun phugs brtol/ /phung bo phung grol phung sum pa/1gtsug phud phyir phud lu gud pa/ /phud du khur cing zas phud drangs/ /mdung 'gog spus dang khang ba phung/ /slog pa'i phur kha gyong nas phur/ /phur bar btags nas phur ma byung / /phul byung phul gang skyes sa phul/ /mda' phog khal bos da pa phog /phyar ba gru btegs da za phyar/ 1ral gri phyar dang gzar dus phyar/ /phyi nang snga phyi phyi bdar dang / /phyi mo khungs dad rtsa ba dang / /mes mo dag la 'jug pa 'o/ /kha bas mig jid 'khangs nas phyid/ /'tsho ba sdug pas tshe ma phyid/ / sun phyung ba dang gnas na4 zung / /390

mi nga gcig don ma nga la 'jug pa mthong ba dan gsal/— phyes nas phyed pa'i zud ka yin/ /phyogs res mi gtsang 'phyags nas phyogs/ /nyi ma shar phyogs blo kha phyogs/ /phru ma zhes pa sha ma dang / /dmag sgar pho zang dag la 'jug /phrag dog bcu phrag phrag par bab/ /'phags ma mchog ni dgung la 'a pags/ /'phang lo 'phang 'khel 'phang mdung 'phen/ /go 'phang dang ni dbu 'phang mtho/ /'phong gi dpong sa 'phong —skyed pa/ /rin gong 'phar chag rtsa lhar 'phar/ /gcan gzan 'phar ba 'phar 'gro sprel/ /da dul 'phongs rta yi 'phongs la zhon/ /'od 'phra 'phro mthud za 'phra bsgyur/ /lag tu 'dod pa lus la 'phrod/ /ba'ibag ma bag yod bag mi tsha/ /bag zan bag chags bag la nyal/ /3༷1

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /—bang mdzod bang rim bang so dang / /rta yi bang mthogs chus mi bang / /'du khang kha bad ba mo'i bad/ /chang gis bad kyang bad kan bslang / /bam chen bam ro sha bam pa/ /bar ba bar chad bar do 'phrang / 1bud med sgor bud bud shing 'thus/ /mkha' la bud 'jib bud kyis 'khyer/na gun ban bun bu lon dun/ /sems med bem po ro'i bem po/ /bem pa zhes pa sbyid pa 'o/ 1nyes pa byang ba lag rtsal byang / /lcags khem bkol nas yu ba byang / /byang phyogs srid du byang ba mang /byan tshogayo bskol nang byan chud/ /dus pa byis pa'o me bus pa/ /dung dkar dus nas rgyang la grags/ /byi la byi ba spu byi ba/ /392

mings cig dod mang la 'jug pa mthob bdon bas 1bying zhing 'thibs pas chu nang bying / /rkang ba'i pyin pa gzhan la byin/ /byin rlabs mnos nas gzi byin chags/ /bye ba'i grangs kyi me tog bye/ /bye zag mang bos bye mar 'khu/ /ma zas khung bu rko bar bra1 /zad mos chu zan gtsab gri brdar/ /sha dri bro zhing bro bor ba/ /bro 'khrab pa dang bla pre brgyangs/ —na bro 'phar nas ngu bro ba/ /bla bo bla ba bla ma dang / /bla 'og bla thabs bla 'gugs pa/ /mtha' bral dbu ma chu'i dbu ba/shedabu smog ces pa mgo 'phang ngo / /dbal ni gri dngo phur ba'i rtse /me drod rnams la 'jug pa 'o/ /dbur tes gos srubs dbur bar bya/ /gnas dben pa na nor gyis dben/ /393

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /khu dbon dgon pa'i dbon po dang / /dbyug pa ma dbyug khyes mi 'brad/ /dbye thang dbye ba so sor dbye/ /dong brus mtshang brus rta ra'i bres/ /thag pas khal bres bla re bres/ /'bag sku ngo 'bag bskon pa dang / /btsog par ma 'bag rgyu nor 'bags/ /mi mo 'ba' nas 'ba' cha za/ /'ba' yig 'ba' zhig dpang du 'dzin/ /chang gis 'bogs nas lung ma 'bogs/ /'bog rwa rta 'bog bcas pa bor/ /sbyangs nas 'byong ba bshal gyis 'byong / /rgyu nor 'byor ba lag tu 'byor/ / —'bri chu 'bri g.yag ri mo 'bri/ /ko 'breng bzhin du 'breng mi 'chad/ /kha zad khye zad zad kyis bcad/ /chun por sbam dang sgam mtho ba/ /mtsham sbyor brda spyor mthun rkyen sbyor/ /394

ming gcig don mang la 'jug pa mthong ba don gas /smo dang sbyi mong sbo dri bro/ / rdza dang gtsang spru byas pa bzang / /'asrid pa'i ma mo lug ma mo/ /phyi mo'i ma mob min mo/ /nu khyud zu bzhi mu mthud pa/ /ltogs jig yi mug mug ba sril/ /'od mog mog dang rta mog mog /dkon min mod dang ma thag mod/ /mod mi dma' ba dpangs mtho ba/ /mos pa dga' ba dran pa dang / /re ba 'dod pa yid ches pha'o/ / kha dog dmar dang dmar khrid dang / /dmar zas la ni dmar dad che/ /dmigs bu dag la nyes dmigasaXmed/ /dmigs pa dmigs yul dmigs bsal bya/ /'dre srin da nu dang dmu chu nad/ /dmu rgod mi srun tsho ba'i dmu/ 1396

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon dang —gnod sbyin zugs 'dzin bying zugs sangs— /srog chag ga migs pa khyi yis skugs/ /che ba bsres dang spya ba dang / /sga'i med dang ni bshad pa ched/ /sma phab gdong gi sna ra dang / /spe ba dgu dang lus kyi smo/ /gtsang sbo med pa smo sha can/ /smin drug min ma 'bras bu min/ /srug po'i ri la sgrug pa 'jibs/ /skyo ba'i smreng dang smra ba'i zer / /tsho'igatsang khang gtsang ba gtsang bo chu/ /spyi gtsug gtsug phud gtsug lag khang / /gal che'i gcigs dang mi 'dzur gtsigs/ /stag gis mche ba gcigs pa 'o/ /gtsub shing me gtsub thal rdul gtsub/ /lcags kyi btsa' dang spyan gyis btsa'/ /me btsa' dang ni phru gu btsa'/ /396

ming gcig don mang la 'a ga ba mthong ba don gas 1 nga — —bor stor btsal ba phyag btsal ba/ /brkus btsugs pa la mdung gis btsugs/ /mi gtsang btsog dang rdo yis ba'i ga /nye ba'i rtsa dang rtsa lag dang / / khungs ma'i rtsa ba rtsa dkar nag /sdong bo'i rtsad pa rtsad gcod pa/ /gyang gi rtsig pa yar la rtsig —thug pa dwabs rtsig ran pa 'thung / /bye mas so gtse gnod cing bka 1sgo'i — — —tshags ma'i tshags da yo tshags su tshud/ /khyim tshang bya tshang grangs ke tshang / /tshangs pa tshangs spyod tshangs ga drang / /drod kyi tshad pa nad tshad pad / ring thung tshad pa tshad mar 'dzin/ /'a sa tshan chu tshan tshan po che1 / tshar gcig tshar gcod tshar bu tsor/ /tshar du dngar dang rdzogs pa'i tshar /397

dag yigs rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung lu gu'i tshar du shing tshar bu/ /kha tshar phun tshang man tshar skyes/ /tshul khrims gnas tshul tshul dang mthun/ /rus rgyud tsho ba sha tsho ba/ /ba po tshon bkra ga tshon bcad/ /khang chen tshoms dang slos gar tshoms/ /lam du re zhig tshoms nas bsdad/ /tshon rtsi tshos dang bkus nas tshos/ /mtshan snyan mtshan ma mtshan mo dang / /rtags kyis mtshan pa mtshan nyid gsal/—/mtshams khrid mtshams sbyor mtshams tshigs 'brel/ /me yis mi 'tshig sems ma 'tshig /bu yug 'tshubs pa sna 'tshubs pa/ /'tshal ma 'tshad dang phyag 'tshal ba/ /cha ma 'tshal ba shes par 'tshal/ /lug 'tsher mo dang rta 'tsher ba/ /'od —'tsher ba dang sems 'tsher ba/ /nor lug 'tsho ba srog 'tsho ba/ / 398

ming gcig don mang la 'jug pa 4—thong ba dan gas 1/'tsho tshis mos pas 'tsho ba skyid/ 1rigs rgyud 'tshob pa mtshon mo 'tshob/ /tsho'ikhon 'dzing sne 'dzing gyen du 'dzing — /lag pas 'dzin dang zhe la 'dzi na/ /pha shul bu 'dzin bdag tu 'dzin/ /kha 'dzem nad 'dzem ngo tsha 'dzem/ /mig gi ji ma rlung gi rdzi/ /rdzi bos bag zu ji bar byed/ /tsho'iwa kha'i chu ni wa mos 'thung / /pha long rna rgyan wal gyis gsal/ /oṃrkang lag zha ba bag la zha/ /nyid zhag dang ni tshil gyi zhag /g.yu la rdo zhad 'dres pa dang / /snan la gla rtsi zhad tsam btab/ /mig zhar ba dang zhar zhor dang 1 /399

dab yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyur /zhal ras zhal ka zhal tshos bzhes/ /bshigs nas zhig dang de ci zhig /bcil nas zhi ba zhi zhing dul/ /zhing khams zhing lngags zhing bregs pa/ /re ba zhu ba drod kyis zhu/ /zhugs ni me dang rjes su zhugs/ /'jigs pa'i zhum dang ngu ba'i zhum/ /zhed po bu ngar zhed pa skrag /zhen chags chang la zhen pa log /rtsa ba blo la zhed par bya/ /'o zho zho bcu srang gang yin/ /zhogs par lug khyu zhogs shing byer/ /gzha' tshon yib pa'i gzha' ba dang / /rma kha sos dka' gzha' ba zer/ /gzhar yang nam yang skra gzhar ba/ /rig gang srid gzhung sman gzhung dang / /yid gzhung gzhung lugs las ka'i gzhung / /bsam gzhug mngag gzhug nang du gzhug /400

ming gcig don mang la 'jug pa mthong ba don gsa'—'tsho zhing gzhes pa bzhugs pa'i gzhes / —me bzhil ba bzhin nyon mongs bzhil/ /mda' gzhu dang ni lcag gis gzhu/ /gzhen skul dang ni me —ka gzhed/ /gnas su bzhag dang dang khrol bzhab /'dab chags bzhad dang me tog bzhad/ /dgod pa'i zhe sa bzhad pa 'o/ /lang ba'i bzheng dang bslang ba'i bzheng / /slob khang bzhengs nas mgur ma bzhengs/ /ji lha ji bzhin bzhin 'dzum pa/ /bza' btung bzhes shing khur du bzhes/ /laza ma mo yis za ma za/ /sgo lcags zag dang mar la zag /dar zab zab brlang gting zab pa/ /zam kha 'gro ba zam miXchad/ /zug zu che ba'i khyi mo zug / dpyid mgo zug nas 'dam la zug /401

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /bzung nas zin pa shes zin pa/ /bya ze phag ze me tog ze/ /zur pa zur za gzur nas zur/ /gra ma nyams pa zur ma chag /sngo sman zor ba zor bas 'breg /sga zor yang ba gtor zor 'phen/ /ri rtse'i zom dang zo ba'i zom/ /lham rigs zon pa nyen zon pa/ /rdzum bu'i zu dang sgo lcags za/ /rin chen gzi dang gzi mdangs chags/ /bab col skyabar gzu lum zer/ /gzu bas gzu bshad sgyud thag bcad/ /gza' skar bza' ro gza' phog pa/ /gzar stan g.yang gzar bkal ba'i gzar/gzungs sngags gzungs btab mi brjed gzungs/ /gzengs su bsted pa spu gzengs pa/ /lag pa gzed pa phrag la gzed/ /sdod kyi gzeb dang gur gyi gzeb/ /402

ming gcig don mang la 'jug pa mthong ba dan gsalagazod ma'i dus dang da gzod dang / /bza' btung na bza' bza' tshang skyid/ /la 'o na 'o brgyal 'o dod 'bod/ /'ur rdo 'ur sgra 'ur langs pa/ /'ol tshod 'ol ka bya 'ol ba/ /'or nad 'or cig 'or che ba/ /lha'i yan chad yan lag yan gar ba/ /zog yan rgya yan yan par btang / /pho long brgyab da yar la yar/ /dkar me'i 'od yal rgyu yal ba/ /yur ma yur ba gnyid yur ba/ /chu rka la yang yur ba zer /mig yor tho yor yor yor po /sgo yi yol ba dus yol ba1 /ngos gzab g.yang dang phywa g.yang dang / /phyugs g.yang rgyas par kha g.yang bos/ /403

dag yi rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung —g.yam la rgyug dang rdo g.yam pa/ /lcags g.ya' nam mkha'i g.ya' dag pa/ /'brum pa'i g.ya' ba skyi g.ya' ba/ /g.yar ni spyan dang g.yar nas bkol/ /g.yung drung rbod g.yung g.yung za ba/ /sems ma g.yeng bar chu kha g.yeng/ /gon pa bkrus nas nyi mar —g.yeng / /g.yer kha rgod g.yer g.yer bag can / /rnam yengs brjed pa rnams la 'jug /g.yo sgro/ g.yo bskol sgro snying g.yo ba/ /lar gad rag dang mdog rag rag /kham du rag sha ras las pa /nga rang yi rang rang ga ba/ /rgyas bsdus ran pa dus ran pa/ /rtswa ran pa dang rab 'bring dang / /chu bo rgal rab rab tu bde/ / rangs1 pa dga' dang rilaXbo'i don/ /404

ming gcig dad mang la ba ——dpe ris phyogs ris ris su bor/ /rum la bu chags rum la ru ma/ /bro ba'i ro dang ro gcig pa1 1ro stod ro smad shi bo'i ro/ /za ro dad ro ro tsa gso/ /bza' btung rol ba gar la rol/ /rol du khrid nas pha rol phyin/ /rlan gyi rlon pa ma tshos rlon/ /rang sems bden rlom nga rgyalaXrlom/ /lalan gsum dris kyang lan ma thob/ /skyon gyis lan nas lan chags byung / /lam lugs bzang bo'i lam du 'gro— /las ka las na las 'bras bzang — /bzhu lugs ji bzhin lugs su blugs/ /lud pa lu ba kha nas lud/ /bka' lung ri lung sa lung dang — /lus po rjes lus rtsom gyi lus/ /405

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /bzlogs nas log pa phyir log pa1 /khe log tshong log rdo log log /nye sa'i logs dang logs su dgar/ /long ba dag la'ang khom long med/ /longs su spyad nas tshad longs pa/ /lag tu lon ba lo brgya lon/ /lha'iri dwags sha ba shing sha ba/ /tshig mtha'i shad dang shad sbyangs dang / /shad kyis shad pa shad shad mo/ /lo gsum can gyi zog gi ming / /shan spyar shan 'byed shan zhugs pa/ /dngul gyis shad pa shan stobs che/ /gru shan sha las shan pa zer/ /shing thog shing shing za tshul med/ /stobs shugs rang shugs dngos sam shugs1 /pags pa bshus dang bshus nas bris/ / mi ngan gshags dga' shing gshags pa/ 1406

ming gcig don mang la 'jug pa mthong ba don bas 1—tshwa rdog zhib dur brdungs nas gshags/ /skra ni bshad cing gtam ni bshad/ /zhing sa gshin pa mnyes shing gshin/ 1song ba'i gshegs dang shi ba'i gshegs/ /rlan zhing gsher ba rtsod cing gsher/ /sgang gshong spubs gshong khron pa gshong / /ngo gshang gshang ba ku re'i tshig /lam gyi bshul dang rgyab kyi bshul/ /mig skum can la bshul chabs zer/ /zas kyi bshos dang 'khris spyor bshos/ /bshol zla phyi bshol chibs las bsho'1/ /lha'iganyid sad nyams sad ba mo'i sad/ /sun snang skyes nas sun phyung ba1 —se'u bcu can gyis se'u za/ /zhing gi ser srung ser ba 'dag /ser kha gas shing ngo mdog ser/ /ser snas ma ser bcud kyis 'tsho/ /zhe07

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /sor mo sgyu ra chud sor bzhag pa/ /sel 'jug rkyen sel 'dem zhing se la/ /sa pon rtse na dang pha mthar son/ /—gro nas sgyu bas gsos nas so/ /sos ka zu/—da sos sos dal ba/ /mi mthub srab dang srab kyis skyog /chos srid snang srid srid na dkon/ —yang srid ji srid dpe la srid/ /'bu srin sna srin srin bya dang / /'o ma sru sgyus shig gos srubs btsem— /lus sru' bo dang pags pa srul/ /mdog sre bo dang mnyam du sre/ 1gsos nas sro babs sro sgrim pa/ /shig gi rdo ste mang me la sro1 /me la sbob/ pa bya sreg pa/ /rmos shu' srol dang lam srol bzang // //408

zhe tshig rna ba'i bcud— —dasde tshan bco lnga ba/ zhe tshig ra ba'i bcud len/zhe tshig sprang char zil ma yis//yid kyi dga' tshal rgyas par byed//ya rabs srol gyi dri bsungaX'athulami chos gtsang ma'i dge mtshan shar//sgra ni brjod 'dod rjes 'brangs te/ kha gdangs na glo rig zer ba bzhin/ /byams sdang ngag gi lam du mchis/ /dga' sdug tshig bi zur na yod/ /gtam smra ba ni/ brda sprod pa yin/ brda sprad yul la 'du shes ji 'dra 'changs pa/ ngag gi sbyor ba las don nyams dang tshig nyams gsal mi gsal ci rigs shig 'dres yod/ zhe sa dang sbyar nas tshig 'jam par smra ba'i— gong du bkur 'os pa rnams la gus pa'i mchog byin pa dang / rang nyid dma' sar bzung ba'i sgo nas/ 'chad nyan phan tshun gyi 'bre'1 ba rje nye dang ji dam du gtong thabs gal chen zhig yin/ mi rigs gang gi skad du'ang zhe tshig 'jug pa mang — zhe tshig mang tshod ni bod skad kyi yan med/ bod skad du zhe tshig sa khyab rdo khyab tu bkol bzhid yod pas na/ zhe tshig bod skadaXdu go sa gal chen zhig zin yod la/ bod skad kyi khyad chos mngon par gsal ba zhig kyang yin no//409

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung /don tshan dang bo/ bod skad du zhe tshig de 'dra mang bo yod don/de lugs mdor bstan na/ zhe sar sbyar ba'i ming byung snga ba dang / bod mi rigs kyi brtse dung legs par mtshon pa dang / ya rabs kyi gus srol khrims kyis bskyangs pa dang / zhe tshig gi mtshon stobs rab tu che ba'i phyir yin/ de yang rgyas par bshad na/dang bo/ zhe sar sbyar ba'i ming byung snga ba/bka' thang sde lnga las/ spur rgyal gong du mnga' mdzad drug tu byung/ /dang bo gnod sbyin nag pos dbang byas te/ /yul ming bdud yul kha rag mgo dgur btags/ /snga rtags gnyen po btsan pa de nas byung / /de nas bdud dang srin mos dbang byas te/ /ming yang lha srin gnyis kyi yul du btags/ /snga rtags sha za gdong ba dmar ba byung / /de nas klu dang btsan gyis dbang byas te/ /yul gyi ming la bod khams gling dgur btags/ /snga rtags dkar bu chu la spyod pa byung / /de nas ma sangs spun dgus dbang byas te/ /yul ming bod khams g.ya' drug bya bar btags/ /snga rtags mda' mdung mtshon cha de nas byung / /de nas za rams skyes drub dbang byas te/ /yul ming stong sde bco brgyad bya bar btags/ /snga rtags rta zhon rna cha 'dogs pa byung / /de nas rgyal phran bcu gnyis dbang byas te/ /yul gyi ming 410

zhe tshig da ba'i bcud che1na/ni su kha brgyad du btags/ /snga rtags phyag dang zhe sa de nas byung / /gzhug tu spur rgyal btsan pos dbang byas te/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ spur rgyal gnya' khri btsan po'i gong rol na/ bod kyi spyi tshogs su phyag dang zhe sa byung yod pa gsal/de yang / bskal ba ya thog mi'i 'gro ba ni/ phal cher ri dgas spra dang spre'u 'dra ba/ 'tsho ba rang byung gi bza' btung la bsten pa yin/ rang srog 'tsho ba'i ched du/ sems can gzhan dang mi 'dra bar yo byad bzos nas bkol shes pa'i sgo nas/ rig pa rim gyis dar nas phan tshun go brda sprod pa'i skad cha yang bshad shes par gyur nas/ mi'i 'jig rten 'chags byung /de rjes bdag gir 'dzin pa'i lam lugs byung thog rkyen sna tshogs kyi dbang gis/ rus rgyud tsho ba du ma re rgyal phran so so rer grub par/ mi rnams las dbang cha che chung dang / go sa mtho dman dang / yon tan mchog dman sogs kyi khyad par gsal song / spyi tshogs kyi 'brel ba las rang 'a sa mtho bar bkur ba dang / rang las dman par byams pa dang — rang dang mnyam par 'cham pa dang / tshang ma 'grig mthun yong ba bcas kyi mi chos bzang bo spel ba'i dgos dbang gis/ tshig sbyor byed kyi ming dkyus ma tsam gyis 'du shes mtshon pa'i nus pa de 'dra mi 'thon pas/ zhe sa'i mingaXmang ba zhig rang shugs su byung ba yin no//411

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /gnyis pa/ bod mi rigs kyi brtse dung legs par mtshon pa/gangs can bod ni shes rig rnam par bkra ba'i mi rigs shig yin te/mi rnams gzhung drang zhing rgyud 'jam pa/ blo dkar zhing tshig thog tu 'dug pa/ya rabs kyi sro—za bskyed cing dge ba'i las la gzhol ba/ bdag gzhan mnyam brje/ skyid kyi bag lo mnyam za/ sdug gi khur bo mnyam 'khur/ go gnas dang /yon tan dang / mi thog dang / lo la sogs pas che ba dmas la gong du bkur ba/ med mug chad gsum gyi sdug bsngal myong ba rnams la gtong phod che ba1rgas 'khogs zha bo dwa phrug lha du dmas la byam sa dang brtse bas skyong ba la sogs pa'i bsam pa bzang bo'i 'du shes 'di rnams legs par mtshon ched/ rjod byed tshig tu zhe sa phun sum tshogs pa byung ba red/gsum pa/ ya rabs kyi gus srol khrims kyis bskyangs pa/rgyal bo srong btsan sgam po mchog gis lha chos dang mi chos kyi srol bzang bo btsugs/ lha chos dgeb bcu las/ bden par smra ba/ phra ma mi byed pa/tshig 'jam par khra ba/ ngag mi 'chal ba— zhes pa bzhi'i snying bo zhe sa yin la/mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi khrims las/ lha dkon mchon gsum la mos gus bskyed pa dang / dam pa'i chos btsal zhing bsgrub pa/ pha ma la drin lan 'jal ba dang / rgan par bkur ste che ba dang / yon tan cad la zhe mthong yod pa dang / yul mi khyim mtshes la phan 'dobs pa dang / ngag 'jam zhing smra ba 412

zhe tshig rna ba'i bcud rked na—nyung ba/ zhes pa'i don tshan drug gi rtsa ba zhe sa la thug yod pa dang / bka' 'gros chen mo drug las kyang / dge bcu sgrub cing mi dge bcu rdo dang / zhes gtan la phab yod pa'i dbang gis/ rjod byed tshig tu bab dang bstan nas/zhe sa sbyar ba ni/ khrims kyis bskyang ba1 par brten nas/ ya rabasaXkyi srol dang —spyi tshogs kyi 'grig lam dam pa zhig tu gyur song / de lugs mi rabs mi thog siXdage ba'i bshes gnyen dam pas/ mi thog mnyam paXdang / gzhug zu1 kun ba lha chos dge ba dang / mi chos gtsang ma rnams dril bsgrags nas rgyud la bag chags bzhag pa yin/ dper na/ rje sta ga phuXbs bya mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod ces bya ba brtsams pa las/ rgan la bzhon gyis bkur ba ni/ /ya rabs skye bo'i srol yin pas/ /rang gzhan rnams la khrems su bca'/ /rang nyid gang du ba nas na yang / /bong ma rnams ni gtsug tu bkur/ /'a1na tshun thad kar mtshungs rnams kyang / /shin tu brtse zhib 'grogs pa1ra bya/ /dman rnams byams pa'i sems kyis skyongs/ /zhes dang / bsod namasaXtshogs chen rdzogs pa la/ /byams pa lha du'i dge pa med/ —ces gsungs pa lnga bu'o//bzhi ba/ zhe tshig gi mtshon stobs rab tu che ba/sangs rgyas dang lha rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa'am/ skyabs 'jug zhu ba dang / rang las che ba rnams la bkur ste byed pa'am/ bka' drin zhu ba'am/drin gzo ba dang / rang dang mnyam pa rnams la dga'aXb skyed nga1'am/ re ba 413

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /'jog pa dang / rang las dman pa dmas la gces par 'dzin pa dang /mtha' na/ dgra la dma' 'bebs pa'am/ zur za byed pa sogs la/ zhe sa gang 'tshams sbyar na/ tshig nyams dang don nyams phun sum tshogs pa zhig ston thub/ da ni zhe sa'i 'jug yul dang mtshon stobs dper brjod la brten nas dkyus gcig tu cung zad bshad na— /1 sangs rgyas dang lha rnams la zhe sa sbyar tshul/ bya mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod las/ bslu med dkon mchog rin ched rnam gsum lags/ /las —ngan bdag gi smon lam dpang bo ru/ /gshegs shig brtse bas dgongs pa'i dus la bab/ /kye ma kyi hud bslu med dkon mchog gsum/ /snying med bdag la cung zad mi gzigs sam/ /chos kyi nyi ma rgyal bo dgung du gshegs/ /——— — —gser bzang pad mo mya ngan sad kyis bcom/ /zhes pa sogs zhus pa ste/ rgyal du'i 'gro don mi la med par bya dang ri dwags la yod ces gsungs par nyan nas/ btsun mo gser bzang mas de'i gzugs rnyed du re nas/ nags khrod stug po kun tu mtshan nas bos shing btsal te/ dka' sdug nyen gsum gyis 'chi la khad par re ba chad nas/ rang lus dor te tshe rabs phyi mar rgyal bu dang mjal bar smon lam btab pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la shin tu dad pa'i re ba bcol lo/ /lha bu'o//2 rang las che ba rnams la zhe sa sbyar tshul/ zhal ras gsal la rang ——414

zhe tshig da ba'i bcud 'inamadangs gang ba bzang / /gdams ngag zab la ma chad ba dad rang / /las ngan bag chags thams cad bsal mdzad pa/ /'phags pa mdzad ma yang dag —dam pa lags//zhes gsungs pa 'di zhe sar ma sbyar na don rgya cha nas rgyal ——bo la gus nyams dang / tshig gi cha nas nga ro drang ba kho nas sho ma ka re grub pa'i mdzes nyams thon dka'o//ldong gi ma yig lung gtam las/ thugs klong she' dkar shā long la/ /— ——rnam rig dri med 'od dkar bkra/ /gsung dbyangs ka la ping ka la//'gag —— —— med grags stong chos kyis phyug /sku lus g.yo med ri rgya la/ /mdzes sdug ——dbyar gyi dpal yon rgyas//yon tan mkhyen ra gter mdzod 'a /me long lha —bu'i rang mdangs shar//zin las drag po'i thog mda' 'a//dgra dpung zag dmar gzhom la mkhas/ zhes khring seng chen rgyal bo'i sku gsung thugs gsum gyi yon tan dang /dpa' mdzangs mnyam 'dzoms kyi mthu stobs bcas la zhe sa sbyar nas bsngags pa'i rtsal gyis/ tshig don gnyis kar nyams phun tshogs pa zhig shar snang /bya mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod du/yab dang ming ngol gsol ba/ /— —lha mchog yab sras bdag la dgongs//khrim ni nyes pa kun gyis gnas//gdug ———— ——can sprul gyi tshang dang mtshungs//de yi bdebs tshim pa yang / /sprul gdug gdengs ka'i grib bsil 'dra de bas bdag la brtser dgongs na//bdag 46

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /ni nges par 'byung bar 'dod/ /ces pa las/ du mo ma ti ma snas lha chos byed par dga' zhing / gnas la mi 'gro ba'i re ba yab rgyal bo dang ming bo la nan gyis zhu ba las/ zhe sa bla na med pa sbyar ba ni/ gcig tu/ yab dang ming bor sku drin che ba shes tshul bstan nas dga' sna nga bskyed pa dang / gnyis su/thugs rjes gzigs shing rjes su gnang ba'i re ba che tshul mngon par bstan byung /pad ma'i tshal gyi glos gar du/ de bas 'dod 'byung nor bu dpag bsam shing / dang bo dam pa'i mgon di brtag cing bsten/ /tha ma dgongs — ——spyod bslab cing thugs yid bsre/ /skal bzang de 'dra bdud kyi dbang mi ——— 'gro/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang rnyed par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa las/— ———thugs yid bsre/ zhes thugs yid gnyis kyi ngo bo gcig kyang / zhe sa yin min gyi cha nas bkur bya'i yul dang bkur ba bo so sor zud cing / bla ma'i thugs dang slob ma'i yid chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa'i ngang tshul mngon par bstan byung /brjid pa tshig bsdu mang bo nyid/ ces pa'i ngag rtsal thon snang ngo //3 rang dang mnyam pa rnams la zhe sa sbyar tshul/ pad ma'i tshal gyi zlos gar las1 kye kye yid dbang snying sdug gzhon pa/ /dang bo 'grogs nas da lta'i bar du/ /brtse ba'i 'dzum gyis bskyangs pa'i zhal mdzes/ /gnag pa'i khro —gnyer bsdus pa mi dran/ /byams pa'i gsung gis bskyangs pa'i ngag snyan/ /416

zhe tshig rna ba'i bcud 'i1na/khros pa'i bka' bkyon gnangs pa mi dran1 /brtse ba'i thugs kyas 'grogs pa'i ngang de zang /— /khrel med byi byeg bstung ba mi dran/ /zhes par/ bud med gcig gis rang gi yid bzhin nor bu 'dra ba'i khyo bo tsheXlas 'das par/ zu ngan gyis gdungs sheng rab tu dran pa'i ngang nas/ gang nyid bzhugs pa'i ring la/ rang la bsam pa rnam dag dang / 'dun pa rtse gcig bzung zhing /byams dang brtse bas sgo kun nas bskyangs pa'i ngang tshulaXsogs/ sha bshad rgyu bshad du bkur gzo bla na med pa mngon sum du snang zhing / 'jig rten na de lta bu'i khyo bo mi 'dra ba rab tu dkon pa'i snang ba sharaXba'i 'a1shā1 nas skyo nyams dang gus nyams cig car bstan byung ngo //4rang las dman par zhe sa sbyar tshul/ rgyal gu dri med kun ldan gyi rnam thar du/ rgyal bu shin tu dgyes te/ pho brang gi sgor phebs nas/ bram ze la smras pa/ kye ma grogs po khyod ni zag ring lam nas 'ongs/ /la lung che1nga bo myur du brgal ba la1 /thang chad sku ni ngal bar ma gyur tam— /gang 'dod —bka' de myur du rgyu cig ang / /khyod kyi 'dod pa bdag gis bsgub lags — — ———so/ /zhes gsungs pa la/ rgyal bu dbang go sa mtho yang 1 sbyin pa bslang du 'ongs pa'i bram ze rgan po phal ba zhig la/ zhe sa'i tshig gis 'tshams 'dri byas pa las/ dbul po rnams la byams dang brtse ba'i snying rje bstan byung /snang sa 'od 'bum gyi rnam thar las/ yab yum shin tu dgyes te/ bu mo 417

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngod sgyung de'i sku gsung thugs gsum la bstod pa 'di ltar phul lo/ /khrom chen lha mi tshogs pa'i rgyan gcig ma/ /bu mo snang sa 'od 'bum tshur la gson/ / nga mthong ba tsam gyis mig la dag— ster ba'i/ /ba/zugs mdzes lha mo'i sku 'a1 —bdag bstod do/ /zhes par/ bu mo rab tu mdzangs shing mdzes pas/ lha mo zhig yin pa'i snang ba shar nas/ zhe sa sbyar te bstod pas/ rmad byung gi nyams legs par mtshon byung ngo //5 brjod bya'i che chung yod par zhe sa 'jub/ min gyi sbyar tshul/ rta rgyugs dpyid kyi nyi ma las/ rje bla ma mchod pas mnyes pa dang / /gong dpon po nor gyis dgyes pa dang / /gnyen nye 'brel ston mos mgu ba dang / /sdug sprang po ————sbyin pas dga' ba dang / /khrom mi dmangs yid smon dgos pa zhig /lar gtong phod med na phyug po min/ /zhes pa las/ mnyes pa/ dgyes pa/ mgu ba/dga' ba rnams don ga cig kyang / snga ma gnyis kyis skyes bu chen bo mtshon pa dang / phyi ma gnyis kyis skye bo phal ba mtshon par ma zad/ sgra bskyar ba'i skyon bsal nas/ ngag snyan par gyur song /6 lan rer rang la'ang zhe sa 'jug chog mi la ras pa'i rnam zar las/sngar yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan bzhugs pa'i tshe/ mi drag zhan kun nged kyi zhal 'dzum dkar nag la blta ba yin te1 phyis nor yod rgyal bo'i tshul du —song nas / a khu dang a ne'i zhal 'dzum dkar nag ba lha dgos pa byung / zhes 418

zhe tshib rna ba'i bcud che na—nga pa las— zhal 'dzum dkar nag ces pa mi 'a1'i sa ma rang la bcug don/ khyo phyug chung ma grung / bal 'jam snam bu legs/ zer ba'i dpe bzhin/ mi la'i pha bzhugs dus/ rgyu stobs che bas/ mi rnams kyis rang la'ang gong du bkur ba dang / khyo bo 'das rjes/ khyo bo'i nu bo tshang gis rang rgyu blogs nas byug por byur tshe/— mi rnams kyis de ba tshang la'ang gus pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan pa mtshon pa'i sgo nas/ spyi tshogs su phyug po rgyu can gyi rgyu la lta ba dang / btsad po ngo can gyi ngo la lha ba'i gcam bu mthun 'jug kha gsag ngo srung gi srol ngan par sun sgyung ngo //7 dgra la'ang zhe sa 'jug tshul yod/ lho gling g.yul 'gyed las / da reb zug pa'i gro bo skya/ /spyi dpon zer ba ngo zhig shes/ /ma 'dug ma 'dug gdong la bud/ /nyag phran mda' yi mjal dar yod/ /khra ring mdung gi bsu ma yod/ /no chen mtshon gyi skye ma yod / / ga 'a do e bsam sping gi du1 /zhes pa las zhe sa sbyar ba/ bstod pa'i zol gyis smad pa dang / gshin rje'i 'dzum gyis gsad par bya ba'i 'jigs snang bskur ba'o//don tshan gnyis pa/ zhe sa'i ming gi grub lugs/gtam mam rtsom du zhe tshig 'jug dgos sa zhe tshig sbyar na legs te/ mi la che chung dang / las la rgyu 'bras yod pa'i phyir dang / gzhan la bkur ba rang bkur yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhe tshig gi sgrub byed zhe sa'i ming yin pas/ zhe 419

dag yig rig pa'i gas pa ma ldan phyungasa'i ming gi grub lugs shes na/ zhe tshib gi sbyor ba la thogs pa med 'gro/'dir 'e sa'i ming mi grub lugs spyi khog tsam zhig bstan par bya'o//rjed par bya ba'i yul la rje sa dang/ brjod bde ba'i dbang sgas zhe sa ches grags/ zhe sa'i ming byung snga bas/ 'dod rgyal ba ha cang mang zhing / de la brten nas rjes grub kyi ming gi zhe sa yang lhag par mang ba zhig byung snang / de rnams kyi mtshon bya spyir btang dngos po dang / bya ba ci rigs yin pa las/gtso cher lus ngag yid gsum dang / dbang bo lnga dang / bza' btung gon pa sogs dang / de rnams dang 'brel ba'i las dang bya ba la sogs pa yin la/thad kar khyad chos dang / grangs ka'i rigs la 'jug pa med do/ /zhe sa'i ming gi grub lugs/ 'dad rgya' dang / rjes grub dang / ming gi tshogs pa gsum du dril te /dang bo/ 'dod rgyal gyi ming /'dod rgyal gyi ming gi zhe sa'i grub lugs ming dkyus ma dang shan sbyar nas dper na/sgra rkyang ba'i grub lugs/lus ngag yid gsum 6 gsung thugs gsum ste/ /mgo las rkang bar dbu phyag zhabs zhes grags//mig sna rna ba kha ngo lce so la/ /420

zhe tshig da ba'i bcud che1naspyan shang sa snyan zhal zhal ras ljags tshems zer1sto ba zas skom khang ba nye logs gnyid/ /phyal dang bshos skye sa shag dang drung du mnal rje/khyod kho pha ma bu dang bu mo la/ /khyed khong yab yum sras dang sras mo zhe'o//chu dang glu ming gon pa bzhon bya'i rta/ /chab da nga mgur mtshan na bza' bcib pa 'o1lha bu sogs dab 1 ming mtha' sbyar ba//me che lcam cho sbrum ma phyal mo dang / /bla sprul dag gi chung mar rig ma zer//khyo shug stangs dpyal phu nu gcen gcung dang 1 /dpon phrug snang ngu so ba spyan pa zhe'o//lta bu sogs nyung ba las/ phal mo che bya ba'i ming gi zhe sa yin te/skye ba 'khyungs ngam bltam pa bsam pa dgongs/ 1shes pa mkhyen pa dga' ba mnyes sam dgyes//ngal ba mnyel ba na ba 'ing ba dang — /bsad pa bkrongs pa shi ba grongs pa za/1phrad pa mjal lta ba'am mthong ba gzigs — / 2 1

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /byin pa gnang ngam bstsal pa nyan pa gsan//byas ba mdzad pa 'gro 'ong pheb bam bzhud/ /rgas pa bgres pa nyal ba gzim pa dang //lang dang bsgang dang btsugs dang skrun pa bzheng / /gon pa mnab bam klub pa longs spyod bzhes//zhu ba gsol ba 'dod dam khas len bzhed/ /'khyer ba snam pa dbang ba mnga' ba 'o//lta du sogs so/ /gzhan yang / brjod bya gcig pa'i zhe sa'i ming dang dkyus ma'i ming gnyis ngo bo gcig tu sbyar ba/ zhal ngo / sku lus/ gsung bshad1 mjal 'phrad/ lta bu sogs yod kyang / lan rer tshig gi sdeb sbyor du dgos pam gtogs/ 'di 'dra'i sdeb tshul ma spel na bzang ste/ don bskyar ba'i phyir ro//gnyis pa/ rjes grub kyi ming /rjes grub kyi ming gi zhe sa'i grub lugs gsum yod de/1 ming gi cha shas gnyis ka zhe sa yin pa/blo mig mkhyen spyan lag len phyag bzhes dang //'khor g.yog phyag brnyan yang na zham ring zer/mgo 'dren dbu mdzad go 'phang dbu smog mtho//422

zhe tshig rna ba'i bcud len/——kha brda'am yig bskur da ga la bka'aXmachid zer11dkor gnyer phyag mdzod thel tshe phyag dam dang /1kha bshal zhal bsil gcin snod chab tob dang //rkang ba 'khrud byed chu la zhabasaXbasil zer/ /ngo tshab zhal skyin 'bod pa gdan 'dren zhe'o/1lta bu sogs dang /2 sgra rkyang ba'i ming dkyus ma zhe sa'i gzhi dang sbyar ba/skra dang dbu skra zhwa dang dbu zhwa dang / /gzan dang sku gzan 'bagaXdang zhal 'bag mnab//gdung dang sku gdung khrus dang zhal khrus gnang / /tshe dang sku tshe srog dang sku srog brtad//chang dang skyes ma chang ja dang gsol ja bzhes//mal dang gzim mal khri dang bzhugs khri mdzes/—gros dang bka' gros rtsom dang lngags rtsom mdzad//'grel dang dgongs 'grel yi ge phyag yig bris//lha bu sogs dang /ka ming dmyus ma'i cha shas phal ba dor nas za shas gtso bo che sa'i gzhi dang sbyar ba/423

dag yig ris pa'i gab pa mngon snang1mgron po sku mgron mi drag sku dras gis/ /gdung rgyud sku rgyud rim gro sku rim sgrub/ /kha btags phyag btags kha lag zhal lag bzhes1 /dga' ston dgyes ston bsod nams sku gsod che/ /las ka phyag las bsam khur thugs khur dang / /dpeXcha phyag dpe sug bris phyag bris mang 1 /yi dam thugs rten snying rje thugs rje che/ 1bka' drin sku drin lag len phyag len bzang / /lag rjes phyag rjes rkang rjes zhabs rjes gsal/ /byed sgo mdzad sgo las 'phro mdzad 'phro 'thud/ /ske rgyan mgul rgyan rna rgyan snyan rgyan btags/ /nyal thul gzim thul mi lam mnal lam yags//lha bu sogs so//'dir shes dgos pa ni/ 'dod rgyal gyi zhe ming da rjes grub kyi zhe ming gi 'byung byed yin pas 'dod rgyal gyi zhe ming mi nyung ba zhig dkyus ming gang 'tshams dang sbyar na/ rjes grub kyi zhe ming du ma re bskyed thub pa gong gsal gyi dper brjod gyi lam nas zur tsam snang mod/ de lugs gsal byed du/'dir dpe 'ga' bkod na/ gsol ba zhes pas/ gsol dpon/ gsol khang /424

zhe tshig da ba'i bcud —nang bsol ston/ gsol mchod/gsol 'debs/ gsol tshigs gsol chang gsol ja/gsol mar/gsol zhib/gsol mdong/gsol sder/gsol thab/gsol phogs/gsol ras sogs dang /chab ces pa/chu'i cha das/zhal chab/chab tshan/chab khang /chab rkyan/chab drel/chab ril/chab khung/chab gsang/chab gdan sogs dang /yang /zab ces pa/ ming bkyus ma'i ya mthar sbyar na/ zhe ming du 'gyur te/ chab srid/chab 'og chab 'bangs /chab sgo/chab gzan / chab shog sogs dang /gnang ba zhes pas/rjes gnang gnang sbyin/gnang skyes / gnang rten/gdang cha / gnang chen / gdang bkag lha bu sogs rigs bsgre bar bya'o//gsum pa/ ming gi tshogs pa/bya byed las gsum gang la gang 'tsham sbyar na/ zhe sa 'i ming ji tshogs pa'am/zhe tshig tu grub pa/sku bltams mtshan gso' 'khrungs skar dgyes ston mdzad//nga — —nga ——— zhal mjal gsung thos mgur bzhengs bzhabs bro 'cham/—nga ———gzigs su phul ba zha' gyis bzhes shing bstod//———————— ——mdzad sgo dbu brnyes sku mkhar bzhengs pa grub//————nga ——————dgung lo bgres pa sku bsnyungs lha rje bsus/—— —— ———nga —— 426

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung thugs rjes gzigs shing bsnyen bkur spyan chab bsil//— — —nga ——0bab bab bab༅3nga bab ba//khong gi gdams pa thugs la mnga' brnyes pa'o//lha bu so sa le ga sa ba rngo par shes na/ gtam rmam rtsom du zhe sa'i bab dang bstu na nas/ ji lha ba bzhin du spel bar ngag gi dbang 'byor bar 'byur ro////

ming gi rdob spyor mkhas pa'i da rgyan/sna tshan bcu drug ba/ ming gi speb rgyud mkhas ba'i na rgyan/sdeb sbyor rig pa'i mdzod kyi ming ṣka ril mo 'di—/rna ba'i rgyan du re ba'i skal ldan rnam ba la 'khyo 1//snyan dngags sgyu mtsho 'phel ba'i gnyen du bsnyed ma na//blo gros ku nud bzhad pa'i dab1la la4ngag dbang 'byor//sdeb sbyor ni sgra rig pa'i yan lag ngag snyan par byed pa'i rig gnas shig ste/ sgra drag zhan bar ma dang / nga ro mtho dman drang 'khyog sogs ming dang tshig tu gang la gang 'tshad du bsdebs shing sbyar na/ brjod pa bde zhing snyad par grag pa'i ngag gi sgyu rtsal legs par 'don thub/ de phyir sdeb sbyor legs par shes na/ ming gi spyor mtshams tshags dam ba1 dang / ming gi 'bri srol khyad par can gyi go ba len pa dang / dngos po gsar ba gang byung la ming gang 'tsham du gdags pa dang / tshig sbyor du tha snyad gang 'os bdams nas 'jug pa dang / tshigs su bcad par rkang ba yas mas do ba zhing sgra lci yang sdeb legs pa dang 1 lhug pa spel bar tshig gi zla bo cha 'grig cing brjod bde ba sogs la ma rig pa'i mun pa grol bar ma zad— mkhas par smra ba'i 427

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon jing/dbang 'byor ro/1don tshan dang bo/ ming gi sdeb sbyor — dngos su yod tshul/sdeb sbyor shes na tshigs bcad la mi rmongs/ zhes pa lhar/ bod dang rgya dkar nag gi sngon byon mkhas pa rnams kyis brtsams pa'i rdob sbyor gyi gzhung rnams la bltas na/ sdeb sbyor ni snyan dngags kyi grogs su tshigs bcad la 'jug pa tsam du mngon te1 rkang ba so so'i tsheg dbar mang nyung gcig pa dang / cha ya do mnyam pa dang / sgra gdangs lci yang sdeb legs pa dang / nga ro mtho dman drang 'khyog 'gyur bag chags pa dang bcas pa'i rol mo'i snyan cha thon pa'i ngag rtsal de 'dra zhig la zer ro/ /snyan ngag bzang bo zhig yin na1de'i lus kyi la nga tsho rgyas pa dang / srog mi dbang bo brtan pa dang / rgyan gyis dam par mdzes pa'i legs cha gsum 'dzom dgos/ de gsum gyi dang bo ni phyi ma gnyis kyi rten gzhi yin la/ lus kyi lang tsho ste rkang ba'i sdeb sbyor bzang na/brjod pa bde la ngab gi snyan cha thon pa'i sgo nas/ brjod bya gsal zhing snying bos phyug pas/ yid kyi gsos su 'gyur ba dang / rgyan gyi mdzes nyams mngon par shar bas/ lha bas mi ngom par 'gyur la/ de phyir tshigs bcad du sdeb sbyor ni snyan dngags rgya mtshor brgal 'dod rnams kyi gru yin par gsungs so1/428

ming gi sdeb sbyor mkhas pa'i na gyin/— ————'on kyang da snga'i sdeb spyod rig pa smra ba rnams kyis/ sdob spyor bya ba tshigs bcad du ji ltar 'jug pa'i tshul bstan pa ma gtogs/ tshis lhug dngakaming gi sbyor ba dag la dgos pa yod med ye gsungs bdag gis thos chub da bas ma go mod/ sdeb sbyor di ngag gi sgyu rtsal zhig yin pas/ ming tshig brjod pa kun la khyab das yod par sems/ bod skad la gzhigs na/ bod shad kyi khyad chos mtshon byed gtso bo zhig ni sdeb sbyor yin te/ yi ge mib du sbyor ba dang / mingaXrkyang dang ming gi tshogs pa'i sbyor ba dang / tshigs bcad dang tshig lhug gi spyor ba gang dang gang yin par brjod pa bde zhing snyan nga1 zhig mgrub nas yod na/ sdeb sbyor gyi nus pa ran tshod cig thebs ma da pa'i rtags red/ —de yang rjod byed du sdeb sbyor rig pa shes bzhin duXsbyar ba min yang / rang skad soms gshis kyis/ mun nag mda' 'phangs lha'i snyu1na/ /zhar bas rdo rdo 'phangs klu'i mgo /zhes pa 'i dpe ltar/ mo ston phag bso'i stabs ka 'grigs song le red/ — —bod la sdeb sbyor gyi rig pa dar snga yang / blags sprur gyi sdeb sbyor bod skad du 'dra dpe rgyas 'gebs byas pa tsam las/ bod skad kyi khyad chos kun nas mtshon pa'i gzhung lugs shig tu grub nas med kyangaX1 bod skad dar ba'i rgyun las sdeb spyor gyi rig pa zhig rang shugs su chags yod/ 'di lhar bshad pa rang sems bden zla ma yin te1 shes byed bal chen 'ga' zhig yod rga/ 429

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung/gcig ni/ brda zod lung ston pa'i slob dpon thon mi mchog gis mdzad pa'i sum kags kyi rtsa ba las dam par bstan pa'i yi ge'i sbyor bdang / phrad gzhan dbang can gyi thob thang dang / rjes 'jug gi ming ma 'a 'dren tshul sogs ni1 sdeb sbyor gyi rig pas grub par mngon te/ yi ge du ma zhig gcig tu bsdus nas sdeb legs par 'byor ba rnams— don gyi ngo bo ston pa'i ming du grub la/ sdeb sbyor ma 'phrod na/ ming rtsa mi 'grub ste/ ka la dbyangs badzigang yang mi 'thob pa/ sgra ha lam mtshungs shing brjod pa mi gsal ba'i phyir dang / ming gzhi rkyang brtsegs ci rigs dang / 'phul rten yod med ci rigs las/ gang la dbyangs bzhi gang rung zhig sbyar na/ klog mi bde ba rnams kyang ming du mi 'grub bo/ /pha 'a ra la ha ma drug la sngon 'jug mi ba pa/'dogs can ga yis mi 'phul ba/ la mgo can la 'dogs bzhi bral ba/'phul yig rang sder 'jug mi dpe ba/ pho ni ma ning la mi 'jug pa/ mo yang pho la 'jug pa med pa/ ma ning rang la rang mi 'jug pa/ mgo can rnams la sngon 'jug dzwa ma gtogs mi 'thob pa sogs sdeb sbyor mi 'phrod pa'i phyir ro//༅da gzhan dbang can ni/ sgra'i rnam grangs nyung mtha' gsum re dang /mang mtha' bcu gcig re yod pa/ sdeb sbyor gyi ngang gis byung ba yin te/'brel sgra'i 'jug pa dper mtshon na— rjes 'jug rnams las pho yig da ba sa gsum la kyi dang / mo yig nga la gi dang / ma la gyi dang / 'a la 'i'am yi sbyar 430

ming gi sdebasgyur ma bas21'in rgyan/ —————ba ni/ rtags mtshungs drangs pa dang / pho yig ga la gi 11ra ba gnas mtshungs drangs pa dang / ma ning na ra la gsum la gyi sbyar ba ni/ tre/ mtshungs drangs pa yin no1 1'o na rjes 'jug da ba sa gsum la da zhes mi 'jug pa1ra / kyi zhes 'jug don gang zhe na1 da ba sa gsum gyi sgra'i skye gnas rim bzhin so dang /mchu dang /so rtsa'i rkan yin par/ mgrin pa 'a1sa byung ba'i ki sgra skyar na/ skye gnas kyi bar thag rib bas brjod mi bde zhing bzhun cha nyams pa'i phyir dang / mgrin pa dang rtse rtsa ma zad rtse'i rked pa yan chad las byung ba'i kyi sgra sbyar na/ brjod bde zhing snyan cha 'dzoms pa'i phyi ra ri/ 1rjes 'jug no ma ra la bzhi la gyi zo 'jug pa yang / dpe de bzhin sdob sbyor gyiXmachog gyin pa'o1/rjes 'jug gi ming mtha' 'dren tshul las/ rtags mtshungs 'dren pa dang / gnas mtshungs 'dren pa dang / sgra mtshungs 'dren pa gang yang brngod bde bar byed pa ste/ sdeb sbyor gyi bdag nyid yid no/ /'di lugs 'byung 'gyur gyi ming gi sdib sbyor du shes par bgyi'o//gnyis ni1 bad rnying du brjod pa mi bde ba'i ming dang tshig rnams sdeb legs par 'chos pa ji bzhin gtan chags bar gyur pa rab tu zu1nga ste/ ming rkyang la dper na/ gzhug tho la gzhug to zhes pa/ pho yis pho 'i1 ming mtha' drangs pa dang / spyang ki zhes pa sgra drag pos drag pa drangs pa dang /pu ste ka zhes pa'i zur chag ba pu ti ni/ nga ro'i 'phang smad nas gug par bklagasaXn 431

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung —brjod mi bde bas/ po ti zhes nga ro bstod pa nas bkug par bsgyur nas sdeb legs pur byur song / sdug nga 'a la sdug bsngal du grags pa ni/ lce dang phrad na lbi bar 'gyur/ zhes pa lhar grub pa yin/ khung bu dang / du ba ni don 'dra yang / mib gi cha sa shu sbyar na/ sdeb spyor du 'phrod mi 'phrod kyi khyad par yod de— sna khung dang / sna bu'i dang / shang4 bug ce na 'phrod kyang /shangs khung zhe na mi 'phrod nga dang / shag khang brang gsum don 'dra yangaX/ grwa shag lha khab / bla brang ltar sbyar na 'byug kyang 1 grwa brang / lha shag bla khang ltar spyar na mi 'grib pa noms sdeb sbyor nyams pa yin pas/ ming du mi 'grub bo/ /rta zog dang 1 lho nub/ lha bu ni/ sgra drag pa'am lci bas zhan pa'am yab ba drangs pa dang / dbon zhang da lta du che chung gi go rim bzlogs ba dang /wa spya nga / lta du sgra'i skye gnas go rim bzhin sbyar ba/ lha bu rnams brjod pa bde bar byas pa yin/ tshig gi cha shas gtso bo snye/ byed pa dang / las dang / bya ba gsum gyi go rim bsnol nas bya byed las gsum du sbyar ba ni/ bya byed gnyis kyi ming gzhi'i skye gnas gcig pa dab / byed kyi rjes 'jug dang / las kyi ming gzhi'i skye gnas so mchur nye bas/ brjod bde6bar grub bo/ /gtan tshigs rig pa'i sbyor ba 'god tshul la cha shas gsum gyi dang bo phyogs te/rang gis 'grub par 'jug 'dod rmya ba'i ba bya dang / gnyis pa dpe ste/mngod sum gyis mthong ba'i dngos po dpe ru 'jog pa dang / gsum pa rtags 432

ming gi sdebasgyur mkhas pa'i da chen— ————te/ rgyu mtshan yang dag pa bkod par brten nas pha rol po 'a1 dam bcas pa'i don khas len par 'jug pa yin mod/ tshig sna bsdus nas/— rtag4dpe phyogs gsum/ zhes go rim log par sbyad ba ni/ ka shed che chung lhar brjod bde bar byas pa yin no/ /rten gsum la sku gsung thugs rten ltar sbyar ba ni/thi rtsi zhing drag 5 sdo ma dang / lci ba bar ma dang / ran pa mtha' mar bkod nas klog bde bar gyur to/ /stag gzig dom dred/ ces ba1 yang 1 ming mtha' 'dren bdang / sgra shed snyom pa'i srol lhar go rim bsgrigs nas brjod pa thogs pa med song / tshig la dper na/ skyes thob kyi shes rab dang / sbyangs ———stobs kyi yon tan/ zhes pa'i nang gi stobs ni stobs shugs min kyi thob ka'i —— — don yin/ sbyangs thob ce na/ snga ma'i skyes thob dang sgra bskyar bas klog mi bde ba'i rkyen gyis/ gzhan dang 'brel ba'i bya ba thob kyi cheb tu/ bdag dang 'brel ba'i bya ba stobs sbyar ba dang / spyang ki rta gzan/ lug ros mi brgyab—ces pa las/ gzan ni zan te/ bya ba da lha ba za la na mtha' sbyar ba'i zan ni/za ba bo'i don po kyid/ — rta la spyar na sgra yang ches pas / gas 'du 'a spyar das brjod pa bde bar gyur spe lha bu sogs kyis gsal/gsum ni/ dpe rnying rnams las tshig don band chesa'i ba snyad kab zhig brjod mi bde na/ rang skad du chags pa'i sdob spyor gyi srol ltar/ skad kyi gdangs sam/ sgra yi nga ro legs par 'chos pa sa khyab rdo khyab tu mthong ste/433

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon rgyung —sprul ba'i ba bos sdod — bab ba ka—ba 1lda sa/ chos bkyi snye gsar sngas che bas dar skyen la nub skyen/ zhes pa'i gsar sngas ni gsar ngas ——— nga yin yar / sgra snga phyi lci yang mi bdum pas shed mnyam par byas so/ /dbon zhang dbu snyung ba'i no ring gi bka' gcigs las/ snyan pa'i sgra skad ni gnyi zlas slebs so chog tu khyab ste/ zhes pa'i nyi la gas 'phul ba yang / sgra shed bsnyams pa yin/ sgra sbyor bam po gnyis pa las/ 'ol phyir bsgyur du rung —— —yang / don du de lhar yin min gtol med pa rnams la ni/ zhes pa'i 'ol phyi ni 'ol spyi yin rtsod/ rtags mtshungs 'dren pa ‘ltar sbyar pas/ sgra shed kyang mnyam par gyur nas brjod pa rab tu bde song / bstan 'gyur gyi gtsug phud byang chub kyi skyes pa'i rabs las/ me tog dri zhim po sna tshogs kyi bsung gis bsgos pa'i ser bu'i ngad nyams su bde ba ldang ba1 zhes pa'i bser du'i —bser gyi bas 'phul dor ba ni/ bu dang sgra mnyam par byas pa yin/ bstan 'gyur sna tshogs su bzhugs pa'i dpal ldan ka lnga par 'jug pa las/ dgun zla 'bring bo la yang chab brom chags pa med na/ zhes pa'i chab rom la chab —————brom du bris pa/ sgra mtshungs dang gnas mtshungs 'dren pa lhar sbyar ba dang /klong chen snying teg gi sngon 'gro khrid yig las/ ma cig khro ma nag mo gar ——thabs ling ngeXyod pa/ zhes pa'i gar stabs la gar thabs su bris pa/ sgra shed —bsnyams ka rtags mtshungs 'dren pa lhar sbyar ba yin/ gru gu go rdzong las/434

ming gi rdob spyor mkhas pa'i da rgyad— gos chen gser mas g.yogs pa'i tshar slag gyon zhing / zhes nga1 las/ tshar —bu'i slog pa la tshar slag ces na ro dor ba ni/ sgra ga 3sa kyi nga ro gnyis ka drang bar byas nas/ brngod bde bar grub pa lta bu sogs so//brda rnying dang dpe rnying rnams las/ ming dang tshig gi sbyor ba spyir 'grig par snang yang / sgra drag zhan bar ma'am/ nga ro mtho dman drang 'khyog sogs phan tshun mi 'dum par gyur na/ ming mtha' 'dren nga1'am/ sna shed snyom pa'i thabs kyis brjod pa bde bar byed pa ni/ bod rang skad du chags pa'i sdeb sbyor rig pa'i gab pa thog mar phyung ba'i dge mtshan yin no/ /de nas ha lam spyi lo chig stong nyis brgya tshun chad du/ legs sbyar kyi sdeb sbyor bod du dar yang / de'i rig pa bed spyad nas bod skad dang mthun pa'i sdeb sbyor gyi nges srol ma rnyed par/ legs sbyar gyi sdeb spyor bod skad du 'dra dpe rgyas 'gebs kyis bsgribs nas/ bod skad du so na gnas pa'i sdeb sbyor gyi snang ba tsam yang mog par gyur nas/ sdeb sbyor bya ba ming tsam du lus so/ /deng sang gi tha snyad gsar ba phal cher skad rigs gzhan las tshur bsgyur pa yin mod/ mi nyung zhig 'gyur mi dag cing sdeb sbyor nyams pa'i dbang gis/don gyi ngo bo ston pa'i nus pa zhan pa dang / tha na go bdami 'phrod pa'i 'gyur log kyang snang ngo / /na gzhon la la'i rtsom du/ ming ngam tshig gi sdeb sbyor nyams pa'i skyon gyis 'bags nas/ tshig gi go rim rtog pa brjod bya kha 435

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung —mi gsal ba/ brjod pa thogs rdugs mang ba/ tha snyad rang bzo don du mi 'byor ba sogs kyi rgud pa'i rang mdangs snang bas na/ sum rtags dag gsum phar zhog sdeb sbyor rig pa'ang sbyang rgyu gal che'o//don tshan gnyis pa/ ming gi sdeb sbyor/ming gi sdeb sbyor ni/ bstan bya'i chos kyi ngo bo tsam rjod pa'i ming gang zung sgrub pa'i yi ge tshogs pa'i sgra yi byed rtsol dang / dbyangs kyi nga ro mi 'dra ba rnams sang la gang 'tsham du sdeb legs par sbyar nas/ brjod pa bde zhing snyan cha thon pa'i ngag gi sgyu rtsal la zer ba yin/ ming gi rig ba1 gnyis las /'dod rgyal gyi ming gi sdeb sbyor ni/ phal cher ming mtha' 'dren par rag las shing / rjes grub kyi ming gi sdeb sbyor ni/ phal cher sgra shed snyom par rag las so/ /'di gnyis ka'i mdor rtsa bsham gsal/ming mtha' 'dren pa rtags mtshungs dang / /gnas mtshungs sgra mtshungs gsum du 'dod/ /de la rtags kyi dbye ba ni/ /spyir na dbyangs mo gsal byed pho/ /gsal byed ming gzhir 'jug pa'i tshe/ /ka ca ta pa tsa lnga pho/ /kha cha tha pha tsha ma ning / /436

ming gi rdob spyoraXmakhas pa'i na rgyan/ ga ja da ba dza dang wa/ /zha za 'a ya sha sa mo/ /nga nya na ma shin tu mo/ 1ra la ha ni ni mo gsham ste/ /ma ni mtshan med ces kyang bya/ /sngon 'jug lnga bo'i rtags kyi khyad1 /ba pho ga da gnyis ma ning / /'a mo ma ni shin tu mo/ 1rjes 'jug bcu bo'i rtags kyi khyad/ /ga da ba sa bzhi bo pho/ /nga ka 'a gsu mi mo yin zhing / —na ra la gsum ma ning ste/ /yang 'jug da sa pho yig go /sgra gdangs drag zhan bar ma rnams/rtags kyi dbye bas mtshon pa yin/ /rtags mtshungs 'dren pa rjes 'jug gis1 /ming mtha' rang rtags mthun pa drang / —gnas mtshungs 'dren pa rjes 'jug gis/ / 437

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung 1ming mtha' skye gnas rang mthun drang / /sgra mtshungs 'dren pa rjes 'jug gis/ /ming mtha' rang sgra mtshungs pa drang / /sgra shed stom pa sgra spyi yi/ /lci ran yang gsum sdeb tshul yin/ /mtha' rten yod med gang rung gi /sgra ni ming gzhi'i rtags lhar bya/ /ya ra wa gsum 'dogs can rnams/ /ming gzhi'i rtags kyis rtsi yang zud/ /la btags can ni rtsi bar brtsi/ /mo yis mo 'phu za yang ba dang / /ma ning mo 'phul ran pa yin/ /ming gzhi rkyang bar ma ning ngam/ /pho yis 'phul ba lci ba yin/ /nyis brtsegs can dang sum brtsegs can/ /bas 'phul yod med kun kyang rtsi/ /lci dang phrad na rtsi bar 'gyur/ /ran par phrad na ran par 'gyur/ /438

mir gi rdob sbyor mkha pa'i da rgyan/nga ——yang dang phrad na yang bar 'gyur/ /sgra shed de bzhin ma stoms na/ /lci ran yang gsum rim par bya/ /go rim 'chings pa ma gtogs pa/ /— log par sbyar ba skyon du 'gyur/ /dang bo/ 'dod rgyal gyi ming gi sdeb spyor/'dod rgyal gyi ming ni/ dngos po gang zhig gang zab sgas ngos thog mar 'dzin tshe/ rgyu mtshan med par brda zhig sbyar ba de'i ming du chags pa/'dod pa ltar rgyal bar gyur pas de skad grags so/ /de'i la tshan gzhi dper na/ gnam dang nyi ma/ mtsho dang ri bo/ gser dab byu ru/ rta dang bong bu/ rtswa dang stag pa/ lha bu sgra bshad med pa'i rigs so cog go /'di rigs las shing dang lcags/ lha du sgra res ming re grub pa rnams yi ge'i sdeb sbyor legs shing brjod pa bde bas/ don gyi ngo bo ston par byed 'a1/ yi ge'i sdeb sbyor ma 'phrod na/ sgra'i byed rtsol thogs par byur bas/ ming du mi 'grub ste1 wi/ bzhi/gam ga 'a zar/ lha bu rnams so/ /sgra gnyis res ming re grub pa'i sdeb sbyor ni/rjes 'jug gis ming mtha' 'dren pa'i tshul la thug yod/ de la rtags mtshungs 'dred pa dang / gnas mtshungs 'dren pa dang / sgra mtshungs 'dren pa ste/ rnam pa gsum yod/439

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgrong /rtags mtshungs 'dren pa ni/ snga ma'i rjes 'jug gam yang 'jug gis ming mtha' rang dang mtshungs pa zhig drangs pa ste/ pho yis pho yi ming mtha' drangs pa/ dag pa— grogs po/ klag cor/ dpyid ka snyed ku/ zhal ta/ gab tse/thab ka zhabs tog rus krang/ sos ko lha bu sogs dang / mo yis mo yi ming mtha' drangs pa/ gang bu/ gzhong ba/ snang du/ tshe zhu/ 'dam bag tham garam shag zha nye/ bze re/ khye'u sos/ lta bu sogs dang / ma nor gis ma ning gi ming mtha' drangs pa/ dgun kha1 mtshon cha/ skyin thang / thur phud/ g.yer kha/mal tshe/ ral kha1 lta duXsogs te/ mtha' rten drag pa dang ming mtha' drag pa sbyar na/ byed rtsol dam 'a rlung shugs che mnyam dang / zhan pa dang zhan pa sbyar na/ byed rtsol lhod la rlung shugs chung mnyam dang / bar ma dang bar ma sbyar na/ byed rtsol ran la rlung shugs 'bring mnyam ste/ so so'i sbyor mtshams mthun pas/ brjod pa bde zhing ngag snyan par grub bo— /rtags mtshungs 'dren pa khyab che yang / skor zhig de ltar sbyar na/ brjod mi bde bas/ gnas mtshungs 'dren pa'am/ sgra mtshungs 'dren par gyur song /gnas mtshungs 'dren pa ni/ rjes 'jug gi skye gnas dang / ming mtha'i skye gnas gcig pa'am ha lam 'dra ba ste/ dper na/ rim pa/ sdom pa/ zhim po/klum po/ rib ma/ mdzub mo1 'thab mo/ zhib bu/ sib bu/ lha bu sogs rjes 'jug skye gnas mchu can gyis ming mtha' skye gnas mchu can drangs pa dang /440

ming gi rdob spyor mkhas pa'i rna rgyan—bon long / yan lag nan tan/ kun dong / bstod ra/ smad ra/ gtad so/mtshal lu/ wal le/ lta bu sogs skye gnas so can gyis so can drangs pa/gnas dang byed pa phrad pa tsam gyis sgra rang shugs su byungs zhing bzhun cha dang ldan pa'o//'di'i rjes mthun gnas bsnyen 'dren pa ni/ tshon po/ sbyin pa/ thun mong / ston mo/ mchil ma/ rol mo/ thil bo/ ltad mo/ dred mong/ thar ba/ thur ma/ lta bu sogs rjes 'jug so gnas can gyis ming mtha' mchu gnas can drangs pa sbyor mtshams nye bas brjod pa bde bar grub bo/sgra mtshungs ba 'dren pa ni/ ming gi cha shas snga ma dang gyi ma sgra mtshungs pa'am dbyangs tsam min pa gcig pa drangs pa/ ka ka chag chag khrung khrung /ril ril/ lhung lhung/ khar kher/ ngan ngon/ dar dir/ ltab lhub sta bu sogs sbyor mtshams gsal zhing brjod pa bde la nyams thon pa'o//gong gsal 'dod rgyal gyi ming gi byed rtsol/ rtags gnas sgra gsum gang mthun du sbyar ba rnams/ rang gis brjod bde ba/ gzhan gyis go sla ba/gnyis ka'i rna la snyan par byur ba ni/ sdeb sbyor gyi mchog byin pa'i phyir ro/ /sdeb sbyor ma 'grigs na/ brjod mi bde la ming dag pa zhig tu mi 'grub pas/don gyi ngo bo ston pa'i nus pa'ang nyams 'gro/ dper na bzang ba dang /blun pa/ lha bu'i khyad chos kyi ming gi ming mtha' la na ro sbyar na/ bzang bo 441

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mdzad zung—dang / blun po1 zhes sdeb legs shing dngos po'i ming du stsar mod1 mtho ba dang 1 dma' ba1 lha bu'i ming mthar na ro sbyar na/ mtho bo dang / da ma' bo/zhes bzad mi bde bas dngos po'i ming du mi 'grub pas/ mthon po dang /dma' mo/ zhes sdeb legs par 'chos pa yin no/ 1yang / sprel dang / spyil bo/lta bu'i chung ngu'i rigs ston pa la/ spre'u dang / spyil bu/ zhes 'u dang bu sbyar bas 'thus mod1 rta dang mda' mo/ so dang zo ba/ lha du'i chung ngu ston pa la/rta'u/ so'u sogs su 'i sgra sbyar na brjod mi bde bas/ rte'u dang mde'u/ se'u dang ze'u/ kar nga ro drang ba dang / bstod pa dag sgrong bar brjes nas sdeb legs par grub bo11gnyis pa/ rjes grub kyi ming gi sdeb sbyor/rjes grub kyi ming ni/ 'dod rgyal gyi ming gang 'tshams shig la 'brel yod kyi ming ngam1 sgra zhig sbyar nas/ bstan bya'i chos kyi ngo bo gzhan zhig rjod pa'i brdar gyur pa zhis ste/ byur dkar dang / bya sgong ni/ byu ru dkar po dang / bya mo'i sgo nga'i tshes bar 'dus pa'i ming yin zhing / thub dbang dang /byang sems ni/ thub pa'i dbang bo dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'dus ming yin pa dang / nags ri dang / gser gzhong ni/ nags skyes ba 'i ri bo dang /gser las grub pa'i gzhong ba'i tshig sna 'dus pa'i ming yin pa lha bu sogs/sgra'i steng nas don bshad rgyu yod pa ji snyed pa'o/ /'di rigs kyi sdeb sbyor ni/4 1mi

— ming mi rdo bkar mkhas pa'i da rgyan—ming mtha' 'dren pa lhar sbyar ba dang 1 sgra snga phyi'i shed snyom pa ra sbyar ba gnyis su 'dus so/1ming mtha' 'dren pa lhar sbyar ba ni1 ming mtha' 'dren pa dngos min yang / de bzhin sbyar ba zhig so /de yang / 'dod rgyal byi ming gi ming mtha' dngos ni/ ming snga ma'i grogs su sbyar ba min na don bstan rgyu med ‘sha1 rjes grub kyi ming gi— cha shas phyi ma ni ming rma tha' min gyi ming yin te/ snga ma dang 'bre' nas don gzhan zhig ston par byed pa'o//de la rtags mtshungs 'dren pa lhar sbyar ba/ sdub bsnga' / bdud rtse/ rgyab rten/ rgyas spros / lta bu sogs pho yis pho yi ming mtha' 'dren pa ltar sbyar ba dang / snying rje/ gtam rgyud/ rdo rgyus1 mtha—ra dag lha gu sogs mo yis mo yi ming mtha' 'dren pa lhar sbyar ba dang / gtan tshigs1 dur khrod/ mtshan dpe/spar khrim1 lta du sogs ma ning gis ma ning gi ming mtha' 'dred pa lhar sbyar ba'o//sgra mtshungs 'dren pa lhar sbyar ba/ rig gnas/ bzang ngan/ gad dar/gzhon nu/ rab byung / khyim mtshes/ mtha' 'khob/ rnal lam1 chos srid/ lha bu sogs snga ma'i rjes 'jug dang / phyi ma'i sngon 'jug gam ming ga'i rang sgra mtshungs pa sbyar ba'o//ba/nas mtshungs 'dren pa lhar sbyar ba/ kham phor/ dam phrag khub rtsog44 3

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung /phrin las/ 'ur langs pa/ gral rim/ nyan rang / 'chad nyan/ gzungs sngags/lta bu sogs snga ma'i rjes 'jug dang phyi ma'i ming gzhi skye gnas mtshungs pa sbyar ba'o//sgra snga phyi shed snyom par sbyar ba ni/ spyir sgra drag pa dang drag pa/ ra ma dang bar ma/ zhan pa dang zhan pa shed mnyam par sbyar ba dang / nyung zad cig sgra drag pa nas rim gyis zhan par shed ji lhod du btang nas spyar ba yin/'di rigs las/ mkha' dbyings su rgyu ba'i skar ma la rgyu skar dang / 'dam las skyes pa'i pad ma la 'dam skyes/ zhes pa lha bu rnams go rim btsan pa'i dbang gis/ sgra zhan pa snga ma dang / drag pa phyi mar spyar ba dmigs bsal yin pa las/ spyir sngon rjes ming gsum ci rigs shig gtso bor byur pa'i khyad par yod pa gsham gsal/gcig ni/ sgra drag zhan bar ma'i 'dren byed sngon 'jug yin pas/ snga ma'i sngon 'jug phyi ma'i sngon 'jug gam ming gzhi las sgra cung zad drag par sbyar ba/ dper na/ bsod nams bsngo smon/ bshes gnyen/ dmus long /dkon mchog dpal yon/ gti thug gzugs phung / lha bu sogs dang /gnyis ni/ sgra drag zhan bar ma'i 'gyur byed mtha' rten yin pas/ snga ma'i mtha' rten phyi ma'i sngon 'jug gam ming gzhi las sgra cung zad drag par sbyar ba/ 'dag chal/ phyogs lhung / rmad byung / dud 'gro/ deb zer/ skyabs 444

ming gi rdob spyor mkhas pa'i rna rgyanamagon/ thos 'dzin/ klos gar/ 'khor 'gro/ kun mkhyen/ ral gri— lha du sogs dang /gsum ni/ sgra drag zhan bar ma'i nges byed ming gzhi yin pas/ snga ma'i ming gzhi phyi ma'i ming gzhi las sgra cung zad drag par sbyar ba/ 'di la rnam pa gsum mchis te/1 ming gzhi snga phyi gnyis ka'i sgra shed mnyam par sbyar ba/ spang spos/ rtsa rtse/ brtad skyen/ rdo rje/ bslab sbyang / rig 'dzin/ thod phreng / legs nyes/ lta bu sogs dang /2 snga ma'i sgra gdangs lci zhing dam pa ste ming gzhi pho yig brtsegs pa can dang / phyi ma'i sgra gdangs lci zhing lhod pa ste ming gzhi mo yig brtsegs pa can nam/ ming gzhi pho yig rkyang ba can gnyis mnyam du sbyar ba/ skam rlon/sgra brnyan/ lcags sgyug spun zla/ rtsa rlung / spyi sger/ brtag dpyad/ spyi gtsugartsad bcad pa/ lta bu sogs dang /3 snga ma'i sgra gdangs lci zhing lhod pa ste ming gzhi mo yig brtsegs pa can dang / phyi ma'i sgra gdangs lci cha med par drag pa tsam mam/ ran pa tsam ste/ ming gzhi pho yig rkyang ba'am ma ning gnyis mnyam du sbyar ba/ sgra gcan/snying nyig bsnyen bkur/ rdos bcas/ rgang thur/ rngo thogs pa/ snying thag pa/—lha bu sogs so//44 5

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung nga don tshan gsum pa/ ming blu sdeb legs par bca' thabs/—ming si sdeb sbyor ma 'phrod na 'phrod par bca' dgos mkhas nga1'i phyag rtsom dang btan chabs pa'i tha snya da so gas la bltas na— bcos tshul gtso bo rnam pa bzhi sna nga /dang bo/ ming bi cha shas phyi ma bcos pa/ming ga nyis ming gcib/ tu spyar nas chos kyi ngo bo gzhan zhig sto na par/spyir cha shas btso bo snga ma dang / phal ba phyi mar sbyar ba yin la1 sdeb sbyo ra ma 'phrad na/ gtso bo so na bzhas nas pha' ba brtsas pa men te/ bzu g.ya' sel las/ ta yig ma bo 'bring dpung ba thung / /khos 'dren drang 'a rked ltem klum/ /———zhes pa'i rked ltem ni/ rked pa'i them pa ste/ tsheg da ra bsdus nas rked them zhe na/ sgra lci yang shed mi mnyam pas1 rtab/sa mtshungs 'dren pa lhar brjod bde bar 'chos so/ /bka' 'chams ba khol ma 'a sa/ rgyal bo yab yum gnyes kyi zhe sar sta ngas zha' zhes byung yang 1 de'i phyis kyi lo rgyus rnams su sta ngas ——dpyal du bris pa yang / sgra shed stom par byas pa yin1 de yang dang thog khyo ———shug 'a stengs gcal zer zhing thos 'og sga don yin pas/ de ltar bris na mig 'a gzan pas stangs dpyal du bris ba bar gyur to/ 1rwa lo tsā ba'i rnam thar 446
