ming i ldeb sbyor mkhas pa'i da rgyana' sa/ lha ba mig no— thos pa rna gas nga / zhes pa'i bsang ni sangs te gsal ba'i don yin/ rmes byed ni sngags bzag thabs las/ a ku ha lo sogs kyi brgag tshul la/ skad kyi gdangs sa ngas sangs su mgrin pa'i gnas la sa 'byung ba'o/ /zhes dang / 'dra ba'i gas cho byed 4rtsegs gyur na/ /kha khengs pa skad sangs mthon po'i bdangs kyis bklag zhes pas bsal yang / sgra lci bar phrad na rlu bar 'gyur/ zhes pa ltar/ sgra yang ba'i sangs ni sgra lci ba'i gsang du gyur song / sngo bsangs ma zhes pa'i bsangs kyang sangs yin mod/ snga —— ——ma'i sngo lhar sgra rtsi bar gyur nas bas 'phul thob song / pad ma bka' thang las/ kha mig lag pa mi zug bya byed mang / zhes pa'i mi zug ni mi tshugs te/——— ——sgra shed bsnyams pa yin/ yid dga'1 yid bzang / yid gcugs pa/— — ——— — —— — — — ———yid gzhungs pa/ yid bzhin nor bu/ zhes pa sogs kyi yid dang / yi mug pa/spang dang ba/ yid ma/rā re—gas—/—zhe rme tre rnams kyi yi gnyis rdon gcig kyang /snga rme ḍā spre pre rā byer bas rjes 'jub/ da thob pa dang / phyi ma sgra yang ba la sbyar bas da mtha' dor ba'o/ 1gzhung rnying rnams las/ snyan ngag la snyan dngabs — nga — —su bris pa/ sdeb sbyor gyi mchos byin pa yin mod1 kha cig gi snyan ngag ces pa/ rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i tshigs bcad kyi ming dang / snyan dngags zhes pa de'i gzhung la zer/ zhes bkral ba ma dag pa'o/ /nam gzhar la nam zhar ——— —dang / nam nam zhar zhar la nam nam zha zha ru bris pa yang / brjod bde ba'i — —————nga —147

ming gi sdeb sbyor mkhas pa'i da rgyan/kun stong la kun dong / khe sbogs la khe bogs/ gyi na 'da' ba'i tsheg — ——dbar bsdus nas gyin 'da' dang /de yang gyin ta zhes par gyur pa/rnga dang ——cha lang gi bsdus ming la rnga gshang /cig char la cig car/chab rom la chab — ———— —brom/snying bo'i snying bo la yang nying /stod 'gag la stod sgag bstan chos la —bstan bcos/sprang phrug la sprang sprug ba glang la ba lang /ma g.yar dang du —— ——g.yar la ma yar dang bu yar/ rdzogs so la rdzogs sto/ gzungs 'jug la — — ——gzungs gzhug zhwa mo skya leb la zhwa mo skya nyeb sha stag la sha dag sogs su — — — nga bris pa/ngag tu blangs tshe/sgra shed ngang gis mnyam par stsar nas brjod bde bar grub pa yin/ thog khebs dang bla gab/chang phor dang spos por/zhim mngar dang zil dngar/dngos spyad dang yo byad/bsil g.yab dang rnga yab/thor cog dang gtsug tor/gos zugs dang be'u 'phrug smin dbrag dang kha brag mkhur tshos dang rkub tsos/spu gzeng ba dang rwa zeng ba/ngu ngag dang smre sngags/phung khrol dang 'dab krol/zhal chems dang bka' 'chems/na khu dwangs pa dang snyun gdangs pa/ lhan thabs dang stangs stabs/ mdongs mtha' can dang sgro sdongs/gsham gsal dang sham thabs/'gyogs 'jam dang phebs byams/gru yor dang rlung g.yor sogs gnyis gnyis su go bsdur ba las/ rtags kyis mtshan pa dag gi don gcig la/snga ma 'bri srol dngos te sdeb kyang legs/phyi 49

dab yig rig pa'i gab mngon rgyung—ma sdeb sbyor mi 'phrod pas/ la la ming mtha' 'dren pa lhar dang / la la ji shed stom pa ltar/ brjod pa bde ba ji lha ba bzhin du bris par myur pa yin no //nom dbye tshis phrad gzhan dbang can gang rung 1 don nges can gcig gam du ma re gsal bar byed pa'i sgra yin pas / de'i ming du da lha ba bris na 'gris mod/ sdeb sbyor ma 'phrod na/ ma 'ongs pa'am 'das pa gang rigs shig spyar ba'i srol byung / dper na/ 'brel sgra dang / byed sgra dang / la dan dang / 'byung khubs rnams ni/ bdag gzhan gnyis kyi ngo bo rnam par 'byed pa'i sgra yin pas— rnam 'byed/ ce na 'grig mod/ sgra rtsi yang shed stom par byas nas/ rnam dbye zhes grags song / de bzhin rdzogs tshig la zla sdud ce na/nga — — ——da lha ba thob kyang / slar bsdu zhe na/ ma 'ongs pa thob bo/ /'gog par byed —nga pa'i sgra la da gag sgra dang / de 'di gnyis te ngos 'dzid par byed pa'i sgra la ——nga ngos bzung / zhes grags so/ /der ma zad/ dper brjod dang / mdor bsdus — — — ————— ——dang / gas 'phul rnams kyi ming mtha' bsdus das brda chad du 'jug tsho/ de ——————dag la sbyar ba'i ra sgra dang sa sgra dag bsdu dgos mod/ ma bsdus 4ra bzhag pa ni brjod bde ba'i phyir ro//gnyis pa/ ming gi cha shas snga ma bcos pa/ming gi sdeb sbyor ma 'phrod na1 cha shas phyi ma bsgyur dgos/ des kyang ma 1rta0

ming ji steb sbor ma las pa'i za rgyam —— ——— ——'phrod na/ cha shas snga ma bsgyur dgos1 dper na/ dbon 'ang dbu snyung ba'i rdo ring mi bka' gcings las/ mtsho chen po'i (nang)nyi ma shar pa/ zhes dang /snyan pa'i ma skad no gnyi zlas slebs so chog tu khyab ste1 'es nyin byed kyi ming la nyi ma zer tshe1 nyi zlo gas 'phul med kyang / nyi ma dang zla ba'i bci sa ming la gnyi zla zhes gnyi la sas 'phul ba ni— sgra lci yang shed mnyam par byas so/ /sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas kyi 'grel ba rnams las/ yi se gsum re'i tshogs 4 la sum tshan/ zhes tshan gyi sgra cung zad yang bas na1 sum gyi gas ————'phul dor byung yang / mnyam pa'i bka'i yi ge bcu gcig pa'i sdeb sbyor la gsum bsngags / zhes bsngags kyi sgra lci bas na/ bsu ma gyigs 'phul dmigs ——— —— —— kyis bzhag pa yin no/ /krirti dkad pa'i dpar rkon gyi bca' yig las par ———shing ches pa'i par gyi das 'phul dor ba ni/ bya pa'i ming da ngos po'i ming du —sbyar ba gsal/ da par chon gyi dpar yang dngos po'i ming du sbyar ba yin mod/————— das 'phul bzhag pa ni/ rkon dang sgra shed mnyam par byas so — /ded dpon gyi nga — ——ded la da lta ba 'ded thob kyang / rlu shed sto ma ched 'as 'phul dor ba yin no1/de bzhin du/ tshig mjam pas bsgo ba la gzhams bsgo/ nye bar bkur ba la bsnyen bkur/ thas gdang sga ra ba shā dang ra—shi we— rjes dran gyi ston mo la yi ston glang bo che'i swāche ba shā ka so / da dus ste dang dasdos ste shā da 161

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung dang dbu ru/g.yon ru dang g.yon lag la g.yo ru dang g.yo lag 'gan rgya la gnang /bsnyeng khu la nying khu/ gtan grogs ca dan grogs rje sa la zhe sang re tshon la gzha' tsho / spo tho la po to/ sa tho la sa do/ bskyar nga gshar sbyang /bya glag la byan glaganor gnag gi sha bal ga sha ze mong la sre ——nga nga —mong spa rtsog la pa cog gnam mkha' la nam mkha'/ mthun mong la thun rmeng —ris mo la ri mo/shes gnyen la bshes gnyen du bris pa sogs kyang /sdeb sbyor gyi mchog nga pa yi na no/ / gsum pa/ ming gi cha shas gnyis ka bcos pa/ming gi sdeb sbyor ma 'phrod na/ cha shas snga phyi gang rung zhig 'os par bsgyur dgos/des kyang ma phan na/tshang ma bsgyur dgos/dper na/bka' 'chems ka khol ma las/ g.yung drung la g.yu rung bon bstan/ zhes dang zhol rdo ring phyi ma las/ zhabs dbring la zham 'bring dang / de phyis kyi yig rnying rnams las zham ring du bris pa dang / phag tu gzha' ba la bag la zha ba —lhar byas pa nams ni/ sdeb legs par 'chos pa yin/ dpe de bzhin dubaza' 'tsho la za tsho/glang pho la lung bon/'chang gzung la chang zung /nyis cu —— la nyi shu/ ne'u gsing la no sing /gnam dpangs la nam 'phang /yid —— —spru ga pa la yi nug pa lhar jis pa sogs kyang brjod bde la ngag snyan par gyur pa'i shugs 'byung yin no//462

ming gi sdeb spyor mkhas pa'i rna rgyan/bzhi ba/ ming gi nga ro bcos pa/ming gi cha shas gnyis ka'i skad kyi gdangs mi mthun pa med kyang /brjod ma bde na/ dbyangs kyi nga ro mtho dman drang 'khyog gang 'tsham du ma byung ba'i skyon yin/ de yang / sa'i dbyangs dang ldan pa rnams drang ba dang /gug gu can rnams bkug pa dang / zhabs kyu can rnams smad pa dang / 'greng bu can rnams sreng ba dang / na ro can rnams bstod pa'o/ /ming gi cha shas gnyis kyi nga ro gcig pa dang / bstod pa nas drang ba'am smad par rtser pa rnams brngod bde la/ smad pa nas bkug pa'am bstod par sgyur pa rnams brjod mi bde zhing / smad pa nas drang bar byas na/ yi ge tshogs pa'i dbang gis brjod bde mi bde'i khyad par yang yod pas/ dbyangs kyi nga ro rnams gang la gang 'tsham du bsdebs na/ ngag snyan par 'gyur la/ dper na/ sa ming mgo log ces pa thog mar 'gu log tu grags kyang / sgra'i nga ro thur du smad nas mthon por bstod na/ brjod mi bde bas/ nga ro gnyis ka bstod par gyur song / de yang mgo log rus mdzod kyi bshad srol ltar na/ spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bzhi ba'i mjug tu/ zi khron zhing chen gyi khongs su gtogs pa'i dpal yul rdzong 'gu kho lung gi mgo ba 'bru lha rgyal 'bum gyis dud khyim lnga bcu tsam khrid nas rdo rol gong dang bo dang / gas kyi ma mo'i bzhi mdo sogs su bskyas nas gzhis chags/ yul gru de'i mi dmas kyis 'gu log pa 463

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung ———————nga —'es 'bod pa 'i ska da bdangs 'gyur nas 'go log tu grags1 spu rob gyi stod smad par gsum gyi ba nyan rtse dang 1 ma/bar re dang / ba le tsho ba gsu ma gyib— dpod po rnams kyis/ 'bru lha rgyal 'bum pha bu'i chos sred kyi sto bas 'byor rgyad pa za phrag dog nas/ mnyam du log ste dmag drangs nas/ tshur mgo len pa sgyub/ par mgo shor nas ma bo log tu grags skad/ dpe de ba'i na1 — bcu lnga dang / bcu brgyad dag kyang nga ro mi da pa nas drang bar bton na brjod mi bde bas1 wa btags phal cher na ro ste/ /wa sgra cung zhig ldan par bklag 1ces sngags bklas thabs las ba/sungs pa ltar/ bcwa lnga dang / bcwa brgyad du bris pa'i dpe byung / de yang sbyor klog mi rung bas na/ bco lnga dang / bco ——— — ——ba3da ‘ltar klog bde bar byas so/ /pags pa phyi ra bslobs nas bzos pa'i go na pa la slog shā zer yang / tshar bu'i slog pa la tshar snag ces na ro dor byung / zhabs gnyis bskyil nas sked pa yong nger bzhugs pa la skyil krong zer yang 1 nga ro'i sdeb sbyor 'phrod par byas nas/ skyil krung du gyur to//bya ba'i ming la bdag gzhan byi dbye bas khyab ma khyab dang / dus gsum kye la tshig dang bzhi'i rnam bzhag yod pa sa/ dngos po'i ming du 'jug pa la/byir btang du/ byed pa da lha ba yis dang / /las ni ma 'ongs pa yis sgrub/ /pya ba dus gsum1 bab dang bstun/ /zhes ba star/ bya ba'i ming byed par 'jug pa/rnam 'dren/ sgo srung / bal 'breg rtsom pa bo/ nor 'dzin/ lha du noms byed 4 54

ming 'i rdob spyor mkhas pa'i rna rgyan1pa gzu bo dang / sgrub byed/ kha ba1rtsad/ rko spyad/ sen 'dra/ lha yu rnams byed pa phal ba dang / dpe cha ba lha/ glog brnyan lha/ ri mo bltas/ song la ltos/ lta bu rnams rim pa bzhin bya ba ma 'ongs pa dang / da lta ba dang / 'das pa dang /sku la tshig tu grub bo— /sdeb sbyor du bya ba rigs gsum dang / dus ba/sum gyi dam bzhag phan tshun brje chog pa'i dmigs bsal yod de/ gzhom gzhig —ched pa dzwa rje'i brag lhar brtan/ zhes pa'i gzhig ni bshis gi tshab ste/ don 'dra ba'i ma 'ongs pa gnyis las kyi dngos po brlag par bya bar sbyar ba yin mod/ bdag dang 'brel ba'i bya ba bshig gi sgra snga ma'i gzhom las lci bas na/bzhan dang 'grel ba'i bya ba zhig 'a gas 'phul nas sbyar bas sgra shed mnyam par byur to/ /bla gab kyi gab ni don du khebs te/ bkab nas khebs pa'i nga rtsol byung yin gyi/ rang byung min pa'i phyir/ bla khebs zhe na/ nga ro drang ba nas skreng bar bsgyur na/ brjod mi bde bas1 bdag dang 'bre' ba'i bya ba'i dod du/ bdag gzhan gang la'ang ma 'brel ba'i bya ba sbyar to/ 1bzho ze'u 'dzin byed la bzho 'dzin zhe na/ brjod mi bde bas/ bzho bzung zhes dzwa lta ba'i dod — —————du ma 'ongs pa sbyar nas/ nga ro bde bar ma zad/ sgra shed kyang mnyam par gyur song / khab kyi 'dzin pa la khab bzung zhes da lta ba'i tshab tu 'das ba ༷ ———sbyar nas/ nga ro drang ba nas snad par byas nas dbyangs snyan par ma zad/zags mtshungs 'dren pa lhar gyur nas brjod ma1'ang ra ba tu bde song / spyad 66

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /par bya ba'i yul la spyod yul zhes ma 'ongs pa'i dod du da lha ba sbyar nas brjod pa bde song ——bye ba byed la rlung g.yab tu grags pa yang nga ro smad pa nas drang bar brjod 4de bar gyur pa yin/ sha 'dzin pa'i lcags kyu lta bu la sha 'dzin mi zer bar sha zung / zhes da lta ba'i dod du gas 'phul ——dor ba'i ma 'ongs pa sbyar ba yang kha skad ltar brjod bde bar byas pa'o/ /sbrang ma mchu reng gis zug par skyob pa'i yol ba la sbrang skyabs zhes 'bod pa yang brjod bde ba'i shugs 'byung yin no// // —

sgra gdangs mthun par 'gyur tshul gyi gnad don gas la byedalde tshan bcu bdun pa/ sgra gdangs mthun par 'gyur tshul gyi gnad don gsal byed/gangs can skad du tha snyad mang bo zhig /ngag nas brjod tshe phan tshun byed rtsol gyis//sgra gdangs mthun par 'gyur ba'i gnas lugs 'di//legs par rtogs na bri klog kun la phan//bod yig ni bod skad kyi khyad chos ji bzhin gtan la phab pa yin pas/bod skad dang thod mi thug sa med mod/ yin na yang bod skad kyi tha snyad mang bo zhig ngag tu brjod par sgra gdangs mthun par 'gyur ba'i gnas lugs ma rtogs ba gtso bor bzung ba'i kha cig gis/ bod yig dang bod skad thod mi zug ces bla brdol smra zhing / zlos gar sogs kyi tshig sbyor go sla bar byed ched/kha skad ltar yi ge gang 'dod du bris pa dag cha nyams pa'i dbang gis/gzhan gyis bltas na lhag par go dka' bar byur snang /grun po 'phyugs na mtho gang / /mkhas pa 'phyugs na 'dom gang / /zhes pa'i dpe bzhin/ sgra gdangs mthun par byur pa'i tha snyad gang la yi ge gang bab ma rtogs log rtog tu 'bri nyes byas pa/ skye bo phal gyi bris ma las byung na/457

dab yig rig pa'i rgab pa mngo sgyung 15 na cher med kyang / dag yig ming mdzod du byung na/ gnod pa che ste/ ma das rgyun 'byams su 'gyur lnga das yig bsar bsgrigs zhes bya ba las/ kha ska da du grabs pa'i tha snyad skor zhig bsdus yod pa bzang mod/ ma dag pa mang ste/la this la kha 'dig tu 'bri nyes byas byung / rgyus pa la yul skad du rgyus rka yang zer/ zhes ka 'a ra mgo sbyar ba skyon/ rta'i thor bu la tho ru ltar bris pa ma dab ste1 thor mo la thoXmo zhes bshad srol med pas gsal/ sla nga ni zangs nga'i ming gzhan/ zhes pa — phyi ma snga ma'i ma dag pa'o/ /kha skad du brda rnying ji bzhin 'grub la 'gyub ces grags pa/ ma brtags par/ 'ju/ zhes blo bzo zhig bris nas/ 'grel dang dpe la/ tshags su chud pa'i don te/ zhing 'de pas pa'i gra sgrig gi las lo rnams sngar nas 'jus yod/ ces bshad pa lha bu sogs so//brda dag ming tshig gsal ba zhes bya ba las1 mjing yon la 'jing yon dang / 'phongs sha la yong sha dang / phyar ba la phya ra dang / gnyan shing nya brug la nyab rib tu bris pa sogs dag cha nyams song /bod rgya tshig mjod chen mo la / srin 'bu ni spen bu dang 'dra zer/'dra ba min te/ snga ma nor/ shing rigs shig la yo 'bog dang / yom 'bob gnyis jis pa'i phyi ma yig log red/ 'phongs shing la 'ong shing dang / dbyen sbyor ba la/ gzug sbyor ba dang da so gtse ba la so brtse ba sogs su bris pa yig 458

—༅ba ba—bye— — ————skyon mang bar1ma zad/ tha snyad du sbyar ba'i༅ se ma jag rgyud 'byams dag ther ma mdzad par sang༄nga bsdus pa'ang mang ngo // — 1 da 1res mthun par 'gyur tshul legs ma ra the41 na/ rgong du dpe drang ba — — — sgyu stad— dī rtso'i lha bdangs tsam la rmongs pa'i da bang du mi 'chorabs/ ) rad 'i yig skyon mi 'byung bar ma zas bris ma na4 sa las yig 'o ba de rig—sgyu mthong na dang bang dag pa ltar go ba len thub— da per dag shar ra mda' stan byed/ dpa' bo rdo sta da byed(rgyal bo srong btsad gyis phyi blon rnams ‘sgyu gdams pa las)gsungs pa'i zar ra ni/— —stag shar pa'i don yin pa ra rtob sa pa lta bu'o1 1 deb phyir skabs 'der bod skad kyi sna gdangs mthun rtsa1ra 'gyur tshul mdo bsdus shig spro bar bya'o/ 1 tha snyad skor 'ig gi sngon 'jug dang ming gzhi ram/ tsheg khrim sngaXphyi'i sgra gdangs 'gang mi gcib kyang / ngag nas brjod pa'i— che/ byed rtsol gyi man phan chun la zhudaka nas sgra gdang su mthun par gyur 'gro la1 'de ni brngod ba de ba'i bla zabs shig ste/ sgra gnyis 'grel das myud du klob tshe/ gnas dngabyed pa'i sbyor ba mi 'dra ba de gnyis ka'i khyad tshosaXji bzhin bzad na dad sa na/brjod mi bde phyir1 sgra 'dres na gdangs 'gyur ba'i srol lhar/ de gnyis ka'i byed rtsol mthun par gyur nas brjod bde bar grub pa yin/ de la lubs 4da9

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung 'byung mthun 'gyur/ lugs ldog mthun 'gyur/ bye brag mthun 'byur/ yongs rdzogs mthun 'gyur/ nang gses mthun 'gyur/ phyi rol mthun 'gyur bcas rnam pa drug yod do//dang bo/ lugs 'byung mthun 'gyur/lugs 'byung mthun 'gyur ni/ ming gcig gi cha shas snga mas cha shas phyi ma mthun par byed pa zhig yin/ de yang gtso cher cha shas snga ma'i rjes 'jug gi gnas dang byed pa'i rtsol ba bsrangs pa'i shugs kyis/ phyi ma'i ming gzhi'i rang sgra 'byung khom med par/ snga ma'i rjes 'jug gi sgra'i khyad chos dang mthun par 'byur ba yin no//(ga) lag pa la lag hwa lhar grags pa ni/ lag gi rjes 'jug ga mgrin pa dang lce rtsa las bskyed cing / ming mtha' pa mchu las bskyed pa yin la/ sgra gnyis ka'i skye gnas bar thag ring bas/ myur du klog tshe/ byed rtsol (byed rtsol ni gnas dang byed pa'i spyor ba'o)cung zad thogs pa'i skyon snang / rang skad goms gshis kyis/ snga ma'i rjes 'jug gi sgra phyi mar 'dres nas/ pa sgra hwa sgra lhar grags par gyur nas gdangs mthun zhing brjod bde bar grub bo/ /dpe de bzhin/ rjes 'jug ga sbyar ba'i ming gzhi rkyang brtsegs dang / 'phul dang yang 'jug yod med gang rung la/ dbyangs med pa'am/ 'greng du'am/ na ro thob pa can gyi ming mtha' pa la hwa dang / po la ho ltar klog pa ste/ yag pa la 460

smo gdangs mthun par 'gyar rtsom gyi gdad don gas la byed/yag hwa/ theg pa la theg hwa/ brtsegs pa la brtsegs hwa/ slog pa la slog hwa/las legs po la las legs ho/ drag po la drag ho ltar grags pa'o/ /rjes 'jug ga sbyar ba'i ming gzhi gang rung la gug gu dang zhabs kyu thob pa kun gyi ming mtha' pa la ka dang / po la ko ltar klog pa ste/ rig pa la rig kwa/bsgrigs pa la bsgrigs kwa/ bkug pa la bkug kwa/ thug pa la thug kwa/ jig po la rdzig ko mthug po la mthug ko gcig pu la gcig ku lhar grags pa'o/ /de bzhin/ na ning gi lu gu lag ka la kha skad du/ lag wa zer ro/ /(nga) rkang dung la rkang 'dung du grags pa ni/ snga ma'i rjes 'jug nga'i sna sgra phyi ma'i ming gzhi da la 'dres nas gdangs mthun par byur pa yin/ngang ba la ngang nga dang / seng ge la seng 'ge dang / sdong bo la sdong 'ong ltar grags pa rnams kyang de bzhin yin/ tun hong nas thon pa'i yig rnying las/glang pho la lung bong zhes bris snang ba/ yi ge ma dag kyang / kha skad du de lhar grags pa'i sgra la brtags na shes par 'gyur ro//(da) 'od zer la 'od tser lhar grags pa di/ snga ma'i rjes 'jug da yi byed rtsol phyi 'i ming gzhi za la 'dres nas/ sgra gdangs de ltar gyur pa red/bstod ra la bstod dra dang / skad rigs la skad drigs dang / bod yig la bod cig dang / zad po la zad do lhar grags pa sogs kyang rigs 'gres so//(na) srin bu la srin 'bu lhar grags pa ni/ snga ma'i rjes 'jug na'i sna 461

das yib rig pa 'i gab pa mngom sgyub ——————— —sgra phyi zu1'i ming gzhi ba la 'dres nas skad kyi gdangs de lha ra gyur song 1 de bzhin/ sbyin pa 'a sbyin 'ba'/ tshon po 'a la tshon rang1 kun rigs la kun 'dris don grub la don 'grub/ rid ‘4 la ren 'ba' lhar grabs pa sogs kyang snga ma'i rjes 'jug gi na sgra phyi ma'i ming gzhir zhugs nas sgra gdangs mthun par dzir pa red11(ma) 'dam bag la 'dam 'bag ltar grags pa ri/ snga ma'i rjes 'jus ma'i sna sgra phyi ma'i ming gzhi ba la 'dres nas gdangs mthun bar gyur pa yin/ska ma nga1 la ska ma 'ba' thom du la thom 'bu/ dam pe la dam 'be— chos po la chom 'ji lhar grags pa sogs kyang rigs 'gres so//('a1 lha lang la lha 'ang ltar grags pa ni1 snga ma'i shugs bstan gyi rjes 'jub blu da kan pa byes shing rlung sna khung du cung zad rgyu ba'i 'a sgra zhugs na sa gdangs zu1thun par gyur pa red/ kha zud la kha yed/ a phyi la ye ye/ wa zhwa la wa ya / bse driX' bse ri/ phyi dro la phyi ro— bcu drug 'a bcu rug zha byis la zha ye lhar grags pa sobs kyang rigs 'gres/ mtsho sngo na gyi yul gru zhig 'a brda rnying lhar khyi wa zhes pa khri kha dang 1 dpa' ris kyi yul gru zhig la brda rnying ltar ha khyi zer ba pha khri dang / rma chu rdzong ge sde ba zhig la chi wa ma zhes pa chu kha ma yid no 1thi gdang sa mthun par 'gyur ba'i lugs 'di la rigs bsgros na1 di dag gi don dang yi ke kang bab bde blag tu rtogs so/ 1de 162

sna gdangs mthun par 'gyur tshul gyi gnad don gsal byed1ba'i na du/ shing rig ba sheg la kha skad du ma lal zhes 'bod pa'i sgra la brtags na/ ma gal yin ba ra go'o//(ra) rlung bser du la bse ru lhar grags pa ni/ snga ma'i rjes 'jug gi lce rtse 'dar ba'i ra sgra phyi ma'i ming gzhi ba la zhugs nas ba/dngas mthun par byur pa red/ ser ba la ser ra1 nor bu la nor ru/ dbar po la dkar ro/sgyur po la skyur to (da drag gi dbang gis)/ gsar bu lo nyung la gsa' ru lo nyung / mtshar po la mtshar ro spar ba spa ra ltar grags pa sogs kyang de bzhin no/ /yul gru 'bur la 'bo ra zhes grags pa yang / sdeb sbyor du 'bur gyi nga ro smad pa dang / ba yi nga ro drang ba yin la/ sgra 'phang smad pa nas drang bar bton da brjod mi bde bas/ smad pa'i nga ro bstod pa'i nga ror brjes nas/ 'bor ba zhes brjod bde ber gyur/ de yang ga ma'i rjes 'jug gi ra spu phyi ma'i ba la zhugs shing sgra mthun par byur nas/ 'bor ra'am 'bo ra zhes grags pa yin no /(la) ril gu la ril lu ltar grags pa ni/ snga ma'i rjes 'jug gi rtse rtse cung tsam 'dar ba'i la sgra phyi ma'i ming gzhi ba la zhugs nas gdangs mthun par gyur to/ /yol ba la yol la1 gdal bu la gda' lu/ rul dri la rul ri/star bu la sta ru/ sdur ba 'a sdu ra lhar grags pa sogs kyang de bzhin no1/(sa) dpa' ris skad du1 chos pa la chos bsa'/ rtsis pa la rtsis bsa'/‘1(3

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /(zla ba)gnyis pa la gnyis bsa'/ las ka la las ska/ gnyis ka la gnyis ska ltar grags pa sogs ni/ snga ma'i rjes 'jug gi so srubs las byung ba'i sa sgra phyi ma'i ming mthar zhugs nas/ sgra mthun par gyur pa dang / rogs pa la rogs bsa' dang / skyes pa la skyes bsa'/ rus pa la rus bsa'/ gsus pa la gsus bsa' ltar grags pa yang / rjes 'jug dang yang 'jug sa ni pho yig yin zhing / phyi mar zhugs nas pa sgra bsa' ltar grags pa yin no//gnyis pa/ lugs ldog mthun 'gyur/lugs ldog mthun 'gyur ni/ ming gang gi cha shas phyi ma'i sgra yis cha shas snga ma'i sgra dang mthun par byed pa zhig ste/ de yang ming gang gi cha shas phyi ma'i sngon 'jug gi byed rtsol sdun la shor nas/ snga ma'i rjes 'jug gam ming gzhir zhugs nas sgra gdangs mthun par gyur pa yin1 dper na/ sa gzhi la sag gzhi dang / mda' gzhu la mdag gzhu ltar grags pa ni/ klog ma sgogs pa'i dbang gis/ snga ma'i 'a mtha' dngos shugs ci rigs kyi sgra thon yags ma byung bar1 phyi ma'i gas 'phul gyi sgra 'dres nas mthun par byur pa'i phyir yin/rgyu mtshan la rgyun mtshan dang / rgyal mtshan la rgyan tshan ltar grags pa ni/phyi ma'i sngon 'jug gi byed rtsol snga ma'i rjes 'jug la zhugs nas mchu btsums pa'i sna sgra thon byung ba'i phyir yid/dkyil 'khor la dkyin 'khor lhar grags pa ni/ phyi ma'i 'as 'phul gyi 464

sgra gdangs mthun par 'gyur tshul gyi gnad don gsal byed1sna sgra snga ma'i rjes 'jug la zhugs nas sgra de lhar gyur pa dang / mgo dkyil la mgog kyil lhar grags pa ni/ phyi ma'i 'phul dang ming gzhi gnyis ka'i sgra snga ma'i rjes 'jug tu zhugs nas sgra gdangs de lhar mthun par gyur pa yin no//gsum pa/ bye brag mthun 'gyur/bye brag mthun 'gyur ni/ byed rtsol kyi dbang gis/ ming gi cha shas gcig gi bye brag cha shas cig shos kyi tshab byas nas sgra mthun par 'gyur ba dang / cha shas gcig gi bye brag ste dbyangs brjes nas1 cha shas cig shos dang sgra mthun par 'gyur ba rigs gnyis yod de/ snga ma dper na/ dar ba la da ra dang /phyar ba la phya ra dang / 'phyur ba la chu ra lhar grags pa ni/ cha shas snga ma'i rjes 'jug ra de cha shas phyi ma'i tshab byas nas/ phyi ma snga ma'i bye brag tsam du sgra mthun par gyur pa lta bu dang /phyi ma dper na/ bu mo la bo mo ltar grags pa ni/ smad pa'i nga ro dang bstod pa'i nga ro mtho dman mi gcig pa gnyis myur du 'brel nas klog tshe/brjod mi bde phyir/ snga ma'i zhabs kyu phyi ma'i na ro dang mthun par gyur nas/sdeb legs par grub bo/ /bcu lnga la bco lnga dang / bcu brgyad la bco brgyad du bris pa yang / kha skad du grags pa ltar/ smad pa'i nga ro bstod pa'i nga ror gyur nas drang ba'i nga ro dang sdeb mthun zhing brjod bde bar grub pa yin no//465

dag yig rig pa 'ib ba ba mngon phyungabazhi pa/ yongs rdzogs mthun 'gyur/yongs rdzogs shā thun 'grur ni/ gzhi 'am tshig grogs gzhan dang 'brel ba'i ming gcig gi cha shas ba nyis myur du klog tshe1 phan tshun 'dres nas yongs rdzogs ka bcig tu gyur pa zhig ste1 dper na/ sgo nga/ sla nga / po ti/ cho ga sogs drus sgra bsdus nas gni dang thad mar spyar tshe/ bya sgong/ khro zang/gzhung pod/ grong cho༅ lhar sgra gcig tu mthun pa gyur pa sa1 de bzhin bris pa dang /byu ru/ rdo rje/ shes rab lha bu sogs tshig grobs dang spyar tshe/ byur dkar1phyag rdor/ sher 'od ltar sgra gcig tu gyur pa yin1gzhan yang / thu ba la tho' dang / 'phye ba la 'phyo' dang / mche ba la mcho 'a ltar grag sgyu pa so gas kyang 1 snga ma'i rjes 'jug ‘ra dang / phyi ma ming mtha' ba'i byed rtsol phan chun shan zhugs nas/ yongs rdzobs sgra gcig tu mthun par gyur pa yin no/1lnga ba/ nang gses zu thun 'gyur/nang gses mthun 'gyur ni/ ming gcig gi nang gses sngon 'jug dang ming bzhi'i byed rtsol phan tshun shan zhubs nas sgra mthud par gyur pa zhig yin la/ am ska da du sngo na 'jug lnga bo'i sgra'i zur mngon par thon pa'i dbang gis/ ming gzhi smor zhig sga klog tshul sngon 'jug ba sgra dang mthun par gyur 4kyi6

sgra bdangs mthun par 'gyur tshul gyi nad don bsal byed—— ba 'gro dper na/ sa'am la ba yan lhar klos pa ni/ sngon 'jug sa'i mgrin pa dang lce rtsa'i byed rtsol gyis/ ming ga'i zha yi ba nas dang byed pa'i phrad sa ltag mar brdzur nas1 sgra cung zad rtsi ba'i ya lhar grags pa'i phyer yin/bzhag la bal ga lhar klog pa yang / sngon 'jug ba yi byed rtso' gyis/ming gzhe zha yi lce rtse dang nye ba'i byed pa zan 'a1 reg pa dang bral nas— mchu dang 'brel ba'i ya lhar grags ba 'i phyir ro//dpa' shā1 dka' ltar klog pa ni1 sngon 'jug da yi lce rtse so rtsar phrad pa las mchu yi rtsa' ba med pa'i dbang mis/ ming gzhi pa yi mchu btsum pa 'i rtsol ba nyams nas hwa ltar grags nga1'i phyir yin1dbang la da wang lhar glog pa yang / sngon 'jug da yi byed rtsol gyis/ming gzhi ba ༷ nga so mchu ma reg pa tsam 'a sa rang cha dang ldan pa'i la lhar grags pa'i phyir yin/'bar la sna sgra dang ldan rdzu4'i par lhar klog pa ni/ sngon 'jug 'a yi sna sgra ming gzhi ba la zhugs nas 'ba' ltar grags pa'i phyir yin/'gyur lugs 'di shes na/ dbyen phra ma'i dbyen la g.yen ltar bris pa'i 'khrul ba mi 'byung ste/ dper na/ bya ba'i ming 'i dbye la jis 'jug na sbyar na/ dbyen zhes dngos po'i ming du stsar pa'i do na ma shes kyang / sngon 'jug da yi lce rtse so rtsar sbyar ba'i thi de1 lce rtsa mgrin par sbyar ba'i gas 'phul gyi sgra 67

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung /dang khyad par che bas nor dogs med do//drug pa/ phyi rol mthun 'gyur/phyi rol mthun 'gyur ni/ ming gang zhig phyi rol gyi phrad kang dang 'brel rung / rjes 'jug gi byed rtsol gyis phrad de nyid kyi sgra rjes 'jug rang sgra dang mthun par gyur 'gro/ dper na/ zhing la chu 'dren/ dmag la zhugs/ rgyal khab la phan 'dogs/ su la dga' sogs/ kha skad du/ zhing nga chu 'dren/dmag ga zhugs/ rgyal khab ba phan 'dogs/ su 'a dga'/ zer ba bzhin grags pa dang /bskor nas 'gro/ 'thab nas rgyal/ yong nas bsdad/ bsams nas bshad/ sogs la/ bskor ras 'gro/ 'thab bas rgyal/ yong ngas bsdad/bsams mas bshad/ ces grags pa lha bu'o//gzhan yang 1 yod do/ yin no/ bzang ngo/ lags so/ lta du rdzogs tshig gi thob thang dang / 'grig gam1 red dam/ shes sam/ go'am/ lha bu 'byed sdud kyi thob thang la sogs pa'ang rigs 'di'i khongs su gtogs so//mdor bsdus na/ bod skad kyi tha snyad phal cher ngag nas rjod pa'i tshe/sgra gdangs phan tshud thogs pa med pas/ so so'i gnas dang byed pa'i sbyor ba ji bzhin zur phyin par 'don lob byas na/ yi ger dag cha thon sla/ yin na yang/ tha snyad skor zhig zur phyung nas ma lhogs par klog tshe/ byed rtsol phan 468

sna gdangs mthun par 'gur tshul gyi gnad dan gas byedatshun thogs nas brjod mi bde bar gyur 'gro/ skyon 'di sel byed la/ ngag sga goms gshis las byed rtsol phan tshun shan zhugs nas/ sgra gdangs mthun par 'gyur ba'i srol 'di byung ba red/ srol 'di legs par shes na/ phyur ba la chu ra dang / srin bu la srin 'bu dang / kha jig la kha 'dig dang / lag ka la lag wa sogs su 'bri mi dpe'o/ /bod yig dang bod skad 'brel ji lhar chags pa'i zhib cha khong du chud nas/ yi ge bton na ngag gi nyams thon cing /brjod bya bris na yi ge'i dag cha thon pas/ bri klog kun la phan thogs che'o// //469

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung 1—sde tshan bco brgyad ba/ nyams mtshon ba'i zi snam par bshad pa/ba/zugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa/ /khyad gzhi gang gi khyad chos ji lha ba1/nye bar mtshon pa'i sgra rnams 'jub/ mkhas na//brjod bya'i don nyams mngon sum snang bar 'gyur//nyam sa mtsho na pa'i sgra ste1 nyams sna tshogs nye bar mtshon pa'i sga ni/ bod kad kyi khyad chos sgyu4chos tu gyur pa zhig yin/ tshig sbyo ra du nus pa thun mong ma yin pa zhig thon pas1 rtsom dang kha skad du 'jug pa ha cang mang 1 dper na/pad ma bka' thang zhes bgyi ba las/mkha' 'gro sde lnga gar byed shigs se shigs —nga —nga ———dri 'im spo sa kyi ngad ldang thu 'u 'u ——bing chen dpa' bos bro rdung khrabs se khrab — — ———ba — — mkha' 'gro bsang ba'i brda skad di ri ri ———— ma mo mal 'a 'gro smin dkar jibs se theb 6 nga ———470

nyams mtshon pa'i ku nam par bshadapa—ging chen dpa' bo'i shubs sgra kyi li le— —— zhes ba la sa / ging chen dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyi kar ba pa'i gar stabs dang / kang ba'i bro stabs/ brda skad dang 1 shugs sgra sogs mngon sum du mig mthong rna thos su byung ba lta bu dang / ri dwags kyi gtam nges 'byung pho nya 'a sa/sha khyi dang rngon pa rjes su bdas nas zin la khad par/ ri dwags de tsher phung zhig tu 'dzul nas/ mchi ma khram khram/ sug po thab thab/ skyi bung —— —— — ——— ——bung / dbugs snyed sted/ 'dar hril li li byas kyin 'dug pa'i tshe/nga — ——— —— —nga — —ces pa las/ ri rwags de bros nas gam du byung ba bzhin/ de'i dbu༅sa 'tshang tshul/ sub pa 'dar tshul1 skyi g.ya' tshul/ mchi ma shor tshul sobs mig lam༄ dngon par shar ba dang / 'jar gling g.yu la 'gyel las1de nas mi ngan snang mtho ma/ 1de ring btang ma mda' la 'gran/ /mda' mi 'phen tho gcig 'phen rgyu yin/ /gzhu mi 'gug brag cig 'gug rgyu yin/1gzhu yar 'khyogs 'brug sgra 'ur re 'gug /——— mar 'khyog pa glog dmar khyugs se 'gug /— —————— ——chang zung ser ba tha re 'gug /—

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung mda' mo thog lce 'bebs 'bebs byed//sgro gshog 'ur sgra dir re 'phen/ /—khyod gzugs phung brag ri gtor 'dra byed//zhes pa las/ mda' ltong rgyud la sprad cing gzhu bdungs shugs che la 'phong skyen pa'i tshul sogs1 glu blangs pa'i ngar skad las byung zhing / pha rol zil gyis non pa'i 'jigs nyams bstan byung ngo //gong gsal tshig gi 'phreng ba dag las rtags kyis mtshan pa dmas ni/nyams mtshon pa'i sgra yin/ nyams mtshon pa'i sgra rnams tshig tu 'jug mkhas na/ gtam smra ba'am/ rtsom rgyag par/ rngos sgra de rigs la brten nas/ tshig nyams dang don nyams mngod sum du bstan pa'i nus pa thon pas/ nyan mkhan nam klog mkhan dag brjod par bya ba'i yul de la dngos su zhugs pa bzhin du/ mthong thos dran reg gang ci'i snang nyams 'char ro/ /yin na yang /nye bar mtshon pa'i sgra'i skor/ sum rtags dag gsum gyi sgra rig pa'i gzhung rnams las/ ched du brjod pa med pas na/ deng gi gsar bu lo nyung rnams kyis de lugs legs par ma rtogs pas/ tshig nyams dang don nyams nye bar mtshon pa la/ zlos sgra de rigs 'jug pa shin tu nyung ngo / /skabs 'dir blo gsal dmas kyi dran pa bslang khul dang / skal ldan noms kyi de lugs kyi ro zung ba dang / nyams dpyad par bde ster ched/ nyams mtshon pa'i sgra dang 472

nyams mtshon pa'i sna rnam par bshad pa/khyad chos kyi ming gi khyad par dang 1 nyams mtshon pa'i sgra yi sbyor tshul dang byung tshul dang / nyams mtshon pa'i sgra yi gnad don 'ga' dang bcas pa bshad par bya'o//dang bo/ khyad chos kyi ming dang nyams mtshon pa'i sgra yi khyad par/khyad chos kyi ming dang / nyams mtshon pa'i sgra phan tshun 'brel ba dam yang don mi gcig ste— khyad chos kyi ming ni/ khyad gzhi gang rung gi khyad chos rjod pa'i brda yin te/ sgra rkyang du'ang don gyi ngo bo tsam ston thub/ dper na/drang ba/ gug pa/ 'dzig 'dzig sogs kyis dbyibs dang / dkar ba/ gsal ba/ mun nag sogs kyis kha dog dang / mngar ba/ kha ba/ bska ba sogs kyis ro dang / zhim pa/ dme ba sogs kyis dri dang / 'jam pa/ grang ba/ skom pa sogs kyis regazu dang / lci ba/ ring ba/ mtho ba sogs kyis tshad dang /bzang ba/ dpa' ba/ byams pa sogs kyis rang bzhin sogs kyi khyad chos bye brag pa kho thag cig bstan pa lha bu yin zhing / nyams mtshon pa'i sgra ni/ tshig sbyor du brjod gzhi dang 'brel ba'i khyad chos kyi zhib cha ji 'dra yin pa nye bar mtshon thub kyang / rang sgra yan gar ba tsam gyis don gyi ngo bo tsam ston mi srid do/ /sa paṇa gyis mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo zhes bya ba las/ khral khrol/ dar dir/cal cal/ chil chil la sogs pa la/ nye bar mtshon pa'i sgra zhes gsungs/473

dag yis rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung/———— ——yang /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dang 1 /sems las byung ba'i khyad par 'ba'1 /phyogs bcib1 nges par mi nus pa/ /sto na te nye bar sbyar ba'i sgra/ /de sogs sbyo ra ba'i ngag phal cher/ /nye bar ston na zlos sgra 'jug /ces gsungs pa lhar/ brjod par bya ba'i yul drug gang rung gi khyad chos zhib gsal ji 'dra yin pa/ nye bar mtshon pa'i sgra sbyar na don 'byor ba dang / ma sbyan na/ phyogs de tsam gyis nges pa ston mi nus shing / zos sna gang brngod bya'i chos dang ma sbyar na yang / spyi bam pa zhig las don gyi ngo bo gang yang nges par ston mi nus te/ dper na— mtsho chu sngo/ zhe na/ mtsho chu'i kha dog sngo ba tsam las/ dwangs nyog gi tshod mi zin mod/ mtsho chu sngo sang nge ba/ zhe na/ mtsho chu sngo la ha cang dwangs pa'i don 'byor ro/ /dar dmar rlung gis bskyod nas g.yo/ zhe da/ g.yo ba'i rnam pa ji 'dra yin pa mi shes mod/ dar dmar rlung gis bskyod nas lhab lhub g.yo/ zhe na/ g.yo ba'i rnam 'gyur mngon par mthong snang du bstan byung ba lha bu dang / zhwa mo rlung gis lhab be khur song / glo —bur du byung ba'i rnam pa bstan byung ba lha bu/ yang / sang nge dang / lhab be/474

nyams mtshon pa'i sgra rnam pa bshad paces pa dag brjod bya'i chos dang ma sbyar na/ don ci yang nges par bya mi nus pas/ brjod bya'i chos dang nye bar sbyar dgos pa lha bus gsal lo/ /gnyis pa/ nyams mtshon pa'i sgra yi sbyor tshul/nyams mtshon pa'i sgra yi sbyor ba rtsa ba bo gsum yod de/gcig ni/ sgra rigs 'dra gnyis mnyam du sbyar ba/ khyus khyug gul gul/rtsig lcig chi chil/ ljab lngab/ brtas brtas/ spud spud/ mog mog tsar tsar/lhung lhung / lha bu la sob/sa pa'o/ /'di rigs ni khyad chos spyir btang rags pa tsam mtshon pa yid/ khyad chos de dmas 'phros te1 zhib cha nye bar mtshon pa/dper na/ gul gul/ zhes g.yo ba'i rnam pa cung dal ba bar mtshams yod pa la/ gul lu gul lu/ zhes rjes 'jug rang la dbyangs rang 'dra zhig so sor sbyar ba dang / myur ba bar mtshams med pa la/ gul lu lu/ zhes gul phyi ma dor ba yin/ dir der/ zhes grags pa'i sgra bar mtshams yod pa la/ dir ri ——dir ri/ zhes pa dang / myur zhing bar mtshams med pa la/ dir ri ri/ zhes pa/ — ————sbyor tshul gong bzhin yin/ rjes 'jug gzhan rnams rjes 'jug ra la lhar lce rtse 'dar ba'i sgra med pas1 sbyor tshul gong gnyis dang mi 'dra/ dper na/ldem ldem/ zhes pa'i g.yo 'gul ha cang mgyogs pa la/ ldem ldem ldem1 zhes — —— sgra 'dra ba gsum lhan na sbyar ba dang / g.yo 'gul dal zhing bar mtshams yod pa la/ ldems se ldem/ zhes snga mar yang 'jug sbyar nas 'das pa'i tshul 476

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /—dang / phyi ma sor bzhag da lha ba'i tshul du byas shing / bar du se sgra zhig sbyar ba yin no1 /gzhan rnams kyang rigs 'gre'o/ /'di rigs kyi dper brjod 'ga' zhig drangs na/nyer nyer lha ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa yi/ /chil chil rlabs kyis bskyod pa'i spya mtsho'i chu/ /yang yang brag ri'i phug 'dir snyeg par brtson/ /kye kye phyogs 'dir ci zhig bzhugs ba phags/ /(po ta la kun tu dga' ba'i gtam las)(zung ldan la jig rtabs kyis mtshon pa dang / zung ldan min par 'khyugs rtags kyis mtshon pa)de nas phyin phyin gyur pa'i mtsho 'gram na rā mi rgan mgo dkar zhis sgas nya rgya btsugs —lcags kyu re yis nya re bzung nas su —skam la phyung nas ling ling 'phar gyin 'dug —— —(bka' 'chems ka khol ma las)kha ba'i 'dab ma lhab lhab tu chu kha babs pa sib mi btu thim song / (tsa ri sman rdzong las) bye ma'i thang chen po/ ri med pa/ rlung sgra 'ur 'ur/ 'jag ma kyur kyur/—nga 176

nyams mtshon pa'i sna rnam par bshad pamatha' thag ring bo na seng ldeng nags tshal tho re ba yod rwa lo'i rnam thar ———lasagasung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i bstan bcos phal cher la bltas pa tsam nas/'di'i don 'dir 'dug snyam pa 'bad med du lam lam 'char ba/ de gzham la bstan na/ go ba chen po blo yul da bde sang sang ba zhig 'char thub/ lam rim bla rgyud 'a sadage slong rnams tsha bas rmya ste/ lus skya seng seng bor gyur/ lung phran — nga che gas lasasrin po mkha' lding gser mig 'do rta yi thog tu yang 'dug dang /zhags nag lag la yang 'dzin zhe sdang gi so sgra khrom khrom/ ngo ya thod sha 'gu za shig shig mig rtsa dmar lhog lhog sna nas du rlangs thul le/kha nas me nga nga nga 'bar 'ur re/ srin gru spyang nas ngar ma la drangs nas glu 'di 'dra zhig nga blangs so//a bse'i khrab rdzong lasa'adug sa sdod pa mi tshugs myug myug mang— rang 'khor nang 'thab snying rul snying 'changs 'ong—snying nas mi da ga 'a stong stong ngu snying 'dod —— —sems na yeng yeng dun bun chob chod 'byungaX ——— nga 4 7

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /(pad ma bka' thang las)gser brdo' ba thos nas/ zhang drung bya ba'i byang ba gcig kyang ku/ser khar song nas/ gser long long du yong snyam nas/ kam me kam cu she brkos nas ———— ——— ba cang ma bud/(dpe chos rin chen spungs pa las)khyis pho rog ded nas phur ba ma zin par kha skyengs pa bzhin byas das/rdo la sna bsnams mchu 'thor/ don de mi da zhig yod pa bzhin byas nas/yul yul nom nom byas kyin log nas 'gro/ (dpe chos rin chen spungs pa —— ——bkas)gling gi lha bsang ba rnams zing long nge btang / dpal thul rnams kyes ba rang gi rta dang sna srab gang zin zing zing long long byed skabs/ ('dzam gling ——————spyi bsang las)the'u rangs g.yu 'phrul stag rgyal de/ /mi nag g.yu yi thor tshugs can/ /stag 'phru bcu gsum mgo la btsugs/ /rdzi smin sma ra kham pa 'phyang / /mig gcig mig brda ling nge ling / /—sna gnyer rba rlabs 'khrugs se 'khrug/—mche gcigs kha pho thams se tham/ /478

dag yig rib pa'i gab pa mngon zung /nab 'dug pa——shin tu bzang bas gnyug srings shig —(gso rig gi bstan bcos man ngag bka' rgya ma las)sems rnam g.yeng yi da bang du btang / lus kho nas khyo ro ro phyag 'tshal ———mdog byed pa ni/ rang gi lus por sdug gtad pa tsam las/ snying bo ci yang med pa/(klob chen snying tig yi sngon 'gro khrid yig las)sngon shig dang khyi shig gnyis kyis mi'i spyi bor su mgyogs sngon la bslebs pa des spyi bo nas za bar byas te/ shig gis rgyab nas yar gab gab ngal ma gsos par phyin/ khyi shig gis mdun nas yar spung re byas kyin lo nga bas nga rang mgyogs nas 'ong gi snyam gyin ngal re gsos kyin phyin pas/ sngon la shig gis spyi bor phyin pa yin lo/ (dpe chos rin spungs las)lta bu sogs so//gnyis ni/ sgra snga mar dbyangs bzhi gang yang med pa dang 1 phyi mar dbyangs bzhi gang rung zhig zhugs yod pa'i khyad par ma gtogs mtshungs pa gnyis mnyam du sbyar ba/ khyar khyor/ gyal lhol lngan lngin/ rnyang rnying / brang breng / rtsab tsub/ yar yer/ shar shur/ sar sor/ hral hrul/ lta bu la sogs pa'o/ /'di rigs ni khyad chos spyi tsam mtshon pa yin/ khyad chos de dmas kyi zhib cha nye bar mtshon pa 'a / dper na/ gom stabs mi brtan pa la khyar khyor zer zhing / phar tshur g.yo ba cung zad dal zhing bar mtshams yod pa la/480

nyams mtshon pa'i sgra rnam par bshad pa——khyar re khyor re zer zhing — sgra gnyis ka'i mtha' la rjes 'jug rang 'dra re la —'greng bu re sbyar ba dang / lan rer 'a sgo zhing lan rer mi 'khyod ba la/khyar— ma khyor zer zhing / sgra gnyis ka'i bar du dgag sgra re byin ba yin/ lug —khyu lta bu thar thor du snang ba la/ 'dus yod sa dang 'thor yod sa 'grams nas yod shā 'a / thar ma thor zer zhing / thor re ba du ma yod pa spa/ thar re ———— nga thor re zer te/ sbyor tshul kong bzhin yin/ gon rgyu lta bu so tsho min pa la/——rnyang rnying zer zhing / cung tsam rnying ba dang ha cang rnying ba 'ga' lhan na yod ———par/ hong ma lhang zer ba dang / rnying ba 'ga' re yod pa la/ rnyang nge rnying nge — —nga zer te/— sbyor chul gong dang mtshungs so/ /'di rigs kyi dber brjod 'ga' zhig drangs na/rkang byin pa'i gyad thung stobs bskyed kyang / 1khur lus po mi theg ling —ling 'dar/ /rten 'khar ba grogs su sprun na yang / /'gro gyal gyol 'khyor ——zhing ris 'ga' 'bub/ /(dbyangs can dga' blo'i dben par zo ba'i gtam las) lto gos ngan ngon gyis chog shes pa/ (thang stong rgyal bo'i rnam thar las)——gling lha tshar smin nag po'i mun pas g.yogs nas 'a ma ma mthong bar/lam gyi zur rdo pha bong khrab khrob kyi bar gseng du bsdad nas/ gdam e gsal gyi re ba dang / rjes gcod ra mda' yong dogs kyi blo mi bde kem kem 481

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /ngang mtshan mo der lus/(gdug pa spun bdun las)tshig ldab ldib spras pa da bar gzan/(hor gling g.yul 'gyed las)—————tshes bco lnga'i zla ba lta bu phyogs thams cad du ya yo 'khyag 'khyog med —par kyi ler yong ba/(klong chen snying zig las )ba sa 'bar 'bur shang shong zhig tu bslebs nas/ 'gro dka' zhing thang ——— —chad nas/ ngal gsos zhor bro zos/ der char ba zam me zim me lan re babs nas tsha gdung yal/ bde sang nge ngal sos/(gru gu go rdzong las)ba de bzhin du mig gis gzugs la bltas kyang / lang nge long nge zhig las/rang bzhin ci yin pa mi mthong ba'i tshe/ mig gi shes pa 'gags/ (klong chen snying teg gi sngon 'gro'i khrid yig las)slob sbyong byed na dpe char 'a le 'ol le tsam bltas pas mi chog (dag —yig gsar bsgrigs las) stag rgod khyung lding gis lag g.yon pas 'brong gi ra rtse la 'thams1g.yas pas ral gri lan gsum btab pas— ske dum mer bcad/ gzhan gnyis las gcig dpa' thul lngas mda' rub byas nas bsad/ gcig 'brong rgyas zhal dkar gyis zhags pa btab ste bzung ba na/ 'brong shugs che bas/ zhal dkar rta las lhung ste drad ma drud du byung ba na/ bye sras nas mda' brgyab ste —bsad/('jar gling g.yul 'gyed las)482

nyams mtshan pa4 sna rnam par bshad pa/khri tshang bza' mi'i lto rgyab gnyis kyi phyir/ /mi rje dge sdig las byed pa'i bya ba btsog /mi tshe yad ma yud kyi ngang la shor/ / ——chos med pha rol 'gro ba'i bya ba btsog /(zhabs dkar ba'i rnam—thar las)(khro thung)blon 'dan mas gang bshad thams cad phar bltas bar 'dum byed mdog bstan kyang / don la mi chung gi rgyab rtsa/ a khu nga la tshig zar rgyag nga —zur rgyag sha stag red snyam nas/ tshig pa shin tu zos te— ('jang gling g.yul 'gyed 'a sa) da khyod kyis tshig ngan dam dum zhig rna bas go na/ de yang mi bzod par khyod mi ngo mdangs 'gyur lugs/ kha ngan tshig ngan 'di gcig pu la ltos dab /—(zhabs dkar ba'i rnam zar las)yang nyid zhig nyams snang la mkhyen rab kyi bdag po rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dang / ngag dbang lha mo dbyangs— can ma gnyis kyi zhal gzigs pas/lha gnyis ka zhal ras 'dzum zhing bzhad bzhin du thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros te/ nam mkha' la thin lhar 'khrigs pa'i dkyil nas/ lha sku yig 'bru phyag mtshan thig le bum pa me tog cod paṇa smad sna 'dra ba/ gzhan yang ming mi thogs pa khra khra shig shig legs legs mang bo char ltar babs pa rang gi — 483

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon rgyur ———lus la sib sib thim pas/ bde stong gi rtogs pa bas gyis mi khyab pa ———nga 'phel nas / lus ban bun lang long shag shig tu gyur pa zhig byung bas/————nga ————(zhabs dkar ba'i rnam thar las)gcan gzan gtu po1nags kyi gshed ma tshogs/ 1'phral du bsal ba'i sha rus dam༄ma du/ / — ‘ mche ba'i sta res gcod pa'i thag thug dang / / khya1ga ldan khyag gis myos pa'i ngar ngur sgras/ 1brtan yang 'jig pa'i spu long zang zing byed/ /—(chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang rnam par rgyal ba la phul ba'i zhu 'phrin rig 'dzin pho nya las)lta bu sogs so// — gsum ni/ sgra gang 'tshams gcig gi mthar la/ rjes 'jug rang 'dra 'greng du can te/ ge nge de ka be me 'i re le bci dzags shig sbyar ba/ rog gesang nge/ phyag de/ lhan no/ thib pe/ ldem me/ dge 'i/ bar re/ com le/ rubs se/ lta bu rnams so/ /sgra 'di tsho brjod lha'i chos dang spya ra na1 gzugs kyi snang tshul/ sgra yi grags tshul/ 'gyur ldog byung tshul/ reg bya zungs dkal/ yid la shar tshul sod shes gsal bar bstan zub/ dper na/ g.yag rgad nag 'bo le —————ba zhig nged tshang gi nor khyu la 'ongs snang / zhes pa las/ nag 'bol le zer bas/ g.yag rgan de bongs che dang / cid pa nag la mthug cib ring ba zhig 484

nyams mtshon pa'i sga tsham par bshad payin par mngon no bya khyu 'ur dir re phur song zhe na bya rnams skrag nas nga nga —nga glo bur du gshog pa drag tu brdabs pa sgra dang bcas te 'phur ba/rga go ba'i rna rtsa dang / mthong mthong ba'i mig rtsar byung snang kar ro/ /tshar thul 'di yang nge 'jam me bkab na legs so /zhes pas/tshar thul de'i reg bya ji lha tre bkyi zhin du gsal bar bstan byung /pha ma dang bral nas yid skyo ting nge lus zhes pas/ drin chen pha ma dang kha bral nas yid la sdug snang dang stong sna nga cig car byung ba'i ngang tshul mngon par bstan pa/ lta bu sogs so/ /'di rigs kyi dper brjod 'ga' zhig drangs na/spre'u rnams ma 'cham par tshan pa bzhir chad nas gyes so/ der mes po sprel rgan gyis bu tsha bo yang tsha rnams la brtag gzhig byas pas/ tshan pa gcig ni sna ldong nge byas pa zhig byung nas/ ming rus ldong bya bar btags/—tshan pa gcig mgo se yang nge byas pa zhig byung nas/ ming rus se bya bar nga btags/ tshan pa gcig 'gram sha stong nge byas pa zhig byung nas ming rus nga stong bya bar btags/ tshan pa gcig 'tshub pa sgrug sgo re byas pa zhig byung —nga das/ming rus sgru bya bar btags/bka' 'chems ka khol ma lasaskra dang bo gser g.yu'i ral ba nyil le ba la/ phyis skya bo seng seng shig —sro'i ral ba nyil le ba byung bas/ mthong ba dang thos pa'i mi sem sa chung kun mchi ma 'chor ba dang / a khu dang a ne la lkog lab dir re ba byung rung —8

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung —'dzem med byas/(mi la ras pa'i rnam thar las)'u ga gi ske len pa la mig sngo ce re/ mchi ma khra tha re ro khyim du drud/(klong chen snying thig gi sngon 'gro khrid yig zlos) —ba ra po la du bsad pa'i sha tshil khrag tsa re rlangs pa phal le ba de la gtsang mar 'dzin/ (gong dang gcig pa)ston mor sha mar thud gsum shing tog la sogs pa bza' btung zhim dgu ma tshang ba med pa mdun du bshams/ gser gyi sder kha ser tshubs se/ dngul gyi sder kha ngang khrig ge rid chen sna lnga'i sder kha khra spu(1da pungs kad kyug kyug tu bsgrigs—/ rdorje rabar gling g.yul 'gyed las)lam 'gag cig tu mi ser po mig dmar lngib be/ ral ba dmar ser rkang ba'i thad ka mar nyil le slebs pa/ sbar mo gnam lcags kyi dam pa sngo seng nge rdo ba/ sna che zhing so no ba1 lag da gser gyi ral gri thogs pa gcig de rje/ dbye ma dkar po'i rnam thar las)ra 'dra 'chi bdag ya med de'ang / rang rgyud la zhe sdang gi me dpung bzod glags med pa zhig ches cher 'bar bas/ dom nab khyag gis rtsos pa ltar/ kha nas me lce 'ur re/ mig dmar khrag mtsho 'khyil le/ sna nas du ba thul lte/ so sgra gro yos 'cha 'cha'/ khros skad stag mo ngar ngar/(gdug pa byed bdun las)486

nyams mtshon pa'i sgra rnam par bshad pa—gzig 'phen gyis sha khyis sha ba mthong ba bzhin/ nye bar bcar nas shor dogs kyis mdung nag dug lce ngar ma de/ dam srid btsan rgyal 'bum thub kyi lto bar brdzud nas/ rgyab na mdung so sngo rgyang nge thon nas/ dar lhog rlung gis 'gyel ba ltar thul lo/ /(gdug pa spun bdun las)sa thog 'di na yod pa'i 'o skol thams cad 'chi/ rgan gzhon la ko rim med/ pho mo la bzang ngan med/ gzugs byad la legs nyes med par nges par 'chi zhing / nam 'chi cha med/ nye ba dang lab 'phro/ las kyi byed 'phro/gos kyi gon 'phro/ zas kyi za 'phro/ nyal mal lus chas lto phor yan chad 'phro long nge/ shul hang nge/ thab skor gyi gral nas ha re 'gro dgos te/ kho shi'o mo —— —— ——shi'o zer ba'i gtam gyi rjes shig min pa mi 'dug pas/ (zhabs dkar ba'i rnam thar las)nu zi nag po'i bzang bo mtshan mo me nyob la btab pas/ me sngo bun ne 'bar ba dang / (dri med shel phreng las)de nas 'jigs ye re skyo ting nger ljon shing gi mgor shing lo gcig gi ————ba 'og tu yibs te bzhugs/(bya mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod las)srin po dmag la chas pa lhar/ gdong dmar phyur re/ shes pa khro ling nge /—————rgyud tsub hrag ge rtag tu gzer gur re ba zhig byas1 (klong chen snying tig ———— ba las) lta du sogs so//487

dag yis rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung —gsum pa/ nyams mtshon pa'i sgra yi byung srol/nyams mtshon pa'i sgra yi byung srol shes na/ de rnams kyi tshig nyams dang don nyam kyis ji ma ji bzhin dpyis phyin par mjal lon pa dang 'jug mkhas par 'gyur ba ma zad/ sngar ma dar ba yang byung srol lhar spel thub par gdon mi za'o//sgra 'di rigs spyir khyad chos kyi ming dang /bya ba'i ming dang /dngos po'i ming sogs la brten nas byung ba red/gcig khyad chos kyi ming 'a brten nas byung ba/1khyad chos kyi ming zhig la rjes 'jug rang 'dra 'greng bu can zhig sbyar nas byung ba/ skye nga nga sos ka'i me tog 'dra/ mdzes pa'i yag gi ming mtha' pa'i dod du ge sbyar nas grub bo//bu mo'i lus ring yang shan ne ba zhig red/ drang ba'i gshan gyi gas 'phul dor nas/rjes 'jung dra 'greng bu can zhig sbyar nas grub bo/skrangs log hrem me tsha skyes/ gyong bar gyur ba'i hrem la rjes 'jug rang — 'dra 'greng du can me zhes pa sbyar nas grub ji lta bu sogs so//2khyad chos kyi ming zhig la rang sgra mtshungs pa zhig grogs su sbyar nas byung ba/lto gos ngan ngon tsam las longs spyod rgyu med/zhan pa'i ngan la rang sgra mtshungs pa na rjeng na zhes pa rjes su sbyar nas grub pa/ sa khod mi snyom 'bar 'bur mang yar 'phags pa'i 'gur la sgra rang 488

nyams mtshon pa'i sgra dam par ba da pa1—'dra dbyangs yig med pa 'bar zhes pa snga mar sbyar das grub pa/ dpe cha 'al le 'ol le tsam bltas pas mi chog zer ba'i rags rim tsam gyi 'ol la rang sgra yo med pa'i 'al zhes pa snga mar spyar nas grub pa lha bu sogs so//3 khyad chos kyi ming 'brel chags ba gnyis ma nyam du spyar nas byung ba1mdog gi dkar dang / mdangs gsal ba'i lhag gnyis mnyam du spyar nas/nya gang zla ba )kar lhag ge shar zer ba —sha rgyags pa'i brtas dang / dbyibs klum pa'i ril gnyis mnyam du sbyar dag/ byis pa brtas rim bo zer ba ———mdog sna 'dres pa'i khra khra dang / 'od gsal ba'i lam lam gnyis mnyam du sbyar nas/ me tog hūṃ lam lam zer ba lha bu sogs so/1gnyis/ bya ba'i ming la brten nas byung ba/ 1 bya ba'i ming zhig la rjes 'jug rang 'dra 'greng bu can spyar nas byung ba1 skra dgag la gser g.yu nyil le ba/— gzar sa nas mar 'dril ba'am ——'phyang bal nyil la rjes 'jug rang 'dra 'greng du can le zhes pa sbyar nas grub pa/gtsod rwa zeng nger skyes pa/ zeng ni gyen du 'greng ba'i gzing gi gas 'phul dor kas rjes 'jug rang 'dra nge zhes pa sbyar das grub pa/ 489

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /glog dmar khyugs se 'brug sgra ldir re/ kya kyur g.yo ba'i 'khyugs kyi —— 'as 'phur dor nas se sgra sbyar nas grub pa lha bu sogs so//2 bya ba'i ming zhig la sgra spyi rang 'dra ba zhig ya mthar sbyar nas byung ba/snang ba khral khrul tsam du zad/ 'phyugs pa'i 'khrul gyi 'as 'phul dor nas/sgra rang 'dra da pa'i khral zhes pa grogs su jer nas grub pa/chang gis bzi nas gom pa khyar khyor byas nas phyin pa/ lus tshugs mi ——thub pa'i 'khyor gyi 'as 'phul dor nas/ khyar zhes pa grogs su sbyar nas grub pa/rtsid che nas drad ma drud byed zer ba'i drad drud ni/ 'then das 'gro ba'i drud la rang sgra spyi tsam 'dra ba drad ces pa sbyar nas grub pa/ de'i bar la dgag sgra 'jug pa ni/ cung tsam cung tsam du 'drud pa'i tshul bstan pa lha bu sogs so//da bya ba'i ming gi sngon 'jug gam yang 'jug dor ba'i sgra gnyis mnyam du sbyar nas byung ba/ nga rgyal gyis bsnyems nas mgo bo krog krog byed/'drogs par byed pa'i dkrog gi das 'phul dor ba'i sgra gnyis sbyar nas grub ༷pa1dril bu sang nge sang nger grags zer ba'i sang sang ni/ gnyid dengs pa'am gnam thang ba'i sangs kyi yang 'jug dor ba'i sgra gnyis sbyar nas grub ༷490

nyams mtshon pa'i sgra rnam par bshad pa/ma —skrag nas sig sig 'dar/ skra'am spu sogs g.yo ba'i gsig gi gas 'phul dor nas grub pa/rgad po'i so bzang sran ma khrum khrum du 'cha' thub/ bcag nas khrol bur dkrums nas khrum pa'i khrum gnyis spyar nas grub pa lha bu sogs so/—gsum/ dngos po'i ming la brten nas byung ba/rdo zam cal le ba'i steng du chu bo'i pha rol tu bud pa/ gcal ni mthil ngos kyi ming ste/ rdo leb bteng ba'i mthil la rdo gcal dang / de bzhin pang gcal dang / lho gcol dang / ar gcal lha bu'i gcal gyi gas 'phul dor nas/ rjes 'jug rang 'dra 'greng bu can le zhes pa sbyar nas grub po// lung ba sha re shur rer bskung sla zer ba'i shar shur ni/ grog mo'i shur la rang sgra mu med pa shar zhes pa sbyar nas grub pa/ ༷sa 'bar 'bur shang shong zer ba'i shang shong ni/ dma' sa'i gshong (bu)gi gas 'phul dor nas ra sgra o med pa'i shang zhes pa snga logs su sbyar nas grub pa lha bu sogs so//—bzhi/ khyad chos kyi ming dang bya ba'i ming gnyis la rten nas byung ba/khur log rtsi tig ge ba zhig khur nas phyin pa/ yang mo min pa'i rtsi dang / 491

dag yig rig pa'i gab paXmangon sgyung /mar thig par byed pa'i gtig gi gas 'phul dor nas mnyam du sbyar bas grub pa/ khong gis dmar khrid gnangs pa las/ go ba bde sang sang ba zhig 'char thub/ thogs pa med pa'i bde dang / sad pa'i sangs kyi yang 'jug dor nas mnyam du sbyar bas grub pa/sto bar brdun nas rgyab tu mdung rtse sngo rgyang nger thon/ mdog gi sngo dang / bsring ba'i brgyang gnyis mnyam du sbyar te grub pa lha bu sogs so/—gong gsal nye bar mtshon pa'i sgra de rnams kyi byung tshul ma shes na/ bri la dag cha thon dka'/ dag yig ming mdzod la la dang / brtsams chos dmas su/de lugs kyi yi ge ma dag pa mang du mthong ste/ mgo bo lhog rtsog ldem la/ mgo bo krog kyog ldem/ rna ba cor cor byed pa la/ na ba rkyar spyor byed/ ling ling g.yo ba la/ lang lang g.yo/ lung khul sal sul la/ lung khul zal zil/ 'bar —'bur shang shong la/ 'bar 'dur zhang zhong / ldab be ldib be la/ ldab 'i ldib bi/ dam me dum me la/ dam mi dum me— gtsang sang nge la/ gtsang sing nge /—— nga — —'od chem me la/ 'od ma me/ zhes bris pa sogs/ sgra rags par 'dra yang /——zhib cha mi gcig sa'i dbye ba ma zud pa'i skyon yin/ sgra de rnams kyi byung srol legs par shes na/ mtshon don ji bzhin yi ge gang 'grig tu bri bar nus so/1493

nyam sa mtshon pa'i zad ma ra bshad pa—bzhi ba/ nyams mtshon pa'i da/ dang 'brel ba'i shes bya 'ga'/gong gsal gyi dper brjod rnams las/ nyams mtshon pa'i sgra'am glos sgra'i don gcig rkyang bris pa mi gcig pa dang / mtha' lo pa'am ba sbyar yod med dang / ge sogs spyor sa'i sgra snga mar mtha' rten yod med sogs zur tsam mthong la/ mthong nas kyang de rnams dag dang ma dag pa'i khyad par yin nam snyam pa las/ gang rta nges she na1 glo dur du bdar sha chod dka'/ dpe cha rnams las de lugs mang du mchis pa la/ mi bsi pa'i bya bar 'jug pa'i thog ma ba rnams kyi snang ngor som nyi'i phyang zag tu 'gyur srid pas/ dogs po bcod byed du/ don tshan lngar dril nas bshad na1— 1 don gcig kyang 'bri tshul mi gcig pa ni/ sdeb legs par spyod ba yin te/ ka'i dag kyug kyug me phung dmar khyug khyug ne'u sing sngo tsug gyug lha nga —— ——bu dag gi kyug kyug dang / khyug khyug dang / gyug gyug gsum gyi don gcig ste/kha dog da che/ par bkra nga'i nyams mtshon pa yin la/ ngag gi snyan cha 'don par rtags mtshungs pa sbyar nas/ drag pas drag pa dang / ran pas ran pa dang / zhan pas zhen pa drangs —das/ brjod pa ha cang bde bar byur song 1mtshan mo nag ting nge ba 'a / dgra dmag dmas 'jam jing nger gnyid pa'i tshe/zhes pa las/ ting snge rgyud nga / thing nge dag gi don ma snye/ snye ba'i ngang tshul 493

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngod phyub /te grag 'gul ci'ang med tshul mtshon pa yin mod/ sdeb sbyor du snga ma ltar spyar ba'o/ /ra na dar rtsog skya lhob be yod pa/ phug ron gshog pa leb be ———— —nga —bsgongs 'dug lha bu las/ —lhob be dang / leb be dag gi don 'dra ste/ leb mo'i dam pa mtshon pa yin/ sgra shed bsnyams nas/ lci na mnyam rtsi dang —/ yang na mnyam yang byas nas/ ngag snyan par gyur song / /tshang tshub kyi bskyar tshul mtshon pa la/ tshub be tshul be zhe na brjod mi bde bas/ — tshubs se tshub ces brjod bde bar grub pa dang / thar thor gyi bskyar tshul mtshon pa la/ thar re thor re zhe na/ 'dar sgra mang bas rtse rtse thogs pas dang / tha re tho re zhe na/ sgra zur chag pa'i skyon snang 1 tha re thor re zhe na/ brjod pa bde bar ma zad / skyon de dag kyang bsal ba'i bogs thon pa yin/ —gzhan rnams kyang rigs bsgro bar gyis shig — 2 ge nge sogs dang ri li sogs spyar sa'i sgra snga mar mtha' rten bris pa med kyang / don du yod yod pa yin te/ wa le ni/ lal le dang / sa le ba di —gsal le ba yin zhing / sgra snga mar rjes 'jug la sogs med na/ le sogs ——yong srol med pa dang / de bzhin gu lu lu ni/ gul lu lu dang / yo ro ro ni — —yor ro ro ste/ sgra snga ma'i rjes 'jug zur chag pa yid/ 'di 'dra'i 'bri tshul ———cung nyung / phal mo che zur thon pa ltar bris snang / des na gang ltar bris na legs zhe na/ mkhas pa phal cher gyis jis pa lhar byas na/ sgra zur mi nyams 464

nyams mtshon pa'i tho rnam par bshad pa/—pa dang / go sga ba'i phan thogs yod/ dper na/ rgyal srid sna bdun sngon mjug na re byung(pad ma bkal thang 'a sa)/ ces pa'i na re byung la/ nar re byung lhar bris 'dug na/ brgyud mar byung ba'i dod bde blag tu go ba/ lha bu'o/ / —da grags tshul rags pa tsam 'dra yang 'bri tshul lam sbyar gzhi mi gcig pa ni/ thi'i zhib cha ste rtsi yang sogs kyi khyad par gtod pa yin te/ ldir ri ri dang / dir ri ri/ grags tshul 'dra yang / sgra dzi zhing rgya che ba la/ 'brug sgra ldir —ri ri/ zhes dang / yang zhing gu dog pa la bung ba'i gshog sgra dir ri ri/ zhes — nga —pa lta bu dang / de bzhin du/ rta rgod po nyig dir re 'drogs song / bya khyu 'ur —dir re phur byung / dong tsho thag dir re sar lhung / lta bu dag las/ dir rer —grags pa 'dra yang / snga ma sgra shugs che ba dang / bar ma sgra mang bo mnyam du 'dres pa dang / rjes ma sgra gcig la yang zhing gsal ba'i khyad par yod pa rto bu sogs so// 4 glos sgra'i mthar pa ba po bo ci rigs shig sbyar nas yod na/ nyams gang ldan pa'i chos can de'i ngo bo mtshon mi dngos bo'i ming gi cha dab ldad pa yid te/ mos dar gos sham bu lnga brtsegs stengs / dri ma lcam me ba zhig gon —yod pas(rgya bza' kong jo khab tu bzhes pa las)/ zhes pa las/ dri ma lcam —nga me ba ni/ gos dri ma can gyi ming yid pa dang / pha bong la mda' rib be ba ————496

dag yig rib mgab mard jing —ban ni rgyal bo'i mda' yin(ka khol ma las)/ zhes pa'i mda' rib be ba ni/— nga ———————mda' zu pa can gyi ming yin pa dang / lto gos 'dzoms pa'i mi chog bzang ———bzang bo zhig dgos/ zhes pa'i bzang bzang bo ni/ zas bzang bo dang 1— ———— ——gos bzang bo'i ming yin pa rnams kyi shes byed ni/ zlos sgra de dag gi mtha' la ba'am bo sbyar ba'i mthu yin/ des da sa sgra'i mthar shā po ba bo gang 'tshams shig sbyar na1 bdag po'i sgra ru she sa—pha ran/ /sngar med gsar du sbyar ba na— /bdag po'i sna ru shes pa ran/ lngar med gsar du sbyar ba na/ /bdag po'i sgra ru shes par bya1 ka'i sa pa'i don kud la bsal bas/ bshad pa'i dgos pa med mod/ sgra de noms tshig thur bu zhig gi mthar spyar ba la bshad rgyu yod de/ tshig thung ngu zhig gi mthar spyar nas gang zag gi ming du grub pa/ bdag sgra dngos yin la/ gang zag ma yin pa'i mi du grub pa/ bad sgra cha 'dra ba yin te/brta zhod pa ka/ las dang bya ba 'grel ba'i tshig thung ngu zhig yin la/de mthar bo sbyar nas/ rta zhon pa bo zer na/ skya mi ste/ don gyi ngo bo ston pa'i ming du grub bo/ /de bzhin/ rtswa za ba ni tshig dang / rtswa za ba bo ni rtswa gzan gyi ming ngo / /shing dum 'don ma gsum ni/ grangs dang bgrang bya 'brel ba'i tshig yin zhing / sheng dum 'dom gsum pa ni/ ming du grub bo/ /'brug ris yod pa'i dkar yol ni1 rten da nga brted pa 'grel ba'i tshib dang / dkar yod 'brug ma ni ming ngo / /de bzhin du/ zla ba lham me zhe na/ khyad gzhi dang khyad nga —496

chos 'brel ba'i tshig dang / zla ba ltam me ba zhe da/ khyad gzhi dang khyad chos ngo bo gcig tu grub pa'i ming yin pa gsal bar mngon no/15 zlos sgra yin na nyams mtshon pa'i sgra yin pas ma khyab ste/ khrung khrung ni/ bya rigs shig gi dang / zhang zhung ni/ yul gru zhig gi dang / rtog ge ni/gtan tshigs rig pa'i ming lha bu sogs yod pa'i phyir ro// //

dka yig rig pa'i bab pa mngon phyung 1sto tshan bcu dgu ba/ mdzan brjod gzi yi 'phreb ba — ming phyub/ par byed pa'i mngon brjod ni//don ma tshon par mkhas pa'i ngab rtsa la te/—sgra snya na par rjod pa'i sdeb sbyor dang /1tshig mdzes par spras pa'i rgyan du'ang 'gyur//don gyi ngo bo ston pa'i ming du/ 'dod rgyal dang rjes grub ni/ yongs grags kyi ming yin te/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum spyi la 'jug pa dang / mngon par brjod pa ni/ yongs grags ma yin pa'i ming ste/ snyan dngags dang rtogs brjod lha bu'i sgyu rtsom du 'jug pa mang ngo //mngon brjod kyang rjes grub kyi ming yin mod/ dngos ming min gyi btags ming yin no/ /btags ming 'di rigs ming gi rnam grangs yin pas/med na mi chog pa med kyang / yod na don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i shul du nyams mtshon par tshig rgyan gyi nus pa dang / ro bro bar don gzhan 'dren pa'i nus pa dang / brjod bde bar sgra mang nyung dbang 'byor ba'i nus pa dang / zlos skyon sel bar rnam grangs brje ba'i nus pa ci rigs 'byung la—198

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreng ba/dper na/ nam mkha' la kun gsal bu mo zhe da/ gnam thang ba'i khyad chos ——— ——nga mtshon par ba zad/ gzugs can gyi rgyad yang nyan pa dang / khyi rgan la nor —skyong nor bu zhe na/ dga' ba'i nyams mtshon par ma zad/ rab btags kyi ——spyan yang nyan no/ /khyab 'jug 'a rgom gsum non zhe na/ des blo rig pas lha ————— — min stobs ldan bcom pa'i gtam rgyud snang ngor shar ba'i ro khyad par ba zhig bro'o/ /gla rtsi la sprul dug ce da/ gla rtsi sprul gdub pa 'joms byed yin pa ——shes pas/ lus la khyer na sbrul nye bar mi yong ba'i phan thogs yod do/ 1nyi ma 'jug sa tsheg dbar lnga'i dgos pa yod na/ nyin mo'i kha lo ba dang / bzhi'i ————— —dgos pa yod na/ srid pa'i sgron dang / gsum gyi dgos pa yod na/ 'jig ——— — — nga rten mig lha bu sbyar rung ste/ sgra mang nyung la thogs pa med pa'i rang dbang ——'byor ro/ /tshig snga ma las me tog yod la/ tshig phyi mar yang 'jug pa'i dgos pa yod na/ sgra bskyar ba'i skyon sel ched/ yid dga' zhes pa sbyar bas —'thus so// skad rigs phun sum tshogs pa kun la mngon brjod yod kyang / dam grangs mang shung dang 1 mtshon stobs che chung la jid par shin tu che'o/ /bod skad du mngon brjod ha cang khyab che/ grangs bgrangs na khri tsho lnga lhag yod/brjod bya'i chos la dam grangs du ma re snang / dper na/ nyi ma la ming gi rnam grangs nyis brgya nye ba dang 1 zla ba la ming grangs brgya dab bzhi bcu yod do/ —493

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phrengababade zhing snyan cha 'dzoms pa/ nyams mtshar zhing ro bro ba'i snyan dngags phul du byung ba zhig tu grub snang / gal srid 'chi med yul la lha gnas dang /shākya'i tog la shākya thub pa dang / rta bdun pa la nyi ma dang / kun bsal la nam mkha' zhes pa'i dngos ming sbyar na/ sgyu rtsal gyis dman pas/ don gyi cha nas dgod bro ba'i mtshar nyams thon yang / tshig thi cha na sa brjod bde ba'i 'jibs nyams thon dma'o//bod skad du mngon brjod rab tu mang la mtshon stobs che zhing / sgra rig pa'i rtsal las byung ba zhig yin pas/ rig gnas bcu'i ya gyal zhig tu brtsis nas ga tshigs su bzung yod/ ming myug par byed pa mngon brjod yin pas/mngon brjod legs par ma shes na/ ngag gi sgyu rtsal gyi brtsams chos rnams la bltas na/ mngon brjod mang bas ji bzhin 'o da ka'/ de lugs kyi rtsom zhig brgyab na/ tha snyad kyis dbul bas/ don nyams dang tshig nyams bdon dka'/de phyir mngon brjod shes na ming la mi rmongs/ zhes grags pa ni/ nyams myong las byung ba'i legs bshad cig yin no//mngon brjod la rnam grangs mang ba ngo mtshar che ba/ go rgyu mang ba/bsring bskum bde ba/ ming gcig don mang dang / don gcig ming mang bcas kye khyad chos dang ldan pas/ tshig phreng spel bar mang nyung ran tshod dang / brngod bya ji bzhin 'jug mkhas na/ brjod bde la ngab snyan pa1 don 501

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngod sgyung 1gsal zhing bcud che ba rtsal du thon la/ rtsom du 'jug ma mkhas na/ tshig skyon dang don skyon yang 'byung srid/ rtsom gang yang bzhan la bsta bar 'jug ched brtsams pa yin pas/ thog mar kha gsal zhing go bde ba zhig yin dgos/mdzan brjod ci thub kyis gang mang sbyar na/ skye bo phal gyis go dka' bar 'gyur bas/ dgos pa dang bstun nas ran tshod du 'jug dgos/ mngon brjod 'a dam grangasaXmang bas— gdam nga med par gang rung zhig spyar na mi 'phrod sa yod pas/ skabs bab kyi brjod bya dang bstun nas mtshon stobs gang che zhig sbyar dgos/ nam mkha' dper mtshon na/ gnam ngo dwangs shing sprin med pa la kun gsal zhes dang / char ba babs shul nam mkha'i g.ya' dag pa'am/ mtshan mor gnam ngo g.yu mdangs bkra ba la sngo bsangs ma zhes — —dang / dgung mo ban ma thang yags yin pa la rgyu skar lam zhes dang / gnam ———grur bsdad nas nam mkhar phur cing bag yangs pa la lha lam mam/ bya lam —— ——zhes dang / nam mkhar smin 'khrigs pa la srin lam mam/ chu mthongs zhes pa ——— ——ltar sbyar na/ gnas ska bas de'i nam mkha' ji 'dra yin pa mngon brjod rang las gsal bar snang bas/ gsal 'debs bya ba'i dgos pa med la/ tshig kyang brjid pa nyid du grub bo/ / mngon brjod kyi grub tshul sna tshogs yod kyang / rgyu mtshan gang la brten nas byung ba ni1 rnam par dbye ba'i rtsa ba yin/ rtsa ba la brten das khyad par 502

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phrengabapye na1 grub tshul gtso che ba rnam pa bcu gnyis yod pa gsham bsalaming can gang gi gtam rgyud byung rabs dang / /rten 'brel rang bzhin khyad chos gzugs da tsubs dpe/ /yon tan nus pa bdag dang spyod pa dang / /byed pa yul dus dam grangs la sogs pa/ —gsal bar byed ched mngon par brjod pa yin//grub tshul de rnams legs par rtogs na/ mngod brjod kyi don dang 'jug par mgo mi rmongs pa'i phan thogs yod do/ /da ni dbye ba de dag so sor dper brjod 'ga' re bkod nas bstan par bya'o//1 gtam rgyud dang sbyar nas btags pa/ dper na/ drang srong phur du la thigs pas bsangs/ zhes pa ni/ sngon lha gnas sum cu rtsa gsu ma par bram ze sarba 4 zer ba'i sgra mkhan zhig byung / des lha'i dbang bo brgya byin la sgra'i bstan bcos bslabs/ brgya byin gyis drang srong phur gu la bslabs te/ lha dmas kyi sgra'i ston par bskos pa na/ de nga rgyal che bas lha rnams kyis bsten dka' ba byung tshe/ brgya byin gyis phur bu la gser bum zhig bskur te/rgya mtsho'i chu bum pa gang longs gsungs pa lhar blangs/ de la ku sha'i rtses chu thigs gcig blangs nas/ sgra yi bstan bcos rgya mtsho tsam /kho bos shes pa bum pa gang / /khyod kyis shes pa chu thigs tsam/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rgya mchos 503

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon rgyung/thigs pa tsam gyi dpes phur bu'i dran pa gsal bar ba blangs shing / nga rgya'1 gyi snyems pa bsangs pas na1 thigs pas bsangs dang / lha'i bla ma zhes — — —— nga —grags so//brgya byin la mig stong can 'es pa/ sngon drang srong rga ta ma'i chung ma —gshol med ma ni/ gzugs mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba zhig yin la/ re zhig drang srong med shul du/ brgya byin gshol med ma yin la/ re zheg drang srong med shul du/ brgya byin gshol med ma la 'dod pa spyad du 'ongs nas lhan tu rtse thog go ta ma badzra bas pa dang / gshol med mas brgya byin khog la mid nas srus so/ /drang srong gis mngon shes kyis rig nas/ sgyug par bcug nas dmod bor ba bzhin du/ brgya byin gyi lus la dud med kyi mtshan ma stong du byung ngo / /brgya byin gyis zod gsol nan gyis zhus pa na/ drang srong gis mo mtshan de rnams zhi bar bya ba'i thabs med pas/ mig stong du sprul pa'i phyir ro1 tshangs pa la gdong bzhi ba zer ba/ sngon tshangs pas jig le mchog ma zhes bya ba'i bu mo mdzes ma zhig sprul bas/ de la chags nas/ de phyogs bzhir bskor ba na/ lha bde bar gdong bzhi byung / de steng phyogs su 'phur ba na1mgo gtsug nas gdong ba zhig byung / dbang phyug nam mkha' nas mthong bas ngo tsha ba'i dbang gis/ steng gi gdong ba sen mos bcad/ de nas tshangs pa la 604

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreng ba/gdong bzhi yod pas/gdong bzhi zhes grags pa lha bu sogs so//2byung rabs dang bstun nas btabs pa/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la zas gtsang sras zhes pa ni/ sngon rgya gar gyi rigs rgyud las byung ba'i rgyal bo zas gtsab zhes bya ba'i sras su 'khrungs pa'i phyir ro//'dab chags spyi la sgong skyes zhes pa/sgo nga las byung bas so//— nga rgya mtsho la rin chen 'byung gnas zhes pa/ de las mu tig dang byu ru la ————sogs pa byung bas so/da rten 'brel gyi sgo nas btags pa/nyi ma la pad ma'i gnyen zer ba/————me tog pad ma nyi ma shar ba na 'dab ma'i 'dzum grol ba'i phyir/rgya mtsho la zla ba shar ba na/mtsho chu rgyas par 'gyur bas/zla bas 'phel —zer/nyi zla sgron ma dag la nun pa'i dgra zhes pa/ de dag gi 'od zer gyis ———sun nag med par btang ba'i phyir/4rang bzhin la bltos nas btags pa/ nyi ma ni me las tsha zhing 'od stong 'bar bas na/tsha zer can zhe'o//rlung ni yang 'ing g.yo ba'i bdag nyid yin pas g.yo byed zerasgyug ma ni me tog gad nas 'bras bu thogs pa dang / 'jig par gyar bas / 'bras dus 'jig ce'o//50

dab yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon jing /5khyad chos la bltos nas btags pa/ spyan ras gzigs kyi phyag mtshan du pad dkar bsnams shing yod pas/ phyag na pad mo dang /——pad mas mtshan dang /pad dkar 'chang ba dag tu grags pa'o//—nga —— nga zla ba ni/'od dkar zhing gsal bas 'od dkar can zeramatshan mo ni/nun nag 'jibs pas mun pa can zhe'o//6gzugs dbyibs la bltos nas btags pa/ glang bo che ni sna ring zhing zhags pa btab pa bzhin ci yang zin pas sna zhags can zhes so//sprul ni/lce nyis mtshe yin pas lce gnyis pa zer/tsong ni khog kun tu stong bas kun dong zer/nga —7dpe'i sgo nas btags pa/sgron me ni khrim nang gsal bar byed pa'i go chod bas / nor bu'i gzugs su bkod nas/khrim gyi nor bu zhes grags/chu ni/nyal nas 'gro ba'i tshul du snang bas nyal 'gro zer/'ja' nam mkhar shar ba/ lha'i dbang bo brgya byin gyi gzhu ltar snang bas/dbang bo'i gzhu dang /brgya byin gzhu zhe'o//nga nga — ——8yon tan la brten nas btags pa/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs ni shes bya thams cad me long du gsal bar snang ba bzhin du gzigs pas ye shes me ——long dang /ye shes mdzod ce'o//—nyi ma 'od kyi phung bo yin pas/snang ba'i mdzod dang /gsal byed ce'o//— ——606

mngon brngod gzi yi 'phreng ba/zla ba ni/chu shel lhar gsal zhing/ mig la sman pas/ man shel zhes ——pa'o//9nus pa la bltos nas btags pa/ sgrol ma ni 'gro ba rnams sdug bsngal las skyob par mdzad pa'i phrin las myur bas myur skyob ma zhes gsol/—nga me la nor las rgyal zhes pa/'di dngos po gang la thug kyang /bsregs —nas tshig pa'am/bzhus pa'am/nyams par byas pa'i phyir/gla rtsi la dug sprul gzhom pa'i mthu yod pas sprul dug ces grags/ ——1༷bdag po'i tshul du snang ba'i cha nas btags pa/ sa gzhi ni srog chags/ rtsi shing / gter ros sogs bdag tu bzung ba'i tshul gyis nor —'dzin zer/—phyag rdor ni gsang sngags kyi mdzod 'dzid pas na/ gsang ba'i rgyal — —dang /gsang ba'i bdag por grags/—gzhon nu gdong drug la lha'i dmag dpon zer ba/des lha dmag dmas — —drangs nas lha ma yin dang 'thab pas/ khrung khrung dang / sgrol byed sogs bsad pa'i phyir ro//11spyod pa la bltos das btags pa/ khrung khrung ni ston mjug 'tshogs nas sa cha dro sar gshar nas 'phur bas/gshar skyod/ces dang /— —pha wang ni sngon dud 'gro dang 'dab chags 'thab pa na/ pha wang gis 07

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung rgyang nas bltas shing /dud 'gro rgyal ba na/dud 'gro'i phyogs su bud nas rka lag dang so bstan nas/kho'ang dud 'gro yin zer/'dab chags rgyal ba na/yang 'dab chags phyogs su bud nas/ gshog pa bstan te/ kho yang 'dab chags yin zer/ phyis su dud 'gro dang 'dab chags 'dum par byur nas/g.yo sgyu can la blo gtad med/ ces phyogs gang gis kyang rig mi nyan par gyur pas/g.yon ma zhes dang /——sprung nag ni sems can gyi lus rmas byung sar 'tshangs nas rnag khrag 'ju ba dang 'bu gtong bas rmas sar 'tshang zhes pa lha bu'o//———12byed pa gtso pha' la bltos nas btags pa/srin po ni mi ro sogs zas su za bas ro zan zer/——zla ba la bsil sbyin mkhan zhes pa/ de shar ba na tsha gdung sel bar ———'gyur ba'i phyir/mig ni lta bar byed pa yin pas lha byed zer zo//—13yul dang ba bya la bltos nas btags pa/lha yul la 'chi med gnas sam 'chi med grub pa'i gnas zhes pa ni/ lha ni tshe ha cang ring ba'i — ——— —dbang 'byor ba dang /khong tsho'i bzhugs gnas yin pa'i phyir ro//sdig pa rwa tsa la rdum gyis nyen pas/ rdzum 'joms dang / mar gyis nyams byed zer/—nga —608

mngon brngod gzi yi 'phreng badri rnams rlung la brten nas phyogs phyogs su 'thul bas/ rlung la dri'i —ba'on pa zhe'o//—nga gzugs ni ba lha bar bya ba yin pas blta bya zer ro//——14dus tshod la bltos nas btags pa/dpyid ka ni drod babs pas/rtsi shing skye zhing me tog bzhad pa dang /skye 'gro'i 'dod pa'ang 'phel bas na/'dod pa'i dus zer/——khu byug ni dpyid ka drod babs dus sa mgo mtho sar yong zhing grag pas/dpyid kyi pho nya zhe'o//nga nga 'brug sgra ni dbyar kha 'byung zhing rnga lhar grag pas dbyar rnga zhes pa'o//———15rnam grangs la bltos nas btags pa/ nyi ma ka ka ba na dbar ba bo'am/rta bdun pa zhes pa ni/nyi ma'i shing rta 'dren pa'i rta ni/rlung dang /—yid 'gyogs/mdog lnga ba/thig le can/nges brjod/shin tu rgyal mtshan/ri 'joms bcas bdun yod pas so// zla ba ni cha zas bcu drug gis nya gang bas/bcu drug cha zhes so//———sgog pa la ro drug las lan tshul ro gcig chad sa/ro gcig chad ces ———pa lha bu sogs so//mngon brjod rgya mtsho'i zhun thigs las go dka' sla dang / bkol sa che chung ci rigs yod pa brjod kyis mi lang ngo / /skabs 'dir cung zad go —09

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /dka' yang nyer mkho che ba skor zhig rigs gnas 'dir tsha gdung skom pa chu 'dod lhar dga' ba'i gsar bu ba rnams la ngo sprod kyi tshul du bkral ba ni/shes brjod 'jug gsum du phan 'dogs khul byas pa yin/don tshan dang bo/ mtho ris kyi sde yan lag dang bcas pa bshad pa/dang bo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i skor/sangs rgyas spyi'i mtshan/ ji lta ji snyed kyi chos thams cad lag mthil gyi ri mo lhar mngon sum du gzigs pa'am mkhyen pas na/ kun gzigs dang /kun mkhyen zhes grags/————nyon mongs pa'iXbadud/ phung bo'i bdud/ 'chi bdag gi bdud/ lha'i bu'i bdud bcas/ bdud bzhi las rnam par rgyal bas rgyal ba zhe'o//—mig gi dang / rna ba'i dang / sngon gnas rjes dran gyi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi dang / gzhan sems shes pa'i dang / zag zad kyi mngon shes drug dang ldan pas na/ 3da —kab ba ldan zhe'o / /bdud bzhi rnam par bcom pa dang / /dbang phyug dang ni gzugs bzang dang / /dpal dang grags pa ye shes dang / /brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa ste/ /yon tan drug dang ldan pa dang / /'khor ba las ni 'das pas na/ /bcom ldan 'das zheb1 gsungs pa'o/ /——————510

mngon brngod gzi yi 'phreng ba1gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang 1 las kyi rnam par smin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / mos pa sna tshogs pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / khams sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs dang 1 dbang bo mchog dang mchog ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / thams cad du 'gro ba'i la mo mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang dam par byang ba mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / sngon gnas rjes dran mkhyen pa'i stobs bcu mnga' brnyes pas/stobs bcu mnga' ba zhe'o1/chos dbyings de bzhin nyid kyi ngang la rtag tu bzhugs pas na/ de —bzhin gshegs pa zhe'o//thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la bde bar gshegs pas/ bde ——gshegs zhes so//—nga gdul bya rnams sdug bsnga' gyi gnas las dge ba'i phyogs su nom par 'dren pas na nom 'dren du grags so//——rdo rje 'chang gi mtshan/ sku mtshan dpes spras pa dang / rang snang gi rig ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba dang/ lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen po dang ldan pa dab /rar bzhin med pa'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa dang / thugs rgyud snying rje chen pos yongs su gang ba dang / 'khor ba ma stong bar du sku'i 511

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung —rigs rgyud mi 'chad pa dang / 'gog pa med pa bcas kha sbyor bdun dang ldan pas/ kha sbyor bdun ldan zhes gsungs/theg pa chen po'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i mgon po yin pas/'khor lo'i mgon po zhe'o// ————nga gams nges pa 'og min stug po bkod pa kho nar bzhugs pa/ sku nges pamatshan dpe yongs rdzogs kyis spras pa/ 'khor nges pa byang sems 'phags pa sha stag gis bskor ba/ chos nges pa theg chen gyi chos 'ba' zhig gsung ba/dus nges pa 'khor ba ji srid bar du bzhugs pas/ nges pa lnga ldan zhe'o//dang bo sku nyid kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dang / rdo rje'i rigs dang / rin po che'i rigs dang — pad ma'i ribs dang / las kyi rigs te sprul ba lngar gyes/ de nas de re re las lnga rer sprul bas nyer lnga byung / de tsho yang bzhi rer sprul bas brgya tham pa byon pas/ rigs brgya'i bdag po zhes grags —so//shākya thub pa'i mtshan/ sngon rgya gar gyi mang bkur gyi rgyud las rgyal bo brgya tham pa byung ba'i mtha' ma rna ba can gyi bu che ba go ta ma drang srong mdog nag la rab tu byung ste/ lo ma'i spyil bur gnas pa'i tshe/ g.yo can pad ma'i rtsa lag gis smad 'tshong ma bzang mo dga' mgur spyod pa'i dus su ma slebs par khros te bsad nas/ ral gri khrag can go ta ma'i spyil du'i nye 'dabs su 512

mngon brjod gzi yi 'byung ba/bor ba'i rkyen gyis1 go ta mar nyes med khrims chad phog ste gsal shing la bskyon pa/ khams kyi dwang4ma babs nas bu ram shing thog lhung bas/ 'ing des sa bon bzung zhing / nyi 'od kyis bskyangs pas/ khye'u zhig byung bas/ bu —ka ka shing ba dang / bhe ma'i gnyen dang / nyi ma'i rgyud dang / 1 ta ma zhes rigs rgyud kyi mtshan de lhar thogs so// —shākya'i rigs rgyud de'i nang gi mchog tu gyur pa yin pas na/ shākya'i khyu ———mchog dang / shākya'i rgyal bo dang / shākya'i tog dmas su grags so//— ———— bskal pa bzang bo 'di la sangs rgyas stong 'byon pa'i nang gi bzhi ba yin pas/ dam 'dren bzhi zhe'o1/tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha rnams la chos ston pa'i bla ma yin pas/ lha'i —bla ma che/sa so//——spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan/ srid pa'i skyon gyis ma gos pa mtsho'i byed du phyag na pad ma dkar po bsnams pas/ phyag na pad mo zhes gsungs/rgya gar lho phyogs kyi po ta la ste/ ri bo gru 'dzid du bzhugs pas/ gru —'dzin bdag po zhe'o//'dod khams dang / gzugs khams dang / gzugs med khams gsum gyi mgon po yid pas/ 'jig rten gsum mgon dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / 'jig rten mgon po dag tu grags/— nga 513

dag yig ris pa'i gab pa mngon phyung dmigs med brtse ba'i gter chen yin pas/ brtse ba'i gter dang ————snying rje'i gter dang /thugs rje chen po zhes so/——— —————'gro ba kun la thugs rje'i bdud rtsi char lhar 'bebs pas/ bdud rtsi ——— char ldan zhe'o//————'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mtshan/ rnam pa kun tu gzhon nu'i tshul du —————nga nga ——bzhugs pas/'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang /gzhon nu'i sku dang /—nga nga —byis pa'i brtul zhugs zhes so//————nga ——smra ba'i khyu mchog gam rgyal bo yin pas/ ngag gi dbang phyug dang / smra ———— —ba'i rgyal zhe'o//— —blo gros la 'dzad mtha' med pa nor bu'i gter mdzod lta dur thur pas/blo yi gter zer/———shes bya thams cad me long las gsal bar snang ba bzhin gzigs pas/ye shes me long dang /ye shes mdzod dang /ye shes sku zhes so/—— nga ——— —nga ngag gi dbang phyug gi go 'phang rab tu brtan cing phyag zhabs sogs su 'khor lo'i ri mo'i mtshan bzang dang ldan pa'i cha nas brtan pa'i 'khor lo zhe'o/—dbu skra lan du lnga bcings nas yod pas/zur phud lnga bar grags so//sngang rdo1 nga hūṃ/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi mthu stobs gcig tu 4

mngon brngod gzi yi 'phreng ba ba/bsdus pa'i bdag nyid yid pas/ mthu stobs bdag dang / mthu chen thob —ce'o//gnod sbyid sogs kyi rje bo yin pas/gnod sbyin sde dpon zhes so//nga gsang sngags kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bdag po yin pas/ gsang ba'i bdag ces gsungs//——byams pa'i mtshan/ khong gi bzhugs gnas dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin yid pas/dga' ldan bdag dang /dga' ldan gtso bo zhe'o//nga nga rgyal ba byang chub sems dpa' dam pa tog dkar gyi tshab tu bzhugs pas/rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab bam rgyal tshab ce'o//——bskal pa bzang bo 'dir sangs rgyas stong byon pa'i gras kyi lnga ba yin pas/rnam 'dren lnga ba zer/thug byams pa chen po dang ldan pa'i gzu bo yin pas/ byams ched — —mgon po zhe'o/das pa tog dkar gyi rgyal tshab tu bskos pas/ lha dmas kyis bdag cag mi pham mo zhes brjod pas/ mi pham pa dang / mi pham mgon po zhes ——— ——gsol//sgrol ma'i mtshan rgyal ba kun kyi yum yid pas/ rgyal ba'i yum dang /——— —rgyal ma zhes gsung /nga —6

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /spub pa bo rnams la mchog gi dngos grub ster ba'i ma lha du yin ba sa — mchog gi ma dang /legs sbyin ma zhe'o/———sha za rkun po lcags sgrog dang //seng ge glang chen dug sprul dang /me chu 'jigs pa brgyad skyob pas/ /'jigs brgyad skyob ma dang / 'jigs pa nga brgyad las sgrol bar dpa' bas/dpa' mo zhes so//chos dbyings kyi dpal rtag tu rol bas/chos kyi dpal mo zhe'o//byang chub sems dpa' spyi'i mtshan/rgyal bas dgongs pa bla da med pas nga nga nga nga bskyangs pas theg pa sems bskyed kyi rgyud dang ldan par gyur pas/rgyal ba'i thugs sras dang /rgyal ba'i rgyud dang /rgyal ba'i gzhi dang /rgyal ba'i myu gu ——— ——— — —rnams su gragasargyal ba'i dgongs par rab tu bsten nas zeg chen skyes bur gyur pas na chos las byung dang /'phags mchog dang /'phags pa chen po dag tu —grags so/nyon mongs pa'i bdud las nom par rgyal bar byed pas/rnam par rgyal —byed ces so//—dbyangs can ma'i mtshan/ sngon lho thugs kyi rgya mtsho chen po rlung gis ——————————g.yos pa las/brtan g.yo'i sgra skad chen po snyan par grags par/tshangs pa chem pos sgra de la mngon par dga' zhing ro myong bar 'dug go mthar sgra 66
