mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreng ba/dbyangs de rnams gcig tu 'dus pa las lha mo 'di nyid byung bar grags 'di'i yum gyi dod rgya mtsho dang /yab kyi dod tshangs pa yin pas/rgya mtsho'i —nga bu mo dang /mtsho ldan ma dang /mtsho byung ma dang /tshangs pa'i bu mo dang /— —— ——— ——————tshangs sras ma dang /tshangs byung ma dang / tshangs ma sogs su grags so/—— ——zla ba rgya mtsho las byung ba rig byed kyi gtam rgyud du grags pa dang /de'i rjes su lha mo 'di byung bar bshad bas/zla ba'i sring mo zera'adi'i bzhin mdangs zla ba ltar dkar zhing mdzes pas/ zla mdzes ma —— —dang /dkar ma zhes grags/ 'di'i gsung dbyangs ha cang 'jam la snyan zhing 'jibs pas/dbyangs kyi rgyal mo dang / ngag gi dbang mo dang / sgra dbyangs lha mo dang /——ngag dbang lha mo dang /smra ba'i lha mo sogs su grags/——'di yang shes rab kyis rab tu phyug pas/ shes rab lha mo dang / blo —gter ma zhe'o//dzam bha la'i mtshan/ rgyu nor gyis rab tu phyug pa'i lha yin pas nor lha nga nga —— nga dang nor gyi dbang phyug dang /nor bu bzang bo zhes grags/— —sangs rgyas kyi sku bsrung bar lhas sbyin gyis snyegs rdos lus rmas pa'i gdung ba chu rgyun gyis sel ched/chu la gnas pas/chu yi dbang bo dang /chu'i ———— — thub pa zhe'o—— 67

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /nyan thos kyi mtshan/tha mal rang ga ba'i spyod pa brtul nas/thun mong ——nga ———ma yin pa'i spyod par rab tu zhugs pas/brtul zhugs dbang bo zhe'o//—thub pa'i dbang bo'i gsung thos nas mngon rtogs rnams skyes pas/thub dbang ga nga skyes she'o// ————thos pa dmas gzhan la bstan cing sgrog par mdzad pas/ thos sgrogaces so/rang rgyal gyi mtshan/rgyu rkyen gang rung zhig dang phrad tshe/don de'i ngo bo nga nga nga —rtogs pas/rkyen gcig rtogs zer/—slob dpon la ma bsten par rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i chos nyid sgom par byed pas/rten 'brel sgom zhes so//— de lhar bsgoms nas gang zag bdag med dang / chos bdag med zud tsam rtogs te/rang byang chub mngon par brnyes pa'i dgra bcom pa yin pas/rang sangs rgyas dang /de nyid rtogs 'bring zhe'o//————de yang theg pa dman pa'i dgra bcom pa yin pas/ sangs rgyas 'dzing bo dang /theg 'bring skyes bu zhe'o// — nga nga rang nyid gcig pur dka' thub la gnas te sangs rgyas spub pa/ ri dwags bse la rwa gcig yod pa'i dpe bzhin du/bse ru'i rgyal ba zhes grags/sgom tshul 'di las/gcig pur spyod dang /rang byang chub dang /rang zhi — nga 68

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreng ba/don gnyer zhes 'bod pa'ang byung ngo /gnyis pa/lha dang lha yul dang bcas pa'i skor/lha yul gyi mtshan/ lha rnams la'ang skye gnas 'jig pa'i skabs gsum ——————yod pas/skabs gsum gnas she'o//tshe ha cang ring bar dbang 'byor ba'i lha rnams kyi bzhugs gnas yin pas/'chi med grub pa'i gnas dang /'chi med gnas zhes bya'o//mtho ris kyi rim pa mtho shos gsum pa lha yin pas/ lha gnas la gzhi —gsum pa zer/tshangs pa dang /khyab 'jug dang /dbang phyug gsum gtso bas lha rnams rtsed pa'i 'dun sa yin pas/sum rtsen nam/sum rtsen yul lam/sum rtsed —— — —'dun sa dag tu grags so//—lha spyi'i mtshad/lha rnams kyang skye gnas 'jig gsum gyi bdag nyid yin —————pas/skabs gsum pa zhe'o//dge bar skyes pas na/dge skyes dang /dga' ldan dang /bde 'gro zhes —so//rtag tu sad nas 'dug pas/rnam sad dang /gnyid med dang /mig mi 'dzum dang mi lam med ces grag / — —nga — —— —9

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zungasngon lha dang lha ma yin dmas kyis rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las/lha mo dpal cho byung ba khyab 'jug gis khyer zla ba byed pa byung ba dbang phyug gis spyi bor rgyan du byas/dug bum pa gang byung ba dbang phyug sis mgrin par bzhab pas mgrid pa sngon por song /chang bum pa gang byung ba lha rnams kyis khyer/chang rnams lha la dbang ba'i cha nas/lha la bcud ldan zhes grags/lha ma yin la — ——chang ma thob pas/bcud mi ldan zhes ming thogs/——rgya mtsho bsrubs pa'i byung ma yod tshad lha rnams kyis khyer bas/ lha dang lha ma yin ma 'grigs par so sor gyes das 'thab 'a ga byung bas/ lha la lha —min dgra zhes so//—lha rnams bdud rtsis 'tsho bas/ bdud rtsi skyes dang / bdud rtsi can — —dang /bdud rtsis zas she'o//lha rnams khros pa'i tshe dmod pa'i ngag la nus pa che la mda' dang mtshungs pas/tshig mda' can dang /ngag gi mtshon cha zhes so//—mgrin pa dang phyag zhabs rnams su bkra shis pa'i ri mos mtshan pas/legs bris she'o//——sor mo la sogs pa'i tshigs rnams rab tu mdzes pas/ tshigs bzang ———zhes so//khyab 'jug gi mtshan/ lha drag po mchod pa'i phyir du pad ma dkar po 520

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreng ba/stong gi gzugs byas pa la/ drag po de las gcig mi snang bar byas pas/'dis mig gcig phyung nas— pad ma dkar po'i gnas su bzhag pas/ pad —dkar mig dang / dkaraXldan zhes so//—— — —mkha' lding gi rgyal mtshan zhig thogs pas/ mkha' lding rgyal mtshan zhe'o/1—— ——lab na 'khor lo zhig yod pas/ 'khor lo'i phyag zer/——————rtag tu sos ser po lhon pas/ gos ser can dang / ngang ba can zhe'o/1————— —lha mi dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi gtso bor gyur pas/ 'gro —ba'i tog zer/bskal pa 'chags pa'i dus su/ 'dis skye dgu sna tshogs ba'i ba par 'dod nas/ dang bor chu bskyed/ de la sa bon 'phangs pas gser sgong zhig byung ba las tshangs pa 'khrungs/ tshangs pas snye 'gro rnams skye bar byas pas/khyab 'jug la dang bo'i lha dang / dang bo'i pha zhes grags/'dir lha ma yin stobs ldan dang / sgra gcan sogs kyis mi thub pas/gzhan gyis mi thub dang / ma pham pa dang / rgyal dka' zhes grags/de rnams bsad pas/ rgyal byed dang / lha min 'jom dang / lha min dgra bo dang / dug gi lag pa sogs su grags/ ————— ——lha ma yin stobs ldan dang 'thab pa'i mkhos ka bral nas/ mi'u thung gi gzugs su sprul nas/ sa gzhi gom pa do bslangs pas gsum yang khyer zer 531

dag yig rig pa'i bab pa mngon sgyung 1bas/ lus bskyed de ri rab dang rgya mtsho'i mthil la gom pa gnyis bzhagagacig sgas med pas stobs ldan gyi mgo la bzhag nas rgyal bas/ gom gsum — non ces so//———'dis 'jig rten gyi bya ba bsgrub pa la/ nya ru sprul nas rig byed bzhi rgya mtshor nub pa phyir bton pa dang / rus sbal gyi gzugs kyis 'jig rten btegs nas rgyun du gnas pa/ phag rgod kyi gzugs kyis tshangs pa'i 'jig rten mad chad mnan cing ba nas pa/ smad mi la stod seng ge'i gzugs kyis lha min gyi dbang bo 'gro skyob gser can gyi lto ba dral nas bsad pa/ mi'u thung du sprul nas lha min stobs ldan la sa gom pa gsum bslangs te bslus pa/rgyal bo shing rta bcu ba'i bu rā ma kar sprul nas/ sprel ha nu mjil grogs bcom te/ rang gi chung ma phrogs pa'i srin po laṅka mgrin bcu btul ba/dzam rā asne'i bu dgra sta sā mar sprul te/ rgyal rigs srid sgrub la sogs pa bsad pa/ sngon 'jig rten du than pa chen po byung bar/ bram ze nag por spru' te/ rgya mtsho bzhi dang chu bo du ma skrun pa/ sangs rgyas shākya thub par sprul nas sngon rgyal rigs sogs bsad pa'i sdig pa sbyangs pa/ rigs ldan bram ze'i bu ka'i tsi zhes bya bar sprul nas/ ma 'ongs pa na 'byung bas sems can mang bo brtul ba'i mthar dus ldog pa rtogs par gyur pa bcas kyis/ 'jug —pa bcu ba dang / sbyor ba brgya ba dang / sna tshogs gzugs can dang / gzugs —— — — — — nga 6 22

mngon brjod gzi yi 'a ra ba/kad sogs su grags so/ rgya mtsho bsrub ba pa las byung ba'i dpal mo'i khyo ga yin pag dpal —bdag dang /dpal 'dzin dar dpal mo'i dpal zhes so/ —'dod lha'i mtshan/ 'di khyab 'jug gi bu yin pas/ pha la nag po yang 'bod pas/nag po skyes zer// ——'di 'dod pa la rab tu dga' ba'i bdag nyid can yin pas/ 'dod —pa'i pho nya dang / bdud dga' rab dbang phyug dab / yid srubs bdag po ——nga dang /dran pa'i shing rta dang /dus rtsen sogs su grags /—nya'i rigs chu srin gzugs rgyal mtshan gyi rtser 'khod yod pas/ nya yi tog dang /chu srin mtshan pa dang /chu srin rgyal mtshan can zhe'o/ nga nga nga lag na me tog gi gzhu yod cing / 'phen pa'i mda' yang me tog gi dbyibs can yin la/ de 'phangs na pha rol po'i lus ma rmas par bde bar brtsom pas na/ me tog gzhi can dang / mchod ba'i gzugs dang / bde — —'joms dag tu grags/ —me tog gi mda' la smyo byed/sred byed/kun tu smongs byed/skem bye da/'chi byed lnga yod pas / ma da' lnga ba zer/ —lha dbang phyug ri bo gangs can na/lha mo go dris mchod cing dka' thub la gnas pa na lha rnams the tshom du grur te/go rī dang lhan cig dka' thub 623

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /spyod pa bden nam bsams nas/'dod lha blta bar btang ba dang /'dod lhas mda' lnga rim gyis 'phangs pas/ dang bo dang gnyis pal rtog pa tsam yang ma byung /gsum pa dang bzhi ba la rtog pa tsam byung /lnga ba phog pa dang go rī dang lhan cig gnas pa'i dka' thub zhig go /skad cig phyi ma la 'gyod pa skyes nas cis nyes snyam du bsams pas/'dod lhas nyes par shes nas/mig gsum nas me phyung ste 'dod pa'i lha bsregs so/ /de nas 'dod pa gtan nas med na/skye ba len pa med pas/'us med pa'i sems can gyi ngo bor gyur par brten nas/dka' thub dgra dang /sdom pa'i dgra dang /lus —med dag tu grags so// —tshangs pa'i mtshan/ gser gyi sgo nga las byung bas gser mngal can dang /gnyis skyes dbang bo zhes so//—gser sgong de chu las byung sa/chu skyes she'o//—gser sgong las byung nas/'jig rten khams kyi snod bcud thams cad sprul bar mdzad pas/kun byed rgyal bo dang /sna tshogs byed dang /'jig —rten byed po dang /'jig rten dbang dang /'gro ba'i mes po dang /skye dgu'i —bdag po sogs su grags/——gdong bzhi yod pas/zhal bzhi ba dang /'dren byed brgyad pa dang /rna —ba brgyad pa zhe'o//nga ———524

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreng ba'adi'i shing da ngang bas 'dred pas/ ngang ba'i shing rta dang /ngang ba — ——bzhon zhes so// —dbang phyug gi mtshan/sngon lha rnams 'tshogs nas/khyab 'jug gis rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las byung ba'i zla ba dbang phyug gis gtsug rgyan du bkod pas/gtsug na zla ba dang /zla ba 'dzin pa zhe'o//yang rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las dug nag po brtsegs pa dum pa gang byung ba/de gzhan du bzhag na sems can la 'tshe bar byed cing / lto bar song na 'tshig par byed par snyam nas/ dbang phyug rang gi mgrin par bzhag go /de'i stobs kyis mgrin pa bdaka'i mdog lhar shin tu legs par gyur pas/dpal mgrin dang /mgrin sngod can dang /mgul nag ce'o//— ——'di'i mig g.yas pa nyi ma dang /g.yon pa zla ba dang /dbu ma me'i mig yin pas/spyad gsum pa dang /sna tshogs mig can dang dpral mig pa dang /nga — —nga mi mthun mig dang /dzi bzad mig dang mi nga sogs su grags/dran pa ste 'dod lhas dbang phyug gi dka' thub zhig pas/ dbang phyug khros nas mig las me phyung ste 'dod lha bgregs pas/ dran pa'i dgra dang ————dran 'joms dang /dran pa 'phrog byed ce'o//———su mā dang stoms 'jug byed pa'i dus su /me lhas sa bon rnams su ka'i mngal du song na bu shin tu thu ba 'byung ba snyam nas ma gtong zer bas sa 525

dag yig rig pa'i gab ba mngon phyung /bon sa la pho ba na/ mu mas me lha khyod kyi mngal du gyur cig ces dmod pas/de'i mngal du song nas shin tu ma bzod pas skyo zhing dub ste/ lha mo gang ka'i drung du byin te phyung nas/ de'i mngal du bcol lo/ /de sgyug ma'i tshal du song nas gzhon nu gdong drug ces bya ba skyes pas/ me'i khu ba dang / me'i sa bon —— ——zhe'o/ 1 ) — —ral ba shin tu stug cing ring bas/ bza bar dang / 1la ba zer bskal pa 'jig pa'i mes mtho ris thams cad sreg pa'i tshe1 lha mo gang shā lhung nas byung ba na/ dbang phyug gis ral ba nam mkhar brkyangs thog gang gra bzung bas/ gang shā 'dzin dang / nam mkha'i skra can zhe'o// lha'i gtso bo —yin pas/ steng 'phur dbang bo dang / steng 'phu) rgyal bo chen ba dka1/ go dri'i mtshan/ dbang 41ga gi btsun mo yin pas/ skra can ma dang / ral can rme de /dbang ldan ma zhes so/1 nga ——— —— stobs ldan dang khyab 'jug phu nu gnyis kyi sring mo yin pas/ stobs —ldan sring mo dang / khyab 'jug sring mo zhe'o//———— ——————dbang phyug dka' thub la gnas par go rī ma rangs pas spu u zhes brjod cing begs byas pas/ yu ma dang / dka' zog ma zhes so//— 526

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreng ba1tshogs bdag gi mtshan/ dbang phyug la chung ma gnyis yod de1 gang shā —dang yu lnga'o/ /gang shā la bu gcig skyes pa dang 1 u mā blta bar song ba la/sto na par ma 'dod nas bu la ma so med zer/ u mā khros nas mgo med par gyur cig dmod pas/ bu de'i mgo med song / rla ra u mā la zhus pas/ mgo byang du bstan pa'i ro gang rnyed pa gcig si mgo chod la spyor dang / du la mgo yod par 'grur ro zer bas/ der mi mgo ma rnyed/ glang bo che'i ro gcig dang phrad pa/ de'i mgo bcad nas sbyar cing 'byor bas/ glang bo'i mgo dang /——————— nga —glang sna dang / glang bo can zhe'o//nga yu ka'i bu gdong drug dang rtse ba na/ tshogs bdag gi mche ba gcig la 'changs pas chag go /de nas gdong drug bdas pa na ma'i drung du bros/ ma na re/ chung ba la sam pa med pas de lhar ma byed zer ro/ /'o na cher song ba dang gsad ces pas/ ji srid khyod kyi pus mo la ma bslebs mi bar du ma gsod cig zer ro/ /de nas gdong drug rtag tu gzhon— nur gnas so/ /tshogs bdag la mche ba ya med pas/ mche ba gcig pa zhes grags/—— 'di la glang bo che'i gdong 'byor rjes/ rang gi ma gang gā mas ma zad/mu gras kyang gsos pas/ ma gnyis pa zer/gegs rnams las khyad par 'phags pa'i gtso bo yin pas/ log 'dren dang 1 gegs kyi rgyal bo zhes so// 627

— dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /gzhod nu bdong drug gi mtshan/ 'di dbang phyug dang gang gra'i sras su ————'khrungs pa sa bdi byed (dbang phyug gi ming gzhan)sras1 dang / gang gra skyes — — ——nga zhe'o//'di la gang shā dang 1 yu mā dang/ me lha dang / 'dam du'i tshal dang /smin drug dang / sa ga bcas ma drug dang ldan pas/ ma drug pa dang / mang bo ————skyed zer/ma drug 0za lha ba'i gdong drug tu sprul bas/ gdong drug dang / bcu — gnyis mig ldan du grags/lha'i dmag dpon yin pas/ ral gri'i gnyen dang / dmag gi dpung chen po dang ldan pas/ sde chen zhes so//—brgya byin gyi mtshan/ lha'i dbang bo yin pas/ mtho ris rgyal dang /——ska bas gsum bdag dang / 'chi med dbang phyug dang / tshig mda'i mgon —dang / legs bris khyu mchog sogs su grags/mu stegs pa rnams kyi lugs la mchod sbyin brgya byas na/ lha'i dbang bo 'thob par grags shing / lha 'dis de lhar byas pas lha'i mchog tu gyur pas1mchod sbyin brgya ba dang / mchod sbyin mchog ces so//brgya byin la 'khor stong yod pa rig pas rgan pas1 de rnams kyis gang bsgos pa bzhin nyan pas/ rgan la nyan zhe'o/—528

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreng ba/lha ma yin bcom pa'i snyan grags kyi rgyun nu tig star la bsgyus pa lhar mu 'khyud pas/grags pa'i nu khyud zer/nga —rig byed kyi gtam rgyud du/ khang ba la sogs pa'i gnas brgya byin la bsgangs na/byin gyis rlob cing ster bar bshad pas/gnas bdag tu grags/—lha ma yin gyi ma de spya zhes pa'i du thams cad brgya byin gyis bsad pas/ma di ba sems sdug nas drang srong 'od srung la bsnyen bkur mang du byas pas/de na re/ po ci 'dod zer bas/ brgya byin thub pa'i bu gcig 'dod zer ro//des chu'i thigs pa gcig byin te mngal du bzung ngo //de brgya byin gyis thos nas da lta nyid du med par bya'o snyam du bsams nas/ de'i mngal du zhugs nas/de dum bu bdun du byas pa dag ngu 'bod shor yang ma shi/yang khros te de re re yang bdun bdun du byas so/ /de dag lhan cig tu rlung gi lha bzhi bcu rtsa dgur gyur to skad/gtam rgyud 'di las mi gcod ma'i mngal gyi sems can la ngu 'bod shor du bcug pas/ yang dag ngu dang / yang dag nga nga nga 'bod sna ce'o// —legs brjod ma'i mtshan/ lha dbang brgya byin gyi btsun mo yin pas/———nga ————'chi med dbar mo dang /dbab chen ma dang /mchog rgyal ma dag tu grags/—lha ma yin drang srong pu lo ma la skyes pas/ pu lo'i sras mo dang / pu lo skyes ——zhes so/ 529

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung —me lha'i mtshan/ 'di la sbyin sreg mkhan gyis ci bsregs kyang 'tshig pas/—————sbyin sreg za zhe'o// ༷ ———u mas dmod pas/ dbang phyug gi thig le 'di'i mngal du song zhing bsregs nas cung zad tshig pas/ gser gyi kha dog can du gyur pa'i bu(bzhon nu gdong drug)zhig byung bas/ bkar gyi thig le dang / gser khu ba ———— ———— —nga zhes so//'di la me lce bdun te/ nag po dab ni 'jigs byed dang / /yid mgyogs legs phan mi stag can/ /du ba'i mdog bzang sna tshogs 'od/ /bcas yod pas/ 'od bdun pa dang / sna tshogs 'od ces so//——lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i me ri rgod ma kha lhar 'bar bas/ rta dmar can zhe'o//—drang srong bi shā na ra la skyes pag ji shā ra na'i bu zhes so//me'i ming / me la ci zhig bzhag kyang tshig pas/ sreg za dang / byin ——— nga —zab ched da/ / ——dngos po gang la'ang bsregs nas tshig pa'am nyams par byed pa4nor —las rgyal zer/ ————rme 'bar ba rlung gis grogs byed pas/ rlung gi grogs po zhe'o// pame lce 'khyog por 'bar bas/ 'khyog 'bar zhe'o//gshin rje'i mtshan/ pha nyi ma las skyes pas/ nyi ma'i bu zer/——530

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreng ba/sdig pa byas pa'i sems can noms la chad pa gang 'os gcod pas/chos kyi rgyal bo zer/ —nga pha mes gshin po rnams kyi lha yin pas / mtshun gyi lha zhe'o//—chu bo ya mu na'i ming bo yin pas/ya mu na'i kun zhes pa'o/—lam lnga ba'i bdag po yin pas/lnga ba'i ba bdag dang / 'chis bdag ce'o//——— ———dpon g.yog dbul phyug thams cad 'dis mtshungs par 'joms pas/mtshungs 'jug dang /mthar byed ces pa'o//———chu lha'i mtshan/ 'gro ba'i skom pa sel ba la mchog tu bzang ba'i sems nga nga nga nga nga yod pas/mchog snyin dang /mchog sems zhes pa'o//— — chu skyes thams cad kyi bdag po yin pas/chu skyes dbang bo zhe'o//———sgra mang bo dus cig car du sgrog pas/lce brgya ba zhe'o//nga —sprul gyi zhags pa 'dzin pas/zhags pa can zer ro// nga —rlung lha'i mtshan/ 'di las dbugs zams cad 'byung bas/ dbugs nga sbyin bdag po zhes zer/— nga nga g.yo zhing skyod pa'i stobs bskyed par nus pas/sto bas kyi lha dang /g.yo — — — nga ba'i mgon po zhe'o// nga —'di bzhon pa'i rta kha dog dkar dmar ser gsum dang ldan pas/ sna —tshogs rta can zhe'o//— ——53

dag yig ba rig pa'i kab pa mngon phyung rlung spyi'i ming / nam yang mi 'dug par rtag tu 'gro bas/ rtag rjeb bab 'o dang /'gro ba'i ngang tshul zer/ ——— rdul khur nas 'gro bas/rdul gyi kha lo ba zhe'o//tshangs ma sogs ma mo bdun yod pa'i gdas las 'phel ba'i pyir/ ma mos 'phel zhe'o//———dri sna tshogs 'khur zhing 'khyer bas/dri bzhon zhe'o//rnam sras kyi mtshan/gsang bar sbas pa'i gter rnams kyi bdag po yin nga pas/gsang bdag dang /gter bdag ces pa'o//gnod sbyin thams cad kyi rgyal bo yin pas na/ gnod sbyin rgyal dang /gnod sbyin 'dren pa zhe'o//—nga ———— —go dri'i gzugs shin tu bzang ba mthong nas/ de la chags shing bltas pas/'od kyis mig phyid cing chud zos pas/drag po na re/de ltar ma byed zer nas mig dmar skyar byas pas/mig skya zer/—'di la rkang ba gsum dang mche ba brgyad yod pa la shin tu mi sdug pas/lus ngan zhe'o//'di la ling ga rkang ba tsam zhig yod pa ma theg par/ dbang phyug gis 'degs pa'i mi zhig byin pas na/rkang ba gsum ldan dang mi la zhon zhes nga —grags so/632

mngon brngod gzi yi 'phreng balha ma yin gyi mtshan/ma sbyin ma la skyes pas/sbyin skyes dang /sbyin byung dang sbyin ma'i bye zhe'o// ——sngon rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las byung ba'i bcud rnams lha noms kyis bdag byas te/lha min rnams la ma thob pas/bcud mi ldan zhe'o//nga lha ma yin dmas dang thog ri rab kyi rtse la gnas pa'i lha yin mod/phyis lha rnams kyis de rnams ri rab kyi smad du bskrad cing lhar mi rtsi bas na/lha ma —yin gyi ming thogs kyang / dus kyi cha nas sngon gyi lha dang / lha las rgan zhes — ——pa'o//lha dang dgra ru gyur bas / lha la 'i nga dang /lhar smod dang /dbang bo'i dgra rnams su grags/—gza' pa sangs te khu ba'i slob ma yin pas/pa sangs slob ma dang /khu nga — ba'i slob ma zhe'o//——srin po'i rgyal bo'i ming / mgo bo bcu yod pas gdong bcu ba dang /— nga —mgrin bcu ba zhes bya'o// —srin po'i grong khyer laṅga pu ru'i bdag po yin pas/ la da'i bdag po —zhe'o//bden pa mi rtsi bar las mi dge ba spyod pa'i rgyal bor byur pas/bden ——bral bdag po zhe'o//633

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung gsum pa/ nam mkha' dang bcas pa'i skor/nam mkha'i ming / lha dang myu skar sprin dang bya bye'u sogs 'gro bsang —nga ——nga kun 'gro zhe'o//——nam mkha'i mthongs na lha'i chu bo yod pa'i skad kyis lha yi jing ring du grags/khyab 'jug spru' chen po'i gzugs kyis nam mkha' na gnas pas/khyab nga 'jug gnas zhes pa'o//—mtha' mtshams med pas na/mtha' bral zer/——sprin gyi ming /mkha' la lding zhing chu rdul khyer ba'i phung bo yin pas/chu nga nga —'dzin dang /chu yi shing rta zhe'o//nga nga des nyi 'od bsgribs pas/mkha' gos can zhe'o/ ———bar snang du 'gro bas/mkha' la rgyu zhe'o//rlung gis khur nas 'gro bas/rlung gi shing rta zhe'o//gzugs kyi snang ba 'dra ba'i cha nas/ nam mkha'i glang bo dang / nam nga — ———— —mkha'i rgyal mtshan zhe'o//——glog gi ming / khang ba dang sdong rgan dang sems can sogs la 'jug cing brlag pas/'jug pa brgya ba zhen/spran phung las glog 'od gser gyi mdog can phra mo lhug ma 'dra 'khyug 54

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreng ba/pas / sprin gyi lhag ma dang /lus phra dang /gser 'od can zhe'o// — — ——de myur du mi snang bar 'gyur bas/ skad cig 'od dang / skad cig nga — gsal ba zhes pa'o//——————'brug sgra'i ming / thin 'khrigs nas tsha grang 'thab pa las ldir sgra byung ——————bas/sprin gyi sgra zhe'o//nga —sgra grags tshul drag zhan ring thung dal mgyogs sogs kyi khyad par yod pas/ sgra rgya zhe'o/ dbyar kha 'byung zhing rnga bo che ldir ba zhin du grag pas/dbyar skyes rnga dang /dbyar rnga zhes pa'o//—thog gi ming /sprin las byung zhing 'od 'phro bas/chu 'dzin skyes dang /sprin gyi 'od zer dang /sprin gyi me bo che sogs su grags/— —khro lcags gri sogs kyi dbyibs ltar grub cing me las tsha ba/ sprin las babs pas/me char dang /gnam lcags dang nam mkha'i tho ba sogs su nga —grags pa/de ci la phog kyang 'joms pa'am 'jigs par byed pas/'phra 'joms dang /ri 'joms dang /'jigs byed ces so//'ja' yi ming /sos ka bslob sa pa dang /char ba babs shul shar bas na/sos ka bzhad zer——'od mdangs lnga dang ldan pas/'od lnga ba zhe'o//———536

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /rlan gyis grub pa'i jin las shar bas/ gzha' ris zhes pa'o//—ser ba'i ming / sprin nang gi chu thigs 'khyags nas sra mo rdo dang rus pa lhar chags pas/ chu mkhregs dang / sprin gyi rus pa dang / sprin gyi rdo dang /smin gyi gong bu dang / rdo char sogs su grags/—lo thog 'joms par byed pas/ lo thog gshed ce'o//—rdog po lci bas rlung bser bus de 'dra g.yo bar mi 'gyur bas ka ba ltar drang mor 'bab pas/ sprin gyi ka ba zhes so//char ba'i ming / yul gru kun tu snyoms shing dal gyi bab pas/ gru char ba ba ——————zer— dus su babs pa rtsi shing lo thog sogs skye byed kyi spyang rtsi lha bur gyur pas/ sbrang char zhe'o//————sprin gyi snying bo yin pas/ smin gyi bcud zer/chu rgyas byed kyi sa bon yin pas/ chu'i sa bon zhe'o//chu yi zegs ma yin pas/ chu rdul zhes pa'o//—brtan pa'i ming / 'di drang srong gi rgyal bo rkang steng gi bu yin pas/——————rkang steng bu zhes so//rgyu skar rnams 'di las ha cang mi nye mi ring bar rgyu bas/ rtod phur zhes bya'o//ri byi'i ming / drang srong chu lhas lha mo ud shī mthong ba las khu ba shor ba 536

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreng ba—bum par blugs pa de las1 'di skyes pas1 chu lha'i bu dang / bum skyes zhes —— — — ———grags/lha'i sman pa yin pa'i stobs kyis 'ji shar ba na/ chu rnams nad kyi gnyen por stsar pas/ mig ldongs pa sogs sel bar nus pas na/ ldongs —sel zhes pa'o// — —sgra gcan gyi mi / 'di drang srong 'gro skyob gser can gyi sring mo seng ge ma zhes bya ba'i bu yin pas/ seng se ma'i bu zer/ —————'dir lha yul snang bar byed pa'i khur dang ldan pab / mtho ris snang —— nga ——byed ce'o// —— —'dis nyi ma dang zla ba bsgribs das sa steng nun par byed pas/ mun pa ————can zer/—gza' mig dmar gyi ming / pa sangs kyi bu yin la/ pa sangs sa khams —yin pas na/ sa skyes zer/—gza' 'di sdig pa che bas mi shis pa las ldob ba'i ming du/ bkra shis she'o//'od zer dgu yod pas/ 'od zer dgu ba zhes pa'o//———lhag pa'i ming / pha zla ba yid pas/ zla ba'i bu zer/zla ba ni mtho ldan dbang bo yin pas1 mtho ldan bu yang zer/637

dag 'ig rig pa'i sa bab mngon rgyung /— nga — nga shā rgyu skar snar ma yin pas/snar za skyes she'o//sku mdog sngo sangs dang ldan pas/sngo sangs lus zhes pa'o//phur bu'i ming /drang srong me bzhi las skyes pas/me zhi skyes zerang —nga —sgra ba ha cang mkhas pas/blo ldan dang dbyangs bdag ce'o//—lha rnams kyi sgra rig pa'i slob dpon byas pas/lha'i bla ma zhes pa'o/pa sangs kyi ming /drang srong ngan spang gi bu yin pas/ngan spong spu —nga nga —zerazu ngan med cing dam pa zams cad du bzang ba'i jir/dkar po zhe'o//lha ma yin gyi dang bo'i sbyin byed kyi bla ma yin pas/lha min bla ma zer/snyan dngags la ha cang mkhas pas/ snyan dngags mkhan dang / tshig —brgya'i dbang zhes so//spen pa'i ming /yum tshangs ma la skyes pas/tshangs skyes she'o//pha nyi ma yin pas/nyi ma'i bu zer/'od zer bdun dang ldan pas/'od zer bdun pa zer/gos sngon po lhon pas/gos sngon can zhes pa'o//nyi ma'i ming /mtshan mo 'joms pas/nyin mor byed pa dang /nyin mo'i mgon po dang /nyin mo'i 'dren pa dang /nyin mo'i 'byung gnas dang /nyin nga nga mo'i dbang phyug dang nyin byed nor bu sogs su grags/nga —538

mngon brjod gzi yi 'byung ba'od kyi phung bo yin pas / 'od gzugs dang / 'od kyi nor can/——— ——'od byed/'od 'byin/gsal byed/'od stong can/snang ba'i mdzod/rab —— ————— ———nga —rib 'joms sogs su grags/ ——nga nyi ma shar ba na/me tog pad ma kha bye bas/pad ma'i gnyen dang ku — —mud kha zum pas / ku mud dgra zhe'o//tsha ba'i drod kyis chu dros nas rlangs par gyur pa las/ char ba 'bab par byed pas/char 'bebs she'o//chu skom par byed pas/chu'i chos rkun zer/———'jig rten gsal bar byed pa'i mig lta bu yin pas/ 'jig rten mig —dang / nam mkha'i mig dang / spid pa'i sgron me dang / long ba'i kha lo ba —— — —sogs su grags/nyin mtshan dang /zla dang /lo sogs kyi dbye ba gsal bar byed pas/dus kyi byed po dang /dus bdag dang lo yi shing rta sogs zer/——nyi ma bgrod pa'i lam du bsleb sa'i gnas bcu gnyis te / lug glang 'khrig pa/kan ṭa/seng ge bu mo/srang /sdig gzhu chu srin/bum pa/nya bcas khrim bcu gnyis yod pa de rnams kyi bdag po'i tshul du snang bas bcu —gnyis bdag po dang /gza' bdag dang /gza' yi su khyud ces pa'o//— ———nyi ma'i shing rta 'dren pa'i rta ni/rlung dang /yid mgyogs/mdog lnga ba/63mi

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon jing thig le can/nges brjod/shin tu rgyal mtshan/ri 'joms bcas bdun yod pas/ rta bdun pa dang / rta bdun dbang bo dang / rta de dmas kyi kha dog nga nga —ljang gu yin pas/rta ljang can zhe'o//——— skya rengs kyi ming / drang srong 'gro skyob kyi bu bya khyung gi phu bo skya rengs zhes pa'i brla g.yas pa chag nas med par grags pas/brla med ces pa'o//bya khyung gi sngon du skyes pas/khyung sngon skyes she'o//———nyi ma'i shing rta 'dren pa'i rta rnams las bsku bar byed pas/ nyi ma'i ——kha lo zhe'o// ——zla ba'i ming / rgyu skar rnams la 'od shid tu che bas/ sgyu skor rgyal bo zhe'o//'od mdangs shin tu dkar bas 'od dkar can zhes so/— ——mtshan mo gsal bar byed pas/mtshan mo'i bdag po dang /mtshan mo'i —nor bu zhe'o// ——'od bsil bas tsha gdung 'jom bar byed pas / bsil zer can dang /bsil sbyin mkhan zhes grags/ nga sngon lha gas kyis rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las byung bas/ rgya mtsho skyes zhes dang /dbang phyug gis ral ba'i rgyan du byas pas/ bde 'byung gtsug rgyan 50

mngon brngod gzi yi 'phreng ba/zhe'o//sngon ri bong byang chub sems dpa'i sku'i dus su bram ze slong ba bo'i re ba skong ched/ me 'obs su mchong nas/ sku lus sbyin par btang bas/ brgya byin ngo mtshar te/de lugs lha mi noms la ston pa'i phyir du/zla ba'i ngos la ri bong gis gzugs bris pas/ri bong 'dzin pa dang /ri bor can dang /ri nga —— —nga —dgas mtshan ma sogs su grags/ ——cha shas bcu drug gis nya gang bas/bcu drug cha dang /cha bdag dang /cha gter zhe'o//— —nga zla ba shar ba na/me tog ku mud bzhad pas/ku sud gnyen dang /pad nga ma zum pas/pad ma'i dgra zhe'o//——bzhi ba/ dus kyi skor/dus kyi ming /skad cig kyang mi 'tshom par yang dag pa ra 'gro bas na/lda nga dag 'gro zhe'o// phar song ba slar mar yong bas/sgar byung zer/—'das pa dang /ma 'ongs pa dang /da lta ba la sogs nga grangs kyi bgrang bya yin pas/bgrang bya zhe'o//nyid mo'i ming /nyi ma shar ba dang mun pa grol bas/nun bsal zhe'o//mtshan mo ni snang ba'i bdud dang 'dra ba la/ nyi mas 'joms pas/64

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon bdud 'joms she'o//nga — ——mtshan mo'i ming /bya ba dor ba'i dus yin ba sa/bya zal zer/nga nga nga nga nga mun nag 'thibs pas na/snang med ce'o//—rkun jag sogs la gzab dgos pa'i dus yin pas/mel tshe can zhe'o//nam mkha'i mdangs ha cang dag pa'i dus yin pas/sngo bsangs chags — dus zhes pa'o//—yar ngo'i ming /zla ba'i dkar cha 'phel bas na/dkar phyogs she'o//zla — nga —gcig gi phyed snga ma yin pas/phyogs snga ma zer ro 7mar ngo'i ming /zla ba'i cha shas 'bri ba'i phyogs yin pas/nag phyogs nga sam/ dmar phyogs she'o//zla gcig gi phyogs phyi ma yin pas/phyogs phyi ma —— —— ——zhes pa'o//dus kyi zla ba'i ming zla bas lo 'jal bar byed pas/'jal byed zer/skyes bu nad med pa zhig gi dbugs 'byung rdub kyi khug pa nyis khri chig stong drug brgya ni nyin zhag gcig gi tshad dang / de sum cu la zla gcig lon pas/dbugs bab zer/lo ni zla ba bcu gnyis kyis grub pas/ lo yi yan lag dang / lo yi cha ———shas can dang /lo'i mdzod dag tu grags shing yar ngo dang mar ngo phyogs —gnyis yod pas / phyogs can zhe'o/—— rta

mngon shā rjod bzi yi 'phreng ba/— —— nga nga —nga dgun stod kyi ming /kha ba babs pa'i dus yin pas / kha ba'i dus bang /— —— — ——— ——— —grang dub dang bsil ldan dus shed //—— ————dgun smab kyi ming / grang zab che ba'i dus yi na pas/ grang zeg can ——nga —— nga ——nga dang 'khyabs pa'i dus zer/——dpyid ka'i ming 'dod pa 'phel ba'i dus yin pas/'dod pa'i dus bang /dga' byed du ba she'o — —drod bab par 'gyur ba'i dus yin ba sa/drod 'bab ce'o/ ——me tog bzhad bas rje me tog ldad dus dang /dre zhim ldan dus she'o/sos ka'i ming / bsil drod mnyam pa'i dus yin pas/ dro 'jam dus nga dang /drod babs nas sems cad dmas bde ba'i dus yin pas bde byed dus zer—dbyar kha'i ming /tsha ba che ba'i dus yin pas/tshad chen zhes pa'o//—————— —sprin 'byung sla bas / smin snyes she'o// char ba chen po 'bab pas/char dus dang /chu spyas she'o//nga ston kha'i ming /lo gcig dus drug tu bgos pa'i lnga ba yin pas/dus —kyi lnga ba che 'o//—'a sa bu thogs pa'i dus yin pas/'bras ldan dus zer/——lo tog smin nas ser mdangs chags pas/gser ldan dus zhes so//6ba

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyungalo'i ming / zla ba dang bo nas bcu gnyis pa'i bar bgrang bar bya ba'i ba ——dus yun yin pas/ bgrang bya dang / bgrang gzhi dang / zla ba'i 'phreng ba dag —— —tu grags/ zla ba bcu gnyis kyi bdag nyid yin pas/ dus kyi rgyal bo zer/ dus bzhi rim bzhin phar 'gro ba dang / slar yang tshur 'ong bas/ 'gro 'ong zhe'o//—dus bzhi'i snga mas phyi ma 'dor bar byed pas/ 'dor byed ces so//don tshan gnyis pa/ sa 'og gi sde yan lag dang bcas pa bshad pa/ dang bo/ sa 'og dang dmyal ba sogs kyi skor/—sa 'og gi ming / mi rnams kyi rkang ba'i 'og tu yod pas/ rkang 'og ce'o//khyab 'jug gis lha ma yin stobs ldan sa 'og tu bskrad pas/ stobs —ldan gnas zer/ ——/ klu rnams rgya mtsho na gnas pas/ klu yi 'jig rten zhe'o//'dod lha rigs drug dang ming bzhi ste bcu'i 'og tu yod pas/ bcu —'og ces pa'o//—mun pa'i ming / nun pa stug po 'thibs 'dug pas/ smag rum dang /mun 'khrigs she'o// —mig gis mi mthong bas/ ldongs byed ce'o//544

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phrer ba1nam mkhas bsgribs pa ltar mi mthong bar byas pas/ nam mkha'i pags — —— ——bapa zhes so// ———klu yi ming / drar srong 'od srung gi chur ma ka bru la skyes pas/ ka bru'i bu bcab ————chen// — milus la khrib lha byu'i bdebs ka skyes yod pas/ bdengs can zhe'o1/ri rgya1 gyi rtsa nas skyes pas/ ri gnas zhes bya'o—//nga —— ————— —3 sprul gyi mi / rdzul la rkang pa yod par bshad kyang / phyir mi mngod pas/bab————rkang sbas she'o/ /—— lho das gog nas 'u gro bas/ lto 'phye dang / lto 'gro zer/ ——— —da ba med la sgra mig gis thos par grags pas/ mig gis tho4zer/—————rlung zas su za bag rlung zas can zhe'o //———dug spro bas/ dug 'dzin dang / dub gi mtshon cha can zer ro// — —dmyal ba'i ming / rang gi 'dod pa lhar bde ba skad cig kyang med pas/——————'dod pa'i 'bras bral dang / bde med/ sdug bsngal gter sogs su grags/— nga pan 'gro gsum gyi rteng mtha' yin pas/ ngan bgro'i mthil zhes pa'o//yi rwags kyi ming 1 lus kyi dbyibs dang kha dog shin tu ngan pas khyab pas na/ red khyab ces pa'o paphun tshogs dpal gyi longs spyod med pas/ dpal min dang / phun ——646

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /tshogs min zer/chu la rab med pa lhar thar sa med pas/ chu bo rab med zer/gnyis pa/ chu dang bcas pa'i skor/rgya mtsho'i ming / chu bo kun 'dus pa'i mdzod lta bu yin pas/ chu gter dang / nyal 'gro'i gter dang / dal 'bab mdzod sogs su grags/— nga mtha' mi mngon pas/ pha rol mi mngon zer/ sngon lha rnams kyis rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las zla ba byung bar grags pas/zla ba'i ma ma zer/—de la chu srin gnas pas/ chu srin 'byung gnas dang / chu srin rgyal mtshan cad dang / chu srin grong khyer sogs su grags/ chu yi ming / rdul dang dri ma sogs dag par byed pas/ dag byed dang /ngan sel zhe'o1/'bru sna skye bar phan pas/ 'bru dzin zer/rlangs pa sprin du 'gyur bas/ sprin gyi myu gu zhe'o//'bab chu'i ming / thur du 'gro bas/ thur bgrod dang / gzhol 'gro zhe'o//———ba — —nyal ba'i tshul du 'gro bas/ nyal 'gro zer/kyag ge spyog ger 'gro bas/ 'khyog 'gro dang / kya myu 'gros she'o//za rlabs lang ling du rgyu bas/ ba rlabs can ma zhe'o//646

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreng ba/ ——'jig rten pas dngos rdzas skyel ba'i gru gzings sogs gtong bar nus pas na/ 'jig rten shing rta ma zhe'o//chu zu gang ka'i ming / mngar ba dang / bsil ba/ 'jam pa/ yang ba/dwangs pa1 gtsang ba/ mgrin pa la mi gnod pa/ lto ba la phan pag yan lag ——nga brgyad ldan zhe'o/ / cha sngon dra nga srong dza hus 'thungs te bsgyugs pas/ de'i bu mo dang 'dra bas/ dza hu'i du mo zhes so//—mtho ris dang / mi yul dang / sa 'og gi lam gsum brgyud pas/ lam —gsum 'gro dang / rgyun gsum pa zhe'o//gram pa'i bye ma gser rmi mdog dang ldan pas/ gser ldan ma zhe'o//glang bo che'i kha 'dra ba las 'bab pas/ glang chen ga 'bab ces pa'o/ /'di rgyal bo skal ldan shing rtas khyab 'jug gi rkang ba la mchod yon tu phul bas/ khyab 'jug rkang ba zhes dang / — ma pa ldan shing rtas 'jig rten du phab pa las/ de'i bu rgyud dang 'dra bas/ skal ldan shing rta'i bu mo zhes pa'o//mtho ris das babs pa'i chu bo yin pas/ lha'i chu bo zhes so//chu bo ya mu na'i ming / 'di'i pha nyi mar grags pas/ nyi ma'i bu mo zer/gshin rje'i log ming zhi ba zer ba'i sring mo yid pas/ zhi ba'i sring mo —6 7

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung zhe'o/ rgya gar gyi nub phyogs nas babs pas rje pa gru zhe'o//—chu bo ba ming /lha rnams rtsed 'jo rol ba'i gnas te ri bo 'ji/sa —nga nga byed las byung bas/rtsed 'jo'i chu bo zhe'o//chu bo 'di zla ba las skyes par grags pas/zla ba skyes she'o//——'di lha mo gang gra'i sngon du byung bas/sngon gyi gang gra zhe'o// ———chu bo si sna'i ming / chu 'di la rtag tu zla mtshan lha gu'i rdul dmar po nga nga 'bab pas/khrag 'bab ces pa'o//drang song be shā ra zhes pa'i bu shi bas/ sems zu ngan gyis non nas rdo rje lto bar bcings te/chu 'di la rtsebs par/chu 'di skrag nas dum bu brgyar gyes pas/ba gyes she'o//lha bde byed kyis lha mo go rī bag mar blangs pa'i lag pa'i chu las byung bas/lag pa'i chu bo zhes pa'o// —bar bas kyi ming /rlabs phreng g.yo bas chu 'khrug dang /chu'i 'khri shing — —dang /steng 'a par dang /chu'i 'gre log sogs su grags so// nga — —dung g.yas 'khyil gyi ming /dung skye ba lnga blangs na/g.yas 'khyil 'ongs par grags pas/ skye ba lnga ba zer/ skyo lnga ba ni dung rnam4las mchog tu ———stsar pa yin pas /rgyal ka'akhyil ba zhe'o/— ༷ 48

mdzan brngod gzi yi 'phreng ba/byang chub sems dpa' dag skye ba lnga bar smo na lam gyi mthus dung g.yas 'khyil du skyes de'i sgra thos tshad ngan song du mi 'gro zhes bkra shis pa'i jis yin pas/bkra shis dung zhe'o//nya rtsibs kyi ming / nu tig ni nya rtsibs las byung ba yin pas/ nu nyib nga —nga 'byung gnas dang /nu teg ma zhe'o// —dug gis tshiganod pas/dug gis mi brdzi zhe'o// nga nga mu nyig gi ming /ma bkrol rang grol du byung bas grol ba can zer nya lcibs las sa thon chags nas byung bas / nya rtsib rā bon zhes dang /————nya phyis spubs 'dra ba las byung bas/spubs skyes she'o//byu ru'i ming /sdong bu dmar zhing yal 'dab dang ldan pas / lus dmar — nga —'dab ce'o/——rin po che'i sdong du yin pas/rin chen sdong bu dang /nor bu 'khri shing — — ———nga —zer/me tog ltar mdzes pa'i dpal dang ldad bas/dpal me tog ce'o/—g.yu yi ming /rdo nang gi yag shos yin pas/rdo yi rgyal po zhe'o/———rin po che'i mchog tu byur pa yin pas/rin po che'i rgyal bo zer/————sngo zhing dkar la bkra mdangs che ba/ nun par yang mthong ba can la drug dkar zhe'o/—————643

dag yi rib pha'i gab pa mngon jing /sngo zhing dmar mdangs che la snum pa can la drug dmar zhe'o//de gnyis zil gyis non pa drug dkar 'a sa sngo ba la g.yu spyang zer ro/chu srin gyi ming / rgya mtsho'i srog chags khri tsho mang bo bzung nas za bas/'dzin khri dang / kun 'joms she'o//——nga so ral gri dang 'dra bas/ ral gri'i so can zhe'o//— ——nya dmas khyur mid byed pa'i sems can chen po yin pas/ nya mid che zhes so//nya byi'i ming / 'di rigs kyi pa du 'dzum she pas1 mig mi ———'dzum zhe'o// ————mig gser gyi mdog can yin pas/ gser gyi mig can nam/ gser —mig ce'o//chus 'tshub mi srid pas/ chus mi 'tshub ce'o//—chu las rnam par 'phyo bas/ rnam 'phyo zhe'o//rus sbal gyi ming / bu ga nas mgrin pa 'don pas/ 'gram rkyong zer/ba ba ba ba ba 'gro pa dal bas/ dul 'gro zhe'o/1dgra dang phrad na yan lag lnga bo skogs nang srus pas1 yan lag lnga spus ——dang / —rus pa'i shubs ngan pa dang ldan pas/ ngan shubs can zer/—560

mngon brngod gzi yi 'phreng ba/skogs kyis rang lus dam por 'dzin pas/ dam du 'dzin zhes pa'o—/— ——————sram gyi ming / nya bzung nas za bas/ nya 'dzin zhe'o//chu'i nang du 'dzul nas rgyug pa'i yang rtsal spre'u 'am sre mong dag dang mtshungs pas/ chu'i spre'u dang / chu'i sre mong dang / chu'i byi ba sogs su ——grags/dbugs bsdams nas skad cig la chu la 'dzul nas nya zin pas/ skad —cig dbugs zhes pa'o//nya bzung nas 'ug pa la mchod pas/ 'ug pa mchod byed ce'o//gru yi ming / chu'i pha rol tu sgrol bar byed pas/ sgrol byed zer/chu'i pha rol tu sgrol ba'i shing rta lha bu yin pas/ chu yi shing rta zer/—gru shan la rta mgo dang bcas pa yod pas/ rta mgo can zhe'o//mnyan pa'i ming / gru pa yin pas/ gru'i kha lo ba zhe'o//——————gru skul byed kyi gdos pa'am skya ba 'dzin pas/ gdos pa 'dzin dang /skya ba 'dzin zhe'o//nya pa'i ming / nya 'tsho rten du byed pas/ nya yis 'tsho ba dang / nya yi zas can dang / nya lto pa zhes pa'o//—rgya lta bu sogs la brten nas nya 'dzin pas na/ nya 'ching dang / dra ba ——'dzin dang / dol thogs sogs su grags/ ——651

dab yig rig pa'i gab pa ngon sgyung/pad ma'i ming / chu las skyes pas/ chu skyes dang / ——'dam las skyes pas/ 'dam she zer/mtsho las skyes pas/ mtsho skyes she'o//——'dab ma mang bas/ 'dab brgya zhes pa'o//g.yang chags pa'i sos sam 'dab ma dang ldan pas/ dpal zas dang /nga —dpal rmi 'dab ma zer/ ——— ——nga chu mdzes par byed pas/ chu yi rgyan dang / chu yi lang tsho zhe'o1 1sbrang rtsi chags pas/ sprung rtsi 'dzin dang / sbrang rtsi'i 'byung sa nas dang /——sprang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan sogs su grags/—nyi ma shar da bzhad pas/ nyi mas bzhad ces pa'o/a sprul gyi ming / chu las skyes shing mdog sngon po yin pas/ chu skyes sngon ba po zhe'o//—dbang sngon gyi mdog lhar mchog tu gyur pas/ dbang mchog ce'o//—— —mig la rab tu mdzes pas/ mig gi gnyen zer/chu kha nas 'od dang drod dag blangs nas skyes pas/ steng 'thung zhe'o//sa yi rgyan lta bur gyur pas/ sa yi gdu bu zhes pa'o11 ——ku nu da'i ming / chu las skyes shing me tog dkar po yin pas/ chu ba skyes dkar po zhe'o//662

mngon brngod gzi yi 'phreng ba/zla ba shar ba dang kha bye bas nga ༄ka' dang / ka bas bzhad dang /mtshan mo bzhad ce'o/ ——chu bal gyi ming /chu khar nyal nas bsdad yod pa 'dra bas chu nyal zhe'o//— — —ba thag lta bu sngo nal nal chus g.yeng zhing /nya yang lcibs par nus pas/nya lcibs zer/ ——nya 'khebs pa'i rtswa 'di 'byar bag gi rnam pa snabs ba dang 'dra bas/ nya —snabs she'o//——sa la dba' bas/sa mos zhes pa'o// —rdo ba'i ming /sreg pa dang ri bong dang gser mig sogs sped par byed pas/sped byed ce'o/shing dang rus pa sogs gcog byed nyan pas/cog po zer/—gtsog byed rdo gtun la/tsog po zer/—rdo ril bo la gor ma dang ju bo zer ro//— —li khri'i ming /sa rdul dmar po can zhig yin pas/ca da1da dang /bye ma dmar po zhe'o//—bzang shos kha dog ngur smrig dwangs par snang bas/sa dwangs ma zhe'o//'di lha mo brtan mas bkra shis pa'i rdzas su bcom ldan 'das la phul bar grags pas/bkra shis rdzas zer/ —563

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /bal bos zha nye las bzos pa'i li khri'i tshon la zha nye skyes zer ro//nga —ba bla'i ming /ldong ros lha du'i dri ma 'jam tsam bro ba/mer bsregs na dud pa ser por 'ju bas/ser po dri ldan zer/'di la rigs gsum las/ rab kha dog dmar rngam can dwangs shing gsal ba/ rta so'am ba so bcag pa 'dra bas/ rta so 'dra dang / ba lang so 'dra zer/——'bring ser po 'od dang ldan pa gser shog brtsegs pa lhar so sor dbye rgyu med pas/sa 'og phreng ba dang /dpe'i gzugs su bkod nas/lha yi na bza' zhe'o//tha ma sngo lngang 'dres pa rdo rul 'dra bas/rdo rul zer/—rigs gsum gyi mdog mi gcig pas/sna tshogs mdog ce'o//——kha dog spyir zhum bu'i mig dang 'dra bas/byi la'i mig ces pa'o//ldong ris kyi ming / bal bo'i yul las byung ba shas che bas/ bal yul skyes she'o//—rdo dmar ser li khri'i mdog can su zi'i dri las khyad par mnam pas/dmar po dri ldan zeragag pa'i sman mchog yin pa dang / li khri'i mdog can gnyis ka'i cha nas dpe'i gzugs su/gar mkhan ma dang /yid 'bod ma dang /glu lce pa nga 65

mngon brngod gzi yi 'phreng bdag tu bkod pa'o// spang ma'i ming /zangs rdo'i g.ya' las grub pa'i tshon sngo lngang yin pas/sngon po zer/ ——rma bya'i mdog dang 'dra bas/mo bya can dang /———sgos su rma bya'i mgrin pa'i mdog dang 'dra bas rtse can mgrin zhes so//————mthing gi ming mdog sngo nag mig snan dang 'dra bas/mig sman zhe'o/ ——'di zangs rdo'i g.ya' las grub cing dbyar la me tog lhar sngo mdangs bkra bas / dus kyi me tog dang /gsal ba can zer/—btsag gi ming /mdog dmar ser me lce dang 'dra bas/me rtse zhe'oku——le brgan gyi kha dog lhar rnam par bkra bas/le brgan me tog dang /——nga —le brgan la tshon chen zhes mngon par brjod pas/ 'di la yang tshon chen zhe'o/ nga —rin chen sngon po'i ming /legs sbyar gyi skad du ind+ra ni la zer/nga —rid po che mchog tu myur pa yin pas/nor bu'i snying bo zhes pa'o//kha dog sngon po nam mkha' dwangs pa lha du yin pas/dbang sngon dang /mthon ka zer/chu shel gyi ming /rin po che dkar po yin ba pas / nor bu dkar po zhe'o//nga nga zla ba'i mdangs lhar gsal bas/zla 'od ces so/—5༷

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /mig la sman pas man shel dang /mig la phan zhe'o//——gser gyi ming /chu bo gang gra las byung ba la / gang gra skyes zer/gser mchog dman gnyis las mchog la/sa le sbram zhe'o//lcags rigs las bzang shos yin pas/ lcags mchog dang lcags —kyi gtso bo zer/—— sa 'og na yod kyang 'od mdangs 'phro bas/sa yi zla ba zhe'o/mdog gi mchog yin pas/mdog gi rgyal bo dang /mdog bzang dang /—mdangs ldan zer/— —rin chen sna lnga las dang bo yin pas/rin chen dang bo zhe'o//zong zog las mchog tu gyur pa yin pas/zong mchog ces pa'o//tshong khrom du ha cang rgyug che bas/tshong 'dus 'grim zer/—mi tshe gtong spyad yin pas/'tsho ba sgrol byed ce'o//—dug dang ldan pas/skye ba rgyun gcod zer ro/dngul gyi ming /kha dog gser las zhan pas/mdog ngan zhe'o//rin chen sna lnga'i gnyis pa yin pas/rin chen gnyis pa zer/——mdog dkar bas/dkar po zhe'o//rdo las byung bas/rdo snying zer/——zangs kyi ming /lcags rigs las mdog dmar po yin pas lcags — 556

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreng babod mi rigs ni sa gzhi'i mtho sa na gnas pas sgang da ces —grags so/khang ba'i ming / bza' tshang 'du sa'i gnas yin pas/ 'dun gnas nga nga — — she'o/'tsho brten sa'i gnas yin pas/ rten gnas she'o/ /thob khebs yod — nga pas/bla gab can dang /phibs 'og ce'o/———gtsug lag khang gi ming dkon mchog gsum gyi bzhugs sa yin pasadakom mchog pho brang zhes dang /——————mthong ba tsam gyis nyon mongs sel bas / kun dka' ra ba zhes dang ————sku gsung thugs rted 'du ba'i khang bzang yin pas/'du khang zhe'o//dri bzang dang ldan pa'i khang ba yin pas dri bzang khang zhes so/ / legs sbyar gyi skad du gad la zer ro dgon pa'i ming khu sim pa'i gnas yin bshadaben gdas shed//—chos dge ba bya ba'i yul yin pas/zhi ba 'a grong dar /chos kyi 'du rwa yin pas/rngos kyi 'dun sa zhe'o// ———ting 'dzin sgom pa'i 'dug gdas yin pas/ bsam gtan khas zhes —pa'o//tshor ba'i ming / btsong bya'i zong 'grem pa'i gnas yin pas/ zong —— —66

dag yig rig pa'i/ba pa kar phyunga' gre za ge'o// ——nga —nga — nga tshang rgya sa yin nga sa rje chong 'dus bang /tshong bab zheb kyang lha'i//— ——bco— ra 'i ming /khrims la sbyar ba rnams khang ba munas pa cam da bskor nga bas 3/ma sa du na zhe'o khri nun zhes pa khrims nu na gyi bris no ra yin snyam/—— —nga —kums kyi yod da bkol ba'i khyim yin pas 'phrul 'khor khrim zhes ——————pa da /kar mar btsag pa ltar gnon shing gcir ba'i ra ba yin pas/ )la —mar ra pa zhes so /nga ——gnyis pa/ rtsi shing sobs kyi skor/nags tshal gyi ming / dgas skyes pa 'tshub pas/ tshang tshing zhes pa'o/ /nags— skyis pa rgya khyod che ba la/nags klung zhes so// nga ———skyed tshal gyi ming / rang shugs su skyes pa ma yin par bskrun pa'i tshal yin pas/bcos ma'i tshal zhe'o// me tog sogs btab nas skyes pa'i ra ba yin pas/kum ra zhe'o//—de dri bsung 'thul zhing mig la mdzes pas kun dga' ra ba dang /dga' tshal zhes so//bza' shing ra ba'i ming /'bras gu thogs pas/'bras ldan nags dang btung ba mchog gi tshal dang /dpal gyi kun dga' ra ba sogs su grags——— —— — ba62

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon rgyung 'di gzhon pa'i skabs su srin dus khung bu 'phreng du byas pa/ rlung gis bskyod pa las sgra 'byin pas/ rlung gis sgra sgrog dang / rlung 'bud can zhes —pa'o/ / rol mo'i bye brag glang du bzo chog pas/ glang bu'i shing zhe'o/ —————— —— — shun pa sra zhing mkhregs pas/ shun pa mkhregs dang / pags pa'i snying bo —————zhes so/ /byang chub shing gi ming / rtsa bar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub mngon du mdzad pas/ smon shing 'di shing gi mchog tu gyur pas na/ shing — dbang dang / ljon pa'i dbang bo zer/ nga ———'di'i lo ma glang bo ches za bsi/ glang bo'i zas she'o/ /—— — —rlung cung zad yod na 'dab ma g.yo bas/ lom bskyod ces pa'o /dpag bsam shing gi ming / 'dod yon ma tshang ba med pa yongs su ba ———————'dus pas/ yongs 'du zhe'o/ /—'bras bu rin chen dang ldan pas/ gser shing dang /—'dod yon phun tshogs 'phel bas/ phun tshogs 'phel zhe'o1 /— —— nga gser gyi sa gzhi brdol te skyes pas/ sa brdol zhes pa'o/ / — ———lo ma'i skyes tshu' rnga yab dang 'dra bas1 rnga yab shing zer ro/ /——u dum bā ra'i ming / sangs rgyas 'jig rten du sgyun das/ bdud bzhi 564

mngon brngod gzi yi 'phreng babacom pa'i dus cig car me tog 'di skyes bas / bdud 'joms she'o———'di las gser gyi 'o ma 'byung bas/gser 'o ma zhe'o//tsan dan spyi'i ming /rtag tu sngo zhing spob dang man yang byed chog pas/dpal mchog dang / dpal ldan dang / dpal gyi dum bu dang / bzang bo'i —nga ——dpal sogs su grags/—dri bsung dang ldan pas/dri yi snying bo zerakhu ba lus la byug na bsil ba ster bas/bsil byed ces so//lag ru'i ming /dri zhim mchog tu stsar pa sbyin pas / mchog sbyid dang —nga ———dri zhim bro ba'i shing yin pas/dri shing dang dri zhim ljon pa zhe'o//——me tog gis mdzes nyams ngom par byed pas/mdzes sbyin zhe'o//— —dri bsung 'thul bas mi bdag gnyis ka dga' bar byed pas/mi bdag ——dga' zhe'o/——a ru ra'i ming / nad kud sel ba'i sman gyi mchog yin pas/ sman gyi ——rgyal bor grags/nad kud sel ba'am dag par byed pas dag byed dang / dge legs ——she'o//sngon lha dang lha ma yin gyis bdud rtsi longs spyod pa'i dus su/ tshangs pa'i 'al nas thigs pa lhung ba ri rab kyi rtse ste/ lha'i gnas su babs nas 666

dag yig ri pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /—'khrungs pa'i shing las/ lha mo blo gros bde byed mas a ru ra rnam par rgyal ba rta'i mgo tsam pa zhig sems can gyi don du btus te/ sman gyi lha mo bdud rtsi ma'i sprul grub pa'i lha mo yid 'phrog ma la phul/ yid 'phrog mas a ru ra de bsnams nas rgya gar rdo rje gdan du byon nas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rab 'byams spyan drangs te1 sman 'di'i yon tan phun tshogs yongs su bsngags shing / sman 'di shar phyogs spos ngad ldan du 'khrungs pas/ sprul ba'i ri bo sbos ngad ldan/ /'phags min so snye bgrod par dka'/ /de phyir sa phyogs gzhan kun tu/ /rigs lnga'i sa bon thebs thin shog /sman mchog rnam rgyal 'di la sogs/ /nus ldan sman rigs thams cad kyis/ /mi mjed 'jig rten khams khyab nas/ /'gro ba'i nad kun zhi byed shog /ces smon lam btab pa bzhin skyes skad/ des na man 'di mi'i 'gro ba la lhas gnangs pa'i gso byed kyi mchog tu gyur pa zhig yin pas/ lha rdzas she'o/ /——lha rdzas dgu ba sa ru ra/ /rigs bdun sa la 'khrungs pa 'di/ /brgya byin bdud rtsi 'thung ba'i tshe/ /thigs pa bdun ni mar la lhung / /rlung gis khyer te sa las skyes— /bdud rtsi gtso bor rab tu grags/ /zhes pas/ brgya byin ————spros zer/—sa ru ra rigs lnga'ang gser gyi mdog ltar snang bas/ gser mdog ce'o /566

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreng ba——'dis nad kyi 'jigs pa dang nad kyi sdug bsngal mi ldan bar byed pas/'jigs me na zer/——dug gi rkyen byed pa'i nad rnams 'joms pas/dug 'joms she'o//nga ——tshad ba 'phrog pas/tshad pa'i mdangs 'phrog ce'o/shing gi rin po che yin bas / shing gi nor bu zhe'o//'gro drug sdug bsngal skyob pa'i ma//de phyir shing gi lha mo zer//seng phrom gyi ming / 'di'i khu ba dwangs ma'i nang du rgya skye sa spyan na/nga tshos 'phral du zhu zhing phyir 'byung bas/zhu mkhan zhe'o//rgya skyegs kyi tshos mdangs mdzes shing sgrub por 'gyur byed yin pas/skegs grogs dang /tshos khu dwangs par zud pas/dwangs byed dang /dag byed zer/rgya skyegs las mdog dmar ra len pa'i nus pa dang ldan pas/ dmar —po len zhe'o//nga 'od ma'i ming / nas dang 'dra ba'i 'bras bu thogs pas/ nas 'bras can zhe'o/—shun pa shin tu sra bas/shud pa mkhregs dang /pags pa'i snying bo zhes —so//lhu tshigs mang bas/tshigs brgya ba zhe'o//667

dag yig rig pa'i rgab pa mngon sgyungagayer ma'i ming / dbyibs 'u su 'dra ba dmar la tsub pa/ bskams na kha bdangs par 'gyur bas/ kha gdangs zer/zas kyi bro ba 'don pa'i spod rdzas ngar che 'ing kha tsha ba zhig yid pas/sgod tsha zhe'o/ /—nga rtsa kha 'byed par byed pas/ rtsa 'byed ces pa'o/ /li shi'i ming / sbos kyi mchog yin pas/ spos kyi rgyal bo zer/me tog zangs kyi gzer chung 'dra ba/ bskams rjes kyang dri zhim mi yal ba'i sman bzang bo zhig yin pas lha la mchod pa'i cha nas/ lha rdzas dang / lha nga — —yi me tog ce'o/ /lung tong gi ming / 'di'i 'bras su nag la dmar sgrug nyams can 'od dang ldan pa ri bong gi mig dang 'dra bas/ ri bong mig ce'o/ /gnyan dang mgul 'gags sel bas/ mgul dga' zhes so/ /lo ma bdun pa'i ming / lo ma sgang dbyibs cad lag pa'i mdzub bu'i — tshul du bdun re skyes pas/ 'dab bdun pa dang /—lo ma cha mi mnyam pas/ mi mnyam 'dab zer/——ston kha me tog bzhad nas legs par mngon pas/ ston ka legs zhes nga — ———so1 /shing ka dam pa'i ming / go ma rje'i ri la sprin gyi chu 'dzar ba shing 'di'i 568

mngod brngod gzi yi 'phreng ba/khong bar chags pas chang du gyur cing / de stobs bzang gis btu ngas pas 'di la dga' bar gyur pas/ gshol ldan dga' dang / dga' byed dang —— ——— ——stobs ldan dga' zhes grags/————'di la 'bras bu mang bo 'byung bas/'bras mang ldan ba dang /tshogs can — ——zhes so//shing mya ngan med kyi ming / drag po chung ma mi 'dod bar/ dkar mos shing de'i drung du dka' thub spyad pa na/ bsam pa yongs su rdzogs pas shing la sa sho ka ste/mya ngan med du btags shing /lha mo go dri'i re ba bskangs pas/ ——dga' ba sbyin byed kyang zer/—————me tog ni nyi ma dang zla ba'i 'od phog pas mi 'bye la/ bud med kyis rkang bas reg pas na/kha bye zhing mdzes par mngon pas/rkang mdzis dang /—bud med rkang bdeb bzhad ce'o//——shing tsha'i ming /'di'i lus kyi yan lag ste shun pa ni/drad sman mchog nga nga tu gyuྈ pa yin pas/yan lag mchog dang /lus mchog can zhe'o//——— —grang rlung sel zhing 'dru ba gcod pas/drod skyed dang /———lo ma mthus pas /pags pa'i 'dab ma zhes pa'o/— —shug pa'i ming /dri ngad dang ldan zhing bdug spos byed pas/ngad can ——shing dang /bdug spos shing zhe'o// — ———569

dgabs rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyub /nga lha bsang du mjug ngas /lha shing dang /brgya byin keng 'thung zhe'o//————se 'bru'i nga /mchin nad 'joms pas/kang nga nga zer/pho ba 'i me drod nyams pa la phan pa sa/pho ba'i gnyen zhe'o//gang gu'i nang du 'bras bu dmar pos phyur bur gang bas/ mdzod ldan —zhes pa'o//seng ldeng gi meng /'o ma phra bas/byis pa'i lus dang /byis pa'i lo ma nga —dang /'dab ma gzhon nu can zhe'o//— nga —shing ni rol mo bzo ba'i rgyu bzang bo yin pas/gru ba dang /gru len ma zhe'o//yal ga dang shun pa zla ba'i mdog ltar dkar bas zla ba'i yal ga dang /zla ba'i shun pa zhe'o//'di'i khu bas mdze nad 'joms pas/khu ba mdze 'joms dang /tshil 'jom par byed pas/tshil dgra dang /tshil 'joms dang / —nga —nad sel bar byed pas/'tsho ba'i shing zhe'o//——sra 'bras kyi ming /'bras du lcags kyi bum chung 'dra bas/lcags bum zhes pa'o//nus pas zug rngu med par gtong bas/zug rngu med ces so//——gsom pa'i ming /sdong bo chen po skyes pas/ljon pa che zhe'o//670

mngon brngod gzi yi 'phreng ba/—khang zam pa ca lag yo byad ci yang bzo chog pas1 mkho dgu can zhes so/ /thang chu yod pas/ thang shing dang / bcud 'dzin zer/—kaṇḍa ka ri'i ming (bod skad du 'bru sil zer1/ sdong lo'i steng du zho gtor ba lhar dkar jigs yod cing / tsher ma'i ba spu dang ldan pas/ stag —ldan dang / tsub ma'i reg bya dang / reg dka' ma dang / tsher ma can sogs ṭa/ grags/'bras bu dmar po byu ru dang 'dra ba spungs nas skye bas/ byu ru'i phung bo zhe'o/ /klu shing gi ming / 'di'i ge sar gyi dpyibs skra dang 'dra bas/ skra can —zhe'o1 /ge sar gyi kha dog dmar po yin zhing / rlung gis bskyod na rnam par g.yo bas/ glog can zer/shing khog stong ba yin pas/ shing bum pa dang / bum can zhe'o/ /kyu ru ra'i ming 1 bad mkhris khrag nad dmas las dam par rgyal ba'i 'bras bu yin pas/ rgyal 'bras dang / zhi byed dang / bdud rtsi can dag tu —grags/ nus pa bsil bas nad kyi tsha gdung skom pa sel bas/ skom sel zhe'o/ /671

dag yig rig pa'i sab pa mngon zung /khrag nad sel bas/khrag skem dang /khrag 'byed zer/khong du bsten na 'byung ba lnga la phan pa'i bcud yin pas/bcud lnga ba dang /bcud gnas ma ma dang na tshod gnas byed dang /lang tsho rtan byed — —— nga nga nga dang /da pal ldan dang /'chi med sogs su grags so/——— ——sgyur rtsi chen po'i ming /'di'i me tog nang dkar zhing phyi dmar ba nom ba ra mdzes pas/dam mdzes zer/ro skyur te kha myong btang na bzhin ras sdud par byed ba sa bzhin sdud ——ce'o//shing thog zos na so gtse bas/so gtse zhe'o//—skyer ba'i ming /shing mdog ser bo yin pas/shing ser dang /gser nga —nga nga ming zhe'o// —tsher ma no bas rje tsher rdon zer/nga —'bras bu sgyur bas/'bras sgyur zhe'o//———khu ba ser bo yin pas/khu ba ser bo zhes pa'o/kham bu'i ming / tshi gu'i mar byugs pas sgra dang smar smon rtsongs spu —sogs skye bas/spu skyed ce'o//—shing thog bcud che bas/shing thog bcud ldan zer/— ——sha rus bsregs pa'i thal bas rma gso zhing chu ser skom par byed pas/rta72

mngon brjod bzi yi 'phreng ba/rma 'jom zhe'o//——go bye'i ming ( bse dkar gyi 'bras du/'bras du'i phyi skogs skye mtshams ————su rkyal ba'i kha ltar 'dus shing / dbyibs rta'i nu ma 'dra/ nang du snum dmar po khrag 'dra ba yod pas rta yi nu mdel dang /ma nu khrag can dang /——— —khrag rkyal dag tu grags/sman du rul ba gcod pas/ru 4 gcod ces pa'o/———gu gul gyi ming / 'dis sa gdon lhog pa gnyan nad sogs 'joms nga bad sa / gdon bcom zer/———sngon phyag da rdo rjes ma 'ongs par 'gro ba rnams la mi min gyes gnod pa bya bar dgongs nas/de'i gnyen por shing 'dre 'jigs kye sa bon btab pa bden pa'i mthus skyes thing / de'i thang chu'i dri ma ldang ba dpag tshad tsam gyi sar 'dre gdon rnams nye mi nus shing 'jigs par byed pas 'dre —'jigs thang chu dang /'dre bdud klu dug pa dang /'dre gsod dab spyang ——nga ————— — —nag gza' dug pa dang /rdzas kyi phyag rdor dang /bgegs sgrod dang /gza' — ————— —gsod rogs su grags/ —'di la thang shing dang 'dra ba'i tshi ba yod la/ me la bsregs na dri ngad khyad par ba ldang bas/ljon pa'i bcud ce'o//nga —rgya skyebs shib gi ming /'di'i me tog gi 'dab ma nang dkar la phyi nag 673

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyub cing /ze 'bru ser po dang lo ma ljang gu bcas shin tu mdzes pas/kha dog ——mchog ldan zhe'o//—'dab ma gsum gsum du skye bas/'dab gsum pa zhes so//tshos kyi 'byung gnas yin pas/tshos kyi ma zhe'o//rgya skyegs kyi ming / rgya skyegs shing las byung ba'i tshos yin pas/rgya tshos —nga zer ri mo sogs bri bar cha shas dmar bo can mtshon par byed pas/ mtshon —byed ce'o//—kha dog dmar po yin pas dpe'i sgo nas srin po'i khrag dang /lha mo'i zla mtshan zhes pa'o//—sgron shing gi ming /thang chus zin pas/thang chu shing dang /bcud 'dzin zer/shing 'di sbar na me lce mchen bla zhing sgron me byed chog pas/me lce'i shing zer ro/lcang ma'i ming /chu bo'i 'gram du skyes pas/chu klung skyes zer/me tog gi dbyibs dang kha dog thin dkar po dang 'dra bas smin gyi me tog ce'o/—chu klung gi rgyud du skyes pas/bsil shing dang /bsil nags she'o//——574

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreng ba/ja shing gi ming /'di'i lo 'dab lo rer lan bdun gce ༄ pa'i dang bo la/me rtog g.yang 'dzin zer——nus pa bsil la ba ba pa sel bas tshab pa 'joms zer— —nga shing phran 'di dang thog lha yul na yod pa/ bya tshe ring gis lo 'dab 'bras bu dang bcas pa'e yal ga zheg mar phab pas/stong khun rgyal bo'i sras tshad pas bsnyun pa'i pang du lhung bas lo ma zhal du myang sa pas nad las grol te/ 'bras bu sa la brta ba pa skyes nas rgya yul du 'phe' bar grags pa las/lha yul nas 'phos te sa la skyes ba sa/'phos skyes she'o//——ta mā la'i ming rgya mtsho'i nye 'khor du skyes pa'i ljon shing lo ma sngo nag —can yin pas/sdong nag dang /nag po'i phung bo dang /mun pa 'dzin sogs nga nga —su grags/tsha gdung nges par srung bas/nges sprung dang /gdung skyob ce'o//nga —star bu'i ming /tsher ma gla ba'i spu las 'dzings pas rje gla tshor zhe'o//—— sngon sgra gcan gyi kha'i thigs pa sa la lhung ba las skyes pas/ sgra gcan ——skyes zer/—sil star bu smin che dmar po me'i mdangs dang ldan pas me ldan ma ——zhes so/stag pa'i ming shun pa mthug pas/pags pa can zer/nga —67 6

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreng bgrags pas/bud med 'gram chang mnyes zhes pa'o/nga nga ba ta'i ming /shing thog bcud can thogs pas/bcud skye zhe'o//——nga ———'bras du sdong mgor thogs pas/'bras ldan mgo rgyan dang /nga — — —'brar bu rtag tu gnas pas/'bras bu rtag dang /— ——shang chog sgo nga'i dbyibs can mang du thogs pas/ 'bras du'i phung bo ———che sa so/ byi tang ga'i ming / bod skad du sren bu 'jom zer ) sman gzhung du/nga rang nus 'bru res srin du yi/ /grong khyer bco brgyad 'jom par nus/ /zhes pa/don med ma yin don yod yin pas/don yod 'bras bu zerasrin nad 'joms par dug dang 'dra bas/srin dug ce'o//——sbrang shing gi ming / ro mngar mo dang ldad pas/ mngar gnas dang /mngar ba 'dzin dang /mngar shing dang /snang rtsi'i sngon pa sogs su grags/———— —nga me tog la bu ra lha bu'i ro yod pas/bu ram me tog zer/nags tshal gyi nang dang logs su skye bas/ nags lobs can dang /nags su rab gnas she'o//—— sro lo dkar po'i ming gangs ri g.ya' ri pa las skyes sheng / tsha ba'i nad kun 'joms pa'i stobs kyis/ stag gam seng ge'i gzugs su bkod nas/gangs kyi seng chung dang ——— —————577

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung 1 rang bzhin ha cang bsil bas/ stag sman zil can zhe'o/ /— ———tsha nad 'joms par dug lha bu yin pas/ gangs sprul dkar po zer/ ——sha yu mo glo tsha byung bar 'di zos nas drags pas/ yu mo glo sman du ——grags/ hong len gyi ming / (ser tshos)rteng bar sder mo'am sug pa lha bu'i rtsad pa thogs pas/ sug pa skyes dang / khra'i sder mo dang / bya rgan sug pa zhe'o/ / ——— —don lnga'i tshad pa sel bar ga bur la co 'dri bas/ ga bur zil non —zer sdong skam steng du skyes pas/ shing skyes dang /shing gi bcud 'dren pas/ shing za zhe'o/ /——sa phyag gi ming 1 srib mo'i na spang dag tu skyes shing / me tog dmar ser gur kum dang 'dra bas/ spang gi gur kum zhe'o/ /me tog gi dbyibs lug mig dang 'dra zhing / de las chung bas/ lug ——chung dang / gnod sbyin mig kyang zer/—'di'i lo ma sna khung du bcug cing / phyi nas 'phur na sna khrag 'bab par 'gyur bas/ rdzum du khrag gtar zhes pa'o/ /ma sprul gyi ming / rtswa ri sogs su skyes pa'i utpal gyis sa yi bcud rkang bas 'thungs nas me tog gi steng du zil ba rgyun du gnas pa'i mtshan nyid 578

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreng bdang ldan pas/rteng 'thung zhe'o//me tog gi steng du zil ba 'phyang bar byed pa'i nyams dang ldan pas/'phyang byed zer/—nga 'di dge dang she'u dag gis zos na/lang tsho dar bas/ dge'u dar dang she'u dar zhe'o/———ku sha'i ming /tsā yi mchog yin pas/rtswa mchog dang /rtswa dbang zhe'o//—mchod sbyin gyi rgyan du 'jug pas/mchod sbyin rgyan zhe'o//—'di sngon tsā 'tshong bkra shis kyis bcom ldan 'das la phul ba dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis dka' spyad lo drug la gdan du bting bar mdzad pas/mchod sbyin gdan dang /bdud 'dul gdan zhe'o//nang ba'i chos lugs pas dad ldan dar sa la 'dis byabs khrus mdzad pas/khrus rtswa dang /dag byed dang /gtsang byed ce'o//—kon pa gab skyes kyi ming /sha dug 'jom par 'di gcig pus thub pasasha dug chig thub zer/rma ni shid tu tshabs che zhing / /chag 'jigs nyes tshad glang chen lhar/ /khros kyang seng ge mi 'jigs pas//seng ge 'jigs med ces par grags/khrog chung ba'i ming /khrag gcod pa'i nus pa dang ldan pas / khra cad ce'o573

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung —lo ma'i rtse mo phra zhing rnying ba zheng che bas/ khras gcod ral ba can zhe'o/ /— ————— — — —rjod 3 rgang gi mid / gzhung rta'i zur bzhi logs brgyad lo ma brtsebs pa'i mchod rtsen 'dra ba'i rtse mo la/ rab mdzes lha'i 'a dkod pa'i chun pos brgyan pa rgyal mtshan gyi tshul du snang bas rgyal mtshan mchod rten can zhe'o/ / —— ——nga — ———me tog dkar tshu yin pa dang / khrag mkhris sel bar/ sbyor sdeb grogs su ma bltos par rang gcig pus thub nga sa/ dkar po chig thub zer/—— ——nga —gur kum kyi ming / bskal ba bsum ldan dus su/ kha che'i yul chus gang ba ste/ ri noms kyi stod las cher mi mngon pa'i dus der/ ri phug tu dgra bcom pa nyi ma gung bya ba zhig thugs dam la bzhugs par/ klu'i dbang bo rnams za ngon par dad cing chos zhu ba'i tshe/ dgra bcom pas klu rnam sa la1 dkon mchog mchod pa dang / 'gro ba'i nad sel ba'i phyir/ gur kum 'debs sa bslangs pas phul ba bzhin mtsho bri1 dgra bcom pas ri bo bya rkang nas sa bon blangs te btab/ de nas rim gyis skye sa rgya cher khyab bo skad1 des na sma na chen 'di thog mar dgraXbacom pa nyi ma gung this rnyed pa yin pas/ nyi ma ——gung rnyed ce'o/ /— — ri bo bya long du skyes pa'i rigs la yul de nyid kyi ming thogs pas/ bya —kang ba zhe'o/ /— ———me tog 'jam dbyangs kyi mdog lhar ngur thig yin pas/ 'jam nga 580

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreng ba/dbyabs mdog can zhe'o/nga ——sdong bu'i rtse na me tog me ltar dmar ba yod pas/me'i rtse mo zhes so//——nus pas lang tsho'i dpal bskyed pas/dpa ba dang /———lus zungs bskyed nas srog brtan par byed pas/brtan pa zhe'o//mchin nad gsar rnying sel bas/mchin sman gtso bo zhes so//——go snyod kyi ming me tog dkar po gdugs lhar klum pas/ gdubs nga dkar zhe'o//nga —mig nad sel bas/mig la phan dang mig gi gnyen zer/— — nga ——gres ma'i ming / nus pa bsil drod gnyis ka ldan pa/ tsha shas che la nga nga nga bsil dud 'gyur/grang shas che la drod du 'byur/tsha grang 'dres la snyoms par ldan pas/nus pa gnyis ldan zhe'o//sngon spyan ras gzigs kyis ma 'ongs pa'i 'gro rgyud la dgongs pa'i— nying nge 'dzin la bzhugs pas/ dus kyi phyi mar dug gi sbyor bas 'jig rten phung ba'i dus tshod 'byung bar gzigs nas/ 'gro la thugs brtse ba'i spyan chab mang du zun cing smon lam mdzad pas/ sa gang du'ang skye bar gyur brjes / khyab skye zer/—'di'i me tog bzhad pa dang /khu byug dgod pa'i dus thog mnyam pas/khu byus me tog ce'o//——— nga 58

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zungadug nad can la bdud rtsi dang 'dra bas/ dug gi gnyen po zer/rtsa ba brdungs nas bcing ba'i khu ba mes tshig pa'i rma la bskus na myur du 'tsho bas/ mes tshig sos zhes pa'o/ /——gla sgang gi ming(mon lug)/ gzhung rta phra mo tshigs pa can drang mor skyes ba pa / rlung kha las 'khyog par g.yo zhing gar byed pa'i dam pa dang ldan pas/'khyog gar dang / tshigs stong can zhe'o/ /rtsa rdog gi zhabs na rtsa phran phra la ring ba sa 'og yongs su 'thor ba bzhin khyab par 'dug pas/ yongs 'thor zhe'o/ /rang bzhin bsil la zhu nus dro bas/ bsil nus she'o/ /lcam pa'i ming / nus pas chu 'gags 'byin pas/ sngon po chu khrid ce'o/ /——nyi ma gar gnas la me tog kha blta bar dga' ba'am/ gus pa'i tshul snang bas/ nyi dga' dang / nyi mar gus pa zhes so/ /tsā dur ba'i ming / 'di'i me tog chun po snye ma lha bu ka klum dbyibs 4 chags shing / glang chen thal dkar gyi mdog dang 'dra ba/ snye ma phra zhing thung ba spu dang 'dra bas/ glang gi spu skyes zer/rtsa ba lta bu'i gzhung rta sa la nyal ba'i thog la lo shubs mang ba skyes pas/sa yi 'dab dang /————sa 'og gi rteng bar rtsa phran spu lta bu mang bas/ sa yi spu zer/682

mngon brjod gzi yi 'byung bgazhung rta la tshigs pa mang bas/tshigs brgya ba dang /dum bu 'dzin pa —nga —zhe'o// — kha lung sogs la rtsa ba spang rgyus tsam las med kyang / klung chen 'gram dmas su rtsa ba mdzub mo'i sbom phra 'dom gsum bzhi tsam du skye stobs che bas/skye ldan dang /brtson 'grus brgya ba dang /nus pa stong ldan dang /mtha' yas nga nga sogs su grags/ sman du tshe sring ba'i nus pa dang ldan pas/tshe 'phel dang /'chi dka' zhe'o//'bu srin dug can khong du song ba'i dug zhi bas/sdig pa'i dug zer/'dam bu ka ra'i ming /chu nang skyod pa'i gru gu 'dzad par byed pas / gru —'dzad ces so//—rtsa ba'i ro mngar bas/rtsa mngar zhe'o//rkang kher skyes dang lo ma nas kyi ljang chung 'dra bas/ ljang lo chig skye zer/pu shel ci'i ming / ga bur gyi dri ma bro ba'i rtswa yin pas/rtswa ga bur zhe'o//spang rgyan gyi ming /gtam rgyud du/spang rgyan dkar sngo nag gsum lha mo nga spun gsum sprul nas/dpyid ka drod cung zad bab tshe/g.yar mo thang ba dang 683

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngod jing sga tig dang / ka tha gsum du 'khrungs pas na/ sman rigs zams cad mi skye rang dbang med pas dang / ston dus drod shor kha spang rgyan spun gsum du 'khrungs nas mjug sdud pa'i brda rgyag par1 sman rigs gzhan thams cad mi 'gro rang dbang med pas na/ gzhan gyis mi thub dab) gzhan las rgyal nga —— nga ——— — —zhe'o/ / — sngo sman thams cad kyi skye mgo 'dren pa dang mjus sdud pa'i lha mor grags pas/ sman gyi lha mo zhes so/ / — sngo'i lha mo 'dis sos kar sngo sman kun gyi sna khrid de kun tu bzhad par 'gyur bas/ kun tu bzhad ce'o/ /ri bo'i stod du skye zhing me tog mdzes pas/ ri bo'i rna rgyan zhe'o/ /—ston rting sa 'khyag khar bzhad pas/ ston gyi me tog ce'o/ /— — —— ——tshad nad thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i nus pa bsil ba 'dzin pas/ bsi' 'dzin zhe'o/ / ———spang spos kyi ming / dri ngad che zhing sdong du'i sto da de thong gar me tog —dmar ril le byas pas/ dri chen thob dmar zhe'o/ — ——— dri zhim la lha rnams mnyes pa'i byis pa dang 'dra bas/ dri'i sras po dang / ————————dri rdzas zer/—rteng bar lo ma rnying ba sgrug nag skud pa lta bus bstums nas yod pa/684

mar dbarjod gzi yi 'phreng ba1dpe 'byung bo'i ba ba'i gzugs su bkod nas 'byung bo'i ral ba zer/———ral ba can ba yang ngo / ——————gzhub rta'i stod du ba spu thung ba gra gnyis tsha mnyam du skyes shing / smad kyi mtha' khar ba spu khyab das yod pas/ spu can ma zhe'o/ /ba sha ka'i ming / me tog rta'i so rter ba sa/ rta yi so can dang / rte so me tog ce'o/ — — — ——'di'i lo sdong bcad 'phro khrag dron nang du bcug na/ khrag 'thungs nas rtse mo'i bar du 'dren nus pas/ khrag 'thung zer/————nus pas khrag mkhris sel bas/ khrag skem zhe'o/ /ba gcig ༵/ skya ha/bdal ba brgyad/ 'a~X ba'i ༵ ༵ ༵// /ming dī bdun ༵ dmag tshogs g.yos/ /srog gi nor bu gzhom nye tshe/ /sring gcig dpa' bos ra ༵ yin bdud/ pyi /rdo rdo~X dī ༵ ༵bas/ ༵dī/ —sbyog ya rno ༵ḍi ༵ ༵ dī~X la zhes bya ba zhig byung / de la tshangs pas hūṃ ring gis gzir bas snang gzugs zhi nas rgyu ba dang / mi rgyu ba'i dug rigs so sor thim pas mi rgyu ba'i dug gi nang tshan dug lnga'i rang mdangs byung ba'i btsan dug rigs lnga dang / ra dub spyang dug bcas rigs bdun skyes te/ skye 'gro'i srog 'phrog 685

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /par brtsams pa'i tshe/ sman gyi lha mos mngon mkhyen gyis gang gi dug de dag sgas 'gro ba'i srog 'phrog par gzigs nas/ de dag gi stob nus 'jom byed kyi gnyen po'i smad zhig skye bar smon lam btab pas/ bdud rtsi zag skya ha bo zhes dug rigs thams cad 'jom byed kyi man mchog 'di 'khrungs pas na/ ming bdun sring gcig tu grags so/ /dug 'jo sa stobs che ba'i dpe'i gzugs su btsun mor bkod pas/btsun mo re ral dang / lha lcam ma zhe'o/ /gong 'dzin rdo rje'i brag las skye zhes zag stod du skye bas/ gong ba 'dzin pa zhes so/ /——brag spos kyi ming / lo ma sngo lngang gi 'og tu gser jig gzig gi mjug ma lha bu tshod pas/ gzig mjug 'dra dang / g.yu ber gser rgyan zhe'o/ /mgo chag pa'i rus pa sbyor byed kyi kum sman yin pas/ mgo chag gsang lhum zhe'o/ /—rgod thang dkar gyis rus pa rmas ma thag zag spos la bsten das slar sos pas/ thang dkar bcad 'byor zer/bre ga'i ming / sdong du'i steng du 'bras bu leb mo snying go ldog lta bu'i 'dab gshog zheng che ba rnga dbyibs can thogs pa bon pos rnga khur ba dang mtshungs pas/ bon po rnga khur dang / 'dre rnga khur zer/686

mngon brngod gzi yi 'phreng ba/de yang dge slong gis chab ril btags pa 'dra bas/ dge slong chab ril zhes pa'o/—'bu su hang gi ming / rtsad pa ring du thogs sar che bshad dang yag bshad byas nas/ rgya mtsho'i mthar thug dang / lha'i 'phreng ba dar /— —lha mo'i 'khri shing sogs su gragasalo sdong du me tog ser po bzhad pas/gser gyi cod pan zer/klad nad gso ba'i snan༄chog yin pas/gtam rgyud dang 'brel nas/co ga klad sman dang /byi'u rgad sman dang /lu gu kad snan zhes pa'o//'bri ta sa 'dzin gyi ming / ngar ba dmar po sa steng khyab pas/ ba thag —dmar po zhe'o//ngar ba sa la nyal zhing ring ba keng mgor dkris na thang la rgyag srid pas/dpe'i sgo nas sa 'dre zhes pa'o//nga 'bri mog gi ming / rtsa ba'i rtsi dmar po yin pas/ ji'i khrag dang /'byung bo'i khrag ce'o/ri las 'ong ba'i tshos yin pas/ri tshos zhes pa'o// nga rtsad kyi ming / dug nad zams cad 'joms par nus pas/ dgu thub cem//dri che chung las 'bam po dang nor dogs yod pas/ yul skad du rtsad —587

nga dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung pa rtsod pa zer/ ———gze ma'i ming /zu ngam thang du skyes pas/chu med skyes she'o//— ————rtsad pa ha cang ring bas/mtha' rnyed dka' dngan rgya mtsho'i mtha' can nga nga —zhe'o/1 tsher ma'i reg bya tsub pas rje reg dka' dang /reg sdug dang /'dzugs ——— nga —nga byed dang /ngu byed mas gas su grags go/ —— ————ga kar yo thang ba'i ming /no'u ga ming du skyes shing /me tog pad ma rā ga ltar dmar bas/gsing ma me tog dang /ga ming ma dmar po zhe'o//————ra mnye'i ming / tshe ring rgas sra bcud len mchog yin pas/ rgan po ——gzhon nur byed pa zer/——lus zungs nyams pa gsos das 'dod pa spyod pa'i nus pa bskyed pas/ro tsa zhes so //——ma rnyi ka'i ming rtsa ba dkar zhing / 'di gcig pus kyang dug gi nad rnams sel thub pas/dkar po chig thub ce'o//————dug nad med par gtong bas / dug med ce'o//——byir dug 'gyur dug mgo mi sogs 'phral du 'joms la 'jigs mi dgos pas/a'u rtsi zhe'o/—'di'i rtsa bas dug nad dang /lo mas chu ser gyi dad dang /'bras bus588

mngod brjod gzi yi 'phreng ba/mgo nad dang / rting bas cha ba'i nad rnams sel bas:/ 1dud cig 'joms zer/————'di'i sdong bu dang me tog sgrug shas che ba dang 1 sman nus che bas/ klu —bdud nag po zhe'o/ / —————gzhung rta phra mo drang bor gyen du skyes thog nu ma lha bu'i 'bur bo dkar po yod pas1 'o ma 'dzin pa zhes bya'o/ /—————rtswa a wa'i ming 1 dbyibs spya khab gshibs pa 'dra zhing / me tog dkar ba po cung zad yod pa'i mo rigs la/ dngul gyi mo khab zer/ (pho regs la me —————tog med)ma dog dngul dang dbyibs thur ma phra rma gshibs pa lhar mchis pas/dngul thur zhe'o/ /———a la'i ming / sha mo'i rigs srug mdangs chags pa/ mgo dang yu ba sha mo ltar 'brel la gcig par snyes pa/ nang ris sul phra zhib glad nas yu bar thon pa/ sman rtsa chen zhis yin/ de sha mo'i rigs dang mthug la ko ba lhar snang bas/ ko sha zhe'o/ /——klung sha'i ming / ro lan tshu dang ldan pas tshwa sha zer/—— ———dkar sha'i ming / mdob dngul lhar dkar bas/ dngul sha zhe'o/ /sgrug sha'i ming / mang la zhib pa gral greng du skye bas/ lu gu brgyud zer/—589

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zungalud sha'i ming 1 dug dang ldan pas/ dug sha zhe'o/ /——shing sha'i ming / dbyibs ri dwags dgo ba dang sha ba'i grod pu dang 'dra bas/ dgo grod dang / shā grod zer/——ser sha'i ming / gser gyi mdog dang 'dra bas/ gser sha zhe'o/ /pha ba dgo dgo'i ming / sha mo'i rigs yin zhing / dug shin tu che bas sgad pas cha nas/ 'dre sha zer/——'di bskams na thal ba'i thum dang 'dra bas/ 'dre thal thum dang / spyang — ——ki thal thum zhe'o /—rang tshugs thub pa nang gi thal ba rkom tshugs byas pa bzhid dbyibs lnga ba ltar gum mi 'gro bas/ 'dre mo thal rkom zer/kas nas bskams na dang du zal ba ser nag 'thul bas/ ma bsregs thal ser zhes pa'o/ /lo tog spyi'i ming / zhing du skyes shing 'bras bu thogs pas/ zhing thog ce'o/ /lo tog smin par mi rnams dga' bas/ rangs byed zer/ka ped kyi ming / 'bras bus tsha 'khru gcod pas/ 'khru gcod ce'o/ /ped thog che ba lug zang gi grod pa tsam yong ba'i nang du lha ba dkar sob kyis gang ba'i gseng na/ sa bon gyi 'bras dkar leb gser me'i phyogs 690

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreng ba/dbyibs yod pas/gser la phud pu zer/——ped thog nang lha ba dkar sob dra ba'i tshul du yod pas/ dra ba can —— nga zhe'o//sdong bu ring du skye bas/sdong bu ring zhe'o//———'bras bu khu tshur tsam byung tshe/ 'og tu rdo leb bzhag par nyi mas dros pa'i rkyen gyis 'ams bu cher myur bas rgyas pas/rdo zog shing skyes she'o//sngon shing gi lha mos bcom ldan 'das la shing thog gi snying bo 'il bka ped chung bo'i rigs kyi phul te/bkra shis pa'i ji sa su byin gyis brlabs pasa'abras mchog dang /dpal 'bras zhes pa'o/——ka ra'i ming /tshad pa sel ba'i sman rta yin pas/mgyogs byed dang /—nga ——rgyug byed ce'o//khrag mkhris tsha ba sel bar 'dis sman nus rtsa la 'khrid pas/ rtsar khrid ce'o//nus pa bsil bas tshad pa sel ba'i smanas rta yin pas/bsil rta zhe'o//ske tshe'i ming /ngar ba'i mgo na me tog ser po bzhad pa dpe'i sgo nas/zangs kyi gtsug phud ces pa'o//——ro tsha la tsub pa dang snum che bas kyi tsha ba'i rdzum cad zer ro//——khri'i ming /snye ma byi la'i mjug ma dang 'dra bas/ byi la'i mjug ma —59

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngod zung zhe'o/ /'bru'i shud pa bgrus byung ba'i dru ma ser po yin pas/ dka ba zhes bad/ — gro'i ming 1 gro byes bza' btung ci byas kyang yid du 'ong bas/ yid ———bzang dang / yid legs she'o/ /—— ————sga skya'i ming / sman dang spod du 'gro bas/ kun 'jub ce'o/ / — ———sgog pa'i ming / sngar lha dang lha ma yin gyis bdud rtsi rtsod par/ lha min dbang bo sgra gcan 'dzin gyi ske tshangs pas 'u khor los bregs pa'i khrag gi thigs pa sar lhung ba las sgog pa'i ribs byung bar grags pas/ lha min khrag ————— —zer mi dge ba'i nad med par gtong bas1 mi dge med ce'o— /'di'i nus pas rlung srin dug mjo gcin sri sel zhing 1 yi ga 'byed cing skra skyed cham pa 'gog pas/ sman chen zer/ro dpa ldan pas/ ro ldan dang /——ro drug las lan tshun ro gcig chad pas/ ro gcig chad ces so/ /— nga —ste nag gi ming / sa bon gyis stong bas/ son long ba zhe'o/ /— ——— —sol ba'am dud pa dang mtshungs pas/ ma bsregs sol ba dang / me med nga ———— —— — ——dud pa zhe'o/ /——692

nga dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung —rtsa ba ni sman du 'jug pa dang /tshod ma rngo byed kyi dri rdzas bzang bo yin pas rje rtsa ba bzang zhes so// —— ca su'i ming /'bras bu ga bu kha sbyor dang 'dra bas/ga bu kha spyar zer—nga nga nus pas sko ma ba sel bas/skom sel zhe'o/—— sdo— bu sna yal ga dang me tog mang bas/me tog brgya ba dang man lag —— —— ————brgya ba dang /brgya'i mi bas can zer/ —nga ——nga —yongs kar gyi ming / 'di sngon phyag na rdo rjes zas gtsang sus la phul nga —bas/sangs rgyas kyi rus 'di la thogs pas/zas gtsang dang /———'de sangs rgyas kyi phyag tu brgyud nas/ bkra shis kyi rdzas mthu stobs dang ldan pas/'dre dang 'byung bo sogs 'a thun brgyab na/gang dag ha cang 'jigs pas na/'byung bo 'jig byed ce'o//nga —thun dang sman rdza gnyis kyi go chod pas/dod grub ces so/——yung ba'i ming ( sga ser/khu rtsi ser po yin pas/khu ser ma dang ser ————— ———nga nga mo zhe'o//—'di'i mdog 'jam dbyangs kyi sku mdog gser gyi mdangs dang ldan par mtshungs pas 'jam dpal dang /mdog mchog mdog mdzes ma/—gser ldan ma sogs su grags/——————sman du rul ba 'jom pas/rul gcod ma zhe'o//———6 94

mngon brngod gzi yi 'byung ba/nus pas gser 'joms par byed pas/gser 'joms ma zhes pa'o//———yos kyi ming nas sogs g.yos nas tshos pa can yin ba pas/'bru brngos nga nga ma dang /brngos nas rnam par bkra zhing skye rgyu med pas/mdzes pa'i rma can — —zhes so/shing bal gyi ming / sa bon gyi phyi ngos su spren nam bal dkar po lha du thogs yod pas/smin bal dang khangs ba 'a zer/nga ——ras 'thag byed kyi bal yin pas/ras bal yang zer/so ma ra da ming /sdong bu mnyen zhing ring bas/lhug bzang zer/nga nga —— 'bras du'i kha dog nag rog ger yod pas / 'bras nag dang dpe'i gzugs su bkod nas/lug nag ma zhe'o//'bras bu'i shun pa sra bas/rus pa'i 'a sa bu zer/dza'i rigs me tog dkar zhib bzhad pa zla ba'i mdog 'dras gang bas/zla tshes rdul dang /sdong bu ring bas/zla ba'i rdzug ma zhe'o//nus pas mdze nad 'joms pas/mdze 'joms zhes pa'o//gsum pa/ srog chags sogs kyi skor/'dab chags spyi'i ming /dang bo sgo nga btang ba dang /de nas sgo nga las ———byung bas / sgong skyes dang /gnyis skyes zer/'dab ma skyod byed yin pas/'dab ma'i shing rta can zhe'o//9

dag yig rib pa'i gab pa mngon phyung steng nam mkha' nas 'phur bas/steng 'phur dang /mkha' skyod dang /—— —mkha' la rgyu zer/——phal mo che sdong bor gnas pas/nags khyim zhe'o//— —mgo dang gshog pa rkang ba mjug ma bcas yan 'a ga drug yod pas/yan lag drug pa zhe'o// ——chu bya spyi'i ming / nya la sogs pa zas su za bas/ chu ba/nas zas can — — —nga — nga zhe'o//chu kha na sgrog pas chur sgrog dang /chu nang 'dzul dab nya sogs 'dzin pas/chur 'jug ce'o//nga —ka la ping ka'i ming / skad kyi snyan cha che ba rgya' ba'i gsung dang 'ab bas/rgyal gsung rjes 'gro dang ka snyan sgrog ce'o// — — nga sgo nga'i spubs las grag pas / sgong nas skad 'byim zhes pa'o//—— skya rga'i ming /bya khra khra yin pas/'dab ldan khra mo zhe'o//mgron po ma bslebs gong du bza rgyag pas/mngon shes can zhes so//nga — ——sgyung ka'i ming / 'di grags na rlung bser du g.yug pa'i snga rtes yin pas/grang reg pho nya dang /yul ngan 'bod zer/— nga mchu tho dmar po yin pas/mchu dmar ma dang /byu ru'i mchu zer ro//———khu byug gi ming /khu byug gis sgo nga bya rog gi tshang du btang bar bya nga 596

mngon brngod ba yi 'phreng ba/ rog gis rum nas phru gu byung ba gsos nas 'tshar bar grags pas/ bya rog ——gsos dang / gzhan gyis gsos dang / / —— —sgo nga bya regs gzhan gyi tshang du bzhag nas bskyed bcol bar bsam pas/ gzhan la bsem zer — )mgrin pa las ku hu zhes skad snyan par grags pas/ ku hu'i mgrin can —dang / ku hu'i sgra can dang / ku tu 'don dang / ngag snyad sogs su 'bod/dbyangs skye —rnge rme pa bdun las lnga ba dang ldan pas/ snye ldan zer te/ lnga —ba me tog ldan dus su/ /khu byug skad snyan sgrog par byed/ 1ces pas/ lnga ba'i —dbyangs dang / sgra lnga bu dang /—〈 'dod pa'i bye/sa ༵nga bar dpyid sna dīX yo/ nga nas grags pas / dpyid kyi rgyal ka dang / 'dad paka pho nya dang / dpyid kyi dbyangs ldan sogs su 'bod do/ /khug rta'i ming / char la dga' zhing sgra sdil snyan lhar grags pas/ dang lta dga' ba'i sil snyan dang / char dga' dang / char sdod bye'u zhe'o/ /—sa la babs nas chu mi 'thung ste smin gyi bcud tsam 'thung bas chog pas/chu nyung zhes dang / nga sprin la chu slong bas/ smin la slong zhe'o/ /——bar snang du smin phung yar 'degs pa ltar 'phur bas/ sprin 'degs —697

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyur —she'o/ /'dam bag bskyel nas tshang ra bzo bas/ 'dam ra ba dang 1 'dag bye'u — — —zer/khri bya de pho'i ming / ku ku zhes sgra gnyis rer sgrog pas/ ku ku sgra sgrog dang / zung gi sgra sgrog zer/nam gung dang nyin gung lon par brda rgyag pas/ dus tshod smra ba dang /nam tshod 'dzin zhe'o/ /nam tshod bzung nas mi rnams la dga' ba ster bas/ dga' byed dang /bde legs can zer/nga sgo nga mang du btang nas mi gso bar byed pas/ gso byed ce'o/ /ske na byu ru'i mdangs dang ldan pa'i lkog shal yod pas/ byu ru'i lkog shal can zhe'o/ /mgo na ze dmar mdangs can yod pas/ zangs kyi gtsug phud can dang / zangs ze can dang / khyim gyi gtsug phud can sogs su grags pa'o/ /khrung khrung gi ming / rkang ba shin tu ring bes/ rkang ring zer/mjug ma mig sman lhar nag pas/ mig sman mjug ma dang / mjug nag ce'o/ /ston mjug 'tshogs nas sa cha dro sar gshar nas 'phur bas/ gshar —698

mngon brngod gzi yi 'phreng bskyod zer ro/ ——khra'i ming bye'u dang phug rom sogs bzung nas za bas/'dab chags —nga nga nga za dang /bye'u zas can zhe'o/— — nga sa ngos da bye ༄ dang byi ba sogs e mthong du bar snang na tshad gcig tu gshog pa g.yo bar byed pas/g.yo ba zhe'o//——'i ta'i ming /ka ka zhes sgra gnyis rer grags pas/ka ba nyis pa zer/nga nga — —bkra mi shis pa'i 'jigs skad sgrog pas jigs sgrog ce'o//— sems can shi bo'i ro rig na sgrog pas bden sgrog dang /bden pa'i ngag zer/——lus yongs rdzogs kyi sgro spu nag po yin pas/mdog gcig pa zhe'o/——gzhan khu byug gi phru gu gso bar byed pas/gzhan gso zhe'o//bya rog 'ug pa'i khon zhes pa'i gtam rgyud dang sbyar nas 'ug pa khon ———zer/zas su ru dang grong khyer sogs su skyod pas/grong khyer skyod ce'o/—go bo'i ming /lto ba me drod che la rus pa dang rdo yang zhu bas/byin za'i nga nga —nga —lto ba zhe'o/—rgas na mgo spu dkar por 'gyur bas/zla 'od skra can zer/—nga —'di'i brun sman du 'gro bas/mkha' lding bdud rtsi zhe'o//——99
