dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung /gong mo'i ming / zla ba'i 'od zer grub par byed pas/ zla 'od 'thung —dang /nga zang dang /'od la dga' zhe'o//khyi snyon gyis so btab nas snyos pa 'di'i skad thos na drag pas/ thos —grol zer/—glag gi ming / 'bye ba dang ri bong sogs gsod pas/ 'joms byed ———dang /ri bong za dang /lu gu'i dgra zhe'o//nga —— —gsod par mkhas pas/gsod mkhas she'o//ngang ba spyi'i ming sder mo'i skyi mo zel nas 'khor lo 'dra bas/'khor — lo'i yan las ba can dang /bsdus ming la 'khor lo'i las dang / dra ba'i rkang nga — —ldan zhe'o//—mgrin pa'i sgra grags tshul ro ngo'i dper bkod nas/ mgrin pa'i ngo rnga nga — can zer/—'degs 'jog dal bas/ zhi 'i 'gros can dang / 'gros mdzes —— —nga ———she'o//mtsho khar gnas pas/mtshor gnas dang /mtsho bya zhe'o//— —'dam bab dang 'dam rtswa za bas/'dam zan zer ro/—ngur ba'i meng / sder mo rnams skyi mos phan tshun sbyil nas 'khor lo'i dbyibs su gyur pas 'khor lo can dang /shing rta'i yan lag can zhe'o//— —nga 600

mngon brngod gzi yi 'phreng ba/po mo gnyis gnyis su 'grogs pas / gnyis gnyis spyod dang /——'dod pa'i dbang gis pho mo gnyis re 'bral med du gnas pas/'dod —pa ldan zhe'o/—mtshan mor khyo shug gnas so sor gnas pas/mtshan mo bral gnas zer ———ro/co ga'i ming /mkha' la lding zhing skad snyan 'byid pas/lding snyan zhe'o//nga nga gling du mdzu gu drug gis bsdebs nas 'bud pa bzhin snyan par grags pas/bye'u drug 'gyur zer/———chu skyar gyi ming /rkang ba ya gcig la brten nas lang dga' bas/rkang —gcig pa zhe'o//———gangs sbal gyi bzang sa yin par grags pas/ gangs sbal mdza' mo zer/nya bzung nas za bas/nya 'jigs byed dang /nya yi zas can zhe'o//sprin 'khrigs pa'i sngon du 'phur bas sprin gyi bya dang /sprin sngon zhes ——so//mchil ba'i ming / khang ba'i bya 'dab sogs na gnas pas/ khang bye'u ———dang /khyim du nyal zhe'o//— —'dis dus gcig la 'dod pa lan bcu gcig spyod nus pas/'dab —60

dag yig rig ba'i gab pa mngon phyung chags bcu gcig pa dang / —————nga —'dod pa nye bar chags pas/nyer chags zer/nas 'bru za bas/nas zan zhes pa'o//——'jol mo'i ming / khu byug gi skad lhar snyan par grags pas/ lnga ba'i —dbyangs ldan dang /gre 'gyur mkhan zhe'o//——sneng sa ming /'dis mi skad thung ngu mnyan rjes lad mo tsam bshad shes pas/ska da gnyis pa dang /rtse gnyis pa zer/———mchu gug pa yin pas/'khyog po'i mchu zhe'o//gshog pa mnyen zhing 'jam pa dang /kha dog lngang gu yin pas/'jam —lngang ba dang 'jam lngang 'dab ldan dang / margad 'dab can sogs su nga —grags/rgyud 'jam zhing yid gzhung bas/yid gzhung zhes so//———mgrin pa kha dog sum 'phreng dang ldan pas/sum 'phreng can zer ro//pu shud kyi ming /khyad chos la bltos nas/sgro yi gtsug phud zer/mchu tho ring bas/mchu ring zhe'o//dri ngan pa bro bas/dri nga'i 'dab chags she'o//nga —pha phang gi ming skyi mo leb mo'i gshog thogs can yin pas/ skyi leb —dang /pags pa'i 'dab ma dang /pags byi'u zhe'o//nga nga — —602

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreng ba/mdog ser nag nyid kyis/ rgya skyegs lta bu zhe'o/ /bya rog dang 'thab rtsod byung ba'i gtam rgyud las/ bya rog dgra zhe'o/ /mtshan mor phyi rol tu 'phur bas/ mtshan dus rgyu dang /—char ba 'bab pa'i mtshan mo 'phur sa med tshe khyim du 'gro bas/ khrim du —'gro zer/——sngon dud 'gro dang 'dab chags 'thab pa na/ — pha wang gis rgyang nas bltas shing / dud 'gro rgyal ba na/ dud 'gro'i phyogs su dud nas rkang lag dang so bstan nas/ kho'ang dud 'gro yin zer/ 'dab chags rgyal tshe/ yang 'dab chags phyogs su dud nas/ gshog pa bstan te kho yang 'dab zags yin zer/ phyis su dud 'gro dang 'dab chags 'dum par gyur nas/ g.yo sgyu can la blo gtad med/ ces phyogs gang gis kyang rig mi nyan par byur pas/g.yon ma zhes so/ /phug ron gyi ming / skad grags pa dig pa ltar mi gsal yang snyan cha dang ldan pas/ dig snyan zhe'o/ /lha ba'i mig phrul ler g.yo bas/ 'phrul ba'i mig can zhe'o/ /khang ba'i rgya 'ibs sogs su tshang bca' bas/ rgya phibs gnas 'cha' —dang / de'u zas su za bas/ rdo yi zas can zhes so/ /'dod chags ha cang skye sla bas/ skad cig 'dod ldan zer ro/ —603

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon jing /bya gag gi ming /mdag dkar po yin pas bya dkar zhe'o//— nga nga rkang ba ring bas/rkang ring dang /byin ring zhe'o//— —khrim tshang gis zas gtor ba da bas/ba gyi gtor za zhe'o//————zas 'tshol slad 'dam bag 'thor bar byed pas/ 'dam 'thor zhes so// ————bya rgod kyi ming /thang ga dkar bas/zang dkar zer/ 'a bo'i bshegad sgyu yod bar snang lding 'khor brgyab kas lha bas/ mkha' la ——'kho/ra dang /—nam mkha'i dbyings su bstod pas/ nam 'phang gcod byed dang /——mkha' skyod dang rlung kha yengs nas lding bar byed pas/rlung spyod ces so/—le bar stong gi sa na khrag thigs re yod na'ang mthong bar grags pas/ring du mthong zer/———nga srog mi gcod par sems can shi bo'i ro za bas/shi bo ro zan zhe'o//—rma bya'i ming /dug za bas/dug zan dang /———sgrul za bas/kag 'gro'i zas cad zer/mgo na gtsug phud yod pas/gtsug phud can zhe'o//— mgrin pa sngo sngo yin pas/mgrin sngon can zhe'o// —rna ba'i zur du mdog dkar pos bskor nas yod pas/ rna rgyan can 60

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon skyab mo yib ce'o/ /mgo byi la'i mgo dang 'dra bas/ byi la'i mgo can zhe'o/ /ba —— — — ———mtshan mo phyi rol tu bud nas 'phur bas/ mtshan rgyu dang / mtshan mo nga nga spyod zer/——'di chu khar bslebs na/ sram gyis nya bzung nas zas su 'dul bar grags pas/ sram gyis mchod pa zhe'o/ / —nga ———sngar bya thams cad 'dus nas rgyal bo bsko ba la/ 'ug pa la bltas nas kha cig na re/ 'di tshogs kyi dbus su brjid che/ mtshan mo 'gro na mig gsal/mgo la rwa yod pas rgyal bor 'os so/ /zer ba la/ khu ta na re/ 'di'i rkang ba ser kas gang ba bran rkang ba/ ma yar mo las sha brkus nas zos pas/ sha'i khu ba mig tu song nas zhag mig pa/ skad mi snyan te/ 'dun ma thams cad du 'ug pa'i sgra 'byin pas skad 'ug pa/ mgo la rwa byung ba ltas ngan yin pas bdag mi 'thad zer nas phur song ba dang / bya thams cad kyis bden no/ /nges pa'i rgyu mtshan tshang ngo zer nas/ 'ug pa bsgyur nas gyes so/ /de nas bzung ste/ 'ug pas bya rog la snying nad bzung bas/ bya rog dgra zer ro/ / ba ba —'ol ba'i ming / ping sgyur zhes skad 'byin pas/ ping sgyur zer/ mdog ba —ba ser skya yin pas/ 'ol ser zhe'o/ /ri skegs kyi ming / kang bar khra thig yod pas— kang bkra ma zhe'o/ /— —606

mngon brngod gzi yi 'phreng bami skad cung zad tsam 'a da mo byed thub pas/ rjod byed ma dang /——— — gtam brjod pa'i don 'bras med kyang / rjes 'brangs kyi snye ma 'dra yod pas/ brjod pa'i snye ma zhes pa'o/ /——— —————shang shang te'u'i ming 1 dug gis gdungs pa'am 'chi bar 'tsho bar byed ———————— pas/ dug sel dang / dug 'tsho byed dang / 'tsho byed sogs su grags/———————— nga —shing rta mo'i ming 1 shing brkos nas shing 'bu za bas/ shing rkon dang / ————shing mnyen pa za bas/ shing zan zhe'o/ /———shing bkos nas brlag pas/ shing 'joms she'o/ /—lce ring bas/ lce ring zhes pa'o/ /———— ——srin bya'i ming / mig ser skya yin pas/ ser skya'i lha byed ce'o/ /——nun nag nang du mig gis mthong bas/ mun pa'i mig can zhe'o/ /nyin mo long bas dga' ba dang bral bas/ nyin mo dga' bral zer/skad grags pa gad mo dgod pa dang 'dra bas/ gad mo'i dbyangs ldan nga nga che/sa so/ /mi rnams kyis de grags na bkra mi shis par brtsis pas/ than bya zer/—— sngod 'dab chags 'tshogs nas bya rgyal bsko ba'i 'dun ma byed pa la/srin byas khu byug 'bod du phyin/ de la khu byug gis tshod bgam du/ khyod kyi gzugs chung lugs sam dris pas/ srin bya na re/ nga na so gzhon nas skye 'phro 601

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung/yin pas lan byas/ khyod kyi mgo leb leb nyan pa ci yin/— lo mang lon pas lan byas/ mig ser ba ci nyes/ mar khu 'thung bas lon byas/ 'o na rkang las ser kha mang don ci/ zhag nya mig tsam kha la ma yong ba'i lan byas/ khyod nyin mo yibs nas bsdad pa ci ma rung / nga gcig pur song bas srog zon pa yin/khyod nub mo khu tang bsgrags nas ci byes/ nga la pha tshan dang spun zla mang bas 'bod brda brgyab pa yin byas/ de nas khu byug na re/ khyod kyi rdzun 'phongs khyod rang bstan/ /dris lan yid ches rang ma byung / /snga tshig phyi 'gal ya re mtshan/ /nga ni mi 'gro khyod rang song / /zhes ska da/ de nas srin bya la 'gal —— —'du'i rdzun can zhes grags so/ /—————sreg pa'i ming / gshog pa khra khra yin pas/ ga thog bkra zer/—me tog ku nud za dga' che bas/ ku mud zas can dang / ku mud bcud ——— — ——'thung dang 1 ku nud dga' zhe'o/ / —— — ——grog ma'i ming 1 rgyug 'dur che bas/ 'dur rgod dang / rgyu rgyu ra zer/— —— — —— ——lus kyi stod smad che zhing ked pa phra ba rdo rje dang 'dra bas/ rdo rje'i lus —————can zhe'o/ /————grog tshang gi ming / grog ma'i tshang du sa mkhar spungs das yod pas/grog mkhar dang / srin bu'i ri zhe'o/ / —— —sa mkhar mtho zhing 'dzul khung mang ba/ mig stong ldan pa'i brgya byin gyi 608

mngon brjod gzi yi 'byung ba/mgo bor dpe blangs nas/brgya byin spyi bo zer/gros ma'i sprang ci la/brgya byin sprung zhes pa yang /brgya byin gyi mig ltar ———khung du rab tu mang ba'i tshang nang gi sprang rtsi yin pa'i phyir ro//'gron bu'i ming /gna' dus rgya gar du 'di dong tshe byas shing /kha ngog zho ltar dkar bas/zho'i dong tshe zer/————'di rus pa dang 'dra zhing tshong byed spyad yin pas/rus zong zhes so// ——cha ga ba'i ming /tshag kyi ga tu grags pas/'bu tshag pa zhe'o//nga nga nga bye'u ltar cung zad 'phur thub cing 'ur sgra grag pas/bye'u 'ur ba dang ————dpe'i sgo nas/khyung phrug ce'o// —nga da byid kyi ming /gangs kyi sbal ba'i bsdus ming du/gangs sbal zer/——sman dus ro tsa skyed pa'i nus pa che bas/stobs skyed ce'o//de gangs ljongs 'khyags sar rtag tu gnas thub pa'i lus stobs ldan zhing /rgyab la pags pa mu tig gis g.yogs pa ltar 'od chem mer snang bas/stobs ldan su nyig gos can zer/ ri na skyes pas na/sa 'dzin skyes zhes pa'o//dar 'bu'i ming / dar gyi bal zag sgyug pa'i srid bu yin pas/ dar —srin dang /skud pa'i 'bu zhes pa'o//—tshe gang bor phyi spags thengs bzhir brje bas/pags rje ma zer ro/609

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyungadug zang gi ming / dug mdung yod pas/ dug ra can zhe'o/ /ba — —phru gu bskyang ba dang nyer mkho'i zas su sprung rtsi 'dang tshod tsam las mi bsag pas/ sprung rtsi ches nyung zhes pa'o/ /sdig pa'i mi11 / dur bas sdig pa 'joms par nus pas/ dur bas 'chi zer/mjug ma'i sne khar rwa lha bu'i kyu ba dug can zhig yod pas/ sdig pa ra can dang / srin bu tsher ma can zhe'o/ /—lus kyi dbyibs btsog pas/ lus mi sdug zer/ rdzum gyis nyams par byed pas/ rtsam nyams dang / mar nyams she'o/ /sdom gyi ming / spyod tshul myur ba sprel dang 'dra sa/ spre'u 'dra zhe'o/ /bal thag gi dra ba 'then pas/ dra ba can dang /bal rgya 'thag mkhas pas/ 'thag mkhan dang / bal rgya cad zhe'o/ /'bu skyog gi ming / tshang ra rnga'i dbyibs can 'khur bas/ rnga khur zer/—na bun byung dus tshang ra las mgo phyir bud pas/ da bun bu mo zhe'o/ /—sprung nag gi ming / bza' ba dang 'bu thal gtang ched/ sha la 'khor bar byed pas/ sha la 'khor zhes pa/dri ma gang btsog za bas/ dri ngan za zhe'o/ /sems can gyi lus rmas byung sar 'tshangs nas dag khrag 'jub pa dang /610

mngon brngod gzi yi 'phreng ba/'bu gtong bas/rmas sar 'tshang zer ro//————dung ba'i ming / legs sbyar gyi skad du lha ma ra zhes ra yib gnyis dang ldan pas/ra yig gnyis pa zer/—rkang ba drug yod pas/rkang drug ce'o/'khor nas 'phur bas/'khor 'gro zhe'o//———me tog gi bcud 'thung bas/me tog 'thung dang /sprung rtsi spyod dang / nga — sprang rtsi'i zas can dang /sprang rtsi'i brtul zhugs sogs su grags/—— —me tog gi rgyan du snang bas/rgyan can zhe'o//——me tog gi bcud dang rdul blangs pas/bcud 'dzid dang rdul 'chang nga nga zer/phru gu dmas sprung rtsi las skye bas/sbrang rtsi skyes dang /snang rtsi'i bu zer/sgang ma mang bo 'dus pa'i g.yo 'gul las snang rtsi'i spung bo 'dar bar byed pas/sprang rtsi 'dar dang /—sprang rtsi skyong mkhan yin pas/sprung rtsi'i bdag po zhe'o//sprang rtsi bsags pa dri ngad mnam pas/sngos dang ldan zhe'o—sprung rtsi sbyin par byed pas/bcud sbyin dang /mchog sbyin zhe'o/—me leb kyi ming /sgron me'i 'od la 'dzings nas srog lcebs pas/lceb ——'dre ma zhe'o/——6

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /me khyer gyi ming /'od dang bcas te skar ma bzhin du rgyu bas/skar skyod — ———ce'o/mtshan mo mkha' la snang bar byed pas mkha' snang dang / nam mkha'i 'od ce'o//—mtshan mo mkha' la phur nas 'od kor tsam gsal ler shar bas/ nam —mkha'i nu khyud ce'o//mtshan mor 'od gsal bar rtser pas/mtshan mo gsal dang /—nyin mor 'od mi gsal bas/nyin mi gsal zer/—'od chung ngu sa bon tsam du snang bas/'od kyi sa bon zhe'o//—shing 'bu'i ming /shing za bas/shing zan dang /shing zos nas yi ge brkos pa lhar gyur pas/yi ge ba zer/shing bzas nas brlag pas/shing 'joms zhes pa'o//gcan gzan spyi'i ming /ri dgas sogs gsod pas/ri dwags za byed — nga —dang / ri dwags dgra dang / srog chags gtum po dang / sha zan sogs su —grags so//ce spyang gi ming ( 'phar ba/ tshugs ka khyi dang pha ka cher 'dra bas/ khyi —'dra zhe'o/ —rkang rjes lag rjes thog spos nas 'gro bas/rjes gcig ba zer/—62

mngon brngod ga mi yi 'phreng ba/nags nang gi khyi 'dra ba yin pas/ nags khyi zhe'o/ /—stag gi mib / skad 'jigs pa sgrog pas/ bar skad can zhe'o/ /—dpa' rtsal che bas/ brtul phod can zhes so/ /—dri bsnams nas pha rol bo ci dang thag nye ring brtag pas/ dri snom ——zhe'o/ / lus la spu ris ser shar nag shar spel mar yod pas/ lus bkra dang /ris bkra zhe'o/ / ———dom gyi ming / thong ga na spu dkar po tshom du zhig yod pas/ snying dkar zhe'o/ /rtag par phug pa sogs su nyal bas/ phug nyal zhes so/ /dom mkhris kyi ming / dom gyi dang ga dkar dang / de'i mkhris pa sman du pho ba'i zas skom rnams 'drul zhing / me dang mthun pa'i las byed pas/thugs kar me mnyam zer/ srog 'tsho byed zas skom dab / zas skom 'ju byed me drod de mkhris pa yin la/ lus kyi lang tsho me rtog gi gzugs su bkod nas1srog gi me tog zer/nus pas rtsa kha sdom par stobs che bas/ rtsa sdom dang / rtsa sdom shugs —chen zhes ba'o/ / —spyang ki'i ming / lug gsod par dga' bas/ lug gi gshed ce'o/ /—————613

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung lug sogs de'i tshang gi nye sar song na mi 'tshe ste/phru gu la gnob dogs kyis g.yo thabs kyi sgo nas tshang srung bar byed pas/g.yo spung zhe'o//—nga —dbyi dkar gyi ming / rna ba'i rtse na spu rwa lha bu yod pas/ no tsor can —zer ro wa'i ming /g.yo sgyu mang bas/sgyu mang dang /ngan g.yo ma dang slu byed nga — nga dang /gcan gzan khram pa sogs su grags/sa sros pa'i rjes su myos byung ba ltar brgyal bas/sa myos dang /—de brgyal ba na phe 'debs sheng ngu ba 'dra bas/ phe ngu dang / phe sgrog — —zer/sgang ma'i tshang brlogs nas sprung rtsi za bas /sbrang ma'i dgra zhe'o/gzig gi ming lus la thig les khyab pas/thig le'i lus dang /pags — nga bkra zer/khyi la snang bas/khyi gshed zer/ —seng ge'i ming /gcan gzan rnams kyi rgyal bo lha bu yin pas/gcan —nga gzan rgyal bo dang /sder chags dbang bo zer/—gcan gzan dang ri dwags thams cad zil gyis gnon pas/ dam —gnon zer/—ri dwags rnams kyi srog 'phrog par byed pas/ 'phrog byed dang /'jigs gnon zhe'o//64

mngod brngod gzi yi 'phreng ba/rkang ba rnams kyang kha ltar pha rol bo 'joms nus pas/ gdong lnga ba ———dang /kha lnga ba zhe'o/glang bo che yang gsod par nus pas/ glang bo 'joms dang / glang bo —'tshe byed ce'o// gnya' ba na spu sngo sngo ring ba ral ba'i tshul du yod pas g.yu ral can dang /ral ba'i khur can zer/——skad kyi nga ro che bas/nga ro can zer ro//——ri dwags spyi'i ming /nags tshal du 'tsho bas/nags su spyod ce'o//nyer mkho'i pags pa 'byung ba'i lus can yid pas/ pags pa'i skye gnas she'o//—gcan gzan gyi gnod pa byol bar rlung lhar myur ba'i 'gros kyis srog thar bar byed pas/rlung gi srog dang /rlung 'gros zer/spu kha gzugs sgrib pa'i sa'i mdog dang 'dra bas/sa yi mdog dang /sa lus she'o//—rkyang gi ming / rnam pa rta dang 'dra bas/ rta'i ri dwags dang rta'i —gzugs can zhes pa'o/kha skya bo yin pas / kha dkar zhe'o//gla ba'i ming /lte ba na dri tshus bzang bo yod pas/lte ba dri cad dang /66

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon sgyung/dri bzang ci can zhes pa'o/——— —gla rtsi'i ming ri dwags gla pho'i lte ba las byung ba'i dri rdzas yin pas/—ri dwags rtsi dang / lte ba'i dri dang / dri'i rtsi dang / dri yi rgyal bo sogs su — —nga nga ———grags 'doms kyi pho mtshan khar chags pa'i ngad rtsi yin zhing / shun pags kyi 'thums nas 'dug pas/nga mas kyi ngad ji dang /sri ḍi bab ba nga zera'adis sgrul la gdug pas sprul gyis dri ma tshor na byol nas 'gro bas/sprul skrag byed dang /sprul dug ce'o//sprel gyi ming /nags su gnas pas da/nags gnas zer/——sdong bo'i yal ga la gnas pas/yal ga'i ri dwags she'o//bya spyod mi dang 'dra bas/mi dang bad ba zhe'o'agro stangs mchong zhing rgyug pas/rgyug mchong dang /mchong byed dang /— —'phar 'gro zhe'o// gdong gnyer mas gang bas/ gnyer ma'i gdong dang / bzhin ngan —zhe'o// 'brong gi ming / gangs rir gnas shing g.yag dang 'dra ba / gangs —g.yag ce'o//—bre snye mchu tho'i spu kha ser skya yin pas/gre ser zhe'o//nga 66

mngon brjod ga yi 'phreng ba/ gzugs mo'i ming / za bar dogs shing sgrag pas spu gzeng bar byas te nga ——nga —nga nga ——khyi la bsgrun pas/sdi nga nga zerabyi ba'i rigs la spu thur skyes pas byi thur zer sdeb sbyor du rtags mtshungs 'dren par rtsos das / byi dur zhes nga 'ang snang /ri bong gi ming /lhol zhing sding ba lhar rgyug pas/lhol lding zhe'o//nga nga ———mi yis bdag tu bzung med pa dang / kad pa'i zur gyi da ba bong bu'i rna ba ltar ring 'ing cor bas/ bdag med bong du'i klad pa dang / rna cor — —— nga zhe'o// sha ba'i ming /ra la yad lag bcu yas mas yod pas/rwa bcu ba zhe'o//nga nga bas sha chen zer/ —nga —nga shā rwa'i ming /shā rwa gsar skyes snyi zhing snying bo khrag dang min spu thung thung skyes nas yod ba la khrag rwa dpo / ———ra khrag 4bag 'bog yin pas/bog rwa zer ro//—— bse'i ming kher 'dug byed bas/gcig pur gnas she'o//phal mo che'i sna gdong du ra gcig tsam skyes pas/rwa gcig pa zhe'o/byi ba'i ming / 'bru sogs brkus nas za ba'am 'khyer bas/ rkun du —zer/khyim nang gi bza' bya dag bar lhad bas / khyim sbyong zhe'o//67

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyungakhung bu rko bar byed pas/rko byed dang /bu ga byed ce'o//nga khung dur 'dzul nas nyal bas/khung nyal ba zhes so//sgra tsi mi grags pas/tsi tsi zer ro//—glang bo che'i ming /rkang mthil 'khor lo'i dbyibs dang 'dra bas/'khor lo'i rkang zhe'o//—mgo na tsum pa'am nu ma rgyas pa lha bu'i 'dur tho zhig yod pas/bum pa —can dang /myos bum can zer/ —sna ring zhing zhags pa ltar gzung bya zin pas/sna ring dang /sna zhags —can dang /dbyug pa'i sna can dang /lag ldan sogs su grags/ — nga nga mche ba gnyis sbom zhing ring la stobs dang ldan pas/mche ba can dang /mche ba stobs ldan zer/—chu nang gi 'dam bu brdzis nas brlag pas/'dam bu 'joms she'o//——chu sna nas blangs te kha la lhug pas/gnyis 'thung zhes pa'o//—nga ma te'i ming /tsha gdung byol bar chu la zhugs pa 'dris shing goms pas/chur nga nga /—/rta la rdung bas / rta yi dgra zhe'o//gshin rjes ma ter bzhon par grags pas/gshin rje'i bzhon pa zhe'o//zhing rmod par byed pas/gshol ldan zhes so//——68

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreng ba/rnga mong gi ming mgrin pa gug pa 'khor lo'i nu khyed dab 'dra bas/nga 'khor lo'i mgrin zer/—————mchu sgros mar 'phyang bas/mchu 'phyang zhe'o//—— —rgyab na nog yod pas/nog ldan zer/mang bo gcig rjes gcig sprul nas 'gro sa/mang bo sprul zhes pa'o//——ra ma'i ming / sems can gzhan gyis bzung ba'i tshe skrag skad 'byin nga nga nga pas/skrag skad cad zer/nga nga ske na lnga ba 'phyang bas/lnga 'phyang zhe'o//—sdong bo'i lo 'dab zas su za bas/'dab zas she'o//— nga ma ne la spu ring ba skyes yod pas/ yog tshar cad dang / yog tshod can —nga ——zhes so//lug gi ming /lto ba 'phyang bas/lto 'phyang zhe'o/nga nga —nga bal 'jam zhing ring bas/bal ldan zhe'o//——phyugs g.yang dkar po yin pas/g.yang dkar zer/shed bzang bas bal la dkar mdangs chags pa gzugs phung sgo nga ril ler byas pas/shel snang zhes pa'o//———phag gi ming /mchu tho 'khor lo dang 'dra bas/'khor lo'i gdong dang /———gti nug pa dang 'khor lo'i gdong yin pas/tig mug 'khor lo zhe'o/——nga —6 9

dag yig rig pa'i dab pa mngon phyungamachu tho ring bas/mchu ring dang /mchu tho rko byed nyan pas/rdo ji'i mchu zhe'o//'khor lo'i mchus sa rko bar byed pas/rko byed dang /sa rlog dang /sa — — —'jom zhe'o//—rna ba che bsad can dang /da chen zhe'o//— ——spu tsub pa khab༄nga 'dra bas/khab spu can dang /spu rengs she'o//—— ———skyag pa za bas/skyag gzan/bshang gzan dang /bshang ba za rme'o/———ngur sgra sgrog pas/ngur sgra can zhe'o/phag brun la ga bur nag po zer te/phag brun nus sreg byas pa'i thal ba —ni/ gnyan tshad 'thab pa'i tsha ba ga ga bur lha bu'i nus pa dang ldan zhing /mdog nag po yin pa'i phyir ro//byi la'i ming /khyim du gnas shing yang rtsal spre'u dang 'dra bas/grong gi —spre'u zhe'o//——rtag tu gdong la slos byed pas/da mkhan zer/—nga mig kor kor yin pas/gong bu'i mig ce'o// ——mun nag las de'i mig 'od 'bar ba bzhin du mthong bas/'bar ba'i mig ce'o/—lan rer lus skum pa'am zhum pa'i tshul gyis 'gro bas/lus skum dang /620

mngon brngod gzi yi 'byung bzing zhe'o//byi ba bsad nas za bas byi ba gsod dang /bye ba'i zas can zerab nga ba sped par byed pas/bshang ba sped dang /nga — nga ces pa'o//khyi ༷ kang /sgo srung bar btsan pas/grob gi gcan gzan—zhe'o//bdag po'i rgyu nor srung bas/dang dang /srung byed rig pa gsal bas/ji gsang ba zhe'o//sems can gzhan mthong na zug pas/zug byed ce'o//mjug ma rdo rje'i dbyibs ltar snang bas/rdo rje'i mjug ma zer ro//——ba lang gi ming /skog shal 'phyang bas/skog shal can dang /lkog 'phyang zhe'o//1sdo'i ming ngur sgra sgrog pas/ngur sgra can zhe'o//rtsid pa dang ldan pas/rtsid pa can zhe'o//'brog pa'i longs spyod kyi rgyu nor rtsa chen yid pas/nor zhes pa'o//ḍi1na ma'i ba— /'o ma bzho bya'i gnas yin pas/sdo nga nga dang /ka bab bab ba༅ dang /bab ba byed lus ldan dang /nga sa ka dang /1rdo nga 1 dang /nga nga sogs su grags so/ba pa'i ming / rkang bzhi phyugs kyi nor dang ldan pas/ rkang bzhi'i no༅ ka zhe'o// 62

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon4nga/phyugs las thon rdzas kyis phyug par byur pas/ phyugs kyis ba phyug ce'o//rta nor lug gsum 'tsho skyong byed pas/phyugs skyong dang phyugs ji zhes pa'o —nga ba—mar gyi ming /'o ma'i bcud yin pas/'o ma'i snying bo dang /nga —— — nga —nga 'o ma bsrubs pa las byung bas/ srubs skyes zhes pa'o/—zho'i ming /'o ma ska bar rab tu chags pas/rab chags she'o——nga kha na 'o zhag pags pa ltar sra chags pas/pags mkhregs zer/—rta spyi'i ming /gom pa mgyogs pas/mgyogs 'gros dang / 'gros ldan ——nga nga dang /bang ldan zhe'o//nga — zhon pa ba dang khal dag rgyab tu 'dzinas pa lha bur snang bas/rgyab 'dzin nga nga zer/rngog ma skyes nas yod pas/rngog ma can zhe'o/mjug ma rnga yab dang 'dra bas/rnga yab mjug ma can zhe'o/lam 'dren par byed pas/'dren byed dang /—rlung ltar mgyogs pas/rlung gi shing rta zhe'o/————rgyun du tsā za bas/rtag tu za dang /yang yang za zhe'o//nga —thog mar rgya mtsho las byung bar grags pas/rgya mtsho skyes zer ro/—rta mchog gi ming /ci'ang shes pas/cang shes dang /kun shes zer/nga nga —622

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreng brna~X pa kun ༵ zhi dbyina~Xbs/༅par dul zhe'o// bo'ilha dbang brgya na bzhon pa yin pas/ tsho༄ ba zhe'o/ gro go shozhe ba'o / / ma pa rlung las myur bas/rlung las ba /༅ ka༅1 sa pa//drel gyi ming / khal 'gel shed che zhing ring du 'gro nus pas bar ba dang /bab bab pa gel ba~Xdang/bar ba na pas the zer/'i bopham rigs ba mchog yin pas/༅ bar rigs gnyis ba/pha ma ba me ga~Xmar bas gcig las ma/ gas gnyis ba//cig pa~X rgyu da na rabs gag las rgyud chad par gyur pas/ ka༅ 1ka~X dī/mi/ phe ba chece 0 nga / gtags na skad ba bgab na dang /4 'o// dzi se pe rje'irna ba gnyis ba'i tshan langs pa'i da phur bu'am rdo gzugs su bo sa/sdod sdi— da rgan ༵ /nga 4 zhe'o//de'i gseb la bab ba bab zer/ pho mtshan ring bas/chos can ring dang /pho mtshan langs pa'i dkre ni/ 'khor lo'i dbyibs dang mtshungs 6༵ ༵/

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon gyuba'atshar lo can zhe'o/—mi spyi'i ming /'gro byed rkang ba gnyis yin pas rkang gnyis pa zhe'o/nga nga nga —'gro ba rigs drug las mi'i 'gro ba yin pas/mi'i 'gro ba zhe'o//rgyud la skyon yon gang rung re zhig gang ba dang / re zhig zag pas na/gang zag ce'o//——bden par zhen pa'i dbang du gyur pas/bden zhen dbang byung zhe'o//blo dang ldan pas/blo ldan 'e'o//———'phags lam ma thob pa'i mi la so so skye bo zer———bskal ba thog ma'i mi la/shed bu zhes pa'o//— skyes pa'i ming /pho mo'i zlas phyed pa'i pho yin pas/mi pho zhe'o//——lus rten thob pa bzang bas/skye bas rgyal dang /skye bas mtho zer/— — ——nga khams dkar po'i bdag po yin pas/khu ba'i bdag nyid ce'o//nga — 'byung ba lnga las skyes pas/lnga skyes she'o/nga —bud med spyi'i ming /pho mo'i zlas phyed pa'i ba mos yin pas rje mi mo zhe'o//nga lus rten thob pa dman pas / skyes dman zer/mtshan ma pad ma'i gzugs su bkod nas/pad ma can zhe'o//lus stobs skyes pa las cung zad zhan pas/stobs dman ma zhe'o/zla mtshan dang ldan pas/mtshams ldan mi zhes pa'o//—624

mngon brngod gzi yi 'phreng ba/bud med mchog gi ming /dud med kyi mtshan nyid brgyad de/khyim thab med kyang 'dod pa'i dbang du mi 'gro ba dang gcig skyes pa gzhan mi bsam pa dang gnyis/spru ba nyung ba dang gsum/rdzun mi bshad pa dang bzhi/phrag dog med pa'am chung ba dang lnga/ zla grogs nyid la 'dun pa rtse gcig 'dzin pa dang drug rang rigs kyi bu byung ba dang bdun/ longs spyod lag len mkhas pa ste brgyad dang ldan pas/mtshan ldan ma zhes so//———mi chos gtsang mar srung mkhas pas/chos gtsang ma zhe'o// ——thabs mkhas pa'i bud med yin pas/ mkhas ma dang / mchog ldan ma —— ——zhe'o//'jig rten pa dmas kyi yid du 'ong bas/'jig rten 'dod ma zhe'obud med phul du byung ba yin pas/phul byung ma zhes pa'o//mdzes ma'i ming /mdzes pas yid 'phrog par byed pas/yid 'phrog ma dang /yid 'ong ma dang /dga' byed ma zhe'o//—— ———sgeg nyams mtshar bas/sgeg mo zhe'o//———zhal ras zla ba ltar dkar zhing mdzes pas/zla zhal ma zhe'o/mig ri dwags kyi mig ltar rgyal sprin gsal le bar mngon pas/ ri —dwags mig can ma dang/ri dwags mig dang /mig mdzes ma dag tu grags/———sked pa phra bas/sked med ma dang /———625

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung lus sgad rgyas pas/smad rgyas ma zhe'o//——kang ba dang lag pa dkar la 'jam pa mnyen cha dang ldan pas/ yan —lag mchos ldan ma dang /mchog gi rdzug ma dang /bzugs can ma zhes pa'o// ———————nga nga — ————————'dod ldan ma'i ming /'dod pas kun tu gdung bas/kun tu gdung ma ————————— —nga nga —dang / chags pa dang ldan pas/chags ldan ma dang /— —chags pa'i mig zur g.yo bas/mig g.yo ma dang / ———chags pa yang yang skye bas myos pa'i phreng ldan ma dang /nga nga 'dod pa spyod pas/'khrig pa'i dga' ston ma sogs su grags pa'o//——————smad 'tshong ma'i ming 'dod pa'i don du yang yang 'gro bar dga' nga bas/rkub yang ma zhe'o//—grong ba'i chos tshul min du rol bas/ngan rol ma zhe'o//chags pa'i zol gyis bslus nas gnod nga nga/ —chags pa'i gdon can ———zhe'o/'dod pa'i dbang du dmigs yul du 'khyam pas/'phyon ma dang /——khrel med pas/dpa' mo min zhe'o//—skyes pa gang gis 'jus kyang mthun par byed pas/ 'jud mthun ma —dang /626

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreng bskye bo gang rung dang 'dod pa spyod pas/skye bo kun 'jub dang ————'dod pa bo mang du 'khor bas / tshogs can ma dang /—— nga —nyal rogs brje res byed pas/res ma zhes bya'o//——pha'i ming /bu gu skye byed kyi rgyu yin ba pas/skye srid sa bon pa zhes//nga nga — ——nga phru gu skyong ba bo yin pas/skyed byed dang /'tsho byed dang /gso ba bo — —— ——zhes pa'o//ma'i ming mi'i skye ba blang bar lam ster bas/skye ba'i lam ster zer/——bu gu skyo nga ba ma yin pas/skyed byed ma dang /skyong ma zhe'o/nga —mi lus rab tu skrun par byed pas/rab skrud zhes pa'o//khyo bo'i ming / chung ma dga' byed kyi grogs yid pas dga' grogs ——she'o//gtan gyi grogs po yin pas/gtan grogs dang /mdza' na bo ste / mdzad pho dang /—ha cang snying nye bas/rab tu tsha byed ces so//chung ma'i ming /khyim tshang skyong bar byed pas/khyer bdag ma dang /khyim nga nga 'dzin ma zhe'o// nga —khyo bo'i dga' bya yin pas/dga' ma dang /dran ma zhe'o//——mdza' na mo ste mdzan mo yin pas/yid gcugs ma zhes so//——627

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mdzan phyung /yid kyi zig le yin pas/snying gi dum bu dang /snying sdug ma zhes pa'o//—nga —zag pa'i ming /bu mo'i tshe grogs yin pas/bu mo'i bdag po dang /bu nga —nga ——nga —mo'i zla bo zhe'o/— nga mna' ma'i ming / rang khrim nas bzhan khyim du bag mar song ste gnas pas / gzhan khyim gnas she'o//bu'i zla mo yin pas/bu'i chung ma zhe'o//——bu gu'i ming / pang du 'khyud nas nu zho 'thung bar byed pas/ 'khyud —'thung dang /zho 'thung zhe'o//— ——lang ma ran par nyal nas 'dug par bcug pas/gan rkyal nyal zhe'o//———byis pa'i ming / sam mi shes pa'i skabs yin pas/bsam med ce'o//—lus kyi shed mo ma bye bas/shed ma bye zhe'o//——— se'u bcu tsam las med pas/se'u bcu ba zhes pa'o//nga nga pho gzhon gyi ming lang tsho dar la bab pas/dar ma dang lang tsho can ——— ———zhe'olus stobs yongs su rdzogs pas/kho lag rdzogs pa zhe'o//————dpa' bo'i brjid chags pas/stag shar zer ro//mo gzhon gyi ming /lang tsho dar la bab pas/dar bab ma dang /lang tsho nga — nga ma zhe'o//—628

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreng ba/ lang tsho khengs par gyur pas/khengs ldan ma zhes so//skyes dman lang tsho'i dpal shar ba'i dus yin pas/sman shar zhe'o//lo mtshan dang ldan bas/ rdul bcas ma dang / chos ldan ma zhes pa'o/rgan po'i ming /lo na rgas pas/lo lon dang na tshod yo' dang /lang — —tsho nyams she'o/nga mgo skyes dkar por gyur pas/mgo dkar zhe'o//lag rten dang mi 'bral bar de nyid dang grogs po lnga bur stsar pas/'khar ba'i mdzo' bo zhe'o//— —mi tshe gang bo pyis pa'i dang /gzhon nu'i dang /dar ma'i gnas skabs gsum tshar dag das pa'i gnas skabs bzhi bar bslobs yod pas/gnas skabs bzhi ba zhe'o/—rgan mo'i ming /'khar ba'i grogs mor rgyu pas/'khar ba'i mdza' mo —zhe'o//skra dkar por gyur pas/lha dkar ma zhe'o//rgas shib 'khogs pas/'khogs ma zhes so//lo mang bo theg bas kyi lo yi theg ma zhe'o//rgyal bo'i ming /mnga' khor sa kyi sa gzhi skyong mkhan yin pas/sa skyong nga dang sa bdag dang /sa srung zhe'o//—nga 629

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung /sa gzhi ste nor gyi blo gros kyi bdag po yin pas/ nor gyi blo gros bdag ——————— nga —ce'o /mnga' khongs kyi bdag po yin pas/ mi bdag dang / mnga' bdag dang ————mi rje dang / mi yi dbang phyug dang / mi yi 'dren pa dang / skye dgu'i bdag po nga — ——sogs su grags/ mang bos bskur nas rnam 'dren du gyur pas/ dpung las skyes zhes —pa'o —rgyal mo'i ming / mnga' 'bangs bdag byed pas/ mi bdag ma zhe'o— /————mnga' 'bangs dam par 'dren pas/ rnam 'dren ma zhe'o/ /—————mnga' khongs kyi sa gzhi dbang bsgyur bas/ sa spyod ma zhes pa'o/ /btsun mo'i ming / mi bdag gi dud med yin pas/ mi bdag mo zhe'o/ /rgyal bo bzhugs sa'i pho zang gi 'khor mo yin pas/ pho brang 'khor ma —zhe'o/ / rgyal bo'i rigs ma ste— rgyal rigs ma zhes so— /rgyal phran gyi ming / yul kha sa shig gi rgyal bo la/ khams kyi rgyal bo —zhe'o/ /yul 'khor zhig gi dbang bo la/ yul 'khor dbang dang /sde dpon lha bu la/ sa yi thig le 'dzin zhe'o1 /—630

mngon brngod gzi yi 'phreng bablon po'i ming / rgyal bo'i bka' lag len du bstar ba'i dbang bo ste nga gtso bo yin pas/bka' dbab zhe'o//blo gros kyi snad dang ldan pas/gros sdod ce'o//rgyal khrims dbang du bsgyur bas/khrims kyi kha lo ba zhe'o//—sna 'dren chen po ste/sna chen zhes pa'o//dmag dpon gyi ming cha/gag dpung gi gtso bo yin pas/dpung gi khyu ———————— nga —mchog dang /dpung gi mgon po zhes so/— ——mtshon cha'i grogs su gyur pas/ ral gri'i gnyen dang / ral gri'i rgyun —'dzin zhe'o/—dpa' bo'i ming /zhum pa mi mnga' bas/'jigs med dang /bsnyengs bral dang /bag mi tsha zhe'o//— ——pha rol po zil gyis non pas/pha rol non dang /rnam gnon can dang ——brtul phod ce'o//g.yul ngo na blo gros brtan pas/g.yul ngor brtan ce'o//brjid nyams che bas / g.yul na brjid ces so//mkhas pa'i ming / shes bya'i gnas rnams legs par rtogs pas/ blo —ldan dang /nom gsal dang /rig pa can zhes so//—blo gros gsal ba mig gis mthong ba dang 'dra bas/ blo gros mig can— 63

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung dang ring du mthong zhe'o//—shes rab ni sto ba sa shugs yin pas/rig pa'i dang / 'a bo dang /—nga ————bsam blo btang na rig pa'i dbang 'byor bas/dran dbang zhes pa'o//—slob dpon gyi ming / legs nyes dam par 'byed pa'i lam ston pas/lam ston zhe'o/—gzhung lugs smra ba bo yin pas tha ma dang /rig pa'i gnas rnams legs par ston pas/stod pa zhe'o//—yig mkhan gyi ming / sgyu gu 'dzin mkhan yin pas/ sgyu gu can dang /—nga sgyug thogs pa dang myug 'dzin zhe'o//yi ge 'bri mkhan yin pas/yi ge ba zhes pa'o//nga —gnyer ba'i ming /bang mdzod gnyer mi yin pas/mdzod pa dang /rgyu nor skyong bas/nor skyong zhe'o//lde mig 'dzin pas/lde mig pa dang /mig gi chos can zhe'o//———sman pa'i ming / sman dang thabs kyis nad gso bar byed pas gso dpyad mkhan dang /—'tsho byed pa dang /'tsho thabs pa sogs su grags/ nga nga —— nga —lag rtsa brtag pas/mkhyub dpyad pa zhe'o//na tsha 'byung ba'i rkyen shes pas/skyon shes zer mi tshe rig par byed pas/tshe 4rig byed pa zhes pa'o/632

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreng ba/nad pa'i ming /dad dang ldan pas/nad can zer/——na khus mnar bas gdung bas gzir dang /zug gru can dang sdug —— ——— —bsngal can sogs su grags/— —nad byung bas/bro 'tshal ba dang /—nga —nad kyis bzung bas/nad kyis btab dang /——— —ngo mdog shor bas/mi sdug 'gyur 'is pa'o//———nad sos pa'i ming /na tsha med song bas/zug zu bral dang nad kyis btang dang / nad las grol dang snyun gdangs pa dang / na ba sangs pa — ——— ——sogs su grags so/spyang po'i ming /rig pa sgrim mkhas pas/sgrim po dang ——rig pa grim pas kyi grim po zhe'o//— ——blo che bas / gsal bo dang grung bo zhes so//——— ——glen pa'i ming /shes pa mi gsal bas/blun po dang /chongs pa dang /— — —ma rig pa dang /ldar ba dang /——— — long bar gyur pa 'dra bas/ldongs pa sogs su grags so//— —skugs pa'i ming /gnyam mi shod pas/smra bcad dang /ngag gis dbul ——nga —— —dang /ngag mi ldan dang /tshig nyams dang /smra mi shes sogs su grags so//————— —— ——gnyid kyi ming /gnyid log pas / mig zum zer633

dag yis ris pa'i bab pa mngon phyungaganyid song na cang mi shes ro dang 'dra bas/gnyid kyi ro ba dang /rab —— — —— nga nga — — nga ————— —tu 'thibs dang /rmongs pa'i grogs po sogs su grags so—— — —————nga lus kyi ming / zag bcas nyer len gyi phung bo yin pas/ zag phung nga nga nga — nga 'e'o'abyung ba lnga la sa grub pa'i ba lus kyi cha shas yongs rdzogs 'dus pas/tshogs pa dang /—dbang bo drub sga skye mched yin pas/dbang bo'i skye mched ces pa'o//————ma bo'i ming / mig thi dbang bo 'dzin pa can yin pas/ mig 'dzin nga —nga ———nga dang /yad ga lnga bo las mchog tu byur pa yen pas/ yan lag mchog ces nga nga —pa'o//skra'i ming /ma bo na skyes pas/mgo skyes dang /spyi bo skyes zer/——— ————mgo la nyal ba lhar snang bas/mgo nyal zer/—— bzhar btang na slar yang skye bas/slar skye zhe'o//—mig gi ming / gzugs thams cad lta ba'am mthong bar byed pas/ lha —byed dang /mthong byed zer—— —nga —gzugs rnams blo yul du 'dren par byed pas/'dren byed ce'o//———mun pa sel bar lha'i sgron ma lha bu yin pas/lha'i sgron ma zhe'o/——634

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon 4 nga /mgrin pa'i ming /mgo bo'i rten byed yin pas/mgo rten dang /mgo yi ——nga thos sa sa yin pas/ma bo 'dzin zhes pa'o//— ——las pa'i ming /sor mo lnga yod pa dpe'i sgo nas yal ga lnga ba zhe'o/nga —dpung ba'i 'dab ma dang 'dra bas/dpung ba'i 'dab ce'o//——nga gzung bya 'dzin spyad yin pas/'dzin byed ces so//— —lab brdas don go bar byed pas/tha snyad ston byed zer ro//—— nu ma'i ming /brang kha na skyes nas yod pas/brang skyes she'o//—nu ma'i nang du 'o ma 'dzin pas/'o 'dzin zer/nu ma rgyas par gyur pa ni/ bud med rnams lang tsho dar la bab pa'i rtags yin pas rje lang tsho'i mtshan zhe'o//— —nga 'dod zags kyis myos par byed pa'i bum pa lha bu yin bas/ 'dod — —pa'i myos bum zhe'o//rkang ba'i ming 'gro spyad yin pas/'gro byed dang /bgrod byed dang /—— — —rgyu byed ces pa'o//nga —pho mtshan gyi ming /pho mtshon byed kyi rtags yin pas/pho rtags she'o/brla bar gyi snga bar bya ba yin pas/'doms kyi sba ba zhe'o//nga —lang tsho ma rnams kyis sems la dran pa'i ka ba lta bu yin pas/dran pa'i ——ka ba zhe'o//636

mngon brjod gzi yi 'phreb bachags pas myos par byed cing 'khri shing dang 'dra bas/ myos byed 'khri ——— —————— ———shing zer ro//—mo mtshan gyi ming /mo mtshon byed kyi rtags yin pas/mo rtags she'o/nga nga —bu gu'i 'byung gnas sam 'byung ba'i lam yin pas/chos 'byung dang /——srid pa'i 'am dang / skye gnas dang / skye 'dzin dang bu gnas grong khyer —— — — — ——— ——sogs su grags/'dod pa spyod par pho mo gnyis ka'i dka' sa yin pas/ gnyis dga'i ———khyim zhe'o//——myos par byed cing pad ma'i dbyibs can yin pas/ myos byed pad ma nga —zhe'o//dga' ba skyed pa'i khung bu 'dra yin pas/dga' ba'i bu ga zhe'o/— nga zla mtshan yong sa'i lam yin pas/ me tog lam dang / rdul gyi lam —— ———zhe'o/gzhan yang /don lnga sdod drus lus kyi cha shas gzhan dag dang bcas pa/gnyen 'brel brtsi yul dang / las rigs dang / thon rdzas yo byad la sogs pa'i mngon brjod rab tu mangs dogs nas 'dir bko) med la/shes 'dod rnam pas mngon brjod kyi gzhung rnams la gzigs par gyis shig///637

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung snge tshan nyi shu ba/ grangs kyi mngon brjod mi brjed gzungs sngags/grangs kyi mngon brjod dpe yi sa bstan pa mtshar/ /yid la bzung na snang ngor dpar pa 'dra/ /rtsis la btab na ri cho ba chos1 pa bzhin/ /yi ger ra ba na tsheg dbar nyung bas grub1 /bgrang bya gas nga bar gab pa 'i ko ya nga chod1 /grangs kyi mngon brjod ni grangs nges pa'i chos can gang zhib dpe yi bzugs su bkod nas mtshon pa yin te1 mib ni gnyis dang / khams ni bco —— —brgyad lta bu'o1 /mngon par brjod pa'i grangs blo la 'dzin par mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob 'a / dper na/ spyi lo624bar rigs ldan rgya mtsho rnam rgyal khri la 'khod pa nas bzung ste/ rigs ldan rgyal dka'i lo mtha'i bar du lo ngo bzhi brgya dang gsum song ba de la rgyud 'a sa me mkha' rgya mtsho zhes gsungs pa/ —— ————— — —grangs nges pa yid la gtan 'jags par byas pa yin/ de'i phyi lo ste me yos lor rab byung dang bo'i ma so brtsams pa me mal 'a rgya mtsho nas brtsis so de no spyi lo1༷27par yin la/ lo grangs de yid la mi brjedaXpa'i gzungs shig 638

grangs kyi mngon brjod mi ba rje dgazungs sngagasagadab dgos da/ rta mig 'byor ba zhes pas 'thus so / /grangs gal chen zhig ————— —— — rang blor nges pa dang gzhan la gsang ba/ dper na/ dngul srang nyis 'bum bzhi khri chig stong sum brgya dang brgyad la/ lha stong 'dod rgyal ba/ zhes bris — ————— —— —— nas bzhag kyang gab par gyur pa sa1 mngon brjod mi shes pa dag sis shes mi srid do1 /gzhan yang rtsis dpe rnams 'a sa grangs kyi mngon brjod sbyar ba rab tu mang bas 1 de lugs ma shes na bgrang bya'i mdud pa mi 'khro'1 g.yung drung bon gyi bstan rtsis ngo mtshar nor du'i phreng ba zhes bya ba las/ grangs gnas thams cad mngon brjod kyis bstan pa/ dper na/ shing khyir tho ri gnyan btsan ba lhams1 /de la mda' gzugs rtse mos phri1 /sa glang srong btsan sgam po bltams / /'byung mdas phri ba'i shing sprel la/ do/ stegs byed pa'i rtsis mgo zug /me mkha' rgya mtsho thog mar 'dren/ /de la chu gter phri ba yi 1sa rtar khri srong lde'u btsan byung / /zhes pa las mda' bzugs rtse mo dang 1'byung mda' dang / chu gter zhes pa dag shes na/ lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan nas srong btsan sgam po'i bar lo ngod1kyi('gor ba dang / srong btsan 'khrungs nab lo ngo55'khor tshe1 rab byung dang bo'i dbu zug de nas lo ngo 94'gor tshe/ khri srong lde btsan 'khrungs par bshad/ des na srong btsan nas khri srong bar lo ngo1bka'agor ba legs par shes la/ grangs kyi mngon brjod de dag ma shes na/ tshig 'di dag gi don rtogs par mi 'byur ro/ 1deng tshong 63 9

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon rgyung/khrom dpal 'byor dang / tshan rig lag rtsal sogs su rtsis bkol sa rab tu mang bas/ grangs kyi mngon brjod lag len du 'jug pa legs par shes pa ha cang gal che bas/ 'dir cung zad dgrol bar bya'o/ /1 rang bzhin gzugs dang bse ru dang / /zla ba 'od dkar ri bong can/ /'di rnams gcig gi ming du grags/ /dngos po gang ci'i dwang bkin ni gcig dang / lus kyi phung bor grub pa'i gzugs ni gcig dang / ri dwags bse phal mo che'i ru ni gcig dang /nam ma6'i zla ba ni gcig yin pa'i phyir/ 'od dkar cad dang / ri bong can ni zla ba'i speng gi rnam grangs yin pas gcig rdun no / / 2 lag mig zung bgrod thabs shes dang / 1'khrig sbyor gshin rje mtshe ma gnyis/ /mig dang lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis re yod pa dang / zung ni gnyis dang / ༷lo gcig la dbyar kha nyi ma lho bgrod dang / dgun kha nyi rno byang bgrod de bgrod pa gnyis dang / don gang ci 'grub par byed pa la thabs dang shes rab gnyis dgos pa dang / 'khrig pa sbyor ba la pho mo gnyis 'jel ba dang /gshin rje rgyal bo ni las dkar nag gnyis kyi dbye ba zhib tu brtsis pa dang /dus gzug tu phru gu gnyis skyes pa la mtshe ma zhes pa'i phyir ro/ / 640

grangs kyi mngon brngod mi brjed gzungs sngags12 'jig rten tsha ba yon tan me/ /srid pa rtse mo can rnams gsum/ /sa bla/ sa steng / sa 'og ni 'jig rten gsum zer ba dang / sga skya dang /mi spu ling dang / pho ba ril brngus drod ba na tsha ba gsum du grags pa dang /rdul dang / sun pa dang / snying stobs bcas la skyon tan bsum zer ba dang /lho phyogs rgya mtshor rta gdong me dang / khrim bcu gnyis kyi me nyi ma dang 1bsreg bya za ba'i me ste me nom ba bsnyen sum yod pa dang / lha yi srid pa dang / klu yi srid pa dang / mi yi khrod pa ni srid pa gsum zer ba dang / dbang phyug gi mdung la rtse mo gsum yod pa'i phyir ro/ / 4 rgya mtsho chu gter chu bo bdud/ /rig byed sde ba zung ldan bzhi/ /ri rab kyi phyogs bzhi na rang mdangs phog pa'i rgya mtsho 'am chu gter dkar ser dmar sngo bzhi yod pa dang / rgya gar du rme dzwa chen po sheng shā/ba/ si sna/ pa'i bzhi yod pa dang / phung bo'i bdud/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud/ 'chi bdag gi bdud/ lha'i bu bdud de bdud bzhir grags pa dang /mchod sbyin1 nges brjod/ snyan tshig srid srung ste rjig byed bzhi zer ba dang /gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba/ phal chen pa/ gnas brtan pa— mang bos bkur ba ste rtsa ba'i sde ba bzhi zer ba dang 1 zung ldan ni bzhi yin pa'i phyir ༷ 641

das yis rig pa'i gab pa1 mngon lung1zod/ /5 'dod yon nyer spyod phung bo mda'/ /'byung ba dbang bo lnga yi ming / /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ste 'dod yon lnga yod pa dang / me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas bcas la nyer spyod lnga zer ba dang / gzugs/ tshor ba/ 'du shes/ 'du byed— rnam shes bcas la lhang bo lnga zer ba dang /'dod lha'i bu bdud dga' rab dbang myug la myos byed/ sred byed/ rmongs byed/ skom byed/ 'chi byed bcas me tog gi mda' lnga yodaXpa dang / sa chu me rlung nam mkha' ni 'byung ba lnga yin pa dang / mig rna ba sna dang lce dang lus ni dbang bo lnga yin pa'i phyir ro/ / 6 ro dus mtshams dang bro ba dang — /rgyan dang bzang bo drug gi ming / / mngar ba/ sgyur ba/ kha ba/ bska ba/ tsha ba/ lan tshwaXb ste ro drug gam bro ba drus yin pa dang — lo gcig la dpyid ka so ga dbyar kha/ ston kha/ dgun stod/ dgun smad de dus drub yod pa dang / nyin mor snga dro/ nyin gung / phyi dro bsum dang / mtshan mor srod/ nam gung / tho rengs gsum ste1 nyin mtshan dus mtshams drug tu brtsis pa dang / klu sgub1 ārya de wa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ phyogs glang / chos grags bcas 'dzam gling shā1dzes pa'i rgyan 642

spangs kyi mngon brjod mi brjed gzungs ji bam1drus yin pa dang / snying la dza ti1 glo bar cu sang — mchin par gur kum/ srob rtsar li shi mkhal ma la su ga sme la/ mtsher bar ka lo la bzang bas sman bzang drug ces grags pa1'i phyi ra ro/ 1 7 rin chen sa 'dzin thub pa gling 1 1drang srong ri gza' rta rnams bdun1 /bser/ dngul/ bai ḍūrya1 spug rdo'i snying po/ sheb 1 mu tis dam ra po ste rin po che sna bdun dang yang na 'khor lo/ nor bu1 btsun mo/ blon po/༷ dmag dngo na— glang bo che/ rta mchog bcas 'a rgya8 srid rin chen ji bdun zer ba dang /gnya' shing 'dzin/ bka' mda' 'dzin— seng ldeng can1 mu khyung can/rta rna/ lta na sdug rnam 'dud de gser ri'am gser gyi sa 'dzin bdun du grags pa dang 1rnam gzigs / gtsus tor can1 thams cad skyob/ 'khor ba 'jigagaser thub/ 'od srungs1 shākya thub pa bcas la thub pa bdun zhes ba1sungs pa dang /zla ba— 'od dkar/ ku sha mi'am ci/ khrung khrung / drag po'i gling / 'dzam gling chen po bcas 'a gling bdun zer ba dang /'od zer can / 4 ma/ rgyun shes/ 'od yangs/ lha min 'joms/ mchod 16 )

dag yib rib pa 'i gab ba1 1ngon par1sbyin can/ gnasaX'ajos bcas la drang srong bdun zer ba dang —nyi ma/ zla ba/ mig dmar/ lhag shā/ phur bu1 pa sangs/ spen pa ste gza' bdun yin pa dang / rlung/ yid 'jog mdog lngaXb/ thig le can/rngos brjod shin tu rgyal mtshan/ ri 'joms bcas ni nyi ma'i shing rta 'dren pa'i rta bdun yin pa'i phyir ro/ / 8 lha klu bkra shis gdengs can sgrul/lto 'gro nor lha nor dbyig dang 1 /nye sras rnams ni brgyad kyi ming / /khyab 'jug tshangs pa/ brgya byin/ dbangaXphyug chen po/ 'dod pa'i dbang phyug tshogs bdag sgrod ri rnyi/ bzhon nu gdong dug bcas lha chen brgyad yin pa dang / mtha' yas/ 'jog po/ stobs rgyu/ rigs ldan/ nor rgyas/dung skyong / pad ma/ chu lha bcas klu chen brgyad ma da la/ bdengs can dang /spru' dang / lto 'gro ni klu yi ming gi snam grangs yin pa dang gdugs/ gser nya/ dum pa/ pad ma/ dung / dpal be'u/ rgyal mtshan/'khor lo bcas bkra shis rtags brgyad dngaX1 yang na/ me long / dung dkar g.yas 'khyi' / zho/ shib thog bil ba/ yungs kar/ gi wang/ rtswa dur ba/ li khri bcas bkra shis rdzas brgyad yin pa dang /chu'i da(nga bo/ brtan pa/ zla ba/ 'dzin byed— rlung / me— nam langs/6 14

grangs kyi mngon brjod mi brjed gzungs sngabs /'od byed bcas nor lha brgyad dang / nor dang dbyig ni nor lha'i sla 'bodayin pa dang / 'a(ma dbyangs/ phyag na rdo ji/ spyan rngos rgazisas/ sa yi snying bo/sgrib pa rnam sel/ nam mkha'i snying bo/ byams pa/ kun tu bzang bo bcas nye ba'i sras chen brgyad yin pa'i phyir ro/ / 9 srin po bu ga bter rtsa dgu/ /pad ma can/ pad ma chen po can/ chu srin can/ rus sbal can/ rnga yab can/ dung can/ dga' ba can/ sngon po can/ sbyin byed bcas gter dgu dang / gter srung srin po'ang dgu yod pa dang / kha/ sna khung gnyis/ mis gnyis/ rna ba gnyis1 bshang lam/ chu so bcas bu ga dgu yod pa dang /dbu ma/ rkyang ma/ ro ma/ spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo/ dpral ba bde ba'i 'khor lo/ mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo/lte ba sprul ba'i 'khor lo/ gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo bcas rtsa dgu yod pa'i phyir ro/ / 10 'jug pa khro bo sgra sgrogs phyogs/ /'byor ba stobs dang sor mo bcu/ /khyab 'jug rgos 'jis rten gyi phrin las sgrub pa la/ nya/ rus sbal/ phag rgod/ mi'i seng ge mi'u thung/ rā ma ṇa/ nag po/ shākya thub pa/ rigs ldan/khri rte tsi ste 'jug pa bcu'i sgo das grub pa dang / 64rta

dab yis rig pa'i bab ji1mngon du nga1gnod mdzes — ba'i na rje bded— zhan gyis mi thub pa/ rta mgrin/bdud rtsi 'khyi' ba1 'dod pa'i rgya' bo1 dbyu4 sngon can1 stobs po che1 mi ba yo ba— bcub tor 'khor lo'i sgyur ba bcas khro bo bcu ro da pa dang 1sren po'i rgyal bo sgra sgrogs 'a mgrin pa bcu ched pa dang 1phyobs ba'i/ mchar1sa— 4'i1 steng 'og bcas sbyobs bcu yod pa dang —mi yi na pa yu la dbus su skyes pa1 dbang bo tshang ba/ 'a sa kyi mtha' ma 'o sa pa1 gnas la dad pa ste rang 'byor lnga dang / sangs rgyas 'jib rten du byon pa11 des dam pa 'i chos sto na pa— brnya na pa ba nas pa/ de'i rjes su zhugs pa bzhan phyir snyingaXbartse bas rjes su bzung ba ste ba 'ad 'byor lnga bcas 'byor ba bcu yod pa dang / gnas dang gnas min las kyi rnam par smin pa/ mos pa sna tshogs pa/khams sna tshogs pa/ dbang bo mchog dang mchog min/ thams cad 'gro ba'i lam/ kun nas nyon ro ngas pa dang rnam par byang ba/ sngon gyi banas rjes su dran pa 1 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba1 zag pa zad pa bcas mkhyen pa'i stobs bcu dang /lag pa ba yas ba yon 'a sor mo bcu yod pa'iXphyir ro/ / 11 drag po dbang phyug bde byed dang 1 /bde 'byung 'phrog byed bcu gcig go /646

grangs kyi mngon brjod mi brjed gzungs sngags/ma skyes rkang gcig 'phel ba/ bstod pa/ drag po/ brtson 'grus ldan/'phrog byed/ bde 'byung / spyan gsum pa/ gzhan las rgyal ba/ dbang ldan/ sa gsum pa ste drag po'i lha ni bcu gcig dang / dbang phyug dang / bde byed dang / bde 4byung )nga 'phrog byed ni drag po'i speng zhe rnam grangs rben ka'i phyir ro/ / 12 nyi ma rten 'brel khrim bcu gnyis/ /dbang bo/ byed po/ lam pa/ char 'bebs/ bstod byed/ sngon min/sngon 'phags/ mi gzugs/ rgob 'jug 'od can/ chu bdag gshin rje bcas nyi ma'i khrim gyi lha bcu gnyis dang /ma rig pa/ 'du byed/ dam shes/ ming gzugs/ skye mched/ reg pa/tshor ba/ sred pa/ len pa/ srid pa/ skye ba1 rga shi bcas rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis dang / lug gi khri / glang gi khyim/ 'khrig pa'i khyim/ ka ka ṭa'i khyim/ seng ge'i khri / bu mo'i khri / srang gi khyim/ sdig pa'i khyim/ gzhi'i khri / chu srin gyi khyim/bum pa'i khrim1 nya'i khyim bcas khyim bcu gnyis yod pa'i phyir ro/ /1ka gdugs rim sna rtsigs lus med dang 1 /'dod pa myos byed bcu gsum ming 1 1theg pa chen po'i mchod rten la gdugs rim pa bcu gsum yod pa dang 1 647

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /glog gi 'od can ma/ thig le mchog ma/ pad dkar ma/ lag bzang ma/dga' ba'i shing rta ma1 rab tu rtsos byed ma/ mi shā ka skra 'dres ma/ legs brgyan ma/ mu lnga skyes ma/ a pa ṣa/ chu shing brla can ma / skad legs ma bcas lha'i smad 'tshong ma'am 'dod pa bcu gsum yod pa dang /sna tshogs tog gam/ rnyis nid dam/ myos byed dag ni bdud dga' rab dbang phyug rgo ming gi rnam grangs yin zhing / de la 'dod pas myos par byed pa'i cho 'phrul bcu gsum yod par grags pa'i phyir ro/ /14shed bu ma nu sred pa yid/ /srid pa'i gnas rnams bcu bzhi'o/ /shed bu 'ad 1 ma nu ni mi'i ming gi dam grangs te/ sngon rgya gar du mi'i rim pa bzhi zu ba la4/ sgrol rigs la rkang thang / rta ba/ glang chen pa/ shing rta ba bzhi dang / bram ze'i rigs la nags gnas/ khyim gnas/ dka' thub pa gsum dang / rje rigs la yig mkhan/ tshong ba/ mi na pa gsum dang / dmangs rigs la sa zhing rmo ba/ ba lang skyong ba/ 'jim las pa/ khyim gnas pa bzhi bcas bcu bzhi yod pas so/ /'dod gzugs kyis zu bas lha la brgyad dang / skye gnas kyisaXbye ba'i dud 'gro la bzhi dang / mi dang dmyal ba bcas srid pa bcu bzhi yod pa dang /srid pa de zams la gnas kyang bcu ba'i yod pa'i phyir/ de yang yid can 648

grangs kyi mngon brngod mi brjed gzungs sngags/bcu bzhi yin pas so/ /1kyi( tshes zhes bya ba bco lnga'i ming / /zla ba'i dkar cha dang nag cha'i 'phel 'grib kyi phyogs re la tshes zhag bco lnga yod pa'i phyir/ — 1(‘ cha shas dang ni rgyal bo dang / /mi bdag ces pa bcu drug go/zla ba la cha shas bcu drug yod pa dang / sngon rgya gar na aṅga/ ma ga rnya1rko sa la/ ka shi ) '-i dzi/ ma la ya/ pud ta/ sreg pa/ ka ma/ a brnyi/ ku ru/ lnga len/ bas ta/ dpal za/ ya ba na/ kam po bcas yul 'khor chen po bcu drug yod pa la/ rgyal bo'am mi bdas kyang bcu drug yod pa'i phyir ro/ / 18 nyes skyod khams dmas bco brgyad do/ /gzugs mi sdug pa/ skra byi ba/ dpral ba chung ba/ mdog ser skya/ mig ser ba/ smin mtshams 'byar ba/ sna leb pa/ so sto ba/ dig pa/ mig rlum pa/mig chung ba1 sgu ra ba/ lto ba che ba/ dpung ba dang rje ngar thung ba/ spu can/rkang ba dang lag pa mi mnyam pa/ tshigs sbo ma pa/ kha dang lus las dri ngan pa 'byung ba bcas lus la mi sdug pa'i skyon nam nyes pa bco brgyad yod pa dang /mig sna rna ba lce lus yid de rten dbang ka'i rtems drug dang / mig shes sna shes rna shes lce shes lus shes yid shes te brten pa rnam shes kyi khams drug 649

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /dga' drags ngu shor/ :tsho1 shā mi la ras pa'i rnam thar las mi —rgan nga rang(bla ma mar ba)gi snying dang 'dra ba'i gdams ngag dmas byin te/sgrub rgyags yang nga rang gis sbyangs nas sgom du 'jug pas dga' bar gyis shig gsungs byung ba dang / de'i tshe nga'i yid la/ nga'i 'di mi lam yin nam mngon sum yin/ mi lam yin na gnyid ma sangs na dga' ste snyam pas/ dga' drags ngu shor ba'i ngang nas phyag 'bul/ zhes gsungs/ dgod bro dī khri/ bar sog mi la ras pa'i rnam thar las/ de dmas rgyas par bshad na/ la la ni dgod bro/ la la ni ngu bro/ zhe'o/ /nor yod rgyal bo'i tshu' / waṃ:shā ma ༅ gong )sal las/ sngar yab —— nga mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan bzhugs pa'i tshe/ mi dras zhan kun nged kyi zhal 'dzum dkar nag la blta ba yin te/ phyis su nor yod rgyal bo'i tshul du song nas/ ma khu dang sa de'i zhal 'dzum dkar nab cho brnyi ba byung / gsungs/yi nug khong gzer/ snyam sems sdug cing snying na ba ste/ bong — —'a sa / drag sngags tshig ngan dmod pa yis/ 1yi mug khong gzer gting nas bslangs/ /tshugs shing ber ka mtshon char gyis/ /bdag lus zug zu na tshas bkang / /zhes gsungs/zin re shor dogs/ dzwa4rtse'i lag la e zin re ba byed pa dang 1———lab tu zin na yang shor e 'gro dogs pa zos pa ste/ gong las/ da lta khyod 664

dpe chos mi ba'i gsos mchogakyi snang ba la/ /nyon mongs zhe sdang ma bzod pas/ /ri pha ri'i logs nas shor gyi dogs/ —tshu ri'i logs la zin du re/ /zhes so/ / rkyen ngan grogs shar/ 14 bka gegs bar chad ni 'dod don ———— ——nga sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen du byur pa ste/ snang sa 'od 'bum gyi lo rgyus las/ a ma rang nas bton pa(snang sa sgor phud pa)ma zad/ lan chags kyi bu chung de yang nga rang dang mnyam du med pa sogs rkyen ngan grogs shar 'gol gseng 'di 'dra'i skabs su lha chos byed du ma phyin da/ dzwa dung gnyen nye ba sogs kyis phyi bshol sogs chos la bar chad gang yong mi shes/ da lta rang 'gro dgos dgongs/ she'o/ 1skya min ser min/ bkar༅ ya ma zung gi dpe ste/ gong gsal nga —las/ gzugs mdzes skad snyan snang sa 'od 'bum khrod/ /ri nang dpon po'i jo mo mi byed cing / /drin chen pha ma'i kha la mi nyan na/ /skya min ser min byung dus ma 'gyod cig —ces so/ / ma bos mgron po/ ra ma cho gdan ma drangs la glo bur du yong ba'i ———mgron po ste— snang sa'i lo rgyus las/ pha ma gnyis dang ri nang dpon po yis/ /ba sha glang 'gel bka' bkyon dgongs 'tshom yong / /ma bos mgron po da lha log na dga'/ /zhes so/ / klad med mgo 'khor/ za ༅ba rmongs pa'i dbang du rtser pa'i dpe nga —665

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa ma ngon phyung /ste/ lha gling gab rtse dgu smor las/ dgung nyi zlas ri rab bskor le des/ /gling bzhi yi nyams la ma phan na/ /ri rab phan med gnod med red/ /nyi zla klad med mgo 'khor 'dra/ /gling bzhi bzang byas ngo med red/ /ces so/ / rdu dgas gter srung / chu༅༅ lha gling sgyur sa/ gtong phod med pa'i ——phyug po de/ /yi dgas gter srung cis mi 'dra/ /spyod dbang med le yi re sdug /ces so/ /nyam nga bag tsha/ bas bar dngangs shing skrag pa'i don te/ bdud 'dul las/ bdud g.yag de ming dkar gyi nye phyogs bcar bar/ dpa' thul rnams kyis zha' ngo rdza ri nag po la char sprin 'khrugs pa lha bu'i dkyil nas/ sdang mig smin gyi lhag ma 'tshub pa lhar dmar lhog lhog 'khor zhing /thugs la nyam nga bag tsha spu tsam med/ ces so/ /khog re yi rgo yod/ ka'adzi gnas tshul rtogs pa'i dpe ste/ hor gling g.yul 'gyed las/ nga shan pa yid la bsam tshul ni/ /da bsdad na mi bzang 'gro na red/ /hor mi gzhan khog na yi ge med/ /nga shan pa'i khog na yi ge yod/ /zer/ ce rgod mi thub/ ma za dpa' ya med rgod po mang bos mi thub pa ste/ gong gsal las/ seng blon ri rgyal lhun po 'dra/ /sde dpa' thul sum cu'i che mgo red/ /da snga nyi ma'i phan chad la/ /hor 'bum dmag bye ma'i 666

dpe chos spya ba'i gsos mchogartsig pa 'dra/ /gling pho gsar khyu rgod mi thub bo/ /zhes zer/snga 'gras da 'khon/ zam/1kam sngon gyi khog sdug dang deng gi snying nad/yang de las/ khyod dang nged rang gnyis po la/ /snga 'gras da 'khon spu tsam med/ 1pho sha moXlhod rdul tsam med/ /ces so/ / dam bca' rdo rje'i tshig mam za gong las/ nged gnyis dam bca' rdo rje'i tshig——/rdo gor mor ri mo brkos pa 'dra/ /zhe'o/ / ༷phyi lan nang sprod/ ma’6waṃ phyi das 'thab pa dang / nang nas gtor ——ba mnyam du 'brel nas 'jug pa ste/ gong las/ dgra ma sdug bzang drug mkhar rtsa non/ /jus phyi lan nang zod la thang med1 1ces so/ / —dpal mgon sdong) grogs/ ) ༅za yon tan stsol ba'i mgon po —nga ———dang / rogs ram byed pa'i grogs po ste/ gong las/ dpa' dgra lha zhe na ge sar yin/ /tshe gang bo'i dpon po ge sar yin/ 1blon dam tshig 'gyur med 'dan ma yin/ /de ring dpal mgon sdongs grogs mdzod/ /ces so/ /gnam la bya rgya/ sa shā byi rme/ mtshom 1 nyes can 'dzin thabs tshags —————dam par bkod pa'i dpe ste/ gong las/ de'i tshe hor che 'bring chung gsum thams cad kyis ser bo hor gyi yul 'dir gnam la bya rgya/ sa la byi rgya yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ thang chen pad ma yar 'khyil rno rmer chen po brgyab 'dug zer ba ci yid ang / zhe'o/ /667

dag yig rig pa'i bab pa mngon jing/zha nye khu ba dngul dkar byung /ka༅ — ka /gas dge phrug dge —— ———rgan las mchog tu gyur pa'i dpe ste gong las bye ma'i gling nas gser rdog 'bud /na nye khu ba dngul dkar byung / /glang rog po'i rgyud la khyung dkar mdzo//bob mgrin bzang rgyud la mig chung drel//zhes so//ma nyal mi lam/khye'u rje kar re ba stong ba'i dpe ste/ gong las/pho de ———nga ——bsad ston rgyu ga na yod/ /ma nyal mi lam zur na med/ /ma bzhi'i dpon pos bsad ba de//ngo tsha med pa'i stong gtam yin//zhes so//mi brgya kha gceg༅bkar mi mang bo'i bshad tshul gcig ste/gong —las/mi brgya kha bcig gtam gtong gyis/ /rta brgya srab gcig kha lo gyis/ /zhe'o//mi rgod rgod mdos༅ka tsho gong las/pho mi byed byed mdog byas — nas byung //mi rgod rgod mdog bstan nas byung //zhe'o//mi lhags 'dre btums/mab tshomango bo 'dre la rnam pa mi ste/ gong — las/ khro thung gis tsha bo jo ru 'dir mgo zhig ma bskor da/ mi lngags 'dre btums 'dis ci byed ha mi go /zhes so//blo shom gros phud/ka shātsho༅gong las/blo ma shom las la gcig kyang — med//gros ma phud bsdad pa gnyis kyang med//ce'o//mdzub mo ri ston/zag ra nag 'gros tsam bshad pa'i dpe ste/—— —668

dpe chos sgruba'i gsos mchogagong las/ lam sna rang gis ma zin na/ /mdzub mo ri ston a bar rigs1 / zhes pa'o/ /rtsis che che/ bsa' nyan nyan/ 41po'i zhes kha len tshis rtsi'i nyams —— — — — —— ——————gya1tshon pa ste1 gong las/ mi chung kha bde'i sgal bar zangs sgrom zhis khur nas/ rtsis che che/ bka' nyan nyan byed bzhin 'dug ces so/ /4 srung dzwa sdebaX/ 1 khu1’—༅1/ mi ngan kha dgel lag 'grel byed pa'i dpe —— —— ————ste/ kong las/ gangs seng dkar mo'i 'gying ya la/ /ka spyang dra sdeb kha re skyengs/ /she'o/ / ༷da kar ba 1/ 41za12༅ mnyam du 'chi ba'i grogs su gyur pa'i dpe ste/ gong las/ nga sngags rgan sdig pa la bsams nas mi gsod par 'tsher snang skyes te/ pā dur shed chen gnyis ra lug ske stel byas nas khrid yong / zhes pa'o/ /wa mo khrab lhon/ ba)ka sdar ma dras chas spras kyang 'thab ya mi chod —— —————pa'i dpe ste/ gong las/ pho dpa' bo yin na rgod rtags ston/ 1wa mo khrab ༷ gyon dgos pa med/ /ces pa'o/ / kha nya nya/ gyid pa zha zha/ 4ku mas gus gus zhum zhum gyi rnam 'gyur ——nga — ———mtshon pa ste/ kha che'i g.yu rdzong pha pa las/ phyag mang du btsal cing kha nya nya sgyid pa zha zha byas nas zhu ba phul/ zhes so/ / 669

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung/brgya ya gcig 'pher/ lo—zod brgya tham pa'i ya bo gcig gis thub pa ste/ 'jang khring g.yul 'gyed las/ chos rgyal kun dga' 'jigs med de/ /brgya stong kha ya byed mi yin/ /dmag khri tsho gcig las ngar rgod che/ /kha ling kha la me 'bar de/ /'gran na brgya ya gcig thub yin/ /zhes so/ /yug chad sne mthud/ bar ched ba 'gal zla gnyis slar 'dum pa'i dpe ———ste/ gong las/ pha chos dar dkar yug gcig gi /yug chad sne mo mdud pas mthud/ /ces pa'o/ /'phyi ba khang nyul/ rmadang yo nang du 'dzul bsdad nas phyi yi gnas tshul mi go ba'i dpe ste/ gru gu go rdzong las/ rang sems ma rtogs sgom chen mtshar/ /'phyi ba khung du nyul dang mtshungs/ /de la mun nag mgo 'thom thogs/ /ka'o/ / rtsid skud mgo bregs/ ka mi mi yi ༅ so so'i mgo thon pa'i dpe ste/ gong las/ dmag mi cid skud mgo brigs tsho/ /rna mi snyan ke sgra 'ur ru ru/ /mig gzan pa'i mda' 'phen she ra ra/ /gru ma len e go pha yi bu/ /zhe'o/ /tshig bzang gser gyi jigs pa/ rtse mtho gong las/ 'dan ma na re/———khyod tsho ma brel bar nga mi rgan gyi tshig la nyon dang / tshig bzang gser gyi thigs pa yod/ ces so/ / 'jing 'dod lag snga/ zar—7 gong las/ 'dzing 'dod lag snga rma — 670

dpe chos spu ba'i gsos mchoganyin dpon/ /dpa' rtsal ci 'dug da reb blta— /zhes so/ /wa snying stag gdong / yul—8༅ dpa' snying med kyang 'jigs snang ——— —— — —bstan pa'i dpe ste a khu(khro thung)wa snying stag gdong khyod/ /bkra shis pa'i lha mkhar gso ba las/ /ltas ngan pa'i kuX rtsa zu la rjad/ —ces so/ —srul la tsher lcag phog pa/ — bka ༅ reg pa tsam gyis 'phar 'gro ba'i ——nga — —nga —dpe ste1 me khring g.yul 'gyed las/ khri btsum gyis yi ge klog par/ nang ba'i chos khongs la 'jug dgos zer ba thos ma thag sgrul la tsher lcag phog pa bzhin/ nga rgyal gting nas langs/ zhes so/ / gnyis pa/ gtam rgyud las byung ba/skye ka'i tshogs kyis 'ug chung bda'/ tsha༅—ku1yo2 tshang ma mnyam du —————— —————— ——— — log nas mi ngan pa la ngo ya byed pa'i dpe ste/ dpe chos rin chen spungs pa las/ 'phan yul rgyal gyi lcang gseb na/ skye ka'i tshang zhig 'ug chung gis blogs pas/ skye ka bza' mi gnyis kyis stod lung tshun chad kyi skye ka g.yabs nas 'ug chung yul btod skad/rgyu shor 'jag mas rtsebs/ mard༅ rgyu ham che bas srog btang ba'i — nga dpe ste/ gong las/ byi ba kun gyis ston dpyid nas dang gro ma la sogs pa mang bo bsags yod/ byi tshang nas gser ba yu la sogs pa'i nor yang rnyed pa byung ste/ gcig gis byi tshang nas g.yu gcig rnyed de/ sang nangs par lta ru 671

dag yig rig pa4 gab pa mngon phyung/phyin pas/ byi ba de rtswa nyag ma gcig gis ske dkris nas lcebs 'dug skad/nags gces tha ga pa/ mtsho'i ma blun zhing rmongs pa'i dpe ste/ rgod —— —— — — —nga nga la sa/ sngon rgya gar na tha ga pa gcig gis nags su thags shing gcad du phyin pas/ shing gzhon pa legasaXpa mang bo 'dug pa la/ de thams cad gcad du phangs nas bzhag min phyin pas/ nags kyi mtha' mar lhan gyis song bas/nags kyi lha mo mgu nas/ khyod la dngos grub cig sbyin gyis ci 'dod zer bas/ der kho yi zla bo la dri yi byas nas dris pas/ grogs po na re/ da lha 'o cag gi rkang lag bzhis thags btags pas kyang mang bo zin na/ rkang lag bzhi rgyab phyogs su yang yod na/ thags mang bo zin pas rnyed pa cher yong zer bas/ der khos lha mo la/ bdag gi rgyab phyogs su yang kang lag bzhi zhu byas pas de ma thag byung skad/ de nas grogs po dang gnyis kyis grong khyer du zags 'thag pa yod dam zer du phyin pas/ grong ba thams cad 'di lhas ngan yin snyam/ rdo char byas so/ /zhe'o/ /phyir log nas so btab/ ba—pa gong las/ 'phyi ba gsod mkhan cig gis 'phyi ba ded pa/ tshang du tshud pa'i rkang ba nas zin pas/ 'phyi ba gru mo brgyangs te/ kha phyir log nas mi'i lag pa la so btab nas ma btang bas/zla bo kun gyis ma zin dam bya) pas zin zer/ ) re mar 'then byas pas/ngas ma zin khos zin zer ro/ /672

dpe chos smra ba'i gsos mchobabye leb me 'dzing / ba16 ma smongs pas rang srog phung ba'i dpe ste/nga ———— —gong las/ phye ma leb kyis mar me la gzhal yas khang du mthong ste/ der dga' dga' 'dra bar bsnyegs pas/ me lces tshig cing mar khur lhung /zhe'o/ / sbyangs na rgan mos ma te theg bza mkhye/ba'i kyi gong las/ rgya gar gyi yul ————— —— — — ——nga na rgad mo zhig gis ma ho phru gu gcig nangs nub pang gis yar khyer mar khyer byas shing gsos pas/ gzhug ma te cher skyes kyang / sbyangs pa'i dbang gis rgan mos ma ho theg pa byung zer/ zad zad mnyam po zad/ bo༅—za mnyam du tshar ba'i dpe ste/ gong ——nga —————las/ sngon zhang zhung gi mi gcig dang / bod gcig 'grogs nas rgya gar rdo rje gdan du 'gro ba la/ zhang zhung gi mi de la rgyags nas gtsang ma'i zu mang bo yod1 bod de la sran zu gre bzhi las med pa/ bod de 'u rang gnyis zu bsres nas za' byas pas/ zhang zhung ba na re/ khyod kyi phye nyung ba dang /nga'i mang bas mi bsre zer ba la/ des rang gi zu zad tshod las mi za byas pas/ 'o na rung zer te bsres nas kha gnying thams cad dkrugs nas zos pas/ zhag 'ga' lon nas da khrod kyi zu kha sang du zad/ da khrod kyis nga'i zu ma za zer ba la/ bod na re/ nga'i zu zad tsam na mi za bar chad pa yin te/nga'i zu da dung ma zad/ sran ma khyug ge ba 'di thams cad nga'i zu yin no 67 3

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon zung zer/ der zad zad mnyam po zad skad/rab rib mig gis smra shad mthong / ༅ ‘— bka/sgyu— shā lha ba 'khrul ba'i dpe ste/ gong las/ sngon rgya gar du rgan mo zhig gi bu phyi la song shul/ mig la rab rib kyi nad byung ste/ mnaXd mas zas ci byin pa la skra shad btab nas 'dug par mthong bas/ der bu log tsa na/ rgan mo na re/ khyod med pa'i shul du khyod kyi chung mas/ nga la 'bras chan la skra shad btab nas byin pas ngan zer ba la/ der dus chung ma la khros pas/ chung ma na re/ ngas skra shad ma btab1 rgan mo rang gi mig 'khrul ba yin/ da khyod rang gis byin dang zer te/ bus 'bras chan byin pas/ ma na re/ 'di la yang 'dug zer bas/der mig skyon yin par shes nas/ 'o na 'bras chan 'di thu bar sbo sa shig byas nas/ sman pa bos te/ mig nad bcos pa sos te/ da thu ba'i 'bras chan de ltos dang byas pas/ der skra shad nyag ma gcig kyang med do skad/kha 'o ma/ khog tsher ma/ tshob༅ ba kha 'jam zhe tsub kyi dpe ste/ mi ro —rtse sgrung las/ nyin zhig dom dang / sprel dang / byi ba gsum pos rang srog bskyabs pa'i mi drin can des slar yang slong mo byas par mthong bas1 khyod 'di lhar gyur pa ci nyes dris pas/ khos ral ba cad gyis zhu ba byas pas/yid bzhin nor bu de la sprad byung zer/ de gsum pos ral ba can mi rnal ma zhig ma red/ ja lan du chu lan 'jal na chog gam/ kha 'o ma/ khog tsher 674

dpe chos za ba'i gsos mchokam de'i lag nas yid bzhin nor bu phyir len dgos zer nas/ thabs kyis rin po che phyir blangs nas mi drin can de la byin pa dang / drin can de la slar longs bye da phun sum tshogs pa byung skad/mkhar shul la rtswa bskyed pa/ chogs cho shul med du btang ba'i dpe ste/————————— nga — gong las sngar sa cha zheg na sgyu ma mkhan sprul bar mkhas pa'i spun bdun yod pa/ de dang rgyang mi ring ba'i khrim tshang zhig na spun gnyis yod pa'i phu bo gsal byed sgyu ma mkhan spun bdun gyi drung du sgyu ma bslab tu song nas/ lo ngo bsum 'gor yang kho tshor g.yog las byas pa ma gtogs/ phyir brgyangs nas sgyu ma sprul thabs ma bslabs/ nyin gcig nu bo don grub kyis gro bskyal nas blta bar song / dgung mo sgyu ma mkhan tshos sgyu ma sprul bsgyur sbyong bar/don grub phag tu bzha' nas bltas te/ sgyu ma sprul bsgyur gyi man ngag lhag chad nor ga4ma med paraXshes thog nam gung du/ phu bo dang mnyam du bros song / phyi nyin snga mor sgyu ma mkhan tshos spun de gnyis kas sgyu ma sprul ba'i man ngag brkus song ba shes byung / sgyu ma mkhan spun che bo des/ nga tshos spun de gnyis yan par gtong mi rung / phu nu de gnyis kyi mkhar shul la rtswa skyes pa zhig ma byas na/ nga tsho'i mtshan snyan grags dang hūṃ nor skyong sgo ༷ tshang ma thal phung rlung gis gtor 'dra zhig 'ong nges pas/ thabs dang sgyu 'phrul ston dgos zer ro /675

dag yig rigaXpa'i gab pa mngon phyung thang gi rdo 'bus/ rum gyi gro lhung / ༅ mam gong las1 las mi khyi ————gnyis kas ded pa mthong bas skrag nas khung du mgo rdol zhig gi nang du 'dzul song / mi le lo can des zhwa phud nas khung sgo gcig bcad1 mda' gzhu sha zag la btags/ rta'i srab mda' khyi ske la zel/ rang nyid song nas khung sgo gcig brkos pas— wa de skrag das khung nang du sdod mi tshugs par khung sgo nas yar thon pas/ zhwa mgo la gon nas bros/ sha khyis de mthong 'phral/ wa'i rjes bsnyegs nas ded/ rta yang khyi'i rjes la bang rtsal gyis brgyugs song / le lo can des thang gi rdo 'thus nas rum gyi gro bor zhes pa'i dper song bas/ zang thang mgo rkyang rā rta'i rjes bsnyegs/ she)/ /mo ston phag mgo'i stabs 'grig 4ma1bka gong las/ sngar khyo ga le lo can zhig chung mas bskul nas ri dwags bda' bar song / rta sogs bor nas rig rig gnyis kar dri lugs ma 'grig pas/ rdung thun nyos pa ma zad/lu yang bshus byung / bros nas dgong rub dus/ rgyal bo zhig gi sgo khar bslebs/ der rtswa phung zhig yod pa'i nang du 'dzul nas nyal/ de nas phag gcig kyang rtswa'i nang la 'dzul nas 'ongs pas/ kho shin tu skrag song / phyi nyin snga mor rtswa'i gseb nas nyan nas bsdad par/ thag ces dngos po zhig mar lhung bar ba lhas tshe/ g.yu rdog gcig yin 'dug g.yog mo zhig gis blangs nas lci bas btums te gyang ngos la spyar/ yud tsam 'gor nas 676

dpe chos spya ba'i gsos mchogabatsun mo'i bla g.yu bor song / zhes 'du long byung sgang / de tsā'i gseb nas mgo yar bud de/ ngas mo 'debs shes zer bar/ rgyal bo'i 'khor rnams kyis kho la gos bskon/ bza' btung gis tshim par byas thog mchod cha ci dgos zhes dris pa'i lan du/ des phag gis sbag bslangs ba dran nas/ phag mgo zhig dang / dar tshon sna lnga dang 1 gtor rtsam bcas dgos zer ba bzhin/ de rigs khyer 'ongs/ le lo can des phag mgo la dar tshon sna lnga btags/ rtsam pas gtor ma mang bo cos te/ dbyangs gyer nas mo bdar byas shing / mig yud tsam btsum nas glo dur zu zhing / phag mgo bzung nas sgor thon te/ lci leb de la brgyab nas 'di'i nang na yod/ ces rnyed par byas pas/ de la rgyal bos rta sogs 'dul ba gya nom pa byin cing mi mngags nas yul la bskyal/ de nas khos nga ni mo ston phag mgo mngon shes can yin zer nas 'ud brgyab/ sa sngo ni sngo/ sa skya ni skya/ mjar 10zad ba kho thag yin pa'i dpe ste/——gong 'phros/ yang nyin zhig rgyal bo'i mdzod du brku shor nas mo ston phag mgo bos/ khos gnas tshul mi shes pas 'gro mi phod mod/ chad pa phog par skrag nas song ste/ da thengs rkun ma ngos 'dzin gyi mngon shes bsgrub dgos pas mtshams la 'dug dgos zer das/ khang ba zhig la 'dzul nas mtshangs la bsnad/ kho skrag cing sems tshig nas yi ga chad/ mtshan mo gnyid mi khug 677

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyungapas/ lus po skya zhing sngo bar mthong nas/ a sngo ni sngo/ a skya ni skya/ sha skam rus zad/ ces sdug skad yang yang shor/ rkun shā gnyis ka )jib nyan du 'ongs pa/ stabs legs kyis gcig gi ming la a sngo dang / gcig gi ming la a skya zer ba yin pas1 de skad thos 'phral shin tu skrag nas brkus pa'i rin po che rnams mo ston phag mgo la phul nas zhu ba byas/ mo ston phag mgos rgyal bo la phul bas/ yang 'bul ba gya nom pa thob song skad/ka ta 'ug pa'i 'khon/ ༅lo ༅ dgra slor gyur pa'i dbe ste/ sa skya legs bshad las/ khu yis 'ug pa ma phab pas/ —bskal ba'i bar du 'gras la ltos/ /zhes pa ni/ gna' bor bya thams cad 'dus te rgyal bo 'tshol ba na/ kha cig na re/ 'ug ba 'di tshogs kyi dbus su ba'i da che/ mtshan mo 'gro na mig gsal/ mgo la ra yod pas 'dis rgyal bo bya'o zer ba na/ ka ta na re/ khyod ci zer/ 'di'i kang ba ser gas gang ba bran rkang ba/ ma g.yar mo las sha brkus nas zos pas/ mas sha'i khu ba mig tu blugs pas zhag mig pa/ skad mi snyan te 'dun ma thams cad 'ug pa'i sgra 'byin pas da 'ug pa/ bya'i mgo la rwa byung ba lhas ngan yin pas/ bdag ni mi 'thad/zer nas song ba dang / bya thams cad na re/ bden no/ /nges pa'i rgyu mtshan tshang bas so/ /zhes zer nas 'ug pa gcig pu der bsgyur nas bya thams cad phur song / de nas 'ug pa dang — khu ta gcig gis gcig la rig 678

dpe chos spya ba'i gsos mchogami nyan pa'i dgra zlar gyur song zer ro/ /wa mo rams skyabs/ 11ra chog ma mi ngan par dbang bskur na —nga ——mnga' 'og la gtse ba'i dpe ste/ gong las/ blun po bya ba la sbyar na/ /don nyams de yang nyams par 'gyur/ /wa skyes rgyal bor bskos pa yis/ /'khor sdug rang yang bsad ces grags/ /zhes pa 'di yang / ka skyes shig zas su nyul ba na/ tshos mkhan gyis sngo rtsi ma nga gang sbyar pa'i nang du lhung bas/ spu rtse zar ma'i me tog lhar gyur to1 1de dud 'gro kun 'dus nas jo bo btsal ba dang phrad nas/ bdag srog chabs dbyig kyang zer/ gcan gzan gyi rgyal bo zhes kyang bya'o zer/ der thams cad kha mthun te rgyal bor mnga' gsol/seng ge de'i blon po byas/ des seng ger bzhon cing 'gro ba la sogs pa'i bkur ba'i rim pa byas su zin kyang / 'khor phal mo che la sdang zhing / khyad par rang gi rigs wa dmas la shin tu gtses pas/ de thams cad 'dus nas gros la/ ngo bo 'di rang cab/ rigs gcig 'dran yang / 'u cag kho nar sdang bas/ de yin min brtag ched/ tshes bco lnga'i nub rang cag thams cad 'dus rte brgyal bar bya/ de yang la yin na brgyal srid ces te/ dus la bab pa na de lhar byas pas/ jo bo de yang logs shig tu song ste brgyal ba la/dud 'gro kun 'dus nas de la dmod cing / mthar seng ge la ji lhar byur pa bshad de de nyid du bsad skad/679

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa ma ngon sgyung lab rgyu pha bsad 4 la'ang yod/ lo shā12 waṃ 1ka—slobaka 1 mi la gnod — —nga nga pa bca' 'dod na/ snyad 'dogs rgyu los chud zer ba'i dpe ste/ gong las/gting nas nyams pa'i khrel 'das rnams/ /rang gi gtam ngan ngo sor 'khyer/ /ka lha'i yul gyi rgyal rigs 'ga'/ —pha bas da pa la rgyal rnga rdung / /zhes gsungs pa de yang / ka lha'i yul gyi mi'i bdag po'i bu lo brgyad can zhig la gos shin tu legs pa zhig yod pas/ bus ma la nga'i gos sbos shig rgyal srid thob na gon no zhe'o/ /mas khyod ‘sha mi thob ste phu bo yod pas so zer/ thabs ci yod/ da lha khyod kyis pha bsad nas rgyal rnga brdungs na thob bo/ /de bzhin dus mas byin pa'i chu gri thogs te/ rgyal bo'i drung du phyin nas dga' ba'i nyams kyis brid de/ phang du song ba dang chu gris pha'i lto ba dgrugs nas bsad do/ /de ring nas nga rgyal bo yin no byas te rgyal rnga brdungs zer/spre'u sa mir 'phya/ ༅༅chu lnga mthong ba dkon na mtshar ba'i dpe ste/——— ———dge ldan legs bshad las/ drun pos mkhas pa dbul mthong na/ /nga rgyal sems kyis khyad gsod byed/ /sprel rgan rnams kyis mi bzung nas/ /mjug ma med ces bgad la ltos/ /zhes gsungs/ de yang lho khams phyogs su nags tshal chen po'i nang na spre'u mang du yod pa la/ mi zhig zhing blta bar song ba/ spre'u mang bos bzung nas mtha' bskor te/ 'di ni bdag cag gi 680

dpe chos spu ba'i gsos mchogarigs dang 'dra ba la mjug ma med pa mtshar ro/ /zhes zams cad bgad de 'phya smod byas so/ zhes grags/drin lan log 'jal/ yu4ku1ma gong las/ drin lan log par 'jal ba de/—/she son pa bsha za nyid dang mtshungs/ /zhes pa dzwa/ sngar mi zhig ba stor 'tshol du song nas/ nags tshal shang shong zhig tu mgo 'khor/bkres skom gyis nyam thag pas/ shing ting tu ska/ zhig gi steng du 'dzegs nas de'i 'bras bu za 'dod par/ yal ga chag nas kho bo'ang gcong rong zab mo zhig tu lhung nas phyir ma thar/ gson pa'i re thag chad nas spre sngags bton par/ spre'u byang chub sems dpa' zhig gis thos shing song nas/ mi de rgyab tu khur/ rab tu rtsi bas non kyang / shed mo yod tshad phyung zhing dka' ba gang thub spyad nas phyir dud/ der shin tu ngal zhing chad nas gnyid log pa dang /mi khrel med des drin gang bsam rgyu med par 'di bsad na sha za rgyu yod pas/nags 'di las thar bar mi dka'o snyam nas/ rdo chen po zhig btegs te/spre'u bdag nyid chen po de'i mgo bo'i steng du 'phangs pa thad kar ma phog par zur zhig phog ste rmas byung zer/gsod yang shi ba/ mchos ma mi lus thob kyang mi zhig gi go mi chod —————nga — —pa'i dpe ste/ gong gsal las byung ngo / /rul ba rul bas bsad/ shā mchos ba ngan pa bed spyad das ngan pa bcom nga —————————nga 681

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung pa'i dpe ste/ dge ldan legs bshad kyi 'grel ba las/ sngon ri'i phyogs shig na pad ma'i jing chen po zhig yod pa la/ de dang nye ba na glang bo che zhig dang /de'i phyogs gzhan zhig na pha zhig kyang gnas so/ /lan cig glang bo che pad ma'i jing nas chu 'thungs te 'gro ba na/ wa 'ongs pa dang phrad do/ /der was smras pa/ 'thab mo bya'am lam las 'dzur zer/ glang bo ches bsam pa/ rul ba spyi rdol can 'di/ bdag gi mche ba'am/ sna dang / keng lag gis bsad na mi gtsang bar 'gyur ro snyam nas/ lam bzur te myur bar myur bar song ba dang / was bsam pa/ tshig tsam kho nas bdab gis 'di bcom pa yin te/myur ba myur bar bros so snyam nas/ glang bo che'i rjes bzhin du snyegs pa dang /wa de nye bar 'ong bar shes nas/ glang bo ches sprus pa/ rul bas rul ba bsad byas pas/ /khyod ni rul bas gsad par bya/ /zer nas shugs drag pos wa4 steng du rtug pa bor ba phog nas shi bar nyur to zer/shā rnga bstan nas bong sha btsong / ba༅ za1da gong las/ blud po —nga — ——nyes pa kun ldan pas/ /gang du phyin pa de nas ldos /bong sha yin par ngo shes nas/ /sus kyang nyo ba med la ltos/ /zhes pa/ sngon mi khrel med g.yo sgyus 'tsho ba zhig gis/ ri dwags shā ba'i rnga ma zhig brnyes nas/ de mi rnams la bstan te ri dwags 'di'i sha yin zer res/ mi mgo bskor te bong bu'i sha 'tshong shā na/ re zhig na mi dmas kyis brtags pas/ bong bu'i sha yin par rngo 682

dpe chos spu ba'i gsos mchogashes nas/ nyo mkhan su zhig kyang ma byung 1 phyis su khos sha ci 'tshong yang skye bo'i tshogs yid mi ches par gyur to1 /zhes grags pa ste/ ngo lkog g.yo slad byed pa'i dpe'o/ /khron pa'i rus sbal/ zo 2tshe mig dkyus thung ba'i dpe ste/ chu'i ——— ——————————bstan bcos las/ yangs pa'i rgyal khams ma mthong ba/ /sa mtha'i blun po rang mthong che/ /khron pa'i chu la 'gying ba yi/ /rus sgal rgya mtsho'i gtam gyis shi /zhes pa/ sngon khron pa zhig tu rus spul long ) gceg gnas pa la/ nam zhig na rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyis bdas pa'i rus snal gcig khron pa der phyin/rus sgal long ba des khron pa'i zur gcig tsam stan nas rus sbal cig shos la khyod kyi rgya mtsho de che chung 'di tsam yod dam dris pa na/ de las che zer/ de nas rim gyis phros te khron pa'i phyed tsam yod dam zer bas rgya mtsho chen po ni gnying dang mtha' shin tu dpag dka' ba yin pas/ khron pa ni dper bya ba ga la rung zhes smras pas/ rus sgal long bas kho rang gi gnas la bstod ra bgyis pa tsam ma gtogs/ nga'i khrom pa tsam ga la yod snyam du ha thang ba lha bur byur to skad/dbu rul shangs kyis mi tshor/ khor la rang mgo rul nas dri ngan bro —— ————————————— — —yang rang snas mi nom pa ste— bya ba sgyug bro ba'i las la sbyar rung ngo tsha rgyu med pa'i dpe'o/ /g.yag lug ra phag gi gtam rgyud las/ las rgyu 'bras med pa'i 683

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /sngags rgan la/ /las bden rdzun med pa'i chos skyong zhig /las dge sdig med par mi la zad/ /las ngan pa'i mtshon cha rang la 'khor/ /dbu rul ba shangs kyis mi tshor ba'i/ /khyod mdo med sngags rgan smyo ham can/ /don 4de de pa 6sung) 4 rgyal ba'i bka'/ /tshig rna thos yod na bsam blo thongs/ /zhes gsungs/kha nas tshig shor yu ba thung / ——zab1 —smod༅ tshig shor na zin rgyu med pa'i dpe ste/ sgom chen rdza mig las/ rdza bra ser skya dang sgrug chung gnyis ka yang sngar las da su rgod pa lhar song ste/ rkang lag 'khrab cing mgo lus lan gsum du sprugs te 'di skad du/ ha ha kha nas tshig shor yu ba thung ba'i dpe/ /kha nas thon tshad lab na 'thus yong ngam/ /sngar med gsar byung byas na 'thus yong ngam/ /dpe la a pho spyang ki kha zhan te/ /ra lug 'jabs nas a lce wa mos za/ /zer ba de bzhin nged gnyis kha zhan kyang / /mchod gtor rku mkhan ha ma go /zhes rtsod res byas skad 1snga tshig phyi 'gal/ karma chos tshig snga phyi thod mi thug paXste bya sgrung las/ —— —'dab zags 'tshogs nas bya rgyal bsko ba'i 'dun ma byed pa la/ srin bya mang shos nas khu byug 'bod du phyin/ de la khu byug gis tshod bsam du/ khyod kyi gzugs chung lugs sam dris pas/ srin bya na re/ nga na so gzhon nas skye 'phro yin pas lan byas/ ba'i kyi mgo leb leb nyan pa ci yin/ na so rgas nas lo 684

dpe chos ma ba'i gsos mchogamang lon pas lan byas1 mig ser ba ci nyes/ ngas mar khu dag 'thung bas lan byas/ 'o na rkang lag ser kha mang don ci/ zhag nya mig tsam kha la ma yong sa lan byas/ khyod nyin par yibs nas bsdad pa ci ma rung / nga mi gcig pur song bas srog zon pa yin/ khyod nub mo khu tar bsgrags das ci byas/ nga la pha tshan dang spun zla mang bas 'bod brda brgyab pa yin byas/ de nas khu byug na re/ khyod kyi rdzun 'phongs khyod rang bstan/ /dris lan yid ches rang ma byung / /dris lan snga tshig phyi 'gal mtshar/ /yid ches mi 'dug khyod rang song zer ro bya gshog byi so/ mtham pha wang bya dang phrad na gshog pa ngoms te bya yin —gye ba spyadang phrad na so ngoms nas byi ba yin zer/ g.yo sgyu che ba'i dpe ste/ gtam rgyud du/ pha lang g.yo che ste/ bya khrag byung dus pyi so ngoms shing / byi khral byung dus bya gshog bstan nas khral mi 'jal/ mthar 'dab chags dang dud 'gro'i brngo du gyod byung nas 'dzing res byed par/ phyogs gang rgyal na pha wang gang phyogs langs/ yun ma ring bar 'dab chags dang dud 'gro'i b.raXgyi lhod zhi nas 'dums par/ pha wang g.yo sgyu che ba kun gyis shes nas rig mi nyan/ pha wang sgrag nas mtshan mo min pa nyin mo phyi la 'bud go mi chod par grags/mdze bo ro btsangs1 zo1zag༅ mi mang gi gral du gsang shor ba'i dpe ba — —— ———685

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung —ste/ mdze bo zhig lhad mor song bas/ rang gi nad btsog gzhan gyis shes 'gro bar dogs nas/ mgo bo smad de mi mang gi tshogs gral du 'tshang kha brgyab par/ mig nob dag gis shes par gyur te/ 'jigs par bltas shing myur du bzur bas/ nye logs kun gyis go song / de nas mdze bo ro btsangs zhes bzhad gad kyi gnas su gyur to/ / gsum pa/ legs bshad dang / bslab bya dang /rtogs brjod sogs las byung ba/rmongs pa rang rdug tsho mas nu rig pa'i dbang gis sdug myangs pa'i don te/ sa skya leg bshad las/ rngongs pa bde ba 'dod bzhin du/ /bya ba sdug bad 'ba' zhig sgrub/ /gdon gyis btab pa'i skye bo 'ga'/ /sdug bsngal sbong phyir lcobs ba mthong da)zhes gsungs/blud po spu ba nyung na mdzes/ ༅sgyu zo741 shes rab mid na bshad rgyu nyung na dga' ba ste/ gong las/ blun po smra ba nyung na za1dzes/ /rgyal bo lkog tu 'dug na mdzes1 /sgyu ma brgya lam mthong dzwa mjis / /nor chen dkon na rin thang che/ /zhe'o/ /ris su bor ba/ ja2ba yal bar dor ba'i don te/ dge ldan legs bshad las/ blud pos rdzun par smra ba yis/ /rang tshig gzhan gyis ris su bor/ /nu stegs byed kyis rdzun smras pas/ /khyim bdag lug gis spangs ༷ 686
