dpe chos spru ba'i gsos mchog—la ltos//zhes gsungs/gzhan sdug par snying tshim/ za ༅zatsho kun phan legs bshad las/nga —— —gzhan sdug par snying tshim ma byed/sdug pa rang la yar 'ong zhes so//'dun ma sna gcig lha zagang bya bar blo rtse bcig tu gtad pa'i ——— nga don te/ dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me'i bslab bya las spub pa mthar thon zhig byed na//'dun ma sna gcig la gtad dgos//zhes gsungs/mdzo sprul g.yang lhung / mtshom phung na mnyam du phung ba'i dpe ste/——nga nga —rong ba zhig gis log brgyab shul/mdzo gnyis phur na mi zin bsams nas/mnyam du sprel nas btang rjes/ gad kha zhig tu phar 'then tshur 'then/gcig gi kang bar jig pa dkris nas log ste/gnyis ka g.yang la lhung skad/gong gi bslab bya las/ don 'di la bltos nas/ chen po phugs brtan zhig byas na//ya rabs srol bzang gi 'phro skyongs//mdzo sgrol g.yang lhung zhig byed na//ma rabs grogs ngan la snying gtod//ces gsungs/ wa kha dgra 'bod ma zangs khengs gtam 'dzem med lab pa'i dpe nga nga —ste/chos 'byung 'bel gtam thung ngu las/non cha don gyi lcid med na/rnam 'gyur nub mos pha rol mi thub ste/ wa kha dgra 'bod mi yis 'phya/ zhes gsungs/ rkyen ngad ru 'dzing /ma4 tsho bal na chags gcig rjes gnyis mthud —nga nga —687

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyunga'atshogs nas yong ba'i don te/ lcags kyi bsta na bcos las/ phywa g.yang khyu 'dul 'khor ba dka'/ /rkyen ngan ru 'dzing yong ba sna/ —zhes so/ /skom pa chu 'dod/ 7rme// tsho re shā ches che ba'i dpe ste— sa mtha' med smra dgag pa las/ rmeb gnyer la skom pa chu 'dod dang ldan pa tshor mkho che/zhe'o/ / yid chad gnong langs/ tsho bzad mi la'i mgur 'bum las/ yid chad gnor langs te/ 'gyod drag mchi ma shor/ zhes so/ / za 'dod snyad 'tshol/ za༅bza rgyu nom pa hab thob kyi klan ka btsal ———ba ste/ gtam pad ma'i tshal gyi zlos gar las— ltad mo ba lha ba'i mtshar 'dod gcig /dad pa ma skyes gnas mjal gnyis/ /phan yon mi shes bskor ba gsum/ /za 'dod snyad 'tshol khram pa bzhi/ /bsam blo ma btang bskor rgyu lnga/ 1gnas bskor 'dra ste gnas bskor min/ /zhes gsungs/ma nyes kha g.yogs/ ༅ba'i ba nyes pa med par gleng nag po btab pa ————ste/ bya spung las/ ma nyes kha g.yogs byung ba'i dus su dpa' ste stag 'dra ba zhig dgos/ zhe'o/ /wal gyis shar ba/ chos tsho bslabs pa'am gzhan gyis dran bsnangs par brten nas rgyu mtshan zhig glo bur du go bar gyur pa ste— gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud las/ yab yum zung mya ngan gyis non pa'i gzugs rnyan yid 688

dpe chos mi ba'i gsos mchogakyi me long gtsang mar wal gyis shar bas dran pa'i gsos 'debs su gyur te yid blong blong du sprur/ ces smras so/ /mdza' bshes smon 'drin/ za1ma snying nye zhing yid gcugs pa'i ma ma ma — ma —grogs po ste/ mi dbang rtogs brjod las/ mong gol gyi rje bo dang lhag par yid gcugs pa mdza' bshes smon 'drin lha bur grur/ zhes so/ /stobs kyis bsdegs pa/ mtsho bad stobs 'byor mnga' thang gis — — — ———ba 'jigs snang bskur ba ste/ lam rim bsdus don las/ tshul khrims nyes spyod dre ma 'khrud pa'i chu/ /nyon mongs tsha gdung sel ba'i zla ba'i 'od/ /skye gro'i dbus na lhun po lha bur brjid/ /stobs kyis bsdigs pa med par 'gro kun 'dul/ /zhes gsungs/thigs chus brag 'jigs/ 7bzod zu yi bstan brtsos las/ rtag ——— —————nga —nga ————gus brtson pa ma btang na/ /mi 'grub bya ba ci yang med/ /chu thigs stag tu 'bab pa yis1 /brag gi ri bo 'jib/sa la ltos/ /zhes gsungs/dgun gyi khu byeg 1—1༅ za bshad mi phod par kha rog tu bsdad pa'i — ————— ——dpe ste/ mi dbang rtogs brjod las/ ma rungs pa 'di ni kho bos tshar bcad zin gyi/ slad du'ang kho bo la 'gran du bzod na ci dga' bar dpung skyed cig bsgos mod kyi/ 'on kyang srog chags bya bye'u phra mo ni/ 'dab chags khra'i bu la bdo na rang nyid nyams pa chos nyid du shes pa ltar do zlar ma 689

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung/———spobs nas dgun gyi khu byug bzhin du smra ba med par byed do//kas ro//kha na nga lce rgyus1nyab1ka gnas tshul gsal bar rtogs pa'i dpe ste/——— ——mi dmabs nas phul ba'i gan rgya zhes pa 'as/ sa ga nas rdzob gtsos kha nang rtse rgyus dang 'brel nad thog sman khel byung /zhe'o// meg stos rim lad / 'a1 6bas gcig nas gcig gi sbyor ba ngan par — nga la8 ma byas nas srol bzang pe rim gyis nyams par 'gyur ba ste sa gnas srid gtsung gi shas byed nang ma khag yongs kyi nyams len zhu sgo'i rtsa tshig las/spyi byings na sa kyang gnas dus tshod rtsis kyi snang chung bag yangs mig ltos rim lad kyi sngon gnang rtsa tshig gi 'bru don ris bor gyis sgrig khrims 'chal spyod sogs ci rigs shig 'dug ces gsungs/brjod kyis mi lang / mgos ma go brda ji bzhin sprod dka' ba ste/————mdzangs blun zhes bya ba las na tsha tsha ba'i sdug bsngal rus pa la thug pa brjod kyis mi lang ba zhig myong ngo //zhes gsungs/tshig tsub ngag 'bal/ bza ka da gzan pa'i ga6ma 'chal te/—tshogs drug rang grol gyi gru dbyangs las/tshig tsub ngag 'chal spru ba dang //brnab sems gnod sems log lta rnams/ /snying nas gnong 'gyod bshags pa gyis//mi dge bcu la 'dzem par mdzod//ces gsungs//rdud lam thur bde/ka༅mas ma rabs kyi srol lob kha sga ba'i dpe 630

dpe chos za ba'i gsos mchogaste/ dpe lhas rin chen spungs pa las/ sdig pa'i las la slob gnyer dang 'bad rtsol mi dkos par/ ngang ngam shugs kyis lob pa dang 'jug par 'gyur te/ sems can zams cad rdzud lam thur bde zhes gsungs/ne lha'i kha ton/ tsho yu che lad rmos byed di dpe ste/ gong las— tshig —nga ————gcig pu la nan tan byas nas don la nan tan mi byed tsam na1 chos mang bo blo la zin kyang / ne tso'i kha ton du 'gro gsungs/ra lug rang ze/ rtse71 ma rigs gcig pa mnyam du 'grobs dga' —————ba'i dpe dang / deng mi ngan pa ngan pa dang 'grogs pa'i dpe ste/ gong 'a1sa/ra dang lug thag pas stel ring la kyi le 'grogs te/ srel thag chad ma thag ra ra'i zla la 'gro/ lug lug mi zla la 'gro gsungs/wa mo gal 'dzin/ snyed11 / shā g.yo 'og tu tshud pa'i dpe ste/ gong las/——— — ———wa la gal 'dzugs tsam na/ wa gal gyi nang du bsur dud btang ste bzhag pas/ wa sna rdo bas thag ring bo nas tshor te/ sgom gyis der yong bas/ gal gyis tshir gyis zin pa ltar— rang re yang 'dod yon gyi dri la 'khor 'khor nas grogs ngan gyi gal gyis 'dzin gsungs—zongs zhen blun dad/ za khri lo nges shes med par grags pa tsam la ————— ———nga ha cang rlom nas ma rig pa'i dad pa skyes pa ste/ rdo sbos dge bshes kyi rtsom pod gnyis pa las/ khyod la rmongs zhen blun dad kyis kun nas bskangs te 691

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyungaspros bral ni/zab mo mthar thug gang du'ang brjod du med pa zhig ko /zhes gsungs/zha nye'i khab4 4 ba no dbal med pa'i dpe ste/bong las/zha nye'i khab dpre mtshu pa kho bo'i blo//za zi'i bdag nyid gang la'ang mi no bas/ 'a 'ur tsam zhig ma gtogs zab don las/ /ya yor gyur ram snyam du dogs pa skyes/zhes gsungs/rang lta mchog 'dzin/ gsab༅ rang gi lta ba mchog tu 'dzin pa ste/—— — —nga gdam nga hral sngol dang phal skad rang lha mchog 'dzin gyi rigs dor na legs zhes rdo sris dge bshes kyis dag yig shes bya rab gsal zhu dag gnangs pa'i dpyad gtam las gsungs so/bzhi ba/ nyams myong las byung ba/rko gyong lab mnyes/ 4 kam 6 mi ngan nga bcos thabs med pa'i ———— ——gnas su gyur ba'i dpe'o//ko gru gar gtong mnyan pa'i 'a ga /shā shā ‘pa 'dod don 'grub — ——— nga ——yu na dal mgyogs dang spus ka bzang ngan sogs sgrub mkhan la thug yod pa'i dpe'o//ko rul rgyun du mi nyan/snyed tshem dgos pa med pa'i dpe'o//— nga ———klad med phugs chung / 'ji1ma 'dang rgyag mi shes shing phyi bltas ————692

— dpe chos mi ba'i gsos mchogathung ba'i dpe'o/ /rke bo skyong skyong / sbud pa mel mel/ ‘1da ba gzab bzab byed pa'i dpe/zhe/ / ——— — ——— —— ——— —dkar lhab nag 'tshub/ kara~X ston kha'i gnam ngo yud tsam la dkar snyeb lhab deng /——rkyed tsam la nag 'tshub 'tshub ste/ dga' sdug 'phar kha che ba'i dpe'o/ /bka' dris sngo na por zhu lan lngang khu/ za16chod1 phar dris pa dang tshur lan 6 de mi thu ga pa'i dpe'o/ —/ ——bkra shig brtsegs pa/ 41— 1khri— ka bkra shis thog bkra shis pa'o/ /dang rjes zag bsub ma/ ma po bza sngon gyi byas rjes bzang bo dag rjes skye sbyor ze ngan pas brlags par gyur pa'i dpe'o/ /rkang nad la mgo sman/ ༅ ra༅za rjod byed dang brjod bya thod mi thug gi dpe'o 1 —/ —— — ——rkang sne rdo thogs/ kun kyi)1 sdigs thun nyos pa'i dpe'o/ /rkong bas— lus rā— 'khyog zod1khur41ra rang tshugs mi zin pa'am gzhi za brte na pa'i dpe'o/——/skar ma phar bskyal/ nyi ma tshur bsu/ mtshor ba nyin mtshan sgril nas 'bad༄ za de spe 'o / /—— ——693

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyungaskar ma zhwa byed/ba mo lngam byed/kar 'a za mtshan shar brgyab nas ————lam du 'gro ba'am/ snga langs 'phyis nyal phyi rol tu las la 'bad pa'i dpe'o//skobs su chud pa/kar ba'i bya da ka' ba'i gnas su lhung ba'o//—skya zad sngo rdugs/tsher bar bza' ba rnying bas tshar zhing gsar ba rjes mi chod pa ste/bar chad 'byung ba'i dpe'o//lnga ba/ kha skad las byung ba/klad med phugs chung /ba4༅ 'dang rgyag mi shes shing phyi bltas thung ba'i dpe'o//rkang sne rdo thogs/ bar sdigs thun nyos pa'i dpe'o//—skyor skyor gyi bzi bo thu/ba mi skyon cad la lhag pa gzhams ——bsgo byas na lhag pa ngan par 'gyur ba'i dpe'o//kha dag zhabs rdzogs/ tshe kun lus lhag med par btang ba'i dpe'o//khu rgyu med la ma lo / ma ka4mi sdug rtsag mdog byed pa'i dpe'o//—khur du ma song rgyan du song / ༅mtsho sdug gi khur bor ma gyur par/——bzang bo'i rgyan du gyur pa'o//khe 'dod grags 'dod/ bza1jo khe phan dang snyan grags la re ba nga —— —694

dpe chos spu ba'i gsos mchogabyed pa/gos chen tsha lcibs/ ma—411cho7 gos chen tsha ba lcib spyad byed pa ste/nom zhe gong chen— bab med sa bkol ba'i dpe'o/ /gyen lam thur sprad1 1—4— 1 sa gong gi spyod tshul 'og gis lad mo byas shā lte/—bde na ngan par 'jug pa mang / grib nag spar 'dzin/ rme— 1'am༅ khungs gtugs sa med pa'i bshad yams— skye dpe'o/—/—— ———glang lo ba'i chab sgo yos lo bar khel/ bar lhad nyes med nyes can gyi tshab hūṃ 'jug pa'i dpe'o—/ —/— ————rgyu ma chad nas gson re/ bar sha ) 'chi kha 'phag ra gtags nas tshe sring— thabs byed pa'i dpe—'o/ /brgya kha gcig gcod/ — za tsho mi mang bo'i bsam 'char mi nyan par/rang gcig pu'i 'dod 4 rter thag gcod par byed pa'o/ /gcig go gnyis chod1 — 4 bka4ka don gcig spub zhor don gzhan zhig zang 'grub— kar 'gyur bar zer ba yin/'chi la ngang ba pad mtshor zhugs 'dra/ slong ma༅ bden pa'i don du rang srog phangs med du btang— ba'i dpe'o/ /nge bkab ji gsal/ 'ja43༅ skyon mtshang dmar lhag par bkab na nga ——— ——— —— 636

dab yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung/lhag par mi 'kheb par je gsal du 'gyur ba ba'o/nyi ma me grogs/ char ba chu grogs/ tshe1 (smob ro dngos po gang rungang — — nga nga mthun rkyen la brten na rgyas par 'gyur ba'i dpe'o//rta khyu 'ur 'gros/bza cho rta mang bo 'ur langs nas rgyug pa ste/———zhogs che ba'i dpe tshurta lam grog mas bkag ba 4rang tshod mi thub pa'i dpe'o//nga — —dpon ngan rgyu gzan/mad za༅ dbang cha bed spyad nas mi dmangs kyi rgyu nom pa ham zos byed pa'o//spyang ki rta gzan lug ros mi brgyag 'tsho 1 4 5 dpon ngan rgyu nga —nga —gzan la nom pa rtsa chen min pa brdzangs kyang phan thogs med pa'i dpe'o/ /phar dgra tshur gshed/༅tsha ༅ma 'gal zla gnyis phan tshun me gshed chu dgrar log pa rje/nga/ phyar ba gru 'degs/ bkar thang ma skem pa'i phyar ba zur bzhi —nga —nas mnyam du bkyags na yar 'khyog pa ste/ las ka bsgrub par mnyam du log nas 'bad na 'grub par 'gyur ba'i dpe'o//bya chad thang la lhung /— ka —༅mthon por 'a par ba'i dpon ngan go sa shor ba'i dpe'o//—za khung rgyab ral/ bza a bra'i khung du klad brdol sa mang ba ste/——696

dpe chos spru ba'i gsos mchogatshul dang mi mthun sa rdzun gyi dra ba las mngon par gyur 'dug pa'i dpe'o/ /brag stod bya rgod/ — 1 4— ma —da go sa mthon por bsdad nas 'gab kyi gnas thul sgo —she sa / —rmeng byings dang kha bral ba'i dpe'o/ 1dbang mang tshang gi don mi 'grub/ ༅ zod tsho7khu dbang 'dzin mi mang ba kha rme —'chams na bye— pre lam zlo rme 'gro ba'i dpe'o/ /ma dab rgyun 'byams/ lnga —1(4tre / 1( skad cha'am yi ge ma dag pa bden par rlom zhes— gcig mi—rme gcig la brgyud nas khyab par gyur pa'o/ /ma 'bad rang thob/ 4 zo/1za rang gis ngal rtsol mi byed par gzhan— gye —thon— rdzas blangs pa'o/ /ma lus kun 'dus/ (1༅21tsho'i gcig kyang ma lus par thams cad ba 'dzoms ba hūṃ/—— —/ ——ma shi dmyal ba/ ma —11)ba'i ma sdug bsngal bzod dka' ba lhong ba'i dpe'o—/ —/——————mig 'dris rnar 'jags/ mad ku༅ mig gis mthong lob dang rna bas thos rme ba yin pa'o/——she ——mod nyo dkon 'tshong / za༅zad zong zog mod dus gong dma' mos mang bye nyos dge bsags pa dang / dkon dus gong mthon pos btsongs te khe log za ba'o/ /697

dag yig rig pa'i gab pas mngon phyung/rma byas 'brug sgra thos pa/lorngo bar ba tu dga' ba'i dpe'o//————brtsad mkhas kyang bden pas thub/ ༅ zalo:kha rgyal rtsod par nga ———— —mkhas kyang /rgyal kha bden par thug yod/mdzo khal ra yis mi zeg7 cho1lngid mi khyab pa'i dpe'o// nga ——zur phyung rgya bskyed/zo yo ka phyogs mang ba'i dpe blangs shing lung ————dang rigs pas rgyas par spros pa'o//rang bsam bden rlob/khye37b.rang gi bsam pa gang 'grig 'grig ——tu brtsi pa ste/rang mthong che ba'i don/ri bong gnam rdib kyi sdug bsngal/ kum’rnga sems khur don med ———nga — ——byed pa'i dpe'o//lam ngan su 'byams/ chogs ṇa srol ngan pa mu mthud nas khyab par ———————gyur pa'o//long bas lag rten gal 'dzugs/za mi rngo gdeng tshod med pa'i dpe'o//shes bya'i mtha' med / ba 6ma shes bya'i gnas la mtha' med pa'o/————nga —sa gsal zang go za tshol ba khrim tshang thams cad kyis ka ba'i — dpe'o//sog rul phon thag zhib mas mo tshe sog ma'i phon po rul zhing dkris ———698

dpe chos spya ba'i gsos mchogazag chad nas zhig ral du song ba ste/ tshogs khag lad nas thor ba'i dpe'o/ /gser gzhong mar khus gang ba1 tsho—kar po bzang thog bzang spyar gyi ——————— —— —— ————nga dpe'o/ / bsam gyis mi khyab/ mas thu yo blo yul las 'das pa'o/ /———— ——— — —gzhan yang / gtam dpe'i tshig sna bsdus nas dpe chos su gyur pa yang yod/ dper na/ka bar 'jag ma'i lhan pa/ za1 kar rten ka ba ldid mi theg par/ ——— ———————— —— ————rtswa 'jag ma'i chings kyi skyor ya/ /zhes pas grub pa ste/ phan mi thogs pa'i dpe'o/ / —kha 'jam khog rtsub/ tsho—/1 bza kha 'jam lce so dkar la byed/ /gting ba — — tsub bsam pa nag la byed— /ces pa'i bsdus pa'o/ /kha bzang don med/ lda7)ram dpon chen po kha bzang don med red/ /'ja' kha dog mdzes kyang stong ba red/ /ces pa las phyung ba'o/ / nyin dkar lha dang mtshan mo 'dre/ ja ma nyin dkar lha mor ‘lha —— ——— — —— ————— bzheng rogs dang 1 /mtshan mo 'dre mor thags 'thag rogs byed/ /ces pas grub pa ste/ ngo gnyis ma4 dpe)/ /mtho gang 'dom 'jal/ 4(yod da rtsod rgyu dus la ma brten par/ /gleng rgyu dgung la gragasaXnas yong / /mtho gang mdzub mos speb sa la/ /pho ༷ 69 9

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung/'dom rgyang gis 'jal nas yong / /zhes pa'i bsdus tshig ste/ don chung ngu chen por btang ba'i dpe'o/ /sa skyes dgung bsnyegs/ yor༅mo'i dma' ba sa nas skyes pa dang / /mtho de— dgung la bsnyegs pa 'dra/ /zhes pas grub pa rnye/ spyos bu rlabs po cher dpe mtshon pa'i/ /sa bshud rdo 'bud/ 7tshe kar ma sa bshud nas song na/ /rdo lhang la 'dud 'ab/ / ra bas grub pa ste/ rtsad bcad na gsal kha 'byung ba'i dpe'o/ / lo rgyus kyi chu bo dal 'bab ring mo las— dpe chos mu mthud nas byung dang 'byung bzhin yod/ bcings grol tshun chad yang dpe chos gsar ba 'dra skor zhig byung snang / dper na— khe log tshong log 11—mnya113 bden pa bden thog 1 da rang khrim rang bdag zo tsho1ma rang mkho rang sprod/ kar ba rang stobs rang spel/ sdoms cho lha bu sogs so// //700

yig nor 'byung rkyen sel ba'i gnyen po/sne tshan nyer gnyis pa/ yig nor 'byung rkyen sel ba'i gnyen po/don gyi ngo bo gsal bas ma rtogs log rtog grol/ /yi ge'i rgyu bzhi gsal bas sgra la 'khrul ba med/ /ming gi sdeb sbyor gsal bas gsar rnying brda la mkhas/ /ngo bo 'byur lugs gsal bas yi ge gang bab shes/ /sgra gdangs mthun 'gyur gsal bas zur chag 'byung rkyen sel/ /gsal ba 'di lnga yig skyon sel ba'i gnyen po lags/ /don tshan dang bo/ yi ge'i dag cha gdon pa ha cang gal che/yi ge bris na dag snyoms mdzes gsum dgos/ snyoms cha dang mdzes cha zhan yang mi chog pa med mod/ dag za ma thon na mi chog ste/ go brda ji bzhin 'phrod dka' ba'i phyir/ rtsom mkhan gang yang dag cha gtso bor 'dzin pa yin/skye bo phal gyi brtsams chos rnams las/ yig skyon mang nyung ma gtogs mtha' dag pa dkon/ de yang dag yig la ma bsten pa min yang / tshad ldan yin 701

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyung /min ma brtags par/ sha gzub za rkyang byas pa mang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen shes rab rgya mtsho mchog gis/ sngon nas da bar dag yig che chung gi phreng ba ring bor bstar ba'i khrod na/ gtan nas phan mi thogs pa'ang med la/mtha' gcig tu sha gzug za rkyang rang yin pa'ang dkon paraXgada' bas/'dor len ma nor ba shin tu gal lo/ /(dag yigashes bya rab gsal gyi mjug byang du'o)zhes gsungs so/ /'bri mkhan phal ba rnams kyi smyug rtse la / rgyun par yi ge ma dag pa 'byung sla ba'i snang tshul ni/ brda dag ming tshig gsal ba zhes bya ba las mngon par mthong bas/ ming mdzod de'i skyon yon cung zad dpyad na/yi ge'i dag cha gdon par phan thogs yod par mthong ngo //ming mdzod de dge bshes chos kyi grags pas lo ngo bcu gsum gyi ring la/dpe cha sna tshogs las tha snyad btus shing bsags nas/ 'grel ba dang bcas gung bsgrigs pa yin/ spyi lo1975bar/ pe cin mi rigs dpe skru na khang nas par thengs dang bo mdzad/ spyi tshogs su nyer mkho che bas/ de'i rjes su rim gyis thengs 'ga' 'or dpar mdzad/ bod kyi brtsams chos gar khyab la/ ming mdzod de ma khyab pa med/ rgyu mtshan ni/ ming mdzod de ma 'khungs gong gi gzhung 'grel ma gtogs/ dag yig dpe cha phal cheraXblo la 'dzin bde ched/tshigs su bcad pa yin la/ tha snyad bsdus pa grangs kyis dbulaXbar ma zad/don yang phal cher tshig phreng gi dper brjod sgo nas bstan pa las/ zur du 702

yig nor 'byung rkyen sel ba'i gnyen po/'grel ba bkod pa nyung ba dang bcas pas/ go de 'dra chod kyin mi 'dugadag yig ming mdzod der tha snyad bsdus pa ha cang mang zhing / 'grel ba 'khod yod pa dang / go rim bzhin btsal kha bde ba sogs kyi drin gyis/ bod yig slob gnyer rnams la tsha gdung skom pa sel ba'i bdud rtsir gyur pa yin/rtsom pa bos/ mi zas yun ring zos pa'i rin 'bab tu/ /deb chung 'di nyid mi yi yul du bzhag /(ming mdzod de'i mjug byang du gas /) ces gsungs mod/khong gis bzhag pa'i zas rin 'di gzhug ma gang mang gis bkol bar phan thogs che zhing 'dzad rgyu med pa'i rin po che zhig red/ /don tshan gnyis pa/ bri la nor sla ba'i yi ge skor zhig gi 'byung rkyen/rin po che de bsregs bcad brdar ba gnad du de 'dra ma things pas/ming dang 'grel las/ ming gcig la yig gzugs mi 'dra ba gnyis re dang /mtha' na gsum re yang bris snang / rags brtsis ltar na/ nyis brgya nye ba zhig yod pa las/ gdam nga dang 1 sdeb sbyor du ha lam bzhi cha gcig 'grig par snang yang / sgra'i zhib cha mi gcig pa'i dbye ba ma zud par nya nyung mnyam bsres su byur pa'i ma dag pa bzhi cha gsum snang / de dmas las nyer mkho che zhing / bri la nor sla ba'i tha snyad skor zhig dag pa snga ma dang / ma dag pa phyi mar bkod cing / nod so gtso bo brgyad du dril nas dpe drangs na/703

dag yig rig pa'i ba/ba pa mngon phyungadang bo1 ming ba/zhi nor ba/ming ga'i 'i sgra de gnas rgang las 'byung zhing / byed pa kang sgas bskyed pa1 rtsol ba dwag zhan bar ma ji 'dra yin pa ma brtags par/ sgra spyi 'dra ba tsam la brten nas/ de dag gi zhib cha mi gcig sa'i dbye ba ma phyed par/dag ma dag gnyis gsum re bris byung ba red/ dper na/ khang ba'i lcam shing la phyam dang / khyam gnyis bris pa/ snga ma 'grig la phyi ma 'phyugs snang / 'di gnyis ka'i sgra spyi mchu btsums pa 'dra ste/ jis 'jug ma yig yin pa'i phyir/zhib cha mi gcig ste/ snga ma mchu dang / phyi ma mgrin pa las byung ba yin no/ /de bzhin du/ mtha' yas pa la 'byams kas pa dang 'jam klas pa/ dus re zhig bza' btung mi spyod pa'i chos kyi dka' thub la bsnyung gnas dang sgyung gnas dang bsnyen gnas/ spyang bo la grung bo dang drung bo/ lam rgyags la bro dang dro/bzo byed mthu ldan la 'phrul 'khor dang 'khrul 'khor/ 'gal ba 'dum par byed pa la sdum pa dang klum pa/ nor ba la 'phyugs pa dang 'chubs pa/ dbang 'byor ba la klong du gyur pa dang rlong du byur pa/ yi ge 'briXbyed la sgyu gu dang snyu gu lta du sogs las snga ma dag pa dang / phyi ma ma dag pa'o— /gnyis pa/ mgo can dang mgo can yin min nor ba/ mgo can gsum las/ ra mgo lce rtse 'dar ba dang / /la mgo lce slod rgya yangs bskyed/ /sa mgo so yi bar nas dbyung / /zhes pa'i gnad ma zin pa 704

yig nor 'byung rkyen sel ba'i gnyen podang / mgo can gyi sgra lci ba dang / mgo med kyi sgra yang ba'i khyad par ma byed par/ dag ma dag gnyis bris byung ba red/ dper na/ smra ba la sped pa dang med pa gnyis bris snang / snga ma 'grig la phyi ma mi 'grig ste/ sgra so srubs las rlung phud pa dang / lce rtse 'dar ba las byung ba'i khyad ma byed pa'i lan yin/las rogs la lag pod dang lag sbod gnyis bris pa las1 snga ma 'grig la phyi ma mi 'grig ste1 pod sgra drag pa tsam las lci cha med pa dang / spod sgra lho zhing drag pa'i khyad par ma byed pa'i lan yin/ de bzhid/ sta gon la lag sdog dang lag rdog dbyibs skum po leb mo la kor kor dang skor skor/ 'od 'khyims la 'od kor dang 'od skor1 sprang bo la nu to ba dang nu lto ba/ phru slog pa la rmo blod pa dang rgo mod pa lta du sogs kyi snga ma dag pa dang / phyi ma ma dag pa'o/ /gsum pa/ sngon 'jug da dang mgo 'jog nor ba/sngon 'jug da rtse rtse'i byed pas bskyed cing / ming gzhi dang sbyar nas myur du klog tshe/ rlung gis bskyod pa las lce rtse cung zad 'dar bar gyur pas/ra mgo'i sgra dang ches mtshungs pa'i dbang gis/ sgra 'di gnyis phan tshun nor sla zhing / la mgo dang sa mgo yang sgra lce rtse dab/ lce rtse dang nye ba'i cha dang ldan bas na/ sngon 'jug da dang nor sla/ de phyir 'di rigs las gdam nga cad du 'khrul ba mang ngo / /dga' drags pa la dgod pa dang rgod pa gang rung bris pa/ snga ma'i das 'phul dang / phyi ma'i ra mgo'i grags tshul 'dra bar gyur 70 6

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon gyung /nas gdam nga'i tshul du byur kyang / gdam nga ma yin te/ dus kyi rnam bzhag las/ dgod ni da lha ba dang skul tshig yin pa dang / ma 'ongs pa la dgad dang / 'das pa la bgad yin pa las/ ra mgo med pas gsa'1/ de bzhin/bza' zla'i lcam sring la snyid mo dang gnyid mo/ bongs dang snyid che ba la rdos bcas dang gdos bcas/ rig pa gsal bo ma yin pa la dmun pa dang zun pa dang sgrun pa/ rigs ngan la dme sha can dang che sha can dang spe sha can/nam mkhar 'gro ba'i phyang thag la zu zag dang da su zag gal bo che la gcigs che ba dang rtsigs che ba/ ma bsregs thal ba la pha ba sgo sgo dang pha ba dgo dgo dang pha ba rgo rgo/ ra ma 'dra ba'i ri dwags shig la rgo ba dang dgo ba/zas sogs bldad pa la da nur ba dang zur ba lha bu sogs kyi snga ma dag la phyi ma ma dag pa'o/ /bzhi ba/ sngon 'jug yod med nor ba/bas 'phul so mchu reg pa las/ /gas 'phul gre ba'i phugs nas dbyung / /das 'phul lce rtse slod pa las/ /ba phye ma btsums gnyis ka sna/ /'phul zur chag na 'phul med 'dra'o/ /bri bya'i ming der 'phul sgra yod med dang / yod na gang yin bam brtags na/ no ra 'khrul 'byung sla/ dper na/nyam thag pa la kos thag pa dang / dkos thag pa gnyis bris snang / brjod ngag tu kos zhes sgra drag pa tsam las/ thog mar lce rtse slod pa'i sgra zur 'byung 706

yis nor 'byung rkyen sel ba'i gnyen pargyu med pas gsal/ de bzhin/ dpe cha mang bo'i mtshan byang cig car 'khod pa'i ming la dkar chag dang kar chag log bshad lha bu la kyog bshad dang bkyog bshad/ slad mar la rjes sor dang rjes gsor/ mi'i gzugs lta bur bkod pa'i srung byed la tho yor dang mtho yor dbyid kyi lo nya la khu byug dang khu dbyug prel ba med pa la so sa dal dang sos gdal/ lugs rnying gi tshes pa sum cu la nam gang dang gnam gang / nyan rna la 'on sangs dang 'on gseng / bzod pa'am bsam pa la brnags pa dang mnags pa lta bu sogs kyi phyi ma nor ro/ /lnga ba/ sngon 'jug nor ba/sngon 'jug ma dang 'a gnyis la sna sgra ldan pas/ mchu dbye btsum gyi khyad par ma zud na nor sla/ sngon 'jug ga da ba gsum gyi sgra lci bas/ so so'i byed rtsol gyi dbye ba rnam par ma byed na yang nor sla'o/ /dbu mdzad la mgo 'dren dang 'go 'dren 'bri tshul gnyis byung ba ni/ mchu 'byed 'dzum gyi dbyeb ma zud par/ sgra yang zhing sna nas rlung 'gro ba'i cha nas nya nyung mnyam bsres su gyur pa red/ dag yig 'a lar/ lus kyi mgo ni ma mgo la/ /dus kyi 'go ni 'a 'go yin/ /zhes pa bden par ma mthong ste/ yan lag lnga bo las mchog tu gyur pa mgo yin par dpe blangs nas/ tshogs pa'i gtso bo la mgo ba dang / sems can kun gyi skyabs mchog la mgon po zhes ba/ de ma zad 707

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phung—mgo yi zhe sa la dbu dang / mgo 'dren la zhe sa sbyar na dbu 'dren zer ba ma yin nam/ des na mgo ni dngos po'i ming dang / 'go ni bya ba'iXming ste/'byar ba'i don yin pas/ 'go 'dren ltar bris pa ma dag pa'o/ /nga rgyal gcog par gcom sgyung ba dang / bcom skyung ba bris pa gnyis las 1 gas 'phul mgrin pa dang lce rtsa las byung ba dang / bas 'phul mchu las byung ba'i khyad par shes na/ brda sbyor ba'i sgra ltar snga ma 'grig par 'dzin no/ /de bzhin/ lus khams dwangs par byed pa la khams bsang dang khams gseng /ske 'khyog la mjing yon dang 'jing yon/ ngo thug par zhal mjal ba dang zhal 'jal ba/ drin lan 'ja' ba la drin gzo ba dang drin bzo ba/ kha 'cha pa la mthun pa dang 'thun pa/ snad 'tshong ma la 'jud mthun ma dang mjud 'thun ma/ ngal ba la mnyel ba dang gnyel ba/ phyugs 'tsho ba'i ru gnas la mtsher sa dang 'tsher sa lha bu sogs kyi snga ma dag pa dang / phyi ma nor ba'o/ /drug pa/ yang 'jug yod med nor ba/spyir yang 'jug pho yig yin pas/ sgra dam zhing drag par 'don pa dang /rjes 'jug tsam ni yang 'jug las sgra cung zad zhan par 'don pa yin mod/deng / yang 'jug gi sgra zur ha lam nyams kyang / sgra gcig ming don mi gcig pa'i 'byed byed yang 'jug yod med yin pas/ don la ma brtags na nor sla/ dper na/ gna' bo la ya thog dang ya thogs gnyis bris snang / thog 708

yig nor 'byung rkyen sel ba'i gnyed po/'og thog mtha'i dang thog la sa mtha' med pas/ snga ma 'grig srid 'dzin las khungs tshugs yod sa la gzhung sa las/ gzhungs sar bris pa nor song /de bzhin/ chu gtsub pa'i ming la chag chag dang chags chags/ khang mig la shag chung dang shags chung / btsun pa'i smad gos la sham thabs dang sham thab/g.yo skol byed spyad la sla nga dang slang nga / khog drang ba la gzhung bzang ba dang gzhungs bzang ba/ phan pa'i grogs la stongs grogs dang stong grogs lha bu sogs kyi snga ma dag pa dang / phyi ma nor ba'o/ /bdun pa/ dbyangs yig nor ba/dbyangs kyi nga ro lnga las/ a ni drang ba ste/ sgra mnyam par byas nas 'don pa dang / gug gu ni bkug pa ste/ sgra spyi bo'i cha nas gug par byas nas 'don pa dang / zhabs kyu ni smad pa ste/ sgra 'phang mar la phab nas 'don pa dang / 'greng du ni sgrong ba ste/ sgra gyen la bkyags nas 'don pa dang / na ro ni bstod pa ste/ sgra 'phang mthon por byas nas 'don pa bcas kyi khyad par legs par ma phyed pa'i rkyen gyis nor ba yin/ bkal ba'i da lha ba la khal 'gel ba dang / khal 'gal ba 'bri tshul gnyis byung ba las/ 'gal ni 'greng bu'i sgra'i zur chag pa'i skyon yin/ de bzhin/ kha zas la zhal tshus dang zhal 'tshus dang zhal tshos/ khril gyi g.yog tu bkol ba la khral 'khol ba dang khral 'khul ba/ de ring yan gyi nyin bzhi ba la gzhes nyin dang gzhis 709

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon gung 1nyin/ sha rid pa la zud pa dang/ jid pa/ nges par brten pa la rag las pa dang ras lus pa/ rgyun du sngo ba'i shing tshigs ma can la smyugaXm dang spyig ma/lhol bo la 'jon theng ma dang 'jon thing ma lha bu sogs kyi phyi ma nor ro/ /brgyad pa/ gdangs mthun nor ba/bod skad du tha snyad mang bo zhig gi tsheg khyim phan tshun gyi sgra gdangs 'gang mi gcig kyang / byed rtsol gyi shan phan tshun zhugs nas/ sgra gdangs mthun par gyur pa'i dpe yod/ de lugs ma shes par/ sgra zur chag pa ltar bris nas nor ba yin/ 'o ma bsrubs nas mar blangs shul gyi gsher khu la dar ba zer mod/ myur du klog tshe/ sdo ma'i ra sgra phyi mar zhugs nas/ ba sgra nyams pa lhar/ da ra zhes bris pa nor ro/ /de bzhin/ mig 'o nga ba la zhar ba dang zhar ra dang zha ra/ bye'i gor ba la 'khur ba dang khu ra/ gnyid log pa'i har sgra la rdzur ba dang ngur ba dang ngu ra/ smos ra gnod pa'i byi ba la a bra dang ab ra/ phyugs kyi spu gra las 'jam pa la khul dang khu lu/ rma chu rdzong gi 'brog ru zhig la chu kha ma dang chi wa ma/ 'o ma'i phyur ba la/ chur ba dang chu ra/rta'i thor bu(thor mo)la tho ru dang(thor mo)/ sgra sna tshogs 'dres nas grags pa la 'ar 'ur dang 'a 'ur lha bu sogs kyi phyi ma nor ro/ /gong gsal gyi nor so rgyad ni/ gtsoXbo yi ge'i spyor ba skad kyi gdangs lhar sgra zur legs par thon ma thon la rag las pa yin mod/ don gyi ngo bo 710

yig nor 'byung rkyen blol ba'i gnyen po/gcig mi gcig la nges shes 'dren pa'ang gal che/ dper na/ grangs nyung ba zhig la 'ga' dang kha shas gang spyar 'thus kyang / 'ga' shas zer nas brda gnyis gcig tu bsres tshul med do/ / mdog dang kha dog don gcig par snang yang / rim pa lhar 'jug yul la khyab che chung yod par ma zad/ sbyar byung dang rang byung gi khyad par yang yod de/ bal bo'i sil tog ma zos kyang / /kha dog nyid las bro ba shes/ /zhes dang / ras mdog dmar por byas byung / zhes pa lha bu/ mdog dang kha dog gi dbye ba ma bltos par/ kha mdog ces pa mi 'grig go /'gron po dang mgron po/ sgra spyi 'dra yang don la khyad che/ bya ba'i ming /'gro/ zhes par rjes 'jug na sbyar na/ dngos po'i ming du byur pas/ lam 'gro la 'gron po zer/ ston mor gdan drangs pa'i mi la mgron po zer/ des na 'grul ba phar 'gro tshur 'gro'i 'dug sa la 'gron khang las/ mgron khang zhes pa nor ro/ /thog mtha' bar gsum gyi mtha' ma dang / rab 'bring tha gsum gyi tha ma gnyis/ khyad med du bris pa mi 'grig ste/ dbus mtha' dang / tha chad/ ces pas gsal/sdongs grogs dang stongs grogs gnyis la'ang khyad par yod de/'grogs pa'i grogs la sdongs grogs dang / phan pa'i grogs la stongs grogs 711

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon du nga —zer/ 'jug yul la ma bltos par gang rung du sbyar mi rung ngo / /mdongs dang ldongs gnyis las/ mig gi dam pa can la mdongs zer te/rma bya'i rnga sgro'i spyan kor la mdongs zer ba lta du/ mig lha bu des cang mi mthong bas ldongs zer/ de gnyis dngos po'i ming dang / bya ba'i ming gi khyad par yod pas/ mdongs mtha' can la sdongs mtha' can dang / mig ldongs pa la mig mdongs par bris pa mi 'grig go /mdun sa dang 'dun sa las/ sdun so la mdun sa dang / 'du ba'i gnas la 'dun sa zer te/ 'jug yul la ma bltos par gang rung sbyar ba nor ro/ /da tshur(mtshur)dang dar tshur gnyis las/ da tshur ni tshur rigs bzhi'i dkar tshur gyi ming dang / dar tshur ni tsha la'i ming yin pas don mi bcig pas/ skabs gang thob tu 'jug par bya /phyu ba dang chu ba gnyis las/ snam du'i lu la phyu ba zer/ de char gos byed nyan par bsams nas chu ba zhes bris pa mi 'grig chu ba ni me tog lta bu'i yu ba'i ming dang / rgyus pa'i don la'ang 'jug go /bye ma dang bye ma don mi gcig sbyar byung dang rang byung gi khyad par yod/sman phye ma dang / rdo bye ma lta du/ gcig gcig gi dod du sbyar mi rung ngo / /brgya tham pa las bcig tsam yod tshod la brgya lam dang / lam chen la rgya 712

yig nor 'byung rkyen da ba'i gnyen po1la zer/ brgya lam na zhes par༄ lam na ltar sbyar ba bzugs so/ /'bu dang srin bu'i 'jug yul la khyab che chung gi khyad par yod de/ srog chags phra mo'i rigs spyi la 'a4 zer zhing / de rnams las ha cang phra zhing nad rgyu byed pa'i rigs la srin bu zer te/ so srin/ sna srin/ zhes pa lta bu1 des na srin bu'i dod du/ 'buXdang srin ngo bo mi gcig pa'i ming gnyis gcig tu sbyar nas/ srin 'khu zhes bris pa ma dag pa'o/ / mtho ba dang / mthon po'i ngo bo mi gcig ste/ snga ma khyad chos mtshod pa'i ming yin/ de la rjes 'jug na sbyar ba'i mthon po ni/ dngos po'i mibaXdu gyur pa yin pas/ mtho ba dang mthon po'i dbye ba ma zud la/ mtho po zhes bris pa nor ro/ /de bzhin/ rdon po la no po dang / chen po la che po sogs su bris pa ma dag pa yin pa lha du sogs so/ /don tshan gsum pa/ yig skyon sel ba'i gnyen po/yi ge'i— dag cha gdon pa la/ dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho mchog gis/rang gis mthong ba'i dag yig re la mdzub mo ri ston byed pa las/ rgyu mtshan gzhan med na 'thad po zhig ma logs te/ gzur gdas dam dpyod kyi me long mnga' ba tsho'i thugs la sdoms/ sum rtags kyi rnam gzhag blo mun blol ba'i 'od snang zhes bya ba zhu dag mdzad pa'i gsung sgros las/ gsungs pa bzhin/713

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon phyungaming gang la yi ge gang bab/ dag pa yin min/ sgra rig pas brdar sha gcad dgos/ de yang yi ge skyed byed kyi rgyu ste/ gnas dang byed pa rlung dang rnam rtog legs par shes thog ming gi byung tshul 'phel tshul dang / ming gi ngo bo 'gyur tshul dang / sgra gdangs mthun par 'gyur tshul dang / sdeb legs par sbyor tshul sogs kyang legs par shes dgos/ brda dag ming tshig gsal ba zhes bya ba las/ ming mang bo re la 'bri tshul gnyis gsum re byung ba las/mang phyogs gong gsal dag ma dag gi rted par yin/ nyung phyogs rags par bshad na 'grigs te/ don gzhan ston par mi 'gyur zhing / zhib tu bshad na/don ston tshul la zhib cha'i dbye ba'ang yo da do/ /de yang gtso bo phyogs gsum yod de/dang bo/ gdam nga'i thad du/nyung zad las phal cher sngon 'jug da dang mgo 'jog dag klog tshe/sgra'i byed rtsol dang lci yang ha lam mtshungs par gyur pas/ tshig sbyor du das 'phul can dang / mgo can dag gdam nga can du 'jug par gyur song yang /rigs pas dpyad na/ lhag pa gang 'os tshad mar bzung na legs snyam ste/skrag pa'i don la dngangs dang / sngangs gang rung 'jug kyang / rgyugs che ba la snga ma bris na legs/ ngar 'jom pa la dpa' bkong ba dang / spa bkong ba gang rung bab kyang / spa mdzes rkyen dag la'ang 'jug pas/ dpa' bris na go 714

yiganor 'byung rkyen sel ba'i gnyed po/bde'o/ 1chu'i 'bur bu rdos pa la spu ba dang dbu ba gang rung chog kyang / dbu ni mgo dang dbus la 'jug pas/ spu ba sbyar na bzang ngo / /ngan bshad pa la dma' 'bebs pa dang / sma 'bebs pa gang rung chog kyang / kha spu la sma ra 'jug pas/ dma' sbyar na go bde'o/ /chu rlabs la rba dang dba' gang yang rung mod/ rgyugs che ba la rba sbyar na legs snyam mo/ /bud med la mo dman dang mo sman las/ spyir mo dman bris pa mang ( bud med mchob ba mo sman zhes ched du sbyar ba yang yod mod/ don du mi pho la skye bas mtho dang / mi mo la skye bas dman zhes mngon par brjod pas gas / mdzes pa'i nyams can la mchor sgog dang / 'phyor sgeg gang rung bris kyang / don du snga ma dag par mngon no/ /sras pa'i ldog zla la mthug po dang / 'thug po gnyis las/ 'brog skad lhar na snga ma dag pa lha bu sogs rigs bsgro bar bya'o— /gnyis pa/ sdeb sbyor gyi thad du/ngag gi snyan cha gdon par/ rjes 'jug gi ming mtha' 'dren bar brjod bde ba zhig dang / ming gi cha shas gnyis kyi sgra shed mnyam pa'am ha lamamanyam pa zhig dang / dbyangs kyi nga ro phan tshun mi thogs pa zhig dgos/ spyir ming gi sdeb sbyor ni/ kha la brjod bde ba dang / rna bar gdangs snyan pa zhig dgos pa'i dbang gis/ mi la lar de bzhin byung ma byung gi 'bri tshul gnyis re byung ba yin te/ rtsom rigs shig la snyan dngags dang / snyan ngag 'bri 716

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon snang—tshul gnyis yod/ snga ma ni bad rnyir ste/ rtags mtshungs sbyar cing sgra shed mnyam lci byas nas/ sdeb sbyor gyi mchog byin pa dang / phyi ma ni sgra zur chag nas go bde ba lhar bris pa yin no/ /lus po phyir dkan nas nyal ba'am log pa la/ gan kyal dang / gan rkyal gnyis las/ sgra shed bsnyam par rkyal gyi lci cha dor nas gan sprul du bris pa yin/ gnam ngos dwangs sang nge la sngo bsangs dang / sngo sangs gnyis las/ sngo'i sgra lci bas/ sangs la bas 'phul nas sgra shed bsnyams pa yin/ dngos po'i cha shas chung ngu'i ming la/ zegs ma dang / gzegs ma gnyis las/ sgra lci yang shed bsnyam par gas 'phul dor ba yin/ phyogs gnyis su ma gtogs pa la— phungaXsum pa dang / phung gsum pa gnyis las/ mo yis mo yi ming mtha' drangs pa lhar gas 'phul dor ba yin/smad gos la sham thabs dang / gsham thabs ba nyis las/ gsham gyi sgra rtsi bas gas 'phul dor nas shed mnyam par byas pa yin/ ske tshe'i rigs shig la/yungs kar dang / yungs dkar gnyis las/ pho yis pho yi ming mtha' drangs pa ltar gas 'phul dor ba yin/ bshang lam mdo khar byung ba'i rma 'brum la/gzhang 'brum dang / shang 'brum 'dzi tshul gnyis las/ bshang gi sgra ji yang du btang nas gzhang du bsgyur byung ba red/ zog gi rigs shig la ba lang dang / ba glang gnyis las/ snang gi sgraXlci ba yang bar byas nas ba lang du bris so/ /sems dga' ba la yi rang ba dang — yid rang ba gnyis dang /716

yig nor 'byung rkyen sel ba'i gnyed po—sems sdug pa la yi nug pa dang / yid mug pa gnyis dag mo yis mo yi ming mtha' drangs pa lhar/ yi'i rjes 'jug da bsubs pa sogs/ sdeb sbyor du ngag gi dpal bskyed pa yin pas/ de ltar bris na legs par sems so/ /gsum pa/ ming gi ngo bo 'gyur ba'i thad du/ming la la'i 'bri tshul gnyis rim gyis brten cing 'brel ba'i ngo bo gnyis ston par gyur pa yang yod/ de dag gi khyad par gtso bo ni/ sngon 'jug yod med du byas pa yin/ sngon 'jug da dang mgo 'jog gis dbye ba mdzad pa yang yod/ de rnams mkhas dbang gang gis gtan la phab pa min gyi/ yi ge'i lag len du ma bgros rang mthun du grub pa yin/ dper na/ dmar ba/zhes bya ba1 mtshal mdog dang / sha khrag gi dpe dang / gal bo che dang / nor khyad par ba sgor mo sogs la 'jug pa/ dmar po mtshal 'dra'i gros shig byed/(bya sprel gtam rgyud las)ces dang / nya dmar dad che bas lcags kyo zhi sha la khyud mid byas/ (dpe chos rin spungs las)zhes dang / gsung gleng shin tu dmar ba gnang / (bla ma dkar po'i rnam thar las)zhes dang / nor gang dmar khyer ba'i dbang mo che/ (mi la'i rnam thar las)zhes pa sogs kyis gsal/ rim gyis don snga ma gnyis la dmar dang / don phyi ma gnyis la smar zhes pa 'jug ste/ sgra 'dra yang yig gzugs mi 'dra bas don gyi ngo bo mi gcig pa ston par gyur song / grangs kyi dgu ni grangs ngesaXng1 dang / grangs 717

dag yig rig pa'i gab 21 1ngon pangamang bo la'ang 'jug mod/ rim gyis grangs mang bo shā rgu skyar—nas/ skye dgu la ha lam skye rgu lhar bris pa'i khyad byung / sgos su bya ba'i ming dngos po'i ming du 'jug sto 'das pa'i sngon 'jug dor nas khyad par bstan pa mang / bya ba 'das pa bton pa zhes pa'i sngon 'jug ba dor nas/ kha rton zhes gdon bya'i ming du grub pa yin pas/ kha 'don du bris pa ma dag pa'o— /'khebs pa ni bdag dang 'brel ba'i bya ba bkab pa zhes par brten nas byung ba'i gzhan dang 'brel ba'i bya ba 'das pa yin la1 kun khebs zhes nam mkha'i ming du 'jug tshe/ 'as 3ra phul dor dgos mod/ ma dor ba ni ming gi ngo bo 'gyur ba'i rtags ma thon pa red/ gshags pa ni bya ba'i ming ste1 dngos po'i ming du 'jug tshe/ gas 'phul dor ba yin/ des na shags 'byed pa dang /gshags 'byed pa gnyis las— snga ma 'grig 'a1/ phyi ma nor ro/ /bya ba'i ming 'khor ba zhes pa'i 'as 'phul dor na dngos po'i ming du 'gyur bas/ khor mo yug ces pa dag cing / 'khor mo yug ces pa ma dag pa'o/ /bya ba'i ming mthun pa zhes pa'i mas 'phul dor na dngos po'i ming du gyur pas/ thun mong la mthun mong du bris pa nor ro/ /yang / grangs ka'i ming — bcig gnyis/gsum dag dngos po'i ming du sbyar na/ gas 'phul dor ba yin pa1sa/ chig brgyud/ nyis thog sum mdo sogs la/ gcig brgyud/ gnyis thog gsum mdo sogs su bris pa ma dag pa'o// //718

ming gi 'grel ba shes bya'i 'jug ngogs/snge tshan nyer gsum pa/ ming gi 'grel ba shes bya'i 'jug ngogs/e ma shes bya pha mtha' yas/ /de dag re re'i ming gi yang / /rgyu mtshan nges tshig ma shes na/ /brda dag sbyor ba ji lhar shes/ /zhes rje sa paṇa gyi gsung 'dis/ brda sprod par ming don legs par go ba ha cang gal che bar bstan byung / brtsams chos gang yang tshig gi 'phreng ba spel nas grub pa yin/ tshig gi sgrub byed de ming so so'i don yang dag par go na/ tshig gi 'jal lon pas/ gzhung gi sgo brgya 'byed pa'i 'phrul gyi lde mig lag tu chud la/ des na/ ming don yang dag par dgral ba ni/ dpe cha blta ba/'chad nyan bya ba/ rtsom rgyag pa/ dag yig ming mdzod bsgrig pa sogs la go ches che ba chod pa yin no/ /de yang / ming gi ngo bo yang dag par shes na/ gzod ming don yang dag par dgral thub— ming dang tshig yang dag par brten nas/ go brda ji lha ba bzhin du sprod thub/ dpe khrid du/ ming dang tshig gi dka' gnad dgral ba ni 719

dab yig rig pa'i gab 21 mngon༄ ngab ba —ba babya ba gal chen zhig yin/ dge rgan gyib bslab bya'i nang gi ming dang tshis ko dka' ba gang ci tshad ma dang ldan par bkral nas/ slob ma rnams kyiXrgyud la 'jags na/ slob ma tshos ming gi 'jug pa dang / tshig gi spyor baXlegs par shes thog ba zhung gi don la go ba rje zab dang 1 rtsom rgyab pa'i nus pa'ang ji cher gtang thub/ gal te ming gi rgyu mtshan legs pa1ram rtobs na/ tshig sbyor du brjod bya ji bzhin 'jug pa'i gdeng tshod mi zin— tha na zhwa dpe lham 'gebs byas pa'i thang yang 'byung srid/ ming mdzod lha bu bzag par 'gre' ma dag pa dang / sgos su 'grel nyes byung na/ mkhas pa 'phyugs na 'dom bang 1 zhes gnod pa che/ dper na/ tshig mdzod cig tu/ mda' ra ni1 mda' shubs yin pa ma go nas/ yig ngo lhar mda' 'phen sa'i ra ba yin/ zhes bkral snang bar— shes pas mthong na dgod bro ba dang — mi shes nga1sa mthong na1ma yin yin mdog tu 'dzin pa'i 'khrul snang 'byung la/ des na/ ming don dgral lugs dang dgral thabs legs par shes dgos/ /don tshan dang bo/ ming don dgral lugs/dang bo/ lta ba yang dag pa zhig dgos/ sgra di brngod 'dod rjes 'brang pyir/ skad rigs gcig tu/ ming gi tha snyad gang dang gang yin pa/ thun mong du grags pa dang / mthun par snang ba zhig yin pas/ phan tshun go brda legs par 'phrod pa yin/ ming don bkral 720

ming gi 'grel ba shes bya'i 'jug ngogs—na yab / zu1 bgros rang mthun gyi spyi tshogs kyi snang ba 'di dang bstun dgos/yin na yang / mi snams kyi lha ba mi gcig pas/ steng gi bkod pa dang / 'du shes 'dzin stangs thad kyi ming la la'i go ba len tshul dang / 'grel rgyag tshul don gyi ngo bo dang thod mi thug sa yod/ dper na/ dpyad rtsom 'ig las1 bod ljongs kyi 'grel du/ bod ljongs bskal ba ya thog nas krung go rgyal khab kyi mnga' khongs yin/ zhes pa chab srid kyi phyogs 'then ma gtogs/ don du yon rgyal rabs nas krung go'i mnga' khongs su 'dus pa yin no/ /chags sdang gi 'grel du/ chags zhen dang zhe sdang ste/ de la gral rim dbye zhib kyi lha tshul yod dgos/ zhes don med kyi rnga ma zhig sprad byung / skad cha la gral rim gyi rang bzhin med de/ spyi tshogs yongs kyi brda zod byed thun mong ba zhig yin pas/ ming gi ngo bo je bzhin gsong bor dgral ba las/ gral rim gyi lta ba'am/zab srid kyi dmigs yul dang 'brel nas 'khyog bshad byed mi nyan/ /gnyis pa/ tshad ma dang ldan pa zhig dgos/ming di sgra don gnyis kyi 'dren ma yin zhing / sgra mi gcig pas don mi gcig pa mtshon pa yin pas/ sgra mi gcig pa'i zhib cha ngag tu brjod pa lhag par dag na/ don so so ba'i ngo bo yid la shar ba lhag par gsal ba chos nyid yin/ ming don dgral bar/ ming gang gi rjod byed sgra dang / bstan bya'i don zung du 'brel nas go ba yang dag pa zhig led dgos/ nges shes ma 'drongs 721

dab yig rig pa'i gab 1mngon(1ngan/ 'grel nyes 'byung kho thag red/ des na ming gi 'jug yu'1 dang khyab che chung nges dgos par ma zad/ ming la la btags ming du 'jug pa dang / ming la la don du mar 'jug pa yang yod/ ming la la yul lam dus kyi dbang gis don gyi ngo bo 'gyur ba yang yod pa la sogs nga1ra gsal bdakar ba zhig ma shes na/ 'grel la dag cha 'thon dka'/ dper na/ kug pa ni/ sgra 'byung ba'i don yin mod/ bod rgya tshig mdzod chen mo las/ thos pa dang shes pa'i dod du bkral nas/ dper brjod du/ nga la skad cha khyad mtshar po zhig grag byung zer(༅bka 11 —ba'i da tshe)/ de yang / bya tshis tshig mdzod du/ ji ma ji bzhin du ngo bshus byas snang / 'di ni ma dag rgyun 'byams ma yin nam/'dun ma ni gros tshogs kyi ming yin mod/ dag yig gsar bsgribs su/ gros byas nas thag gcod rgyu'i don gal chen gyi ming / zhes bkral ba dag pas dben pa'o/ /khrems pa ni/ gzhan dang 'brel ba'i bya ba ste/ bkram nas khrems pa zer ba/ khyab pa'i don dang phal cher 'dra'o/ /'di la tshig mdzod cig tu/ thim pa dang sim pa/ zhes bkral ba gtan nas mi 'grig dag yig la lar/ bkra pa'i don du bkral ba/ bkram ba1 dang khrems nga1 nya nyung mnyam du bsres so/ /bkram pa ni/ bdag dang 'brel ba'i bya ba ste— byed po'i rtsol ba dang 1 khrems pa ni/ gzhan dang 'grel ba'i bya ba ste/ las kyi 'gyur ba dang /'grams pa ni/ bdag gzhan gang la'ang ma 'bre1 ba ste/ ngang gis byung ba 722

ming gi 'grel ba shes bya'i 'jug ngogasayin/ bya ba rigs gsum ni/ bod skad la yod pa'i khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa zhig yin/ rigs 'di gsum gyi dbye ba legs par shes na/ zhwa dpe lham 'gebs kyi skyon mi 'byungaXngo 1 /spyir ming gi sgyu mtshan bstan par/ chad lhag nor gsum med par tshad ma dang ldan pa zhig bya rgyu ha cang gal che'o/ /gsum pa/ kha gsal zhing go sla ba zhig dgos/ming tshig gsal ba med na ni/ /don mtshon brjod pa kun kyang med/ /ces gsungs pa lhar/ 'grel rgyag don ni/ go dka' ba go sla bar byed pa yin pas/ 'grel du sbyar ba'i tshig dang dper brjod kha gsal zhing go bde ba zhig dgos/ dper na/ sgyud paXni/ lag pa gnyis bsrings nas pang du 'khyud par byed pa/ sdong rgan mi gnyis kyis lag gdang byas nas bsgyud kyang mi 'khyud rto bu zhes pa lhar ro/ /'grel ba go dka' na don gyis dben te/ rdung deg la nyes gtag ces bkral ba/ 'grel byed dgral bya las go dka' bar byas pa phan thogs ci yod/gta' ma ni/ bu lod 'jal rgyu'i dmigs rten dngos po rin can/ zhes bkral ba yang cung zad go dka'/ de la sgor mo bskyis pa dus su sbyin pa'i khag theg tu bskyi yul la bzhag pa'i nor rdzas yin zhe na/ bde blag tu go 'gro'o/ /ming la la'i rgyu mtshan ci zhig yin pa bstan pa tsam gyis nges shes bsnyed dka'/ de ji ltar yin pa'am/ ci phyir yin pa dag kyang bstan byung na/723

dag yig rig pa'i gab ba1 mngon snang/'grel ba'i mchog yin/ dper na/ la gdong ni1 sgal tshigs kyi mar sne'i gzhug chung ste/ rus pa de'i dbyibs wa skyes kyi gdong dang 'dra bas wa gdong zer/ zhes dang / spur len ni/ spos shel te/ cung zad brdar na rdul lam spur ma len pa'i phyir/ zhes pa dag las/ don kyi ngo bo dang nges tshig gnyis ka shes la/ nges tshig las ji lhar yin pa dang / ci phyir yin pa shes pas/ blo la nges pa brjed med du 'gyur la/ 'grel ba kha gsal zhing ko bde bar/ tshig ngos gtsang rgyu ha cang gal che/ tshig ldab ldib kyis go brda legs par 'phrod dka'/ dper na/ sga/ zhes pa'i dper brjod du/ rta khal gyi dka' ngal gso len byed dus gcig nas gcig tu sga spo ba/ zhes pa'i 'grel la brten na/ ci yang go rgyu med do/ /bzhi ba/ tshig nyung la don tshang ba zhig dgos/'grel byed kyi tshig nyung na 'khyer bde/ don tshang na mthil rtogs/ de yang tshig nyung na bzang yang 'ol spyi tsam du gyur na/ nges nga1 ster dka'/dper na/ spun ni rigs kyi nye du/ zhes bkral—ba las/ go ba yang dag pa zhig lon dka'/ de la phu nu/ zhes bkral na/ tsheg dbar de 'a1sa tung zhing don yang tshang bas nges pa bskyed thub/ ba dam ni/ sran ma'i bye brag cig ces bkral pa las/ sran ma rigs mang bas gang yin mi shes/ de me tog gad shul gyi gzhung rta sa la zug nas 'bras bu gang bu can thogs pa zhis(cho16 cho)724

ming gi 'grel ba shes bya'i 'jug ngogs/yin zer na go brda 'phrod 'gro'o/ /tsha ba gsum 'i/ sman tsha ba gsum/ zhes bkralaXkyang / sman tsam las gang gab yin pa mi shes/ 'grel de las sga skya dang / pi pi ling dang / pho ba ris gsum bstan yod na/ don cha tshang zhig go bar 'jug thub bo/ /don tshan gnyis pa/ ming don dgral thabs/ming sna tshogs kyi grub lugs mi gcig pas/ dgral thabs kyang gang la gang 'tshams shig dgos1 dag yig dang ming mdzod dmas kyi 'grel bar bltas na/ dgral thabs gtso bo lnga snang / don gsal bar byed ched/ de rnams las la la phan tshun sdeb chog go /dang bo/ mtshan nyid ston pa'i thabs/gtso cher ming gi cha shas gang yang bsdu mi rung ba'i ming rkyang ba'i rigs la 'jug pa yin/ dper na/spren ni/ rlangs pa bar snang du 'phags pa/ grang reg dang phrad nas chu rdul phra mor chags pa'i tshogs pa'o/ /lhang ba ni/ snod drug gi ya gyal dri chu gsog sdod de/ lus kyi chu khams snyigs ma spos/ /dgang ba ltar du gnas pas na/ /lgang ba zhes par btags pa yin/ /'o shang ni/ zhag bzhabs shul gyi 'o ma'o/ /725

dag yig rig pa'i gab 1mngon kungaganyen po ni/ log phyogs 'joms par byed pa'i stobs rte/ nad kyi gnyen po smad dang / khong khro'i gnyen po bzod pa1 lha bu'o/ /dngaXyan ni/ nang rgyus phyi'i dgra la skyel mi'o/ /mas dben spun ni/ pha gcig kyang ma mi gcig nga1'i pū nu'o/ / stong thun ni/ gzhung gcig mthar chags su bshad pa1 ma yin par/gzhung mang bo'i gnad ka blangs nas/ sman thun sna ra tshan tshan du bsdus pa'i bshad tshul lo/ /sde tshan ni/ mtshungs pa rnams bsdus pa'i 'dus ma'o/ /brda chos ni/ go brda sprod pa'i mtshon rtags/ dga' 'dun ni/ spro ba skyed pha'i tshogs nga1'o1 /'grul rgya ni/ grong khyer ram yul gru zhig du rkyen ngan byung bar/ dus nges can zhig tu 'grul mtshams bcad pa'i bya thabs yinabargya lam ni/ brgya tham pa las gcig tsam yod tshod kyi don/skyom pa ni/ chu sogs sdod du 'khrom par byed nga1 ste/ ma 'ongs pa la bskyam pa dang / 'das pa la bskyams pa dang / ska'1༷tshig 'a1 skyoms so/ /'khyur ba ni/ gzhan dang 'brel ba'i byab ste ba'i ra nas 'khyur ba/ lha du'o//gshang ba ni/ ku re byed pa'i tshig ste/ dngos su bshad pa min/ gshang ba 726

ming gi 'grel ba 4sa bya'i 'jug ngogs/byas pa yin/ zer ba lha bu'o/ /gnyis pa/ nges tshig ston pa'i thabs/gtso cher tsheg dbar ram tshig sna bsdus pa'i ming 'dus ma'i rigs la 'jug pa yin/dkar yol ni/ 'thung snad de/ rdo dkar gong tsha la dang sbyar nas bzos pa'i yol go'o/ / 'gram stegs ni/ me 'khor 'tshom sa'i lcags lam 'gram gyi stegs ma'o1 /thog shas ni/ sa bogs te/ zhing bdag la sprud bya'i lo thog gi cha shas so/ /rdo rgyus di/ rdo'i rigs sra la mnyed pa rgyus ka lha bu zhig tsha spubs btum spyad sogs su bkol bka /glang shu ni/ glang jig gi gnya' ko lta bu mthug cing mkhregs pa shu thor yang 'byung ba'i pags nad rigs shig 'bur len ni/ shing leb ngos kyi 'khur sa blangs nas mnyam par byed spyad/sog rdul ni/ sog les dras pa'i shing rdul/'dus byas ni/ rgyu dang rkyen rnams 'dus par byas pa'i chos so cog go/ 727

dag yig rig pa'i gab 21 mngon sgyungamajal dum ni/ phan tshun zhal mja'1 nas 'dum pa1ra byas pa'i dam ban chen / zlos gar ni/ ngag nas bzlas shing gar du bsgyur ba'i rol rtsed cig go/rigs lam ni/ tshad ma dang ldan 4ra bang rigs su bshadang1'i ngag gi ma ma dka/ / rgyal rong ni/ rgyal mo tsha ba rong ste/ lha chen rkyal mo mu rdo na yod pas rgyal mo dang / de gar tsha ba cung che bas tsha bdang / zhing 'debs kyin yod — —— —pas rong zhe'o/ /—chu zheng gab pa ni/ chu ring ba dang / zheng yangs nga1 gnyis ka'i tshad phan tshun gab pa'o/ /6nga shā me shor ni/ rig pa rdo zhing ldobs skyen pa'i dpe ste/ shes rab spang la me shor/ /brtson 'grus brag la mda' zug /ces pa'i gtam dpe las byung ba'i dpe chos/bum pa gang byo ni1 bdud rtsi bum pa gang bo snod gzhan du byo yags byas pa ste/ bu slob rnams la rang gis shes pa yod tshad gang thub kyis slob pa'i dpe'o/ /dud 'gro'i me ni/ mkhris pas zas skom dmas 'ju bar byed pas na/ me zhes bya ste/ dud 'gro'i mkhris pa'i nang du chags pa'i gi wang ngo / / 728

ming gi 'grel ba shes bya'i 'jug ngogasalu ra skad chen ni/ bong bu ste/ des lan rer wa ra wa ra zhes skad che bar sgrog pas so/ /gsum pa/ dbye ba ston pa'i thabs/ming gi tshogs pa dang chos kyi dam grangs sogs la 'jug pa yinadaper na/rgyu rkyen gyi rgyu ni/ 'bras bu'i ngo bo skyed byed dang / rkyen ni 'bras bu'i khyad par skyed byed de/ rgyu sa bon grung bo dang / rkyen lud dang drod gsher lta bu'o/ /bad kan gyi bad ni/ chu dang / kan ni sa ste/ lus kyi sa chu'i khams gnyis kyi ming ngo / /thabs shes zung 'jug ni/ thabs bkod pa dang / blo shes rab mnyam du 'jug pa'o/ /ngag gi rtsal gsum ni/ lo rgyus kyis dge thon pa/ gtam gyis bzhad gad thon pa/ shags kyis pha rol non pa'o/ /bka' pod lnga ni/ lha ba gtan la 'bebs pa dbu ma dang tshad ma gnyis/sgom pa gtan la 'phebs pa mdzod dang phar phyid gnyig spyod lam gtan la 'bebs pa 'dul ba ste/ bka' po nyi lnga'o/ /dge ba bcu3/ mi dge— ba bcu spangs shing / de'i gnyen po dkar po'i 129

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa rngo1ngon phyung 1phyogs rnams nyams su len pa ste/ srog gcad pa 1/ngas nas sems can gyi srog bskyab da ngos/ ma byin par len pa spangs nas sbyin pa gtang dgos/'dod 'o1ga spangs nas chul khrims bsrung dgos/ rdzun spangs nas bden par spu dgos/ phra ma spangs nas 'khon pa bsdum dgos— tshig tsub spangs nas rnyan par spru dgos / ngag ‘kar la spangs nas kha ton bya dgos/ brnal sems spangs nas gtong sems 'chang dgos/ gnod sems spangs nas phan sems bsgom dgos— log lha spangs nas yang dag pa'i lngaXb rgyud la bsten dgos pa bcas so /sdug bsngal brgyad ni/ 'dod pa btsal kyang mi snyed pa/ mi 'dod pa spangs kyang mi 'phang ba/ dgra sdang ba dang phrad pa/ gnyen byams pa dang bral ba ni phyi'i sdug bsngal bzhi'o/ /snye rga na 'chi ni nang gi sdug bsngal bzhi'o/ /phar phyin drug ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug ste/ sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod pa gsum ni bsod nams kyi tshogs dang / bsam gtan shes rab gnyis ni ye shes kyi tshogs dang / brtson 'grus di gnyis kar gtogs so/ /sa yi dge bcu ni/ bam 'brog rgyang 'brog 'brog gi dge /khang sa zhing sa sa yi dge —'thung chu yur chu chu yi dge /khang no 'thag rdo rdo yi dge /khang shing bud shing shing gi dge'o/ /grags pa nyams pa'i rgyu drug ni/ rgyan 'gyed pa/ 'dus pa la lha ba1 le 730

ming gi 'grel bshes bya'i 'jug ngogasalo/ chang 'thung ba/ sdig grogs bsten pa/ mtshan mo grong du 'gro ba'o/ /bzhi ba/ gzhan dag ston pa'i thabs/ming gi rnam grangs dang / ming gcig don du ma dang ldan pa'i rigs la 'jug pa ste/ dpe khrid sogs su ming gang gi skabs bab kyi brjod don de nyid bstan pa tsam gyis chog mod/ ming mdzod lha bu bsgrig par/ ming gang gi rnam grangs gzhan dag gam/ ming gang gi 'jug don gzhan dag dang / ming de las 'phros pa'i don gzhan dag kyang so sor drangs nas stan dgos/dper na/pa yag ni/ sngo sman zhig ste/ ro mngar la kha/ zhu rjes bsil/ rtsa bas glo nad sel/ glo rnag 'dren/ lo mas rma gso/ 'bras bus snying nad sel/ ming gi dam grangs la/ skye ba rgyun gcod/ kho yag pa/ rgyal bo gtsug na nor bu/ thog nag mgo dgu— bya rog nor du/ bya rog bu/ lug snying / shu ba tog len1 ma byag bcas so /shing gi lha mo ni/ a ru ra'i ming gi rnam grangs shig ste/ lha rnams kun gyi bdud rtsi ma ru ra/ /de phyir me la'i rgyal bo zer/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyi nor bu ste/ /de phyir gtsug gi nor bu zer/ /mi dmas kun gyi nad sel sman/ /de phyir smad mchog rgyal bo zer/ /klu rnams kun gyi rtsos sel rtsi/ /de phyir gser sgong zur mang zer/ /'gro drug sdug bsngal skyob pa'i ma/ /de phyir shing gi lha mo zer//731

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon snang—dom mkhris ni/ mkhris pa'i mchog ste/ rtsa kha 'dzin/ rma gso/ mkhris nad sel/ mig nad la phan/ ming gi dam grangs la/ thugs kar me mnyam/ nag po bcad 'byor/ g.ya' kyi bcad 'byor/ rtsa sdom shugs chen/ srog gi me tog sogs yod/ yos ni/ 1 mi yul du 'tsho 'i ri bong gi rigs/ 2 gro nas lha bu sla ngar g.yos pa'i tshos ma'o — zhag ni/ 1 nyi ma snang ba'i cha la nyin dang / nub pa'i cha laXmatshan zhes/nyin mtshan phrugs gcig la zhag zer/ 2 'o ma'i kha'i snum/ ka tshil bzhus nas sra chags ma chags gnyis la'ang 'jug 'dab lo ni/ me tog gi 'dab ma ste/ 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas lo ma dang / gshog pa la'ang 'jug go /gzhan yang / tshigasaXbacad gcig gi phyed snga ma'am zud phyi ma la'ang 'jug go /rgyab yol ni/ gar stegs rgyab ngos kyi mtshon ris te/ deng / don rkyen la shan zhugs pa'i khor yug dang 'brel ba la nga 'jug pa/ chab srid kyi rgyab yol dang / lo rgyus kyi rgyab yol zer ba lha bu/ —rgyang grags ni/ gzhu 'dom lnga brgya'i bar thag ste/ dung gus pa'i sgra rgyang thag de tsam du grags pa thos pa'i phyir/ deng / kun khyab rlung 'phrin la'ang 'jug go /732

mib gi 'grel ba shes bya'i 'jug jogasaskyon pa ni/ 1 gon par byed pa ste/ shā skyon pa lta bu/ 2 zhon par byed pa ste/ rta la skyon pa lha bu/ sha gnam la gzar ste/ gsal shing la skyon pa lha bu'o/ / gzhen pa ni/ 1— dran par byed pa ste1 dran bskul la gzhen bskul zer ba lha bu/ 2 'a ra bar byed paXste/ sku gdung zhugs la gzhen pa lha du'o/ /rum ni/ 1 mngal gyi brda rnying ste/ ma'i rum 5 bu zags lta bu/ 2 lu ba'i sko rags yan gyi pang khong ste/ rum la bus pa bcug lha bu/ ka pang du dro bar byed pa ste/ bya mos sgo nga rum lta bu/ 4nang gi don te/ smin rum nas char ba babs lha bu'o/ /spro ba ni/ dga' ba dang ming mtha' med pa'i sbo ni/ khro ba'i don te/ smo langs pa zer ba lta bu dang /bsgral ba ni/ skyob pa dang gsod pa la 'jug pa rnams ni/ sgra gcig gis log phyogs kyi mtha' gnyis ston pa can no/ /lnga ba/ gtam rgyud ston pa'i zabs/gtam rgyud las byung ba'i ming dang mngon brjod sogs la 'jug pa yin/ — hor 'dra ni/ bcings grol sngon du bod sde ba gnung gi sku tshab bang chen la hor 'dra zer/ don ni de tsho sngar yon rgyal rabs ring gi hor gyi sne mo ba 733

dag yig rig pa'i gab pa mngon snang rnams 'dra bar drag pa'i phyir/shor gsum byung ni/ chag sgo du ma byung bar 'phya ba'i dpe ste/ sngar grwa pa gcig grong chog tu song bar/ dgung mo grong ba dag gis de'i tshul khrims dag min tshod bgam ched/ chang dam be gang dang / rtsid bu gcig dang / bud med gcig dang bcas spud par/ dpe med mi dgos zer/ gsum las gcig cis kyang blang bar nan gyis zhus pas/ chang dam pe gang blangs/ chang 'thungs nas bzi bas/ ra yang bshas/ bud med la yang 'byar bas/ shor gsum byung zhes grags so/ /'dre 'jig zang chu ni/ gu gul te/ sngon phyag na rdo rjes ma 'ongs par 'gro ba rnams la mi min gyi gnod pa 'byung bar dgongs nas/ de'i gnyen por shing 'dre 'jigs kyi sa bon btab pas/ bden pa'i mthus skyes shing /de'i thang chu'i dri ma ldang ba'i dpag tshad tsam gyi sar 'dre gdon rnams nye mi nus shing 'jigs par byed pas na/ ming yang de ltar grags so/ /me tog lug mig ni/ sngo sman rgyal ba'i spyan can gyi ming ste/ dri med shel phreng las/ sngod tshe rgyal bo yul 'khor srung gi bu'i thu bo rgyal bo bshes gnyen bya bas lha dang drang srong la mchod sbyin rgya chen byas pa'i tshe drang srong rakta na re/ ma hā de ba kun gyi mjug tu spyan drongs byas pas/ lha chen po mjug tu spyan drangs pa la ma mnyes te/ khros nas dad ba nas mig ser la 'bur ba 7 34

ming gi 'grel ba shes bya'i 'jug ngogs——gsum byung nas/ bang du ba lhas pa'i yu —za du nad 'du brnam pa bzhi byung /chung ma nam gru re tī dang rlung lha'i lag tu nad rkyal bskur te gtor bas/ mi la rims nad byung ba rim pas 'gos/ de dag gis gar ba lhas kyi sa la nad dam pa sna tshogs/ skyes pa de gang gis lan gzhan gyis ma shes/ 'phags pa 'jam dpa za gyis nad dbang phyug chen pos btang ba mkhyen te1 lha mo lug skyes ma yu ma de wa'i mig blangs te/ rgyal ba'i spyan du byin gyis brlabs nas/nad de dag gi gnyen por smon lam btab nas sa la btab pas/ nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i gnyen por 'phrod pa'i me shāg sngon po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa skyes/ de lha mo lug skyes ma'i mig 'a sa byung bas/ lug mib tu grags so/ /zhes byung /gzhon nu gdong drug ni/ nu stegs kyi 'khor du gtogs pa'i lha zhig ste/rig byed kyi gtam rgyud du/ dbang phyug chen po dang su ma ga3s snyoms par zhugs pa'i dus su/ drang srong zhig yon slong du byung la/ u ma khros nas da lha'i skabs su slong ba 'di 'dod pa min nam zer nas/ tsā la re zhes— rang gi chos 'byung nas sa bon me 'dag gi phung bor sprus nas khar byin pas/ de kha tshig ste rgya mchos 'gram du bsgyugs nas kha bkrus so1 /de'i tshe gzhon nu ma drug gis rgya mtshor khrus byas pas/ phyag me 'dag gi phung bo de la bsros pas/yid kyi bu gcig byung bas/ nga'i gu yin zer/ drug po rtsod pas/ drug ka mgu 735

dag yig rig pa'i gab mngon sgyungabar bya ba'i phyir gdong drug sprul/ de tshogs bdag dang rtse bas/ sor del gyis tshogs bdag gi mche ba g.yas pa bcag pas/ dbang phyug gis 'di'atshar longs par sod/ de bar ma gsod/ ces gdams pa la nyan pas/dbang phyug gis de gzhon nu nyid du 'dug par byin gyis brlabs pas na/gzhon nu gdong drug ces grags so/ /chu zla snyob pa ni/ ngal ba don med kyi dpe ste sngar dgas tshal zhig tu spre'u mang bo yod pa las/ sprel dpon mtshan ba mor nags 'dabs kyi khron pa'i rtsar phyin pa dang / khron pa'i nang du zla ba dkar lhag ge 'dug pa mthong nas/yar blang snyam pa khos ma lon par/ zla bo kun bos/ gcig gi rnga mar gcig gis 'jus nas khron pa'i gting gi zla ba snyob pa dang khron khar 'thams pa'i spre'u des lngid ma theg ste lag nas shor bas/ spre'u yongs rdzogs khron par rub kyis lhung nas shi skad/'greng brgya kun 'tshal ni/ mi thams cad kyis shes pa ste/ tun hong nas thon pa'i btsad po rim byung gi lo rgyus las/ tseng ldeng gi bra gu dang / /yar lha ni shad po gnyi/ /gang che ni gang chung ba/ /'greng brgya' ni kun kyang 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs snang —/ // 736
